A New Beginning#308.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#309.src: We should t-train together some day.
A New Beginning#309.dst: い、いつか一緒に訓練しよう。
A New Beginning#309.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#311.src: Did you... need help with anything?
A New Beginning#311.dst: 何か… 手伝ってほしいことある？
A New Beginning#311.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#312.src: Mhm! Me, Zeph, Rex, and Mora all, um, have rooms here. Oh, and Syndra, too. And Kaio lives nearby too...
A New Beginning#312.dst: うん！私と Zeph、Rex、Mora は、えっと、ここに部屋があるの。あ、Syndra も。Kaio も近くに住んでて…
A New Beginning#312.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#313.src: I've... been meaning to decorate some more. You know... make it more, um, homely.
A New Beginning#313.dst: もっと飾りつけしようと… 思ってて。ほら… もっと、えっと、家らしく。
A New Beginning#313.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#314.src: ...but life's been getting in the way, I suppose.
A New Beginning#314.dst: …でも、いろいろあって手が回らなくて。
A New Beginning#314.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#315.src: Um! I d-don't, ha, judge me for this, but... I'm, um, writing in my diary.
A New Beginning#315.dst: えっと！わ、私、は、笑わないでね… えっと、日記を書いてるの。
A New Beginning#315.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#316.src: ...a-and before you ask! No!! You're, um, not allowed to read it.
A New Beginning#316.dst: …そ、それと聞かれる前に！だめ！！えっと、読んじゃだめだから。
A New Beginning#316.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#317.src: ...thank you. I'll, um, see you later.
A New Beginning#317.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#318.src: Hmm... Delivering mail from river settlement to {p}... Kaio... Check... Hmmm.
A New Beginning#318.dst: ふむ… 川沿いの集落から {p} への郵便配達… Kaio… 済… ふむ。
A New Beginning#318.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#319.src: Ah! {u}, do you require my assistance?
A New Beginning#319.dst: おや！{u}、何かお手伝いしましょうか？
A New Beginning#319.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#320.src: Ah... You overheard me talking to myself, then. Hoh!
A New Beginning#320.dst: ああ… 独り言を聞かれてしまいましたか。ほほ！
A New Beginning#320.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#321.src: I am just writing and filing some reports I had forgotten about. We are trying to keep better track of our activities throughout the forest, you see.
A New Beginning#321.dst: 忘れていた報告書を書いて綴じているだけです。森での私たちの活動を、もっときちんと記録しようとしていましてね。
A New Beginning#321.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#322.dst: むう… で、呪われとるのか？
A New Beginning#322.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#323.src: Hm... I guess not, thinking on it now. A few years ago, had you asked, I'd've probably said yes. But I don't got the strength in me for it anymore.
A New Beginning#323.dst: ふむ… 今考えると、せんだろうな。数年前に聞かれてたら、たぶんすると言っとった。だがもう、わしにはそんな力は残っとらん。
A New Beginning#323.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#324.src: It's good your arrival has given Syndra and the younguns some hope, for once. We've been a bit, eh... lacking in it lately.
A New Beginning#324.dst: お前さんが来て、Syndra と若いのが珍しく希望を持てたのはいいことだ。ここんとこ、ちいと… 足りとらんかったからな。
A New Beginning#324.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#325.src: I've got no such delusions, unfortunately. I reckon this path only ends in tragedy. But it's not my place to say so, so I don't.
A New Beginning#325.dst: 残念ながら、わしはそんな夢は見とらん。この道は悲劇で終わるだけだと思う。だが言う立場じゃないから、言わん。
A New Beginning#325.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#326.src: Would be good to be proven wrong... but I don't think I will be. I've seen this sorta thing before.
A New Beginning#326.dst: 間違っとったと証明されたらいいんだが… そうはならんだろう。こういうのは前にも見た。
A New Beginning#326.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#327.src: ...what? I got nothin' else to say.
A New Beginning#327.dst: …何だ？もう話すことはないぞ。
A New Beginning#327.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#328.src: Interesting that you're drawn to that grave in particular. S'our latest loss, that'n there.
A New Beginning#328.dst: よりによってその墓に惹かれるとはな。そいつがわしらの一番最近の犠牲者だ。
A New Beginning#328.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#329.src: It's a damn shame. A tragedy each 'n every time, yet still happens often enough to feel routine. But that's life, I reckon.
A New Beginning#329.dst: まったく惜しいことだ。毎回が悲劇なのに、慣れちまうほど頻繁に起きる。だが、それが人生ってもんだろう。
A New Beginning#329.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#330.src: ...did you now? Funny thing to say about a dead man, considering I ain't ever seen you 'round these parts before.
A New Beginning#330.dst: …ほう？死人についておかしなことを言うな。この辺でお前さんを見かけたことなんぞ一度もないのに。
A New Beginning#330.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#331.src: Now, spill. 'Fore I go and tell Synny you ain't no good after all.
A New Beginning#331.dst: さあ、吐け。やっぱりお前さんは駄目だと Synny に言いに行く前にな。
A New Beginning#331.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#332.src: Ah... caught Rex muttering something 'bout that once or twice before. Poor girl... it'd do her well to set it aside, for a time.
A New Beginning#332.dst: ああ… Rex がそのことを一、二度ぼやいとるのを聞いた。かわいそうに… しばらく脇に置いといたほうが、あの子のためだ。
A New Beginning#332.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#333.src: Didn't think much of it, but I suppose you're livin' proof, aren'tcha? Strange as can be...
A New Beginning#333.dst: 大して気にしとらんかったが、お前さんが生きた証拠ってわけか？まったく妙なもんだ…
A New Beginning#333.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#334.src: Say, is the memory wipin' a real thing? Got no damn clue where that theory started, but... well, if one thing's true, why not the rest?
A New Beginning#334.dst: なあ、記憶を消すってのは本当なのか？どこから出た説か見当もつかんが… まあ、一つが本当なら残りもそうだろう？
A New Beginning#334.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#335.src: Damn. Damn. That's rough. That real rough, ain't it. And you're tellin' me that's where he ended up?
A New Beginning#335.dst: くそ。くそっ。ひどい話だ。本当にひどい、そうだろう。で、あいつは最後にそこへ流れ着いたってのか？
A New Beginning#335.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#336.src: Hrm... y'know, it's funny. Big guy like him, you wouldn't take him for a thief. Hard to keep hidden, eh? And yet...
A New Beginning#336.dst: うーむ… なあ、おかしなもんだ。あんな大男、泥棒には見えん。隠れるのも難しいだろう？なのに…
A New Beginning#336.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#337.src: He'd manage to turn blending into a crowd into an art. No matter where he was, who he spoke to, how he was actin', he'd always seem like he fit right in.
A New Beginning#337.dst: あいつは人混みに紛れるのを芸術にしとった。どこにいようと、誰と話そうと、どう振る舞おうと、いつも自然に溶け込んどった。
A New Beginning#337.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#338.src: ...t'was a right stupid risk that did him in, in the end. I told him, I did it ain't worth breaking into the Sovereign's place, especially not during festival times...
A New Beginning#338.dst: …結局、あいつを殺したのは馬鹿げた無茶だった。言ったんだ、確かに言った。君主の屋敷に忍び込む価値はない、祭りの時期は特にな…
A New Beginning#338.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#339.src: But he was the kinda sort to dig in his heels. Said he'd be fine, said it'd be worth it, nabbin' all those documents. Something to help the cause... I hardly even remember now.
A New Beginning#339.dst: だが、あいつは言い出したら聞かん奴でな。大丈夫だ、やる価値はある、書類を全部かっさらうと。大義の役に立つ何か… 今じゃほとんど覚えとらん。
A New Beginning#339.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#340.src: Can't save 'em all. Especially not from themselves. I've learned that many times over, over my years.
A New Beginning#340.dst: 全員は救えん。特に、自分自身からはな。長年、何度も思い知らされた。
A New Beginning#340.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#341.src: So he got caught. Heard a cursed one got involved... was a whole damn mess. Sovereign really wasn't happy with Synny when he heard, let me tell you. Ain't seen her that shellshocked in years.
A New Beginning#341.dst: で、捕まった。呪われし者が絡んだと聞いた… ひどい有様だったそうだ。君主は聞いて Synny にえらくご立腹だった、本当に。あいつがあれほど呆然としとるのは何年ぶりか。
A New Beginning#341.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#342.src: ...but you're sayin' he lived? How's that all work out?
A New Beginning#342.dst: …だが、あいつは生きとったと？どういうことだ？
A New Beginning#342.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#343.dst: ああ。そうか。そう… か。
A New Beginning#343.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#344.src: Well... tell me this, then. Was he happy, you think? Out there in the wider world? Did he live a good life?
A New Beginning#344.dst: じゃあ… これだけ教えてくれ。あいつは幸せだったと思うか？外の広い世界で？いい人生を送ったか？
A New Beginning#344.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#345.src: ...alright. Alrighty. Good. That that's good, y'hear. I... I'm glad for that much.
A New Beginning#345.dst: …そうか。そうか。よかった。そりゃよかった。わしは… それだけで嬉しい。
A New Beginning#345.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#346.src: Thank you for... for tellin' me all that. S'not a tale that ends in happiness, but I reckon so long as he made the most of it... that's all you can really hope for.
A New Beginning#346.dst: 話してくれて… ありがとうよ。幸せに終わる話じゃないが、あいつが精一杯生きたなら… 望めるのはそれくらいだろう。
A New Beginning#346.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#347.src: Y'may as well leave me be a while, now. Got some thinkin' to get through.
A New Beginning#347.dst: しばらく一人にしてくれ。考えることがある。
A New Beginning#347.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#003~1.src: To honor Her Majesty and to celebrate Her grace and blessings placed upon the land.
A New Beginning#003~1.dst: 女王陛下を称え、この地にもたらされた恵みと祝福を祝うために。

A New Beginning#004~1.src: You've gotten about as much worthwhile information out of this conversation as you'll get.
A New Beginning#004~1.dst: この会話から得られる有益な情報は、もうこれくらいだろう。

A New Beginning#005~1.src: E's real! Real I tells ya! Saw 'im with my own two eyes I did!
A New Beginning#005~1.dst: 奴は本物だ！本物だって！この目でしっかり見たんだ！

A New Beginning#006~1.src: But enough of that. You want to go to {p}, right?
A New Beginning#006~1.dst: だが、その話はもういい。{p} に行きたいんだろ？

A New Beginning#007~1.src: WRAHAHHEHGHHHHOROOOARRRRR!!!!!! 'E jumps out at me... And 'e... 'e...
A New Beginning#007~1.dst: ウラハヘグホロオアアア！！！！！！奴が飛び出して…奴が…奴が…

A New Beginning#008~1.dst: 瓶には「Auburn Amaretto」というラベルが貼ってある。

A New Beginning#300~1.src: It's... complicated - we have something of an agreement. What matters is that everything is taken care of. Since you're here, {u}, take this. Your passport.
A New Beginning#300~1.dst: それは…複雑なの- ちょっとした取り決めがあってね。大事なのは全部片付いたってこと。ここにいるなら {u}、これを。あなたのパスポートよ。
A New Beginning#300~1.speaker: Syndra

A Sandy Scandal#000.src: Before anybody could hear me, a large explosion occurred inside of the house the bandits intruded.
A Sandy Scandal#000.dst: 誰かに声が届く前に、強盗たちが押し入った家の中で大爆発が起きた。

A Sandy Scandal#001.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Sandy Scandal#001.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる {p} の銀行警備員と話す

A Sandy Scandal#002.src: You look like a hardy one! {p} army is it? Would you be willing to help {p} a bit?
A Sandy Scandal#002.dst: たくましそうだな！{p} 軍の人か？{p} にちょっと手を貸してくれないか？
A Sandy Scandal#002.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#003.src: {p} bank tends to be a prime target for bandits, and there's been a string of incidents that have made us suspicious.
A Sandy Scandal#003.dst: {p} の銀行は強盗の格好の標的でな、立て続けに起きた事件のせいで怪しんでいるんだ。
A Sandy Scandal#003.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#004.src: We're looking into some witness reports to try and gain information on the bandits' plan.
A Sandy Scandal#004.dst: 強盗の計画を探るため、いくつかの目撃報告を調べているところだ。
A Sandy Scandal#004.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#005.src: If I give you some of the reports, will you help check them out for clues?
A Sandy Scandal#005.dst: 報告書をいくつか渡すから、手がかりを調べてくれないか？
A Sandy Scandal#005.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#006.src: Great! The store from the first witness report is straight down the stairs, just past this building right behind me.
A Sandy Scandal#006.dst: 助かる！最初の目撃報告の店は、階段を下りてすぐ、私の後ろの建物を過ぎたところだ。
A Sandy Scandal#006.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#007.src: It's called "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", and the owner reported a robbery a few days ago.
A Sandy Scandal#007.dst: 店の名は「Gibbs' Mining Supply Store」、店主が数日前に強盗被害を届け出た。
A Sandy Scandal#007.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#008.src: Good luck! Report back to me if you find any information.
A Sandy Scandal#008.dst: 頼んだぞ！何か分かったら報告してくれ。
A Sandy Scandal#008.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#009.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#009.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の目撃報告の場所へ行く。

A Sandy Scandal#010.src: Hello gentlemen! What can I interest you in today? Some industrial torches? Pickaxes?
A Sandy Scandal#010.dst: いらっしゃい、お客さん方！今日は何をお探しで？工業用松明？ツルハシ？
A Sandy Scandal#010.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#011.src: Shut yer’ trap, old man. We came for a different kind of business.
A Sandy Scandal#011.dst: 黙りな、じいさん。俺たちゃ別の用で来たんだ。
A Sandy Scandal#011.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#012.src: Wha-? Look, fellows. Just step out of my store, and nobody gets hurt. I don't want any trouble.
A Sandy Scandal#012.dst: な―？いいかい、あんたら。店から出てってくれれば誰もけがはしない。面倒はごめんだ。
A Sandy Scandal#012.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#013.src: Listen up old man, tell us the code to the TNT vault in the basement, or I decorate my necklace with your fingers!
A Sandy Scandal#013.dst: よく聞けじいさん、地下のTNT金庫の暗証番号を言え。さもなきゃ、てめえの指で首飾りを作るぞ！
A Sandy Scandal#013.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#014.src: Certainly not! That TNT is for licensed mining companies only, not your average amateur miner.
A Sandy Scandal#014.dst: 断じてお断りだ！あのTNTは認可を受けた採掘会社専用で、素人の鉱夫向けじゃない。
A Sandy Scandal#014.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#015.src: Well then! I guess you'll still be able to grasp a pick with four fingers, eh?
A Sandy Scandal#015.dst: そうかい！指が四本でもツルハシは握れるよなあ？
A Sandy Scandal#015.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#016.src: Gaaah! Alright, alright! No more violence, please!
A Sandy Scandal#016.dst: ぎゃああ！分かった、分かった！もう乱暴はやめてくれ！
A Sandy Scandal#016.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#017.src: The code is {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... please don't hurt me!
A Sandy Scandal#017.dst: 番号は {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}… 頼む、傷つけないでくれ！
A Sandy Scandal#017.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#018.src: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... thanks! We won't be needing you anymore... now go to sleep!
A Sandy Scandal#018.dst: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}… ありがとよ！もう用済みだ… さあ、おねんねしな！
A Sandy Scandal#018.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#019.src: Open the vault in the basement [Code: {~}].
A Sandy Scandal#019.dst: 地下の金庫を開ける [暗証番号: {~}]。

A Sandy Scandal#022.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Sandy Scandal#022.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる {p} の銀行警備員と話す

A Sandy Scandal#023.src: Ah, you're back! Did you find anything interesting in the report?
A Sandy Scandal#023.dst: おお、戻ったか！報告の件で何か面白いことは見つかったか？
A Sandy Scandal#023.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#024.src: Missing TNT in the shop's vault? Looks like the shopkeeper was telling the truth.
A Sandy Scandal#024.dst: 店の金庫からTNTが消えていた？店主の言っていたことは本当だったようだな。
A Sandy Scandal#024.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#025.src: We need to catch these criminals quickly if they have access to that amount of TNT - they could blow a hole right into the bank's vault!
A Sandy Scandal#025.dst: あれだけのTNTを手にしているなら、急いで捕まえないと― 銀行の金庫に穴を開けられかねない！
A Sandy Scandal#025.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#026.src: You should check out another witness report, from after the attack on the shopkeeper.
A Sandy Scandal#026.dst: 店主が襲われた後の、別の目撃報告も確かめてくれ。
A Sandy Scandal#026.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#027.src: It was taken from the rooftop garden of the Scroll Merchant's residence, you should take a look.
A Sandy Scandal#027.dst: スクロール商人の屋敷の屋上庭園で記録されたものだ。見てきてくれ。
A Sandy Scandal#027.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#028.src: Be quick! We don't have much time if we want to stop these bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#028.dst: 急いでくれ！この強盗どもを止めるには時間がない。
A Sandy Scandal#028.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#029.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#029.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の目撃報告の場所へ行く。

A Sandy Scandal#031.src: Ey', what do you two blighters think you're doing with those dangerous explosives in the city?
A Sandy Scandal#031.dst: おい、そこの悪党二人、そんな危ない爆薬を街中に持ち込んで何をするつもりだ？
A Sandy Scandal#031.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#032.src: Guards! Guards! Robber! Come quick! Urgently!
A Sandy Scandal#032.dst: 衛兵！衛兵！強盗だ！早く来てくれ！大至急！
A Sandy Scandal#032.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#034.src: Find the source of the detonation at [{~}, {~}, {~}].
A Sandy Scandal#034.dst: [{~}, {~}, {~}] で爆発の発生源を探す。

A Sandy Scandal#036.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#036.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる {p} の銀行警備員と話す。

A Sandy Scandal#037.src: Were you able to uncover any new information regarding the status of the criminals?
A Sandy Scandal#037.dst: 犯人どもの状況について、何か新しい情報はつかめたか？
A Sandy Scandal#037.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#038.src: Ah... that's troubling. The criminals plundered two very powerful weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#038.dst: ああ… それはまずい。犯人どもは強力な武器を二つも奪ったのか。
A Sandy Scandal#038.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#039.src: It won't be easy facing those criminals if they decide to raid the bank with those weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#039.dst: その武器で銀行を襲われたら、立ち向かうのは容易じゃないぞ。
A Sandy Scandal#039.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#040.src: I'm not certain how to proceed from here, we didn't receive any more witness reports, and-
A Sandy Scandal#040.dst: ここからどう動くべきか… これ以上の目撃報告は届いていないし―
A Sandy Scandal#040.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#041.src: Boss, I just received urgent reports of a robbery underway in the left residential area of {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#041.dst: 隊長、{p} の左側の住宅地で強盗が発生中との急報が入りました！
A Sandy Scandal#041.speaker: Almuj Sentry

A Sandy Scandal#042.src: Oh my… you! Soldier! Quick! The robbery is taking place across the bridge, next to the first house you visited today! It may be the bandits we're looking for.
A Sandy Scandal#042.dst: なんと… おい！兵士！急げ！強盗は橋の向こう、今日最初に訪ねた家の隣だ！探している強盗どもかもしれん。
A Sandy Scandal#042.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#043.src: There will be somebody waiting for you outside of the house once you get to the residential area!
A Sandy Scandal#043.dst: 住宅地に着いたら、家の外で誰かが待っているはずだ！
A Sandy Scandal#043.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#044.src: If you still can't find it, I've written the coordinates in your content book. Now quickly, get to the house!
A Sandy Scandal#044.dst: それでも見つからなければ、コンテンツブックに座標を書いておいた。さあ急いで、家へ向かえ！
A Sandy Scandal#044.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#045.src: Quickly! Go to the house at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#046.src: Hello? Are you with the guards? Good! Hurry! Some bandits just ransacked my house, and left with lots of emeralds!
A Sandy Scandal#046.dst: もしもし？衛兵の方？よかった！急いで！強盗が家を荒らして、エメラルドをたくさん持っていったんです！
A Sandy Scandal#046.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#047.src: Follow me to my house, hopefully you can find the bandits! They stole lots of my precious gems!
A Sandy Scandal#047.dst: 家まで来てください、強盗を見つけてくれるといいんですが！大事な宝石をたくさん盗まれたんです！
A Sandy Scandal#047.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#048.src: Look for signs of the bandits' whereabouts.
A Sandy Scandal#048.dst: 強盗の行方の手がかりを探す。

A Sandy Scandal#050.src: Ready, boys? We've got the TNT, weapons, and the fastest horses those emeralds could buy. Now we just-
A Sandy Scandal#050.dst: 準備はいいか、野郎ども？TNTに武器、エメラルドで買える一番速い馬もそろった。あとは―
A Sandy Scandal#050.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#051.src: Ahah. I had a feeling we had a guard on our tail.
A Sandy Scandal#051.dst: はっ。衛兵に尾けられてる気がしてたぜ。
A Sandy Scandal#051.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#052.src: No point wasting these brand-new weapons on you... since we're blowing up this hideout anyway!
A Sandy Scandal#052.dst: この新品の武器をお前に使うのはもったいねえ… どうせこの隠れ家は爆破するんだからな！
A Sandy Scandal#052.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#053.src: This whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!
A Sandy Scandal#053.dst: ここはあと数秒で吹っ飛ぶ。証拠はみんな砂の下だ。せいぜい逃げ出してみな！
A Sandy Scandal#053.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#055.src: Find where the bandits blasted a hole to get into the bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#055.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で強盗が銀行へ侵入するために爆破した穴を探す。

A Sandy Scandal#056.src: It’s too late to stop us now! We’re already about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!
A Sandy Scandal#056.dst: 今さら止めても遅い！俺たちはもう最高のお宝― エメラルド金庫の中身を持って、ここから飛び出すところだ！
A Sandy Scandal#056.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#057.src: Follow the criminals into the other room.
A Sandy Scandal#057.dst: 犯人を追って隣の部屋に入る。

A Sandy Scandal#058.src: Look here, the soldier decided they wanted to follow us. Dumb move.
A Sandy Scandal#058.dst: 見ろよ、兵士さんがついて来やがった。バカな真似を。
A Sandy Scandal#058.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#059.src: I guess we can kill two birds with one stone: escaping the bank, and killing this pest.
A Sandy Scandal#059.dst: 一石二鳥といくか。銀行からの脱出と、この害虫の始末だ。
A Sandy Scandal#059.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#062.src: Report back to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#062.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる {p} の銀行警備員に報告する。

A Sandy Scandal#063.src: Soldier! Where did you disappear to? Did you hear those explosions, below the bank?
A Sandy Scandal#063.dst: 兵士！どこへ消えていた？銀行の下での爆発音を聞いたか？
A Sandy Scandal#063.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#064.src: We think those bandits might have made their first move in the heist, we're mobilising a troop to-
A Sandy Scandal#064.dst: 強盗どもが計画の第一歩を踏み出したのかもしれん、部隊を動員して―
A Sandy Scandal#064.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#065.src: You've already stopped them? And reclaimed the stolen weapons and explosives..?
A Sandy Scandal#065.dst: もう止めただと？奪われた武器と爆薬まで取り戻したのか…？
A Sandy Scandal#065.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#066.src: Wow. Excellent work, soldier. {p} is in your debt. Please accept these from our vault, as a token of our thanks.
A Sandy Scandal#066.dst: すごい。見事な働きだ、兵士。{p} は君に借りができた。感謝のしるしに、金庫からこれを受け取ってくれ。
A Sandy Scandal#066.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

Acquiring Credentials#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Gavel のパスポートを入手する

Acquiring Credentials#001.src: I'm sorry sir, but I can't just give you a new passport... You'd need approval from-...
Acquiring Credentials#001.dst: 申し訳ありませんが、新しいパスポートを発行するわけにはいきません… 承認が必要で―…
Acquiring Credentials#001.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#002.src: But sir, my passport was stolen! I have a flight to {p} in under {~} minutes. I really need one, quick...
Acquiring Credentials#002.dst: でも、パスポートを盗まれたんです！{~} 分もしないうちに {p} 行きの便が出るんです。どうしても急いで…
Acquiring Credentials#002.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#003.src: I've already told you where where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#003.dst: 新しいものをどこで取得すべきかは、もうお伝えしました。次の方どうぞ！
Acquiring Credentials#003.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#004.src: Hmmm... {u}, is it? Unfortunately, humans are required to get their passports in Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#004.dst: ふむ… {u} さんですね？残念ながら、人間は Wynn でパスポートを取得する決まりです。
Acquiring Credentials#004.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#005.src: I'm afraid I can't help you. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#005.dst: お力にはなれません。次の方どうぞ！
Acquiring Credentials#005.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#006.src: Hey, you! Yes, you! Come outside, would you? I think we can help each other.
Acquiring Credentials#006.dst: ちょっと、あなた！そう、あなた！外へ来てくれます？助け合えそうなんです。
Acquiring Credentials#006.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#007.src: So, I overheard your conversation with the Officer... You're also looking for a passport, right?
Acquiring Credentials#007.dst: 係官との話が聞こえちゃって… あなたもパスポートを探してるんですよね？
Acquiring Credentials#007.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#008.src: Well... so, I've heard rumours of a secret Black Market that hides in the airbase.
Acquiring Credentials#008.dst: それで… 空軍基地に秘密の闇市が隠れてるって噂を聞いたんです。
Acquiring Credentials#008.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#009.src: Apparently they trade illegal products... There has to be a way of buying passports, I'm sure of it!
Acquiring Credentials#009.dst: 違法な品を取引してるらしくて… パスポートを買う方法もきっとあるはずです！
Acquiring Credentials#009.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#010.src: If we work together, we might be able to find a way in. What do you think?
Acquiring Credentials#010.dst: 協力すれば、入る方法が見つかるかも。どう思います？
Acquiring Credentials#010.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#011.src: Explore the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#011.dst: 空軍基地を探索して闇市の手がかりを探す。

Acquiring Credentials#012.src: Oh, you brought us to the Inn! Hmmm, the Barman's been working here for a long time...
Acquiring Credentials#012.dst: あ、宿屋に来たんですね！うーん、ここのバーテンは長く働いてますから…
Acquiring Credentials#012.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#013.src: Maybe he knows something about the Black Market! I'll try and ask, y'know... all, uh... sneaky-like.
Acquiring Credentials#013.dst: 闇市のことを何か知ってるかも！聞いてみます、ほら… こう、えっと… こっそりと。
Acquiring Credentials#013.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#014.src: Excuse me, sir... You, uh...wouldn't happen to know any really cheap stores around here, would you?
Acquiring Credentials#014.dst: すみません… あの、えっと… このへんで、すごーく安いお店、ご存じないですよね？
Acquiring Credentials#014.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#015.src: The table's been set for the great feast, have stout or beer, what will it be?
Acquiring Credentials#015.dst: 宴の卓は整った。スタウトかビールか、どちらにする？
Acquiring Credentials#015.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#016.src: Is that a secret code...? Beer?
Acquiring Credentials#016.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#017.src: Did that work? Is he gonna let us in?
Acquiring Credentials#017.dst: うまくいった？入れてくれるかな？
Acquiring Credentials#017.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#018.src: I guess it wouldn't be that easy to find a way in... Where do you think we can go with that lead, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#018.dst: そう簡単に入り口は見つかりませんよね… {u}、この手がかりでどこへ行けると思います？
Acquiring Credentials#018.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#019.src: Let's just keep exploring. Lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#019.dst: 探索を続けましょう。案内して。
Acquiring Credentials#019.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#020.src: Keep exploring the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#020.dst: 引き続き空軍基地を探索し、闇市の手がかりを探す。

Acquiring Credentials#021.dst: レストラン… なるほど！
Acquiring Credentials#021.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#022.src: Hey, uh...do these people look suspicious to you, too?
Acquiring Credentials#022.dst: ねえ、えっと… この人たち、怪しく見えません？
Acquiring Credentials#022.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#023.src: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#023.dst: 飛空艇の指揮官は、憎むものを愛する。
Acquiring Credentials#023.speaker: Waiter

Acquiring Credentials#024.src: I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
Acquiring Credentials#024.dst: 何かつかめてきた気がします！先へ進みましょう。
Acquiring Credentials#024.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#025.src: Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#025.dst: 手がかりを追う：飛空艇の指揮官は、憎むものを愛する。

Acquiring Credentials#026.src: Hmmm... these crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
Acquiring Credentials#026.dst: うーん… この木箱、品物でいっぱいです。いくつか指揮官に渡してみましょうか？
Acquiring Credentials#026.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#027.src: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#027.dst: 一度裂ければ、二度と戻らぬ。
Acquiring Credentials#027.speaker: Commander

Acquiring Credentials#028.src: Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
Acquiring Credentials#028.dst: よし、先へ進みましょう！この手がかりでどこへ？
Acquiring Credentials#028.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#029.src: Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#029.dst: 手がかりを追う：一度裂ければ、二度と戻らぬ。

Acquiring Credentials#030.src: Who's that on top of that platform?!
Acquiring Credentials#030.dst: あの足場の上にいるのは誰？！
Acquiring Credentials#030.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#031.src: The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
Acquiring Credentials#031.dst: お前ら二人、このためにずいぶん遠くまで来たもんだな？
Acquiring Credentials#031.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#032.src: Well, I can give you the answer to the stout and beer question! But you won't enter the Market with just that.
Acquiring Credentials#032.dst: さて、スタウトとビールの答えは教えてやれる！だが、それだけじゃ闇市には入れないぜ。
Acquiring Credentials#032.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#033.src: You see, to enter the Market you'll need something to sell! And it won't be something you can exactly buy around here, if you get what I mean.
Acquiring Credentials#033.dst: いいか、闇市に入るには売り物が要る！それも、このへんで気軽に買えるような代物じゃない、分かるだろ。
Acquiring Credentials#033.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#034.dst: 何か… 違法なものが要る、と？
Acquiring Credentials#034.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#035.src: Exactly! Luckily for you, I'm in a good mood. There's an airship docked close by. We'll be able to take it and I can help you get an item.
Acquiring Credentials#035.dst: その通り！運がいいな、今日の俺は機嫌がいい。近くに飛空艇が停まってる。そいつを拝借して、品物を手に入れる手伝いをしてやる。
Acquiring Credentials#035.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#036.src: Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well... you could get something out of this too, right?
Acquiring Credentials#036.dst: えっと… どう思います、{u}？どうしてもパスポートが要るんです、それに… あなたにも得があるでしょう？
Acquiring Credentials#036.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#037.dst: …分かりました、やりましょう。
Acquiring Credentials#037.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#038.src: Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Acquiring Credentials#038.dst: よし！ついて来い、すぐそこだ。
Acquiring Credentials#038.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#040.src: Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
Acquiring Credentials#040.dst: 待て！飛空艇を守る衛兵がいる。見つかるなよ！
Acquiring Credentials#040.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#041.src: They're near the edge... Push them off.
Acquiring Credentials#041.dst: 端の近くにいる… 突き落とせ。
Acquiring Credentials#041.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#042.src: Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
Acquiring Credentials#042.dst: あー… きっと無事さ、そんなに高くなかったはず…
Acquiring Credentials#042.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#043.src: Well, that's your only way inside! There are more guards up ahead. Take care of them without being seen, and we'll be in the clear!
Acquiring Credentials#043.dst: さて、中に入るにはそこしかない！この先にも衛兵がいる。見つからずに片付ければ、もう安心だ！
Acquiring Credentials#043.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#044.src: Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Acquiring Credentials#044.dst: よくやった！飛空艇に乗るぞ。
Acquiring Credentials#044.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#045.src: Did you just... Push them all...?
Acquiring Credentials#045.dst: 今… 全員突き落としたんですか…？
Acquiring Credentials#045.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#046.src: Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
Acquiring Credentials#046.dst: しっかりつかまれ！{p} へ向かう。そこで仔竜の卵を集めて、闇市で売れるようにしてやる！
Acquiring Credentials#046.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#047.src: Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
Acquiring Credentials#047.dst: 整備士と Doan と共に {p} へ行き、仔竜の卵を手に入れる。

Acquiring Credentials#048.src: The island we're heading to is home to a Dragonling nest! They use it to lay their eggs, as it's quite a difficult place to access.
Acquiring Credentials#048.dst: 向かう島には仔竜の巣がある！たどり着くのが難しい場所だから、そこで卵を産むんだ。
Acquiring Credentials#048.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#049.src: And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
Acquiring Credentials#049.dst: それって闇市ですごい値がつくんですよね…？
Acquiring Credentials#049.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#050.src: They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#050.dst: もちろんさ！仔竜の卵は珍しいし、あの島は飛空艇でしか行けない… Letvus じゃひと財産になる。
Acquiring Credentials#050.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#051.src: Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
Acquiring Credentials#051.dst: お、見えた！ここから島が見える、つかまってろ。卵を盗みに行くぞ！
Acquiring Credentials#051.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#052.src: What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
Acquiring Credentials#052.dst: あれは何？！あ… 先客がいるみたいです…
Acquiring Credentials#052.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#053.src: Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
Acquiring Credentials#053.dst: くそ、スカイレイダーが来てる！卵を持ち逃げさせるわけにはいかない…
Acquiring Credentials#053.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#054.src: Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
Acquiring Credentials#054.dst: よし、そういうことなら、やることは一つだ！さあ、ついて来い！
Acquiring Credentials#054.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#055.src: We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
Acquiring Credentials#055.dst: こんなに海賊がいちゃ巣にたどり着けない、倒せ！
Acquiring Credentials#055.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#056.src: Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
Acquiring Credentials#056.dst: よし、ついて来い！卵を採りに行くぞ！
Acquiring Credentials#056.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#057.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
Acquiring Credentials#057.dst: 卵を採る間、俺を守ってくれ、人間！
Acquiring Credentials#057.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#058.src: We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
Acquiring Credentials#058.dst: 半分まで来た、そのまま守ってくれ！
Acquiring Credentials#058.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#059.src: There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
Acquiring Credentials#059.dst: よし採れた！飛空艇に戻るぞ、走れ！
Acquiring Credentials#059.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#060.src: Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Acquiring Credentials#060.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#061.src: Human, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
Acquiring Credentials#061.dst: 人間、当てさせるな！飛空艇に当たる前に、武器で砲弾を攻撃して弾き返せ！
Acquiring Credentials#061.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#062.src: We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
Acquiring Credentials#062.dst: これ以上は砲撃に耐えられねえ… 時間の無駄だ、ずらかるぞ！もっと大きな獲物がある！
Acquiring Credentials#062.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#063.src: That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
Acquiring Credentials#063.dst: 危なかった… よし、空軍基地に戻ろう！
Acquiring Credentials#063.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#064.src: Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
Acquiring Credentials#064.dst: Doan と共に Blackbird Inn の酒場に戻る。

Acquiring Credentials#065.src: The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
Acquiring Credentials#065.dst: お前ら二人、今日は確かに実力を示したな！
Acquiring Credentials#065.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#066.src: So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#066.dst: だから、闇市に入る合言葉を教えてやる。
Acquiring Credentials#066.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#067.src: Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#067.dst: 宿屋のバーテンのところへ戻って、こう言え。「喉は渇いてない、いつも瓶を持ち歩いてる」。
Acquiring Credentials#067.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#068.src: That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
Acquiring Credentials#068.dst: それで入る機会が得られるはずだ。幸運を！
Acquiring Credentials#068.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#069.src: Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
Acquiring Credentials#069.dst: 助けてくれてありがとうございます… じゃあ、酒場に戻りましょう。
Acquiring Credentials#069.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#070.src: Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
Acquiring Credentials#070.dst: また来ましたね。バーテンに話しかけましょう。
Acquiring Credentials#070.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#071.src: Um, sir? I'm not thristy, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#071.dst: あの、すみません？喉は渇いてません、いつも瓶を持ち歩いてるので。
Acquiring Credentials#071.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#072.src: Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
Acquiring Credentials#072.dst: 廊下の突き当たりにいる闇市の者とだけ話せ。他の誰とも口をきくな。
Acquiring Credentials#072.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#074.src: Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
Acquiring Credentials#074.dst: 闇市に入り、廊下の突き当たりにいるメンバーと話す。

Acquiring Credentials#075.src: I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
Acquiring Credentials#075.dst: スカイレイダーから卵を盗んだそうだな。大胆な真似を！
Acquiring Credentials#075.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#077.src: Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
Acquiring Credentials#077.dst: パスポート二つ？ざっと {~} エメラルドだな。この卵を市場で売れば手に入る。
Acquiring Credentials#077.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#078.src: Let me fill you in how the market works. You'll get a low starting price for your egg, and then you'll have to go around the merchants asking for a higher bid.
Acquiring Credentials#078.dst: 市場の仕組みを教えよう。卵の最初の値は安い。商人を回って、もっと高い値をつけてもらうんだ。
Acquiring Credentials#078.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#079.src: Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
Acquiring Credentials#079.dst: ただし気をつけろ、値上げを頼めるのは {~} 回までだ。
Acquiring Credentials#079.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#080.src: You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
Acquiring Credentials#080.dst: いろんな商人と話して、それぞれが卵の値をどれだけ上げるか見てみるといい。
Acquiring Credentials#080.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#081.src: Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
Acquiring Credentials#081.dst: 幸運を。死なないようにな。
Acquiring Credentials#081.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#082.src: Talk to the Merchants and try to get {~} emeralds to buy a passport.
Acquiring Credentials#082.dst: 商人と話し、パスポートを買うための {~} エメラルドを集める。

Acquiring Credentials#083.src: That's what we need, {u}. Sold! The egg is yours.
Acquiring Credentials#083.dst: {u}、それで足ります。売った！卵はあなたのものです。
Acquiring Credentials#083.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#084.src: Here, you can have your emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#084.speaker: Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#086.src: Talk to the Black Market Member again.
Acquiring Credentials#086.dst: もう一度闇市のメンバーと話す。

Acquiring Credentials#087.src: So do you have the emeralds?
Acquiring Credentials#087.dst: で、エメラルドは持ってきたか？
Acquiring Credentials#087.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#088.src: Hmm... This will do it. Here, your passports.
Acquiring Credentials#088.dst: ふむ… これで足りる。ほら、パスポートだ。
Acquiring Credentials#088.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#089.src: Uhh.. {u}, I think you dropped your passport. Let me get it for yo-...
Acquiring Credentials#089.dst: あれ… {u}、パスポート落としましたよ。拾ってあげ―…
Acquiring Credentials#089.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#090.src: Wait... That's MY passport?! It was in my pocket all along...
Acquiring Credentials#090.dst: 待って… それ「僕の」パスポート？！ずっとポケットに入ってた…
Acquiring Credentials#090.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#091.src: Well, uhhh... I guess you can have some of these emeralds, then...
Acquiring Credentials#091.dst: えっと、あの… じゃあ、このエメラルド少し分けてあげます…
Acquiring Credentials#091.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#003~1.src: I've already told you where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#003~1.dst: 新しいのをどこでもらうかは、もう言いましたよ。次の方どうぞ！
Acquiring Credentials#003~1.speaker: Officer

Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.src: Talk to the Elf Guard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part I#001.src: Halt, traveler! Entry to {p} Town is forbidden at present.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#001.dst: 止まれ、旅人！現在 {p} の町への立ち入りは禁じられている。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#001.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.src: There is a dangerous criminal on the loose in this valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.dst: この谷には危険な罪人が逃げ回っている。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.src: These doors shall remain closed until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.dst: 罪人が捕まるまで、この門は閉ざされたままだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.src: See if anyone in {p} Valley knows what happened
Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.dst: {p} の谷で、何があったか知る者を探す

Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.src: An outsider in our midst? Exciting to see. I have wished to share our magic with new people for a long while.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.dst: よそ者の方とは珍しい。私たちの魔法を新しい方と分かち合いたいと、長く願っていたのです。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.src: However, I am...well, rather hungry. And I must tend to my garden here for the time being.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.dst: ただ、私は…その、かなり空腹でして。それに当分はこの庭の世話もせねばなりません。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.src: Have you heard the saying “You scratch my ears, I scratch yours”? People must help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.dst: 「耳を掻いてくれたら掻き返す」という言葉をご存じですか？人は助け合わねばなりません。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.src: If you would be so kind as to bring me a loaf of fresh bread you may take my enchanted bucket.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.dst: 焼きたてのパンを一斤持ってきてくだされば、魔法のバケツを差し上げましょう。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.src: I saw you toil to bake this yourself. Frankly, that is above and beyond what I expected, so here is your exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.dst: ご自分で苦労して焼いたのですね。正直、期待以上です。こちらがお礼の品です。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.src: If you require help in the future with anything, do not be afraid to ask. If you put such effort for me, I shall give you the same.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.dst: 今後、何か助けが要るなら遠慮なく言ってください。私のためにそこまで尽くしてくれたのですから、同じようにお返しします。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.src: Find a use for Damys' Bucket
Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.dst: Damys のバケツの使い道を探す

Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.src: This is utterly insane. A full lockdown, over a petty theft... Are we not to help one another? To thieve is unnecessary.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.dst: まったく正気の沙汰じゃない。些細な盗みで完全封鎖とは…助け合うべきでは？盗む必要などないのに。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.speaker: Vaenr

Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.src: The thieving is not the reason, from what I have heard. It is that the grove was jealously hidden due to the potency of the plants there.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.dst: 聞いた話では、盗みが理由ではない。あの林の植物は効き目が強すぎるから、厳重に隠されていたのだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.src: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... The Light only knows what else. It is impossible to reach without unusual means- And that is cause for grave concern.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.dst: Tattytale、Iridesca、Subtraxerim…他に何があるかは光のみぞ知る。普通の手段では辿り着けない。だからこそ深刻な問題なのだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.src: Find a way to grow the plant by the waterfall
Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.dst: 滝のそばの植物を育てる方法を探す

Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.src: Halt! This area is strictly off limits, especially for an outsider. Turn back now!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.dst: 止まれ！ここは立入厳禁、よそ者ならなおさらだ。今すぐ引き返せ！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.speaker: Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.src: Aha, the outsider returns. Is there something troubling you?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.dst: おや、よそ者の方がお戻りに。何かお困りですか？
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.src: ...mmm. Unfortunate, that. I cannot help with this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.dst: …ふむ。あいにくですが、それはお力になれません。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.src: It is not a matter of secrecy or morals- I simply do not know what that leaf is from or what it may be capable of.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.dst: 秘密や道徳の問題ではありません。あの葉が何の植物で、何ができるのか、単に知らないのです。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.src: I am no botanist- Simply a gardener. The mistake is understandable, if regrettable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.dst: 私は植物学者ではなく、ただの庭師です。無理もない勘違いですが。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.src: However, I was taught under a much more storied botanist who may have the answers you seek.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.dst: ですが、私の師はずっと名高い植物学者でした。あなたの求める答えを知っているかもしれません。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.src: Her name is Fiona- Her home is across the valley from here. Take the bridge across. She often stays inside studying.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.dst: 名は Fiona。谷の向こう側に住んでいます。橋を渡ってください。たいてい家で研究しています。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.src: She has forgotten more than I will ever hope to know about plants. If she cannot help you, I fear none can.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.dst: 植物について、彼女が忘れたことだけでも私の知識より多い。彼女に無理なら、誰にも無理でしょう。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.src: Go to the botanist's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の植物学者の家へ行く

Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.src: This is outrageous! To think one of our own would stoop to such thievery and destruction!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.dst: 許せない！仲間のエルフが、こんな盗みと破壊にまで手を染めるなんて！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.src: Outsider, this is not the time to be asking me anything. My home has been ransacked!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.dst: よそ者さん、今は質問に答えている場合じゃないの。家が荒らされたのよ！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.src: Mm? Damys sent you... You have leaves of Iridesca? Hm... Then perhaps we may be able to help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.dst: ん？Damys の紹介…？Iridesca の葉を持っているの？ふむ…なら、お互い助け合えるかもしれないわね。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#030.src: They tore through my shelves and furniture searching, and scanned the pages as fervently once they found it.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#030.dst: 犯人は棚も家具も荒らして探し回り、見つけたら夢中でページに目を走らせたの。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#030.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.src: Afterwards, they threw the book into the back garden, and forced a carnivorous plant to grow and consume my notes!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.dst: その後、本を裏庭に投げ込んで、食虫植物を無理やり育てて私のメモを食べさせたのよ！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#032.src: I assume when the desired information was found, they went into my garden, threw the book into the carnivorous plant and stormed off towards the lab.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#032.dst: 目当ての情報を見つけた後、庭に入って本を食虫植物に投げ込み、研究所の方へ走り去ったんでしょうね。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#032.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.src: I have researched the Iridesca bloom, and many other plants, for a long time. All my knowledge is stored in that book!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.dst: Iridesca の花も、他の多くの植物も、長年研究してきたわ。私の知識はすべてあの本の中よ！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.src: Retrieve it for me, and I will share my knowledge with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.dst: 取り返してくれたら、私の知識を分けてあげる。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.src: Kill the carnivorous plant and loot the book
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.dst: 食虫植物を倒して本を取り戻す

Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.src: ...disgusting. I will have to hang the pages to dry later, but first, our exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.dst: …汚らしい。ページは後で干すとして、まずは約束の取引ね。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.src: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, no...where is Iridesca, again...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.dst: ええと…Herbstzeitlose…Death Whistle、違う…Iridesca は…？
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.src: Aha, there it is. The pages were sticking together. Iridesca leaves are potent in various ways and are very versatile in their use.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.dst: あった、ここね。ページがくっついていたの。Iridesca の葉は様々な効能が強く、用途がとても広いのよ。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.src: They have an incredibly broad range of usage, from soothing joint pain or curing sickness to emetic effect and lethal poison, depending on what it is brewed with.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.dst: 用途は驚くほど幅広くて、関節痛を和らげたり病を治したりから、催吐作用や猛毒まで、何と煎じるか次第なの。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.src: Mm? The book thief also possesses Iridesca...? This... This is very troubling. There are few notes aside from mine on how to heal Iridesca poisoning.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.dst: え？本泥棒も Iridesca を持っている…？それは…とてもまずいわ。Iridesca 中毒の治し方の記録は、私のメモ以外ほとんどないの。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.src: They were headed in the direction of the potionmaker's guild. If they intend something wicked...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.dst: 犯人は薬師ギルドの方へ向かったわ。もし何か悪事を企んでいたら…
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の錬金術師の店を調べる

Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.src: ..you! You have been seeking me! I have seen you tracing my footsteps...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.dst: …お前か！私を探していたな！足取りを追っているのを見ていたぞ…
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.src: I apologize for this... But what I do is a necessity!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.dst: すまない…だが、私のしていることは必要なのだ！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.src: I beg you, do not pursue me any further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.dst: 頼む、これ以上追わないでくれ！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.src: Outsider, I realize the circumstances appear damning, but you must stop!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.dst: よそ者よ、状況が不利なのは分かっている。だが止まってくれ！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.src: What I have done is needed, and if there were another path I would have taken it over this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.dst: 私のしたことは必要だった。他に道があったなら、そちらを選んでいた。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.src: I must take my concoction to where it is needed!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.dst: この薬を、必要とされる場所へ届けねばならない！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.src: See me as I truly am- My name is Korben, and I musn’t be delayed further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.dst: 本当の私を見てくれ。名は Korben、これ以上遅れるわけにはいかない！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.src: G R O W! (In High Gavellian)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.dst: 育 て よ！(High Gavellian 語)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.src: A damnable pace you have... I cannot let you stop me for a moment longer!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.dst: なんという速さだ…これ以上邪魔はさせない！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.src: It will be done soon, but I must reach my destination first!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.dst: もうすぐ済む。だがまず目的地に着かねば！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.src: Finally... I apologize for the delay. I needed to take strong measures to get this to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.dst: ようやく…遅くなってすみません。これを届けるため、強引な手段を取るしかなかったのです。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.src: Here, here... Drink, father. It will clear your throat.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.dst: さあ、さあ…飲んでください、父さん。喉が楽になります。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.src: ...there. It is done. Now... Outsider... Hear me, please.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.dst: …よし。済んだ。さて…よそ者よ…どうか聞いてくれ。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.src: I am aware of exactly what I have done. Shredded Fiona’s research, disturbed the forbidden gardens, unsettled the hearts of many...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.dst: 自分が何をしたかは分かっている。Fiona の研究を引き裂き、禁断の庭を荒らし、多くの者の心を乱した…
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.src: My father fell ill. A trek to {p}’s borders left him stricken with Kerasot poisoning. He was near death...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.dst: 父が病に倒れたのだ。{p} の境界へ旅して、Kerasot の毒に冒された。死にかけていた…
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.src: {p}’s village is one of outcasts- to visit is, stupidly, forbidden. He would have been exiled, and that would have ensured his death with his affliction.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.dst: {p} の村は追放者の村だ。愚かにも、訪れることは禁じられている。父は追放され、あの病ではそれは死を意味しただろう。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#060.src: Desperation causes one to do strange things. I thought only of his safety- I cared little about anything else.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#060.dst: 追い詰められると人はおかしなことをする。父の身の安全しか考えず、他はどうでもよかった。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#060.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.src: Even now I am simply relieved for his safety. If you must turn me in, I understand- I have already done what I set out to do.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.dst: 今でも、父が無事でただ安堵している。私を突き出すなら構わない。成すべきことはもう成し遂げた。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.src: Though I wish to remain free, whether you choose to report my activities or not does not matter to me now.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.dst: 自由でいたいとは思うが、私のことを報告するかどうかは、もうどちらでも構わない。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.src: Traveler, I must remind you- The doors shall remain shut until the criminal has been found.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.dst: 旅人よ、改めて言っておく。罪人が見つかるまで門は閉ざしたままだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.src: ...ah. You have found him, then. The name is Korben... Understood. We shall interrogate him for his actions.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.dst: …ほう。見つけたのか。名は Korben…承知した。奴の行いについて取り調べよう。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.src: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.dst: そういうことなら…{p} の町へは自由に出入りしてよい。門を再び開こう。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.src: ...you... You are... You would lie to the guards and say I perished in the chase? You will keep my identity secret?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.dst: …君は…君は…追跡中に私が死んだと衛兵に嘘をつくのか？私の正体を秘密にしてくれると？
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.src: Outsider... You show generosity akin to my father. He passed his Sol Medallion onto me to continue his legacy...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.dst: よそ者よ…君の寛大さは父のようだ。父は遺志を継げと、Sol Medallion を私に託した…
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.src: ...after what I have done, I do not deserve it. You take it, instead. It is in sufficiently worthy hands, I believe.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.dst: …あんなことをした私には相応しくない。代わりに君が持っていてくれ。君の手なら十分ふさわしい。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.src: I shall beg the Light to shine upon you for the rest of your days. A thousand thanks to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.dst: 君の生涯に光が降り注ぐよう、光に祈ろう。本当にありがとう。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.src: I know who you are, {u}. Do you know who I am?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.dst: お前が誰かは知ってるぞ、{u}。俺が誰か分かるか？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#003.dst: まあ分かるわけないよな、ははっ！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#003.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.src: Enough playing around, I need your assistance. You see... There is something fishy going on behind these doors.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.dst: 冗談はここまでだ、手を貸してほしい。実はな…この門の奥で何か怪しいことが起きてる。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.src: Have you ever heard the saying "Elves never die", well it's true, or so at least I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.dst: 「エルフは死なない」って言葉を聞いたことあるか？本当なんだ。少なくとも俺はそう思ってた。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#006.dst: 説明するよ、ついて来い！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#006.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#007.dst: Olon について {p} の町に入る。

Aldorei's Secret Part II#008.src: You see, my family and a few other elves left {p} Town a long time ago to start a new life in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#008.dst: 俺の家族と何人かのエルフは、ずっと前に {p} の町を出て、{p} で新しい暮らしを始めたんだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#008.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#009.src: I've always heard since I was young that Elves cannot die from old age. Well... recently, my parents both died.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#009.dst: エルフは老いでは死なないって、小さい頃からずっと聞いてた。なのに…最近、両親が二人とも死んだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#009.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.src: More and more people around {p} have died! But none in {p}. I think something sketchy is going on in here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.dst: {p} の周りじゃ死ぬ奴がどんどん増えてる！でも {p} では一人もいない。ここで何か怪しいことが起きてる。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.src: Please, {u}. I really need your help. Us {p} elves aren't exactly welcomed with open arms in {p}. It's a surprise they even let us in at all.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.dst: 頼む、{u}。本当に助けが要るんだ。{p} のエルフは {p} じゃ歓迎されてない。中に入れてもらえたのが驚きなくらいだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.src: Could you try asking around, see if anyone knows about this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.dst: 周りに聞き込みして、誰か知ってないか探ってくれないか。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.src: I will wait up here. Return to me if you find out any valuable information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.dst: 俺はこの上で待ってる。役立つ情報が見つかったら戻ってきてくれ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#014.src: Check with the elves around {p} Town for information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#014.dst: {p} の町のエルフたちに情報を聞いて回る。

Aldorei's Secret Part II#015.src: Welcome to {p} Town. Home of the elves.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#015.dst: {p} の町へようこそ。エルフの故郷だ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#015.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.src: I've heard of you and what happened in the valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.dst: あなたのことも、谷で何があったかも聞いているわ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#018.dst: あら…そう。よくやったわね。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#018.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#019.dst: {p} の町を楽しんでちょうだい。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#019.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#020.src: How come you are so curious?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#020.dst: どうしてそんなに知りたがるの？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#020.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#022.src: I have a lot to do today.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#022.dst: 今日はやることが多いのよ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#022.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#023.dst: 悪いけど、帰ってちょうだい。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#023.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#026.src: But why are you telling me that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#026.dst: でも、どうして私にそんな話を？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#026.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#028.src: Your attitude is really starting to annoy me, young traveler.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#028.dst: あなたの態度、本当に気に障ってきたわ、若い旅人さん。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#028.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#029.src: I don't care if you have defeated all the monsters in the world, never ask a woman like me of her age.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#029.dst: 世界中の魔物を倒していようと関係ないわ。私のような女性に年を聞くものじゃないの。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#029.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#031.src: You seem like such a kind adventurer, you humans aren't all so bad.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#031.dst: 親切な冒険者さんね。人間もそう悪い人ばかりじゃないのね。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#031.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#032.dst: いいわ、質問に答えてあげる！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#032.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#033.src: How come you are so curious?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#033.dst: どうしてそんなに知りたがるの？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#033.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#034.src: Well... when I think about it. No.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#034.dst: そうね…考えてみると。ないわ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#034.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#035.src: Actually. There is an old tale for children about a dying elf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#035.dst: そういえば。死にゆくエルフの、子ども向けの古いお話があるわ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#035.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#036.src: I never thought much about it since I have never seen anyone in here die before.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#036.dst: ここで誰かが死ぬのを見たことがないから、深く考えたことはなかったけれど。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#036.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#037.src: I heard that there is some old graveyard somewhere in {p}. Probably just some weird story.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#037.dst: {p} のどこかに古い墓地があるって聞いたわ。たぶんただの変な噂でしょうけど。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#037.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#038.src: I'm so sorry to hear that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#038.dst: それは本当にお気の毒に。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#038.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#039.src: I don't really see how that is connected to {p} though.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#039.dst: でも、それが {p} とどう関係するのか分からないわ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#039.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#040.dst: 人間は死ぬものでしょう。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#040.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#042.src: You never ask a woman her age. Did you not know that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#042.dst: 女性に年を聞くものじゃないわ。知らなかったの？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#042.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#043.src: All I can say is that I am old enough.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#043.dst: 十分大人だとだけ言っておくわ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#043.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#045.dst: Amber 参上！任務に就きます！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#045.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#046.dst: 迷子ですか、小さな冒険者さん？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#046.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#047.src: Worry not, the great Amber is here to help you find your way!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#047.dst: ご心配なく、偉大な Amber が道案内してあげます！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#047.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#049.src: My name is Amber of the Sol Embassy Royal Task Force!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#049.dst: 私は Sol 大使館王立特務隊の Amber です！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#049.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#050.src: It is my duty to protect the city from wrongdoers!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#050.dst: 悪人から町を守るのが私の務めです！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#050.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#051.src: You AREN'T A THIEF ARE YOU? OR A ROBBER? OR MURDERER!? ARSONIST!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#051.dst: まさか泥棒じゃないですよね？強盗？それとも人殺し！？放火魔！？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#051.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#052.dst: ごめん！ごめん！ごめんなさい！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#052.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#053.src: I let my imagination get the best of me!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#053.dst: つい想像が暴走しちゃいました！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#053.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#054.src: My main job is patrolling the grounds and making sure no one is doing anything they shouldn't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#054.dst: 主な仕事は敷地を巡回して、誰もしてはいけないことをしていないか確かめることです。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#054.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#055.src: I also report anything I hear people talk about that they shouldn't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#055.dst: 人が話してはいけないことを話していたら、それも報告します。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#055.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#056.src: Maybe I shouldn't have said all of that...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#056.dst: 今の全部、言わないほうがよかったかも…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#056.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#057.src: Can I help you with anything else?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#057.dst: 他に何かお手伝いできますか？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#057.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#059.src: I report who comes and leaves the town. Who sells what. Who buys what. Who talks with who.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#059.dst: 町に出入りする人を報告します。誰が何を売り、誰が何を買い、誰が誰と話したか。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#059.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#060.src: The list goes on and on and on and on and on... and on... and on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#060.dst: リストはまだまだまだまだまだ…まだ…続きます。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#060.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#061.src: They like keeping track of what happens inside the town!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#061.dst: 町の中で起きることを把握しておくのが好きなんです！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#061.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#062.src: Can I help you with anything else?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#062.dst: 他に何かお手伝いできますか？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#062.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#063.src: The Sol Embassy and its elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#063.dst: Sol 大使館と長老たちです。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#063.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#064.src: There are six elders who rule over {p} Town!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#064.dst: {p} の町を治める長老は六人いるんです！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#064.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#065.src: They don't often show themselves to the public, they like to keep their privacy. I don't even know what all of them look like!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#065.dst: 人前にはあまり出てこなくて、私生活を大事にしているんです。全員の顔すら知らないんですよ！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#065.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#067.src: Enjoy this wonderful town. Don't hesitate to ask me for help!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#067.dst: この素敵な町を楽しんでください。困ったらいつでも声をかけて！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#067.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#068.src: The Sol Embassy and its elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#068.dst: Sol 大使館と長老たちです。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#068.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#069.src: There are six elders who rule over {p} Town!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#069.dst: {p} の町を治める長老は六人いるんです！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#069.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#070.src: They don't often show themselves to the public, they like to keep their privacy. I don't even know what all of them look like!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#070.dst: 人前にはあまり出てこなくて、私生活を大事にしているんです。全員の顔すら知らないんですよ！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#070.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#072.src: Enjoy this wonderful town. Don't hesitate to ask me for help!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#072.dst: この素敵な町を楽しんでください。困ったらいつでも声をかけて！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#072.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#074.src: Every day I get to catch bad guys, I'm living the dream.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#074.dst: 毎日悪人を捕まえられて、夢みたいな暮らしです。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#074.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#075.src: Well, more like every month or so, or... even one every year. There aren't many bad guys here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#075.dst: まあ、実際は月に一人くらい、いや…年に一人くらいかな。ここには悪人が少ないので。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#075.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#078.src: I... I... No! Bullies don't affect me... *sniffles*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#078.dst: わ…私…違います！いじめなんて平気です…*ぐすん*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#078.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#080.src: Enjoy this wonderful town. Don't hesitate to ask me for help!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#080.dst: この素敵な町を楽しんでください。困ったらいつでも声をかけて！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#080.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#081.src: Oh it's you. I can't believe we let a human into this place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#081.dst: ああ、君か。人間をここに入れたなんて信じられないね。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#081.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#084.src: You dare speak to me like that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#084.dst: 僕にそんな口をきくのか？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#084.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#085.src: I will get you deported if it's the last thing I do, mark my words!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#085.dst: 何としても君を国外追放にしてやる、覚えておけ！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#085.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.src: That's me! Sol the Smart, Sol the Clever, Sol the Best. I go by many names.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.dst: それが僕さ！賢者 Sol、才人 Sol、至高の Sol。呼び名はたくさんある。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#087.src: So what is it you need?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#087.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#088.dst: で、何を知りたいんだい？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#088.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.src: Hmm. I'm sorry but I can't talk about that too much.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.dst: ふむ。悪いけど、その話はあまりできないんだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#090.src: I would love to show you my knowledge but... the grass has ears here in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#090.dst: 僕の知識を披露したいのは山々だが…{p} では草にも耳があるのさ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#090.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.src: I will tell you this, Elves used to die from old age around {~} years ago.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.dst: これだけは教えてやろう。{~} 年ほど前まで、エルフは老いで死んでいた。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#092.dst: ほう。確かにそれは妙だね。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#092.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#093.src: If you don't mind me asking... Is your friend from {p}?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#093.dst: 聞いてもいいかな…その友人は {p} の出身かい？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#093.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#094.src: It seems like my theory is true. {p} elves are dying.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#094.dst: どうやら僕の仮説は正しいようだ。{p} のエルフが死につつある。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#094.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#096.src: Hmm. I'm sorry but I can't talk about that too much.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#096.dst: ふむ。悪いけど、その話はあまりできないんだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#096.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#097.src: I would love to show you my knowledge but... the grass has ears here in {p}.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.src: As I previously mentioned, I've been helping out with keeping the gardens inside tidy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.dst: 前に言ったとおり、中の庭の手入れを手伝ってきたんだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.src: I've picked up a few things here and there, obviously! The conclusion I have is...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.dst: 当然、あちこちで色々耳にしたさ！俺の結論は…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.src: There's a room at the top of the guild hall that stores old military documents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.dst: ギルドホールの最上階に、古い軍の文書を保管してる部屋がある。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.src: It isn't really in use anymore, meaning the way up won't be easy... meet me under the bridge.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.dst: もう使われてないから、上へ行く道は楽じゃない…橋の下で会おう。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#353.src: Find Olon's friend inside the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#353.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} の中で Olon の友人を探す。

Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.src: I haven't seen you in so long! I'm doing good, family too!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.dst: 久しぶりだな！俺は元気だよ、家族もな！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.src: Glad to hear! Listen- we're quite busy today, do you know where the old military documents are being kept?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.dst: よかった！なあ、今日はちょっと急いでるんだ。古い軍の文書がどこにあるか知ってるか？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.src: Is this about the theory you had going? Actually- I recently did some work there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.dst: お前が言ってた説のことか？実は、最近そこで仕事をしたんだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#359.src: There's an elevator up the stairs next to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#359.dst: 俺の隣の階段を上ったところにエレベーターがある。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#359.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#360.src: Please come back and talk later! I miss our conversations.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#360.dst: また後で話しに来てくれよ！お前との話が恋しいんだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#360.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.src: Perfect! lets take that elevator up stairs right away.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.dst: 完璧だ！すぐにそのエレベーターで上へ行こう。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#362.src: Meet Olon under the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#362.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の橋の下で Olon と合流する。

Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.src: The archive should be at the top of one of the big towers of the {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.dst: 記録保管所は {p} の大きな塔の一つのてっぺんにあるはずだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.src: I had a brilliant idea of blessing you with some of my magic that you can hopefully use to get in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.dst: 名案を思いついたんだ。お前に俺の魔法を少し授ける。それで中に入れるといいんだが。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.src: I want to go meet up with my old friend, I'll hopefully see you soon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.dst: 俺は旧友に会ってくる。またすぐ会えるといいな。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.src: Do you see the pool of white magic next to us?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.dst: 隣にある白い魔法の池、見えるか？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.src: Just hop in when you are ready to start.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.dst: 準備ができたら飛び込め。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.src: Use the pool of magic at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to start heading towards the archive.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の魔法の池を使い、記録保管所へ向かう。

Aldorei's Secret Part II#372.dst: これが役に立つといいが。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#372.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.src: Return to {p} Town by either using the Juggler merchant at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or walking to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.src: You found it? Great, it's just as I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.dst: 見つけたか？よし、思ったとおりだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#376.src: Alright- this is the plan. I will stay behind and look for a map of the place mentioned, they almost always mark the reports properly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#376.dst: よし、計画はこうだ。俺は残って、書かれてた場所の地図を探す。報告書にはたいてい印がついてるからな。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#376.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.src: Meet me in {p} Town, at the eastern town exit. Let's try to avoid the elders for now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.dst: {p} の町の東の出口で会おう。今は長老たちを避けておこう。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.src: If you want to get back to {p} Town I heard that there's a so called "juggler" merchant in {p} that will bring you there for free.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.dst: {p} の町に戻るなら、{p} に「ジャグラー」って商人がいて、タダで連れてってくれるらしい。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.src: You could always walk too, I suppose.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.dst: まあ、歩いて行ってもいいけどな。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#380.dst: {p} の町の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Olon を見つける。

Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.src: This road leads to the {p}, so we may have to look around for a while.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.dst: この道は {p} に続いてる。しばらく探し回ることになるかもな。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.src: The canyon moves on its own. Alright, let's get going.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.dst: 峡谷は勝手に動くんだ。よし、行こう。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.src: I'm not here to stop you. Actually, I wanted to help out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.dst: 止めに来たのではない。むしろ、力になりたいのだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#387.src: There are a lot of things wrong with this town, this society. The judgements that we've made...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#387.dst: この町にも、この社会にも、間違っていることは多い。我々が下してきた裁きも…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#387.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.src: Us elves aren't perfect. We like to say that- and frankly, many of us believe it too.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.dst: 我々エルフは完璧ではない。完璧だと口では言うし、正直、本気で信じている者も多いがな。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.src: I've always wanted to be the change in {p} but it's troublesome to convince those who are stuck in their crooked ways.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.dst: 私はずっと {p} を変える力になりたかった。だが凝り固まった者たちを説得するのは骨が折れる。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.src: Please, bring back Elder Birch- for me. Follow the mountain road to the right until you come across a cave with mushrooms.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.dst: 頼む、私のために 長老 Birchを連れ戻してくれ。山道を右へ進むと、キノコの生えた洞窟がある。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.src: In the meantime, I have some things to ask the Elders- good luck, both of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.dst: その間、私は長老たちに問いただすことがある。二人とも、幸運を。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.src: Venture into the {p} and find the entrance to the sealed away Elder at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.dst: {p} に踏み入り、[{~}, {~}, -{~}] で封印された長老のもとへの入口を見つける。

Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.src: Find your way through the canyon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.dst: 峡谷を抜ける道を探す。

Aldorei's Secret Part II#395.src: You have one minute to explain what you're doing here and who you are before I collapse the mountains around you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#395.dst: 一分やる。何をしに来て、何者なのか説明しろ。さもなくば周りの山を崩すぞ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#395.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.src: An elf and a human- inside of my home!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.dst: エルフと人間が、私の家に！
Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#397.dst: おっとっと！落ち着こう。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#397.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#398.src: You can tell THEM I haven't left my home since my banishment. I haven't said a word, nor have I even considered doing anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#398.dst: 「奴ら」に伝えるがいい。追放されて以来、家から一歩も出ていない。一言も漏らしていないし、何かしようと考えたことすらない。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#398.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.src: We aren't with the Elders. I'm from {p}! We are here for the truth.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.dst: 俺たちは長老の手先じゃない。俺は {p} から来た！真実を知りに来たんだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.src: So this is a test, huh?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.src: Do they... want... me back? Is this why you are here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.dst: 奴らは…私を…呼び戻したいのか？だから来たのか？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.src: We aren't connected to the Elders in any way! I'm here for personal reasons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.dst: 長老たちとは一切関係ない！個人的な理由で来たんだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.src: This is some sort of test from the Elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.dst: これは長老たちの何かの試験だ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.dst: 違うなら、納得させてみろ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.src: Prove it! I can't believe they would just forget about me so quickly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.dst: 証明しろ！奴らがこんなにすぐ私を忘れるとは信じられん。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#412.src: So what? That doesn't prove anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#412.dst: だから何だ？何の証明にもならん。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#412.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.src: What... what did he say about me?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.dst: 彼は…彼は私のことを何と？
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.src: Of course he did, he has always taken my side.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.dst: そうだろうな、彼はいつも私の味方だった。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.src: You know what- I will come with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.dst: いいだろう、一緒に行こう。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.src: But I won't tell you anything. I'm only coming because of Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.dst: だが何も話さんぞ。行くのは Alder のためだけだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.src: Alder would never say that... especially not to the likes of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.dst: Alder がそんなことを言うはずがない…ましてやお前たちのような者に。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.src: Although- I do miss him dearly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.dst: とはいえ、彼にはとても会いたい…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#423.src: Tough luck- I don't know how that would convince me you're not with the elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#423.dst: 残念だったな。それでお前たちが長老の手先でない証拠にはならん。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#423.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.src: You'll have to try harder than that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.dst: もっと頑張ることだな。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.src: If the Elders sent you, then you should already know the answer.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.dst: 長老の差し金なら、答えはもう知っているはずだ。
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.src: I am not telling you anything...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.dst: 何も話すつもりはない…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#428.src: Where did that accusation come from?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#428.dst: その言いがかりはどこから出た？
