Celebrations in Smoke#136~1.src: Some regions are circled, appearing to indicate the location of easy game.
Celebrations in Smoke#136~1.dst: いくつかの場所に丸がつけてあり、獲物が獲りやすい場所を示しているようだ。

Celebrations in Smoke#137~1.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who was observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#137~1.dst: Cerisa が忍び込むのを見ていた、目ざとい人を見つけられれば、これで十分だろう。さらに情報が欲しければ、尋問を続けてもいい。

Celebrations in Smoke#138~1.src: New Quest Start: Celebrations in Smoke
Celebrations in Smoke#138~1.dst: 新しいクエスト開始: 煙と消えた祝祭

Celebrations in Smoke#139~1.src: From the information you have, he just looks like a hunter who really likes green tea?
Celebrations in Smoke#139~1.dst: 手元の情報からすると、彼はただ緑茶が大好きな狩人に見える？

Celebrations in Smoke#140~1.src: It's still stuck. Maybe try again, pulling even harder?
Celebrations in Smoke#140~1.dst: まだ引っかかっている。もっと強く引っ張ってみる？

Celebrations in Smoke#141~1.src: You wouldn't know of anyone at all who claimed to be a green tea merchant?
Celebrations in Smoke#141~1.dst: 緑茶の商人を名乗る人に、まったく心当たりはない？

Celebrations in Smoke#142~1.src: Do you want to wear the fox mask?

Celebrations in Smoke#143~1.src: Based on what you've seen here, while Burick does have a lot of green tea, there's no evidence he's a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#143~1.dst: ここで見た限り、Burick は緑茶をたくさん持っているが、商人だという証拠はない。

Celebrations in Smoke#144~1.dst: Cerisa にさらに質問する？

Celebrations in Smoke#145~1.dst: Arris にさらに質問する？

Celebrations in Smoke#146~1.src: Ask the clan member further questions?
Celebrations in Smoke#146~1.dst: 氏族の一員にさらに質問する？

Celebrations in Smoke#147~1.src: What does it even mean to be a trader in the {p}?
Celebrations in Smoke#147~1.dst: {p} で商人をやるって、そもそもどういうこと？

Celebrations in Smoke#148~1.src: Did you see who burned down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#148~1.dst: 誰がウィッカーマンを燃やしたか見た？

Celebrations in Smoke#150~1.src: Ask the tea enthusiast further questions?
Celebrations in Smoke#150~1.dst: お茶好きの人にさらに質問する？

Celebrations in Smoke#151~1.src: Why did you burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#151~1.dst: どうしてウィッカーマンを燃やしたの？

Celebrations in Smoke#152~1.src: You'll have to interrogate him again to see if you can get any new information.
Celebrations in Smoke#152~1.dst: 新しい情報が得られるか、もう一度尋問する必要がある。

Celebrations in Smoke#153~1.src: I found your camp. There's green tea, but nothing else I would expect from a merchant
Celebrations in Smoke#153~1.dst: 君のキャンプを見つけた。緑茶はあったけど、商人らしいものは他に何もなかった

Celebrations in Smoke#254~1.src: I found this burnt medallion, confirming what I was told by a former clan member of yours. You were exiled for theft.
Celebrations in Smoke#254~1.dst: この焼けたメダリオンを見つけた。君の元氏族の一人から聞いた話どおりだ。君は盗みで追放された。

Celebrations in Smoke#255~1.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who buys a lot of green tea. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#255~1.dst: 緑茶をたくさん買う人を見つけられれば、これで十分だろう。さらに情報が欲しければ、尋問を続けてもいい。

similar.text: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who was observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.

Clearing the Camps#000.src: Talk to Captain Kymer outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Clearing the Camps#000.dst: {p} の外 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる Kymer 隊長と話す

Clearing the Camps#001.src: Aha, another {p} soldier, eh? Well, a warm welcome to you.
Clearing the Camps#001.dst: おお、また {p} の兵か？心から歓迎するよ。
Clearing the Camps#001.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#002.src: Did you hear about the requests from the Villagers we've gotten? They say these "Orcs" and "Goblins" are threatening their towns and cities.
Clearing the Camps#002.dst: 村人からの要請は聞いたか？「Orc」と「Goblin」とやらが、彼らの町を脅かしているそうだ。
Clearing the Camps#002.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#003.src: Primitive, brutal creatures, apparently little better than the zombies we're used to, at least according to the {p} military.
Clearing the Camps#003.dst: {p} 軍によれば、原始的で凶暴な連中で、見慣れたゾンビとたいして変わらんらしい。
Clearing the Camps#003.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#004.src: So, we figure if might makes right with them, then defeating their leaders should scare them into submission.
Clearing the Camps#004.dst: そこで、奴らが力こそ正義なら、首領を倒せば怯えて従うだろうと考えた。
Clearing the Camps#004.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#005.src: Our scouts have identified three "chief" orcs in the area- Elisu, Ceifko and Veltu. Though, strangely Veltu is always surrounded by goblins...
Clearing the Camps#005.dst: 斥候がこの辺りで「族長」のオークを三体見つけた。Elisu、Ceifko、Veltu だ。妙なことに Veltu はいつもゴブリンに囲まれている…
Clearing the Camps#005.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#006.src: Well, whatever the case, we're needed to defend {p} here. Can you handle the chiefs? They seem to hide in the camps with green flags- search the plains, return once they're dealt with!
Clearing the Camps#006.dst: ともかく、我々はここで {p} を守らねばならん。族長どもを任せられるか？緑の旗の野営地に潜んでいるらしい。平原を探し、片付けたら戻ってくれ！
Clearing the Camps#006.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#007.src: Find and kill Orc Chieftains Elisu, Veltu, and Ceifko in the camps around {p}- look for green flags
Clearing the Camps#007.dst: {p} 周辺の野営地でオークの族長 Elisu、Veltu、Ceifko を見つけて倒す。緑の旗が目印

Clearing the Camps#008.src: Report back to Captain Kymer once you have the three heads.
Clearing the Camps#008.dst: 三つの首を手に入れたら Kymer 隊長に報告する。

Clearing the Camps#009.src: Ah, the soldier from earlier! You're back, I see. Any luck defeating those- ...yeesh. Are those their heads?
Clearing the Camps#009.dst: おお、さっきの兵か！戻ったな。奴らの討伐は——…うわ。それ、奴らの首か？
Clearing the Camps#009.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#010.src: That's...harsher than I intended, but it works... Not like the Villagers care if they're dead of alive, as long as they're dealt with. I have your share of the reward here.
Clearing the Camps#010.dst: 思ったより…荒っぽいが、まあいい…片付きさえすれば、村人は生死なんて気にしないしな。これがお前の取り分の報酬だ。
Clearing the Camps#010.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#011.src: This kind of surgical strike should help prevent an all-out war with the Orcs. Not sure we'd want a full-scale war to deal with in each province, hah!
Clearing the Camps#011.dst: こういう精密な一撃で、オークとの全面戦争は避けられるはずだ。地方ごとに大戦争なんて御免だからな、はは！
Clearing the Camps#011.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#012.src: You saw that the creatures in Gavel aren't akin to Wynnic fare while you were out, yes? They're a bit, ah...livelier than usual. Better get used to it.
Clearing the Camps#012.dst: 外で見ただろう、Gavel の生き物は Wynn のとは別物だ。なんというか…いつもより元気がいい。慣れておけ。
Clearing the Camps#012.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#013.src: The next major settlement is {p}, in the swamp up north, but I hear the swamp ogres are a lot tougher than the plains' fare. I'd stick around here and train up, first.
Clearing the Camps#013.dst: 次の大きな集落は北の沼地にある {p} だが、沼のオーガは平原の連中よりずっと手強いと聞く。まずはここで鍛えるといい。
Clearing the Camps#013.speaker: Captain Kymer

Cluck Cluck#000.dst: {p} の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる Nohno と話す

Cluck Cluck#001.src: Hey, you aren't a chicken! Wait, you're a human! You can help me! Maybe you are the guy who helped my brother Yahya, but who knows, you humans all look the same to me.
Cluck Cluck#001.dst: おい、お前ニワトリじゃないな！待て、人間だ！助けてくれ！兄弟の Yahya を助けた奴かもしれないが、人間はみんな同じ顔に見えるからな。
Cluck Cluck#001.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#002.src: I really love my chickens, but there is one that I just cannot control...
Cluck Cluck#002.dst: 俺はニワトリが大好きなんだが、どうしても手に負えない奴が一羽いて…
Cluck Cluck#002.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#003.src: His name is Cluckles, he was given to me by a man named Bob before he went to war, but when Bob never came back, Cluckles got angry...
Cluck Cluck#003.dst: 名前は Cluckles。Bob って男が戦争に行く前にくれたんだが、Bob が帰ってこなくて、Cluckles は怒り出したんだ…
Cluck Cluck#003.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#004.src: He's really dangerous to keep on my lovely island, so I keep him in my basement...
Cluck Cluck#004.dst: 俺の素敵な島に置いておくには危なすぎて、地下室に入れてるんだ…
Cluck Cluck#004.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#005.src: I want to take care of him, but my wife says it's too dangerous. Where's my wife you say? Oh, I think she's around here eating some grain.
Cluck Cluck#005.dst: 面倒を見てやりたいが、妻が危ないって言うんだ。妻はどこかって？ああ、その辺で穀物を食べてると思うよ。
Cluck Cluck#005.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#006.src: Anyway, I need you to go down there and... Take care of him for me. I would really appreciate it.
Cluck Cluck#006.dst: とにかく、下に行って…あいつの面倒を見てきてくれ。すごく助かるよ。
Cluck Cluck#006.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#007.src: Bring back [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] to Nohno.
Cluck Cluck#007.dst: [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] を Nohno に持ち帰る。

Cluck Cluck#008.src: What is this?! His feather? What did you do to Cluckles?! I wanted you to take care of him, not kill him!
Cluck Cluck#008.dst: 何だこれ？！あいつの羽根？Cluckles に何をした？！面倒を見てと頼んだんだ、殺せなんて言ってない！
Cluck Cluck#008.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#009.src: You monster! Leave this place now, and keep that feather to remind you of your hideous crime!
Cluck Cluck#009.dst: この人でなし！今すぐ出ていけ。その羽根を持って、自分の非道な罪を忘れるな！
Cluck Cluck#009.speaker: Nohno

Cook Assistant#000.src: Talk to the Cook in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Cook Assistant#001.src: I can't believe what is happening to me.
Cook Assistant#001.dst: なんてことだ、信じられない。
Cook Assistant#001.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#002.src: The King ordered me to bake cakes for all those new recruits!
Cook Assistant#002.dst: 王様に、新兵全員分のケーキを焼けと命じられたんだ！
Cook Assistant#002.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#003.src: Unfortunately, a Grook took my last cake, and I ran out of ingredients!
Cook Assistant#003.dst: なのに Grook に最後のケーキを取られて、材料も切れた！
Cook Assistant#003.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#005.src: That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#005.dst: あの Grook だ！追いかけてケーキを取り返してくれ！
Cook Assistant#005.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#006.dst: 厄介な Grook を追う。

Cook Assistant#007.src: The Grook got away! Return to the Cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out what to do.
Cook Assistant#007.dst: Grook に逃げられた！[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の料理人のもとへ戻り、どうするか考える。

Cook Assistant#008.src: What are you doing? Go after the Grook...
Cook Assistant#008.dst: 何をしてる？Grook を追ってくれ…
Cook Assistant#008.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#010.src: Well, I guess you are going to have to help me find the ingredients and bake another...
Cook Assistant#010.dst: 仕方ない、材料を探して、もう一つ焼くのを手伝ってもらうしかないな…
Cook Assistant#010.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#011.src: There he is again! After him!
Cook Assistant#011.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#012.src: Find out where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Cook Assistant#012.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Grook が飛んでいった先を探す。

Cook Assistant#013.src: Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Use a Scroll to get there faster.
Cook Assistant#013.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の料理人のもとへ戻る。スクロールを使うと早い。

Cook Assistant#014.dst: やった！ケーキを取り返したな！
Cook Assistant#014.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#015.src: I can't thank you enough! Here, take these emeralds and armour for all your trouble.
Cook Assistant#015.dst: 感謝してもしきれない！ほら、手間賃にエメラルドと防具を持っていってくれ。
Cook Assistant#015.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#016.src: You should explore around to become stronger. I hear there might be work to do in {p}.
Cook Assistant#016.dst: あちこち探索して強くなるといい。{p} に仕事があるかもしれないと聞いたぞ。
Cook Assistant#016.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#017.src: I can't believe what is happening to me...
Cook Assistant#017.dst: なんてことだ、信じられない…

Cook Assistant#018.dst: さて、どう手伝ってもらおうか…

Cook Assistant#019.src: Wait! That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#019.dst: 待て！あの Grook だ！追いかけてケーキを取り返してくれ！

Cook Assistant#020.src: Hey there! You must be new around here too, right? I'm Afelis, and you are...?
Cook Assistant#020.dst: やあ！あなたもここに来たばかりでしょ？私は Afelis、あなたは…？
Cook Assistant#020.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#021.src: {u}! Nice to meet you! I haven't been here in {p} for long myself... still trying to figure things out.
Cook Assistant#021.dst: {u}！よろしくね！私も {p} に来てまだ日が浅くて…いろいろ手探りなんだ。
Cook Assistant#021.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#022.src: It's a bit overwhelming, isn't it? A whole new world to explore, and so many people who need help.
Cook Assistant#022.dst: ちょっと圧倒されちゃうよね？探検する新しい世界がまるごとあって、助けを求める人もたくさんいる。
Cook Assistant#022.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#023.src: I just... I really want to do something that matters, you know? I mean, I came all this way for a reason.
Cook Assistant#023.dst: 私はただ…本当に意味のあることがしたいんだ、わかる？だって、わざわざここまで来たんだもの。
Cook Assistant#023.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#024.src: I want to protect people, make their lives better, if I can. Maybe we can figure this out together?
Cook Assistant#024.dst: できるなら、人を守って、暮らしを良くしたい。一緒に考えていけたらいいな？
Cook Assistant#024.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#025.src: Maybe we can figure this out together?
Cook Assistant#025.dst: 一緒に考えていけたらいいな？
Cook Assistant#025.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#026.src: Oh, well, nice to meet you!
Cook Assistant#026.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#028.src: Hmm... honestly, no. It's strange, isn't it? I don't remember much of anything.
Cook Assistant#028.dst: うーん…正直、覚えてない。変だよね？ほとんど何も思い出せないの。
Cook Assistant#028.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#029.src: Just a vague feeling of... something, maybe, but nothing I could describe.
Cook Assistant#029.dst: なんとなく…何かがあるような気はするけど、言葉にはできないんだ。
Cook Assistant#029.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#030.src: So, here I am, I guess! Wynn's where I'll start making memories that count!
Cook Assistant#030.dst: だから、こうしてここにいるってわけ！Wynn で大切な思い出を作り始めるんだ！
Cook Assistant#030.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#031.src: Oh, there's so much I want to do! I thought I'd begin by helping out around {p}, maybe even in {p} once I've gotten stronger.
Cook Assistant#031.dst: わあ、やりたいことがたくさんあるの！まずは {p} の周りで手伝いから始めて、強くなったら {p} にも行きたいな。
Cook Assistant#031.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#032.src: I've heard {p} needs all the help it can get, and I want to make sure I'm ready.
Cook Assistant#032.dst: {p} はどんな助けでも必要としてるって聞いたから、ちゃんと準備しておきたいの。
Cook Assistant#032.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#033.src: And then... who knows! Anywhere people need someone to lend a hand, I'll be there!
Cook Assistant#033.dst: それから…どうなるかな！誰かが助けを必要としてるなら、どこへでも行くよ！
Cook Assistant#033.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#034.src: Oh, well... I think it's because there's so much good we can do, even in a place like this.
Cook Assistant#034.dst: えっと…こんな場所でも、私たちにできる良いことがたくさんあるからだと思う。
Cook Assistant#034.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#035.src: It's not just about fighting, it's about being there for people, making sure they feel safe.
Cook Assistant#035.dst: 戦うことだけじゃなくて、みんなのそばにいて、安心してもらうことが大事なんだ。
Cook Assistant#035.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#036.src: I know the world has its dark parts, but I'd like to think that maybe, if I keep looking for the good, I can help others see it too.
Cook Assistant#036.dst: 世界に暗い部分があるのはわかってる。でも良いところを探し続ければ、他の人にも見えるようにできるって信じたいんだ。
Cook Assistant#036.speaker: Afelis

Cook Assistant#037.src: Doesn't that sound worth fighting for?
Cook Assistant#037.dst: それって、戦う価値があると思わない？
Cook Assistant#037.speaker: Afelis

Corrupted Betrayal#001.src: Hey, soldier! Yeah, you! Got some spare time to lend a hand?
Corrupted Betrayal#001.dst: おい、兵士！そう、お前だ！手を貸す暇はあるか？
Corrupted Betrayal#001.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#002.src: We've got a major issue with this old fortress. It keeps spewing out all these damned slimes, and their proximity to {p} is causing issues.
Corrupted Betrayal#002.dst: この古い砦で大問題が起きててな。忌々しいスライムが次々湧いて、{p} に近いせいで困ってるんだ。
Corrupted Betrayal#002.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#003.src: Soldiers are spending half their guard duty slicing the critters into sludge. Ideally we'd raid the cave, cut out the source, but...
Corrupted Betrayal#003.dst: 兵士は見張りの半分をスライムをぶった切るのに費やしてる。本当は洞窟に攻め込んで元を断ちたいが…
Corrupted Betrayal#003.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#004.src: This place has some history. Nasty stuff. I'd prefer not to head in blind, so I've been checking for any clues to what we might find inside.
Corrupted Betrayal#004.dst: ここはいわくつきの場所だ。ろくでもない。何も知らずに入りたくないから、中に何があるか手がかりを探してた。
Corrupted Betrayal#004.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#005.src: Haven't found much... except this verse, 'scribed into the wall over there. Go on, check it out and let me know what you think.
Corrupted Betrayal#005.dst: 大して見つからなかった…あそこの壁に刻まれたこの詩以外はな。見て、どう思うか聞かせてくれ。
Corrupted Betrayal#005.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#006.src: Nonsense, if you ask me. Most likely kids from {p} messing about. But we haven't found anything else, so... if you've got any time, fancy checking it out for me?
Corrupted Betrayal#006.dst: 俺に言わせりゃ戯言だ。たぶん {p} の子どものいたずらだろう。だが他に何もない…暇があれば、調べてくれないか？
Corrupted Betrayal#006.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#007.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#007.dst: 一行目は明らかに Great Bridge のことだが、残りはさっぱりだ。行って辺りを見て、面白い物があれば教えてくれ。
Corrupted Betrayal#007.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#008.src: Found anything interesting around the riddle yet? Do you need to hear it again?
Corrupted Betrayal#008.dst: 謎の周りで何か見つかったか？もう一度聞くか？
Corrupted Betrayal#008.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#009.src: Near a corrupted bridge, a ruin past its prime..
Corrupted Betrayal#009.dst: 腐敗の橋のそば、盛りを過ぎた廃墟あり…
Corrupted Betrayal#009.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#010.src: Lives a cursed sheep, with the color of lime...
Corrupted Betrayal#010.dst: 呪われし羊住む、ライムのごとき色をして…
Corrupted Betrayal#010.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#011.src: Lead it down the trail, headed to the slime...
Corrupted Betrayal#011.dst: 小道を導き、スライムのもとへ連れゆき…
Corrupted Betrayal#011.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#012.src: Sacrifice its soul, in the blood and the grime.
Corrupted Betrayal#012.dst: その魂を捧げよ、血と泥の中にて。
Corrupted Betrayal#012.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#013.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#013.dst: 一行目は明らかに Great Bridge のことだが、残りはさっぱりだ。行って辺りを見て、面白い物があれば教えてくれ。
Corrupted Betrayal#013.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#014.src: Alrighty. Let me know what when you've got something then.
Corrupted Betrayal#014.dst: よし。何か分かったら知らせてくれ。
Corrupted Betrayal#014.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#015.src: Use the Mage's riddle to figure out where it leads
Corrupted Betrayal#015.dst: 魔術師の謎を解いて、行き先を突き止める

Corrupted Betrayal#016.src: If you are heading towards the Great Bridge, be cautious in the plains around the jungle entrance.
Corrupted Betrayal#016.dst: Great Bridge へ向かうなら、ジャングル入口付近の平原では気をつけてください。
Corrupted Betrayal#016.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#017.src: I have received reports of a strange cursed sheep taking refuge in one of the more fortified ruins around there.
Corrupted Betrayal#017.dst: あの辺りの堅固な遺跡の一つに、妙な呪われた羊が逃げ込んだと報告を受けています。
Corrupted Betrayal#017.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#018.src: As far as I know, it is trapped in the ruins by some jungle growth, though if it was cut down it might escape...
Corrupted Betrayal#018.dst: 聞くところでは、ジャングルの草木で遺跡に閉じ込められているとか。刈り取れば逃げ出すかも…
Corrupted Betrayal#018.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#019.src: Explore the temple for a way to break the barrier.
Corrupted Betrayal#019.dst: 神殿を探索し、障壁を破る方法を探す。

Corrupted Betrayal#020.src: Go to Slykaar's residence at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find out what is hidden there.
Corrupted Betrayal#020.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Slykaar の住居へ行き、隠されたものを突き止める。

Corrupted Betrayal#021.src: By order of the city of {p}, I am here to keep other citizens from entering this house.
Corrupted Betrayal#021.dst: {p} 市の命により、市民がこの家に入らぬよう見張っています。
Corrupted Betrayal#021.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#022.src: From past experiences, everyone who has entered this house has vanished from existence...
Corrupted Betrayal#022.dst: これまで、この家に入った者は皆、跡形もなく消えました…
Corrupted Betrayal#022.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#023.src: I would advise not going inside unless you know what you are doing.
Corrupted Betrayal#023.dst: 何をしているか分かっていないなら、入らないことをお勧めします。
Corrupted Betrayal#023.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#024.src: Well, I guess you must know who I am.
Corrupted Betrayal#024.dst: さて、私が誰かは知っているはずだ。

Corrupted Betrayal#025.src: Welcome to my domain. I am the hero of {p}, Slykaar.
Corrupted Betrayal#025.dst: 我が領域へようこそ。私は {p} の英雄、Slykaar だ。

Corrupted Betrayal#026.src: Well, I used to be. Banished by the very people who asked for my help. Pathetic.
Corrupted Betrayal#026.dst: いや、かつてはな。助けを求めた者たちに追放された。哀れなものだ。
Corrupted Betrayal#026.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#027.src: They couldn't give me a few peasants for their safety? Weak.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.dst: 身の安全のために、農民を数人差し出すこともできんとは？軟弱な。
Corrupted Betrayal#027.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#029.src: I experimented my shamanism for many years underground to create the perfect mix of monster.
Corrupted Betrayal#029.dst: 何年も地下でシャーマンの術を試し、完璧な怪物の配合を追い求めた。
Corrupted Betrayal#029.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#030.src: Most ended in horrific slimes. Aggressive and powerful, but alas, just slimes.
Corrupted Betrayal#030.dst: ほとんどは恐ろしいスライムに終わった。凶暴で強いが、所詮スライムだ。
Corrupted Betrayal#030.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#031.src: Then I found this place. A dark land. A dark god. A source of power.
Corrupted Betrayal#031.dst: そして、この場所を見つけた。暗黒の地。暗黒の神。力の源。
Corrupted Betrayal#031.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#032.src: You mediocre wielders of magic have no idea what this world holds.
Corrupted Betrayal#032.dst: 凡庸な魔法使いどもは、この世界の真実を知らぬ。
Corrupted Betrayal#032.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#033.src: You all strive to be that hero of heroes, “Bob”, but here's the truth. He's lost. You're lost.
Corrupted Betrayal#033.dst: 誰もが英雄の中の英雄「Bob」を目指す。だが真実を教えよう。奴は迷った。お前もだ。
Corrupted Betrayal#033.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#034.src: No one in the Wynn province is willing to make the sacrifices I am to gain power.
Corrupted Betrayal#034.dst: Wynn 地方に、私ほど力のために犠牲を払える者はいない。
Corrupted Betrayal#034.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#035.src: If you want power, you have to give some. Sacrifice a few to save many.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.dst: 力が欲しければ、何かを差し出せ。少数を犠牲に、多数を救え。
Corrupted Betrayal#035.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#036.src: They were willing to give me a few peasants in {~}, when the hordes crossed the bridge.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.dst: {~} 年、大群が橋を越えた時、奴らは農民を数人差し出したではないか。
Corrupted Betrayal#036.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#037.src: The king was happy to throw away lives to save his. But then the hero of Wynn waltzed in a few years later.
Corrupted Betrayal#037.dst: 王は自分の命のために喜んで他人を捨てた。だが数年後、Wynn の英雄がのこのこ現れた。
Corrupted Betrayal#037.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#038.src: They banished me like a rotten fruit. Their hero, their protector. So what if a few hundred nobodies died for it.
Corrupted Betrayal#038.dst: 奴らは私を腐った果実のように追放した。英雄であり守護者の私を。無名の者が数百死んだから何だ。
Corrupted Betrayal#038.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#039.src: Looks like we have a Bob aspirer. Pale imitation.
Corrupted Betrayal#039.dst: Bob の信奉者のお出ましか。粗悪な模倣品め。
Corrupted Betrayal#039.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#040.src: So. Feel free to visit me down below, bring the entire might of the {p} army upon me. It will not be enough.
Corrupted Betrayal#040.dst: さあ、下まで会いに来るがいい。{p} の全軍を引き連れてな。それでも足りぬ。
Corrupted Betrayal#040.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#041.src: I am ready. Soon, {p} will be in ruins. And I shall have my revenge.
Corrupted Betrayal#041.dst: 準備はできた。じきに {p} は廃墟となり、私は復讐を果たす。
Corrupted Betrayal#041.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#042.src: Go have fun in while you can. It's not like you have much of a life to live, anyways.
Corrupted Betrayal#042.dst: 今のうちに楽しんでおけ。どうせ残りの人生など大してないのだから。
Corrupted Betrayal#042.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#043.src: Report back to Lanu about what you've learned.
Corrupted Betrayal#043.dst: 分かったことを Lanu に報告する。

Corrupted Betrayal#044.src: Ah, you're back. Find anything interesting? I've just been knocking back the occasional slime that pops up out of this cave.
Corrupted Betrayal#044.dst: おお、戻ったか。何か見つかったか？俺はこの洞窟から出てくるスライムを時々叩いてただけだ。
Corrupted Betrayal#044.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#045.src: You... saw Slykaar? In another dimension?!
Corrupted Betrayal#045.dst: Slykaar に…会った？別の次元で？！
Corrupted Betrayal#045.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#046.src: This is bad. If he can materialise outside of this cave, even psychoactively... he's getting stronger. It explains the slimes, the attacks on {p}...
Corrupted Betrayal#046.dst: まずいな。精神だけでもこの洞窟の外に現れられるなら…奴は強くなってる。スライムも、{p} への襲撃も説明がつく…
Corrupted Betrayal#046.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#047.src: He's an incredibly powerful shaman, {u}. He has to be stopped, but it would take forever for {p} to mobile a force against him.
Corrupted Betrayal#047.dst: 奴は恐ろしく強力なシャーマンだ、{u}。止めねばならんが、{p} が部隊を集めるには時間がかかりすぎる。
Corrupted Betrayal#047.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#048.src: If you can, you should head in there and... finish him off. Gear up first, though, and find some friends watch your back.
Corrupted Betrayal#048.dst: できるなら、中に入って…奴を仕留めてくれ。だが先に装備を整えて、背中を守る仲間を見つけろ。
Corrupted Betrayal#048.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#049.src: {u}, how's it going? Run into another shaman hallucination at all?
Corrupted Betrayal#049.dst: {u}、調子はどうだ？また例のシャーマンの幻覚に出くわしたか？
Corrupted Betrayal#049.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#050.src: Anyway, good luck in the cave. If you choose to go in, be careful.
Corrupted Betrayal#050.dst: とにかく、洞窟では幸運を。入るなら気をつけろ。
Corrupted Betrayal#050.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#000~1.src: In {~} AP, {p} was on its knees. Hordes of undead were crippling the army and castle.
Corrupted Betrayal#000~1.dst: {~} AP、{p} は屈しかけていた。アンデッドの大群が軍と城を追い詰めていた。

Cowfusion#001.src: A Human, eh? All the way out 'ere at the end of the canyon? Yer a tough one.
Cowfusion#001.dst: 人間か？峡谷の果てまで来るたぁ、タフな奴だな。
Cowfusion#001.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#002.src: Perhaps I can give yer some work, if yer are lookin' for it? Someone's been coming and nabbing my cows!
Cowfusion#002.dst: 仕事を探してるなら頼みがあるんだが？誰かが俺の牛をかっさらっていくんだ！
Cowfusion#002.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#003.src: 'an I know exactly who it is - that blasted cow scientist that lives in the lab just north of 'ere.
Cowfusion#003.dst: 犯人は分かってる。すぐ北の研究所に住んでる、あのいまいましい牛の科学者だ。
Cowfusion#003.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#004.src: Anyway, yer up for the job? Can't let 'im just keep stealing them forever!
Cowfusion#004.dst: で、引き受けてくれるか？盗まれっぱなしじゃたまらん！
Cowfusion#004.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#005.src: His cavern laboratory is just north from 'ere. Not too hard to find. Once yer there, get him to return my cows!
Cowfusion#005.dst: 奴の洞窟研究所はすぐ北だ。すぐ見つかるさ。着いたら牛を返させてくれ！
Cowfusion#005.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#006.src: There's one problem though. The door to the place is always shut, so you'll 'ave to find another way in.
Cowfusion#006.dst: ただ問題がある。あそこの扉はいつも閉まってるから、別の入り口を探さにゃならん。
Cowfusion#006.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#008.src: Find a way into the Laboratory
Cowfusion#008.dst: 研究所に入る方法を見つける

Cowfusion#009.src: Search the Laboratory for the missing cows
Cowfusion#009.dst: 研究所で行方不明の牛を探す

Cowfusion#010.src: Find a way to free the Cows.
Cowfusion#010.dst: 牛を解放する方法を見つける。

Cowfusion#012.dst: 何が起きたか突き止める

Cowfusion#014.dst: こりゃどういうこった？信じらんねえ、お前なのか？俺の娘っ子よ、戻ってくると信じてたぞ！
Cowfusion#014.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#015.dst: 町暮らしの人間を雇ってお前を連れ戻させようなんて考えてたとはな？ハッ！
Cowfusion#015.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#016.dst: よし、囲いに戻れ。ほれ、行け！
Cowfusion#016.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#017.dst: Ranol の農場から逃げ出す

Cowfusion#021.src: You're right, there is no password. Just seeing if you can understand me.
Cowfusion#021.dst: その通り、合言葉なんてない。言葉が通じるか試しただけさ。
Cowfusion#021.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#022.src: You're one of us then, the oppressed? Want to break free from these farmers? Well aren't you in luck.
Cowfusion#022.dst: つまりお前も虐げられし仲間か？農夫どもから自由になりたい？なら運がいいぞ。
Cowfusion#022.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#023.src: I can help you with that. WE can help you with that.
Cowfusion#023.dst: 俺が手を貸そう。いや、「俺たち」がな。
Cowfusion#023.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#024.src: Our people have a secret hideout not far from here. It's located right under that barn just behind me.
Cowfusion#024.dst: 俺たちの秘密の隠れ家がこの近くにある。俺の後ろの納屋の真下だ。
Cowfusion#024.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#025.src: It may seem close, but unless you've been practicing your atheletics, you won't be able to get over these fences.
Cowfusion#025.dst: 近く見えるが、よほど体を鍛えてなきゃこの柵は越えられないぞ。
Cowfusion#025.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#026.src: See that haybale in the middle of our pen? I bet you could push and pull it into such a position that'd allow you to climb over the fence with your cow physique.
Cowfusion#026.dst: 囲いの真ん中の干し草が見えるか？あれを押したり引いたりしてうまく置けば、牛の体でも柵を乗り越えられるはずだ。
Cowfusion#026.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#027.src: The second pen might have a similar problem, but I'm sure you can figure that out yourself.
Cowfusion#027.dst: 二つ目の囲いも似たような問題があるかもしれんが、自分でなんとかできるだろう。
Cowfusion#027.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#031.src: What? What does that even mean? There isn't actually a password! Or did no one tell me that there was? Ah, nevermind, at least you can understand me.
Cowfusion#031.dst: は？どういう意味だ？合言葉なんて本当はないぞ！それとも俺だけ聞かされてないのか？まあいい、言葉は通じるな。
Cowfusion#031.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#032.src: You're one of us then, the oppressed? Want to break free from these farmers? Well aren't you in luck.
Cowfusion#032.dst: つまりお前も虐げられし仲間か？農夫どもから自由になりたい？なら運がいいぞ。
Cowfusion#032.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#033.src: I can help you with that. WE can help you with that.
Cowfusion#033.dst: 俺が手を貸そう。いや、「俺たち」がな。
Cowfusion#033.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#034.src: Our people have a secret hideout not far from here. It's located right under that barn just behind me.
Cowfusion#034.dst: 俺たちの秘密の隠れ家がこの近くにある。俺の後ろの納屋の真下だ。
Cowfusion#034.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#035.src: It may seem close, but unless you've been practicing your atheletics, you won't be able to get over these fences.
Cowfusion#035.dst: 近く見えるが、よほど体を鍛えてなきゃこの柵は越えられないぞ。
Cowfusion#035.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#036.src: See that haybale in the middle of our pen? I bet you could push and pull it into such a position that'd allow you to climb over the fence with your cow physique.
Cowfusion#036.dst: 囲いの真ん中の干し草が見えるか？あれを押したり引いたりしてうまく置けば、牛の体でも柵を乗り越えられるはずだ。
Cowfusion#036.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#037.src: The second pen might have a similar problem, but I'm sure you can figure that out yourself.
Cowfusion#037.dst: 二つ目の囲いも似たような問題があるかもしれんが、自分でなんとかできるだろう。
Cowfusion#037.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#039.src: Find and enter the Secret Cow Hideout
Cowfusion#039.dst: 秘密の牛の隠れ家を見つけて入る

Cowfusion#041.src: Oh, a new recruit? We weren't expecting anyone at this time. How'd you find your way in?
Cowfusion#041.dst: あら、新入り？この時間に来る予定の人はいないはずだけど。どうやって入ってきたの？
Cowfusion#041.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#042.src: Wait, you're different. Something's off about you. Like you've never been in a cow's body before.
Cowfusion#042.dst: 待って、あなた何か違う。どこか変よ。まるで牛の体に入ったことがないみたい。
Cowfusion#042.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#043.src: Oh. Oh, this is not good. Uhm, you should talk to the boss. He'll probably know what to do with you.
Cowfusion#043.dst: あ。ああ、これはまずいわ。えっと、ボスと話したほうがいいわね。どうすればいいか分かるはずよ。
Cowfusion#043.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#044.src: You'll find him in the big office at the very end of this facility. Just stick to the path and don't be nosey, okay?
Cowfusion#044.dst: この施設の一番奥の大きな事務室にいるわ。道なりに進んで、よそ見はしないでね？
Cowfusion#044.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#045.src: Find the one who's in charge of the hideout
Cowfusion#045.dst: 隠れ家の責任者を探す

Cowfusion#047.src: Whoop, alright! Don't want you going anywhere, buddy! Uh... What are you doing here, exactly...?
Cowfusion#047.dst: おっと、よし！どこにも行かせないよ、君！えっと…それで、ここで何をしてるのかな…？
Cowfusion#047.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#048.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#048.dst: 君が…なんだって？ええっ、そんなことありえるの？そんなことができる物なんて何も…
Cowfusion#048.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#049.src: Oh! You must've been snooping through my laboratory. That's... okay, we can talk about that later. Did you step into my machine?
Cowfusion#049.dst: あっ！僕の研究所をこそこそ嗅ぎ回ってたんだな。それは…まあいい、その話は後だ。僕の機械に入ったの？
Cowfusion#049.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#050.src: It's not even meant to do that! Its purpose is to turn the exiles back into Wocs. So how does a Human become a cow...?
Cowfusion#050.dst: そんな機能はないはずなんだ！あれは追放者を Woc に戻すための物だ。なのにどうして人間が牛に…？
Cowfusion#050.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#051.src: Right, right, sorry. Here, uh- I'll try and get this cage down. Darn controls... Why did I design these so poorly?
Cowfusion#051.dst: そうだね、ごめん。えっと、この檻を降ろしてみるよ。操作盤め…なんでこんな下手な設計にしたんだ？
Cowfusion#051.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#052.src: ...So while I try to figure out which lever to push, tell me about yourself! Anything interesting going on in your life?
Cowfusion#052.dst: …で、どのレバーを押すか考えてる間に、君の話を聞かせてよ！最近何か面白いことあった？
Cowfusion#052.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#053.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!
Cowfusion#053.dst: 君は…君なのか？君だ！わあ、また会えて嬉しいよ！Wynn で一緒に暴れ回った日々から随分経つね！
Cowfusion#053.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#054.src: This is great, actually! I- I can show you around this place! Introduce you to some of the folks we freed together! Oh, what fantastic timing this has been.
Cowfusion#054.dst: これは最高だよ！ここを案内してあげられる！一緒に救い出した仲間を紹介するよ！なんていいタイミングなんだ。
Cowfusion#054.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#055.src: I just need to figure out which switch to pull... I think it's this one! Probably. I really need to label these things. Alright, here goes!
Cowfusion#055.dst: どのスイッチを引くか分かれば…たぶんこれだ！きっと。本当にラベルを貼らなきゃ。よし、いくぞ！
Cowfusion#055.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#057.src: I, uh... Hah. Very funny. Tell me you're a human, then pretend to be a cow.
Cowfusion#057.dst: えっと…ハハ。面白いね。人間だと言っておいて、牛のふりか。
Cowfusion#057.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#058.src: That's... fine. You know, I'm under quite a lot of stress right now. Working hard, day in and day out. I don't really need your attitude right now!
Cowfusion#058.dst: それは…いいよ。僕は今すごくストレスを抱えてるんだ。毎日毎日働き詰めでね。そんな態度はいらないんだよ！
Cowfusion#058.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#059.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.
Cowfusion#059.dst: そうだよ、そんな態度はいらない。君を奈落に送ってやる。僕の失敗作が…全部眠ってる場所にね。
Cowfusion#059.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#060.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#060.dst: …武器があるだろ。なんとかなるさ！僕の助けなんていらないよね！ほら、下の居心地を味わってこい！
Cowfusion#060.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#062.src: Okay. So you are just a regular cow. Not a Woc. Uh... Who let you in, little pal? I'm going to need to have to have a word about closing the doors...
Cowfusion#062.dst: そうか。君はただの普通の牛か。Woc じゃない。えっと…誰が入れたんだい、おちびさん？扉を閉めるよう言っておかないと…
Cowfusion#062.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#063.src: Well, this is... awkward. So, then... cow. What's it like being... a cow?
Cowfusion#063.dst: うーん、これは…気まずいな。じゃあ…牛くん。牛って…どんな気分？
Cowfusion#063.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#064.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#064.dst: 君が…なんだって？ええっ、そんなことありえるの？そんなことができる物なんて何も…
Cowfusion#064.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#065.src: Oh! You must've been snooping through my laboratory. That's... okay, we can talk about that later. Did you step into my machine?
Cowfusion#065.dst: あっ！僕の研究所をこそこそ嗅ぎ回ってたんだな。それは…まあいい、その話は後だ。僕の機械に入ったの？
Cowfusion#065.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#066.dst: そんな機能はないはずなんだ！あれは追放者を Woc に戻すための物だ。なのにどうして人間が牛に…？
Cowfusion#066.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#067.dst: そうだね、ごめん。えっと、この檻を降ろしてみるよ。操作盤め…なんでこんな下手な設計にしたんだ？
Cowfusion#067.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#068.src: ...So while I try to figure out which lever to push, tell me about yourself! Anything interesting going on in your life?
Cowfusion#068.dst: …で、どのレバーを押すか考えてる間に、君の話を聞かせてよ！最近何か面白いことあった？
Cowfusion#068.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#069.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!
Cowfusion#069.dst: 君は…君なのか？君だ！わあ、また会えて嬉しいよ！Wynn で一緒に暴れ回った日々から随分経つね！
Cowfusion#069.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#070.src: This is great, actually! I- I can show you around this place! Introduce you to some of the folks we freed together! Oh, what fantastic timing this has been.
Cowfusion#070.dst: これは最高だよ！ここを案内してあげられる！一緒に救い出した仲間を紹介するよ！なんていいタイミングなんだ。
Cowfusion#070.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#071.src: I just need to figure out which switch to pull... I think it's this one! Probably. I really need to label these things. Alright, here goes!
Cowfusion#071.dst: どのスイッチを引くか分かれば…たぶんこれだ！きっと。本当にラベルを貼らなきゃ。よし、いくぞ！
Cowfusion#071.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#073.src: I, uh... Hah. Very funny. Tell me you're a human, then pretend to be a cow.
Cowfusion#073.dst: えっと…ハハ。面白いね。人間だと言っておいて、牛のふりか。
Cowfusion#073.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#074.src: That's... fine. You know, I'm under quite a lot of stress right now. Working hard, day in and day out. I don't really need your attitude right now!
Cowfusion#074.dst: それは…いいよ。僕は今すごくストレスを抱えてるんだ。毎日毎日働き詰めでね。そんな態度はいらないんだよ！
Cowfusion#074.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#075.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.
Cowfusion#075.dst: そうだよ、そんな態度はいらない。君を奈落に送ってやる。僕の失敗作が…全部眠ってる場所にね。
Cowfusion#075.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#076.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#076.dst: …武器があるだろ。なんとかなるさ！僕の助けなんていらないよね！ほら、下の居心地を味わってこい！
Cowfusion#076.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#078.src: Right. Okay. Figure I'd best let you go free.
Cowfusion#078.dst: うん。そうか。逃がしてあげたほうがいいよね。
Cowfusion#078.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#079.src: ...Unless. Unless. Nobody's... nobody's looking. I could just send you to The Pit... Nobody would know.
Cowfusion#079.dst: …待てよ。誰も…誰も見てない。奈落に送っちゃえば…誰にも分からない。
Cowfusion#079.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#080.src: It's... easier this way. It's fine. Maybe you'll even- maybe you'll even make your way out. Good luck, little buddy.
Cowfusion#080.dst: こっちのほうが…楽だ。大丈夫。もしかしたら君も…自力で出てこられるかも。頑張ってね、おちびさん。
Cowfusion#080.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#083.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#083.dst: 焼却炉に落ちた？それで変異した牛の怪物を倒したって？
Cowfusion#083.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#084.src: ...Oh! You're the one Drale told us to look out for. Accidentally dropped into the Pit, huh?
Cowfusion#084.dst: …あっ！Drale が言ってた奴か。うっかり奈落に落とされたんだって？
Cowfusion#084.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#085.src: The boss said to apologize to ya for the inconvenience. We've all been workin' late hours recently... Some of us more than others.
Cowfusion#085.dst: ボスが迷惑かけて済まないってさ。最近はみんな夜遅くまで働いててな…人によっちゃ特にな。
Cowfusion#085.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#086.src: Anyhow, follow me. I'll take you back to him, and you can talk this out! You'll be back as a human in no time.
Cowfusion#086.dst: とにかくついてきな。ボスのところに連れてくから、話し合えばいい！すぐ人間に戻れるさ。
Cowfusion#086.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#087.src: So... yeah. That's Drale for you. Absentminded as ever. He said something about labeling his levers from now on, so I reckon that's a positive.
Cowfusion#087.dst: で…まあ。あれが Drale って奴さ。相変わらずうっかり者だ。今後はレバーにラベルを貼るって言ってたから、良い兆しかな。
Cowfusion#087.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#088.src: ...You're a good friend of the boss, right? Would you be able to put in a good word for us? Gerald and I have been down here for a while, and we'd like to get back to our normal positions.
Cowfusion#088.dst: …あんた、ボスの親友なんだろ？俺たちのことを口添えしてくれないか？Gerald と俺はここに長くいてな、元の持ち場に戻りたいんだ。
Cowfusion#088.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#089.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#089.dst: Drale は機嫌のいい日はいい奴なんだが、最近はそんな日が減っててな！例の…まるで無用な計画で毎晩遅くまで粘ってるんだ！
Cowfusion#089.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#090.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#090.dst: 手持ちの資材で新しい船を造ればいいのに、元の船を探し続けるって言い張るんだ！馬鹿げてるよ！
Cowfusion#090.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#091.src: Maybe you'll be able to get through to him, being his friend and all. We've all been stressed, and it's really just...
Cowfusion#091.dst: 友達のあんたなら話が通じるかもな。みんな参ってて、ほんとにもう…
Cowfusion#091.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#092.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#092.dst: 何の船かって？ああ、あんたは Woc じゃないもんな。実は俺たちの種族は元々…いや、その話はまた今度にしよう。
Cowfusion#092.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#093.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab. Drale will be glad to see you in one piece! He sounded worried for your safety.
Cowfusion#093.dst: 今はとにかく上の主研究所に戻ろう。無事な姿を見たら Drale も喜ぶさ！あんたの身を心配してたみたいだし。
Cowfusion#093.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#095.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#095.dst: あのパイプを上れば、運が良けりゃ Drale の目の前にポンと出られるさ。
Cowfusion#095.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#096.src: Remember what I told you! Try to put in a good word for us, yeah?
Cowfusion#096.dst: 言ったこと忘れるなよ！俺たちのこと口添えしてくれよな？
Cowfusion#096.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#097.src: If not, well... At least I tried. Let the record show I tried.
Cowfusion#097.dst: 駄目なら、まあ…少なくとも俺は頼んだ。それだけは覚えといてくれ。
Cowfusion#097.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#098.src: ...Alright! Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#098.dst: …よし！さあ行きな！会えてよかったよ。
Cowfusion#098.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#100.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#100.dst: 焼却炉に落ちた？それで変異した牛の怪物を倒したって？
Cowfusion#100.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#101.src: Yeah that checks out. So what happened to get you thrown down here?
Cowfusion#101.dst: ああ、それなら納得だ。で、何があってここに落とされたんだ？
Cowfusion#101.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#102.src: Oh, angered him by pretending to be a cow after already speaking? Yeah, I feel ya. When the boss is in a mood, anything you say could get you thrown down here.
Cowfusion#102.dst: もう喋ってたのに牛のふりして怒らせた？ああ、分かるよ。ボスの機嫌が悪いと、何言っても落とされるからな。
Cowfusion#102.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#103.src: Here, why don't you follow me? I'll take you back to him, you can straighten things out, and I'm sure you'll be back as a human in no time!
Cowfusion#103.dst: ほら、ついてきな。ボスのところに連れてくから、誤解を解けばいい。きっとすぐ人間に戻れるさ！
Cowfusion#103.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#104.src: So... yeah. Drale isn't the best at... conflict resolution. Catch him on a bad day, and he might just throw you in the Pit.
Cowfusion#104.dst: で…まあ。Drale は…揉め事の収め方が下手でな。機嫌の悪い日に当たると、奈落に放り込まれかねない。
Cowfusion#104.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#105.src: I got stationed down here for a week because I interrupted him during his daily yoga session.
Cowfusion#105.dst: 俺は毎日のヨガの最中に話しかけちまって、一週間ここに回されたんだ。
Cowfusion#105.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#106.src: Gerald, over there? He used to be in accounting. Until he forgot to carry the two one day, and... Well, here he is now.
Cowfusion#106.dst: あっちの Gerald？昔は経理だったんだ。ある日繰り上がりを忘れて…で、今はここにいる。
Cowfusion#106.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#107.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#107.dst: Drale は機嫌のいい日はいい奴なんだが、最近はそんな日が減っててな！例の…まるで無用な計画で毎晩遅くまで粘ってるんだ！
Cowfusion#107.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#108.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#108.dst: 手持ちの資材で新しい船を造ればいいのに、元の船を探し続けるって言い張るんだ！馬鹿げてるよ！
Cowfusion#108.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#109.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#109.dst: 何の船かって？ああ、あんたは Woc じゃないもんな。実は俺たちの種族は元々…いや、その話はまた今度にしよう。
Cowfusion#109.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#110.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab and hopefully Drale will be in a bit of a better mood!
Cowfusion#110.dst: 今はとにかく上の主研究所に戻ろう。Drale の機嫌が少しは直ってるといいな！
Cowfusion#110.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#112.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#112.dst: あのパイプを上れば、運が良けりゃ Drale の目の前にポンと出られるさ。
Cowfusion#112.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#113.src: If you try explaining the situation again I'm sure he'll be understanding.
Cowfusion#113.dst: もう一度事情を説明すれば、きっと分かってくれるさ。
Cowfusion#113.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#114.src: He usually is after he's had some time to cool off.
Cowfusion#114.dst: 少し頭を冷やせば、たいていそうなる。
Cowfusion#114.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#115.src: Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#115.dst: さあ行きな！会えてよかったよ。
Cowfusion#115.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#117.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#117.dst: 焼却炉に落ちた？それで変異した牛の怪物を倒したって？
Cowfusion#117.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#118.src: Yeah that checks out. So what happened to get you thrown down here?
Cowfusion#118.dst: ああ、それなら納得だ。で、何があってここに落とされたんだ？
Cowfusion#118.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#119.src: Pretended to be a cow when you're actually a human? Must have caught him on a rough day to get thrown down for that. Usually he'd just let a cow go.
Cowfusion#119.dst: 本当は人間なのに牛のふり？そんなことで落とされるとは、よほど機嫌の悪い日だったんだな。いつもなら牛は逃がすのに。
Cowfusion#119.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#120.src: Well here, why don't you follow me? I'll take you back to him, you can straighten things out, and I'm sure you'll be back as a human in no time!
Cowfusion#120.dst: じゃあ、ついてきな。ボスのところに連れてくから、誤解を解けばいい。きっとすぐ人間に戻れるさ！
Cowfusion#120.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#121.src: So... yeah. That's Drale. Catch him on a bad day, and he might just throw you into the Pit.
Cowfusion#121.dst: で…まあ。あれが Drale さ。機嫌の悪い日に当たると、奈落に放り込まれかねない。
Cowfusion#121.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#122.src: I got stationed down here for a week because I interrupted him during his daily yoga session.
Cowfusion#122.dst: 俺は毎日のヨガの最中に話しかけちまって、一週間ここに回されたんだ。
Cowfusion#122.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#123.src: Gerald, over there? He used to be in accounting. Until he forgot to carry the two one day, and... Well, here he is now.
Cowfusion#123.dst: あっちの Gerald？昔は経理だったんだ。ある日繰り上がりを忘れて…で、今はここにいる。
Cowfusion#123.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#124.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#124.dst: Drale は機嫌のいい日はいい奴なんだが、最近はそんな日が減っててな！例の…まるで無用な計画で毎晩遅くまで粘ってるんだ！
Cowfusion#124.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#125.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#125.dst: 手持ちの資材で新しい船を造ればいいのに、元の船を探し続けるって言い張るんだ！馬鹿げてるよ！
Cowfusion#125.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#126.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#126.dst: 何の船かって？ああ、あんたは Woc じゃないもんな。実は俺たちの種族は元々…いや、その話はまた今度にしよう。
Cowfusion#126.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#127.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab and hopefully Drale will be in a bit of a better mood! Maybe mention the human thing this time, alright?
Cowfusion#127.dst: 今はとにかく上の主研究所に戻ろう。Drale の機嫌が直ってるといいな！今度は人間だってちゃんと言えよ？
Cowfusion#127.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#129.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#129.dst: あのパイプを上れば、運が良けりゃ Drale の目の前にポンと出られるさ。
Cowfusion#129.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#130.src: If you try explaining the situation again I'm sure he'll be understanding.
Cowfusion#130.dst: もう一度事情を説明すれば、きっと分かってくれるさ。
Cowfusion#130.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#131.src: He usually is after he's had some time to cool off.
Cowfusion#131.dst: 少し頭を冷やせば、たいていそうなる。
Cowfusion#131.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#132.src: Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#132.dst: さあ行きな！会えてよかったよ。
Cowfusion#132.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#134.src: Oh, this is- Oh! You're alive! I, ah- heh. Sorry about... all that. I really, really need to label these levers properly...
Cowfusion#134.dst: あっ、これは…あっ！生きてたんだ！僕、その…へへ。いろいろ…ごめん。本当に、本当にレバーにラベルを貼らないと…
Cowfusion#134.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#135.src: Right! Right. You'se seen... all that down there, then. I just hope you won't think less of me for it.
Cowfusion#135.dst: そう！そうだね。じゃあ下の…あれこれを見たんだね。それで僕を軽蔑しないでくれるといいけど。
Cowfusion#135.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#136.src: I can... I can tell you more about it later. I hope it wasn't too bad? Down there? You seen to have gotten out in one piece, so...
Cowfusion#136.dst: その話は…また後でするよ。下はそんなにひどくなかった？無事に出てこられたみたいだし…
Cowfusion#136.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#137.src: ...Oh. Right. Gosh, how long has it been since I-...
Cowfusion#137.dst: …あ。そうか。ああ、もうどれくらい…
Cowfusion#137.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#138.src: Okay. Alright, yes, I'll give them better positions. And I'll- I don't know. Apologize. Give them a bonus.
Cowfusion#138.dst: 分かった。うん、彼らにはいい持ち場を用意するよ。それと…どうしよう。謝って、ボーナスを出すか。
Cowfusion#138.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#139.src: It's been... hard, recently. We've been working to get back home, and I guess I just... Put too much of myself into that. It's fine! Don't- Don't worry about me.
Cowfusion#139.dst: 最近は…つらくてね。故郷に帰ろうと頑張ってて、たぶん僕は…自分を注ぎ込みすぎたんだ。大丈夫！僕の…僕のことは心配しないで。
Cowfusion#139.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#140.src: Oh. Right, your body! I can fix that! We just need to get back to the machine, and... Poof. You'll be back to normal!
Cowfusion#140.dst: あ。そうだ、君の体！直せるよ！機械のところに戻れば…ポン。元通りさ！
Cowfusion#140.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#141.src: ...I hope. Hey, being a cow isn't so bad! If- If it doesn't work, we can make you a home here...?
Cowfusion#141.dst: …たぶん。ねえ、牛も悪くないよ！もし…駄目だったら、ここに住めばいいし…？
Cowfusion#141.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#142.src: Uh... It'll work. It's always- always worked in the past! Heh...
Cowfusion#142.dst: えっと…うまくいくよ。今までずっと…ずっとうまくいったし！へへ…
Cowfusion#142.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#144.src: Uh... Hm. Maybe- Maybe being a cow is affecting your brain somehow... That can't be good.
Cowfusion#144.dst: えっと…うーん。もしかして…牛の体が脳に影響してるのかも…それはまずいな。
Cowfusion#144.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#145.src: We should get you back to human as quickly as possible. Come on, follow me.
Cowfusion#145.dst: 早く人間に戻さないと。さあ、ついてきて。
Cowfusion#145.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#146.src: ...This doesn't even mean anything! What am I supposed to do with-
Cowfusion#146.dst: …これじゃ何の意味もない！これをどうしろって…
Cowfusion#146.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#147.src: Oh! It's- It's you! Didn't I just...
Cowfusion#147.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#148.src: ...Um. This is... really awkward, haha. I'm... sorry?
Cowfusion#148.dst: …えっと。これは…すごく気まずいね、はは。僕…ごめんね？
Cowfusion#148.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#149.src: You're... the one who pretended to be a cow, right? I, uh... in my defense, I was very stressed. So I dropped you into the Pit.
Cowfusion#149.dst: 君は…牛のふりをした人だよね？僕、その…言い訳させて、すごくストレスが溜まってたんだ。だから奈落に落としちゃった。
Cowfusion#149.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#150.src: ...Anyway! What's- What's going on with your life? Anything interesting?
Cowfusion#150.dst: …とにかく！最近…最近どう？何か面白いことあった？
Cowfusion#150.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#151.src: Oh! Right. Getting back to normal.
Cowfusion#151.dst: あっ！そうか。元に戻るんだった。
Cowfusion#151.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#152.src: You said you stepped into my machine, right? We could try putting you in there a second time. What's the worst that could happen?
Cowfusion#152.dst: 僕の機械に入ったって言ったよね？もう一度入ってみようか。最悪、何が起きるっていうんだ？
Cowfusion#152.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#153.src: ...Uh. You stay as a cow. That's what. That's... fine. Let's just go and try it out.
Cowfusion#153.dst: …えっと。牛のままってことだね。うん。それは…いいよ。とにかく試しに行こう。
Cowfusion#153.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#154.src: ...This doesn't even mean anything! What am I supposed to do with-
Cowfusion#154.dst: …これじゃ何の意味もない！これをどうしろって…
Cowfusion#154.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#155.src: Oh! It's- It's you! Didn't I just...
Cowfusion#155.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#156.src: ...Um. This is... really awkward, haha. I'm... sorry?
Cowfusion#156.dst: …えっと。これは…すごく気まずいね、はは。僕…ごめんね？
Cowfusion#156.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#157.src: I am talking to a cow. Again. Why is this where my life has taken me.
Cowfusion#157.dst: また牛と話してる。僕の人生、どうしてこうなったんだ。
Cowfusion#157.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#158.src: So! What's... going on, little buddy? Any- any souvenirs? From the Pit...?
Cowfusion#158.dst: で！調子は…どうだい、おちびさん？何か…お土産は？奈落からの…？
Cowfusion#158.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#159.src: Oh, you- Oh. Right! Okay. I don't- I don't quite understand why you would pretend to be a cow. But alright!
Cowfusion#159.dst: あっ、君…あ。そうか！うん。なんで牛のふりなんかしたのか…よく分からないけど。まあいいや！
Cowfusion#159.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#160.src: So, uh... Human turned into a cow. Okay. How did you manage to get yourself stuck as a cow, anyway? I didn't think we had anything that could do that...
Cowfusion#160.dst: つまり、えっと…人間が牛になった。うん。それにしても、どうして牛のまま戻れなくなったの？そんなことができる物なんてないはずだけど…
Cowfusion#160.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#161.src: My machine. It's- It's not even supposed to do that! I designed it to turn exiles back into Wocs, how would it have...
Cowfusion#161.dst: 僕の機械か。そんな…そんな機能はないはずなのに！追放者を Woc に戻すために作ったのに、どうして…
Cowfusion#161.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#162.src: Great. Of course it'd have that issue, and just when I thought I...
Cowfusion#162.dst: 最高だよ。やっぱりそういう問題が出るんだ、しかも僕がやっと…
Cowfusion#162.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#163.src: Right. Right. Alright. We can work with this! Let's just take you back to that machine, put you in it, and see if it turns you back to normal!
Cowfusion#163.dst: よし。よし。分かった。なんとかなる！機械のところに戻って君を入れて、元に戻るか試してみよう！
Cowfusion#163.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#164.src: It'll work. Probably. I mean, I haven't ever tried it, so I can't really say for sure... Oh, yep, you're still here. Let's get moving.
Cowfusion#164.dst: うまくいくよ。たぶん。いや、試したことはないから、確かなことは言えないけど…あ、うん、まだいたね。行こうか。
Cowfusion#164.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#165.src: Uh... Hm. Maybe- Maybe being a cow is affecting your brain somehow... That can't be good.
Cowfusion#165.dst: えっと…うーん。もしかして…牛の体が脳に影響してるのかも…それはまずいな。
Cowfusion#165.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#166.src: We should get you back to human as quickly as possible. Come on, follow me.
Cowfusion#166.dst: 早く人間に戻さないと。さあ、ついてきて。
Cowfusion#166.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#168.src: Well, alright. Let's just- get you in my machine, I guess. It worked for the exiles, so maybe it will work for you...?
Cowfusion#168.dst: まあ、いいか。とりあえず…僕の機械に入れてみようかな。追放者には効いたし、君にも効くかも…？
Cowfusion#168.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#169.src: ...Don't look at me like that. Come on, let's get going.
Cowfusion#169.dst: …そんな目で見ないでよ。さあ、行こう。
Cowfusion#169.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#170.src: So... How have you been? It's been a while since our adventure at {p}, hasn't it?
Cowfusion#170.dst: で…元気だった？{p} での冒険から、ずいぶん経つよね？
Cowfusion#170.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#171.src: Well, you've been turned into a cow... Obviously... But besides that!
Cowfusion#171.dst: まあ、牛にされたのは…見れば分かるけど…それ以外で！
Cowfusion#171.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#172.src: Me? Well... heh. I've been doing pretty well, all thing considered. We've been gathering exiles from all over the province! Set up a city for us all while we work towards...
Cowfusion#172.dst: 僕？まあ…へへ。いろいろあったけど、元気にやってるよ。地方中から追放者を集めてるんだ！みんなの街を作って、目指してるのは…
Cowfusion#172.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#173.src: It's a long story. I can't tell you everything- not yet. But... All of us here, we don't belong here. We just want to go home.
Cowfusion#173.dst: 長い話なんだ。全部は話せない…まだね。でも…ここにいるみんな、ここの者じゃないんだ。ただ故郷に帰りたいだけなんだ。
Cowfusion#173.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#174.src: And- and maybe if we can find our ship again, we'll be able to prove that we're not irredeemable. That whatever we went through- that it won't define us.
Cowfusion#174.dst: それに…船をもう一度見つけられたら、僕らが救いようのない存在じゃないと証明できるかも。過去の経験で僕らは決まらないって。
Cowfusion#174.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#175.src: ...Heh. Don't- don't worry about it too much. For now, this place is enough of a safe haven for us. It'll have to be enough until we succeed.
Cowfusion#175.dst: …へへ。あまり…あまり気にしないで。今はここが僕らにとって十分な避難所なんだ。成功するまでは、それで足りるはずさ。
Cowfusion#175.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#176.src: We're so close. I can feel it. Just... Just a little while left to go.
Cowfusion#176.dst: もうすぐなんだ。感じるよ。あと…あと少しなんだ。
Cowfusion#176.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#177.src: Anyway, uh... Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
Cowfusion#177.dst: とにかく、えっと…エレベーターはここだよ！乗って、研究所まで上がろう。
Cowfusion#177.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#178.src: The- oh. Uh... It's nothing. Nothing to worry about.
Cowfusion#178.dst: あ…あれ。えっと…何でもないよ。心配いらない。
Cowfusion#178.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#179.src: It just leads to... maintenance. Yep! Just- just maintenance. Nothing else.
Cowfusion#179.dst: ただの…整備区画に通じてるだけ。うん！ただの…整備区画。それだけ。
Cowfusion#179.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#180.src: Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
Cowfusion#180.dst: さあエレベーターへ！どうせ入るには鍵がいるし、僕はそんな物、絶対持ってないからね！
Cowfusion#180.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#181.src: ...You're worrying me, friend. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
Cowfusion#181.dst: …心配になってきたよ、君。さあ、行こう。エレベーターに乗って、元に戻そう。
Cowfusion#181.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#182.src: So... Have you done anything interesting recently? Besides- getting turned into a cow. Obviously.
Cowfusion#182.dst: で…最近何か面白いことした？その…牛にされた以外で。もちろん。
Cowfusion#182.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#183.src: You're, uh... Probably wondering what this place is. Just a big city under some random guy's farm, right?
Cowfusion#183.dst: 君は、えっと…ここが何なのか気になってるよね。どこかの農場の下にある大きな街、って。
Cowfusion#183.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#184.src: It's... heh. We've been trying to gather as many of our people as we can. We exiles have to stick together, after all.
Cowfusion#184.dst: ここは…へへ。仲間をできるだけ集めようとしてるんだ。追放者同士、助け合わないとね。
Cowfusion#184.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#185.src: It's a long story. I'm not sure how much of it I really want to tell you, heh. Especially considering... Yeah.
Cowfusion#185.dst: 長い話なんだ。どこまで話したいか自分でも分からないよ、へへ。特に…うん。
Cowfusion#185.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#186.src: But. This place is a safe haven for us exiles. A place for us all to live until we achieve our goals.
Cowfusion#186.dst: でも。ここは僕ら追放者の避難所なんだ。目標を果たすまで、みんなで暮らす場所さ。
Cowfusion#186.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#187.src: And- hey! You've seen our secrets now! May as well let it be a safe haven for you as well, right? Heh.
Cowfusion#187.dst: それに…そうだ！君はもう僕らの秘密を見たんだ！君の避難所にもしちゃえばいいよね？へへ。
Cowfusion#187.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#188.src: Oh- the elevator. Here we are. Uh... Just head on in, little buddy? It'll take us up.
Cowfusion#188.dst: あ…エレベーターだ。着いたよ。えっと…乗ってくれる、おちびさん？上まで行けるから。
Cowfusion#188.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#189.src: The- oh. Uh... It's nothing. Nothing to worry about.
Cowfusion#189.dst: あ…あれ。えっと…何でもないよ。心配いらない。
Cowfusion#189.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#190.src: It just leads to... maintenance. Yep! Just- just maintenance. Nothing else.
Cowfusion#190.dst: ただの…整備区画に通じてるだけ。うん！ただの…整備区画。それだけ。
Cowfusion#190.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#191.src: Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
Cowfusion#191.dst: さあエレベーターへ！どうせ入るには鍵がいるし、僕はそんな物、絶対持ってないからね！
Cowfusion#191.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#192.src: ...You're worrying me. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
Cowfusion#192.dst: …心配になってきたよ。さあ、行こう。エレベーターに乗って、元に戻そう。
Cowfusion#192.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#193.dst: で…やあ、ちっちゃな…牛くん？
Cowfusion#193.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#194.src: Uh. Do you- do you understand what I'm saying?
Cowfusion#194.dst: えっと。君…僕の言葉、分かる？
Cowfusion#194.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#195.src: ...This is stupid. I'm talking to a cow. Of course you can't...
Cowfusion#195.dst: …馬鹿みたいだ。牛に話しかけてる。分かるわけ…
Cowfusion#195.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#197.src: Well I guess I could- talk at you. For a bit. If that's, heh, fine with you!
Cowfusion#197.dst: まあ、ちょっと…話を聞いてもらおうかな。君さえ、へへ、良ければ！
Cowfusion#197.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#198.src: It's been tough, recently. Working towards a goal I know is important, but still feels... out of reach.
Cowfusion#198.dst: 最近はつらくてね。大事だと分かってる目標に向かってるのに、どうしても…届かない気がする。
Cowfusion#198.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#199.src: And it doesn't seem like anybody else can see that! That this is important! They look at me like I'm going crazy, and-
Cowfusion#199.dst: しかも誰もそれを分かってくれないみたいで！これが大事だってことを！みんな僕がおかしくなったみたいな目で見て…
Cowfusion#199.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#200.src: I'm not. I know I'm not. We need to find the ship. If we don't, who knows what...
Cowfusion#200.dst: おかしくない。分かってる。船を見つけなきゃ。でないと、何が…
Cowfusion#200.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#201.src: Anyway! Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
Cowfusion#201.dst: とにかく！エレベーターはここだよ！乗って、研究所まで上がろう。
Cowfusion#201.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#202.src: Hrrgh- You're- you're not a cow?! Why would you... I just said all that, and you could...
Cowfusion#202.dst: うぐっ…君、君は牛じゃないの？！なんで…あんなこと全部喋ったのに、君は…
Cowfusion#202.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#203.src: D-Don't worry about the door. It's... It's nothing. Maintenance. That- that's what it is.
Cowfusion#203.dst: と、扉のことは気にしないで。あれは…何でもない。整備区画。そ、そういうこと。
Cowfusion#203.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#204.src: Er... come on, into the elevator! You want to get back to normal, right? Besides, you'd need a key to get in there, and I don't know where you'd find one of those, haha!
Cowfusion#204.dst: えっと…さあ、エレベーターへ！元に戻りたいでしょ？それに、入るには鍵がいるし、どこで見つかるかなんて僕も知らないよ、はは！
Cowfusion#204.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#205.src: ...Moo. Yep. I agree. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator.
Cowfusion#205.dst: …モー。うん。同感だ。さあ、行こう。エレベーターへ。
Cowfusion#205.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#206.src: So... here we are. The lab!
Cowfusion#206.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#207.src: Just... follow me, for now. The machine is this way.
Cowfusion#207.dst: とりあえず…ついてきて。機械はこっちだよ。
Cowfusion#207.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#208.src: There it is! If you step into the machine, real quick, it should... it should work!
Cowfusion#208.dst: あれだ！機械にさっと入ってくれれば…うまく…うまくいくはず！
Cowfusion#208.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#210.src: Look at you! As good as new!
Cowfusion#210.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#212.src: Heh... Well, there you are! Good as new! I hope...
Cowfusion#212.dst: へへ…ほら、戻った！新品同様！たぶん…
Cowfusion#212.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#213.src: And- to, uh, compensate you for... you know... Here! One liquid emerald. I feel terrible for how our reunion ended up going... I hope you won't hold it against me?
Cowfusion#213.dst: それと…その、お詫びに…ほら…これ！液体エメラルド一つ。こんな再会になって本当に申し訳ない…恨まないでくれるといいけど？
Cowfusion#213.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#214.src: Uh... I really should get back to work. But- hey! Feel free to visit whenever you want! You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
Cowfusion#214.dst: えっと…そろそろ仕事に戻らないと。でも…そうだ！いつでも遊びに来てよ！Ranol の農場の入り口から入れるから。
Cowfusion#214.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#215.src: Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! That'd be nice.
Cowfusion#215.dst: 僕が最近何をしてるか、もっと話せるかも！それはいいね。
Cowfusion#215.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#216.src: There you are! Back to norm...-
Cowfusion#216.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#217.src: {u}?! What are you- that was you the whole time?! Why didn't you tell me!
Cowfusion#217.dst: {u}？！何を…ずっと君だったの？！なんで言ってくれなかったのさ！
Cowfusion#217.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#218.src: Oh gosh, this has been... An awful reunion. I can't believe I dropped you into the Pit...
Cowfusion#218.dst: ああもう、これは…ひどい再会だ。君を奈落に落としたなんて信じられない…
Cowfusion#218.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#219.src: I'm so sorry for- for all of that. You should have told me! Oh...
Cowfusion#219.dst: その…いろいろ本当にごめん。言ってくれればよかったのに！ああ…
Cowfusion#219.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#220.src: Okay, uh... Here, take this. As- as compensation for- for all of that.
Cowfusion#220.dst: よし、えっと…ほら、これ。その…いろいろのお詫びに。
Cowfusion#220.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#221.src: I... I need to get back to work. But- uh, if you ever want, feel free to visit sometime? You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
Cowfusion#221.dst: 僕…仕事に戻らないと。でも…その、よかったらいつでも遊びに来て？Ranol の農場の入り口から入れるから。
Cowfusion#221.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#222.src: Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! Heh...
Cowfusion#222.dst: 僕が最近何をしてるか、もっと話せるかも！へへ…
Cowfusion#222.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#000~1.src: Yeah, yeah, I know. But what's it gonna matter if my back's worse than my grandpa's at the end of this?
Cowfusion#000~1.dst: はいはい、わかってるよ。でもこれが終わった時に腰がじいちゃんよりひどくなってたら、何の意味があるんだ？

Creeper Infiltration#000.dst: {p} の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Thomas と話す。

Creeper Infiltration#001.src: Anyone! Can anyone- oh, hello. You look strong enough to help me.
Creeper Infiltration#001.dst: 誰か！誰か…ああ、こんにちは。あなたなら頼りになりそうですね。
Creeper Infiltration#001.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#002.src: I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for a village in the Pigman Ravine. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
Creeper Infiltration#002.dst: 私は Thomas、豚人渓谷の村で物資の管理を手伝っています。ですが、少し困ったことがありまして…
Creeper Infiltration#002.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#003.src: We're running low on ravine grains, which is our main staple we use for our food.
Creeper Infiltration#003.dst: 主食にしている渓谷麦が残り少ないのです。
Creeper Infiltration#003.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#004.src: We usually get it ourselves but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#004.dst: 普段は自分たちで採るのですが、最近怒った豚人の群れが、麦の育つ渓谷の頂上へ続くトンネルを占拠してしまって。
Creeper Infiltration#004.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#005.src: The last time we entered, I heard an explosion from the top. I fear the pigmen are blowing up our grain supply with TNT...
Creeper Infiltration#005.dst: 前回入った時、上から爆発音が聞こえました。豚人たちが TNT で麦を吹き飛ばしているのではと…
Creeper Infiltration#005.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#006.src: I came here to {p} to see if I could find help here, but I've had no luck. Until now, that is. Would you be willing to help?
Creeper Infiltration#006.dst: 助けを求めて {p} まで来ましたが、誰も見つからず。今までは、ですが。手伝っていただけますか？
Creeper Infiltration#006.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#007.src: You would? You're a life saver. I'll meet you at the village, just follow the path out of town and take the northern-most entrance to the ravines.
Creeper Infiltration#007.dst: 本当ですか？命の恩人です。村で会いましょう。町を出る道を進み、一番北の入り口から渓谷へ入ってください。
Creeper Infiltration#007.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#008.src: Once you get there, keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
Creeper Infiltration#008.dst: 着いたら渓谷の右の壁沿いに進み、階段を上れば入り口です。トンネルでは気をつけて、豚人は石を投げてきますから。
Creeper Infiltration#008.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#009.src: Oh, finally, someone has come to this hidden village!
Creeper Infiltration#009.dst: ああ、ようやくこの隠れ里に人が来てくれた！
Creeper Infiltration#009.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#010.src: I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for this ravine village. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
Creeper Infiltration#010.dst: 私は Thomas、この渓谷の村で物資の管理を手伝っています。ですが、少し困ったことがありまして…
Creeper Infiltration#010.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#011.src: We're running low on ravine grains, which is our main staple we use for our food.
Creeper Infiltration#011.dst: 主食にしている渓谷麦が残り少ないのです。
Creeper Infiltration#011.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#012.src: We usually get it ourselves but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#012.dst: 普段は自分たちで採るのですが、最近怒った豚人の群れが、麦の育つ渓谷の頂上へ続くトンネルを占拠してしまって。
Creeper Infiltration#012.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#013.src: The last time we entered, I heard an explosion from the top. I fear the pigmen are blowing up our grain supply with TNT...
Creeper Infiltration#013.dst: 前回入った時、上から爆発音が聞こえました。豚人たちが TNT で麦を吹き飛ばしているのではと…
Creeper Infiltration#013.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#014.src: You appear to be much stronger than I am, so maybe you could get past the tunnel pigmen and eliminate the explosions at the top.
Creeper Infiltration#014.dst: あなたは私よりずっと強そうだ。トンネルの豚人を突破して、頂上の爆発を止められるかもしれません。
Creeper Infiltration#014.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#015.src: Just keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
Creeper Infiltration#015.dst: 渓谷の右の壁沿いに進み、階段を上れば入り口です。トンネルでは気をつけて、豚人は石を投げてきますから。
Creeper Infiltration#015.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#016.src: Enter the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and reach the top of the ravine
Creeper Infiltration#016.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のトンネルに入り、渓谷の頂上へ行く

Creeper Infiltration#017.src: Bring back the [Creeper Skin] to Thomas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Creeper Infiltration#017.dst: [Creeper Skin] を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Thomas に届ける

Creeper Infiltration#018.src: I didn't expect you to fall out of the sky like that. Are you okay, or should I go get the potion merchant to heal you?
Creeper Infiltration#018.dst: あんなふうに空から落ちてくるとは。大丈夫ですか？ポーション商人を呼んで治してもらいましょうか？
Creeper Infiltration#018.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#019.src: You're fine? Oh, good to hear. Did you manage to get rid of the pigmen and their explosives?
Creeper Infiltration#019.dst: 大丈夫？ああ、よかった。豚人と爆発物は片付きましたか？
Creeper Infiltration#019.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#020.src: A green creature? A "creeper"? No such thing exists in this world, especially with the pigmen all around!
Creeper Infiltration#020.dst: 緑の生き物？「クリーパー」？そんなもの、この世にいませんよ。まして豚人だらけのここに！
Creeper Infiltration#020.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#021.src: Oh, you brought a piece of skin back. How odd, I've seen this skin before...
Creeper Infiltration#021.dst: おや、皮を持ち帰ったのですね。妙だ、この皮は前にも見たことが…
Creeper Infiltration#021.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#022.src: There's a large cave over to the south. I tried to enter it, but I got ambushed by green creatures...
Creeper Infiltration#022.dst: 南に大きな洞窟があります。入ろうとしたら、緑の生き物に待ち伏せされて…
Creeper Infiltration#022.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#023.src: I thought I was just dreaming, but these "creepers" you talk about...they might live in that cave.
Creeper Infiltration#023.dst: 夢だと思っていましたが、あなたの言う「クリーパー」…あの洞窟に住んでいるのかもしれません。
Creeper Infiltration#023.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#024.src: I have an idea. I need to know for sure that they live there. A merchant can make you a mask with the skin and another material.
Creeper Infiltration#024.dst: 考えがあります。そこに住んでいると確かめたい。商人なら、この皮と別の素材で仮面を作ってくれます。
Creeper Infiltration#024.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#025.src: There's a Pigman Overlord that sometimes hangs in a cave nearby. If you can kill it, you can get a pigman hide strong enough to make the mask.
Creeper Infiltration#025.dst: 近くの洞窟に時々、豚人の覇王がいるんです。倒せば、仮面を作れるほど丈夫な豚人の皮が手に入ります。
Creeper Infiltration#025.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#026.src: If you continue on the western path past the tunnel entrance, you should find a camp where the Overlord is located.
Creeper Infiltration#026.dst: トンネルの入り口を過ぎて西の道を進めば、覇王のいる野営地があるはずです。
Creeper Infiltration#026.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#027.src: Go get the pigman hide, and then come back to me so I can tell you what to do next.
Creeper Infiltration#027.dst: 豚人の皮を手に入れたら、戻ってきてください。次にすべきことを教えます。
Creeper Infiltration#027.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#028.src: Retrieve [{~} Pigman Hide] from the Pigman Overlord near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return to Thomas
Creeper Infiltration#028.dst: [-{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 付近の豚人の覇王から [{~1} Pigman Hide] を手に入れ、Thomas のもとへ戻る

Creeper Infiltration#029.src: I see you have the hide. This skin will work perfectly for my plan.
Creeper Infiltration#029.dst: 皮を手に入れましたね。この皮なら私の計画にぴったりです。
Creeper Infiltration#029.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#030.src: There is a Mask Merchant in this village. He can make you a mask with the two materials I have.
Creeper Infiltration#030.dst: この村には仮面商人がいます。私の持つ二つの素材で仮面を作ってくれますよ。
Creeper Infiltration#030.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#031.src: With the mask, you can put it on and go undetected into the cave with these "creepers". Only then will we know the truth.
Creeper Infiltration#031.dst: その仮面を着ければ、気づかれずに「クリーパー」の洞窟に入れます。そうして初めて真実が分かるのです。
Creeper Infiltration#031.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#032.src: To get to the creeper cave, follow the western path and turn left at the pigman camps.
Creeper Infiltration#032.dst: クリーパーの洞窟へは、西の道を進んで豚人の野営地で左に曲がってください。
Creeper Infiltration#032.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#033.src: Also, if you somehow lose the mask, the merchant can make you another one if you bring him another piece of skin and hide.
Creeper Infiltration#033.dst: それと、もし仮面をなくしても、皮と獣皮をもう一枚ずつ持っていけば商人がまた作ってくれます。
Creeper Infiltration#033.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#034.src: Here are the materials. Be careful out there. Who knows what those green monsters could do to you...
Creeper Infiltration#034.dst: 素材をどうぞ。お気をつけて。あの緑の怪物に何をされるか分かりませんから…
Creeper Infiltration#034.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#035.src: Buy the creeper mask from the merchant and enter the creeper hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Creeper Infiltration#035.dst: 商人からクリーパーの仮面を買い、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のクリーパーの隠れ家に入る

Creeper Infiltration#036.src: Bring Thomas [{~} Creeper Powder] to prove him creepers exist in Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Creeper Infiltration#036.dst: [{~1} Creeper Powder] を [-{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] の Thomas に届け、Wynn にクリーパーがいると証明する

Creeper Infiltration#037.src: So, what was in the cave? Were there really creepers in there?
Creeper Infiltration#037.dst: それで、洞窟には何が？本当にクリーパーがいたのですか？
Creeper Infiltration#037.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#038.src: What's this? It smells like gunpowder...but more earthy. And this came from the cave?
Creeper Infiltration#038.dst: これは？火薬のような匂い…でも、もっと土臭い。これが洞窟から？
Creeper Infiltration#038.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#039.src: This powder is definitely not native to this area. It has to have come from those creepers.
Creeper Infiltration#039.dst: この粉は間違いなくこの辺りの物ではない。あのクリーパーから出た物でしょう。
Creeper Infiltration#039.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#040.src: I guess for now we'll leave them at peace. If they do exist, they don't need to be hunted down to extinction.
Creeper Infiltration#040.dst: 今はそっとしておきましょう。本当にいるとしても、絶滅するまで狩る必要はありません。
Creeper Infiltration#040.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#041.src: Besides, if they are composed of gunpowder, they could easily blow this ravine to pieces.
Creeper Infiltration#041.dst: それに、火薬でできているなら、この渓谷なんて簡単に吹き飛ばせるでしょうし。
Creeper Infiltration#041.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#042.src: Thank you for your help. I guess you deserve some sort of reward, considering you helped solve the ravine's big mystery.
Creeper Infiltration#042.dst: 助けてくれてありがとう。渓谷の大きな謎を解いてくれたのですから、何かお礼をしないと。
Creeper Infiltration#042.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#043.src: Feel free to come back to our village any time. By then our food supply should be stable.
Creeper Infiltration#043.dst: いつでも村に来てください。その頃には食料も安定しているはずです。
Creeper Infiltration#043.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#044.src: Ah, it's good to see you again, pal! I apologize for not inviting you to the celebrations, but you seemed rather busy!
Creeper Infiltration#044.dst: やあ、また会えてうれしいよ、友よ！お祝いに招かなくてすまなかった。ずいぶん忙しそうだったからね！

Creeper Infiltration#045.src: Oh, it's you! Aaaagghh... Thank you for what you did for us, it's... mmhhhgg... really appreciated...
Creeper Infiltration#045.dst: ああ、あなたか！うぅぅ…私たちのためにしてくれたこと、本当に…んんっ…感謝してる…

Creeper Infiltration#046.src: Anyone! Can anyone- oh, hello. You look strong enough to be able to help me.
Creeper Infiltration#046.dst: 誰か！誰か…ああ、こんにちは。あなたなら頼りになりそうですね。

Creeper Infiltration#047.src: We usually get it ourselves, but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#047.dst: 普段は自分たちで採るのですが、最近怒った豚人の群れが、麦の育つ渓谷の頂上へ続くトンネルを占拠してしまって。

Creeper Infiltration#048.src: Have you been to the creeper cave? Just follow the western path and turn left at the pigman camps.
Creeper Infiltration#048.dst: クリーパーの洞窟にはもう行きましたか？西の道を進んで、豚人の野営地で左に曲がるだけです。

Creeper Infiltration#049.src: Oh, a visitor? Interesting. I thought I only knew about this cave, considering I was called crazy by my master.
Creeper Infiltration#049.dst: おや、客人か？面白い。この洞窟を知っているのは私だけだと思っていたよ。師匠には頭がおかしいと言われたからね。

Creeper Infiltration#050.src: I've lived down here for a while now, studying the creepers. They are mythical in this region, and I want to prove everyone wrong.
Creeper Infiltration#050.dst: ここにはしばらく住んで、クリーパーを研究している。この地方では伝説の存在だが、皆が間違っていると証明したいんだ。

Creeper Infiltration#051.src: Don't worry about being trapped in here, though. There's a magic doorway right outside my house that can teleport you out if you wish to leave.
Creeper Infiltration#051.dst: 閉じ込められる心配はいらないよ。家のすぐ外に魔法の扉があって、帰りたければそこから外へ転移できる。

Crop Failure#001.dst: ぐぬぬ…あのろくでなしの、嘘つきの、いかさま師の、泥棒の…があああ！
Crop Failure#001.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#002.src: You! Help me out over here! You aren't doing anything important right now, and this is urgent!
Crop Failure#002.dst: おい！ちょっと手を貸せ！どうせ大した用事もないだろ、こっちは急ぎなんだ！
Crop Failure#002.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#003.src: I got a few questions for you, see? Question one: D'you think crops are supposed to look like THIS?
Crop Failure#003.dst: いくつか聞きたいことがある、いいか？一つ目：作物ってのは、こんな見た目のもんだと思うか？
Crop Failure#003.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#004.src: Look at them. I don't think there's a way for 'em to look any more sorry than this.
Crop Failure#004.dst: 見ろよ。これ以上みじめな見た目にはなりようがねえ。
Crop Failure#004.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#005.src: Wha- You think the Oats over there look fine?! Pff. Yeah, right.
Crop Failure#005.dst: な…あっちの Oats は平気に見えるだと？！フン。冗談だろ。
Crop Failure#005.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#006.src: If that's the case, go grab a scythe and try harvesting those Oats yourself!!
Crop Failure#006.dst: そう思うなら、鎌を持ってきて自分であの Oats を刈ってみろ！！
Crop Failure#006.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#007.src: Go on, do it! I dare you! See how good they really are!!
Crop Failure#007.dst: ほら、やれよ！やってみろ！どれだけ立派か見てみろってんだ！！
Crop Failure#007.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#008.dst: Anast の周りで [{~} Oats] を集める。

Crop Failure#009.src: See? What'd I tell ya? Rotten to the roots! Nothing here is ANY good!!
Crop Failure#009.dst: ほらな？言っただろ？根っこまで腐ってる！ここにはまともなもんが一つもねえ！！
Crop Failure#009.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#010.src: They were growing pretty slow this year, all my crops, and then some salesman walks into town with some "MiracleCure" fertilizer.
Crop Failure#010.dst: 今年は作物の育ちがやけに遅くてな、そしたらどっかの行商人が「ミラクルキュア」肥料なんてもんを持って町に来やがった。
Crop Failure#010.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#011.src: I shoulda known it was too good to be true, but he said everyone else tried it too, so I bought some and tried to salvage this mess.
Crop Failure#011.dst: うますぎる話だと気づくべきだった。だが皆使ってるって言うから、買ってこの有様を救おうとしたんだ。
Crop Failure#011.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#012.src: And here we are- me out half my savings and my fields as smelly and dead as an actual CORPSE!
Crop Failure#012.dst: その結果がこれだ。貯金は半分消えて、畑は本物の死体みてえに臭くて死んでる！
Crop Failure#012.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#013.src: Just to prove this ridiculous phony Doubiss is a fraud- Here. I see some roots over here. Watch this, and tell me if this is a "miracle!"
Crop Failure#013.dst: Doubiss のインチキ野郎が詐欺師だって証明してやる。ほら、そこに根がある。見てろ、これが「奇跡」かどうか言ってみろ！
Crop Failure#013.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#014.src: Here we go, here comes the big phenomenal growth he promised me!
Crop Failure#014.dst: さあ来るぞ、奴が約束した驚異の成長だ！
Crop Failure#014.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#015.src: WOW, INCREDIBLE! AMAZING! It's almost like this is actual poison or something!!
Crop Failure#015.dst: わあ、すげえ！驚きだ！まるで本物の毒じゃねえか！！
Crop Failure#015.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#016.src: That Doubiss won't budge for my refund. I spent... so many emeralds... on this tripe! So that's where YOU come in.
Crop Failure#016.dst: Doubiss の奴、返金に応じやしねえ。こんなクズに…エメラルドをどれだけ…！そこでお前の出番だ。
Crop Failure#016.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#017.src: He's in that blue and gray tent by the bank. I don't care how you do it, but get my money back and we'll split it half-and-half, deal?
Crop Failure#017.dst: 銀行のそばの青と灰色のテントにいる。やり方は任せる、金を取り返したら山分けだ、いいな？
