Crop Failure#017.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#018.src: Find Doubiss the salesman in {p} near the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Crop Failure#018.dst: {p} の銀行近く [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で行商人 Doubiss を探す。

Crop Failure#019.src: Good day to ya! What is it ye be needin' from ol' Doubiss' stock?
Crop Failure#019.dst: ごきげんよう！この Doubiss の品から何がご入用だい？
Crop Failure#019.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#020.src: Oh. Oh, goodie. That idiot farmer's sendin' ya to get his money back, ain't he? Sweet baby bovine, this is ridiculous...
Crop Failure#020.dst: ほう。ほう、なるほど。あの間抜けな農夫が金を取り返しに寄越したんだろ？やれやれ、馬鹿馬鹿しいったらありゃしねえ…
Crop Failure#020.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#021.src: Since he obviously ain't gonna be listenin' to me anytime soon, lemme tell ya what the issue is with my fertilizer...
Crop Failure#021.dst: 奴はしばらく聞く耳持たねえだろうから、おいらの肥料の問題ってやつを教えてやるよ…
Crop Failure#021.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#022.src: Nothing! My fertilizer really does work! He probl'ly exaggerated how good I said it'd work, too! What'd he say, twice, three times the growth? More?
Crop Failure#022.dst: 何もねえ！おいらの肥料は本当に効くんだ！奴が効き目を大げさに言ったんだろ！なんて言ってた、二倍？三倍？もっとか？
Crop Failure#022.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#023.src: All the other farmers are usin' it right now and look at their fields! Heck, the only reason these crops ain't dead is because of my product!
Crop Failure#023.dst: 他の農夫はみんな今使ってる、あいつらの畑を見てみな！この作物がまだ枯れてねえのは、おいらの品のおかげさ！
Crop Failure#023.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#024.src: Y'know why? Next time ya' pass a farm, take a good whiff o' the water, maybe a sip or two if you can manage. It'll be smelly and bitter.
Crop Failure#024.dst: なぜか分かるかい？今度農場を通ったら水の匂いを嗅いでみな、できりゃ一口二口飲んでみるといい。臭くて苦いぜ。
Crop Failure#024.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#025.src: The crops, when I got here, were lookin' as pathetic as ya get. I ain't a gamblin' man, but I'd be willing ta bet something's up with the water here.
Crop Failure#025.dst: おいらが来た時、作物は見るも無残だった。賭け事はしねえが、ここの水に何かあるって方に賭けてもいい。
Crop Failure#025.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#026.src: The smell gets worse the closer ya get to the crypts in town, and while I ain't a native Oluxer, I've heard enough to know the wellspring is in the cave hear there.
Crop Failure#026.dst: 町の地下墓地に近づくほど臭いがひどくなる。おいらは Olux 生まれじゃねえが、そばの洞窟に水源があるって話は聞いてる。
Crop Failure#026.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#027.src: It'll prob'ly be best fer everyone if ya took a looksee. Maybe if ya find some evidence, ya can show that to the crazy farmer, have 'im quit pesterin' me, eh?
Crop Failure#027.dst: あんたが見に行くのが皆のためだろうよ。証拠を見つけたらあのイカれた農夫に見せて、おいらに付きまとうのをやめさせてくれや。
Crop Failure#027.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#028.src: The cave is on a little hill, next to the crypt. Careful ya don't go trippin' over a gravestone, now!
Crop Failure#028.dst: 洞窟は地下墓地の隣の小さな丘の上だ。墓石につまずかねえよう気をつけな！
Crop Failure#028.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#029.src: Search the aquifer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the problem with the water.
Crop Failure#029.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の帯水層で水の問題を調べる。

Crop Failure#030.src: Oi, bucko! Took my advice, eh? I'd figured I'd join ye, 'n see for myself what was goin' on.
Crop Failure#030.dst: よう、兄弟！おいらの助言を聞いたか？おいらも一緒に行って、何が起きてるか確かめようと思ってな。
Crop Failure#030.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#031.src: And boy am I glad I bring me water in bottles. This stuff's rancid, full a' swamp slimes. No idea why they're here, though.
Crop Failure#031.dst: いやあ、水を瓶で持ってきてて良かったぜ。こいつは腐ってる、沼スライムだらけだ。なんでここにいるかは知らねえが。
Crop Failure#031.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#032.src: The buggers stick to mountain caves. They don't come down this far, usually... suppose there's an exception fer everything.
Crop Failure#032.dst: あいつらは山の洞窟にいるもんで、普通こんな下まで来ねえんだが…何事にも例外はあるか。
Crop Failure#032.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#033.src: 's no wonder that Anast's crops ain't growin'. This is right under his farm! But we got some clear proof now, ain't we?
Crop Failure#033.dst: Anast の作物が育たねえのも当然だ。ここは奴の農場の真下だ！だが、これで確かな証拠ができたろ？
Crop Failure#033.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#034.src: Howzabout ya take care o' this? I ain't a fighter, but if ya mulch these slimes the water oughta clear up, I figure.
Crop Failure#034.dst: こいつの始末を頼めるかい？おいらは戦えねえが、スライムを細切れにすりゃ水も澄むと思うぜ。
Crop Failure#034.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#035.src: Kill the slimes in the aquifer and bring back [Polluted Slime] to Anast.
Crop Failure#035.dst: 帯水層のスライムを倒し、[Polluted Slime] を Anast に届ける。

Crop Failure#036.src: Pyyyyeww! Yeesh, kid! You smell worse than a pig's sty! What the heck happened to you, where've you been?!
Crop Failure#036.dst: うぇぇっ！おいおい！豚小屋よりくせえぞ！いったい何があった、どこ行ってたんだ？！
Crop Failure#036.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#037.src: Ugh, eww! I don't want any of this sludge! I demand an explanation, now!!
Crop Failure#037.dst: うげっ、やめろ！そんなヘドロいらねえ！今すぐ説明しろ！！
Crop Failure#037.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#038.src: ...mhm, mhm...you went into the well cave...and found what, slimes?! Why would SLIMES be there?
Crop Failure#038.dst: …ふむ、ふむ…井戸の洞窟に入って…見つけたのが、スライム？！なんでスライムがそこに？
Crop Failure#038.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#039.src: I wouldn't believe you if you weren't... well, uh... covered in the stuff. But that's definitely rancid.
Crop Failure#039.dst: お前が…その…それまみれじゃなきゃ信じねえところだ。だが確かに腐ってやがる。
Crop Failure#039.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#040.src: So... that means I've been... oh dear lord I'm an idiot.
Crop Failure#040.dst: つまり…俺はずっと…ああ、俺は大馬鹿だ。
Crop Failure#040.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#041.src: I guess I owe you some thanks anyway for trying to clear the sludge out. Suppose this year's harvest is just a bust.
Crop Failure#041.dst: ともかく、ヘドロを掃除しようとしてくれたことには礼を言わなきゃな。今年の収穫は全滅だろうが。
Crop Failure#041.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#042.src: Can't sell what little I have, so I figure you can take it, and a bit of cash too, since you basically did an exterminator's job.
Crop Failure#042.dst: わずかな作物も売れやしねえから持ってけ。少し金もやる、駆除業者の仕事をしたようなもんだしな。
Crop Failure#042.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#043.src: Just... do me a favor and use that money to buy some good soap and wash up. I'm thankful and all, but you stink to high heaven!
Crop Failure#043.dst: ただ…頼むからその金で上等な石鹸を買って体を洗え。感謝はしてるが、とんでもなくくせえんだ！
Crop Failure#043.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#000~1.src: Oi, bucko! Took my advice, eh? I figured I'd join ye, 'n see fer myself what was goin' on.
Crop Failure#000~1.dst: よう、兄弟！おいらの助言を聞いたか？一緒に行って、何が起きてるか確かめようと思ってな。

Dearly Departed#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で農夫 Cevalus と話す

Dearly Departed#001.src: Ah, looks like a fresh recruit! Did you see my posting? Good, good.
Dearly Departed#001.dst: おお、新兵さんだね！私の張り紙を見たのかい？よしよし。
Dearly Departed#001.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#002.src: You see, my dear father-in-law recently passed, and I had to bury him hastily out back. Couldn't get a priest here in time to bury him all properly...
Dearly Departed#002.dst: 実はね、親愛なる義父が最近亡くなって、裏に急いで埋葬したんだ。神父を呼んできちんと葬る時間がなくてね…
Dearly Departed#002.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#003.src: Unfortunately, it so happens that my wedding ring might have slipped off as I was putting him to rest...
Dearly Departed#003.dst: あいにく、埋葬している時に結婚指輪が抜け落ちてしまったらしくてね…
Dearly Departed#003.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#004.src: I need you to go back there and, well, recover the ring.
Dearly Departed#004.dst: 君にはそこへ行って、その、指輪を回収してほしいんだ。
Dearly Departed#004.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#005.src: It's nothing I couldn't handle myself, of course, but the wife already suspects something, and with her dear father passing so recently...
Dearly Departed#005.dst: もちろん自分でもできることなんだが、妻がもう何か疑っていてね、それに父親を亡くしたばかりだし…
Dearly Departed#005.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#006.src: Well, you see the situation I'm in? Help a poor fellow out, just go and grab that [Muddy Shovel] over there, and then come back to me.
Dearly Departed#006.dst: 私の立場は分かるだろう？哀れな男を助けると思って、あそこの [Muddy Shovel] を取ってきて、戻ってきてくれ。
Dearly Departed#006.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#008.src: The [Muddy Shovel] is just over there. I'd really appreciate the help, recruit.
Dearly Departed#008.dst: [Muddy Shovel] はすぐそこだ。助かるよ、新兵さん。
Dearly Departed#008.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#009.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の農夫 Cevalus のもとへ戻る

Dearly Departed#010.src: You've got the shovel? Great! You've got some sturdy armour and a weapon too, I presume?
Dearly Departed#010.dst: シャベルを手に入れた？素晴らしい！丈夫な防具と武器もあるんだろうね？
Dearly Departed#010.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#011.src: Good, good. Better safe than sorry... As I always say! Always, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#011.dst: よしよし。用心に越したことはない…私の口癖さ！いつもね、はは…
Dearly Departed#011.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#012.src: Oh, no reason really! Just making sure, ha ha... Should be perfectly safe back there, perfectly safe.
Dearly Departed#012.dst: いや、特に理由はないさ！念のためだよ、はは…あそこは全く安全なはずさ、全く。
Dearly Departed#012.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#013.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#013.dst: スキルポイントも振ってあるよね？何かあった時に役立つからね。
Dearly Departed#013.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#014.src: Well, they're Skill Points! You gain them as you level up, then you can assign them to get bonuses in combat. Look, I'm no soldier, but even I know you really should be using them...
Dearly Departed#014.dst: スキルポイントだよ！レベルが上がるともらえて、振り分ければ戦闘でボーナスが得られる。私は兵士じゃないが、それでも使うべきだと分かるよ…
Dearly Departed#014.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#015.src: There's five of them. Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Defence, and Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#015.dst: 五種類ある。筋力、器用さ、知力、防御、俊敏さ、それぞれ別のボーナスがあるんだ。
Dearly Departed#015.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#016.src: You get it, or do you want me to tell you what they are?
Dearly Departed#016.dst: 分かったかい、それとも一つずつ説明しようか？
Dearly Departed#016.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#017.src: is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#017.dst: は、敵をなかなか倒せない時に便利だ。攻撃が重くなる、単純な話さ。
Dearly Departed#017.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#018.src: 's a bit of a tricky one. The more of it you've got, the higher the likelihood is that your attacks will deal double damage. Neat, right?
Dearly Departed#018.dst: は少し厄介でね。多いほど、攻撃が二倍のダメージになる確率が上がる。いいだろう？
Dearly Departed#018.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#019.src: is for the spellcasters, it lowers the cost to cast spells and increases your max amount of mana.
Dearly Departed#019.dst: は魔法使い向けだ。呪文の消費を下げて、最大マナを増やしてくれる。
Dearly Departed#019.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#020.src: is your best bet if you're struggling with staying alive. Decreases the damage you take, 's about all.
Dearly Departed#020.dst: は、生き延びるのに苦労しているなら一番だ。受けるダメージが減る、それだけさ。
Dearly Departed#020.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#021.src: Agility, now that one is for the risktakers. The more you have, the likelier you are to dodge incoming attacks, negating most of their damage.
Dearly Departed#021.dst: 俊敏さ、これは危険を好む人向けだ。多いほど攻撃を回避しやすくなり、ダメージをほとんど打ち消せる。
Dearly Departed#021.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#022.src: Best part is, you can combine them however you want, no matter your class or style of fighting.
Dearly Departed#022.dst: 何よりいいのは、クラスや戦い方に関係なく、好きなように組み合わせられることさ。
Dearly Departed#022.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#023.src: Just open your compass to assign your Skill Points. Then, when you're ready, head in there and get my ring.
Dearly Departed#023.dst: コンパスを開けばスキルポイントを振れる。準備ができたら中に入って、私の指輪を取ってきてくれ。
Dearly Departed#023.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#025.src: Go on then, soldier! Show us the might of {p}'s army! Uh, I mean... get me that ring!
Dearly Departed#025.dst: さあ行け、兵士よ！{p} 軍の力を見せてくれ！えっと、つまり…指輪を取ってきてくれ！
Dearly Departed#025.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#026.src: What's going on in there, soldier? Have you found the ring yet?
Dearly Departed#026.dst: 中はどうなってる、兵士よ？指輪はもう見つかったかい？
Dearly Departed#026.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#027.src: You really should hurry, before... nevermind! Just find the ring and get out of there!
Dearly Departed#027.dst: 急いだほうがいいよ、その前に…いや何でもない！とにかく指輪を見つけて出てくるんだ！
Dearly Departed#027.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#028.src: Holy Bovine! It's... it's... he's back! Kill it, quickly!
Dearly Departed#028.dst: 牛神様！あれは…あれは…奴が戻ってきた！早く倒してくれ！
Dearly Departed#028.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#030.src: You did it! Come back here now, so I can finally get my ring back.
Dearly Departed#030.dst: やったね！さあ戻っておいで、ついに指輪を取り戻せる。
Dearly Departed#030.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#031.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の農夫 Cevalus のもとへ戻る

Dearly Departed#032.src: Goodness, that was a little more exciting than I anticipated, hmph. Still, good work! I'm glad we were able to get rid of that monster...
Dearly Departed#032.dst: いやはや、思ったより少々刺激的だったね、ふむ。とにかくよくやった！あの怪物を始末できてよかったよ…
Dearly Departed#032.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#033.src: I mean... poor father-in-law! I don't know how I'll explain this to the wife...
Dearly Departed#033.dst: いや…かわいそうな義父さん！妻にどう説明すればいいのか…
Dearly Departed#033.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#034.src: I'll take the ring now, it's rather precious to me...
Dearly Departed#034.dst: 指輪はもらうよ、私にとってはかなり大切な物でね…
Dearly Departed#034.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#035.src: Anyhow, take this well-deserved reward for the, well, actions you took today. Perhaps, if you keep it up, you could even become a hero like Ragnar one day.
Dearly Departed#035.dst: ともかく、今日の、その、働きに見合った報酬を受け取ってくれ。この調子なら、いつか Ragnar のような英雄になれるかもね。
Dearly Departed#035.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#036.src: Hello there, stranger. Was there something you wanted to speak to me about?
Dearly Departed#036.dst: こんにちは、旅の方。何か私にお話でも？
Dearly Departed#036.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#037.src: I should be angry but... I can't pretend to be surprised. He's always been such a forgetful oaf.
Dearly Departed#037.dst: 怒るべきなんでしょうけど…驚いたふりはできないわ。あの人は昔から忘れっぽい間抜けなのよ。
Dearly Departed#037.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#038.src: But, it explains a lot... He's been acting weird lately, ever since dad passed. That must've been what happened, so thank you for telling me.
Dearly Departed#038.dst: でも、それで色々納得がいくわ…父が亡くなってから様子が変だったの。そういうことだったのね、教えてくれてありがとう。
Dearly Departed#038.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#039.src: That's right. The one and only, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#039.dst: そうよ。唯一無二のね、はは…
Dearly Departed#039.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#040.src: We're just simple farmers, trying to get by. We were taking care of my dad until... well... yeah...
Dearly Departed#040.dst: 私たちはただの農家で、なんとか暮らしてるの。父の世話をしてたんだけど…その…ええ…
Dearly Departed#040.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#041.src: Thank you... It all happened so suddenly. On the day I left for {p}, dad was as healthy as ever, but when I came back he was already buried. The sickness must have come so fast...
Dearly Departed#041.dst: ありがとう…何もかも突然だったの。{p} へ発った日、父はいつも通り元気だったのに、戻ったらもう埋葬されてた。病気がよほど急だったのね…
Dearly Departed#041.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#042.src: But at his age, I'm not surprised... It's just regrettable that we couldn't get a priest out here in time, dad was such a pious man.
Dearly Departed#042.dst: でもあの歳だから、驚きはしないわ…ただ、神父を間に合うよう呼べなかったのが残念。父はとても信心深い人だったの。
Dearly Departed#042.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#043.src: Dad... Above all, he was kind and always generous. He left us this entire farm. And very pious too, a true believer. Maybe that's why he lived so long...
Dearly Departed#043.dst: 父は…何より優しくて、いつも気前が良かった。この農場を丸ごと遺してくれたの。とても信心深い、本物の信者でもあった。だから長生きしたのかも…
Dearly Departed#043.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#044.src: Oh, dear... If I don't stop, I'm gonna start crying again.
Dearly Departed#044.dst: ああ…これ以上話したら、また泣いちゃうわ。
Dearly Departed#044.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#045.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They could come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#045.dst: スキルポイントも振ってあるよね？何かあった時に役立つかもしれないからね。

Dearly Departed#046.src: There's five of them.  Strength,  Dexterity,  Intelligence,  Defence, and  Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#046.dst: 五種類ある。筋力、器用さ、知力、防御、俊敏さ、それぞれ別のボーナスがあるんだ。

Dearly Departed#047.src: Why are you asking me that?
Dearly Departed#047.dst: どうしてそんなことを？

Dearly Departed#056.src: Now to see if you can find that ring Cevalus mentioned...
Dearly Departed#056.dst: あとは Cevalus が言っていた指輪を見つけられるか…

Dearly Departed#057.src: You manage to pry the ring off the monster's finger...
Dearly Departed#057.dst: 怪物の指から、なんとか指輪をこじ取った…

Dearly Departed#060.src: {#} Strength is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#060.dst: {#} 筋力は、敵をなかなか倒せない時に便利だ。攻撃が重くなる、単純な話さ。
Dearly Departed#060.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Death Whistle (Quest)#001.src: Hello! Hmm, armour, weapon, look of grim despair... You must be from the Wynn province!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.dst: やあ！ふむ、防具に武器、絶望に満ちた顔…さては Wynn 地方の方ですね！
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#002.src: My name is Voer, and I'm an exotic plant merchant. I sell all kinds of, uh, perfectly legal goods to the magicians of Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.dst: 私は Voer、珍しい植物の商人です。Gavel の魔術師たちに、あー、完全に合法な品々を売っています。
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#003.src: Lately, this Decay has been making business rather tough. The magical plants that used to grow here are dying.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.dst: 最近は腐朽のせいで商売が厳しくてね。ここに生えていた魔法の植物が枯れていくんです。
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#004.src: The need for magic has never been as big as it is now, and without supplies, the magicians of the swamp simply cannot operate!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.dst: 魔法の需要が今ほど高まったことはないのに、材料がなければ沼の魔術師たちは何もできません！
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#005.src: I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall that from that- er, my book.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.dst: 特に Death Whistle が必要でして。名前ほど危険じゃありません、本当です。古い名前なだけで…あの…私の本によれば、ですが。
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#006.src: It is a rather rare plant with all sorts of mystical properties, so much so that it can animate objects around it!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.dst: かなり珍しい植物で、神秘的な性質が多く、周りの物に命を吹き込むほどなんです！
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#007.src: Look for the highest mountain in the swamp south-east from here. The Decay hasn't reached the peaks yet, you see!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.dst: ここから南東の沼で一番高い山を探してください。腐朽はまだ山頂まで届いていませんから！
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#008.src: Find the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and a way up on it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#008.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の山を見つけ、登る道を探す。

Death Whistle (Quest)#009.src: Go to the top of the mountain and get {~} Black Whistle Leaf.
Death Whistle (Quest)#009.dst: 山頂へ行き、Black Whistle Leaf を {~} 枚手に入れる。

Death Whistle (Quest)#010.src: Return to Voer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].
Death Whistle (Quest)#010.dst: [{~4} Death Whistle Leaf] を持って [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の Voer のもとへ戻る。

Death Whistle (Quest)#012.src: You've no idea what you even have done, do you? Your thoughtless actions will cost lives!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.dst: 自分が何をしたか分かっていないのでしょう？その軽率な行いが命を奪うのです！
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#013.src: Uhm... Excuse me? What do you want, elf girl? We're in the middle of a deal here?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.dst: えーと…何です？何の用ですか、エルフのお嬢さん？今取引中なんですが？
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#014.src: You sold Pink Pelulite! Have you forgotten its enraging properties? Or shall I read from that herbology book you "found" in my camp?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.dst: あなたはピンクの Pelulite を売った！激昂させる性質を忘れたの？私の野営地で「拾った」薬草学の本を読み上げましょうか？
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#015.src: Wait, wh-what? A Pink PELULITE!? I sold that woman a Pink PELUTE for her luck charms! How dare- wait... wait, Pink Pelute has rounder petals... Oh no.
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.dst: 待って、な、何？ピンクの PELULITE！？あの女性にはお守り用にピンクの PELUTE を売ったんだ！よくも…待てよ…Pelute は花びらが丸い…しまった。
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#016.src: You can't even say for certain. This kind of carelessness has no place! If you refuse to exercise the proper thought and caution, then those around you suffer.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.dst: 確信すら持てないのね。こんな不注意は許されない！きちんと考え注意を払わなければ、周りの人が苦しむのです。
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#017.src: I must... make a difficult choice, and leave this job to you. I've other things to tend to, though it pains me to leave a life in another's hands. Remember this, villager!
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.dst: 私は…苦しい決断をして、この件をあなたに任せます。他にすべきことがある。命を他人の手に委ねるのは心苦しいけれど。覚えておきなさい、村人よ！
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#018.src: Aaah, this is a disaster! Human, please, Pink Pelulite acts quickly and intensely... Follow the pink trail on the ground, the flowers shed their petals. Get it back before something bad happens!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.dst: ああ、大惨事だ！人間さん、お願いです、ピンクの Pelulite は効き目が速くて強烈なんです…地面のピンクの跡を追ってください、花びらが落ちるんです。何か起きる前に取り返して！
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#019.src: Follow the path of residue to the buyer’s cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#019.dst: 残った跡をたどって買い手の洞窟へ行く。

Death Whistle (Quest)#020.src: Ah, um, come back later please! Something strange is happening!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.dst: あ、あの、また後で来てください！何か変なことが起きてるんです！
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#021.src: My body is a bit, um, not-in-my-control right now! I'd rather not hurt anyone!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.dst: 体がちょっと、その、言うことを聞かないんです！誰も傷つけたくないの！
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#022.src: Remove the flower from the woman in the cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#022.dst: 洞窟の女性から花を取り除く。

Death Whistle (Quest)#023.src: You're back, I see... and you're shedding petals! You got the Pink Pelulite back?
Death Whistle (Quest)#023.dst: 戻りましたね…花びらを落としながら！ピンクの Pelulite を取り返したんですか？
Death Whistle (Quest)#023.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#024.src: And what of the woman who bought it? Was she...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.dst: で、買った女性は？彼女は…？
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#025.src: Oh, thank goodness! You got in there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.dst: ああ、よかった！間に合ったんですね。彼女は常連で…なかなかの美人でもある。あの Lari の言うことも、少しは正しかったか…
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#026.src: I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this... but I can't just quit selling the herbs.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.dst: 確かに彼女の本は持ち出しましたし、今後はもっと気をつけるべきです…でも薬草を売るのはやめられません。
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#027.src: I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource-rich region here! Especially not any more.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.dst: 収入が要るんです、この沼は資源が豊かな土地じゃありませんし！今となってはなおさら。
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#028.src: And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise... well, I would not think about it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.dst: それにしても、あんなふうに立ち去るなんて！あなたがいてくれて助かりましたよ、人間さん。でなければ…考えたくもない。
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#029.src: Regardless, you helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.dst: ともかく、大いに助かりました。材料を集めて、常連の命まで救ってくれた。だから贈り物があります！
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#030.src: I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.dst: 私の品の詰め合わせを差し上げます。どれも調合しても安全なよう処理済みなので、今日のような事故は起きませんよ！
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.speaker: Voer

Deja Vu#000.dst: {p} 付近の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Asher と話す。

Deja Vu#001.src: Well well well, look who decided to come back with their tail between their legs.
Deja Vu#001.dst: おやおや、しっぽを巻いて戻ってきたのは誰かと思えば。
Deja Vu#001.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#002.src: Two weeks now and you still haven't found it? Ugh, I can't believe I ever trusted you with such a simple task.
Deja Vu#002.dst: 二週間経ってもまだ見つからないのか？まったく、こんな簡単な仕事を任せた俺が馬鹿だった。
Deja Vu#002.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#003.src: Who am I? WHAT DO YOU MEAN WHO AM I? You offered to help find my shovel, and I've been waiting two weeks!
Deja Vu#003.dst: 俺が誰かって？どういう意味だ？！シャベル探しを手伝うと言ったのはお前だろ、二週間も待ってるんだぞ！
Deja Vu#003.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#004.src: Forget about your payment. Unless you either pay me back or get my shovel right now!
Deja Vu#004.dst: 報酬は忘れろ。今すぐ弁償するか、俺のシャベルを見つけてくるかだ！
Deja Vu#004.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#005.src: My shovel? That's why I sent you out in the first place! It's somewhere in {p}. I lost it while following a trail of flowers.
Deja Vu#005.dst: 俺のシャベルだよ！そのためにお前を行かせたんだろ！{p} のどこかにある。花の跡を追ってる時に落としたんだ。
Deja Vu#005.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#006.src: I think it was south west of the large ruined gate. Now go get it!
Deja Vu#006.dst: 大きな廃墟の門の南西だったと思う。さあ取ってこい！
Deja Vu#006.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#007.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 付近で Asher のシャベルを見つける

Deja Vu#008.dst: Asher にシャベルを返す。

Deja Vu#009.src: Well hello there, stranger! Welcome to {p}! Always nice to see a new face around here.
Deja Vu#009.dst: やあ、旅の人！{p} へようこそ！新しい顔を見るのはいつでも嬉しいよ。
Deja Vu#009.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#010.src: Mad at you? Why would I be mad at you? We've never met.
Deja Vu#010.dst: 怒ってる？なんで俺が怒るんだ？会ったこともないのに。
Deja Vu#010.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#011.src: I know this a bit forward, but I need to ask for your help with-
Deja Vu#011.dst: いきなりで悪いんだけど、ちょっと手伝ってほしいことが…
Deja Vu#011.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#012.src: Wait, is that-? It is! You've found my shovel! I recognize those markings anywhere.
Deja Vu#012.dst: 待て、それって…？そうだ！俺のシャベルを見つけてくれたのか！この模様は見間違えようがない。
Deja Vu#012.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#013.src: But why is it so rusty? Ah, no matter. Give that to me and I'll head inside to get you a nice reward.
Deja Vu#013.dst: でもなんでこんなに錆びてるんだ？まあいい。それを渡してくれ、中から良い報酬を持ってくるよ。
Deja Vu#013.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#014.src: Thank you. Now, about that reward-
Deja Vu#014.dst: ありがとう。さて、報酬だけど…
Deja Vu#014.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#016.src: Oh dear, there he goes again. Poor fool ignored my warnings and touched that shovel.
Deja Vu#016.dst: やれやれ、また始まったか。哀れな奴め、わしの忠告を無視してあのシャベルに触れおった。
Deja Vu#016.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#017.src: He's gone and got himself stuck in a loop.
Deja Vu#017.dst: 自分をループに閉じ込めてしまったのじゃ。
Deja Vu#017.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#018.src: Head inside, soldier, and I'll explain what's happening here.
Deja Vu#018.dst: 中に入るがよい、兵士よ。何が起きておるか説明しよう。
Deja Vu#018.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#020.src: Without Asher, his house has vanished from time.
Deja Vu#020.dst: Asher がおらぬゆえ、奴の家は時の流れから消えたのじゃ。
Deja Vu#020.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#022.src: Let me explain why Asher disappeared...
Deja Vu#022.dst: Asher が消えた訳を説明しよう…
Deja Vu#022.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#023.src: {p} was built many years ago by a long-lost civilization.
Deja Vu#023.dst: {p} は遠い昔、失われた文明によって築かれた。
Deja Vu#023.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#024.src: They had odd powers. They ended up distorting time itself.
Deja Vu#024.dst: 彼らは奇妙な力を持ち、ついには時そのものを歪めてしまった。
Deja Vu#024.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#025.src: The tools they used to make these structures are imbued with their power.
Deja Vu#025.dst: これらの建物を造った道具には、その力が宿っておる。
Deja Vu#025.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#026.src: Asher found one of these tools: the shovel.
Deja Vu#026.dst: Asher はその道具の一つ、シャベルを見つけたのじゃ。
Deja Vu#026.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#027.src: The shovel is tethering its time of influence to today. It keeps sending Asher back.
Deja Vu#027.dst: シャベルは力の及ぶ時を今日に繋ぎ止めておる。そして Asher を過去へ送り続けるのじゃ。
Deja Vu#027.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#028.src: The issue is, Asher died in the past. This creates a paradox.
Deja Vu#028.dst: 問題は、Asher が過去で死んだことじゃ。これが矛盾を生む。
Deja Vu#028.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#029.src: We can save him if I send you back to prevent his death. Go through this rift to join him in the past.
Deja Vu#029.dst: わしがお主を過去へ送り、死を防げば救える。この裂け目を通って過去の奴のもとへ行け。
Deja Vu#029.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#030.src: Find a way to save Asher from his death.
Deja Vu#030.dst: Asher を死から救う方法を見つける。

Deja Vu#032.src: Usually this place is filled with workers.
Deja Vu#032.dst: いつもはここ、作業員でいっぱいなのに。
Deja Vu#032.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#033.src: But no one's here. And this place is clearly not done.
Deja Vu#033.dst: でも誰もいない。それにここ、明らかに未完成だ。
Deja Vu#033.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#034.src: Whatever the case, I should probably find my shovel.
Deja Vu#034.dst: とにかく、シャベルを探さないとな。
Deja Vu#034.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#035.src: If I were a shovel, where would I be?
Deja Vu#035.dst: 俺がシャベルなら、どこにいる？
Deja Vu#035.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#036.dst: うーん。この辺にはないな。
Deja Vu#036.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#037.src: This place... There's so much going on but no one here.
Deja Vu#037.dst: ここは…色々動いてるのに誰もいない。
Deja Vu#037.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#038.src: What I don't understand, though, is why this place looks brand new.
Deja Vu#038.dst: 分からないのは、なんでここが新品みたいに見えるかだ。
Deja Vu#038.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#039.src: This place looks like it's just being built!
Deja Vu#039.dst: まるで建設中みたいじゃないか！
Deja Vu#039.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#040.src: This must be something to do with the valley's magic. Wouldn't be the first time.
Deja Vu#040.dst: 谷の魔法のせいに違いない。初めてってわけでもないし。
Deja Vu#040.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#042.src: In fact, whenever I hold that shovel, this kind of stuff seems to happen.
Deja Vu#042.dst: 実際、あのシャベルを持つと、いつもこういうことが起きる気がする。
Deja Vu#042.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#043.src: Maybe it's sent me way back. Back to the construction of this place.
Deja Vu#043.dst: ずっと昔に送られたのかもな。ここが建てられた頃に。
Deja Vu#043.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#044.src: Then why is no one here?
Deja Vu#044.dst: じゃあなんで誰もいないんだ？
Deja Vu#044.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#045.src: Woah, that tree looks like it might fall over!
Deja Vu#045.dst: うわ、あの木、倒れてきそうだ！
Deja Vu#045.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#047.src: Uhf! How do they have a cannon? These guys must be super advanced.
Deja Vu#047.dst: うっ！なんで大砲なんか持ってるんだ？ずいぶん進んだ連中だな。
Deja Vu#047.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#048.src: I think I'm close now. I can just feel that shovel close by.
Deja Vu#048.dst: もうすぐだと思う。シャベルが近くにあるのを感じる。
Deja Vu#048.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#050.src: My my, a crushing defeat to be sure. You'll have to find a way to stop that.
Deja Vu#050.dst: おやおや、まさに「押し潰される」ような惨敗じゃな。防ぐ手を考えねば。
Deja Vu#050.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#051.src: Go back through the rift and make sure Asher doesn't become a pancake this time.
Deja Vu#051.dst: 裂け目を通って戻り、今度こそ Asher がぺしゃんこにならぬようにするのじゃ。
Deja Vu#051.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#053.src: Well that was quite the explosive end to our friend there. There must be a way to prevent that.
Deja Vu#053.dst: いやはや、あの友人は実に「爆発的」な最期を遂げたのう。防ぐ手があるはずじゃ。
Deja Vu#053.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#054.src: Head back in there. This time with less explosions.
Deja Vu#054.dst: もう一度行ってこい。今度は爆発を減らしてな。
Deja Vu#054.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#055.src: Oh, so close on that try. Who could've guessed that was how our friend met his end?
Deja Vu#055.dst: おお、今回は惜しかった。あの友人がそんな死に方をするとは誰が思おう？
Deja Vu#055.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#056.src: I'm sure you'll nail it this time. Not sure how you will stop a cosmic event, though.
Deja Vu#056.dst: 今度こそうまくいくじゃろう。天体の出来事をどう止めるのかは知らんがな。
Deja Vu#056.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#057.src: Oh there it is! My shovel!
Deja Vu#057.dst: おっ、あった！俺のシャベル！
Deja Vu#057.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#058.src: I'm surprised it took me back this far this time.
Deja Vu#058.dst: 今回はこんな昔まで戻されるとは驚いた。
Deja Vu#058.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#059.src: Well, time to head on back-
Deja Vu#059.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#062.src: Asher, you remember when I allowed you to live in the valley, I told you not to touch any odd objects.
Deja Vu#062.dst: Asher、谷に住むのを許した時、妙な物には触れるなと言ったのを覚えておるか。
Deja Vu#062.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#064.src: You got yourself stuck hundreds of years ago. If it wasn't for this guard, you'd be removed from existence.
Deja Vu#064.dst: お主は何百年も昔に閉じ込められておった。この衛兵がおらねば、存在ごと消えておったぞ。
Deja Vu#064.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#065.src: Oh... So that's where I am. I am so sorry Martyn. Please don't kick me out of the valley.
Deja Vu#065.dst: あっ…ここにいたのか、俺。本当にごめん、Martyn。谷から追い出さないでくれ。
Deja Vu#065.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#066.src: I know time travel can be tempting. But it's far more dangerous than you can ever understand.
Deja Vu#066.dst: 時間旅行が魅力的なのは分かる。だがお主の想像よりはるかに危険なのじゃ。
Deja Vu#066.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#067.src: The valley is banned for most citizens. I watch over this timeline because of poor souls like Asher.
Deja Vu#067.dst: 谷はほとんどの民に禁じられておる。わしは Asher のような哀れな者のために、この時間軸を見守っておるのじゃ。
Deja Vu#067.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#068.dst: Old Man Martyn の話を聞く。

Deja Vu#071.src: How did you get these powers? Are you even human?
Deja Vu#071.dst: どうやってそんな力を？そもそも人間なのか？
Deja Vu#071.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#072.src: Oh you know. I've read a book or two in my time.
Deja Vu#072.dst: なに、わしも昔は本の一冊や二冊は読んだものでな。
Deja Vu#072.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#073.src: {u}, I'm sorry I got you dragged into this. I wish I could have done it myself.
Deja Vu#073.dst: {u}、巻き込んですまなんだ。わし一人でできればよかったのじゃが。
Deja Vu#073.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#074.src: I probably could have gotten myself out...
Deja Vu#074.dst: たぶん自力で抜け出せたと思うけど…
Deja Vu#074.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#075.src: You died in the past. Multiple times.
Deja Vu#075.dst: お主は過去で死んだ。何度もな。
Deja Vu#075.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#077.src: Yes. In some surprising ways too.
Deja Vu#077.dst: うむ。しかも意外な死に方でな。
Deja Vu#077.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#078.src: {u}, I'm sure we will meet again... in time.
Deja Vu#078.dst: {u}、また会えるじゃろう…いずれ時が来ればな。
Deja Vu#078.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#082.src: I don't understand Martyn. He seems to know everything about the past. Here, come closer, I want to whisper something.
Deja Vu#082.dst: Martyn のことはよく分からない。過去のことを何でも知ってるみたいだ。ほら、近くに来て、耳打ちしたいことがある。
Deja Vu#082.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#084.src: I think he might have known Bob. I saw some letters in his house.
Deja Vu#084.dst: Martyn は Bob を知ってたのかもしれない。家で手紙を見たんだ。
Deja Vu#084.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#085.src: Weird, right? Bob was a hard guy to know.
Deja Vu#085.dst: 変だろ？Bob はなかなか知り合えない奴だったのに。
Deja Vu#085.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#086.src: Anyway, take this. It's the least I can do to pay you for saving me.
Deja Vu#086.dst: とにかく、これを受け取ってくれ。救ってくれたせめてものお礼だ。
Deja Vu#086.speaker: Asher

Desperate Metal#003.src: A bunch of stupid mechs came here and just started ransacking!
Desperate Metal#003.dst: 間抜けなメカどもが押しかけて、荒らし回りやがった！
Desperate Metal#003.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#004.src: Looks like a bunch of despermechs. That's what we call junk mechs, trying to survive.
Desperate Metal#004.dst: Despermech の群れらしい。生き延びようとするガラクタのメカを、俺たちはそう呼ぶんだ。
Desperate Metal#004.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#005.src: I count three different mech marks. Looks like they split up once they got their parts.
Desperate Metal#005.dst: メカの刻印が三種類ある。部品を手に入れてから散り散りに逃げたらしい。
Desperate Metal#005.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#006.src: You got to help me here, I'm no warrior. Look they've dropped crates on their escape. Follow them and bring me back evidence that you destroyed them and I shall reward you.
Desperate Metal#006.dst: 手を貸してくれ、俺は戦士じゃない。ほら、逃げる時に木箱を落としてる。追いかけて、倒した証拠を持ってきてくれたら礼をするよ。
Desperate Metal#006.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#007.src: Three trails, three thieving despermechs. Be careful, they aren't to be underestimated.
Desperate Metal#007.dst: 三つの跡に、三体の盗人 Despermech。気をつけろ、侮っちゃいけない。
Desperate Metal#007.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#008.src: Locate the {~} mechs by following the trails of tools, return to Phinas with evidence that you destroyed the mechs.
Desperate Metal#008.dst: 工具の跡をたどって {~} 体のメカを見つけ、倒した証拠を持って Phinas のもとへ戻る。

Desperate Metal#009.src: You Wynn folk sure know your fights.
Desperate Metal#009.dst: Wynn の連中は戦い慣れてるな。
Desperate Metal#009.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#010.src: You found all three? Let's take a look. Hm....
Desperate Metal#010.dst: 三体とも見つけた？見せてくれ。ふむ…
Desperate Metal#010.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#011.src: Wait. These aren't Despermechs.. The factory fell over two years ago. These are brand new. Handmade.
Desperate Metal#011.dst: 待てよ。これは Despermech じゃない…工場は二年以上前に潰れた。これは新品、手作りだ。
Desperate Metal#011.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#012.dst: もっとよく見てみよう。
Desperate Metal#012.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#013.src: Would you look at that! Their code!
Desperate Metal#013.dst: こいつを見ろ！奴らのコードだ！
Desperate Metal#013.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#014.src: Here, have them back. Take a close look at the names of these parts.
Desperate Metal#014.dst: ほら、返すよ。部品の名前をよく見てくれ。
Desperate Metal#014.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#015.src: Find out where to go by looking at the pieces of junk.
Desperate Metal#015.dst: ガラクタの部品を調べて、行き先を突き止める。

Desperate Metal#016.src: What are these? I have nothing to do with them!
Desperate Metal#016.dst: 何これ？私には関係ないわ！
Desperate Metal#016.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#017.src: Ahh.. Well now that I think of it writing my location on these parts was a bit stupid.
Desperate Metal#017.dst: ああ…まあ、考えてみれば部品に居場所を書いたのはちょっと馬鹿だったわね。
Desperate Metal#017.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#018.src: Those mechs were my creation. Corkus can still live with machines.
Desperate Metal#018.dst: あのメカは私が作ったの。Corkus はまだ機械と共に生きられる。
Desperate Metal#018.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#019.src: The factory was a disaster. That's what happens when a machine controls a machine.
Desperate Metal#019.dst: 工場は大惨事だった。機械に機械を操らせるとああなるのよ。
Desperate Metal#019.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#020.src: I am living proof that humans can control them. Make use of them.
Desperate Metal#020.dst: 人間が機械を操り、使いこなせる。私がその生き証人よ。
Desperate Metal#020.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#021.src: The metal shortage has made it difficult to make my machines... Not to mention the new laws..
Desperate Metal#021.dst: 金属不足で機械を作るのが大変で…新しい法律は言うまでもないわ…
Desperate Metal#021.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#022.src: If you want to turn me in fine. You'll find all the evidence you need under my pillow.
Desperate Metal#022.dst: 突き出したいならどうぞ。必要な証拠は全部、私の枕の下にあるわ。
Desperate Metal#022.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#024.dst: 侵入者ヲ検知…警備システム起動。

Desperate Metal#027.src: I'm sorry it ended up like this, you should've just ignored that old man.
Desperate Metal#027.dst: こんな結末でごめんなさい。あの老人なんて無視すればよかったのに。
Desperate Metal#027.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#029.src: I was made to be angry. I can't stop myself...
Desperate Metal#029.dst: ワタシハ怒ルヨウ作ラレタ。止メラレナイ…
Desperate Metal#029.speaker: Big Boss Mech-DM666

Desperate Metal#031.src: Did you find the source of those odd handmade mechs?
Desperate Metal#031.dst: あの妙な手作りメカの出どころは分かったか？
Desperate Metal#031.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#032.src: Nettik? The Light House owner? It's not overly surprising.
Desperate Metal#032.dst: Nettik？灯台の持ち主の？まあ意外でもないな。
Desperate Metal#032.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#033.src: She always did complain about the mech ban.
Desperate Metal#033.dst: あいつはいつもメカ禁止令に文句を言ってたからな。
Desperate Metal#033.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#034.src: You see, many of the Corkian people rely on their machines. Have done for years.
Desperate Metal#034.dst: Corkus 人の多くは機械に頼って暮らしてる。何年もな。
Desperate Metal#034.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#035.src: So when the factory fell and the new laws were introduced, people's lives changed..
Desperate Metal#035.dst: だから工場が潰れて新しい法律ができた時、みんなの暮らしが変わったんだ…
Desperate Metal#035.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#036.src: People don't like change. Anyway, I can't thank you enough. Have this for your troubles.
Desperate Metal#036.dst: 人は変化を嫌うもんさ。とにかく、本当に感謝してる。手間賃にこれを取っといてくれ。
Desperate Metal#036.speaker: Phinas

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#000.src: Find out what's happening at the theatre.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#000.dst: 劇場で何が起きているのか確かめる。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.src: Interesting to see a Human wanting to see a Dwarven play!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.dst: 人間がドワーフの芝居を見たがるとは珍しいですね！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.src: The only play we're performing is the annual Victory Festival.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.dst: 今上演しているのは、毎年恒例の勝利祭だけです。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.src: The entry cost is [{~} Emerald Block]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.dst: 入場料は [{~} Emerald Block] です
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.src: Just take a seat and enjoy the show.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.dst: 席に座って、どうぞお楽しみください。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.src: Wait, is that- Hey, {u}! It's so good to see you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.dst: 待て、あれは…おい、{u}！会えて本当に嬉しいよ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.src: Hello, to the people of Gavel, glad to see so many here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.dst: Gavel の皆さん、こんばんは！大勢のご来場ありがとうございます！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.dst: 劇を楽しみ、多くを学んでいただければ幸いです。今宵の語り手は私が務めます。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#009.src: Pheeeew. I think we outran the villagers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#009.dst: ふうーっ。村人たちは振り切ったようだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#009.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.src: I think we are safe here in the mountains. Oh look. Shiny ores. This is like a gold mine.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.dst: 山の中なら安全だろう。おお見ろ、光る鉱石だ。まるで金鉱だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.src: These nice minerals are very nice, let us start digging.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.dst: この素晴らしい鉱物はとても素晴らしい。さあ掘ろう。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.src: I am a dangerous monster and I will not let you mine these diamonds. We are the Doguns, and we will kill you!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.dst: 我は危険な怪物、ダイヤは掘らせぬ。我らは Dogun、貴様らを殺す！！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.src: Graoaoro. I will eat you all for my afternoon demon luncheon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.dst: グラオアオロ。貴様らまとめて、我の午後の悪魔ランチにしてくれる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.dst: ムハハハ！去れ、ちびドワーフども！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.dst: ぐああ。死ぬ…死んでしまう！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.speaker: Arock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.src: MOAHAHAHA. WE WILL KILL ALL OF YOU.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.dst: ムハハハ。貴様ら皆殺しだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#019.src: We need to forge better weapons so we can fight back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#019.dst: 反撃のため、もっと良い武器を鍛えねば。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#019.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.src: Good idea! We will use our intelligence to slay the demons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.dst: 名案だ！我らの知恵で悪魔を倒そう。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.src: YOU CANNOT BEAT US, WE CAN SUMMON DRAGONS WITH OUR MAGIC.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.dst: 貴様らに勝ち目はない、我らは魔法で竜を呼べるのだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#022.src: Dragons are no match for us?? CHARGE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#022.dst: 竜など敵ではない？？突撃！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#022.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#023.src: We have won. Hooray. And now we have established a great citadel, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#023.dst: 勝った。万歳。そして偉大な城塞を築いたぞ、{p}だ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#023.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#024.src: The dwarven intellect beat the sheer power of the demons magic.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#024.dst: ドワーフの知性が、悪魔の魔法の力に打ち勝ったのだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#024.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.dst: ご覧いただきありがとうございました！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.src: I hope you enjoyed the show, and learned something new today!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.dst: 楽しんで、何か新しいことを学べたなら幸いです！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.src: We are continuing the celebration at the old Demon City. Follow the red banners outside {p} to get there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.dst: お祝いは旧悪魔の都で続きます。{p}の外の赤い旗を辿ってお越しください。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.dst: では、会場でお会いしましょう。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.src: Ugh, that was awful. Don't believe anything you see here, human. History is written by the victors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.dst: うえっ、ひどい芝居だ。人間、ここで見たものは何も信じるな。歴史は勝者が書くんだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.src: Make your way to the Dogun Festival by following the red banners outside {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.dst: {p}の外の赤い旗を辿って Dogun 祭へ向かう。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.src: Welcome one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.dst: ようこそ皆さん！ドワーフの兄弟姉妹、ご来賓の皆様！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#032.src: If I could draw your attention to the wooden stage in the north, we can begin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#032.dst: 北の木の舞台にご注目いただければ、始めましょう。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#032.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.src: Welcome to the annual festival where we celebrate victory over the foul demons...The Doguns!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.dst: 邪悪な悪魔…Dogun に勝利したことを祝う、年に一度の祭りへようこそ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.src: Now, if I can get you to turn around to face the bonfire, we've prepared a lovely firecasting show for you all while we prepare!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.dst: では焚き火の方へ振り向いてください。準備の間、素敵な火炎魔法のショーをお楽しみください！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#035.src: Wow, I didn't know Dwarves could learn such magic! Beats the heck out of firecrackers!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#035.dst: わあ、ドワーフがこんな魔法を使えるなんて！爆竹なんかよりずっとすごい！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#035.speaker: Mahou

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.src: Magnificent! Thank you very much to our fire casters. Now, ladies and gents, your attention to the main stage please!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.dst: 見事！火炎術師の皆さんに感謝を。では皆様、メインステージにご注目を！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.src: For the last {~} years we have captured renegade Doguns that escaped the war, and this year is no exception!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.dst: この {~} 年間、戦争から逃れたはぐれ Dogun を捕らえてきました。今年も例外ではありません！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.src: We shall now entomb the foul demon to join the ranks of the other Doguns on display.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.dst: これより邪悪な悪魔を封じ込め、展示中の他の Dogun の列に加えます。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.src: Note its magical might, its aggressive nature, its intense heat, and its fierce appearance.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.dst: その魔力、凶暴な性質、猛烈な熱、そして恐ろしい姿にご注目ください。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.src: All no match for the ingenuity and comeradery of the Dwarven nations!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.dst: いずれもドワーフ諸国の知恵と団結の前には無力です！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.src: M-Monsters... You all...are the demons here...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.dst: バ、化け物…お前たちこそ…ここの悪魔だ…
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.speaker: Dogun

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.src: Every year, every year, every single YEAR you do this. You all need to open your god-blessed eyes for once!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.dst: 毎年、毎年、毎年毎年こんなことを！一度くらいその目をちゃんと開けてみろ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.src: Do you all really believe everything they tell you? Do you all just lap it up like dogs?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.dst: 言われたことを全部信じるのか？犬みたいに鵜呑みにするのか？！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.src: Our side won the war, but does that really mean we were in the right? I'll tell you right now, it doesn't!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.dst: 俺たちは戦争に勝った。だがそれで正しかったことになるか？はっきり言う、ならない！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.src: We all see it- The Doguns have feelings, family and thoughts, just like anyone else here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.dst: 皆わかってるはずだ。Dogun にも感情も家族も考えもある、ここにいる誰とも同じだ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.src: You are encasing live Doguns for entertainment. Public execution! This twisted display is more demonic than they ever could dream to be!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.dst: 生きた Dogun を娯楽のために封じるなんて、公開処刑だ！この歪んだ見世物は、奴らが夢見るどんな悪より悪魔的だ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.src: Guards! Get this propaganda spewing half pint to the Molten Core Prison, north side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.dst: 衛兵！このプロパガンダを撒き散らすチビを、北側の Molten Core Prison へ連行しなさい。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#049.src: Come along, sir. Let's not make more of a scene.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#049.dst: さあ、来てください。これ以上騒ぎを大きくしないように。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#049.speaker: Dwarven Guard

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.src: Why would Axelus say something so blatantly wrong?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.dst: なぜ Axelus はあんな明らかな嘘を言ったんだ？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.src: What was he talking about? That was all nonsense!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.dst: 何の話だ？全部でたらめじゃないか！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.src: Are they really taking him to the Molten Core? You've heard the horror stories about there, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.dst: 本当に Molten Core に連れて行くのか？あそこの怖い話、聞いたことあるだろ？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.src: Well, the expression 'no hope blows from the north' came from there, since it's on the north side...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.dst: ほら、「北から希望は吹かない」って言葉はあそこから来たんだ。北側にあるからな…
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.src: Apologies, all. I shall provide us all with a quick way back to {p} on the floor here. We hope you enjoyed the show, despite the interruption!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.dst: 皆様、失礼しました。ここの床に{p}へすぐ戻れる道をご用意します。中断はありましたが、お楽しみいただけたなら幸いです！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.src: Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.dst: {p}の牢獄で、あのヒステリックなドワーフについて調べる。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.src: I see I got your attention. Interested in the truth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.dst: 興味を引けたみたいだな。真実に興味があるんだろ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.src: I'm no conspiracy nut. The Dwarves have been lied to for hundreds of years about the war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.dst: 俺は陰謀論者じゃない。ドワーフは戦争について何百年も嘘をつかれてきたんだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.src: I have seen the truth. But my word isn't enough, is it? Seeing is believing, after all.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.dst: 俺は真実を見た。だが俺の言葉だけじゃ足りないだろ？百聞は一見にしかず、だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.src: Hopefully I will see you soon, {u}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.dst: また近いうちに会えるといいな、{u}。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.src: Pick up Axelus' note and head to the location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.dst: Axelus のメモを拾い、[{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ向かう。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.dst: Library of Flames を探索する。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.src: Well, now you have read what I read. The truth...or the lie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.dst: さて、これで俺が読んだものをお前も読んだ。真実…か、嘘か。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.src: My people are tyrants and conquerors...but they are also good. The people have been brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.dst: 俺の一族は暴君で征服者だ…だが善良でもある。民は洗脳されているんだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.src: Many things are about to happen. If you want to know more, come to house number {~} in {p}. I'll be waiting.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.dst: これから多くのことが起こる。もっと知りたいなら、{p}の {~} 番の家に来い。待ってるぞ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.src: Search for house {~} in {p} like Axelus said.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.dst: Axelus に言われた通り、{p}で {~} 番の家を探す。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.src: Talk to Axelus in the Coalition Base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.dst: 連合の基地で Axelus と話す。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.src: Ah, you made it. Come and meet Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.dst: ああ、来たか。Korzim に会ってくれ
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.dst: ようこそ…人間。私は…Korzim だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.src: We...are those who...want peace. I am son...of the Dogun Chief... I have...been banished.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.dst: 我々は…平和を…望む者だ。私は…Dogun の族長の…息子…追放された身だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#071.src: The coalition is a small group of believers in the truth. The Doguns aren't demons, and the Dwarves aren't all brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#071.dst: 連合は真実を信じる小さな集まりだ。Dogun は悪魔じゃないし、ドワーフも全員が洗脳されてるわけじゃない。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#071.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#072.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won’t tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#072.dst: だが当然、隠れて暮らすしかない。Dogun はドワーフを許さず、ドワーフは裏切り者と「悪魔」を狩る。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#072.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.src: Right now, we're trying to convince the public. But it's proving difficult, if not impossible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.dst: 今は民衆を説得しようとしてる。だが、不可能とまでは言わんが、かなり難しい。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.src: It isn't {~} years ago. We have the technology and supply chains to live here peacefully, but they just won't listen!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.dst: もう {~} 年前じゃないんだ。ここで平和に暮らす技術も補給網もあるのに、奴らは聞く耳を持たない！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.src: We have...a plan... To win over...my people...that is.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.dst: 我々には…計画がある…私の同胞を…味方につける…計画が。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.src: Korzim has told us that dragon bone is sacred to his people. We had to make some connections, but we have a way to get it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.dst: Korzim によると、竜の骨は奴の一族にとって神聖なものらしい。伝手を頼って、ようやく手に入れる方法ができた。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.src: If you want, you could come with us. We can explain more of the situation later. Exit's through the back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.dst: よければ一緒に来い。状況は後で詳しく説明する。出口は奥だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.src: Follow the group on the mission.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.dst: 一行について任務に向かう。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.src: The others...are just up ahead. I'll let you through...our tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.dst: 他の者は…この先だ。我々の…トンネルを通してやろう。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.src: We use.. earth and.. fire.. elements. It is slow... like us.. but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.dst: 我々は…土と…火の…元素を使う。遅い…我々のように…だが強力だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.src: We got this drill all the way from Corkus. Axelus had to pay a king's ransom to buy it, but this ought to work!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.dst: このドリルははるばる Corkus から取り寄せたんだ。Axelus が大金をはたいて買ったが、これならいけるはずだ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.src: AAAAGH! Idiot Corkus swindlers! Damn it all! How many emeralds did we waste?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.dst: ぐああ！Corkus の詐欺師どもめ！くそっ！エメラルドをいくら無駄にした？！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.src: Ugh, do you have any experience with machines? You might have some idea of how in the hell to fix this hunk of junk.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.dst: はあ、機械の経験はあるか？このガラクタの直し方、お前ならわかるかもしれん。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.src: Fantastic, {u}! We got the bone! Couldn't have done it without you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.dst: やったな、{u}！骨を手に入れた！お前なしじゃ無理だった。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.src: You can take it back to the coalition base. Barden and I will need to pack up before we join you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.dst: それを連合の基地へ持って帰ってくれ。俺と Barden は片付けてから行く。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.src: Just knock on the black block in front of the cave we arrived in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.dst: 来るときに通った洞窟の前の、黒いブロックを叩けばいい。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.src: Head back to the Coalition Base through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.dst: トンネルを通って連合の基地へ戻る。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#093.src: Dragon bone is one of the hardest substances in all the provinces. It's extremely rare.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#093.dst: 竜の骨は、全地方でも指折りの硬さを持つ物質だ。極めて希少だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#093.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.src: We're going to present this to the Dogun chief as tribute. We need to tidy it up.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.dst: これを貢ぎ物として Dogun の族長に献上する。手入れが必要だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.src: Could you get [{~} Repair Kit] from the eastern part of the base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.dst: 基地の東側から [{~} Repair Kit] を取ってきてくれないか？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.src: Retrieve the [Repair Kit] in the eastern part of the base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.dst: 基地の東側で [Repair Kit] を回収する。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#098.src: There are voices behind this wall, and the trail ends here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#098.dst: この壁の向こうから声がする。足跡もここで途切れてる。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.src: We have no vaults here. Must be traitors... The King really wants to see Axelus.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.dst: ここに金庫なんてない。裏切り者に違いない…王は Axelus に会いたがっておられる。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#100.src: Stand back! I'll ready the charges...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#100.dst: 下がれ！爆薬を仕掛ける…

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.src: No, no, ignore the repair kit! There's no time to worry about that!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.dst: いや、修理キットは放っておけ！そんな場合じゃない！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.src: Our position has been compromised, they blew our doors wide open! We have to evacuate immediately.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.dst: 居場所がばれた、扉を吹き飛ばされた！すぐに撤退するぞ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.src: We've never been caught like this before, they never knew we really had Doguns on our side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.dst: こんな風に見つかったのは初めてだ。こっちに本当に Dogun がいるとは奴らも知らなかったはずだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.src: We need to get to safety right now! The least explored area is the Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.dst: 今すぐ安全な場所へ！一番探索されてないのは Upper Heights だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.src: Everyone, out! Now! They won't follow through the rough terrain!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.dst: 全員、出ろ！今すぐ！険しい地形までは追ってこない！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#107.src: Find your way up to the Dogun Village through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#107.dst: トンネルを抜けて、上にある Dogun の村を目指す。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#108.src: We'll stay around here, we aren't welcome in the village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#108.dst: 俺たちはこの辺りに残る。村じゃ歓迎されないからな。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#108.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.src: But... bring them... the dragon bone as a gift... If they accept it... they might accept us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.dst: だが…竜の骨を…贈り物として持っていけ…受け取れば…我々を受け入れるかもしれん。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.src: You are free to enter the village but we will stay back and wait until the coast is clear. Keep going.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.dst: お前は村に入っていい。俺たちは後ろで、安全になるまで待つ。先へ進め。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.src: What is... that on the... cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.dst: 南の…崖の上にある…あれは何だ？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.src: Hey, aren't those...Doguns?! A whole settlement...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.dst: おい、あれは…Dogun か？！集落まるごと…
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#113.src: They've been gathering forces! We must inform {p} immediately!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#113.dst: 兵を集めている！すぐに{p}に知らせねば！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#113.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.src: Human. Come talk to me... Now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.dst: 人間。こっちへ来て話せ…今すぐ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.src: Human... That Dwarf, he saw us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.dst: 人間…あのドワーフに…見られた…
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#117.src: They will... destroy us... If he reports... back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#117.dst: 奴が{p}に…報告すれば…我々は…滅ぼされる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#117.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.src: We need to... prepare our defenses. We need all the... help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.dst: 防備を…固めねば。あらゆる…助けが必要だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.src: Wait... What are... you holding? Dragon bone...? Just what we need...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.dst: 待て…手に持っているのは…何だ？竜の骨…？まさに必要なものだ…
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.src: Human... if you promise to help us... I will grant you access to... our secret elevators... You can get up and... down the heights with those.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.dst: 人間…我々を助けると誓うなら…秘密の昇降機を…使わせてやろう…それで高地を…上り下りできる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.src: Please return to... us when you reach level {~}. Take this... badge so the... others recognize you... as an ally. One of the elevators is... to the south.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.dst: レベル {~} に達したら…戻ってきてくれ。この…徽章を持っていけ…皆が味方だと…わかるように。昇降機の一つは…南にある。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#000~1.dst: [+{~} 古代の Dogun の石板]

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001~1.dst: クエストライン開始: ドワーフと Dogun

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002~1.src: The report suggests that the two species would compete for space.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002~1.dst: 報告書によれば、二つの種族は生存圏を奪い合うことになるという。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003~1.src: "Public opinion is firmly against removal of the natives..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003~1.dst: 「世論は先住民の排除に断固反対している…」

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014~1.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play, and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014~1.dst: お芝居を楽しんで、たくさん学んでいただけたら幸いです。今夜の語り手を務めます。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014~1.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039~1.src: Welcome, one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039~1.dst: ようこそ、皆様！ドワーフの兄弟姉妹、お客様にご来場の皆様！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039~1.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040~1.src: Axelus! You are under arrest for high treason!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041~1.src: The cover crumbles a touch at your grip when you open it up. How old is this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041~1.dst: 開くと、表紙が手の中で少し崩れる。どれほど古いものなのか？

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083~1.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won't tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083~1.dst: だが当然、俺たちは隠れて暮らすしかない。Dogun はドワーフを許さず、ドワーフは裏切り者と「悪魔」を狩る。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083~1.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084~1.src: We would...melt the beds...they sleep in... After all...we are...molten rock.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084~1.dst: 我々なら…奴らの寝床を…溶かせる…何しろ…我々は…溶岩だ。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085~1.src: This hideout was created by the Doguns in minutes, when it would have taken us days!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085~1.dst: この隠れ家は Dogun が数分で作ったんだ。俺たちなら何日もかかる！

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086~1.src: It's a control panel. It's futile to figure out how it works, perhaps brute force is necessary.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086~1.dst: 制御盤だ。仕組みを理解しようとしても無駄だ。力ずくでやるしかないかもしれない。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096~1.src: We use...earth and...fire...elements. It is slow...like us...but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096~1.dst: 我々は…土と…火の…元素を使う。遅いが…我々と同じく…強力だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096~1.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097~1.src: We don't forbid...you humans to be here, but please leave... We don't want any...unwanted dwarves here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097~1.dst: 人間が…ここにいるのは…禁じぬが、去ってくれ…招かれざる…ドワーフは…いらぬ。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.src: What is...that on the...cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.dst: 南の…崖の上の…あれは何だ？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.src: We need to...prepare our defenses. We need all the...help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.dst: 防備を…固めねば。あらゆる…助けが必要だ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.src: If you want a ticket you'll have to pay me [{~} Emerald Block].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.dst: チケットが欲しいなら [{~} エメラルドブロック] を払ってもらう。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#137.src: ...oh Lord, this must be why! D-Doguns?!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.src: Several rumours are suggested to be propagated amongst the population.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.dst: 住民の間にいくつかの噂を流すことが提案されている。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.src: He is consorting with the enemy! Axelus, they've tainted your soul!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.dst: 奴は敵と通じている！Axelus、奴らに魂を汚されたな！

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.src: They will...destroy us... If he reports...back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.dst: 奴が{p}に…報告すれば…我々は…滅ぼされる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.src: "Any war could result in rioting in {p} and other established colonies."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.dst: 「いかなる戦争も、{p} や他の既存の植民地で暴動を招きかねない。」

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.src: Return to the Dogun village with a Dogun Badge of Trust and talk to the leader of the town
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.dst: Dogun Badge of Trust を持って Dogun の村に戻り、村の長と話す

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.src: You are so young.. to be fighting.. a war so old. Still... it is appreciated.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.dst: かくも若くして…かくも古き戦に…身を投じるとは。それでも…感謝する。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.src: The war... to you, it would be... ages ago. But... when one has lived for... {~} years...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.dst: あの戦は…お前にとっては…遥か昔だろう。だが…{~} 年を…生きた者には…
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.src: We have... few options. We need to discuss... the few we have... available.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.dst: 我らには…選択肢が少ない。残された…わずかな道を…話し合わねば。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.src: I am sorry... to welcome you all... in such troubled times.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.dst: このような…苦難の時に…皆を迎えることになり…すまない。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.src: We thought... we could hide in safety... But there is... no place left to hide.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.dst: 隠れていれば…安全だと思っていた…だが…もう隠れる場所はない。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.src: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.dst: Aval は…我らに…Heights を去れと言う…だが我らは…生き延びられぬ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.src: We must... evacuate the settlement... immediately. They... are coming... again.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.dst: 集落から…直ちに…退避せねば。奴らが…また…来る。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#009.dst: いてっ、すみません…通してください。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.src: Please! You all know me, I'm not with the side of the government. Hear me out, we can fix this!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.dst: 頼む！皆俺を知ってるだろ、俺は政府側じゃない。聞いてくれ、まだ何とかなる！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.src: Stop! I have been hiding from the Dwarves just as much as anyone here, they've been after me too!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.dst: 待て！俺もここにいる誰とも同じくドワーフから隠れてきた。奴らは俺も追ってるんだ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.src: Why... would we... trust you... of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.dst: なぜ…我らが…よりによって…ドワーフのお前を…信じると？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.src: How...could you even help? They...won't listen to you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.dst: どうやって…助けるというのだ？奴らは…お前の言葉など聞かぬ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#016.src: I know all the war strategies and weapon cache locations.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#016.dst: 作戦も武器庫の場所も、全部知ってる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#016.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.src: Treason... against your own kind...? How will you... manage this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.dst: 同族への…裏切りか…？どうやって…成し遂げる？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.src: The human and I will sneak into the armoury and sabotage their equipment, Korzim will help you Doguns evacuate someplace safer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.dst: 俺と人間で兵器庫に忍び込んで装備を壊す。Korzim はお前たち Dogun をもっと安全な場所へ避難させる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.src: I am... yet wary of you... but we will... follow your plan... Dwarf. Korzim... lead us... to safety.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.dst: 私はまだ…お前を疑っている…だが…お前の策に…従おう…ドワーフよ。Korzim…我らを…安全な所へ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.src: {u}, follow the southern road from {p}, towards the {p} entrance. I'll be waiting there for you near the armoury.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.dst: {u}、{p}から南の道を辿って{p}の入口へ向かえ。兵器庫の近くで待ってる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Axelus と合流する。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.src: Shh! Get behind here, and look towards the armoury doors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.dst: しっ！ここに隠れて、兵器庫の扉を見てろ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.src: We need to sneak in when they aren't looking, got it? But we need to be fast.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.dst: 奴らが見てない隙に忍び込むぞ、いいな？だが急がないと。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.src: If they close that door, we'll only have one option left, and it's a huge risk. Those Dwarven gates are almost unbreakable.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.dst: あの扉を閉められたら、残る手は一つだけ、しかも大博打だ。ドワーフの門はほぼ壊せない。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.src: Alright boys, let's close this up and head to base B.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.dst: よし野郎ども、ここを閉めて B 基地へ向かうぞ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.speaker: Rodoroc Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.src: Aaah! Charge them! HEY, STOP RIGHT THERE, SOLDIERS!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.dst: ああっ！突っ込め！おい、そこの兵士ども、止まれ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.src: Defeat the {p} Guards outside the armory.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.dst: 兵器庫の外にいる{p}の衛兵を倒す。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.src: It's the traitor! Capture them, now! There's only one reason they would be near the armoury!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.dst: 裏切り者だ！今すぐ捕らえろ！兵器庫の近くにいる理由は一つしかない！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.speaker: Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.src: Is that all of them? We're out of danger, at least, but they still shut the door, damn it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.dst: これで全部か？ひとまず危険は去ったが、扉は閉められちまった、くそっ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.src: Gah, all that for nothing! You're not too banged up, are you?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.dst: ちっ、全部無駄骨だ！お前、そんなにやられてないよな？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.src: Well, I said there's another way, but it's not a guarantee. Hurry, follow me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.dst: 別の道があると言ったが、確実じゃない。急げ、ついて来い。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.src: Urgh, damn it. They almost never bother to close this door, and now of all times...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.dst: くそっ、ちくしょう。この扉はほとんど閉めないのに、よりによって今…
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.src: There's nothing for it. They'll be sending reinforcements soon, we need a way through here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.dst: 仕方ない。すぐに援軍が来る。ここを通る方法を見つけないと。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.src: Those black bricks look breakable...but that won't solve the door, will it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.dst: あの黒レンガは壊せそうだ…だが扉の方はどうにもならないよな？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.src: Find a way to break through the black bricks outside the wooden door.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.dst: 木の扉の外にある黒レンガを壊す方法を見つける。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.dst: ドワーフの兵器庫を破壊する。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.src: Alright, let's destroy these machines! You see the two cannons?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.dst: よし、この機械をぶっ壊すぞ！大砲が二門見えるか？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.src: If you use rocks as ammo, you'll destroy the machine it's aiming at, but if you use tnt, it'll selfdestruct. Good luck
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.dst: 岩を弾にすれば狙った機械を壊せる。だが TNT を使うと自爆する。頑張れ
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.src: Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city, the {p} Power Core.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.dst: Axelus について{p}の奥へ進み、都市の動力源である{p} Power Core を破壊する。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.src: Nice work! That will slow them down. We're not done yet, we need to pay the king a visit. Let's head further into {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.dst: よくやった！これで奴らも手間取る。まだ終わりじゃない、王に会いに行くぞ。{p}の奥へ進もう。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.src: Hurry! Through here, to the power core!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.dst: 急げ！ここを抜けて動力核へ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.src: This is a geothermal power core. If we can disrupt it, it should slow them down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.dst: これは地熱の動力核だ。こいつを乱せば奴らを足止めできるはずだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.src: The hypocrites used Dogun magic to make this... It's lucky, honestly. I know how to work it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.dst: 偽善者どもは Dogun の魔法でこれを作った…正直、運がいい。俺は動かし方を知ってる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.src: ...hell, they already rallied?! That's the army!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.dst: …なんだと、もう集結したのか？！軍隊だ！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.src: That sounds like an entire battalion!! How did they know I was going after this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.dst: 大隊まるごとって音だ！！俺がこれを狙ってると、なぜ奴らが知ってた？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.src: Dogun magic is slow! Keep me defended, this'll take awhile!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.dst: Dogun の魔法は遅い！俺を守ってくれ、時間がかかる！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.src: Grr, this is harder than I thought!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.dst: くっ、思ったより手強い！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.src: Ah! Don't let them get too close!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.src: I hate that you're having to fight my people, but I wouldn't be asking for help if it weren't needed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.dst: 俺の同胞と戦わせるのは嫌だが、必要がなきゃ助けなんて頼まない。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.src: Hm...the slums should be behind this wall here. We'll lose them there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.dst: うーん…この壁の向こうがスラムのはずだ。そこで撒ける。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.src: The power's down, but...that cannon should do to get us through. You know how to operate it, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.dst: 電力は落ちた。だが…あの大砲で抜けられるはずだ。使い方はわかるよな？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.src: Dwarvern society isn't as great as they make it out to be. The poorest are hidden away.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.dst: ドワーフの社会は奴らが言うほど立派じゃない。最も貧しい者は隠されてるんだ。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.src: The coalition has helped these people through some hard times, we can trust them.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.dst: 連合はここの人たちの苦しい時期を支えてきた。信用できる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.src: There's a reason I brought us here. The sewer system is connected to the royal palace. All the way to the kings bathroom.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.dst: ここに来たのには理由がある。下水道は王宮に繋がってるんだ。王の浴室までずっとな。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.src: We need to find a way to ignite this explosive. Can you take a look around?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.dst: この爆薬に火をつける方法を探さないと。周りを見てくれるか？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.src: Find a way to enter the sewer system.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.dst: 下水道に入る方法を見つける。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.src: If we can convince the king that it’s not worth the fight, he may back down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.dst: この戦いに価値はないと王を説得できれば、手を引くかもしれない。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.src: I'm a little ashamed to admit I know my way round the sewers by now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.dst: 恥ずかしい話だが、もう下水道の道には慣れっこでね。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.src: You have to understand.. The people truly think the Doguns are evil incarnate. But the king knows better.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.dst: わかってくれ…民は本気で Dogun を悪の化身だと思ってる。だが王は真実を知ってる。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.src: Enter the Royal Palace through the sewer pipe and find the king.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.dst: 下水管から王宮に入り、王を探す。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.src: Don't let the guards catch you. Stay out of sight, got it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.dst: 衛兵に捕まるなよ。見つからないようにな、いいか？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.src: Sneak past the guards and talk to the Dwarven King.
