Echoes of Change#655.dst: ならば加速させようか？祝福を悪用する裏切り者はもういない…貴様の計算はここで終わりだ！！
Echoes of Change#655.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#657.src: I... I think I'm gonna be sick...
Echoes of Change#657.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#658.src: He's... he's dead. Again. We beat him... again.
Echoes of Change#658.dst: 彼…死んだ。また。私たちがまた…倒した。
Echoes of Change#658.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#659.src: Again?! So he was being literal about you killing him before?
Echoes of Change#659.dst: また？！じゃあ前にお前が殺したって、文字通りの意味だったのか？
Echoes of Change#659.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#660.src: ... Okay. Okay, so... probably not down for good. Great! That's just... great.
Echoes of Change#660.dst: …そっか。そっか、つまり…たぶん完全には倒せてない。最高だ！まったく…最高だよ。
Echoes of Change#660.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#662.src: I... I don't, um, have enough mana left to fight, anymore... s-so we should leave, before-
Echoes of Change#662.dst: わ…私、えっと、もう戦えるだけのマナが残ってない…だ、だから逃げなきゃ、その前に――
Echoes of Change#662.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#663.src: Uh... y- yeah, we should... get moving.
Echoes of Change#663.dst: あ…う、うん、そうだな…移動しよう。
Echoes of Change#663.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#664.dst: …ぐうううおおお！！我々の…数列は…終わらない…貴様が終わるまでは！！
Echoes of Change#664.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#665.src: H- how...? It, it took him way longer, last time...
Echoes of Change#665.dst: ど、どうして…？ま、前はもっとずっと時間がかかったのに…
Echoes of Change#665.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#666.src: Nngh... You...miscalculated! I told you! You know how good I am at crunching the numbers! I prepared...hhhff...for this possibility!
Echoes of Change#666.dst: ぐっ…貴様は…計算を誤った！言っただろう！私がどれほど計算に長けているか！私は…はあ…この可能性に備えていた！
Echoes of Change#666.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#667.src: It was a calculated risk. Overloading the old Nasin charm... That could've broken it. But instead...my expected solution is here!
Echoes of Change#667.dst: 計算済みのリスクだった。古い Nasin 家の護符を過負荷にする…壊れていたかもしれない。だが結果は…期待通りの解だ！
Echoes of Change#667.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#668.src: A near-instant revival! And I heard your collaborator- All out of power now. I nearly had you in round one, even. Fight all you want- it'll sum to nothing, murderer!
Echoes of Change#668.dst: ほぼ瞬時の復活！それに聞こえたぞ、貴様の協力者――もう力が尽きたとな。一回戦で仕留めかけたほどだ。好きなだけ戦え――合計はゼロだ、人殺しめ！
Echoes of Change#668.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#670.src: ...Soosu. Thank you for taking me seriously. I didn't want you involved for the danger, but with both of us... We'll solve this problem in no time. Follow my le-
Echoes of Change#670.dst: …Soosu。本気にしてくれて感謝する。危険だから巻き込みたくなかったが、我々二人なら…この問題はすぐに解ける。私に続け――
Echoes of Change#670.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#671.src: GAAAH!! S-SOOSU?! You... What was...?! Nnh...
Echoes of Change#671.dst: ぐああ！！S、Soosu？！貴様…今のは…？！ぐっ…
Echoes of Change#671.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#672.src: Soosu!! Th-These are the insurgents! The murderers!! You can't be- What did they- WHAT ARE YOU HOLDING OVER HER?! Soosu, I swear, you can get out of-
Echoes of Change#672.dst: Soosu！！こ、こいつらは反乱分子だ！人殺しだ！！まさか――奴らが何を――彼女に何をネタに脅している？！Soosu、誓って、抜け出せる――
Echoes of Change#672.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#673.src: Yeah, yeah... I know. But I think I'm sick and tired of trying.
Echoes of Change#673.dst: はいはい…分かってる。でも、もう頑張るのにうんざりなの。
Echoes of Change#673.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#674.src: ...Soosu...you can't- I know you can be better, you can- I'll-
Echoes of Change#674.dst: …Soosu…だめだ――君はもっと良くなれる、君なら――私が――
Echoes of Change#674.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#675.src: It'll all be over soon, Z. Please... don't make me kill you again.
Echoes of Change#675.dst: すぐ全部終わるから、Z。お願い…またあなたを殺させないで。
Echoes of Change#675.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#677.src: Why- why are you helping us?
Echoes of Change#677.dst: なん――なんで俺たちを助けるんだ？
Echoes of Change#677.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#678.src: Just... go, Yus. You're wasting time.
Echoes of Change#678.dst: いいから…行って、Yus。時間の無駄よ。
Echoes of Change#678.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#679.src: But... I was the one who stole your project. Why would you...
Echoes of Change#679.dst: でも…君の計画を盗んだのは俺だ。なんで君が…
Echoes of Change#679.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#680.src: Yes, Yus, I know! What does it matter why I'm helping you? Just... just take it and go. Before they realize you're here.
Echoes of Change#680.dst: そうよ、Yus、知ってる！なんで助けるかなんてどうでもいいでしょ？いいから…それ持って行って。気付かれる前に。
Echoes of Change#680.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#682.src: Ugh, why are you so-! Fine! You - when I look at you, it's like I'm looking at myself, before... before I became this.
Echoes of Change#682.dst: もう、なんでそんなに――！分かったわよ！あなたを見てると、昔の自分を見てるみたいなの…こうなる…前の。
Echoes of Change#682.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#683.src: Now, go! Run! Flee! Just, leave!
Echoes of Change#683.dst: さあ、行って！走って！逃げて！早く！
Echoes of Change#683.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#684.src: If... If I leave you here. You, you-
Echoes of Change#684.dst: もし…君を置いてったら。君は――
Echoes of Change#684.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#685.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu, I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#685.dst: 私は大丈夫よ、Yusanu。戦うのに疲れた。務めにも疲れた。こんな人生にうんざりなの。
Echoes of Change#685.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#686.dst: もうすぐ兵士が増える。
Echoes of Change#686.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#687.src: We... we need to go, Yusanu.
Echoes of Change#687.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#689.src: Well then, Syndra the Lioness. Nothing to say in response? Has a cat got your tongue?
Echoes of Change#689.dst: さて、雌獅子 Syndra。何も言い返さないの？借りてきた猫のようね。
Echoes of Change#689.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#690.src: I have no words for you.
Echoes of Change#690.dst: あなたに言うことは何もない。
Echoes of Change#690.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#691.src: No, I suppose you were always more fond of the language of violence...
Echoes of Change#691.dst: そうね、あなたは昔から暴力という言語の方が好きだったものね…
Echoes of Change#691.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#692.src: You'll notice the area has been cleared. You understand what this means for you, yes?
Echoes of Change#692.dst: この辺りが人払いされているのに気付いたでしょう。それがあなたにとって何を意味するか、分かるわね？
Echoes of Change#692.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#693.src: The same as always. I kill you, or I die trying.
Echoes of Change#693.dst: いつもと同じ。あなたを殺すか、殺そうとして死ぬか。
Echoes of Change#693.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#694.src: Yuman... We n- n- need to find an escape route that w- wor- works!
Echoes of Change#694.dst: Yuman…ちゃ、ちゃ、ちゃんと使える脱出路をさ、探さないと！
Echoes of Change#694.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#695.src: Ugh, there are way more guards than we expected! We'll have to find a way to dodge them all...
Echoes of Change#695.dst: くそ、衛兵が思ってたよりずっと多い！全員かわす方法を見つけないと…
Echoes of Change#695.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#697.src: I ca- ca- can't stand this... not h- hel- helping Syndra!
Echoes of Change#697.dst: た、耐えられないよ…Syndra をた、助けられないなんて！
Echoes of Change#697.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#698.src: Hey, man, have faith. She'll find a way out of there! But for now, we've gotta worry 'bout ourselves, 'kay?
Echoes of Change#698.dst: なあ、信じろよ。彼女ならきっと抜け出す！でも今は、自分たちの心配をしなきゃ、な？
Echoes of Change#698.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#699.src: Yeah... th- thanks, Yuman. Let's k- ke- keep moving.
Echoes of Change#699.dst: うん…あ、ありがとう、Yuman。す、進み続けよう。
Echoes of Change#699.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#700.src: Behold, citizens... the face of the insurgent group.
Echoes of Change#700.dst: 市民よ、見なさい…これが反乱集団の顔です。
Echoes of Change#700.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#701.src: The two cursed ones who attacked us have been captured. However, there are still people out there who wish us harm. Please, stay on high alert!
Echoes of Change#701.dst: 我々を襲った二人の呪われし者は捕らえました。しかし、まだ我々に害をなそうとする者がいます。どうか厳重に警戒を！
Echoes of Change#701.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#702.src: If you notice any suspicious behaviour, contact your local military. Together, we will prevail as a nation.
Echoes of Change#702.dst: 不審な行動に気付いたら、最寄りの軍に知らせなさい。共に力を合わせ、国として勝利するのです。
Echoes of Change#702.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#703.src: But do not worry. Even such an aggressive assault from the enemy stood no chance against our might. I will ensure everyone's safety!
Echoes of Change#703.dst: ですが心配はいりません。敵のこれほど激しい攻撃も、我らの力の前には無力でした。皆の安全は私が保証します！
Echoes of Change#703.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#704.src: Now. As punishment for attempting to assassinate me... I will execute Syndra, leader of the cursed terrorists, right here!
Echoes of Change#704.dst: さて。私の暗殺を企てた罰として…呪われしテロリストの首魁 Syndra を、この場で処刑します！
Echoes of Change#704.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#705.src: Her accomplice will be imprisoned and questioned for information on the remaining insurgents.
Echoes of Change#705.dst: その共犯者は投獄し、残る反乱分子の情報を得るため尋問します。
Echoes of Change#705.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#706.dst: 立ちなさい、雌獅子 Syndra。
Echoes of Change#706.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#707.dst: 最期に言い残すことは？
Echoes of Change#707.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#708.src: I don't regret anything I've done. I know Fruma will change for the better. Maybe not today, or tomorrow! But change will come.
Echoes of Change#708.dst: 自分のしたことに悔いはない。Fruma は必ず良くなる。今日でも明日でもないかもしれない！でも変化は必ず来る。
Echoes of Change#708.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#709.src: I regret that it had to come to this, Syndra... I draw no joy from your death. I wonder, whatever happened to that woman who held boundless potential within?
Echoes of Change#709.dst: こうなってしまったのは残念よ、Syndra…あなたの死に喜びなど感じない。無限の可能性を秘めていたあの女性は、一体どうしてしまったのかしら？
Echoes of Change#709.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#711.src: I will find your children, Syndra. This tantrum of yours ends here with you.
Echoes of Change#711.dst: あなたの子どもたちも見つけ出す、Syndra。この癇癪はあなたと共に終わるの。
Echoes of Change#711.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#712.src: Now, as for those Sovereigns of mine...
Echoes of Change#712.dst: さて、私の君主たちはというと…
Echoes of Change#712.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#713.src: I know you, Soosu. Please, tell me what's wrong! This isn't an unsolvable problem! Don't make it so I lose two of my-
Echoes of Change#713.dst: 君のことは分かっている、Soosu。頼む、何があったのか教えてくれ！解けない問題じゃない！私に二人も失わせるな――
Echoes of Change#713.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#714.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I cannot help but notice the obvious lack of captured terrorists, amidst the scene of a battle.
Echoes of Change#714.dst: 君主 Zhiraok。戦いの跡だというのに、捕らえたテロリストが明らかに見当たらないのが気になりますね。
Echoes of Change#714.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#715.src: Your Majesty!! The insurgents, they must have blackmailed Sovereign Soosu, she-
Echoes of Change#715.dst: 陛下！！反乱分子どもが君主 Soosu を脅迫したに違いありません、彼女は――
Echoes of Change#715.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#716.src: Silence. You have failed me twice, now. They have bested you in combat twice, Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#716.dst: 黙りなさい。これで二度目の失態です。戦いで二度も彼らに後れを取ったのですよ、君主。
Echoes of Change#716.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#717.src: I- The cursed have greater cunning than I cal-
Echoes of Change#717.dst: 私――呪われし者のずる賢さは私の計――
Echoes of Change#717.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#718.src: I am disappointed in your performance. You are now expressly forbidden from continuing to chase and track down these... rotten children.
Echoes of Change#718.dst: あなたの働きには失望しました。今後、この…腐った子どもたちを追跡することは明確に禁じます。
Echoes of Change#718.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#719.src: ...I. ... ...I alone take full responsibility for this failure, Your Majesty. Bu-
Echoes of Change#719.dst: …私。……この失敗の全責任は、私一人が負います、陛下。で――
Echoes of Change#719.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#720.src: Focus yourself on maintaining {p} operations in the absence of its Sovereign, would you? You have much experience already, I'm sure.
Echoes of Change#720.dst: 君主不在の間、{p} の運営維持に専念してもらえますか？その経験なら既に十分あるでしょう。
Echoes of Change#720.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#721.dst: ふ…不在――まさか――引き算なさるおつもり――
Echoes of Change#721.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#722.src: Now, stop standing there, and do something! Rally the soldiers, track down the remnants of that terrorist group still hiding!
Echoes of Change#722.dst: さあ、突っ立っていないで動きなさい！兵を集め、まだ潜んでいるテロ集団の残党を追い詰めなさい！
Echoes of Change#722.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#725.src: As for you... do you think your little games will spare you from my wrath? Attacking a fellow Sovereign, allowing these targets to escape...
Echoes of Change#725.dst: そしてあなた…小細工で私の怒りを免れると思っているの？同じ君主を攻撃し、標的を逃がして…
Echoes of Change#725.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#726.src: Bla, bla, whatever. Just get it over with. Kill me already, if I'm so worthless to you.
Echoes of Change#726.dst: はいはい、どうでもいい。さっさと済ませて。私がそんなに無価値なら、さっさと殺せば。
Echoes of Change#726.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#727.src: And allow you a peaceful death? After I gave you everything, and you turned around and betrayed me?!
Echoes of Change#727.dst: 安らかな死を与えろと？すべてを与えてやったのに、裏切ったあなたに？！
Echoes of Change#727.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#728.src: No, Soosu. You deserve no such mercy from me.
Echoes of Change#728.dst: いいえ、Soosu。あなたにそんな慈悲は与えません。
Echoes of Change#728.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#729.src: ...every last factoring person down here is charged with conspiracy. Her Majesty demands their capture, by any and all means.
Echoes of Change#729.dst: …ここにいる奴らは因数一つ残らず共謀罪に問う。陛下はいかなる手段を用いても捕らえよとのご命令だ。
Echoes of Change#729.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#730.src: Get it done. Now. One of them must know what they did to Soo- ... I'll be questioning each of them. Personally.
Echoes of Change#730.dst: やれ。今すぐ。奴らの誰かが Soo――に何をしたか知っているはずだ…全員私が直々に尋問する。
Echoes of Change#730.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#000~1.src: Third Division - Guarding Sovereign Soosu's mansion.
Echoes of Change#000~1.dst: 第三分隊- 君主 Soosu の邸宅の警備。

Echoes of Change#057~1.src: Riiight. Right. Sorry, I got excited. I am right, though - it wouldn't be hard for me to just talk us through this!
Echoes of Change#057~1.dst: そーだな。そうだ。悪い、つい興奮した。でも正しいだろ- 俺なら口先で切り抜けるのも簡単だって！
Echoes of Change#057~1.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#058~1.src: This furnace seems to power the big crane...
Echoes of Change#058~1.dst: この炉が大きなクレーンの動力源らしい…

Echoes of Change#459~1.src: Disgraced, I had my rank and status removed. I was disposed of, sent to the {p}, forbidden from ever leaving.
Echoes of Change#459~1.dst: 私は失脚し、階級も地位も剥奪された。捨てられて {p} に送られ、二度と出ることを禁じられた。
Echoes of Change#459~1.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#683~1.dst: どうして俺たちを助けるんだ？
Echoes of Change#683~1.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#692~1.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu. I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#692~1.dst: 私は大丈夫よ、Yusanu。戦うのに疲れた。義務にも疲れた。こんな人生はもううんざり。
Echoes of Change#692~1.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#693~1.dst: - 一部のピースには特別な条件がある。

Elemental Exercise#000.src: Talk to Captain Ragon in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#000.dst: {p} の兵舎 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] にいる Ragon 隊長と話す

Elemental Exercise#001.src: Ah! You must be one of the new recruits the Admiral told me to look out for! What was it... {u}, yes?
Elemental Exercise#001.dst: おお！提督が言っていた新兵の一人だな！名前は確か…{u}、だったか？
Elemental Exercise#001.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#002.src: You've done well to reach this city as quickly as you have, which must have required a great deal of fighting the undead.
Elemental Exercise#002.dst: これほど早くこの街に着くとは見事だ。道中、アンデッドとずいぶん戦ったのだろう。
Elemental Exercise#002.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#003.src: Now, I've heard from Sergeant Van of your aid in his assault on our overtaken fort- which, good work, very well done...
Elemental Exercise#003.dst: Van 軍曹から、占拠された砦の奪還に君が手を貸したと聞いている。実に見事だった…
Elemental Exercise#003.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#004.src: But the fact still stands that you lack experience. You can certainly fight, yes, but can you fight well?
Elemental Exercise#004.dst: だが、経験不足なのは事実だ。戦えはする。だが、上手く戦えるかな？
Elemental Exercise#004.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#005.src: Lucky for you, that's where I come in. You're just in time for today's training session! Come here, follow me.
Elemental Exercise#005.dst: 運がいいな、そこで私の出番だ。今日の訓練にちょうど間に合った！ついて来たまえ。
Elemental Exercise#005.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#006.src: Follow Captain Ragon to the Training Room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#006.dst: Ragon 隊長について [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の訓練室へ行く

Elemental Exercise#007.src: ...Oh! {u}, hello. Are you here for training as well?
Elemental Exercise#007.dst: …あっ！{u}、こんにちは。君も訓練に来たの？
Elemental Exercise#007.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#008.src: Ahem. Now, in front of you, you'll see five special training dummies. Each one finely imbued with elemental magic. You are aware of the elements, yes? There's five of them in total.
Elemental Exercise#008.dst: ゴホン。さて、目の前に特製の訓練用人形が五体ある。それぞれ属性魔法が込められている。属性は知っているな？全部で五つだ。
Elemental Exercise#008.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#009.src: I am! The elements are... Fire, Air, Earth, Thunder, and... Water?
Elemental Exercise#009.dst: 知ってます！属性は…火、風、土、雷、それと…水？
Elemental Exercise#009.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#010.src: That's right. And generally speaking, they're strong against each other in that order- Fire beats Air, Air beats Earth, and so on.
Elemental Exercise#010.dst: その通り。そして大抵はその順に有利を取る。火は風に、風は土に強い、という具合だ。
Elemental Exercise#010.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#011.src: Elemental weaknesses may vary based on the enemy, but that order holds true in most cases.
Elemental Exercise#011.dst: 弱点属性は敵によって異なるが、ほとんどの場合この順番が当てはまる。
Elemental Exercise#011.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#012.src: Enemies will take more damage from elements they're weak to, and take less damage from elements they resist. This change to your damage is always a flat value, and it varies from enemy to enemy.
Elemental Exercise#012.dst: 敵は弱点属性の攻撃でより多くダメージを受け、耐性のある属性ではダメージが減る。この増減は常に固定値で、敵ごとに違う。
Elemental Exercise#012.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#013.src: Now. For training purposes, you'll be given an elemental weapon to try out on these training dummies. Take note of how each elemental defense and weakness affects your damage dealt. Speak to me once you feel you understand the concept.
Elemental Exercise#013.dst: さて。訓練として属性武器を渡すから、人形で試してみたまえ。各属性の防御と弱点が与ダメージにどう影響するか注目するように。理解できたら私に声をかけてくれ。
Elemental Exercise#013.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#014.src: Test out the elemental training weapons on the dummies, then speak to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#014.dst: 人形で属性訓練用の武器を試し、[{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の Ragon 隊長と話す

Elemental Exercise#015.src: Well? Have you noted the effect of elemental defenses and weaknesses on your damage?
Elemental Exercise#015.dst: どうだ？属性の防御と弱点がダメージにどう影響するか分かったかね？
Elemental Exercise#015.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#016.src: Excellent. I'll take those training weapons back from the two of you. Any questions?
Elemental Exercise#016.dst: 素晴らしい。訓練用の武器は二人から回収しよう。何か質問は？
Elemental Exercise#016.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#017.src: I do have one. If our enemies are susceptible to elements in this way, would that also apply to us?
Elemental Exercise#017.dst: 一つあります。敵がそうやって属性の影響を受けるなら、僕たちにも当てはまるんですか？
Elemental Exercise#017.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#018.src: Ah, yes. A fine observation. Indeed, you are also bound by the rules of the elements. Elemental defenses and weaknesses from your equipment will affect you in the very same way.
Elemental Exercise#018.dst: ああ、そうだ。いいところに気付いた。君たちも属性の法則に縛られている。装備の属性防御や弱点も、まったく同じように君たちに影響する。
Elemental Exercise#018.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#019.src: One final note before we move on from the elements- your weapon may not always be as effective against an enemy as you would like.
Elemental Exercise#019.dst: 属性の話を終える前に最後に一つ。武器が思うほど敵に効かないこともある。
Elemental Exercise#019.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#020.src: However, you have another tool at your disposal in the form of your spells! Different spells will deal different elemental damage, even if your weapon does use that element by default.
Elemental Exercise#020.dst: だが、君たちにはもう一つの手段、呪文がある！呪文ごとに与える属性ダメージは異なる。武器の基本属性と違っていてもだ。
Elemental Exercise#020.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#021.src: ...Oh! So my Bash spell will still deal Earth damage even if my weapon only uses Water, right?
Elemental Exercise#021.dst: …あっ！じゃあ武器が水属性だけでも、バッシュは土属性ダメージになるんですね？
Elemental Exercise#021.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#022.src: Correct! Now, let's see... We have the two of you here. Why don't we have a friendly duel? A chance to test your battle skills in a save environment.
Elemental Exercise#022.dst: 正解！さて…ちょうど二人いるな。親善試合をしてはどうだ？安全な環境で戦いの腕を試す好機だ。
Elemental Exercise#022.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#023.src: That sounds good to me! {u}, we've been traveling together for some time now... I can't say I haven't been curious to see how you fight. Let's see who comes out on top, shall we?
Elemental Exercise#023.dst: いいですね！{u}、一緒に旅してしばらく経つし…君の戦い方、ずっと気になってたんだ。どっちが勝つか、やってみようよ。
Elemental Exercise#023.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#025.src: Alright. I'll be waiting here when you're ready!
Elemental Exercise#025.dst: わかった。準備ができたら、ここで待ってるよ！
Elemental Exercise#025.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#026.src: Go on, then. Just speak to me when you're ready to move on.
Elemental Exercise#026.dst: では行きたまえ。先へ進む準備ができたら声をかけてくれ。
Elemental Exercise#026.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#027.src: Return to Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for a duel.
Elemental Exercise#027.dst: [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の Tasim の所へ戻り、決闘する

Elemental Exercise#028.src: There you are! Are you ready for our duel?
Elemental Exercise#028.dst: 来たね！決闘の準備はいい？
Elemental Exercise#028.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#029.src: Alright! Let's see which of us is the better fighter!
Elemental Exercise#029.dst: よし！どっちが強いか勝負だ！
Elemental Exercise#029.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#031.src: Fight Tasim in a friendly duel.
Elemental Exercise#031.dst: Tasim と親善試合をする

Elemental Exercise#033.src: Phew! That was a good fight. You did well, {u}. We'll have to do this again- and maybe we can get Aledar to join!
Elemental Exercise#033.dst: ふう！いい勝負だった。やるね、{u}。またやろう。今度は Aledar も誘えるかも！
Elemental Exercise#033.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#034.src: Woo! You fought well, {u}, but it looks like I'm still better! Wait until Aledar hears about this...
Elemental Exercise#034.dst: やった！{u} も強かったけど、まだ僕の方が上みたいだね！Aledar が聞いたら…
Elemental Exercise#034.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#035.src: Yes, yes, fine work, the two of you. Now-
Elemental Exercise#035.dst: うむ、うむ、二人とも見事だった。では――
Elemental Exercise#035.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#036.src: Captain! Captain Ragon! There's- there's corrupted forces! Advancing from {p}!
Elemental Exercise#036.dst: 隊長！Ragon 隊長！ふ、腐敗した軍勢が！{p} から進軍してきます！
Elemental Exercise#036.speaker: Scout Evelyn

Elemental Exercise#037.src: Hm. And the Admiral is away... Very well. Mobilize the troops! We meet the forces at the north gate!
Elemental Exercise#037.dst: む。提督は不在か…よかろう。部隊を動員せよ！北門で迎え撃つ！
Elemental Exercise#037.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#039.src: Captain- we're capable fighters too. Let us come along and help fight off these undead!
Elemental Exercise#039.dst: 隊長、僕たちも戦えます。一緒に行って、アンデッドの撃退を手伝わせてください！
Elemental Exercise#039.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#040.src: Hm... As I see it, this is a fine opportunity for you to gain some firsthand experience! Very well. Prepare yourselves, and come to {p}' north gate when you're ready.
Elemental Exercise#040.dst: ふむ…これは君たちが実戦経験を積む良い機会だな！よかろう。準備を整え、終わったら {p} の北門へ来たまえ。
Elemental Exercise#040.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#041.src: This is exciting! But... I'm a little bit nervous, still.
Elemental Exercise#041.dst: わくわくするな！でも…やっぱりちょっと緊張する。
Elemental Exercise#041.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#042.src: ... We'll be alright. Come on, let's go follow the captain.
Elemental Exercise#042.dst: …大丈夫、きっと。さあ、隊長について行こう。
Elemental Exercise#042.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#043.src: Follow Captain Ragon to {p}' north gate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to face the undead forces.
Elemental Exercise#043.dst: Ragon 隊長について [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の {p} 北門へ行き、アンデッドの軍勢を迎え撃つ

Elemental Exercise#044.src: There you are! Ready for battle?
Elemental Exercise#044.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#045.src: I'm prepared as well. These corrupted won't stand a chance against us!
Elemental Exercise#045.dst: 僕も準備万端です。腐敗した連中なんて僕たちの敵じゃない！
Elemental Exercise#045.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#046.src: Yes, yes, very good. Now, it shouldn't be long until-
Elemental Exercise#046.dst: うむ、よろしい。さて、そろそろ――
Elemental Exercise#046.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#048.src: Hm... Take note of the leader. I expect if we can defeat it, the rest of the forces will disperse.
Elemental Exercise#048.dst: ふむ…あの指揮官に注目しろ。奴を倒せば、残りの軍勢は散り散りになるはずだ。
Elemental Exercise#048.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#049.src: Stronger foes such as this one will cast spells one after the other, in a specific order. These spell combos can be dangerous, so make sure to take note of them.
Elemental Exercise#049.dst: こうした強敵は、決まった順番で次々と呪文を放ってくる。この連続呪文は危険だから、よく注意するように。
Elemental Exercise#049.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#050.src: We'll be fighting all around you, so shout if you're in need of aid. Alright, soldiers, let's defend our city!
Elemental Exercise#050.dst: 我々は周囲で戦う。援護が必要なら叫べ。よし兵士諸君、街を守り抜くぞ！
Elemental Exercise#050.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#052.src: I understand. We have time until the corrupted forces arrive, so go prepare. Don't take too long, though.
Elemental Exercise#052.dst: 分かった。腐敗した軍勢が来るまで時間はある、準備してこい。ただし急げよ。
Elemental Exercise#052.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#053.src: Defeat the Corrupted Captain and the force threatening {p}.
Elemental Exercise#053.dst: 腐敗した隊長と、{p} を脅かす軍勢を倒す

Elemental Exercise#054.src: Return to the {p} Barracks and talk to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#054.dst: {p} の兵舎に戻り、[{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の Ragon 隊長と話す

Elemental Exercise#055.src: Ah, there you two are. Come here.
Elemental Exercise#055.dst: おお、二人とも来たか。こっちだ。
Elemental Exercise#055.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#056.dst: あっ、提督！もうお戻りですか？
Elemental Exercise#056.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#057.src: Yes, my absence was never meant to take long. I was paying a visit to the desert city of {p}, for a meeting with an Admiral Amerigo...
Elemental Exercise#057.dst: ああ、もともと長く空けるつもりはなかった。砂漠の街 {p} へ行き、Amerigo 提督と会談していたのだ…
Elemental Exercise#057.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#058.src: But I digress. I've been told the two of you were essential in the defense of our city! Excellent work.
Elemental Exercise#058.dst: だが、話がそれたな。二人は街の防衛で大いに活躍したと聞いた！見事だ。
Elemental Exercise#058.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#059.src: Our preparations for the assault on {p}' spider den are nearing completion. I'd like the two of you to join that mission.
Elemental Exercise#059.dst: {p} の蜘蛛の巣窟を攻める準備も整いつつある。二人にもその作戦に加わってほしい。
Elemental Exercise#059.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#060.src: Sir- are you certain? I mean, we'd be happy to join, but surely there are many others more worthy of such a task.
Elemental Exercise#060.dst: 提督、本当によろしいのですか？喜んで参加しますが、もっとふさわしい者が大勢いるはずです。
Elemental Exercise#060.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#061.src: Nonsense! Captain Ragon has assessed your skills, and has deemed them sufficient. And I trust the Captain's judgement.
Elemental Exercise#061.dst: 何を言う！Ragon 隊長が君たちの腕を見極め、十分だと判断したのだ。私は隊長の判断を信じている。
Elemental Exercise#061.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#062.src: Now, I must be off. I'll see the two of you when it's time for the mission.
Elemental Exercise#062.dst: さて、私はもう行かねば。作戦の時にまた会おう。
Elemental Exercise#062.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#063.src: A big mission to take out the spiders, huh... You know, even though I'm a little worried, I think I'm excited.
Elemental Exercise#063.dst: 蜘蛛退治の大作戦か…ちょっと不安だけど、なんだかわくわくしてるよ。
Elemental Exercise#063.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#064.src: Ahem. Before the two of you return on your business, I have something for the two of you. Payment for your work today, and a special piece of equipment. Make good use of it.
Elemental Exercise#064.dst: ゴホン。二人が自分の務めに戻る前に、渡す物がある。今日の働きへの報酬と、特別な装備だ。有効に使いたまえ。
Elemental Exercise#064.speaker: Captain Ragon

Ensemble of Hope#000.src: Meet up with your friends in room number {~} in hotel {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#003.src: {u}'s here? Good, that means we can-
Ensemble of Hope#003.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#007.src: Ugh. ZEPH! Get out of there already!
Ensemble of Hope#007.dst: はあ。ZEPH！さっさと出てこい！
Ensemble of Hope#007.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#008.src: C...coming! Jeez, Rex, g...give a man his p- pr- privacy...
Ensemble of Hope#008.dst: い、今行く！もう、Rex、プ、プラ、プライバシーくらい…
Ensemble of Hope#008.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#010.src: Rex. I'm f...fine. St- stop asking me that.
Ensemble of Hope#010.dst: Rex。だ、大丈夫だって。そ、それ聞くのやめて。
Ensemble of Hope#010.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#011.src: Okay! Okay. Gods forbid I worry about you for even a second...
Ensemble of Hope#011.dst: わかった！わかったよ。一瞬心配するのもダメなのか…
Ensemble of Hope#011.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#012.src: Rex. You had something to tell us.
Ensemble of Hope#012.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#013.src: Right, okay, I'll get to it. These past few days, I have been plotting. I have something... serviceable, I think.
Ensemble of Hope#013.dst: ああ、そうだった。この数日、ずっと策を練ってた。使えそうな…案がある、と思う。
Ensemble of Hope#013.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#014.src: So, to start with, let's lay out our goal - the destruction of the Crown, the Queen and her Sovereigns included.
Ensemble of Hope#014.dst: まず目標をはっきりさせよう―王家の打倒だ。女王と君主たちも含めて。
Ensemble of Hope#014.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#015.src: We won't be able to do it ourselves - we're only four people. And we definitely won't be able to do it if their eyes are on us the whole time!
Ensemble of Hope#015.dst: 自分たちだけじゃ無理だ―たった四人だからな。ずっと監視されてたら、なおさら無理だ！
Ensemble of Hope#015.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#016.src: Sui and {u}, you two worked with the Canopy while you were in the {p}. Do you think they have the people and resources to help us?
Ensemble of Hope#016.dst: Sui と {u}、{p} にいた時に樹冠と組んでたよな。助けになる人手と物資はあると思うか？
Ensemble of Hope#016.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#017.src: They do. They've... been fighting openly against the crown for years and haven't been caught. So... they know what they're doing.
Ensemble of Hope#017.dst: あるよ。何年も…王家と公然と戦ってて、捕まってない。だから…やり方はわかってる。
Ensemble of Hope#017.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#018.src: Good, we'll want to get in contact then. And Yusanu is with them, anyway... it'll be good to see him again.
Ensemble of Hope#018.dst: よし、じゃあ連絡を取ろう。それに Yusanu もあっちにいる…また会えるのは嬉しいな。
Ensemble of Hope#018.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#020.src: But, uh, moving on. Zeph, you went out earlier and gathered some information on the {p}, right?
Ensemble of Hope#020.dst: で、えっと、次だ。Zeph、さっき出かけて {p} の情報を集めてきたんだよな？
Ensemble of Hope#020.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#021.src: Y- yeah! P...people around here seem v- v- very excited for th...the festival. The C- Cr- Crown is gonna be b...busy with preparations for a wh...while.
Ensemble of Hope#021.dst: う、うん！こ、この辺の人は祭りにす、す、すごく浮かれてる。お、王、王家はしばらくじゅ、準備で忙しいはず。
Ensemble of Hope#021.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#022.src: B- but, uh, Rex, y...you wanted me to- to ch...check out the Dam E- Elevator, right?
Ensemble of Hope#022.dst: で、でも、Rex、ダ、ダムのエ、エレベーターを調、調べてほしいって言ってたよね？
Ensemble of Hope#022.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#023.src: I did, yep. What's the guards situation like? Heavily guarded, lightly guarded... somewhere in between?
Ensemble of Hope#023.dst: ああ、言った。警備はどうだった？厳重か、手薄か…その中間か？
Ensemble of Hope#023.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#024.src: S...somewhere in be- between, I think. Cl...closer to lightly guarded. I don't th- think they're ex- exp- expecting an... a- an attack.
Ensemble of Hope#024.dst: ちゅ、中間、かな。手薄寄り。こ、攻撃なんて、よ、よ、予想してないと思う。
Ensemble of Hope#024.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#025.src: Perfect. Perfect, perfect, perfect... so! How do we all feel about committing some light terrorism today?
Ensemble of Hope#025.dst: 完璧。完璧、完璧、完璧…よし！今日はみんなで軽くテロでもやるってのはどうだ？
Ensemble of Hope#025.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#026.src: Okay, curb the enthusiasm a little. Let me explain why, first.
Ensemble of Hope#026.dst: よし、盛り上がるのはほどほどに。まず理由を説明させてくれ。
Ensemble of Hope#026.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#027.src: Ev- ever the optimist... R- Rex, why do you w...want to take the e- el-... the elevator?
Ensemble of Hope#027.dst: あ、相変わらず前向きだね…R、Rex、なんでエ、エレ…エレベーターを奪いたいの？
Ensemble of Hope#027.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#028.src: Like we haven't done worse already... um, why the elevator, Rex?
Ensemble of Hope#028.dst: もっとひどいことならもうやってるし…で、なんでエレベーターなの、Rex？
Ensemble of Hope#028.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#029.src: We need to get the Crown's eyes off of us. They won't expect us to try to return to the {p} - why would we? The enemy is right here.
Ensemble of Hope#029.dst: 王家の目をこっちから逸らしたい。私たちが {p} に戻るなんて思わない―戻る理由がない。敵はここにいるんだから。
Ensemble of Hope#029.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#030.src: So what happens when we do? They'll start thinking. Why are we doing it? What do we have to gain?
Ensemble of Hope#030.dst: じゃあ、実際に戻ったら？奴らは考え始める。なぜそんなことを？何の得がある？
Ensemble of Hope#030.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#031.src: They'll start to pay attention to that elevator. And, if we're lucky, less attention on what we're actually doing.
Ensemble of Hope#031.dst: そうすればエレベーターに注目が集まる。運がよければ、本当の狙いからは目が逸れる。
Ensemble of Hope#031.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#032.src: ...and, well, maybe if we're fast, we could bring some friends up from Auburn to us. We could use all the help we can get.
Ensemble of Hope#032.dst: …それに、急げば Auburn から仲間を何人か連れてこられるかもしれない。助けは多いほどいい。
Ensemble of Hope#032.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#033.src: Th...that- that sounds nice... it- it's been s...so long already...
Ensemble of Hope#033.dst: そ、それはいいね…も、もうずいぶん経ったし…
Ensemble of Hope#033.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#034.dst: …うん。いいよ。懐かしい顔が増える。
Ensemble of Hope#034.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#035.src: Sui... do you think you and Zeph could handle getting the rest of the Leaves up here? Zeph'll need someone who knows how to find the Canopy, and I need {u} with me.
Ensemble of Hope#035.dst: Sui…Zeph と二人で、風の葉の残りをここまで連れてこられるか？樹冠の見つけ方を知ってる人が Zeph には必要だし、{u} には私と来てほしい。
Ensemble of Hope#035.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#038.src: Well, we'll all be going to take control of the elevator anyway. We can... talk more there.
Ensemble of Hope#038.dst: まあ、エレベーターを奪うのはどうせ全員でだ。話の続きは…向こうでしよう。
Ensemble of Hope#038.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#039.src: {u}, after we've don that, I'll need you to take me to the Canopy. I want to familiarize myself with their leadership, and start working on an actual plan.
Ensemble of Hope#039.dst: {u}、それが済んだら樹冠まで案内してほしい。向こうの指導者たちと顔を合わせて、ちゃんとした計画を立て始めたいんだ。
Ensemble of Hope#039.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#040.src: Okay! I think that's everything. Let's all get ready, then head to that elevator on the southern side of the dam!
Ensemble of Hope#040.dst: よし！これで全部だと思う。準備して、ダムの南側のエレベーターへ向かおう！
Ensemble of Hope#040.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#043.src: Hi, {u}. Ready to fight more of the crown's soldiers?
Ensemble of Hope#043.dst: やあ、{u}。また王家の兵士と戦う準備はいい？
Ensemble of Hope#043.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#047.src: We... have Rex and Zeph back. We're going to reunite with the people we left behind in Auburn. We're going to meet back with the Canopy.
Ensemble of Hope#047.dst: Rex と Zeph が…戻ってきた。Auburn に残してきた人たちとも再会する。樹冠ともまた合流する。
Ensemble of Hope#047.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#049.src: Really? And why would that be?!
Ensemble of Hope#049.dst: そう？なんでそう思うの？！
Ensemble of Hope#049.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#050.src: It's not like- n-not like someone's MISSING! OR ANYTHING!!
Ensemble of Hope#050.dst: 別に―べ、別に誰かが「いない」とか！そういうんじゃないし！！
Ensemble of Hope#050.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#051.src: So- s-so maybe I'm not. But it doesn't matter. We have things we need to get done, {u}! I don't have time to- to feel not fine!!
Ensemble of Hope#051.dst: だ、だから平気じゃないのかも。でも関係ない。やることがあるの、{u}！平気じゃないとか―言ってる暇ないの！！
Ensemble of Hope#051.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#053.src: Don't push this... please? Just... let's follow Rex's plan.
Ensemble of Hope#053.dst: これ以上聞かないで…お願い。とにかく…Rex の計画に従おう。
Ensemble of Hope#053.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#054.src: It's... fine. Solid plan, I guess.
Ensemble of Hope#054.dst: …悪くない。しっかりした計画だと思う。
Ensemble of Hope#054.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#055.src: I couldn't think of anything better at least, so...
Ensemble of Hope#055.dst: 少なくとも私にはもっといい案は浮かばなかったし…
Ensemble of Hope#055.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#056.src: And, um, I'm not the- the tactician, anyway. I'm... glad I don't have to worry about that anymore.
Ensemble of Hope#056.dst: それに、えっと、私は―策士じゃないし。もうそういうのを考えなくていいのは…ほっとしてる。
Ensemble of Hope#056.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#059.src: I... don't really want to face Yusanu again. After... um. You know.
Ensemble of Hope#059.dst: Yusanu とは…あまり顔を合わせたくない。あの…えっと。わかるでしょ。
Ensemble of Hope#059.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#060.src: But... I have to do it eventually. So.
Ensemble of Hope#060.dst: でも…いつかは向き合わなきゃ。だから。
Ensemble of Hope#060.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#061.src: Yeah. Let's... get a move on.
Ensemble of Hope#061.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#062.src: ...ready for phase one of the plan, {u}? Let's pack up quickly and head out.
Ensemble of Hope#062.dst: …計画の第一段階、準備はいいか、{u}？さっさと荷物をまとめて出発しよう。
Ensemble of Hope#062.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#064.src: You know... still awful. But, uh... better, I guess.
Ensemble of Hope#064.dst: まあ…まだひどいもんだ。でも、その…少しはマシかな。
Ensemble of Hope#064.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#065.src: I haven't left the hotel these past few days... but even just getting real food has felt like... like a gourmet meal!
Ensemble of Hope#065.dst: この数日ホテルから出てないけど…まともな食事ってだけで…ごちそうみたいだった！
Ensemble of Hope#065.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#066.src: It's... hm. I've tried to not really... think about it too much. I'll have time for that when we're not still in danger.
Ensemble of Hope#066.dst: それは…うーん。あまり…考えないようにしてる。危険を抜けてから考える時間はあるさ。
Ensemble of Hope#066.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#067.src: But, Zeph... he's been isolating himself. Him and Sui both!
Ensemble of Hope#067.dst: でも Zeph は…自分を孤立させてる。あいつも Sui もだ！
Ensemble of Hope#067.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#068.src: Sigh... it's hard. Whenever I talk to him, he tries to put on his regular happy persona, but...
Ensemble of Hope#068.dst: はあ…難しいよ。話しかけるたびに、いつもの明るい自分を演じようとするけど…
Ensemble of Hope#068.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#069.src: I don't know. Obviously things have changed - I don't think you get out of - ha, what was it, weeks? - of imprisonment unaffected.
Ensemble of Hope#069.dst: わからない。何かが変わったのは確かだ―はは、何週間だっけ？―投獄されて無傷で出てこられるわけがない。
Ensemble of Hope#069.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#070.src: ...he's resilient. Sui too. We'll be able to work past this. It's just... going to take time.
Ensemble of Hope#070.dst: …あいつは強い。Sui もだ。乗り越えられるさ。ただ…時間がかかる。
Ensemble of Hope#070.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#071.src: Still workshopping it! I have a couple of different ideas, but...
Ensemble of Hope#071.dst: まだ練ってる最中だ！案はいくつかあるけど…
Ensemble of Hope#071.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#072.src: Well, it's hard to know which will work without knowing what the Canopy has. Too many different things to consider.
Ensemble of Hope#072.dst: 樹冠に何があるかわからないと、どれが通用するか判断しにくい。考えることが多すぎる。
Ensemble of Hope#072.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#073.src: When we join up with them, I'm hoping I can fill in the gaps. And... I guess, get their opinions on it, too.
Ensemble of Hope#073.dst: 合流したら穴を埋められるといいんだけど。それと…向こうの意見も聞きたい。
Ensemble of Hope#073.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#074.src: So- all that to say, I've got nothing for you! For now. I'll tell you later, okay?
Ensemble of Hope#074.dst: つまり―長々と言ったけど、今は何もない！今はな。後で話すよ、いいな？
Ensemble of Hope#074.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#076.src: I... don't know what to do. I really, really don't.
Ensemble of Hope#076.dst: 私…どうしたらいいかわからない。本当に、本当にわからないんだ。
Ensemble of Hope#076.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#077.src: We've... ugh, we've all lost people. Lots of Leaves got arrested for... this or that, over the years. It sucked, but... it happened.
Ensemble of Hope#077.dst: 私たちは…ああ、みんな誰かを失ってきた。風の葉からも何年もの間に大勢が捕まった。辛かったけど…そういうものだった。
Ensemble of Hope#077.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#078.src: ...it's never been this bad before. Never anyone this close. I mean... sigh. Syndra and Mora. Gods.
Ensemble of Hope#078.dst: …でもここまでひどいのは初めてだ。こんなに近い人は。つまり…はあ。Syndra と Mora。まったく。
Ensemble of Hope#078.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#079.src: I want to help her get through this, but... she's closing herself off. And... we're still not home free just yet.
Ensemble of Hope#079.dst: 乗り越える手助けをしたいけど…あいつは心を閉ざしてる。それに…まだ安全ってわけでもない。
Ensemble of Hope#079.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#080.src: ...when it's over. When it's over. Everything will be okay when it's over.
Ensemble of Hope#080.dst: …終わったら。終わったらだ。終われば全部うまくいく。
Ensemble of Hope#080.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#083.src: I'm r-ready to see my old friends again... I miss Kaio.
Ensemble of Hope#083.dst: 昔の仲間にまた会う準備はで、できてる…Kaio に会いたいな。
Ensemble of Hope#083.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#084.src: Was there s-something on your mind?
Ensemble of Hope#084.dst: な、何か気になることでも？
Ensemble of Hope#084.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#085.src: Ah... I... I don't want to lie to you.
Ensemble of Hope#085.dst: あ…ぼ、僕…君に嘘はつきたくない。
Ensemble of Hope#085.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#086.src: So... I'm not d-doing great. Everytime I... I close my eyes I s-see that... face. The S-sovereign...
Ensemble of Hope#086.dst: だから…正直、あまり元気じゃない。目を…閉じるたびに、あの顔がみ、見える。く、君主の…
Ensemble of Hope#086.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#087.src: Everytime I close my e-eyes I feel all that pain. All of it! All the m-memories!
Ensemble of Hope#087.dst: 目をと、閉じるたびに痛みが全部よみがえる。全部だ！き、記憶が全部！
Ensemble of Hope#087.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#088.src: I was... okay with it all e-ending there.
Ensemble of Hope#088.dst: あそこで終わってもいいって…思ってた。
Ensemble of Hope#088.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#089.src: I know that i-it's over. I know Gikyo is dead but... their ghost still h-haunts me.
Ensemble of Hope#089.dst: も、もう終わったってわかってる。Gikyo は死んだって。でも…その亡霊にまだう、うなされる。
Ensemble of Hope#089.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#090.src: I think it's a s-solid plan.
Ensemble of Hope#090.dst: し、しっかりした計画だと思う。
Ensemble of Hope#090.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#091.src: I j-just wonder how many from the Leaves in the Wind are willing to a-actually come all the way here.
Ensemble of Hope#091.dst: た、ただ、風の葉の中で、ここまで本当にき、来てくれる人がどれだけいるかな。
Ensemble of Hope#091.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#094.src: Well, here we are. The dam really is something to behold, isn't it...
Ensemble of Hope#094.dst: さて、着いたぞ。このダム、本当に壮観だよな…
Ensemble of Hope#094.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#095.src: I- I always d..did wonder what it'd b- b- be like to... to t...take this elevator...
Ensemble of Hope#095.dst: ぼ、僕、ずっとこのエレベーターにの、の、乗ったらどんな感じか…き、気になってたんだ…
Ensemble of Hope#095.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#096.src: Well, you'll finally get your chance. Come on, let's just fight already.
Ensemble of Hope#096.dst: じゃあやっと乗れるね。ほら、さっさと戦おう。
Ensemble of Hope#096.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#098.src: What? We can't rush this? The longer we wait, the more suspicious they'll get.
Ensemble of Hope#098.dst: 何？急いじゃだめ？待つほど怪しまれるよ。
Ensemble of Hope#098.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#099.dst: …わかった。みんな準備はいいか？
Ensemble of Hope#099.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#102.src: Defeat the soldiers defending the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#102.dst: [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] でエレベーターを守る兵士を倒す。

Ensemble of Hope#104.src: Careful! Looks like they've got backup!
Ensemble of Hope#104.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#106.src: H...how many p- people can they fit in th- th- that elevator?!
Ensemble of Hope#106.dst: あ、あのエレベーター、な、な、何人乗れるの？！
Ensemble of Hope#106.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#108.src: You're the insurgents everyone is on the lookout for! MEN, TO ARMS! CAPTURE THEM!
Ensemble of Hope#108.dst: 貴様らが指名手配中の反乱分子か！総員、武器を取れ！捕らえろ！
Ensemble of Hope#108.speaker: Wings Commander Kaezu

Ensemble of Hope#109.src: Talk to the group again at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#111.src: Sigh. Whatever. Let's go... get our people.
Ensemble of Hope#111.dst: はあ。まあいいや。行こう…仲間を迎えに。
Ensemble of Hope#111.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#113.dst: みんな！また兵士が来るぞ！
Ensemble of Hope#113.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#114.src: Sui, are you INSANE?! You almost got SHOT!
Ensemble of Hope#114.dst: Sui、正気か？！もう少しで撃たれるところだったぞ！
Ensemble of Hope#114.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#116.src: You turned your back when there were enemies still around!! What do you think would have happened if we weren't here?
Ensemble of Hope#116.dst: まだ敵がいるのに背を向けたんだぞ！！私たちがいなかったらどうなってたと思う？
Ensemble of Hope#116.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#118.src: Shot. If you were lucky, somewhere that wouldn't have killed - but after what they saw, would they have really taken that risk?!
Ensemble of Hope#118.dst: 撃たれてた。運がよければ急所は外れたかもな―でもあれを見た後で、奴らがそんな加減をすると思うか？！
Ensemble of Hope#118.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#120.src: Sui, stop being so reckless. You're... you're strong, I get that, but... that doesn't mean you're invincible.
Ensemble of Hope#120.dst: Sui、無茶はやめろ。お前は…強い、それはわかってる。でも…不死身ってわけじゃない。
Ensemble of Hope#120.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#121.src: S...Sui, we don't w- want to l- lo- lose you too...
Ensemble of Hope#121.dst: S…Sui、き、君まで、う、失いたくないよ…
Ensemble of Hope#121.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#122.src: But if I'm not good enough, if I'm not f-fast enough, then- then- then I'll lose you, and- and I can't, I can't do that again, I-
Ensemble of Hope#122.dst: でも私が足りなかったら、は、速くなかったら、そ―そ―そしたらみんなを失う、それは、もう二度と、私―
Ensemble of Hope#122.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#125.src: You don't need to prove yourself. You've always been good enough for us.
Ensemble of Hope#125.dst: 証明なんてしなくていい。お前はずっと十分やってくれてる。
Ensemble of Hope#125.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#126.src: Whatever that- that Sovereign said to you, to make you think everything's that's happened to us is your fault? It's not true!
Ensemble of Hope#126.dst: あの―あの君主に何を言われたか知らないけど、起きたことが全部お前のせいだなんて？そんなの嘘だ！
Ensemble of Hope#126.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#127.src: Sui. Sui. Mora's death is not your fault!! We can blame the crown, blame the Sovereigns- hell, blame me for leaving him there!!!
Ensemble of Hope#127.dst: Sui。Sui。Mora が死んだのはお前のせいじゃない！！王家を責めろ、君主を責めろ―なんなら置いてきた私を責めろ！！！
Ensemble of Hope#127.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#128.src: But it wasn't your responsibility to protect him. To protect us. We're a team - a family, and... and I don't want to see you burn yourself to ash like Syndra did.
Ensemble of Hope#128.dst: でもあいつを守るのはお前の責任じゃなかった。私たちを守るのも。私たちはチームだ―家族なんだ。お前が Syndra みたいに燃え尽きて灰になるのは見たくない。
Ensemble of Hope#128.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#130.src: R...Rex is r- right, Sui. We can... f- fi- fight together, sh...shore up each o- oth... each other's w...weaknesses.
Ensemble of Hope#130.dst: R…Rex の言う通りだよ、Sui。い、一緒に戦って、お、お互いのじゃ…弱点を補えばいい。
Ensemble of Hope#130.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#132.src: ...b- but we should pr...probably get going, Sui, b- before more backup sh...shows up.
Ensemble of Hope#132.dst: …で、でもそろそろ行こう、Sui。ぞ、増援が来る前に。
Ensemble of Hope#132.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#133.src: Sigh. Zeph's right. You guys hurry to the Leaves, while we have the chance. {u} and I will prepare for your return.
Ensemble of Hope#133.dst: はあ。Zeph の言う通りだ。今のうちに風の葉のところへ急げ。{u} と私はお前たちが戻る準備をしておく。
Ensemble of Hope#133.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#135.src: Y... yeah. You're right, we should go too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
Ensemble of Hope#135.dst: あ…ああ。そうだな、私たちも行こう。樹冠の洞窟で落ち合おう。
Ensemble of Hope#135.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#136.src: A little. But... I don't know how else to get through to her.
Ensemble of Hope#136.dst: 少しな。でも…他にどう言えば伝わるのかわからない。
Ensemble of Hope#136.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#137.src: It's so... frustrating! Seeing her taking on all of Syndra's worst traits! I- I know what to look out for, this time, but...
Ensemble of Hope#137.dst: 本当に…もどかしい！Syndra の悪いところを全部受け継いでいくのを見るのは！今度は何に気をつければいいかわかってる、けど…
Ensemble of Hope#137.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#138.src: ...but I still don't know what to do.
Ensemble of Hope#138.dst: …それでもどうすればいいかわからない。
Ensemble of Hope#138.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#139.src: Ha. Maybe I should apply my own advice to myself...
Ensemble of Hope#139.dst: はは。自分の助言を自分に使うべきかもな…
Ensemble of Hope#139.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#140.src: We should get moving too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
Ensemble of Hope#140.dst: 私たちも行こう。樹冠の洞窟で落ち合おう。
Ensemble of Hope#140.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#141.src: Travel to the {p} and find the Canopy in their new hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#141.dst: {p} へ行き、[-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] にある樹冠の新しい隠れ家を見つける。

Ensemble of Hope#145.src: Oh, good grief. Look more closely, foxes - these are familiar faces! Or rather, familiar face, I should say - welcome back to the Canopy, {u}! And who might this be?
Ensemble of Hope#145.dst: おやおや、まったく。よく見なさい、狐たち―見知った顔だよ！いや、見知った顔が一人、と言うべきか―おかえり、{u}！で、こちらはどなたかな？
Ensemble of Hope#145.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#146.src: ...you're Captain Rurie, right? Sui told us about you.
Ensemble of Hope#146.dst: …Rurie 隊長だよな？Sui から聞いてる。
Ensemble of Hope#146.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#147.src: Did she! Then that must mean you are one of the dear captured friends - no no, don't tell me, I can figure it out... Rex, I assume?
Ensemble of Hope#147.dst: おや、そうかい！ということは、捕まっていた大事なお友達の一人だね―いやいや、言わないで、当ててみせよう…Rex、かな？
Ensemble of Hope#147.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#148.src: Hm... now, I would bring you in, but then Fuhue might have my head for not following her many numerous protocols... and we certainly can't have that...
Ensemble of Hope#148.dst: ふむ…さて、中へ招きたいところだが、Fuhue の山ほどある規則を守らないと、私の首が飛びかねない…それはまずい…
Ensemble of Hope#148.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#149.src: Ugh, just let them in, Rurie. We've been breaking initiation protocols left and right already, I can't be bothered enforcing them anymore.
Ensemble of Hope#149.dst: はあ、もう入れてあげて、Rurie。入団の規則なんてとっくに破りまくってるし、今さら守らせる気にもならない。
Ensemble of Hope#149.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#150.src: Well, would you look at that! Lucky you! Come on in, come on in. Our numbers have grown since last you were here, {u} - many more friendly faces hanging about!
Ensemble of Hope#150.dst: おやおや、これはこれは！運がいいね！さあ入って、入って。君が前に来た時より仲間が増えたんだよ、{u}―親しげな顔がたくさんいる！
Ensemble of Hope#150.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#151.src: {u}, Rex!! Man, it's good to see you guys!!
Ensemble of Hope#151.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#152.src: Yuman?! What're you doing here? I thought they had you locked up in-
Ensemble of Hope#152.dst: Yuman？！なんでここに？てっきり投獄されて―
Ensemble of Hope#152.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#153.src: In Deraj Prison, yup. Everything they say about it is true- and, and more! They get you workin' in the mines, if you're not... eh, y'know. Disappeared.
Ensemble of Hope#153.dst: Deraj 監獄にな、そう。噂は全部本当だった―いや、それ以上だ！鉱山で働かされるんだ、もし…ほら、わかるだろ。消されなきゃな。
Ensemble of Hope#153.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#154.src: Lucky us, these Canopy guys showed up and broke us out! There were explosions, and growing plants, and crashing waves, and- and-
Ensemble of Hope#154.dst: 運よく、樹冠の連中が来て脱獄させてくれたんだ！爆発に、生える植物に、押し寄せる波に、それに―それに―
Ensemble of Hope#154.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#155.src: And then the feathery birds showed up outta nowhere, like- nothing there, then poof, cloud of smoke, and there they are- and they got us outta there!
Ensemble of Hope#155.dst: そしたら羽の鳥どもがどこからともなく現れて、何もないとこにボンッて煙が出て、もういるんだ―で、連れ出してくれた！
Ensemble of Hope#155.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#156.src: I'm sorry... Rurie. You all... successfully broke into Gravity's Monolith?! And got people out?!
Ensemble of Hope#156.dst: ちょっと待って…Rurie。あんたたち…重力のモノリスに侵入成功したのか？！しかも人を連れ出した？！
Ensemble of Hope#156.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#157.src: Ah, it wasn't so tough once we had the plans of their inner workings! Floorplans, guard rotations... the works.
Ensemble of Hope#157.dst: ああ、内部の仕組みの図面さえ手に入れば、そう難しくはなかったよ！見取り図、見張りの交代…何もかもね。
Ensemble of Hope#157.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#158.src: That Warden's a deadly foe, but he sticks to an incredibly firm schedule - out like a light once it turns {~} PM! Of course, the prison goes into lockdown, but we've got our ways around it.
Ensemble of Hope#158.dst: あの看守長は恐ろしい相手だが、恐ろしく規則正しくてね―夜 {~} 時になるとぐっすりさ！もちろん監獄は封鎖されるが、抜け道はあるんだよ。
Ensemble of Hope#158.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#160.src: Right you are Cileon, right you are... well, we'll have time to discuss the details later! I must return to my owls, there's much left to do!
Ensemble of Hope#160.dst: その通りだよ Cileon、その通り…さて、詳しい話はまた後で！私は梟たちのところへ戻らねば、やることが山積みだ！
Ensemble of Hope#160.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#162.src: Is, uh... is Zeph alright? I overheard a couple of things about what you two went through, so...
Ensemble of Hope#162.dst: えっと…Zeph は大丈夫か？お前ら二人が何を経験したか、ちょっと耳にしてさ…
Ensemble of Hope#162.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#163.dst: 何？あいつが心配なのか？
Ensemble of Hope#163.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#164.dst: へ？はっ、まさか、違うって。
Ensemble of Hope#164.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#166.src: He's alright. He and Sui will be here later, so you can ask him about it yourself.
Ensemble of Hope#166.dst: あいつは大丈夫だ。後で Sui と来るから、直接聞けばいい。
Ensemble of Hope#166.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#167.src: Oh! Oh, ha, uh, alright- sure, that sounds good, yep.
Ensemble of Hope#167.dst: お！おう、はは、えっと、そうか―いいね、そうしよう、うん。
Ensemble of Hope#167.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#168.src: I'm gonna... get back to my bro up there. Talk to ya more later!
Ensemble of Hope#168.dst: 俺は…上にいる兄貴のとこに戻るわ。また後でな！
Ensemble of Hope#168.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#170.src: I should talk to the Canopy's leader, get started on some planning. Come by when you're done talking with everyone, okay?
Ensemble of Hope#170.dst: 樹冠のリーダーと話して、計画を始めないと。みんなと話し終わったら来てくれ、いいな？
Ensemble of Hope#170.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#172.src: Your friend has entered the hideout already, please make yourself at home.
Ensemble of Hope#172.dst: お仲間はもう隠れ家に入りました。どうぞおくつろぎください。
Ensemble of Hope#172.speaker: Canopy Fox

Ensemble of Hope#176.src: Ah, {u}. I'm glad to see you are well.
Ensemble of Hope#176.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#177.src: These have been... a difficult few weeks. For all of us, I gather. We have... been informed of our losses.
Ensemble of Hope#177.dst: この数週間は…辛いものだった。皆にとってそうだろう。我々の…失ったものも聞いている。
Ensemble of Hope#177.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#178.src: I still can't believe we let her talk us into... into all of that!
Ensemble of Hope#178.dst: あいつに言いくるめられて…あんなことをしたなんて、まだ信じられない！
Ensemble of Hope#178.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#179.src: Yulie, let's not speak ill of the dead. We cannot change the past. We can only move forward.
Ensemble of Hope#179.dst: Yulie、死者を悪く言うのはよそう。過去は変えられん。前に進むしかないのだ。
Ensemble of Hope#179.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#180.src: ...I, too, regret not standing my ground. For her sake, if nothing else.
Ensemble of Hope#180.dst: …私も、踏みとどまらなかったことを悔いている。せめて彼女のためにもな。
Ensemble of Hope#180.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#181.src: Sigh... her grief and rage consumed her, in the end, and I did little to stop it. I- ahh- my back...
Ensemble of Hope#181.dst: はあ…彼女は最後、悲しみと怒りに呑まれた。私はそれを止められなかった。私は―うっ―腰が…
Ensemble of Hope#181.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#182.src: Quill, you need to rest. Sit down for a while, please.
Ensemble of Hope#182.dst: Quill、休まないと。頼むから少し座ってくれ。
Ensemble of Hope#182.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#183.src: No, no... I'm fine, Yulie. We have work to do, after all.
Ensemble of Hope#183.dst: いやいや…大丈夫だ、Yulie。やるべきことがあるのだからな。
Ensemble of Hope#183.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#184.src: Well, the guards at the prison didn't really care much about who was physically fit to work or not. They just... work you 'tll you're dead, I guess!
Ensemble of Hope#184.dst: 監獄の看守どもは、働ける体かどうかなんて気にしちゃいなかった。死ぬまで…働かせるだけさ、たぶんな！
Ensemble of Hope#184.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#185.src: Harsh treatment, certainly... but I suppose it is no different than the Roughworks, at its core. Only... less obscured.
Ensemble of Hope#185.dst: 確かに過酷な扱いだ…だが根本は Roughworks と変わらんのだろう。ただ…隠されていないだけで。
Ensemble of Hope#185.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#187.src: {u}, Yusanu told us that he only made it through because of you and Sui. So... thank you. For protecting my little brother when I couldn't.
Ensemble of Hope#187.dst: {u}、Yusanu が、生き延びられたのはあんたと Sui のおかげだって。だから…ありがとう。俺にできなかった時に弟を守ってくれて。
Ensemble of Hope#187.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#188.src: Yes... thanks to yours and Sui's magic, I hear...
Ensemble of Hope#188.dst: ああ…君と Sui の魔法のおかげだそうだな…
Ensemble of Hope#188.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#189.src: From the Steel Feather? The Canopy has quarters built deeper in these caverns. Anyone uninterested in fighting is staying there, for the time being.
Ensemble of Hope#189.dst: 鋼の羽根の連中か？樹冠がこの洞窟の奥に居住区を作ってる。戦う気のない人は、今はそこにいる。
Ensemble of Hope#189.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#190.src: ...those we could find, at least. There are many we are still missing, unfortunately. I pray they are still alive.
Ensemble of Hope#190.dst: …少なくとも、見つけられた者はな。残念ながら、まだ行方の知れない者が多い。生きていてくれるよう祈っている。
Ensemble of Hope#190.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#191.src: Perhaps when this is all over, we will be able to locate the rest... I can only hope so.
Ensemble of Hope#191.dst: すべてが終われば、残りの者も見つけられるかもしれん…そう願うばかりだ。
Ensemble of Hope#191.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#192.src: ...so, look, if we try to charge these in this specific order-
Ensemble of Hope#192.dst: …だから、ほら、この順番で充填してみれば―
Ensemble of Hope#192.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#193.src: No, wait. Your sequence is charging Thunder twice in a row here, when it should only do it once. Too much of a charge, and-
Ensemble of Hope#193.dst: いや、待って。その手順だとここで雷を二回続けて充填してる。一回だけのはず。充填しすぎると―
Ensemble of Hope#193.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#194.src: -and it'll destabilize, right. Thanks for double checking my work, Fuhue.
Ensemble of Hope#194.dst: ―不安定になる、そうだね。確認ありがとう、Fuhue。
Ensemble of Hope#194.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#195.src: ...oh, {u}??? I- I completely didn't... notice you were here...
Ensemble of Hope#195.dst: …あ、{u}？？？ぼ、僕、全然…いるのに気づかなかった…
Ensemble of Hope#195.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#196.src: Yeesh. You've gotta fix your lack of awareness, bro. Anyone could sneak up on you while you're hyper focused in on something!
Ensemble of Hope#196.dst: うへえ。その注意力のなさ、直せよ兄弟。何かに没頭してる時は誰でも背後を取れるぞ！
Ensemble of Hope#196.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#197.src: Ugh, yeah, yeah, you keep telling me- if you're not going to be helpful, stop hovering!
Ensemble of Hope#197.dst: はあ、はいはい、いつも言うよね―手伝わないならうろうろしないで！
Ensemble of Hope#197.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#198.src: Nah. I wanna see the cool stuff happen when you get it working! Don't want to miss the fireworks or any-
Ensemble of Hope#198.dst: やだね。動いた時のすげえとこを見たいんだ！花火とか見逃したく―
Ensemble of Hope#198.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#199.src: To answer your question, {u}, Yusanu believes he has a working theory on the Resonance Weaver's functionality.
Ensemble of Hope#199.dst: {u}、質問に答えると、Yusanu は共鳴の織機の仕組みについて有力な仮説を持っている。
Ensemble of Hope#199.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#200.src: Yeah, but a working theory doesn't mean a whole lot if I can't get results...
Ensemble of Hope#200.dst: うん、でも結果が出なきゃ仮説なんて大して意味ないよ…
Ensemble of Hope#200.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#201.src: Look, these five glyphs - they correspond almost exactly to the ones the Canopy's talismans use. Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Thunder.
Ensemble of Hope#201.dst: 見て、この五つのルーン―樹冠の護符が使うものとほぼ同じなんだ。火、水、地、風、雷。
Ensemble of Hope#201.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#202.src: They can be charged to activate them - a simple burst on its own, maybe, but if chained together... you get something more complex.
Ensemble of Hope#202.dst: 充填すると発動する―単体ならただの小さな爆発だろうけど、連鎖させれば…もっと複雑なものになる。
Ensemble of Hope#202.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#203.src: Resonance... resonance, resonance, resonance... Soosu was always saying there was something she could not see with her blessing. Intangible, not of the elements...
Ensemble of Hope#203.dst: 共鳴…共鳴、共鳴、共鳴…Soosu はいつも、自分の祝福でも見えないものがあるって言ってた。触れられない、属性じゃない何か…
Ensemble of Hope#203.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#204.src: Maybe... if we could find it, we could use the Weaver to... to visualize it. Bind it in place, so we can see it...
Ensemble of Hope#204.dst: もしかしたら…それを見つけられれば、織機で…可視化できるかも。固定して、見えるように…
Ensemble of Hope#204.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#205.src: ...yeah, none of that made any sense to me. Explain it with easier words?
Ensemble of Hope#205.dst: …うん、今の全然わかんねえ。もっと簡単に言ってくれ？
Ensemble of Hope#205.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#206.src: Okay, sure, just for you. Invisible thing in the air. With device, we make it visible.
Ensemble of Hope#206.dst: はいはい、君のためにね。空気の中に見えない物。装置で、見えるようにする。
Ensemble of Hope#206.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#207.src: Oh! Why didn't ya start with that!
Ensemble of Hope#207.dst: おお！最初からそう言えよ！
Ensemble of Hope#207.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#208.dst: はあ…ほんと手に負えない。
Ensemble of Hope#208.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#209.src: Ahem. Will we try the updated chain?
Ensemble of Hope#209.dst: こほん。更新した連鎖を試す？
Ensemble of Hope#209.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#210.src: Right, right... got distracted. Thanks, Yuman.
Ensemble of Hope#210.dst: そうだった…気が散っちゃった。ありがとう、Yuman。
Ensemble of Hope#210.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#214.src: I... I don't know, but... I think it's working! Fuhue, we did it!
Ensemble of Hope#214.dst: わ…わからない、けど…うまくいってる！Fuhue、やったよ！
Ensemble of Hope#214.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#215.src: Maybe if I touch it, something will...
Ensemble of Hope#215.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#218.src: And what, exactly, is this doing here? A blight that permeates the air... concerning. I'll have to speak to Master Azael.
Ensemble of Hope#218.dst: で、これは一体なぜここに？空気に満ちる災い…気がかりね。Azael 様に報告しないと。
Ensemble of Hope#218.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#219.src: Well, uh... now that it is here, can we do anything with it? Like... charge the glyphs to manipulate it?
Ensemble of Hope#219.dst: えっと…せっかくここにあるんだし、何かに使えないか？ルーンに充填して操るとか？
Ensemble of Hope#219.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#220.src: M... maybe. I'll have to do some thinking. But for now, it'd probably be best to... get rid of it. If I hit all five at once, it should...
Ensemble of Hope#220.dst: か…かもね。考えてみないと。でも今は…消した方がいい。五つ全部同時に打てば、たぶん…
Ensemble of Hope#220.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#221.src: ...there. Gods. Why did the Queen need this thing in the first place...?
Ensemble of Hope#221.dst: …よし。まったく。そもそも女王はなんでこんなものが要ったんだ…？
Ensemble of Hope#221.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#222.src: ...yeah, sure, why not. Later. I guess I've got to clean up here anyway.
Ensemble of Hope#222.dst: …うん、いいよ、そうしよう。後でね。どうせここを片付けないといけないし。
Ensemble of Hope#222.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#223.src: Seeing as... is that Rex over there? Oh, good. Well, seeing as she's plotting with Azael, I should get ready for that.
Ensemble of Hope#223.dst: それに…あそこにいるの Rex？よかった。Azael と作戦を練ってるなら、僕も準備しないと。
Ensemble of Hope#223.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#224.src: Yuman, could you help me out? Since you've been annoying me all day.
Ensemble of Hope#224.dst: Yuman、手伝ってくれる？一日中邪魔してたんだし。
Ensemble of Hope#224.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#229.src: I've been looking forward to seeing you again, {u}. That is your real name, right?
Ensemble of Hope#229.dst: また会えるのを楽しみにしていました、{u}。それが本当の名前ですよね？
Ensemble of Hope#229.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#230.src: It feels like it's been ages since we last spoke. As you can probably guess, a lot has changed for me since then.
Ensemble of Hope#230.dst: 最後に話してからずいぶん経った気がします。お察しの通り、あれから僕もいろいろ変わりました。
Ensemble of Hope#230.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#231.src: After we took out Commander Ferreo, there was nowhere for me to go, but I knew I needed to leave the {p} and head somewhere I wouldn't be recognized.
Ensemble of Hope#231.dst: Ferreo 司令官を倒した後、行くあてはありませんでした。でも {p} を離れて、誰にも気づかれない場所へ行くしかなかった。
Ensemble of Hope#231.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#232.src: I couldn't risk taking the train, so sneaking into the {p} at night was my only option. I had no idea what could be waiting for me there, but I had to go quickly, before they would start looking for me.
Ensemble of Hope#232.dst: 列車に乗る危険は冒せず、夜に {p} へ忍び込むしかありませんでした。何が待っているかもわからないまま、探され始める前に急いで出発したんです。
Ensemble of Hope#232.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#233.src: I took the easternmost exit out of the {p}, and by some miracle, snuck through to the {p} after quietly taking out a guard.
Ensemble of Hope#233.dst: {p} の一番東の出口から出て、奇跡的に、見張りを一人静かに倒して {p} へ抜けました。
Ensemble of Hope#233.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#234.src: From there, I blindly stumbled across the region, terrified of what would find me. I was eventually knocked out by a Canopy scout, who took me into their hideout to be questioned.
Ensemble of Hope#234.dst: そこからは何かに見つかる恐怖に怯えながら、闇雲にこの地域をさまよいました。やがて樹冠の斥候に気絶させられ、尋問のため隠れ家に連れてこられたんです。
Ensemble of Hope#234.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#235.src: I told them the truth, about who I was, where I came from, and what I had done... They didn't believe me until I described you, and what you had done for me.
Ensemble of Hope#235.dst: 僕は本当のことを話しました。何者で、どこから来て、何をしたか…あなたのことと、僕にしてくれたことを話すまで、信じてもらえませんでした。
Ensemble of Hope#235.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#236.src: Even after we split ways, you were still there to look out for me!
Ensemble of Hope#236.dst: 別れた後も、あなたは僕を見守ってくれていたんですね！
Ensemble of Hope#236.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#237.src: Of course, they didn't trust me immediately, I still had to prove myself. I've learned more here than I would have ever had at {p}.
Ensemble of Hope#237.dst: もちろんすぐには信用されず、自分を証明する必要がありました。ここでは {p} にいた頃より多くを学びました。
Ensemble of Hope#237.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#238.src: And now, I can call myself a resistance member, same as you. I've thought a lot about my goals since we were recruits. I want Fruma to be rid of corruption, like what we saw with Commander Ferreo.
Ensemble of Hope#238.dst: そして今、あなたと同じレジスタンスの一員を名乗れます。新兵だった頃から目標についてよく考えました。Ferreo 司令官のような腐敗を Fruma から一掃したいんです。
Ensemble of Hope#238.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#239.src: The resistance is the best chance we have at achieving this goal, I'm sure you've realised this too. I am ready to risk my life fighting for a better future for Fruma!
Ensemble of Hope#239.dst: レジスタンスこそ、この目標を果たす一番の希望です。あなたもわかっているはずです。Fruma のより良い未来のため、命を懸けて戦う覚悟はできています！
Ensemble of Hope#239.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#240.src: I could be saying the same thing, but the people here have told me that you can handle yourself just fine.
Ensemble of Hope#240.dst: 僕も同じことを言いたいところですが、ここの人たちから、あなたなら心配ないと聞いています。
Ensemble of Hope#240.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#241.src: I must admit, my time with the resistance has been very difficult. But I can finally say I am fighting for a cause I truly believe in.
Ensemble of Hope#241.dst: 正直、レジスタンスでの日々はとても大変でした。でもようやく、心から信じる大義のために戦っていると言えます。
Ensemble of Hope#241.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#242.src: Deep down in my heart, I've always known I could never live up to the expectations my family had for me. Here, I no longer have to worry about that.
Ensemble of Hope#242.dst: 心の奥では、家族の期待には決して応えられないとずっとわかっていました。ここではもう、それを気にしなくていい。
Ensemble of Hope#242.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#243.src: I was so alone, {u}, I truly can't thank you enough for being there for me...
Ensemble of Hope#243.dst: 僕はずっと独りでした、{u}。そばにいてくれて、本当に感謝してもしきれません…
Ensemble of Hope#243.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#244.src: You have nothing to be sorry for, I completely understand why you couldn't tell me the truth.
Ensemble of Hope#244.dst: 謝ることなんてありません。本当のことを言えなかった理由は、よくわかっています。
Ensemble of Hope#244.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#245.src: What matters the most is that you helped me escape {p} when you found out that I was in danger.
Ensemble of Hope#245.dst: 一番大事なのは、僕が危ないと知って、{p} から逃がしてくれたことです。
Ensemble of Hope#245.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#246.src: ...and if we route through the tunnels - we have a couple options for city sectors...
Ensemble of Hope#246.dst: …で、トンネルを通るなら―街区の候補がいくつかあって…
Ensemble of Hope#246.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#247.src: Yes, I see. It would be worth your while to compare notes with Captain Fuhue, she can help narrow it down.
Ensemble of Hope#247.dst: ああ、なるほど。Fuhue 隊長と情報を突き合わせるといい。絞り込みを手伝ってくれるだろう。
Ensemble of Hope#247.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#248.src: ...ah, {u}. Young Rex and I were just speaking on our options moving forward. Would you like to join us for this discussion?
Ensemble of Hope#248.dst: …ああ、{u}。若き Rex と今後の選択肢について話していたところだ。君も加わるかね？
Ensemble of Hope#248.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#249.src: Well... go, then! Go talk to people, you have time.
Ensemble of Hope#249.dst: じゃあ…行ってこい！みんなと話してこいよ、時間はある。
Ensemble of Hope#249.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#250.src: Alright! So, {u}, here's the deal. If we want to take out the crown, we'll need to hit it at its root - the Queen, the Citadel, and her Royal Palace.
Ensemble of Hope#250.dst: よし！じゃあ {u}、こういうことだ。王家を倒すなら根元を叩く必要がある―女王、城塞、そして女王の宮殿だ。
Ensemble of Hope#250.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#251.src: We're not getting through the front gates, obviously... they're too defended. But we don't need to take the gates - we can come in from below.
Ensemble of Hope#251.dst: 正門から入るのはもちろん無理だ…守りが固すぎる。でも門を奪う必要はない―下から入ればいい。
Ensemble of Hope#251.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#252.src: The caverns and catacombs beneath the Citadel are quite expansive. Captain Rurie has-
Ensemble of Hope#252.dst: 城塞の下の洞窟と地下墓地はかなり広大だ。Rurie 隊長が―
Ensemble of Hope#252.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#253.src: Ah, was that my name I just overheard! We're speaking about the tunnels, are we? If you're hoping to traverse them, I'm the man for the job!
Ensemble of Hope#253.dst: おや、今私の名前が聞こえたかな！トンネルの話だね？通り抜けたいなら、私こそ適任だよ！
Ensemble of Hope#253.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#254.src: It's quite an extensive network, really... the owls and I have spent years mapping each and every inch of it - and we still haven't seen it all! It's very interesting - and that's not to mention-
Ensemble of Hope#254.dst: 実に広大な網でね…梟たちと何年もかけて隅々まで地図にしたが―まだ全部は見ていない！とても興味深くて―それに言うまでもなく―
Ensemble of Hope#254.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#255.src: Get to the point already, Rurie. They want to reach the Citadel through the tunnels. Is that possible?
Ensemble of Hope#255.dst: さっさと要点を言って、Rurie。トンネルを通って城塞に行きたいそうよ。できるの？
Ensemble of Hope#255.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#256.src: Hmph. Possible, it certainly is... though results may vary. Looking for something in particular?
Ensemble of Hope#256.dst: ふん。可能か、と言えば可能だとも…結果は保証しないがね。どこか特に目当てが？
Ensemble of Hope#256.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#257.src: Something easy to take, and easily defensible. University is out of the question... too large. The barracks are out of the question... maybe the Industrial Zone? Someone get me a map-
Ensemble of Hope#257.dst: 奪いやすくて守りやすい場所。大学は論外…広すぎる。兵舎も論外…工業区なら？誰か地図を―
Ensemble of Hope#257.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#258.src: If I- ahh- if I may interrupt... I believe the {p} should fit the criteria you are looking for.
Ensemble of Hope#258.dst: 私が―うっ―口を挟んでもよければ…{p} なら条件に合うと思う。
Ensemble of Hope#258.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#259.src: It is closed off, and only lightly guarded in comparison to the rest of the Citadel... or, at least, it was in my time.
Ensemble of Hope#259.dst: 閉ざされた場所で、城塞の他と比べて警備も手薄だ…少なくとも、私の頃はそうだった。
Ensemble of Hope#259.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#261.src: The {p}, you say? Yes... yes, I believe it could work! The path is long and winding, but should be plenty large enough to fit a strike team.
Ensemble of Hope#261.dst: {p} だって？そう…そうだね、いけると思う！道は長く曲がりくねっているが、突撃隊が通るには十分広いはずだ。
Ensemble of Hope#261.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#262.src: Good! Captain Rurie, would you be able to map out that route so we can-
Ensemble of Hope#262.dst: よし！Rurie 隊長、そのルートを地図にしてもらえれば―
Ensemble of Hope#262.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#264.dst: あ…みんな、その、揃ってる。
Ensemble of Hope#264.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#266.src: Y...Yuman?! Y- you- you're here? Y...you're okay?
Ensemble of Hope#266.dst: Y…Yuman？！き、君、ここに？ぶ、無事なの？
Ensemble of Hope#266.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#267.src: 'Course I am, princess! What, were you worried?
Ensemble of Hope#267.dst: 当たり前だろ、お姫様！なんだ、心配してたのか？
Ensemble of Hope#267.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#268.src: Are you done? Weren't we here to plan our next moves?
Ensemble of Hope#268.dst: もういい？次の動きを決めに来たんじゃないの？
Ensemble of Hope#268.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#270.src: So we're attacking the Citadel through the tunnels?
Ensemble of Hope#270.dst: じゃあトンネルから城塞を攻めるの？
Ensemble of Hope#270.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#271.src: Indeed, we are. It seems we have decided on the {p}? We will take control of the sector to serve as a launching point for future operations.
Ensemble of Hope#271.dst: その通り。{p} に決まったようだね？その区域を押さえ、今後の作戦の拠点とする。
Ensemble of Hope#271.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#272.src: If that's the only thing we attack, won't the crown immediately realize what we're doing?
Ensemble of Hope#272.dst: 攻めるのがそこだけなら、王家にすぐ狙いがばれない？
Ensemble of Hope#272.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#273.src: Hm... yeah, I guess you're right. We'll want to stage a few more attacks elsewhere, divert their attention...
Ensemble of Hope#273.dst: うーん…確かにそうだな。他でも何度か攻撃を仕掛けて、注意を逸らさないと…
Ensemble of Hope#273.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#274.src: We could launch an attack at the gates?
Ensemble of Hope#274.dst: 門を攻撃すればいいんじゃない？
Ensemble of Hope#274.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#275.src: Wh- wh- what?! Sui, y...you can't just th- throw yourself at-
Ensemble of Hope#275.dst: な、な、なんだって？！Sui、そ、そんな無茶な―
Ensemble of Hope#275.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#276.src: Just enough to draw their attention! N-not to try and break through, obviously. We kill a few soldiers, then retreat.
Ensemble of Hope#276.dst: 注意を引くだけ！と、突破するつもりはないよ、もちろん。兵士を何人か倒して、退く。
Ensemble of Hope#276.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#277.src: If... if we can make them think we're trying the gates, then they won't see the group coming through the tunnels.
Ensemble of Hope#277.dst: も…もし門を狙ってると思わせれば、トンネルから来る組には気づかない。
Ensemble of Hope#277.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#278.src: Clever, indeed... I suppose we could spare some of our best fighters for such a task. Cileon, perhaps you might be interested?
Ensemble of Hope#278.dst: 実に賢い…そういう任務なら精鋭を何人か割けるだろう。Cileon、君はどうかな？
Ensemble of Hope#278.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#280.src: Wonderful! Then I suppose it's settled? One team to the gates, one team through the tunnels- and, naturally, a team to handle communication-
Ensemble of Hope#280.dst: 素晴らしい！では決まりかな？門へ一隊、トンネルへ一隊―それに当然、連絡役の一隊も―
Ensemble of Hope#280.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#281.src: Ahem- a moment of your time? Now, admittedly, I may be a tad outta my depth here- but y'all are talkin' a whole lot 'bout fighting?
Ensemble of Hope#281.dst: おほん―ちょいとええかの？わしゃ場違いかもしれんが―あんたら、戦いの話ばっかりしとらんか？
Ensemble of Hope#281.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#282.src: And it seems to me you're disregarding somethin' quite vital. The crown sure ain't lacking in strength... it can always train up new folks to replace the lost. S'done it time n' time again.
Ensemble of Hope#282.dst: わしに言わせりゃ、大事なもんを見落としとる。王家は力には困っとらん…失った分はいつでも新兵を鍛えて埋められる。何度もそうしてきたんじゃ。
Ensemble of Hope#282.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#283.src: But where the crown really lives and dies is the public opinion. Y'know, the whole... ehm, "ordeal" at the Roughworks Festival - it's caused a real stir in the people.
Ensemble of Hope#283.dst: じゃが王家の生き死にを本当に決めるんは民意じゃ。ほれ、Roughworks 祭のあの…えー、「騒ぎ」―あれで民はずいぶんざわついとる。
Ensemble of Hope#283.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#284.src: Sovereigns turnin', public exe-... sigh. Public executions. The people ain't happy. Wouldn't take much to... push 'em over the edge.
Ensemble of Hope#284.dst: 君主の寝返りに、公開処…はあ。公開処刑。民は不満じゃ。ちょいと押せば…一線を越えるじゃろう。
Ensemble of Hope#284.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#285.src: Now, the crown's got the tools to deal with violence. What it don't got is the tools to deal with civil unrest, 'least not quickly. So it might do well to give that a go as well.
Ensemble of Hope#285.dst: 王家は暴力に対処する術は持っとる。持っとらんのは民の騒乱に対処する術じゃ、少なくともすぐにはの。そっちも試してみる価値はあるじゃろう。
Ensemble of Hope#285.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#286.src: That... makes sense. Though, I'm not sure we have the means for something like that...
Ensemble of Hope#286.dst: それは…筋が通ってる。でも、そんなことをする手段が私たちにあるか…
Ensemble of Hope#286.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#287.src: We could ask the Blossom of Blades.
Ensemble of Hope#287.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#288.src: What?! Ugh, no, they're useless. It was a miracle you got anything out of them the first time, Sui! Trying again is just gonna be a waste of effort.
Ensemble of Hope#288.dst: は？！はあ、だめだ、あいつらは役立たずだ。前回何か聞き出せたのが奇跡だったんだぞ、Sui！もう一度なんて無駄骨だ。
Ensemble of Hope#288.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#289.src: No, it won't. Because it'll work. {u} and I, we can talk to them, we can... we can work something out.
Ensemble of Hope#289.dst: ううん、無駄じゃない。うまくいくから。{u} と私で話せば…なんとかできる。
Ensemble of Hope#289.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#290.src: ...fine. If you want to try, fine. But when it doesn't work - which it won't - remember that I told you so.
Ensemble of Hope#290.dst: …わかった。やりたいならやれ。でもうまくいかなかったら―絶対そうなる―言った通りだろって言うからな。
Ensemble of Hope#290.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#291.src: Okay. So you've got two distractions. But you're forgetting the most important problem - there is a GOD to worry about. If she catches on, you're done for.
Ensemble of Hope#291.dst: よし。陽動は二つ。でも一番大事な問題を忘れてる―相手には「神」がいるんだ。気づかれたら終わりだぞ。
Ensemble of Hope#291.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#292.src: Y...yeah... We- we need a way t...to make sure she d- does- doesn't show up...
Ensemble of Hope#292.dst: そ…そう…か、彼女がで、で、出てこないようにする方法がいるよ…
Ensemble of Hope#292.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#294.dst: …で…そうやって引きつける、と…
Ensemble of Hope#294.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#295.src: A move with great risk, certainly. But one that solves our remaining problems if successful.
Ensemble of Hope#295.dst: 確かに危険の大きい一手だ。だが成功すれば、残る問題は解決する。
Ensemble of Hope#295.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#296.src: {u}, a...are you s- sure about this?
Ensemble of Hope#296.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#297.src: Well, then it's settled! To divert the crown's attention - a strike team at the gates, unrest from the gossip group, and {u} turning themself in!
Ensemble of Hope#297.dst: では決まりだ！王家の注意を逸らすため―門への突撃隊、噂好きの一派による騒乱、そして {u} の自首！
Ensemble of Hope#297.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#298.src: There are still several days to go before the {p} Festival... perhaps it could be wise to detail our- aah- our plans further in that time?
Ensemble of Hope#298.dst: {p} 祭まではまだ数日ある…その間に計画を―うっ―もっと詰めておくのが賢明ではないか？
Ensemble of Hope#298.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#299.src: Indeed. Though, before we dismiss this strategy meeting... Yusanu, you have been hard at work on that stolen device, yes?
Ensemble of Hope#299.dst: その通り。だがこの作戦会議を解散する前に…Yusanu、君はあの盗んだ装置に取り組んでいたね？
Ensemble of Hope#299.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#300.src: Yeah. I... think I know how it works, but it's... hard to operate - it's very abstract, needing to figure out which glyphs to activate to get an intended result-
Ensemble of Hope#300.dst: うん。仕組みは…わかったと思う。でも…扱いが難しい―すごく抽象的で、狙った結果を出すにはどのルーンを発動するか考えないと―
Ensemble of Hope#300.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#301.src: But. One thing we managed to do was... reveal some invisible force in the air. {u} said it was... dangerous. And it's, uh... kind of everywhere.
Ensemble of Hope#301.dst: でも。一つできたのは…空気中の見えない力を見えるようにすること。{u} は…危険だって。それに、その…どこにでもある。
Ensemble of Hope#301.speaker: Yusanu
