Fantastic Voyage#241.dst: [{~} Berries] もあったなら、心がうきうきするだろうな！
Fantastic Voyage#241.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#242.src: Check your quest book if you ever need a recap. And to make sure you don't get lost, take this map.
Fantastic Voyage#242.dst: おさらいが必要なら、クエストブックを見るといい。迷わぬよう、この地図も持っていくといい。
Fantastic Voyage#242.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#243.src: Give the Odd Stew to Relend.
Fantastic Voyage#243.dst: 妙なシチューを Relend に渡す。

Fantastic Voyage#244.src: Well, this stew has a rather odd flavor. But any food we can get here I shall savor.
Fantastic Voyage#244.dst: ふむ、このシチューはなんとも妙な味。だがここで食べられる物なら、何でも味わうのが私の流儀。
Fantastic Voyage#244.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#245.src: What remains of my ship won't protect us very well. We'll need to find shelter, as you can clearly tell.
Fantastic Voyage#245.dst: 我が船の残骸では、身を守るのに心もとない。見ての通り、隠れ家を探さねばならない。
Fantastic Voyage#245.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#246.src: To the east, I can just barely make out a tent. Go and look for my friend there. I'm simply hellbent!
Fantastic Voyage#246.dst: 東の方に、テントがかすかに見える。そこで我が友を探してくれ。私の決意は燃える！
Fantastic Voyage#246.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#247.src: Check out the tent to the east.

Fantastic Voyage#249.src: So the tent was all empty and run-down? All of this bad news is making me frown.
Fantastic Voyage#249.dst: テントは空っぽで荒れ果てていた？悪い知らせばかりで、眉をひそめてしまった。
Fantastic Voyage#249.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#250.src: Allow me to borrow your map for a second. We'll have to find him somewhere else, I reckon.
Fantastic Voyage#250.dst: 少しの間、君の地図を貸してくれ。どうやら別の場所で彼を探さねばならぬようだ、やれやれ。
Fantastic Voyage#250.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#251.src: I know we can come up with a solution using our wits. Perhaps we can use an explosive to blow that big rock to bits!
Fantastic Voyage#251.dst: 知恵を絞れば、解決策は見つかるはず。爆薬で、あの大岩を粉々にできるはず！
Fantastic Voyage#251.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#252.src: Let's think of some materials we can get here. There isn't much on this island, I fear...
Fantastic Voyage#252.dst: ここで手に入る材料を考えてみよう。この島にはあまり物がないようだ、どうしよう…
Fantastic Voyage#252.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#253.src: First we're going to need [{~} Gritty Sand]. Where to get it? Try the beach at the back of the island.
Fantastic Voyage#253.dst: まずは [{~} Gritty Sand] が必要だ。どこで手に入るか？島の裏の浜辺を探してみたまえ、さあ。
Fantastic Voyage#253.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#254.src: Next up is [Sawdust], you'll need three. I think the best place to search would be the largest tree.
Fantastic Voyage#254.dst: 次は [Sawdust]、三つ必要だ。探すなら一番大きな木がいいだろうな。
Fantastic Voyage#254.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#255.src: Finally, [{~} Black Powder], found in a place that is very unique. You'll have to brave your way to the volcano's peak.
Fantastic Voyage#255.dst: 最後に [{~} Black Powder]、とても珍しい場所にある。勇気を出して火山の頂上まで登る必要がある。
Fantastic Voyage#255.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#256.src: You'll need those items you craft the bomb, I just told you where to look. If you forget what you need to find, check your quest book.
Fantastic Voyage#256.dst: 必要な物と探す場所は、今伝えたとおり。忘れたら、クエストブックを開くのだ、いつもどおり。
Fantastic Voyage#256.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#257.src: Bring {~} Gritty Sand, {~} Saw Dust, and {~} Black Powder to the Crafting Table.
Fantastic Voyage#257.dst: {~} 個の Gritty Sand、{~} 個の Saw Dust、{~} 個の Black Powder を作業台に持っていく。

Fantastic Voyage#258.src: Use the explosive on the boulder.

Fantastic Voyage#259.src: Incredible, The explosive blew right through the stone!
Fantastic Voyage#259.dst: 素晴らしい、爆薬が岩を貫いた！
Fantastic Voyage#259.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#260.src: Let us progress into this mysterious zone.
Fantastic Voyage#260.dst: この謎の地へ、いざ踏み出した！
Fantastic Voyage#260.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#263.src: For adventurers like us, an incredible cave, perfect to explore.
Fantastic Voyage#263.dst: 我らのような冒険者には、探索にうってつけの見事な洞窟だ。
Fantastic Voyage#263.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#264.src: Surely where my old friend ventured - just as I swore!
Fantastic Voyage#264.dst: 我が旧友が挑んだのは、きっとここだ、誓った通りだ！
Fantastic Voyage#264.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#265.src: Long ago, a strong adventurer like yourself reached out to me for a wonderful sail. It truly is a gripping tale!
Fantastic Voyage#265.dst: 昔、君のような強い冒険者が、素晴らしい航海に誘ってくれた。実に手に汗握る物語だった！
Fantastic Voyage#265.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#266.src: We became best friends on our quest. But then he vanished, oh how he was the best.
Fantastic Voyage#266.dst: 旅の中で我らは親友となった。だが彼は消えた、ああ、最高の友だった。
Fantastic Voyage#266.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#267.src: And we've finally made it to where he'd been. I can't wait to see him again, I don't know where to begin!
Fantastic Voyage#267.dst: そしてついに、彼がいた場所に来た。また会えるのが待ちきれない、何から話そう、胸がいっぱいだ！
Fantastic Voyage#267.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#268.src: A mystical portal! This must be where my old friend got lost!
Fantastic Voyage#268.dst: 神秘の門だ！我が旧友はここで消えたに違いない！
Fantastic Voyage#268.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#269.src: We must go through and find him, whatever the cost.
Fantastic Voyage#269.dst: どんな犠牲を払っても、くぐって彼を見つけねばならない。
Fantastic Voyage#269.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#270.src: I can't believe it! I simply can't speak!
Fantastic Voyage#270.dst: 信じられない！言葉にならない！
Fantastic Voyage#270.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#271.src: I always told the others I wasn't a freak. Old friend, I'll look for you until the bitter end!
Fantastic Voyage#271.dst: 私は変人じゃないと、ずっと皆に言ってきた。旧友よ、最後の最後まで君を探そう、心に決めた！
Fantastic Voyage#271.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#272.src: Find Relend in the strange place
Fantastic Voyage#272.dst: 奇妙な場所で Relend を見つける

Fantastic Voyage#273.src: A foreign land filled with danger, to the brim...
Fantastic Voyage#273.dst: 危険に満ちた異郷の地、溢れんばかりに…
Fantastic Voyage#273.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#274.src: It must be where he vanished to, regardless of how grim.
Fantastic Voyage#274.dst: いかに陰惨でも、彼が消えた先はここに違いない、確かに。
Fantastic Voyage#274.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#275.src: My friend... Where do you think we are?
Fantastic Voyage#275.dst: 友よ…ここはどこだと思う？
Fantastic Voyage#275.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#276.src: Whatever it is, I feel that we're being overseen from afar.
Fantastic Voyage#276.dst: 何にせよ、遠くから見られている気がする、どうも。
Fantastic Voyage#276.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#277.src: With all this danger, I still hope my good friend is still okay.
Fantastic Voyage#277.dst: これほど危険でも、我が友の無事をまだ願っている。
Fantastic Voyage#277.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#278.src: My goodness! Keep your wits about, we may be in for a fray!
Fantastic Voyage#278.dst: なんと！気を引き締めろ、一戦交えることになりそうだ！
Fantastic Voyage#278.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#279.src: Aagh... New friend... are you there?
Fantastic Voyage#279.dst: うう…新しき友…そこにいるか？
Fantastic Voyage#279.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#280.src: Don't...give up... we must find him, I swear...
Fantastic Voyage#280.dst: 諦め…るな…彼を見つけねば、誓って…
Fantastic Voyage#280.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#281.src: I promise I'll find him, I'll do it, without a single scar!
Fantastic Voyage#281.dst: 必ず彼を見つける、やってみせる、傷ひとつ負わずに！
Fantastic Voyage#281.speaker: Relend

Fate of the Fallen#000.src: You can not return until your goal is fulfilled...
Fate of the Fallen#000.dst: 目的を果たすまで、戻ることはできない…

Fate of the Fallen#001.src: Talk to Telvu the mage at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Fate of the Fallen#001.dst: [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] で魔術師 Telvu と話す。

Fate of the Fallen#002.src: Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to gain entry to this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
Fate of the Fallen#002.dst: おや、{p} 軍の者か。この凍てついた墳墓に入ろうとしているところだ。力を貸してほしい。
Fate of the Fallen#002.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#003.src: Are you familiar with the story of Theorick and {p}?
Fate of the Fallen#003.dst: Theorick と {p} の話は知っているか？
Fate of the Fallen#003.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#004.src: Probably not. Well, you see, {p} was not always frozen.
Fate of the Fallen#004.dst: 知らないだろうな。実は、{p} は昔から凍っていたわけではない。
Fate of the Fallen#004.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#005.src: During Theorick's time, this place was like the Wynn plains, warm and arable.
Fate of the Fallen#005.dst: Theorick の時代、ここは Wynn の平原のように暖かく、耕作に適していた。
Fate of the Fallen#005.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#006.src: For some reason, Theorick Twain used his immense power to freeze the land before exiling himself here.
Fate of the Fallen#006.dst: なぜか Theorick Twain は強大な力でこの地を凍らせ、自らをここに追放した。
Fate of the Fallen#006.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#007.src: We need to find out why so we can reverse this spell. Presumably, the source of that spell's magic would lie within the barrow... but we don't want to go in empty-handed.
Fate of the Fallen#007.dst: この魔法を解くには理由を突き止めねば。魔力の源はおそらく墳墓の中にある…だが手ぶらで入りたくはない。
Fate of the Fallen#007.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#008.src: As such...have you heard of a place called {p}? We could use it to go back in time, to try to learn more about Theorick's actions.
Fate of the Fallen#008.dst: そこで…{p} という場所を聞いたことは？それを使って過去に戻り、Theorick の行いを探れるかもしれない。
Fate of the Fallen#008.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#009.src: Well...in a way, at least. There are laws to this sort of magic. For one, you need an item from the specific time we want to see. Second, you can witness the past, not change it.
Fate of the Fallen#009.dst: まあ…ある意味ではな。この手の魔法には法則がある。一つ、見たい時代の品が必要だ。二つ、過去は見られても変えられない。
Fate of the Fallen#009.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#010.src: One of Theorick's staves is on display in the {p} bank. Presumably, it should work for what we need. Could you retrieve it somehow?
Fate of the Fallen#010.dst: Theorick の杖の一本が {p} の銀行に展示されている。目的には使えるはずだ。どうにか取ってこられるか？
Fate of the Fallen#010.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#011.dst: {p} の銀行で Theorick の杖を見つける。

Fate of the Fallen#012.src: Aha, quick job. I see you've got the wand. Must've needed a sharp tongue to get the bankers to give it up.
Fate of the Fallen#012.dst: ははあ、早いな。杖を手に入れたか。銀行員に手放させるには、相当口が回ったのだろう。
Fate of the Fallen#012.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#013.src: Now, it is a long walk to {p}. Needn't take that walk, though, as I can teleport you there. Hopefully.
Fate of the Fallen#013.dst: さて、{p} までは長い道のりだ。だが歩く必要はない、私が転送しよう。たぶんな。
Fate of the Fallen#013.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#014.src: Once you're there, enter the Temple of Time. You should know what to do once you are there. Careful dealing with time travel, friend... No idea what you might find.
Fate of the Fallen#014.dst: 着いたら Temple of Time に入れ。そこへ行けば何をすべきか分かるはずだ。時間旅行には気をつけろ、友よ…何に出くわすか分からん。
Fate of the Fallen#014.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#015.dst: ポータルに入るだけでいい。
Fate of the Fallen#015.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#016.src: Should anything go wrong, I'll stay here to teleport you back to the temple.
Fate of the Fallen#016.dst: 何かあれば、ここに残って神殿へ転送し戻そう。
Fate of the Fallen#016.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#017.src: Enter the portal the mage made.
Fate of the Fallen#017.dst: 魔術師が作ったポータルに入る。

Fate of the Fallen#018.src: Enter the Gate of Time at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and travel back in time.
Fate of the Fallen#018.dst: [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の Gate of Time に入り、過去へ遡る。

Fate of the Fallen#019.dst: 過去の {p} を探索する。

Fate of the Fallen#021.src: Woah, your weaponry and armour is so advanced!
Fate of the Fallen#021.dst: うわ、君の武器も防具もすごく進んでる！
Fate of the Fallen#021.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#022.src: Are you another Twain? Only the Twains know magic like that.
Fate of the Fallen#022.dst: Twain 家の人？あんな魔法は Twain 家しか使えないよ。
Fate of the Fallen#022.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#023.dst: ああ、Theorick を探してるんだ。
Fate of the Fallen#023.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#024.src: He's busy fighting in the war, shouldn't you be doing the same?
Fate of the Fallen#024.dst: 彼は戦争で忙しいよ。君も戦うべきじゃない？
Fate of the Fallen#024.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#025.src: He went west. There was some kind of emergency.
Fate of the Fallen#025.dst: 西へ向かったよ。何か緊急事態があったみたい。
Fate of the Fallen#025.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#026.src: We've been fighting the corruption for years, it seems like it might finally engulf {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#026.dst: 僕らは何年も腐敗と戦ってきた。ついに {p} まで飲み込まれそうなんだ。
Fate of the Fallen#026.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#027.src: Find Theorick in the forest west of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Fate of the Fallen#027.dst: {p} の西の森で Theorick を見つける [{~1}, {~2}, {~3}]。

Fate of the Fallen#028.src: I could've sworn she had gone this way... Oh, what now, more imbeciles? This forest isn't safe to travel!
Fate of the Fallen#028.dst: 確かにこっちへ行ったはずだが…ああ、今度は何だ、また愚か者か？この森は危険なんだぞ！
Fate of the Fallen#028.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#029.src: If you need help, lodge a complaint with the guards. I'm busy and I can't exactly break away from saving this god-blessed province to chill your milk!!
Fate of the Fallen#029.dst: 助けが要るなら衛兵に苦情でも出せ。私は忙しい。この忌々しい地方を救う最中に、お前の牛乳を冷やしに行けるか！！
Fate of the Fallen#029.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#030.src: Are your ears full of wax?! I said-
Fate of the Fallen#030.dst: 耳が詰まってるのか？！言っただろう―
Fate of the Fallen#030.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#031.src: Urgh, the things followed you! See what happens?! STAND ASIDE.
Fate of the Fallen#031.dst: くっ、奴らがついて来た！ほら見ろ！どいていろ。
Fate of the Fallen#031.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#032.src: As though I needed TWO people to save! Now get out of here, I have to find that woman who went missing!
Fate of the Fallen#032.dst: 助ける相手が二人も要るか！さっさと失せろ、行方不明の女を探さねばならんのだ！
Fate of the Fallen#032.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#033.src: HEEEELP! I can't outrun them!!! Guards! Someone!!
Fate of the Fallen#033.dst: 助けてー！逃げ切れない！！！衛兵！誰か！！

Fate of the Fallen#034.src: Whuh! That's her voice! Where is she?! I just cleared this area!
Fate of the Fallen#034.dst: むっ！あの女の声だ！どこだ？！この辺りは片付けたばかりだぞ！
Fate of the Fallen#034.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#036.src: Ugh, is she dragging them over from the west?! You there, If you don't want to end up frozen, GET BEHIND ME, NOW!!
Fate of the Fallen#036.dst: くっ、西から奴らを引き連れてきたのか？！そこのお前、凍りたくなければ今すぐ私の後ろに下がれ！！
Fate of the Fallen#036.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#037.src: Phew... You're out of danger now. If you hadn't left town, though, you wouldn't have been IN any danger at all!
Fate of the Fallen#037.dst: ふう…もう安全だ。だが町を出なければ、そもそも危険な目に遭うこともなかったんだ！
Fate of the Fallen#037.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#038.src: Don't bother apologizing to me, just get back to town. Now.
Fate of the Fallen#038.dst: 謝るのはいい、町に戻れ。今すぐだ。
Fate of the Fallen#038.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#039.src: Next time you feel like picking flowers in the forest or whatever you were doing, remember you have a life to live, hm?!
Fate of the Fallen#039.dst: 次に森で花摘みだか何だかしたくなったら、自分の命を思い出せ、いいな？！
Fate of the Fallen#039.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#040.src: Every day, more corrupteds, more deaths... There is only one thing for it. I have to tackle it myself. Cut the roots...and kill this hellish weed.
Fate of the Fallen#040.dst: 毎日、腐敗体は増え、死者も増える…手はひとつ。私自ら片をつける。根を断ち…この地獄の雑草を殺す。
Fate of the Fallen#040.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#041.src: Still here? Well, listen up. Myself and a few others are planning something risky. Damned be it if our minds are lost, I need to go through that portal.
Fate of the Fallen#041.dst: まだいたのか？なら聞け。私と数人で危険な計画を立てている。正気を失おうが構わん、あのポータルを通らねばならん。
Fate of the Fallen#041.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#042.src: You look heavily geared, so I'm conscripting you. Meet us at our base, immediately. Follow the river south and you'll see a house on the right side.
Fate of the Fallen#042.dst: 装備は立派なようだから、お前を徴用する。直ちに拠点に来い。川沿いに南へ行けば、右手に家が見える。
Fate of the Fallen#042.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#043.src: Head to the base of the operation south of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Fate of the Fallen#043.dst: {p} の南にある作戦拠点へ向かう [{~1}, {~2}, {~3}]。

Fate of the Fallen#044.src: Well, I'll give you this. You're prompt to listen to orders, at least. We're headed to the {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#044.dst: まあ、これは認めよう。少なくとも命令にはすぐ従うな。我々は {p} へ向かう。
Fate of the Fallen#044.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#045.src: The last man that entered the portal and returned became Bak’al... But if there is even a fraction of a chance this could work, we must take it at this point.
Fate of the Fallen#045.dst: ポータルに入って戻った最後の男は Bak’al になった…だがわずかでも可能性があるなら、今はそれに賭けるしかない。
Fate of the Fallen#045.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#046.src: Let's get moving. We'll be taking no breaks on the trip, so I hope you were prepared.
Fate of the Fallen#046.dst: 出発だ。道中休憩はなしだ、準備はできているだろうな。
Fate of the Fallen#046.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#047.src: Now. The sheer cold I command can stave off corruption itself. Somehow I doubt any of you can say the same. I'll go in alone.
Fate of the Fallen#047.dst: さて。私の操る極寒は腐敗そのものを食い止められる。お前たちに同じことが言えるとは思えん。私一人で入る。
Fate of the Fallen#047.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#048.src: When I enter... If I had to make an assumption, corrupteds will swarm the portal after me. Your job? Slay them. I can't have distractions in there.
Fate of the Fallen#048.dst: 私が入れば…推測だが、腐敗体が後を追ってポータルに群がるだろう。お前の役目？奴らを倒せ。中で気を散らすわけにはいかん。
Fate of the Fallen#048.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#049.src: You will not be leaving your post here until I exit that portal. Understood?
Fate of the Fallen#049.dst: 私がポータルから出るまで、持ち場を離れるな。分かったな？
Fate of the Fallen#049.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#052.src: ...no, no, no no no NO!! DAMN IT ALL!!
Fate of the Fallen#052.dst: …だめだ、だめだ、だめだ！！くそっ！！
Fate of the Fallen#052.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#053.src: You know what happened?! I lost!! I will destroy the province if I turn completely! GET AWAY, NOW! DO YOU HEAR ME?! RUN!!
Fate of the Fallen#053.dst: 何が起きたか分かるか？！負けたんだ！！完全に変わり果てれば、私は地方を滅ぼす！離れろ、今すぐ！聞こえるか？！逃げろ！！
Fate of the Fallen#053.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#054.src: I... C-calm yourself, Theorick...don't...don't lose yourself to it...there's...yet a solution...one way...
Fate of the Fallen#054.dst: 私は…お、落ち着け、Theorick…飲まれるな…まだ…解決策は…一つ…
Fate of the Fallen#054.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#055.src: Oh...you again...the others...dead? Run off? Cowards...urgh...
Fate of the Fallen#055.dst: ああ…またお前か…他の者は…死んだ？逃げた？臆病者め…うぐっ…
Fate of the Fallen#055.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#056.src: You live...so...eyes up. Listen to me. If I turn...w-when...when I turn...n-no, can't...gaaah, I'll destr- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#056.dst: 生きているなら…顔を上げろ。聞け。私が変われば…い、いや、変わった時…だ、だめだ…ぐああ、私は滅ぼ…んぐっ…
Fate of the Fallen#056.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#057.src: I won't last, you can tell... Right now...killing me is an impossibility, you idiotic weakl- Agh, GET OUT OF MY MIND!!
Fate of the Fallen#057.dst: 長くはもたん、分かるだろう…今…私を殺すのは不可能だ、この愚かな弱…ぐっ、私の頭から出ていけ！！
Fate of the Fallen#057.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#058.src: Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too fargone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
Fate of the Fallen#058.dst: ぐああ…皆に…伝えろ。私はこの地を凍らせる。私は…も、もう手遅れだ。この地には癒える時間が要る…そして私の力は、封じ…凍らせねば…
Fate of the Fallen#058.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#059.src: All worthless... Urgh, no...they yet deserve life...and this spell...it will surely claim some. Please, let them know why...
Fate of the Fallen#059.dst: 皆、役立たずだ…いや、違う…彼らにも生きる資格はある…この魔法は…必ず犠牲を出す。どうか、理由を伝えてくれ…
Fate of the Fallen#059.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#060.src: If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits to linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
Fate of the Fallen#060.dst: あの鼻持ちならない奴…Mael から学んだことがあるとすれば…理由なき死は魂をさまよわせる。あいつにこれ以上苦労をかけたくはない。
Fate of the Fallen#060.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#061.src: K-keep advancing. Your things, if everyone was as strong as you...we may stand a chance. This could end me, in time, once I am weaker.
Fate of the Fallen#061.dst: す、進み続けろ。お前の装備…皆がお前ほど強ければ…勝ち目はあるかもしれん。私が弱った暁には、これで私を終わらせられるだろう。
Fate of the Fallen#061.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#062.src: Let it be known...Theorick Twain is not dead. He cannot be killed...all will burn...until future days. Here, in this accursed place. Find me...and end it all.
Fate of the Fallen#062.dst: 知らしめよ…Theorick Twain は死んでいない。殺すことはできぬ…全ては燃える…未来の日まで。ここ、この呪われた地で。私を見つけ…全てを終わらせよ。
Fate of the Fallen#062.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#063.src: Tell Telvu the mage what happened.
Fate of the Fallen#063.dst: 魔術師 Telvu に何があったか伝える。

Fate of the Fallen#064.src: You must have succeeded, or you would be yet in the memory of the past. I can feel some potent magic on you.
Fate of the Fallen#064.dst: 成功したようだな、でなければまだ過去の記憶の中にいるはずだ。君から強い魔力を感じる。
Fate of the Fallen#064.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#065.src: So, you met Theorick? He was always said to have fallen from heroism after the great freezing.
Fate of the Fallen#065.dst: それで、Theorick に会ったのか？大凍結の後、彼は英雄から堕ちたと言われてきた。
Fate of the Fallen#065.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#066.src: Were you able to figure out why it was he froze this place, at least?
Fate of the Fallen#066.dst: せめて、なぜ彼がここを凍らせたのかは分かったか？
Fate of the Fallen#066.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#067.src: What... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true this palce has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
Fate of the Fallen#067.dst: 何と…これほどの真実が…氷の魔法が腐敗を防ぐ…？確かにここは地方の他の場所より腐敗の脅威が少なかった…
Fate of the Fallen#067.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#068.src: Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... This was to protect everyone...but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
Fate of the Fallen#068.dst: なんということだ…ずっと勘違いしていた…これは皆を守るためだった…だが正気なら、誰かに意図を伝えたはずだ！
Fate of the Fallen#068.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#069.src: All this time, spent buried alive, wrestling with the corruption. The thought horrifies you, as well, judging by your face. Killing him would be a mercy.
Fate of the Fallen#069.dst: これほど長く、生き埋めのまま腐敗と戦ってきたとは。その顔を見るに、君もぞっとしているようだな。彼を殺すことは慈悲になるだろう。
Fate of the Fallen#069.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#070.src: Here. Use this. It may help protect you within the Ice Barrows... Please, soldier. Be Theorick's guardian angel. Free him from this torment.
Fate of the Fallen#070.dst: ほら、これを使え。氷の墳墓の中で身を守ってくれるかもしれない……頼む、兵士よ。Theorick の守護天使になってくれ。彼をこの苦しみから解き放ってやってくれ。
Fate of the Fallen#070.speaker: Telvu

Finding the Light#000.src: What you have done may not have been the right thing, by anyone's account. However, it was necessary. You have thrown off your bonds, in a sense.
Finding the Light#000.dst: 誰から見ても正しい行いではなかったかもしれぬ。だが、必要だった。ある意味、お前は己の枷を振り払ったのだ。

Finding the Light#001.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
Finding the Light#001.dst: 新しいクエスト開始: 光の領域 IV - 光を求めて

Finding the Light#002.src: That should have cracked open the foundation! You should check to see if you can reach the archive mentioned by the note card.
Finding the Light#002.dst: 今ので土台が割れたはずだ！メモのカードにあった書庫へ行けるか確かめよう。

Finding the Light#003.src: The door down below should open, now that you've activated the mechanisms.
Finding the Light#003.dst: 仕掛けを作動させたので、下の扉が開くはずだ。

Finding the Light#004.src: Some of the few pages are ripped out. It seems to be describing an event occurring with the Guardian of the Forest until the first missing page.
Finding the Light#004.dst: 何ページか破り取られている。最初の欠けたページまでは、森の守護者に起きた出来事が書かれているようだ。

Finding the Light#005.src: The rest of the book is in perfect condition- Who could've done this if the archives were locked away? Did someone enter before you?
Finding the Light#005.dst: 本の残りは無傷だ。書庫が封じられていたなら誰の仕業だ？先に誰かが入ったのか？

Finding the Light#006.src: ...so it returned, asleep and unwakeable. The light has spoken of a time when the Guardian shall grace us with its presence once more...
Finding the Light#006.dst: …こうしてそれは戻り、眠ったまま目覚めなくなった。光は語った、守護者が再び我らの前に現れる時が来ると…

Finding the Light#007.src: ...but such a time is centuries off, and will require great effort. The spell included is vital to the process.
Finding the Light#007.dst: …だがその時は数百年先で、多大な努力を要する。同封の呪文はその過程に不可欠だ。

Finding the Light#008.src: The light also warns- If the darkness should encroach and reach the Guardian's roots, it shall never wake... But it seems we will not have to worry of that.
Finding the Light#008.dst: 光は警告もした。闇が迫り守護者の根に達すれば、二度と目覚めぬと…だが、その心配はなさそうだ。

Finding the Light#009.src: There's another loose page here, with more High Gavellian text on it. Lari should be able to translate this.
Finding the Light#009.dst: ここにも破れたページがあり、高位 Gavel 語が書かれている。Lari なら訳せるはずだ。

Finding the Light#010.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thus far, it seems.
Finding the Light#010.dst: …さあ、やって。今のところ、私はあなたの通訳でしかないみたいね。

Finding the Light#012.src: The voice of the Light told you to pursue her. You shouldn't stop now, should you?
Finding the Light#012.dst: 光の声は彼女を追えと告げた。今さら止まるわけにはいかないだろう？

Finding the Light#013.src: The building looks climbable... You can probably eavesdrop on the conversation if you climb up the walls.
Finding the Light#013.dst: この建物は登れそうだ…壁を登れば、会話を盗み聞きできるかもしれない。

Finding the Light#014.dst: 出てって！とにかく…出てって。

Finding the Light#015.src: You got the plant! You should return by the Guardian of the Forest to proceed.
Finding the Light#015.dst: 植物を手に入れた！森の守護者のもとへ戻って先へ進もう。

Finding the Light#016.src: I DON'T CARE ANYMORE! STOP STEALING MY LIFE LIKE THIS!!!
Finding the Light#016.dst: もうどうでもいい！こんなふうに私の人生を奪わないで！！！

Finding the Light#018.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS "ENOUGH!" TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#018.dst: …ぐああああっ！！これのどこが「十分」なの！今すぐ答えて！

Finding the Light#019.src: To do something "dark," you are about to say, and to that I say you have not.
Finding the Light#019.dst: 「闇」に手を染めた、と言うのだろう。だがそうではない。

Finding the Light#020.src: For a thousand years or more of your own thoughts, I understand that you are conflicted.
Finding the Light#020.dst: 千年以上も独りで考え続けたのだ。迷うのも無理はない。

Finding the Light#021.src: However... You have, in that time, made a grave error. You have grown to realize an incorrect assumption.
Finding the Light#021.dst: だが…その間にお前は重大な過ちを犯した。誤った思い込みを真実と信じたのだ。

Finding the Light#022.src: Dark and Light... They oppose. They clash. They create a cloying pox. But, allow me to ask.
Finding the Light#022.dst: 闇と光…両者は対立し、衝突し、息苦しい病を生む。だが、問わせてほしい。

Finding the Light#023.src: Is the axe evil for chopping the tree? Is the wood evil for resisting the metal?
Finding the Light#023.dst: 木を切る斧は悪か？金属に抗う木は悪か？

Finding the Light#024.src: Are the flames evil for burning up the leaves? Is the water evil for dousing the fire?
Finding the Light#024.dst: 葉を焼く炎は悪か？火を消す水は悪か？

Finding the Light#025.src: Is a victim evil for striking back against those that have struck them?
Finding the Light#025.dst: 自分を傷つけた者に反撃する被害者は悪か？

Finding the Light#026.src: And most importantly... Are any of these things light, or dark?
Finding the Light#026.dst: そして何より…これらのうち、光はどれで、闇はどれだ？

Finding the Light#027.src: I will not ask you to. You must understand that Orphion has no moral bearings- He simply needs action.
Finding the Light#027.dst: 無理にとは言わぬ。Orphion に善悪の基準はないと知るのだ。彼はただ行動を求めている。

Finding the Light#028.src: I admit, such a thing is a conundrum. I agree that it is a tragedy to kill, in many instances.
Finding the Light#028.dst: 確かに難問だ。多くの場合、殺すことは悲劇だと私も思う。

Finding the Light#029.src: Yet when such an action could save the lives of others, it becomes a conundrum with no answer. An impossible value to weigh.
Finding the Light#029.dst: だがその行いが他者の命を救うなら、答えのない難問となる。量りようのない重さだ。

Finding the Light#030.src: Despite the circumstances, you have done the best you could. I cannot fault you for your thoughts and morals.
Finding the Light#030.dst: あの状況で、お前は最善を尽くした。その考えも良心も責められはせぬ。

Finding the Light#031.src: And so... As you are now proven, as I am awoken, the gateway to the Light shall reveal itself to you. Lari... You must prepare for your journey to the Realm of Light.
Finding the Light#031.dst: そして…お前が証を立て、私が目覚めた今、光への門が姿を現すだろう。Lari…光の領域への旅に備えるのだ。

Finding the Light#032.src: I do not blame you for it. By the time you have composed yourself, your ally will be ready. Understand that they are as necessary as you are.
Finding the Light#032.dst: お前を責めはせぬ。心が落ち着く頃には、仲間の準備も整っていよう。彼らもお前と同じく欠かせぬ存在なのだ。

Finding the Light#033.src: I must ask you to pay close attention. I shall present it simply- though the enormity of this cannot be understated.
Finding the Light#033.dst: よく聞いてほしい。簡潔に話そう。事の重大さは言い尽くせぬがな。

Finding the Light#034.src: This is our world, the world we stand in right now. The physical plane of existence.
Finding the Light#034.dst: これが我らの世界、今立っている世界。存在の物質界だ。

Finding the Light#035.src: Only a select few are aware that there is more of the world than this. Even the astronomers and those who view the enormity of the sky cannot understand.
Finding the Light#035.dst: これ以上の世界があると知る者はごく僅かだ。広大な空を眺める天文学者でさえ理解できぬ。

Finding the Light#036.src: For, you see, this realm, this plane- It is mirrored upon a second plane, as the embodiments of Realms clash.
Finding the Light#036.dst: この界は第二の界に映し出されている。そこで諸領域の化身がぶつかり合うのだ。

Finding the Light#037.src: This is the Plane of Influence, comprised of many realms. There are three you must know- But only one you must pay attention to.
Finding the Light#037.dst: それが影響界、多くの領域から成る界だ。知るべきは三つ。だが注意すべきは一つだけだ。

Finding the Light#038.src: The Realms of Influence are connected to the physical plane, tied inexorably so to it. This is why even those gazing at the cosmos cannot grasp the enormity of it.
Finding the Light#038.dst: 影響の領域は物質界と切っても切れぬほど結びついている。ゆえに宇宙を見つめる者にも全容は掴めぬ。

Finding the Light#039.src: These realms are in a constant push and pull- Battles that could not be seen by those of this world, waged constantly.
Finding the Light#039.dst: これらの領域は絶えず押し合い引き合っている。この世界の者には見えぬ戦いが続いているのだ。

Finding the Light#040.src: However, they can be felt. Wide-scale changes to the balance of one realm or another are reflected on the physical plane.
Finding the Light#040.dst: だが、感じ取ることはできる。いずれかの領域の均衡が大きく揺らげば、物質界にも表れる。

Finding the Light#041.src: The Realms of Influence are, themselves, reflections of a Beast- They themselves, a physical manifestation of their realm, as their realm is a manifestation of them.
Finding the Light#041.dst: 影響の領域そのものが、ある獣の映し身だ。獣はその領域の具現であり、領域もまた獣の具現なのだ。

Finding the Light#042.src: So surely, you must know- As Gavel has decayed, it must mean that the Realm of Light is in peril, and thus that Orphion is, as well.
Finding the Light#042.dst: ならば分かるだろう。Gavel が腐朽した以上、光の領域は危機にあり、Orphion もまた危ういのだ。

Finding the Light#043.src: The Light is infected- That abominable parasite has breached the Realm of Light, and sought Orphion to leech away his light.
Finding the Light#043.dst: 光は侵されている。あの忌まわしき寄生体が光の領域に入り込み、Orphion の光を吸い取ろうとしている。

Finding the Light#044.src: And so, as the sun is forced to set, the land of Gavel grows dark. As the dark parasites spread and devour the minds of those here, so too is Orphion subject to this torture.
Finding the Light#044.dst: ゆえに陽は沈まされ、Gavel の地は暗くなってゆく。闇の寄生体が人々の心を喰らうように、Orphion もまた同じ責め苦を受けている。

Finding the Light#045.src: Now, you must enter the Realm of Light, and aid Lari in purging the parasite, before its work is finished and Orphion's mind is consumed.
Finding the Light#045.dst: さあ、光の領域へ入り、Lari と共に寄生体を祓うのだ。その企みが成り、Orphion の心が喰い尽くされる前に。

Finding the Light#046.src: You must ready yourself before this, of course. To venture to another realm is a lofty task.
Finding the Light#046.dst: 無論、その前に備えねばならぬ。別の領域へ赴くのは大事業だ。

Finding the Light#047.src: I will bestow upon you two things that will surely aid you in this, however. First, I shall provide you the way to the Gateway to Light.
Finding the Light#047.dst: だが、きっと助けとなるものを二つ授けよう。まずは、光への門への道を示す。

Finding the Light#048.src: Once you have reached it, I shall bestow upon you a personal blessing of mine, in the hopes that your path will become clear.
Finding the Light#048.dst: そこに辿り着いたなら、私自らの祝福を授けよう。お前の道が明らかになるように。

Finding the Light#049.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Lari を見つける。

Finding the Light#050.dst: 目覚めて！導きが必要なの！
Finding the Light#050.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#051.src: ...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
Finding the Light#051.dst: …あら。{u}。ここでもあなたが必要とされてるってわけ？
Finding the Light#051.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#052.src: I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
Finding the Light#052.dst: 私は…必死に…森の守護者を目覚めさせて導きを得ようとしてるのに、びくともしない！Orphion の声にすら反応しないの。
Finding the Light#052.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#053.src: I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
Finding the Light#053.dst: もう一度お願い、目覚めて！私たち二人は…あなたの知恵を求めてるの！
Finding the Light#053.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#054.src: I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Finding the Light#054.dst: Orphion のかすかな光を捧げます。どうか、応えて！
Finding the Light#054.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#055.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#055.dst: うう…ほらね？何も起きない。もうどうしたらいいか分からない。今までのあなたなら、何か変えられるかも。
Finding the Light#055.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#056.src: My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.
Finding the Light#056.dst: 我が脈動よ、時は来た。守護者の根に我が光を照らそう。お前と彼女は、今こそ学ばねばならぬ。

Finding the Light#057.src: Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.
Finding the Light#057.dst: 大樹の根元の碑文を読む。

Finding the Light#058.src: An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
Finding the Light#058.dst: 碑文だわ！さっきまでなかったのに！それが…一瞬で現れた。一体どうやって…？
Finding the Light#058.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#059.src: But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
Finding the Light#059.dst: でも、とにかく！私だって役に立てる、訳してあげる！Gavel のよそ者に高位 Gavel 語は分からないでしょうし…
Finding the Light#059.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#060.src: It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
Finding the Light#060.dst: こう書いてある…秘密は {p} で最も古い図書館で明かされる、と。
Finding the Light#060.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#061.src: ...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
Finding the Light#061.dst: …そういうこと。エルフは入れないけど、人間は入れる場所。{u}、この図書館は自分で探すしかなさそうね。
Finding the Light#061.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#062.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Finding the Light#062.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある {p} の街で教会の図書館を見つける。

Finding the Light#063.src: Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.
Finding the Light#063.dst: 教会の頂上にある鐘まで登る方法を探す。

Finding the Light#064.src: Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.
Finding the Light#064.dst: 秘密の図書館を探索し、木を目覚めさせる方法を見つける。

Finding the Light#065.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Lari のもとへ戻る

Finding the Light#066.src: Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Finding the Light#066.dst: Orphion の光を拒むというの？お願い、目覚めて！
Finding the Light#066.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#067.src: Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
Finding the Light#067.dst: うう…{u}、何か進展があったと言って。守護者はまだ…全然…目覚めない！
Finding the Light#067.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#068.src: What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
Finding the Light#068.dst: これは何？呪文の巻物…目覚めの森の？！よりによって {p} で？私には…とても行けない場所なのに…
Finding the Light#068.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#069.src: So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
Finding the Light#069.dst: 私は Orphion に選ばれたのに、頼まれたことすらできなかったのね。それは…いえ、考えても仕方ない。巻物を見せて。
Finding the Light#069.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#070.src: ...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
Finding the Light#070.dst: …ふむ。求める者はこの言葉を守護者の言葉の上に置くべし、と。
Finding the Light#070.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#071.src: I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
Finding the Light#071.dst: つまり、碑文のそばに置けってことね。またあなたがやらなきゃいけない仕事か…
Finding the Light#071.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#072.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thusfar, it seems.
Finding the Light#072.dst: …どうぞ、やって。今のところ私はただの通訳みたいだし。
Finding the Light#072.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#073.src: Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.
Finding the Light#073.dst: 木の下の碑文に呪文を使う。

Finding the Light#074.src: Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
Finding the Light#074.dst: これも読ませて。骨が折れそうだけど…
Finding the Light#074.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#075.src: It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
Finding the Light#075.dst: こう書いてある…森の守護者を目覚めさせるには魔法だけでは足りない。エルフの故郷に答えと啓示がある…？
Finding the Light#075.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#076.src: That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
Finding the Light#076.dst: それって…ついに私の出番だわ！まだ私にもできることがある！！ここで現状を保つだけじゃなく、やっと何かができる！
Finding the Light#076.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#077.src: Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
Finding the Light#077.dst: 聞いて、{u}。Achara…今度は私の番。やっと直接あなたを助けられる。{p} の長老たちを知ってるの。きっと答えをくれるわ！
Finding the Light#077.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#078.src: You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
Finding the Light#078.dst: 私が悩んでる間も、あなたは本当に助けてくれた。感謝してる。でももう休んでいいわ！今回は私がやる！
Finding the Light#078.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#079.src: You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
Finding the Light#079.dst: あなたは…他にやるべきことをやってて。いろんな場所で人助けしてるのを見てきたわ。今はそっちに専念して。ここは私に任せて。
Finding the Light#079.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#080.src: Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.
Finding the Light#080.dst: 彼女を追え、我が脈動よ。彼女は決死の行動をとらねばならぬ。独りではその光は何も照らさぬ。道を示してやれ。

Finding the Light#081.src: Enter the portal Lari left behind
Finding the Light#081.dst: Lari が残したポータルに入る

Finding the Light#082.src: Go to the hut Lari entered.
Finding the Light#082.dst: Lari が入った小屋へ行く。

Finding the Light#083.src: W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
Finding the Light#083.dst: な、何？あなた…なんでついて来たの？私ならやれる！やっとまた役に立てるのに！私を…信用してないの？
Finding the Light#083.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#084.src: Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
Finding the Light#084.dst: お願い、私の意思を尊重して！助けが要るなら私から探しに行く。今は帰って！あなたが心配することじゃない！
Finding the Light#084.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#085.src: Find a way to sneak into the hut.
Finding the Light#085.dst: 小屋に忍び込む方法を探す。

Finding the Light#086.src: ...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
Finding the Light#086.dst: …この人間が本当にお前の言う通りのことを成したなら、なぜ助けを拒む？お前らしくもない。
Finding the Light#086.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#087.src: I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
Finding the Light#087.dst: 分かってる、分かってるわ。ただ信じられないの。Orphion 本人に呼ばれて、Taproot にも入れて、Orphion の祝福の印まで持ってるのよ！！
Finding the Light#087.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#088.src: They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
Finding the Light#088.dst: あの人は…ふらっと現れて、私が千年も人生を捧げてこの州を救おうとしてきたのに、私にできなかったことを数週間で全部やってのけたのよ！
Finding the Light#088.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#089.src: Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
Finding the Light#089.dst: これがどれだけ腹立たしいか分かる？私の立場になったこともないのに、分かるっていうの？
Finding the Light#089.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#090.src: No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
Finding the Light#090.dst: いや。分からぬ。だが、なぜこの助けに感謝せぬのかも分からぬ。
Finding the Light#090.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#091.src: I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
Finding the Light#091.dst: 感謝すべきなのは分かってる！ずっとそればかり考えてた。大喜びするべきなの！光は救われる、夢見たことそのものなのに…
Finding the Light#091.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#092.src: But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
Finding the Light#092.dst: でも、自分がまるで役立たずに思えるの。私のしてきたことが全部無駄で、ずっと何もかも間違えてたみたいで！
Finding the Light#092.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#093.src: I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
Finding the Light#093.dst: 過ちを犯したのは分かってる。私が早く動いていれば、Dullahan は今も…彼自身のままだった。でも何ひとつ正しくなかったなんて、受け入れられない。
Finding the Light#093.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#094.src: This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
Finding the Light#094.dst: これはまだ役に立てると証明するチャンスなの。Orphion が私を選んだのはまぐれじゃないって！お願い、碑文には長老なら行き先が分かるって！
Finding the Light#094.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#096.src: ...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
Finding the Light#096.dst: …千年経っても、我らには学ぶことが山ほどある。よかろう。
Finding the Light#096.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#097.src: But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
Finding the Light#097.dst: だが、差し伸べられた助けは受け入れると約束せよ。この機会を無駄にはできぬぞ、Lari。
Finding the Light#097.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#098.src: ...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
Finding the Light#098.dst: …せめて一つくらい正しいことをしなきゃ。いつまでも足踏みしてられない。必要なことは何でもする！
Finding the Light#098.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#099.src: You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
Finding the Light#099.dst: ならば Canned Abis という植物を探すのだ。巨大なシダの葉に覆われた洞窟の中にある。
Finding the Light#099.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#100.src: Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
Finding the Light#100.dst: ありがとうございます。やっと本来の役目を果たせる！今度は何にも邪魔させない！！
Finding the Light#100.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#101.src: ...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
Finding the Light#101.dst: …人間よ、見えておるぞ。彼女に見つからなかったのは幸運だったな。こちらへ来て話せ。
Finding the Light#101.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#103.src: So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
Finding the Light#103.dst: では、お前が Orphion の新たな選ばれし者か。意外でもあり、そうでもない。人間の評判は面白いからな。
Finding the Light#103.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#104.src: Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
Finding the Light#104.dst: 人間は何でも限りなく成し遂げると言われる。不可能な任務の達成であれ、道徳の戒めを破ることであれ。
Finding the Light#104.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#105.src: In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
Finding the Light#105.dst: だが今回は、その両方をせねばならぬ。Orphion が命じたのだろう？ならばやるしかない。そのことは詫びよう。
Finding the Light#105.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#106.src: I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
Finding the Light#106.dst: Lari の働きは見てきた。この地にかけがえのない貢献をした。独りで腐朽の南下を食い止め、ゆえに守護者は今も我らと共にある。
Finding the Light#106.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#107.src: However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
Finding the Light#107.dst: だが、彼女自身の道徳が事態の進展を阻んでいる。彼女は殺せぬ。そして再び光でこの地を満たすには、元凶を根絶せねばならぬ。
Finding the Light#107.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#108.src: Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Finding the Light#108.dst: Orphion の状況は切迫している。ゆえに理解してほしい。道徳において彼は我らの上にいる。そうした概念は当てはまらぬ。
Finding the Light#108.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#109.src: As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
Finding the Light#109.dst: 光そのものの化身として、彼に道徳の感覚はない。あるのは存続と維持のみ。その求めに、多くの者は尻込みしよう。
Finding the Light#109.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#110.src: It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
Finding the Light#110.dst: 道徳を脇に置かねばならぬ事柄だ…それこそ Lari には受け入れられぬ。千年もの間、頑なにそれにしがみついてきたのだから。
Finding the Light#110.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#111.src: To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
Finding the Light#111.dst: それを破るとは…正直、他に解決策があるとは思う。だが実のところ、もう時間が残されていないのだ。
Finding the Light#111.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#112.src: She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
Finding the Light#112.dst: 彼女は持てる力をすべて使わねばならぬが、不殺を貫く限りそれは叶わぬ。Orphion の望み通り、彼女の後を追ってくれ。
Finding the Light#112.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#113.src: There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#113.dst: 残念ながら、ここに正しさはない。あるのは必要だけだ。そこで彼女を限界まで追い込むのだ。Canned Abis の洞窟を探せ。
Finding the Light#113.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#114.src: It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
Finding the Light#114.dst: ここから北東だ。入口は巨大なシダの葉に覆われている。これで足りることを祈るばかりだ。
Finding the Light#114.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#115.src: Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Finding the Light#115.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Canned Abis の洞窟を見つける

Finding the Light#116.src: Find the plant inside the cave.
Finding the Light#116.dst: 洞窟の中で植物を見つける。

Finding the Light#118.src: ...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
Finding the Light#118.dst: …信じられない。私の何がいけないの？何なの？何か理由があるはず、それは何なの？！
Finding the Light#118.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#119.src: There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by "dire actions?!" I've done everything I can think of!
Finding the Light#119.dst: 新しい碑文もない…同じ言葉だけ！「決死の行動」ってどういう意味？！思いつくことは全部やったのに！
Finding the Light#119.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#120.src: ...{u}. I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#120.dst: …{u}。わ、私、知りたいの。Orphion はあなたに何て言ったの？もう知らないままなんて耐えられない。本当に私の代わりにされたの？

Finding the Light#121.src: Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
Finding the Light#121.dst: こ、これじゃまだ足りないの？あなたに縋って、役目もプライドも他人に譲るのが、まだ極端じゃないっていうの？！
Finding the Light#121.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#122.src: .... I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#122.dst: …わ、私。どうしても知りたい。Orphion はあなたに何を言ったの？もう知らないままは耐えられない。本当に私は用済みなの？
Finding the Light#122.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#123.src: I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
Finding the Light#123.dst: 私のすることが全部…うまくいかなくなった理由が他に思いつかない。そうなの？お願い、教えて――
Finding the Light#123.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#124.src: ...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
Finding the Light#124.dst: …待って…あなた…Canned Abis を持ってる！！どこで手に入れたの？！
Finding the Light#124.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#125.src: You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
Finding the Light#125.dst: あなた…知ってるはずがない、もし…あなた！盗み聞きしてたのね！！
Finding the Light#125.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#126.src: You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
Finding the Light#126.dst: 来ないでって頼んだのに、洞窟までついて来たのね！あなた…私があれだけ言ったのに！！私の心の内を全部聞いておきながら！
Finding the Light#126.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#127.src: You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
Finding the Light#127.dst: それでもまだ追ってくるのがいい考えだと思ったの！こんなことして何がしたいの？！
Finding the Light#127.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#128.src: What, are you thinking ‘’oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?‘’ IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#128.dst: 何、「変なエルフの子が何度も何度も失敗するのを見物しよう」って思ってるの？！そうなの？！
Finding the Light#128.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#129.src: You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
Finding the Light#129.dst: やっぱり聞いてたのね！！全部バレてる！私は成功できない！あなたがいる！私にできないことを全部やってる！
Finding the Light#129.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#130.src: I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
Finding the Light#130.dst: 私は役立たずじゃない！違う！そうはならない！絶対に！私がもがいてあがくのを見物なんてさせない！！
Finding the Light#130.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#133.src: Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
Finding the Light#133.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#136.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS ‘’ENOUGH!‘’ TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#136.dst: …ぐああああっ！！これのどこが「十分」なの！今すぐ答えて！
Finding the Light#136.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#137.src: I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
Finding the Light#137.dst: こ、殺しかけたのよ！私が守ってきたもの全部を、踏みにじって汚したのよ！！
Finding the Light#137.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#138.src: TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
Finding the Light#138.dst: 答えて！！どうしてこれが答えなの？！どうしてこうならなきゃいけなかったの？！
Finding the Light#138.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#139.src: WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
Finding the Light#139.dst: なぜ私がこんな…こんな…
Finding the Light#139.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#140.src: T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
Finding the Light#140.dst: わ、私にできないことをやったからって殺そうとしたのが、闇じゃないって？どうしてそう思えるの？！
Finding the Light#140.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#141.src: What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
Finding the Light#141.dst: こんな暴力を許すなんて、どういう守護者なの？今の私のどこが許されるっていうの？
Finding the Light#141.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#142.src: ...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
Finding the Light#142.dst: …あなた。私のしたことが正しかったなんて、言うはずないわよね。そんなの受け入れない。
Finding the Light#142.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#144.src: ...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
Finding the Light#144.dst: …だったら…感じるべきじゃないの…分からない。縛られてない感じとか？怖くないとか？もっと…自由だとか？
Finding the Light#144.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#145.src: If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
Finding the Light#145.dst: 私のしたことが必要なことだったなら、なぜ自分が最低のクズに思えるの？なぜこんなに苦しいの？！
Finding the Light#145.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#146.src: ...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
Finding the Light#146.dst: …私…考える時間が欲しい。私…これを聞くのが、受け止めるのがどれだけつらいか分かる？
Finding the Light#146.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#147.src: My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...
Finding the Light#147.dst: 我が脈動よ、お前の光は眩い…それは Lari を照らし、やがて彼女の光も我が方へ届くだろう…

Finding the Light#148.src: Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
Finding the Light#148.dst: 根に入り、我が領域への道を見届けよ。そして備えよ。最も眩い光を奮い起こすのだ…

Finding the Light#000~1.src: Enter the portal, {u}. I shall show you the Gateway to Light... And I shall wish you luck.
Finding the Light#000~1.dst: ポータルに入れ、{u}。光への門を示そう…そして幸運を祈る。

Finding the Light#056~1.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can effect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#056~1.dst: うう…ほらね？何も起きない。もうどうしたらいいかわからない。前にしてくれたことを考えたら、あなたなら何か変えられるかも。
Finding the Light#056~1.speaker: Lari

Flight in Distress#000.src: Bring your Gavellian Passport to the Airship Clerk at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Flight in Distress#000.dst: Gavel のパスポートを [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の飛行船の係員に持っていく。

Flight in Distress#001.src: Good day, soldier! Will you be flying with us today?
Flight in Distress#001.dst: こんにちは、兵隊さん！本日はご搭乗ですか？
Flight in Distress#001.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#002.src: May I see your passport please?
Flight in Distress#002.dst: パスポートを拝見します。
Flight in Distress#002.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#003.src: It's a bit dusty! It looks very old, but the picture looks like you.
Flight in Distress#003.dst: ちょっと埃っぽいですね！かなり古そうですが、写真はあなたですね。
Flight in Distress#003.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#004.src: Well everything seems to be in order, climb aboard and I hope you have a pleasant journey.
Flight in Distress#004.dst: はい、問題ありません。ご搭乗ください、快適な旅をお祈りします。
Flight in Distress#004.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#006.src: Please remain seated, passengers. We'll be taking off in a moment!
Flight in Distress#006.dst: 乗客の皆様、ご着席ください。まもなく離陸いたします！
Flight in Distress#006.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#007.src: Speak to Captain Ackbar regarding the missing child.
Flight in Distress#007.dst: 行方不明の子供について Captain Ackbar と話す。

Flight in Distress#008.src: Attention passengers. There has been a missing person reported aboard. If there are any volunteers to help search for them, please report to the bridge and speak to the captain.
Flight in Distress#008.dst: 乗客の皆様にお知らせします。船内で行方不明者の届けがありました。捜索にご協力いただける方は、艦橋で船長にお申し出ください。
Flight in Distress#008.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#009.src: This area is off limits to passengers during take off. Climb up to the passenger decks, there will be an attendee waiting at your cabin.
Flight in Distress#009.dst: 離陸中、この区域は乗客立入禁止です。客室デッキへお上がりください。お部屋で係員がお待ちしています。
Flight in Distress#009.speaker: Ship Crew

Flight in Distress#010.src: I hope I do not get nauseous...
Flight in Distress#010.speaker: Passenger Jeremy

Flight in Distress#011.src: Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
Flight in Distress#011.dst: やあ、若き冒険者よ。わしの眼鏡を見かけなかったかね？
Flight in Distress#011.speaker: Baron Axol

Flight in Distress#012.src: The interior of this ship is beautiful!
Flight in Distress#012.dst: この船の内装は素敵だ！
Flight in Distress#012.speaker: Passenger John

Flight in Distress#013.src: Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
Flight in Distress#013.dst: こんにちは、兵隊さん！こちらが今回のお部屋です。快適な空の旅を！
Flight in Distress#013.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#014.src: You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
Flight in Distress#014.dst: 他にすることがなければ、ここで寝て過ごしてもいいですよ！
Flight in Distress#014.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#015.src: The food they serve here is dreadful! As if it were meant for beasts they transport below deck.
Flight in Distress#015.dst: ここの食事はひどいわ！まるで下の甲板で運んでる獣のエサみたい。
Flight in Distress#015.speaker: Passenger Casula

Flight in Distress#016.src: *Sniff*... Have you seen my child? We were in our cabin, and then he just disappeared!
Flight in Distress#016.dst: *ぐすっ*…うちの子を見ませんでしたか？部屋にいたのに、急にいなくなったんです！
Flight in Distress#016.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#017.src: I heard that a big ship was approaching from north. I saw it from the entrance deck. I wonder what they are doing.
Flight in Distress#017.dst: 北から大きな船が近づいてるらしい。入口デッキから見えたよ。何をするつもりだろう。
Flight in Distress#017.speaker: Sub-engineer Akot

Flight in Distress#018.src: Are you here to volunteer to search for the missing child?
Flight in Distress#018.dst: 行方不明の子の捜索に志願してくれたのかね？
Flight in Distress#018.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#019.src: We only just to set off and there is already an incident.
Flight in Distress#019.dst: 出発したばかりなのに、もう事件だ。
Flight in Distress#019.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#020.src: His mother informed us that her son disappeared soon after boarding.
Flight in Distress#020.dst: 母親によると、乗船してすぐに息子がいなくなったそうだ。
Flight in Distress#020.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#021.src: Poor parenting, if you ask me. Alas, we must find the lad.
Flight in Distress#021.dst: 親の監督不行き届きだと思うがね。まあ、あの子を見つけねば。
Flight in Distress#021.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#022.src: Since we don't have any leads, it might be best to ask some of the passengers for information.
Flight in Distress#022.dst: 手がかりがないから、乗客に話を聞いて回るのがいいだろう。
Flight in Distress#022.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#023.src: Most of them will be in the dining area or in the lounge.
Flight in Distress#023.dst: ほとんどは食堂かラウンジにいるはずだ。
Flight in Distress#023.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#024.src: Thank you so much for your help; I hope you find the lad soon.
Flight in Distress#024.dst: 協力に感謝する。早くあの子が見つかるといいが。
Flight in Distress#024.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#025.src: Try and find out where the missing child is located by speaking to the passengers.
Flight in Distress#025.dst: 乗客たちに話を聞き、行方不明の子供の居場所を突き止める。

Flight in Distress#026.src: Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.
Flight in Distress#026.dst: ねえ！あっちの遠くの船を見て。出発してからずっとこの船について来てるんだ。
Flight in Distress#026.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#027.src: I know I shouldn't be down here but...
Flight in Distress#027.dst: ここにいちゃダメなのは分かってるけど…
Flight in Distress#027.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#028.src: I love airships, and I have never seen one like that.
Flight in Distress#028.dst: 飛行船が大好きなんだ。あんなの見たことないよ。
Flight in Distress#028.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#030.src: Okay then, I will head back right now!
Flight in Distress#030.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#032.src: Thank you so much for finding my child! He will not be leaving my side for the rest of the trip.
Flight in Distress#032.dst: うちの子を見つけてくれて本当にありがとう！残りの旅の間、この子は絶対にそばから離しません。
Flight in Distress#032.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#033.src: I'm sorry I caused such a worry earlier...
Flight in Distress#033.dst: さっきは心配かけてごめんなさい…
Flight in Distress#033.speaker: Found Child

Flight in Distress#034.src: Hello again, did you find him?
Flight in Distress#034.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#035.src: How did he get down there?! There is supposed to be someone on duty!
Flight in Distress#035.dst: どうして下に行けたんだ？！当番がいるはずだぞ！
Flight in Distress#035.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#036.src: Thank you so much for finding him. You were the only volunteer.
Flight in Distress#036.dst: 見つけてくれて本当にありがとう。志願者は君だけだった。
Flight in Distress#036.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#037.src: Hopefully that is the only hiccup in the journey.
Flight in Distress#037.dst: 旅のトラブルがこれだけで済むといいが。
Flight in Distress#037.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#038.src: What in good heavens was that? Crew, report!
Flight in Distress#038.dst: 一体何事だ？乗組員、報告しろ！
Flight in Distress#038.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#039.src: Sir! One of our engines blew out! We've lost all thrust on that side.
Flight in Distress#039.dst: 船長！エンジンが一基吹っ飛びました！そちら側の推力が全部失われました！
Flight in Distress#039.speaker: Airship Crewmember

Flight in Distress#040.src: Blast it all! We are sitting dead in the water without both engines.
Flight in Distress#040.dst: くそっ！エンジンが両方ないと、立ち往生だ。
Flight in Distress#040.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#041.src: Go check on the condition of the passengers.
Flight in Distress#041.dst: 乗客の様子を確認してきてくれ。
Flight in Distress#041.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#042.src: Soldier, go report to the Engineer in the engine room and see if there is anything you can do to help us get moving once again.
Flight in Distress#042.dst: 兵士よ、機関室の機関士のところへ行ってくれ。再び動けるよう、何か手伝えることがないか確かめてほしい。
Flight in Distress#042.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#043.src: Look if the engineer has something for you to do in order to help.
Flight in Distress#043.dst: 機関士に手伝えることがないか確かめる。

Flight in Distress#044.src: You must be the 'uman the captain done told me.
Flight in Distress#044.dst: おめえが船長の言ってた人間だな。
Flight in Distress#044.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#045.src: We sure are havin' quite the situation down 'ere.
Flight in Distress#045.dst: 下じゃ、えれえことになってるだ。
Flight in Distress#045.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#046.src: I hafta stay here and man the 'ngines, else she might damage 'erself.
Flight in Distress#046.dst: おらはここでエンジンを見てねえと、こいつが自分をぶっ壊しちまう。
Flight in Distress#046.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#047.src: If ye wanna help 'uman, go on up the riggin' and take a gander at the props.
Flight in Distress#047.dst: 手伝う気があんなら、索具を登ってプロペラを見てきてくれ。
Flight in Distress#047.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#048.src: Ye can get to 'em through the access 'atches in the bridge.
Flight in Distress#048.dst: 艦橋の点検口から行けるだ。
Flight in Distress#048.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#049.src: If'n they're stopped, just hit the breakers that are off.
Flight in Distress#049.dst: 止まってたら、落ちてるブレーカーを入れりゃいい。
Flight in Distress#049.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#050.src: Come back here when ye done. I need ta stay here and keep her cool.
Flight in Distress#050.dst: 終わったらここへ戻ってこい。おらはここでこいつを冷やさねえと。
Flight in Distress#050.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#051.src: Go find and fix the issue with the airship's engines. They are located on top of the balloon through the bridge.
Flight in Distress#051.dst: 飛行船のエンジンの不具合を見つけて直す。エンジンは艦橋から上がった気嚢の上にある。

Flight in Distress#052.src: In event of shut-down, maitenence must be performed.
Flight in Distress#052.dst: 停止時は、整備を行うこと。
Flight in Distress#052.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#053.src: Worker must restart all wooden switches before engine overheats.
Flight in Distress#053.dst: 作業員はエンジン過熱前に全ての木製スイッチを再起動すること。
Flight in Distress#053.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#054.src: DO NOT PRESS THE STONE SWITCHES
Flight in Distress#054.dst: 石製スイッチは押さないこと
Flight in Distress#054.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#055.src: Report to Engineer Eric that you fixed the engines.
Flight in Distress#055.dst: エンジンを直したことを Engineer Eric に報告する。

Flight in Distress#056.src: Thank ye! The 'ngines are back up and running!
Flight in Distress#056.dst: ありがとよ！エンジンがまた動き出しただ！
Flight in Distress#056.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#057.src: I couldn't have dun this without ye.
Flight in Distress#057.dst: おめえがいなきゃ無理だった。
Flight in Distress#057.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#058.src: You go back to yer quarters and get some rest. A passen'er like yerself shouldn' have to help the crew.
Flight in Distress#058.dst: 部屋へ戻って休んでくれ。おめえみてえな乗客が船員の手伝いなんぞするもんじゃねえ。
Flight in Distress#058.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#059.src: I hope the rest of yer journey is good. I'll let the cap'n know so he can turn her up ta max and get us movin' again.
Flight in Distress#059.dst: 残りの旅がいいもんになるといいな。船長に言って全開にしてもらって、また進むだ。
Flight in Distress#059.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#063.src: All staff report to stations! This is not a drill! All staff report to stations!
Flight in Distress#063.dst: 全乗組員、持ち場につけ！訓練ではない！全乗組員、持ち場につけ！
Flight in Distress#063.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#064.src: Explore the lower deck and find out what caused the explosion.
Flight in Distress#064.dst: 下層デッキを探索し、爆発の原因を突き止める。

Flight in Distress#065.src: Hol' togetha old girl, ye got this!
Flight in Distress#065.dst: しっかりしろ、おめえならやれる！
Flight in Distress#065.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#066.src: Men, hold her steady. We can still survive this! We just need to stop them following us.
Flight in Distress#066.dst: 野郎ども、船を安定させろ。まだ助かる！奴らの追跡を止めればいいんだ！
Flight in Distress#066.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#067.dst: もう一隻の船へ向かう。

Flight in Distress#068.src: Look here girls, the meat has come to us!
Flight in Distress#068.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#069.src: Send more in! They can't get all of us!
Flight in Distress#069.dst: もっと送り込め！全員は倒せないさ！
Flight in Distress#069.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#070.src: The rest of you all, get in here!
Flight in Distress#070.dst: 残りの奴らも、全員来な！
Flight in Distress#070.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#072.src: I heard fighting? Is someone there? I am in the jail cell!
Flight in Distress#072.dst: 戦いの音が？誰かいるのか？わしは牢屋の中だ！
Flight in Distress#072.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#074.src: I heard fighting above, well done! Any chance to see those raiders get what's coming warms my old heart.
Flight in Distress#074.dst: 上で戦っているのが聞こえた、見事だ！あの略奪者どもが報いを受けるのを見られるなら、この老骨も温まる。
Flight in Distress#074.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#075.src: I used to be the greatest locksmith in all of Gavel! I was known all over, unfortunately.
Flight in Distress#075.dst: わしはかつて Gavel 一の錠前師だった！不幸にも、あちこちに名が知れていてな。
Flight in Distress#075.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#076.src: These fiends captured me, years ago, and made me create hundreds of keys for their raids.
Flight in Distress#076.dst: この悪党どもは何年も前にわしを捕らえ、略奪用の鍵を何百本も作らせた。
Flight in Distress#076.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#077.src: I am much too old now, but I would love to see them taken down before I leave this world.
Flight in Distress#077.dst: もう年だが、この世を去る前に奴らが倒されるのを見たいものだ。
Flight in Distress#077.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#078.src: My key making gear is stored down the hall, behind the staircase. You can use them to craft a way inside the Queen's quarters.
Flight in Distress#078.dst: わしの鍵作りの道具は、廊下の先の階段の裏にしまってある。それで女王の部屋に入る鍵を作れるはずだ。
Flight in Distress#078.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#079.src: Just look into the keyhole to see how to make them. Good luck!
Flight in Distress#079.dst: 鍵穴を覗けば作り方が分かる。幸運を祈る！
Flight in Distress#079.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#080.src: Make the key to reach the Skyraider Queen.
Flight in Distress#080.dst: スカイレイダーの女王のもとへ行くための鍵を作る。

Flight in Distress#081.src: So you think you can just come on my ship, huh?
Flight in Distress#081.dst: あたしの船に乗り込めると思ったのかい？
Flight in Distress#081.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#082.src: Kill my crew? Interrupt my plunder?
Flight in Distress#082.dst: 手下を殺して？略奪の邪魔をして？
Flight in Distress#082.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#083.src: I know how to deal with 'problems' like you!
Flight in Distress#083.dst: あんたみたいな「厄介者」の扱いは心得てるよ！
Flight in Distress#083.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#084.src: Fight the Skyraider Queen and take one of her personal treasures with you.
Flight in Distress#084.dst: スカイレイダーの女王と戦い、彼女の私物の宝を一つ持ち帰る。

Flight in Distress#085.src: Escape the ship and speak to Captain Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#085.dst: 船から脱出し、Captain Ackbar と話す。

Flight in Distress#086.src: Wow, You single handedly took out a skyraider invasion.
Flight in Distress#086.dst: なんと、スカイレイダーの襲撃を一人で撃退するとは。
Flight in Distress#086.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#087.src: And you're a passenger! It's a good job you did...
Flight in Distress#087.dst: しかも乗客なのに！大した働きだった…
Flight in Distress#087.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#088.src: We have no defense on this ship. We are a civilian carrier.
Flight in Distress#088.dst: この船には防衛手段がない。民間の輸送船なのだ。
Flight in Distress#088.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#089.src: What is this? A ring from the queen? It looks valuable. You should keep it.
Flight in Distress#089.dst: これは？女王の指輪？高価そうだ。君が持っていたまえ。
Flight in Distress#089.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#090.src: I still do not know how to thank you... We owe you so much.
Flight in Distress#090.dst: どう礼をすればいいか…君には大きな借りができた。
Flight in Distress#090.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#091.src: Wait! I know! You can have free travel from {p} to {p}!
Flight in Distress#091.dst: 待て！そうだ！{p} と {p} の間を無料で移動できるようにしよう！
Flight in Distress#091.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#092.src: A private airship owner called Calo owes me big.
Flight in Distress#092.dst: Calo という自家用飛行船の持ち主に大きな貸しがある。
Flight in Distress#092.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#093.src: I will tell him the deal. All you have to do is enter his ship and he'll take you back and forth!
Flight in Distress#093.dst: 話はつけておく。彼の船に乗るだけで、往復で運んでくれるぞ！
Flight in Distress#093.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#094.src: Oh, and you will also be rewarded kindly monetarily. I will also personally send him the ring, so that it doesn't get damaged on the way, and you will receive it there.
Flight in Distress#094.dst: ああ、それから謝礼金もたっぷり出る。指輪は途中で傷まないよう私が直接彼に送っておくから、向こうで受け取ってくれ。
Flight in Distress#094.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#095.src: Just head down to the entrance deck, and we are about to arrive at {p} Airbase now.
Flight in Distress#095.dst: 入口デッキへ下りてくれ。まもなく {p} 空軍基地に到着する。
Flight in Distress#095.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#097.src: Head down to the entrance deck, and get off.
Flight in Distress#097.dst: 入口デッキへ下り、船を降りる。

Flight in Distress#098.src: Speak to Calo next to the little ship at the {p} docks.
Flight in Distress#098.dst: {p} の港にある小さな船の横で Calo と話す。

Flight in Distress#099.src: Hey there. You must be the Human Ackbar told me about.
Flight in Distress#099.dst: やあ。Ackbar が言ってた人間だな。
Flight in Distress#099.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#100.src: I heard what you did on the ship, very admirable. Fortunately for you, I owe Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#100.dst: 船でのことは聞いたよ、見事だった。運がいいな、俺は Ackbar に借りがある。
Flight in Distress#100.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#101.src: I'll take you from {p} to {p} or vice versa whenever you want.
Flight in Distress#101.dst: いつでも {p} から {p}、その逆でも乗せてやる。
Flight in Distress#101.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#102.src: All you have to do is board my ship. Oh, this was also from Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#102.dst: 俺の船に乗るだけでいい。ああ、これも Ackbar からだ。
Flight in Distress#102.speaker: Calo

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.src: Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin' to ya here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.dst: おい、おい、人間ちゃん！そう、あんたに話してんだよ…
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.src: Y'see, I got a few things here... look around for a bit, they're all very rare...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.dst: ほら、いいモンがあるだろ…ちょっと見てきな、どれも激レアだぜ…
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.src: I see that look in yer eyes... Ya interested in something here? It's all 'fa sale...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.dst: その目つき、分かるぜ…何か気になるモンでも？全部売りモンだ…
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.src: ..Say, humie... I ain't mean to alarm ya, but do ya know who that guy sneakin' up behind 'ye is?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.dst: …なあ、人間ちゃん…脅かす気はねえが、あんたの後ろに忍び寄ってるあいつ、誰だか知ってるか？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.src: OI! Wake up, you damned miscreant!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.dst: おい！起きろ、このクズ野郎！

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.src: Took ya long enough.. Alright, listen up, maggot!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.dst: ずいぶん寝てやがったな…よし、よく聞け、ウジ虫！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.src: We found ya outside of {p}, passed out near some dead body, and... Well, we had to arrest someone for that merchant's death!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.dst: {p} の外で、死体のそばでぶっ倒れてるお前を見つけてな…まあ、あの商人殺しで誰かを捕まえなきゃならなかったんだよ！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.src: So, welcome to the {p} Federal Prison. You're in here for the rest of your life, short-nose, so no use complaining about it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.dst: というわけで、{p} 連邦刑務所へようこそ。お前は一生ここだ、短っ鼻。文句を言っても無駄だぞ。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.src: And don't think you get to just lounge around all day in your cell. You gotta do work here, or you're getting thrown in the hole.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.dst: 牢屋で一日中ゴロゴロできると思うなよ。ここでは働くんだ。さもなきゃ独房行きだ。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.src: But for now, you’re stayin’ in your cell, understood? Now, stay here, and take a look around your cell. You'll know when it's time to work..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.dst: だが今は牢屋にいろ、分かったな？ここで待って、牢屋の中を見ておけ。仕事の時間になれば分かる…
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.src: GWAH! Who the hell are you?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.src: Oh, thank grook, you're just another prisoner... So young, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.dst: おお、Grook に感謝を、ただの囚人か…しかもこんなに若い…
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.src: You just got here, right? Well... I can tell you're innocent... Just like almost everyone else in this forsaken prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.dst: 来たばかりじゃろ？ふむ…お前さんが無実なのは分かる…この呪われた刑務所のほぼ全員と同じようにな…
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.src: Listen, human... This prison... You couldn't have come to a more horrific prison in the entire world! This place is hellish!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.dst: 聞け、人間…この刑務所は…世界中でこれ以上恐ろしい所はない！ここは地獄じゃ！！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.src: The guards here, they're sadistic! They'll pluck random prisoners out of their cells, and nobody ever sees them again! They're trying to kill us all in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.dst: ここの看守どもはサディストじゃ！適当に囚人を牢から引きずり出し、そいつらは二度と戻らん！わしら全員をここで殺す気なんじゃ！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.src: I'm being serious, human! If you stay here, they'll kill you, too! You HAVE to escape this place, whatever it t-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.dst: 本気じゃぞ、人間！ここに残ればお前さんも殺される！何としてもここから逃げるんじゃ、どんな代償を払っ―
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.src: Oi, filth! You're comin' with us. Get out of your cell, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.dst: おい、クズ！お前は来い。今すぐ牢から出ろ！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.src: Are you sure, uh, sir? I don't think I'm supposed to be anywhere today...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.dst: ほ、本当ですか、旦那？今日はどこにも行く予定はないはずじゃが…
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.src: Oh, ya think you're smart, trying to resist?? Oi, Jon, block the entrance!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.dst: ほう、抵抗とは賢いつもりか？？おい Jon、入口を塞げ！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.src: H-HEY! WHAT ARE YOU- GET OFF- AAAAAHH!! SOMEONE!! HELP ME!!! PLEASE!!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.dst: お、おい！何を――離せ――うわああああ！！誰か！！助けて！！！頼む！！！！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.src: OI! Quit starin’ off into space, maggot! Come over to your cell's bars.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.dst: おい！ぼーっとしてんじゃねえ、ウジ虫！牢の格子のところへ来い。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.src: It’s work time, filth. I'll escort you to the hallways. Once you're there, someone will tell you what to do. Do as they say, and you might come back tonight.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.dst: 仕事の時間だ、クズ。廊下まで連れていく。そこで誰かが指示を出す。言われた通りにすりゃ、今夜は戻ってこられるかもな。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.src: You got that, wretch? Alright, now get out of your cell!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.dst: 分かったか、ゲス野郎？よし、牢から出ろ！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#025.src: Get your instructions from the guard
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#025.dst: 看守から指示を受ける

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.src: Guess you're the one on cleanin' duty, huh? Alright. Listen up, scum!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.dst: お前が掃除当番か？よし。よく聞け、クズ！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.src: Take this sponge, and look around the hallways. If you see a mess, use the sponge to clean it up. Someone will escort you back to the cells once you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.dst: このスポンジを持って、廊下を見て回れ。汚れを見つけたらスポンジで掃除しろ。終わったら誰かが牢まで連れ戻す。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.src: Got it? Alright. Now, get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.dst: 分かったか？よし。さっさと働け！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.src: Search the hallways for messes to clean up
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.dst: 廊下で掃除すべき汚れを探す

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#030.src: Report to the prison guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.src: You're done cleaning? Alright, it's time for rollcall. You're being escorted back to the cell block. Follow me, and don't move.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.dst: 掃除は終わったか？よし、点呼の時間だ。牢区画まで連れ戻す。ついて来い、勝手に動くなよ。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.src: Well, well, well... Looks like the dross of society is here on time!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.dst: おやおや…社会のカスどもが時間通りに揃ったようね！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.src: Alright. Stay in line, and don't move, maggots! It's time for roll call...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.dst: よし。列を乱すな、動くんじゃないよ、ウジ虫ども！点呼の時間だ…
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.src: You’re all here… Ha! That’s a surprise, you outcasts can actually follow orders!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.dst: 全員いる…ハッ！驚いた、はみ出し者どもにも命令が守れるとはね！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.src: ...Hm… Looks like we’ve got a new arrival too.. Don’t worry, peon... your soul will be well secure here for the rest of eternity.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.dst: …ふむ…新入りもいるようね…心配いらないよ、下郎…お前の魂はここで永遠にしっかり預かってあげる。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.src: Alright. That’s it for now, you worthless menaces. It’s meal time. Head to the cafeteria, and pray that we’re not giving you your last meal.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.dst: よし。今はここまでだ、役立たずの厄介者ども。食事の時間だよ。食堂へ行って、これが最後の食事じゃないよう祈るんだね。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.src: Find a place to sit in the cafeteria
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.dst: 食堂で座る場所を探す

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.src: Hi... Say, could you... do something for me...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.dst: やあ…なあ、ちょっと…頼みを聞いてくれないか…？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.src: I'm... starving to death here... those blasted guards won't... let me get any food...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.dst: 俺…ここで飢え死にしそうなんだ…あのクソ看守どもが…食べ物をくれなくて…
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.speaker: Starving Prisoner
