King's Recruit#127.src: Good luck in there, recruits! You're gonna need it...
King's Recruit#127.dst: 中では幸運を祈るぞ、新兵ども！必要になるだろうからな…
King's Recruit#127.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#126~1.src: Well, what are you waiting for?

Kingdom of Sand#001.src: A {p} soldier! I imagine you're here to investigate the tomb up the hill?
Kingdom of Sand#001.dst: {p} の兵士ね！丘の上の墓を調べに来たのかしら？
Kingdom of Sand#001.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#002.src: It's believed to house the remains of Prince Hashr, the son of the old Desert Emperor, but it's far too dangerous for me to explore personally.
Kingdom of Sand#002.dst: 旧 Desert Emperor の息子、Prince Hashr の遺骸が眠るとされているけど、私が自分で調べるには危険すぎるの。
Kingdom of Sand#002.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#003.src: Instead I've been looking into a related legend - the Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#003.dst: 代わりに関連する伝説を調べていたの――Emperor's Sceptre よ。
Kingdom of Sand#003.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#004.src: It was the source of his power, and potentially one of the most important artifacts in history.
Kingdom of Sand#004.dst: それは皇帝の力の源で、歴史上最も重要な遺物の一つかもしれないわ。
Kingdom of Sand#004.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#005.src: When the Emperor was slain by his son, Hashr, it is said that the sceptre was lost amongst the raging sandstorm that followed.
Kingdom of Sand#005.dst: 皇帝が息子 Hashr に殺された時、王笏はその後の猛烈な砂嵐の中で失われたと言われているの。
Kingdom of Sand#005.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#006.src: ... Until now. I believe I have been able to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#006.dst: …今までは。近くの盗賊団が持っていると突き止めたと思う。彼らは自分たちが何を持っているか分かっていないでしょうね。
Kingdom of Sand#006.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#007.src: I'm not prepared to confront them myself, but... this artifact belongs in a museum, in the hands of careful and respectful researchers.
Kingdom of Sand#007.dst: 自分で奴らに立ち向かう覚悟はないけど… この遺物は博物館に、慎重で敬意ある研究者の手にあるべきなの。
Kingdom of Sand#007.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#008.src: I would be in your debt if you could try to retrieve it, for the sake of history.
Kingdom of Sand#008.dst: 歴史のために取り戻してもらえたら、恩に着るわ。
Kingdom of Sand#008.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#009.src: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#009.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の盗賊のアジトに入ろうとする。

Kingdom of Sand#010.dst: なんだ、アジトに入りてえのか？
Kingdom of Sand#010.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#011.src: Even if yer a crooked soldier, we can't jus let yer in.
Kingdom of Sand#011.dst: おめえが悪徳兵士だろうと、ただで入れるわけにはいかねえ。
Kingdom of Sand#011.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#012.src: That is, unless yer got the password?
Kingdom of Sand#012.dst: もっとも、合言葉を知ってりゃ別だがな？
Kingdom of Sand#012.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#013.src: Didn’t think so. Now get lost, wasted enough of my t-
Kingdom of Sand#013.dst: だろうな。さっさと失せろ、もう十分時間を無駄に――
Kingdom of Sand#013.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#014.src: Now would you look at that... Even soldiers think they can waltz in ere.
Kingdom of Sand#014.dst: おやおや、見てみな… 兵士までここにのこのこ入れると思ってやがる。
Kingdom of Sand#014.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#015.src: Having fun thinking of a password? Sorry to spoil your lunch, but there isn’t one!
Kingdom of Sand#015.dst: 合言葉を考えるのは楽しいか？水を差して悪いが、そんなものはないぜ！
Kingdom of Sand#015.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#016.src: We could use a few more officials on the roster.
Kingdom of Sand#016.dst: 役人の仲間がもう少し欲しいところでな。
Kingdom of Sand#016.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#017.src: If yer are on the liberal side of the law, talk to us outside.
Kingdom of Sand#017.dst: 法のゆるい側にいるってんなら、外で話そうや。
Kingdom of Sand#017.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#018.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Geo と Tarek に会う。

Kingdom of Sand#019.src: Looks like yer in. Look, there ain't a password cause we're meant to be the best thieves in the land, right?
Kingdom of Sand#019.dst: 乗り気みてえだな。いいか、合言葉がねえのは、俺らがこの国一番の盗賊だからだ、だろ？
Kingdom of Sand#019.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#020.src: So what good are words? Yer gotta give the guard somethin' stolen, aintcha!
Kingdom of Sand#020.dst: 言葉なんか何の役に立つ？見張りには盗んだモンを渡すんだよ！
Kingdom of Sand#020.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#021.src: And we just so happen to have the opportunity of a lifetime for you. {p} has gone soft see, a new Mayor is cleaning things up.
Kingdom of Sand#021.dst: そして、ちょうどお前に一生に一度のチャンスがある。{p} は甘くなってな、新しい町長が掃除を始めてる。
Kingdom of Sand#021.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#022.src: Well, we can't have government not under our control. {p} will always be bandit capital.
Kingdom of Sand#022.dst: 政府を俺らの手から離すわけにゃいかねえ。{p} はいつだって盗賊の都だ。
Kingdom of Sand#022.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#023.src: So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
Kingdom of Sand#023.dst: そこで、奴に同じ目を見せてやろう。奴がつけてる日誌を手に入れるんだ。きっと弱みが出てくるぜ。
Kingdom of Sand#023.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#024.src: And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
Kingdom of Sand#024.dst: 「俺たち」ってのはおめえのことだ。屋敷に忍び込んで、見張りを避けな。
Kingdom of Sand#024.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#025.src: He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
Kingdom of Sand#025.dst: 日誌は一番高い部屋にある。見張りの気もそらす必要があるかもな。{p} で一番でけえ屋敷だ、見逃さねえよ。
Kingdom of Sand#025.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#026.src: Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#026.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} Mansion の最上階の部屋に忍び込む。

Kingdom of Sand#027.src: Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
Kingdom of Sand#027.dst: おっ、屋敷の周りをこそこそしてた盗人だ！捕まえろ！
Kingdom of Sand#027.speaker: Mansion Guard

Kingdom of Sand#028.src: Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
Kingdom of Sand#028.dst: こんなことしたら軍をクビになるかもしれねえぜ。
Kingdom of Sand#028.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#029.src: Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
Kingdom of Sand#029.dst: へっ、本物みてえだな。乗りな、ここからずらかるぞ。
Kingdom of Sand#029.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#030.src: That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
Kingdom of Sand#030.dst: その日誌はどんな宝石より価値がある。これで確実に入れるぜ。
Kingdom of Sand#030.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#031.src: Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
Kingdom of Sand#031.dst: {p} Mansion の日誌を Vault Guard に渡し、アジトに入る。

Kingdom of Sand#034.src: Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
Kingdom of Sand#034.dst: おお、こいつは大した合言葉だ、「兵士さん」。これなら十分だ、通りな。
Kingdom of Sand#034.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#035.src: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#035.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の盗賊のアジトで王笏を探す。

Kingdom of Sand#036.src: Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Kingdom of Sand#036.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#037.src: Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
Kingdom of Sand#037.dst: 先週 Mesa の旅人から「頂いた」金は、数えたら {~} 本ちょっとでした。
Kingdom of Sand#037.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#039.src: We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
Kingdom of Sand#039.dst: 盗んだ日誌で、あの忌々しい {p} の町長の化けの皮を剥がす作戦中です。一週間以内に {p} は Creden Tibus の支配下に戻ります。
Kingdom of Sand#039.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#041.src: Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#041.dst: その… 古い墓の周りをうろついてる奴がいます。考古学者みたいで。王笏を探してるんじゃないかと。
Kingdom of Sand#041.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#042.src: Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
Kingdom of Sand#042.dst: ああ… あの王笏は失うには惜しすぎる。そいつを訪ねて、探すのを… やめるよう説得するか。
Kingdom of Sand#042.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#043.src: Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
Kingdom of Sand#043.dst: その通りです、ボス。川辺の壊れた荷車の中を探そうなんて誰も思わないでしょうし、ね？！
Kingdom of Sand#043.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#044.src: Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
Kingdom of Sand#044.dst: 黙れ、馬鹿者！今何て言った？とにかく、考古学者の件は俺が決める。解散！
Kingdom of Sand#044.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#045.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の壊れた荷車を調べる。

Kingdom of Sand#046.dst: 誰かが聞き耳を立ててると思ってたぜ。
Kingdom of Sand#046.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#047.src: We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
Kingdom of Sand#047.dst: 俺たちは盗賊だが、馬鹿じゃねえ。あの王笏は放っておくのが一番だ。
Kingdom of Sand#047.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#050.src: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#050.dst: 墓に戻り、[{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Junes に王笏を渡す。

Kingdom of Sand#051.src: Ah, {u}. I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
Kingdom of Sand#051.dst: あら、{u}。我慢できなくて――どうしても墓を間近で見たかったの。
Kingdom of Sand#051.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#052.src: You have no idea how tempted I am to go inside, but I doubt I'd make it out alive.
Kingdom of Sand#052.dst: 中に入りたくてたまらないけど、生きて出られるとは思えないわ。
Kingdom of Sand#052.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#053.src: You... you found the sceptre? Oh! This is incredible! I can't believe it!
Kingdom of Sand#053.dst: あなた… 王笏を見つけたの？まあ！信じられない！すごいわ！
Kingdom of Sand#053.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#054.src: This artifact, it witnessed the rise and fall of the Empire, thousands of years ago. And you've just been... holding it, without gloves...
Kingdom of Sand#054.dst: この遺物は、数千年前の帝国の興亡を見届けてきたの。それをあなたは… 手袋もなしに持ってたのね…
Kingdom of Sand#054.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#055.src: Under the circumstances, I think I can let that slide. But the things I could learn from studying it...
Kingdom of Sand#055.dst: 状況が状況だし、見逃してあげる。でも、これを研究すれば分かることといったら…
Kingdom of Sand#055.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#056.src: I should get to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#056.dst: すぐに {p} へ向かわなきゃ。ありがとう、{u}。このご恩は一生忘れないわ。
Kingdom of Sand#056.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#057.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you can learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#057.dst: 墓を探索するつもり？帝国について多くを学べるはずよ… でも気をつけてね。
Kingdom of Sand#057.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#058.src: There are nasty legends of what it holds. Silverfish, skeletons... even Prince Hashr himself. Make sure to gear up!
Kingdom of Sand#058.dst: 中には恐ろしい伝説があるの。シルバーフィッシュ、骸骨… Prince Hashr 本人まで。装備は万全にね！
Kingdom of Sand#058.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#059.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and a fossil bone I found around here.
Kingdom of Sand#059.dst: お礼にできることは少ないけど、このエメラルドと、この辺りで見つけた化石の骨を受け取って。
Kingdom of Sand#059.speaker: Junes

Lava Springs#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Gailard 大佐と話す

Lava Springs#001.src: Oh, good, good! I bet'cha you're a {p} soldier, aren't ya? Listen up, soldier! I've got a task here that 'ye can help out with.
Lava Springs#001.dst: おう、いいぞいいぞ！さてはお前、{p} の兵だな？よく聞け、兵士！手伝ってほしい任務がある。
Lava Springs#001.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#002.src: Ya see that lava spring right there? It just went and popped up out of nowhere! The brass is real concerned about it, mhm?
Lava Springs#002.dst: あそこの溶岩泉が見えるか？どこからともなく湧いて出たんだ！上層部はえらく気にしてるぜ、なあ？
Lava Springs#002.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#003.src: They've been yappin' about it bein' related to the Corruption, and 'ye can bet that that means trouble. BAD trouble.
Lava Springs#003.dst: 腐敗が関係してるってわめいてるが、そいつは間違いなく厄介事だ。とびきりの厄介事だぞ。
Lava Springs#003.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#004.src: Now, this here Savannah has always had some Corruption lurkin' about, but not to the point where it can do this! It won't be safe around here if we don't do somethin' about it!
Lava Springs#004.dst: このサバンナには昔から腐敗が潜んじゃいたが、こんな真似ができるほどじゃなかった！何か手を打たねえと、この辺りは危ねえ！
Lava Springs#004.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#005.src: Anyways, high command ain't gonna provide support for this until they know there's actual Corruption, so we've gotta find some evidence around the springs, understand?
Lava Springs#005.dst: とにかく、本物の腐敗だと分かるまで司令部は支援を寄越さねえ。だから泉の周りで証拠を探すんだ、分かったか？
Lava Springs#005.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#006.src: Take a look around the springs, soldier! Find me some damn evidence around here! [{~} Pieces of Evidence] should be enough! Now, get movin'!
Lava Springs#006.dst: 泉の周りを見てこい、兵士！証拠を見つけてこい！[{~} 個の証拠] があれば十分だ！さあ、動け！
Lava Springs#006.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#007.src: Look for three pieces of corrupted evidence around the Lava Spring at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#007.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の溶岩泉の周りで腐敗の証拠を三つ探す

Lava Springs#008.src: Go back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#008.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Gailard 大佐の所へ戻る

Lava Springs#009.src: Alright, good! Ya found some evidence, let me take a look at that!
Lava Springs#009.dst: よし、いいぞ！証拠を見つけたか、見せてみろ！
Lava Springs#009.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#010.src: Oh... This is bad... very, VERY bad...
Lava Springs#010.dst: おお… まずい… 本当に、マジでまずい…
Lava Springs#010.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#011.src: This here is some physical corruption. If it's gettin' onto the surface, then 'ye can bet one of those weeds is spreadin' underground, right beneath the springs...
Lava Springs#011.dst: こいつは実体化した腐敗だ。地表に出てきてるってことは、泉の真下で根っこが広がってるに違いねえ…
Lava Springs#011.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#012.src: If ya could get underneath the spring, 'ye could probably sever whatever damn root is causing this, but... the heat would be sure to fry your skin off...
Lava Springs#012.dst: 泉の下に潜り込めば、元凶の根を断ち切れるかもしれねえが… あの熱じゃ皮膚が焼け落ちちまう…
Lava Springs#012.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#013.src: Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here called {p}, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.
Lava Springs#013.dst: 待て… いい考えがある… よし、よく聞け兵士！この北に {p} って小さな町があるだろ？そこにいる治療師が力になってくれる。
Lava Springs#013.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#014.src: They're holed up inside of some important well in the center of town. There's a password ya need to hop into that place, though...
Lava Springs#014.dst: 町の中心の大事な井戸にこもってる。ただ、入るには合言葉が要るんだが…
Lava Springs#014.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#015.src: Don't have much to go on, but I'm pretty damn sure the password is Bob, or something. After the hero himself.
Lava Springs#015.dst: 手がかりは少ねえが、合言葉は Bob とか何とかだったはずだ。あの英雄にちなんでな。
Lava Springs#015.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#016.src: Right, ye're headin' there to find a potion that can keep ya weak little hide safe from the heat, understand? Here, let me write down the location in that book of yours.
Lava Springs#016.dst: よし、お前はそこで、そのひ弱な体を熱から守る薬を手に入れるんだ、分かったな？ほら、お前の本に場所を書いといてやる。
Lava Springs#016.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#017.src: Talk to Gregor outside the {p} well at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#017.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} の井戸の外で Gregor と話す

Lava Springs#018.src: Hey, hey hey hey! Darling, what do you think you're doing? You can't just waltz in here without telling me the password!
Lava Springs#018.dst: ちょっと、ちょっとちょっと！あんた、何してるつもり？合言葉も言わずにずかずか入れると思って？
Lava Springs#018.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#019.src: Hmm... Your face... confidence... it gleans with confidence... yet... you still haven't spoken to me since you arrived...
Lava Springs#019.dst: ふうん… その顔… 自信… 自信に満ちあふれてる… なのに… 来てから一言も口をきいてないわね…
Lava Springs#019.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#020.src: Could it be... you know that the password is penguin eggs, but you're just too shy to talk? Yeah... yeah, that's gotta be it!
Lava Springs#020.dst: もしかして… 合言葉が「ペンギンの卵」だと知ってるのに、恥ずかしくて言えないだけ？そう… きっとそうね！
Lava Springs#020.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#021.src: You've convinced me, little mute darling... You can enter the well. Go on, now!
Lava Springs#021.dst: 負けたわ、無口なおチビさん… 井戸に入っていいわよ。ほら、行きなさい！
Lava Springs#021.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#022.src: Enter the {p} well and talk to the healer at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#022.dst: {p} の井戸に入り、[{~}, {~}, -{~}] で治療師と話す

Lava Springs#023.src: G'day to you, friend. How can I help you?
Lava Springs#023.dst: やあ、こんにちは。何かお困り？
Lava Springs#023.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#024.src: Hm? The Colonel sent you? what for?
Lava Springs#024.dst: ん？大佐に言われて来たの？何のために？
Lava Springs#024.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#025.src: ...Corrupted... lava springs...? You realize how ridiculous that sounds, yeah? Well, I completely believe you.
Lava Springs#025.dst: …腐敗した… 溶岩泉…？どれだけ馬鹿げて聞こえるか分かってる？まあ、私は信じるけど。
Lava Springs#025.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#026.src: Right, you said lava, sooo... You need a heat resistance potion, yes?
Lava Springs#026.dst: で、溶岩って言ったよね… つまり、耐熱のポーションが必要ってこと？
Lava Springs#026.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#027.src: Welp, you're in luck, kinda... I have a potion that can resist the heat of lava, but the brew will not let you swim in lava.
Lava Springs#027.dst: 運がいいね、一応… 溶岩の熱に耐えるポーションはあるけど、溶岩の中を泳げるわけじゃないよ。
Lava Springs#027.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#028.src: Oh that works, you just need to enter a borehole that goes through the lava? Perfect
Lava Springs#028.dst: ああ、それなら大丈夫。溶岩を貫く縦穴に入るだけ？完璧。
Lava Springs#028.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#029.src: Anyways, if you ever need any more special brews, my assistant will be happy to sell some at a very affordable price.
Lava Springs#029.dst: それと、特製の薬がまた必要になったら、助手が格安で売ってくれるよ。
Lava Springs#029.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#030.src: Now, you have somewhere to be, right? Right. Go and report to the Colonel, soldier. Tell him I said hi, by the way.
Lava Springs#030.dst: さて、行くところがあるんでしょ？だよね。大佐に報告してきな、兵士さん。よろしく伝えといて。
Lava Springs#030.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#031.src: Report back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#031.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Gailard 大佐に報告する

Lava Springs#032.src: Report! Ya got the potion yet, soldier? Good, drink it if ya haven't already!
Lava Springs#032.dst: 報告！ポーションは手に入れたか、兵士？よし、まだなら飲んどけ！
Lava Springs#032.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#033.src: Right, that's what I like to hear! Now, LOOK TO THE LEFT SOLDIER! There is a borehole out there we dug to try and hit the source of this weed.
Lava Springs#033.dst: そうだ、それを聞きたかった！さあ、左を見ろ、兵士！雑草の根源を狙って掘った縦穴があるだろう。
Lava Springs#033.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#034.src: We found a pretty damn hot cave lying underneath the surface! If ya jumped into the borehole, 'ye could probably find the source of the Corruption and stop it.
Lava Springs#034.dst: 地表の下にえらく暑い洞窟が見つかったんだ！縦穴に飛び込めば、腐敗の源を見つけて止められるはずだ。
Lava Springs#034.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#035.src: Now, the roots and spikes of Corruption are very sturdy, but we ain't never seen something like lava burstin' out of the ground.
Lava Springs#035.dst: 腐敗の根やトゲは頑丈だが、地面から溶岩が噴き出すなんてのは見たことがねえ。
Lava Springs#035.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#036.src: Had a small chat with the brass, earlier. They got a hunch that there's a heart to the Corruption that's pumpin' out all the lava!
Lava Springs#036.dst: さっき上層部と少し話した。溶岩をくみ上げてる腐敗の心臓があるんじゃねえかってな！
Lava Springs#036.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#037.src: That's gotta be our ticket, yeah? If 'ye destroy that, ya should be able to stop the spread of the lava! Now, get movin'! Head into the borehole, soldier!
Lava Springs#037.dst: そいつが突破口だ、だろ？それを壊せば溶岩の広がりを止められるはずだ！さあ、動け！縦穴に入れ、兵士！
Lava Springs#037.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#038.src: Drink the Potion of Obsidian Skin, then enter the lava spring through the borehole at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and look for a corrupted heart
Lava Springs#038.dst: 黒曜の肌のポーションを飲み、[{~}, {~}, -{~}] の縦穴から溶岩泉に入って腐敗した心臓を探す

Lava Springs#039.src: Tell Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] that you destroyed the heart
Lava Springs#039.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Gailard 大佐に心臓を破壊したと伝える

Lava Springs#040.src: Hah! I knew ya'd give me results! Ye're pretty damn reliable, soldier! Here, take this for your trouble!
Lava Springs#040.dst: はっ！お前ならやってくれると思ってたぜ！頼りになる兵士だ！ほら、手間賃だ、取っとけ！
Lava Springs#040.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.src: Ah, one of you adventurin' types, huh? We see a lot of you around here... Going in and out as you please. Must be a nice life.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.dst: ああ、また冒険者ってやつか？この辺じゃよく見るよ… 好き勝手に出入りしてさ。いい身分だな。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.src: Though, if you could spare some time, the town could use you-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.dst: でもまあ、少し時間があるなら、町としては手を貸してほし――
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.src: Wait, already?! It's only been a day since last! How insatiable are they...?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.dst: 待て、もうか？！前回からたった一日だぞ！どれだけ貪欲なんだ…？
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.src: THE UNDEAD HAVE OVERWHELMED THE GOLEMS! EVERY CITIZEN FOR THEMSELVES!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.dst: アンデッドがゴーレムを押し切ったぞ！各自、自分の身は自分で守れ！！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.src: This is what I was talking about! We need your help with this! You Wynn folk are good at killing zombies, right?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.dst: 言ってたのはこれだ！手を貸してくれ！Wynn の連中はゾンビ退治が得意なんだろ？！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.src: We need help with this! Defend the town with us!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.dst: 助けが要る！一緒に町を守ってくれ！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.src: The horde's retreating, but we have one citizen dead! Regroup at the square and prepare the pyres!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.dst: 群れは退いたが、住民が一人死んだ！広場で再集結し、火葬の薪を用意しろ！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.src: Hey! Over here, you alright? Come talk to me, I can explain what just happened.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.dst: おい！こっちだ、大丈夫か？話そう、今何が起きたか説明する。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.src: Check in with Burtur about the attack at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Burtur に襲撃について聞く

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.src: Phew. That was a smaller horde, thankfully... Still, good thing you were there. That could have been worse.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.dst: ふう。幸い小さい群れだった… それでも、あんたがいてくれて助かった。もっとひどくなってたかもしれない。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.src: Still, c'mon now... We have to burn the bodies. Can't leave the job half-done.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.dst: さて、行こう… 死体を焼かないと。仕事を途中で投げ出すわけにはいかない。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.src: It's a bit sacrilegious, but necessary to do right now- otherwise they just keep coming back, like they do across the ridge in Kander.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.dst: 少し罰当たりだが、今は必要なんだ。でないと、尾根の向こうの Kander みたいに何度でも戻ってくる。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.src: The ones around here all come up from the river, though, and since it runs right through the town, well... You can see the problem.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.dst: でもこの辺の奴らはみんな川から上がってくる。その川が町のど真ん中を流れてるもんだから… 分かるだろ。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.src: Since we don't live in a reeking, pockmarked plain, we have to burn the bodies so any dead don't turn right around against us.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.dst: 俺たちは臭くて穴だらけの平原に住んでるわけじゃない。だから死体を焼いて、死者が寝返らないようにするんだ。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.src: Say your goodbyes, all. Irahe will be missed. Step away from the pyre!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.dst: 皆、別れを告げよ。Irahe を偲ぼう。薪から離れろ！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.src: Some conspiracy theorists think that the Lazarus Pit is the issue. It's an urban legend, a well of water that can revive the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.dst: 陰謀論者の中には、Lazarus の穴が原因だと考える奴もいる。死者を蘇らせる井戸だっていう都市伝説さ。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.src: Supposing that it's real, it would make some sense, at least- If it started feeding into the river or water tables, then we'd get the current goings-on.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.dst: 本当にあるとすれば、少しは筋が通る――そいつが川や地下水に流れ込み始めたら、今みたいなことになる。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.src: Of course, no one knows where it is, since it's just rumors, but there's supposedly an "Order" of pit-keepers. Conveniently long dead, and buried in that small graveyard just north of here.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.dst: もちろん、ただの噂だから場所は誰も知らない。でも穴の番人の「教団」がいたらしい。都合よくとっくに死んで、北の小さな墓地に埋まってるそうだ。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.src: It's... probably just Referick having made the rounds to any drunk who would listen a while back, but it's also our only shot. If you could give it a search, and a yay or nay?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.dst: たぶん… Referick が前に、聞いてくれる酔っ払いに片っ端から吹いて回ってただけだ。でも頼みの綱はそれしかない。調べて、当たりか外れか教えてくれるか？
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.src: I'll stay back at the town square, in case the undead attack again. Give me a shout if you find something you aren't sure about.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.dst: 俺は町の広場に残るよ、アンデッドがまた来るかもしれないからな。気になる物が見つかったら声をかけてくれ。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.src: Have you checked out that small graveyard north of here yet? Remember, you're looking for any clues about that Lazarus Pit "Order."
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.dst: 北の小さな墓地はもう調べたか？忘れるなよ、探すのは Lazarus の穴の「教団」の手がかりだ。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.src: Find the body of the Order's mage in {p}'s graveyard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} の墓地で教団の魔術師の遺体を見つける

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.src: Locate the chapel mentioned by the talisman, or return to Burtur for assistance.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.dst: 護符に記された礼拝堂を探すか、Burtur の所へ戻って助けを求める。

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.src: Oh, you found something? Well color me shocked that there was any stock to Referick's ranting...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.dst: おっ、何か見つけたのか？驚いたな、Referick のわめきに少しは根拠があったとは…
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.src: Chapel of an ancient order? There's a chapel just northwest of here. I'd say investigate that! I have to stick around here in case of another attack, but...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.dst: 古い教団の礼拝堂？北西にちょうど礼拝堂がある。そこを調べてみろ！俺はまた襲われた時のためにここにいないといけないが…
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.src: Any luck searching out that chapel yet? The coordinates ought to be in your content book, right?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.dst: 礼拝堂探しはどうだ？座標はコンテンツブックに載ってるよな？
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.src: Investigate the Order's chapel northwest of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]、{p} の北西にある教団の礼拝堂を調べる

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.src: Solve the crypt's riddle to 'bring the water of life anew' to the graves.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.dst: 地下墓所の謎を解き、墓に「命の水を再びもたらす」。

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.src: Revive the people in the tombs with the Lazarus Water and complete their tasks.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.dst: Lazarus の水で墓の人々を蘇らせ、彼らの頼みを果たす。

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.src: Ugh. And who put YOU in charge of waking me up? Where's Gwendolyn, my maid? Incompetents- she was supposed to be buried with me too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.dst: うう。誰が「お前」に私を起こす役目を任せた？侍女の Gwendolyn はどこだ？無能どもめ――あれも私と一緒に埋葬されるはずだったのに！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.src: What, you want to enter the crypt? Well, prove you're better than the funeral directors and do something right! The Ghastly Ghouls around here won't stop SCREAMING!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.dst: 何、地下墓所に入りたい？なら葬儀屋どもよりましだと証明して、まともな仕事をしろ！この辺の Ghastly Ghoul がわめき続けてうるさいのだ！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.src: I want them gone! Get rid of, say, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Then perhaps I'll give you the time of day, you strange, small-nosed lookyloo!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.dst: 奴らを消せ！そうだな、{~} 体の Ghastly Ghoul を始末しろ。そうすれば相手をしてやらんでもない、この妙な鼻の低い野次馬め！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.src: Agh! Stop sneaking up on me! Have you killed those {~} Ghastly Ghouls I asked you to, yet?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.dst: ひっ！こっそり近づくな！頼んだ {~} 体の Ghastly Ghoul はもう倒したのか？
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#034.dst: Ghastly Ghoul を {~} 体倒す

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.src: Ah, my favorite little weird-small-nosed-person! The graveyard is so lovely when it's quiet- you really did do a good job!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.dst: おお、お気に入りの鼻の低いへんてこ君！静かな墓地は実に素晴らしい――よくやってくれた！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.src: As important as I am, you must still check with the other graves, though you certainly have my blessing to enter.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.dst: 私はこれほど重要な人物だが、他の墓にも確認せねばならんぞ。もっとも、私の許しは確かに与えよう。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.src: My goodness! Ah, it feels good to stretch these old bones. It's not easy being cooped up in a coffin, you know.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.dst: あらまあ！ああ、この古い骨を伸ばすのは気持ちいいこと。棺桶に閉じこもるのは楽じゃありませんのよ。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.src: You want to get into the crypt? I suppose I could give you a hand... figuratively, I mean. Still, need to see if you can be trusted and all...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.dst: 地下墓所に入りたいの？手を貸してあげてもよくってよ… 比喩的な意味でね。でも、信用できるか見極めないと…
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.src: Oh, right! My dear husband gave me the most beautiful wedding band, but it became lost when I carked it. Some rude shadowy thing- See if anyone ever marries THEM!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.dst: そうそう！愛しい夫がとても美しい結婚指輪をくれたのに、私がくたばった時になくしてしまったの。無礼な影みたいなものに――あんなのと結婚する人なんていやしませんわ！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.src: Bring it back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.dst: 取り戻してくださる？東の古いリッチの塔の辺りで死んだの。そうしてくれたら、喜んで許しをあげますわ！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.src: Bring my wedding band back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.dst: 結婚指輪を取り戻してくださる？東の古いリッチの塔の辺りで死んだの。そうしてくれたら、喜んで許しをあげますわ！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#042.dst: Sir Pigglesworth の結婚指輪を見つける

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.src: Oh, you found it! Wonderful! Just pop it on that fingerbone right there... Ah, it fits even better on the other hand!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.dst: まあ、見つけてくれたのね！素敵！その指の骨にはめてちょうだい… あら、反対の手のほうがぴったりね！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.src: The crypt, you say? I can offer my blessing to enter, but you'll need to check with the other tombs as well. Farewell!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.dst: 地下墓所ですって？入る許しはあげられるけど、他の墓にも確認しなきゃだめよ。ごきげんよう！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.src: I oughta deck you for waking me up!! Don't you realize it's RUDE to re-animate the long-dead corpse of a murderer when he's trying to get his beauty death?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.dst: 起こしやがって、ぶん殴ってやる！！死んで久しい人殺しの死体を、美容のための永眠中に蘇らせるのは失礼だって分からねえのか？！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.speaker: Uggword Pollywaggon the Murderous

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.src: Greetings! Thank goodness, that dreary old tomb was simply awful. No furniture, no natural light, not even a lick of paint! So drab, the whole thing.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.dst: ごきげんよう！ああよかった、あの陰気な古い墓は本当にひどかったの。家具もない、日も差さない、ペンキひと塗りもない！何もかも地味！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.src: What's that? You want to get into the crypt? Well, of course I can help, if you just do one teensy little thing for me?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.dst: なあに？地下墓所に入りたい？もちろんお手伝いするわ、ちょっとしたことを一つしてくれたらね？
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.src: Could you feed my cat for me? I know Mrs. Fluffles must be so lonely after all these years. My old house is just south of here, over at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], just pop some food down for her? Thank you!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.dst: 私の猫に餌をあげてくださらない？Mrs. Fluffles はずっと寂しかったはずよ。私の古い家はすぐ南の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にあるの、餌を置いてきてくれる？ありがとう！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.src: Please, kind adventurer! Feed Mrs. Fluffles for me. I'm sure she's just so lonely, in that big old house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.dst: お願い、優しい冒険者さん！Mrs. Fluffles に餌を。[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の大きな古い家で、きっと寂しがってるわ
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.src: So, is Mrs. Fluffles doing alright without me? Oh, I bet she was so affectionate, always such a softie!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.dst: それで、Mrs. Fluffles は私がいなくても元気？ああ、きっと甘えてきたでしょう、昔から甘えん坊なの！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.src: Oh, thank you so much! I was so worried that after my death she wouldn't be okay... What a relief!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.dst: まあ、本当にありがとう！私が死んだ後、あの子が大丈夫か心配で… ほっとしたわ！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.src: You have my blessing to enter the crypt! Make sure to check with the other graves as well though.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.dst: 地下墓所に入る許しをあげるわ！でも、他の墓にも確認してちょうだいね。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.src: W-wait, Mrs. Fluffles... She was...d-dead? No... It can't be! I left her a lifetime supply of food!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.dst: ま、待って、Mrs. Fluffles が… し、死んでた？嘘… ありえない！一生分の餌を残してきたのに！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.src: You! You killed Mrs. Fluffles, it's the only explanation!! HOW COULD YOU DO SUCH A THING?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.dst: あなた！あなたが Mrs. Fluffles を殺したのね、それしか考えられない！！よくもそんなことを！？
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#058.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の地下墓所の扉を開ける

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.src: Investigate the crypt's inner chamber at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の地下墓所の奥の間を調べる

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.src: ... the Lazarus Pi... said to bring back the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.dst: …Lazarus の穴… 死者を蘇らせるという。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.src: Be warned, traveller, th... not truly alive agai... were before.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.dst: 旅人よ、心せよ… 真に生き返るのでは… かつての姿には…
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.src: ... In times of great need, one can find... at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.dst: …大いなる危急の時には… [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にて見出せる。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.src: But know this... use for greed or self-ga... result in... worse than death.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.dst: されど知れ… 貪欲や私利のために用いれば… 死より悪しき結果を…
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.src: Find the entrance to the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Lazarus の穴の入口を見つける

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.src: Follow the path to the Lazarus pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter the Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Lazarus の穴への道をたどり、穴に入る。

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.src: Follow the cave to find the Lazarus Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.dst: 洞窟を進み、Lazarus の穴を見つける。

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.src: Find a way to block off the water pillar in the Lazarus Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.dst: Lazarus の穴の水柱をふさぐ方法を探す。

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.src: Tell Burtur that you have blocked off the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Burtur に Lazarus の穴をふさいだと伝える

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.src: Ah, you're back! We were getting a tad worried about you. Were you able to figure anything out in the chapel there?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.dst: おお、戻ったか！ちょっと心配してたんだ。礼拝堂で何か分かったか？
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.src: Wait, you found the Lazarus Pit? AND blocked the flow into the river? Grook feathers you humans work quick! It's only been a few hours!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.dst: 待て、Lazarus の穴を見つけた？しかも川への流れまで止めた？Grook の羽根にかけて、人間は仕事が早いな！まだ数時間だぞ！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.src: Heck, I gotta pitch in and compensate you for that hard work! I know we're not the richest, but I hope you'll accept this...other way of paying, too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.dst: こりゃあ、苦労に報いなきゃな！裕福じゃないのは分かってるが… この別の形の礼も受け取ってくれるとありがたい！
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.src: ...loss, but those pure of heart found... untouched by the curse, and formed this Order.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.dst: …喪失、されど心清き者は… 呪いに触れられず、この教団を結成した。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.src: For worry of the misuse... waters, malicious or not, our... shall be taken to the grave.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.dst: …の水の悪用を恐れ、悪意の有無を問わず、我らの…は墓へと持ち去られる。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.src: Only one apart from our... of it, and they have... secrecy, even... immmortality.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.dst: 我ら以外に…を知る者はただ一人、その者は… 秘密を、さらには… 不死を。
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.src: The lich, Espera... keeper of the Order. We ...an outside influence will not...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.dst: リッチ、Espera… 教団の守り手。我らは… 外部の干渉は…
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.src: Looks like there's some debris blocking the path, but perhaps you could blast it away with a spell up close?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.dst: 瓦礫が道をふさいでいるようだ。近づいて呪文で吹き飛ばせるかもしれない。

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.src: There's some kind of door over on the east side, with a hole shaped like an amulet, but I can't seem to find anything that would fit in it...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.dst: 東側に扉があって、護符の形をした穴があるんだけど、はまりそうな物が見つからなくて…

Lexdale Witch Trials#000.src: See what's going on in the center of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で {p} の中心で何が起きているか確かめる。

Lexdale Witch Trials#001.src: We have an enemy amongst our own in {p}! This witch's illegal practice of magic threatens us!
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.dst: {p} の中に敵がいる！この魔女の違法な魔法が我らを脅かしているのだ！
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#002.src: Ms. Amira's home was found to be plagued by spreading Decay! We must kill the witch to protect our sanctity!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.dst: Amira 氏の家は広がる腐朽に侵されていた！我らの神聖を守るため、魔女を殺さねばならん！
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#003.src: WAIT! Let me GO already! I told you what was happening!
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.dst: 待って！いい加減放してよ！何が起きたか説明したでしょ！
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#004.src: The deceit of your dark magic won't work, Ms. Amira. Go quietly- leave us in peace!
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.dst: 闇の魔術の欺きなど通じんぞ、Amira 氏。大人しく去れ――我らを放っておけ！
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#005.src: SHUT UP ALREADY! You can't just single people out like this!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.dst: いい加減黙って！こんな風に人を名指しで吊るし上げないでよ！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#006.src: Just hear me out for a second! It's not me, something infected my home! That's the reason it was so dark!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.dst: ちょっとでいいから聞いて！私じゃない、何かが家に取り憑いたの！だからあんなに暗かったのよ！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#007.src: My basement, some outlandish thing dug into it! Wherever it went, the area withered and decayed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.dst: 地下室よ、何か変なものが掘り進んできたの！そいつが通った所は枯れて腐朽したの！
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#008.src: There's proof in my house that it wasn't me! It's the one that's decayed and barren! You'll see if you LOOK, you gorehound!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.dst: 私じゃない証拠は家にあるわ！腐朽して荒れ果てたのはあっちよ！見ればわかるわ、この血に飢えた奴！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#009.src: Quit with the insults! We'll delay for now- If there's no proof of the witch's innocence she will be executed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.dst: 罵るのはやめろ！ひとまず延期だ――魔女の無実の証拠がなければ処刑する！
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#010.src: Explore the basement of the decayed and barren house.
Lexdale Witch Trials#010.dst: 腐朽して荒れ果てた家の地下室を調べる。

Lexdale Witch Trials#011.src: Follow the creature down the tunnels.
Lexdale Witch Trials#011.dst: トンネルを進んで生き物を追う。

Lexdale Witch Trials#012.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#012.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のトンネルから引き続き生き物を追う。

Lexdale Witch Trials#013.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#013.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のトンネルから引き続き生き物を追う。

Lexdale Witch Trials#014.src: ...Further... intruders...? You are not of the worms... the parasites?
Lexdale Witch Trials#014.dst: …さらなる… 侵入者…？お前は虫ども… 寄生虫の仲間ではないのか？
Lexdale Witch Trials#014.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#015.src: Another stranger... You must have witnessed the tunnels. They blight the stone, wither the roots, make lifeless the land...
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.dst: また余所者か… トンネルを見ただろう。奴らは石を蝕み、根を枯らし、大地から命を奪う…
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#016.src: And here, we starve in isolation. My people are lost, as the very earth itself warps and shifts.
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.dst: そして我らはここで孤立し飢えている。大地そのものが歪み動く中、我が民は迷うばかり。
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#017.src: The water, stagnant and gray. Nothing but those horrid magic scourges, and the worms themselves to sustain ourselves.
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.dst: 水は淀み灰色。あの忌まわしい魔法の災いと、虫そのものしか糧がない。
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#018.src: We cannot escape, for the sun scourges us. There is no place to go, no place to burrow that they do not wait.
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.dst: 日の光が我らを焼くゆえ、逃げられぬ。行く場所も、奴らが待ち構えぬ掘り場もない。
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#019.src: You... You... You have life. You have a heart, and muscle, and meat... To survive till this torture ends...
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.dst: お前は… お前は… 命を持っている。心臓も、筋肉も、肉も… この責め苦が終わるまで生き延びるための…
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#020.dst: 余所者よ、死んでもらう。
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#021.dst: トンネル住人の族長を倒す。

Lexdale Witch Trials#022.src: Wait... These earthquakes! IT'S THEM! AGHHHHHHHHHHH!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#022.dst: 待て… この地震は！奴らだ！ぐああああああ！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#022.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#023.src: Dig yourself out of the dirt. Then go after the creature.
Lexdale Witch Trials#023.dst: 土から自力で抜け出し、生き物を追う。

Lexdale Witch Trials#024.src: Return to {p} and try to show the mayor the creature at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#024.dst: {p} に戻り、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で町長に生き物を見せる。

Lexdale Witch Trials#025.src: You're back. Did- Wait, what in the nine hells is THAT?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#025.dst: 戻ったか。どうだっ――待て、一体「それ」は何だ？！
Lexdale Witch Trials#025.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#026.src: That! That was the thing in my basement!! I knew that human could find it! Thank you!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.dst: それ！それが私の地下室にいたやつよ！！あの人間なら見つけられると思ってた！ありがとう！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#027.src: That thing was spreading the decay through my house! It's NOT witches or magic like you suddenly DECIDED one day!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.dst: こいつが家中に腐朽を広げてたのよ！あんたがある日突然「決めつけた」魔女や魔法なんかじゃない！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#028.src: ...Fine then. This... creature... bug... leach? This whatever- it- is... I'll accept your explanation.
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.dst: …分かった。この… 生き物… 虫… ヒル？この得体の知れんものは… 説明を受け入れよう。
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#029.src: Step off the podium, Ms. Amira. You're innocent.
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.dst: 壇から降りなさい、Amira 氏。あなたは無実だ。
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#030.src: Gah, finally! You're seeing sense! It's almost like something just... took you over one day and never left 'til now!
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.dst: はあ、やっと！やっと話が通じた！まるで、ある日何かに… 乗っ取られて、今まで出て行かなかったみたい！
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#031.src: ...hm. That... Mmh. Regardless. Human, you've proven yourself to be trustworthy. We'll keep our doors open for you.
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.dst: …む。それは… うむ。ともかく。人間よ、信頼に足ると証明したな。我らの門はお前に開かれている。
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#032.src: As for the... THING... Well... I'll be sure to inform the Gavel government.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.dst: その… 「もの」については… まあ… Gavel 政府に必ず報告しておこう。
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#000~1.src: You should follow the creature before it gets away!
Lexdale Witch Trials#000~1.dst: 逃げられる前にあの生き物を追いかけて！

Lost in the Jungle#001.src: Excuse me, traveller... I am dreadfully sorry to ask this of you, but I need your help.
Lost in the Jungle#001.dst: 失礼、旅の方… こんなことを頼むのは誠に心苦しいのですが、力を貸してください。
Lost in the Jungle#001.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#002.src: You see, my son, Aryn. Very recently, he underwent a traditional coming-of-age ceremony from our tribe.
Lost in the Jungle#002.dst: 息子の Aryn のことです。つい先日、我が部族に伝わる成人の儀を受けました。
Lost in the Jungle#002.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#003.src: He was tasked to enter the dangerous {p}, just south of here, and brave the wilderness for three days. He returned a true man, successful.
Lost in the Jungle#003.dst: すぐ南の危険な {p} に入り、三日間荒野を耐え抜くという試練です。息子は見事に成し遂げ、一人前の男になりました。
Lost in the Jungle#003.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#004.src: However, he also brought with him an odd purple gemstone. Our shaman saw it as a bad omen, but I was so caught up in the celebrations, I brushed it off.
Lost in the Jungle#004.dst: しかし、奇妙な紫の宝石を持ち帰ってきたのです。呪術師は凶兆と見ましたが、私は祝いに浮かれて聞き流しました。
Lost in the Jungle#004.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#005.src: Strange happenings began around the village. Aryn walked about at night, talking to someone, but no one else was there with him.
Lost in the Jungle#005.dst: 村の周りで怪しいことが起き始めました。Aryn は夜に歩き回り、誰かと話していましたが、そばには誰もいないのです。
Lost in the Jungle#005.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#006.src: Just last sunrise, he vanished entirely. We sent out a search for him, but even our hardiest warriors could not venture deep into the jungle.
Lost in the Jungle#006.dst: そして昨日の夜明け、息子は忽然と姿を消しました。捜索に出ましたが、屈強な戦士でもジャングルの奥へは進めませんでした。
Lost in the Jungle#006.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#007.src: We returned empty-handed, having lost our newest tribesman. The village is in terrible spirits, and I feel as though I am responsible.
Lost in the Jungle#007.dst: 新しい部族の一員を失い、手ぶらで戻りました。村は沈みきっており、私は自分の責任だと感じています。
Lost in the Jungle#007.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#008.src: You Wynn warriors, however... great stories are told of your exploits. Surely, you will be able to brave the jungle, yes?
Lost in the Jungle#008.dst: ですが、あなた方 Wynn の戦士の武勇は語り草です。あなたならきっと、ジャングルにも立ち向かえるでしょう？
Lost in the Jungle#008.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#009.src: I beg of you, please, find my son. I do not know quite where he is, but undoubtedly he has been taken quite a ways in...
Lost in the Jungle#009.dst: お願いです、どうか息子を見つけてください。居場所は分かりませんが、きっとかなり奥まで連れて行かれたはず…
Lost in the Jungle#009.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#010.src: Hm... I just now am seeing a strange trail on the ground... it matches the color of the gemstone! It may take you to him, please, follow it!
Lost in the Jungle#010.dst: む… 今、地面に妙な跡があるのに気づきました… 宝石と同じ色です！息子の元へ導くかもしれません、どうか追ってください！
Lost in the Jungle#010.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#012.src: P-please, I beg of you spirit, let me go free! The tribesmen must be so worried-
Lost in the Jungle#012.dst: お、お願いです、精霊よ、どうか放してください！部族の皆がきっと心配して――
Lost in the Jungle#012.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#013.src: DO NOT RESIST, BOY! YOUR BODY IS MINE. I WAS TRAPPED IN THAT STONE FOR MILLENIA, AND NOW I AM FREE.
Lost in the Jungle#013.dst: 抗うな、小僧！その体は我のものだ。我は千年もの間あの石に囚われ、今ようやく自由になったのだ。
Lost in the Jungle#013.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#014.src: Aha, I hear someone coming! Surely a tribesman here to rescue me!
Lost in the Jungle#014.dst: あっ、誰か来る音がする！きっと部族の者が助けに来てくれたんだ！
Lost in the Jungle#014.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#015.src: Oh! If so, the body of this warrior will be far better suited to my needs! Grant me your power, boy! I need to thrash them first to possess them!
Lost in the Jungle#015.dst: ほう！ならば、その戦士の体のほうが我には都合がよい！力を寄越せ、小僧！乗り移るにはまず叩きのめさねば！
Lost in the Jungle#015.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#016.dst: Aryn に取り憑いた霊を倒す

Lost in the Jungle#017.src: Make sure Aryn is safe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost in the Jungle#017.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Aryn の無事を確かめる

Lost in the Jungle#018.src: Hahah, take that, evil wraith! You'll never match the power of our tribe-
Lost in the Jungle#018.dst: はは、思い知ったか、邪悪な亡霊め！我が部族の力には到底及ばな――
Lost in the Jungle#018.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#019.src: W-wait, you aren't part of our tribe! Who are you, why did you come here?
Lost in the Jungle#019.dst: ま、待って、あなたは部族の人じゃない！誰ですか、なぜここに？
Lost in the Jungle#019.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#020.src: Oh... my father sent you? Well, I am very impressed, Wynn warrior. You fight with ferocity of our own!
Lost in the Jungle#020.dst: ああ… 父があなたを？それは恐れ入りました、Wynn の戦士。我が部族にも劣らぬ猛々しさです！
Lost in the Jungle#020.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#021.src: I...can't say the same for myself. That spirit completely overtook me, I still can't move right now...
Lost in the Jungle#021.dst: 僕は… そうは言えません。あの霊に完全に乗っ取られて、今もまだ動けないんです…
Lost in the Jungle#021.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#022.src: For now, please. Take away this gemstone. It caused all this, I don't want to be near such a bad luck charm.
Lost in the Jungle#022.dst: ひとまず、お願いです。この宝石を持って行ってください。全部これのせいです、こんな不吉な物のそばにいたくない。
Lost in the Jungle#022.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#023.src: Tell the tribe that I will return on my own. I made it back once, I can do it again once I am prepared.
Lost in the Jungle#023.dst: 部族の皆には、自分で戻ると伝えてください。一度帰れたんです、準備ができればまた帰れます。
Lost in the Jungle#023.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#024.src: Bring the Mysterious Gemstone to Gracen at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost in the Jungle#024.dst: 謎の宝石を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Gracen に届ける

Lost in the Jungle#025.src: Oh my... Aryn was possessed by a spirit residing within the gemstone?
Lost in the Jungle#025.dst: なんと… Aryn は宝石に宿る霊に取り憑かれていたと？
Lost in the Jungle#025.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#026.src: How shameful... Our shaman has never been wrong before, why did I disregard his warning...
Lost in the Jungle#026.dst: 何と恥ずかしい… 呪術師が間違ったことなど一度もないのに、なぜ私は警告を無視したのか…
Lost in the Jungle#026.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#027.src: But that is beside the point. You say you have destroyed the spirit and it does not feel tainted any longer, so I will trust you.
Lost in the Jungle#027.dst: しかし、それは本題ではありません。霊を滅ぼし、もう穢れも感じないとおっしゃるなら、信じましょう。
Lost in the Jungle#027.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#028.src: Looking at it now, this is actually quite a valuable stone. If crushed to dust, it can be used in special charms we make.
Lost in the Jungle#028.dst: 改めて見ると、実はかなり価値のある石です。粉にすれば、我々が作る特別なお守りに使えます。
Lost in the Jungle#028.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#029.src: Here, allow me to grind this down for you. You can keep the shards for whatever purposes you may find for them in the future.
Lost in the Jungle#029.dst: さあ、砕いて差し上げましょう。欠片は、この先どんな用途にでもお使いください。
Lost in the Jungle#029.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#030.src: Our tribe, and especially myself... We thank you for your service. We shall consider you one of our own, from this day forward.
Lost in the Jungle#030.dst: 我が部族、そして何より私から… ご尽力に感謝します。今日この日より、あなたを我らの一員とみなしましょう。
Lost in the Jungle#030.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#031.src: In fact, if you'd like, you may even enter my house here whenever you'd like.
Lost in the Jungle#031.dst: よろしければ、いつでも私の家に入ってくださって構いません。
Lost in the Jungle#031.speaker: Gracen

Lost Royalty#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Yavlis と話す

Lost Royalty#001.src: Oh, hello there! I had hoped not to bother you, adventurer, but this is urgent.
Lost Royalty#001.dst: あら、こんにちは！お手を煩わせたくはなかったのですが、冒険者さん、急ぎの用なんです。
Lost Royalty#001.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#002.src: You see, the king is very... erm, distracted, and you are just the kind of willing, able-bodied person I need.
Lost Royalty#002.dst: 実は、王が今とても… その、上の空でして。あなたこそ、私が求めていた意欲と腕のある方なんです。
Lost Royalty#002.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#003.src: You see, the king's son has gone missing, and with him worrying so much, the problems of the city have festered unsolved.
Lost Royalty#003.dst: 王の息子が行方不明になりまして。王が心配しきっているせいで、街の問題が放置されたままなんです。
Lost Royalty#003.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#004.src: We believe he was kidnapped by the splinter cell mercenaries in the jungle... Unfortunate, too. They used to be quite honourable.
Lost Royalty#004.dst: ジャングルの分派の傭兵たちにさらわれたと考えています… 残念なことです。昔はかなり義理堅い連中だったのに。
Lost Royalty#004.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#005.src: Well, anyway, they're usually spotted outside the run-down farm outside of town. Go there and see what they want in return for the young prince.
Lost Royalty#005.dst: とにかく、彼らは町外れの荒れた農場の辺りでよく見かけられます。そこへ行って、王子と引き換えに何を望むのか聞いてきてください。
Lost Royalty#005.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#006.src: Talk to the Mercenary Leader in their hideout outside {p}
Lost Royalty#006.dst: {p} の外の隠れ家で傭兵の頭と話す

Lost Royalty#007.src: Excuse me?! What are you doing here, how did you find our secret hideout?
Lost Royalty#007.dst: 何だと？！ここで何してる、どうやって俺たちの秘密の隠れ家を見つけた？
Lost Royalty#007.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#008.src: Oh, you're here for the boy? A mighty fine steal, that one! The boy won't be leaving this establishment for free. I'll need some nice loot for him.
Lost Royalty#008.dst: おう、あの小僧が目当てか？そいつは上物の獲物だぜ！ただで出すわけにはいかねえ。いいお宝と引き換えだ。
Lost Royalty#008.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#009.src: Ah, but what to have you fetch...oh, haha! This would be a perfect opportunity to obtain that... Alright, ears open!
Lost Royalty#009.dst: さて、何を取ってこさせるか… おっ、ははっ！あれを手に入れる絶好の機会じゃねえか… よし、耳の穴かっぽじって聞け！
Lost Royalty#009.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#010.src: There's a certain talisman that we aren't able to get to in the temple not far from here. It has special abilities that allow my men to be strengthened, see.
Lost Royalty#010.dst: ここからそう遠くない神殿に、俺たちじゃ手の届かねえ護符がある。手下どもを強くする特別な力があるんだよ。
Lost Royalty#010.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#011.src: The guardians there pack quite the punch, and there's some nasty mechanism in the way that we just can't crack.
Lost Royalty#011.dst: あそこの守護者は腕っぷしが強えし、途中に厄介な仕掛けがあってどうにも解けねえ。
Lost Royalty#011.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#012.src: The temple is found just across the waterway, in a crevice in the mountain. It used to be blocked until those WynnExcavation fellows tried digging there.
Lost Royalty#012.dst: 神殿は水路を渡った先、山の裂け目の中だ。WynnExcavation の連中が掘り始めるまでは塞がってたんだがな。
Lost Royalty#012.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#013.src: You get that talisman in my hands, and the king's boy is yours. Now off you pip! I'm a very busy man.
Lost Royalty#013.dst: その護符を俺の手に渡せば、王のせがれはお前のもんだ。さあ行った行った！俺は忙しいんだ。
Lost Royalty#013.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#014.src: Go to the jungle temple and retrieve the talisman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost Royalty#014.dst: ジャングルの神殿へ行き、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で護符を手に入れる

Lost Royalty#015.src: Bring the talisman back to the Mercenary Leader.
Lost Royalty#015.dst: 護符を傭兵の頭の所へ持ち帰る。

Lost Royalty#016.src: You've gotten the talisman! I can't believe you actually got through that puzzle!
Lost Royalty#016.dst: 護符を手に入れたか！まさかあの仕掛けを本当に突破するとはな！
Lost Royalty#016.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#017.src: At this point I would usually keep the kid and throw you out of here, but since you've done what I've asked in such a timely fashion, he's all yours.
Lost Royalty#017.dst: 普段ならガキは手元に残してお前を叩き出すところだが、言われた通りさっさと片付けてくれたからな、あいつはくれてやる。
Lost Royalty#017.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#018.src: When you get back to whoever asked you to do this, tell him to leave my men and I alone! We guildsmen lay down our lives every day, we don't need any more hostile onlookers!
Lost Royalty#018.dst: お前に頼んだ奴の所へ戻ったら、俺と手下に構うなと伝えろ！俺たちギルドの者は毎日命を張ってるんだ、敵意ある野次馬はもう要らねえ！
Lost Royalty#018.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#019.src: Talk to the Prince of {p} in the jail cell
Lost Royalty#019.dst: 牢屋にいる {p} の王子と話す

Lost Royalty#020.src: Report back to Yavlis with the news
Lost Royalty#020.dst: Yavlis に知らせを報告する

Lost Royalty#021.src: Ah, finally! You're back. Did they let you bring him back? Those mercenaries have an awful habit of failing to honour their deals.
Lost Royalty#021.dst: ああ、やっと！お戻りですね。王子を連れ帰らせてもらえましたか？あの傭兵たちは約束を守らない悪い癖があって。
Lost Royalty#021.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#022.src: Wait, the prince said what? He truly wants to be a mercenary? Oh my... then he must have escaped on his own.
Lost Royalty#022.dst: 待って、王子が何と？本気で傭兵になりたいと？まあ… では、自力で逃げ出したに違いありません。
Lost Royalty#022.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#023.src: Alright then, if that's the path the king's son chooses to walk, then there's nothing we can do.
Lost Royalty#023.dst: 分かりました。それが王の息子の選んだ道なら、私たちにできることはありません。
Lost Royalty#023.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#024.src: I can only hope that he chose to join them out of a will to protect the people, rather than simply brutishness or money.
Lost Royalty#024.dst: ただの乱暴さやお金目当てではなく、人々を守る意志で加わったのだと願うばかりです。
Lost Royalty#024.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#025.src: Such a shame that old guild has stooped to such a level. Well, we must thank you for your help. You can have the emerald ransom we had intended to pay.
Lost Royalty#025.dst: あの古いギルドがあそこまで落ちぶれるとは残念です。とにかく、ご協力に感謝します。払うはずだった身代金のエメラルドをどうぞ。
Lost Royalty#025.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Soles#000.src: Talk to Ferndor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], make sure to bring Abysso Galoshes with you.
Lost Soles#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Ferndor と話す。Abysso Galoshes を必ず持っていくこと。

Lost Soles#001.src: Have you seen boots called Abysso Galoshes on your journey, a pirate stole them from us years ago! I could reward you if you could bring me the Abysso Galoshes and help us!
Lost Soles#001.dst: 旅の途中で Abysso Galoshes という長靴を見かけませんでしたか？何年も前に海賊に盗まれたんです！持ってきて助けてくだされば、お礼をします！
Lost Soles#001.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#002.src: Bring back Abysso Galoshes, received during the quest Beneath the Depths.
Lost Soles#002.dst: クエスト「深淵の底へ」で手に入る Abysso Galoshes を持ち帰る。

Lost Soles#003.src: I see you have the infamous galoshes with you. But do you know even half of the story of them?
Lost Soles#003.dst: あの悪名高い長靴をお持ちですね。でも、その話の半分でもご存じですか？
Lost Soles#003.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#004.src: The boots were once owned by my ancestors, who decided to lock it away in this manor years ago.
Lost Soles#004.dst: この長靴はかつて私の先祖のもので、先祖は何年も前にこの屋敷に封じ込めることにしたんです。
Lost Soles#004.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#005.src: Nobody knows why they decided to hide the boots just after they got into my family's hands. I was told they were acquired from a strange man with pale grey skin.
Lost Soles#005.dst: 手に入れた直後に、なぜ隠すことにしたのかは誰も知りません。灰色の肌をした奇妙な男から手に入れたと聞いています。
Lost Soles#005.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#006.src: We think they hid the boots in some kind of basement in the manor. You can get to it by following the river to the waterfall, but you will need some kind of code to open it...
Lost Soles#006.dst: 屋敷の地下室のような所に隠したと考えています。川沿いに滝まで行けば着きますが、開けるには何かの暗号が要るんです…
Lost Soles#006.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#007.src: I remember Grandon saying that he found a book which is apparently a diary from one of my ancestors. Ever since that filthy pirate raided our home and stole our treasures, weird things have been happening.
Lost Soles#007.dst: Grandon が、先祖の日記らしき本を見つけたと言っていました。あの汚らわしい海賊が家を荒らして宝を盗んで以来、妙なことが続いているんです。
Lost Soles#007.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#008.src: Grandon should already have finished reading it. If I allow you to enter my home, would you talk to him?
Lost Soles#008.dst: Grandon はもう読み終えているはずです。家に入れてさしあげたら、彼と話してくれますか？
Lost Soles#008.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#009.src: There are strange things going on in this mansion and I hope that book reveals everything we need to know...
Lost Soles#009.dst: この屋敷では妙なことが起きていて、あの本が知るべきことをすべて明かしてくれるといいのですが…
Lost Soles#009.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#010.src: I almost forgot to give you your boots back, I am not sure if I want to have them near me. Remember, it is imperative you find the {~} digit code to the basement.
Lost Soles#010.dst: 長靴をお返しするのを忘れるところでした。そばに置いておきたくないので。いいですか、地下室の {~} 桁の暗号を必ず見つけてください。
Lost Soles#010.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#011.src: Visit the mansion dining room and ask Grandon about the book
Lost Soles#011.dst: 屋敷の食堂へ行き、Grandon に本について聞く

Lost Soles#012.src: Ferndor sent you here, correct? That must mean you’re here to help find the hidden {~} digit code in the manor.
Lost Soles#012.dst: Ferndor に言われて来たんですよね？ということは、屋敷に隠された {~} 桁の暗号探しを手伝いに来てくれたんですね。
Lost Soles#012.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#013.src: The book is actually a diary written by our ancestors decades ago. It is actually very interesting, how they remodeled almost the whole house.
Lost Soles#013.dst: その本は、実は何十年も前に先祖が書いた日記なんです。家をほぼ丸ごと改装した話が、とても面白くて。
Lost Soles#013.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#014.src: Ferndor probably told you about the boots, right? The diary has some information about them...ah, here, on this page.
Lost Soles#014.dst: Ferndor から長靴の話は聞きましたよね？日記にもそれについて書いてあって… ああ、ここ、このページです。
Lost Soles#014.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#015.src: Here...our family bought them from "a dark and mysterious humanoid creature" a long time ago.
Lost Soles#015.dst: ここです… 私たちの家は大昔、「暗く謎めいた人型の生き物」からそれを買ったと。
Lost Soles#015.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#016.src: The boots were apparently so valuable that the creature as part of the deal, said they put some kind of spell on them, but that was a lie.
Lost Soles#016.dst: 長靴はとても貴重なので、取引の一環として何かの呪文をかけたとその生き物は言ったそうですが、それは嘘でした。
Lost Soles#016.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#017.src: It was found that the boots themselves were horrendously powerful, imbued with dark magic that will deteriorate and decay everything around it over time.
Lost Soles#017.dst: 長靴そのものが恐ろしく強力で、闇の魔法が込められていて、時とともに周囲のすべてを劣化させ腐朽させるのだと分かったんです。
Lost Soles#017.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#018.src: They were given a special boot container with similar effects, but when the Galoshes are within the Container, they cancel each others' effects out.
Lost Soles#018.dst: 似た効果を持つ専用の長靴入れが与えられていて、Galoshes をその中に入れると互いの効果が打ち消し合うんです。
Lost Soles#018.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#019.src: They hid the boots in the mansion, along with the case. The writer of this diary wrote down some hints as to how to get them, maybe you can find out what they mean. Here, try this one:
Lost Soles#019.dst: 先祖は長靴を入れ物ごと屋敷に隠しました。日記の書き手は手に入れるためのヒントを残しています。意味が分かるかもしれません。さあ、これをどうぞ：
Lost Soles#019.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#020.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way".
Lost Soles#020.dst: 「広間の上の顔は、道を開くために重くすべき鼻を持つ」。
Lost Soles#020.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#021.src: Hmm, all the hints appear in a chapter about this room, the dining hall. Any idea what this meant? It feels like it should be obvious, but I can't for the life of me figure this out.
Lost Soles#021.dst: うーん、ヒントは全部この部屋、食堂についての章にあります。どういう意味か分かりますか？簡単そうなのに、どうしても分からなくて。
Lost Soles#021.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#022.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way"
Lost Soles#022.dst: 「広間の上の顔は、道を開くために重くすべき鼻を持つ」

Lost Soles#023.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings
Lost Soles#023.dst: Grandon と話し、見つけたことを伝える

Lost Soles#024.src: A room hidden underneath the big head? Why didn't I think of that!? I always wondered how self-centered they had to be to put that in, but who knew it actually had a valid purpose!
Lost Soles#024.dst: 大きな頭の下に隠し部屋？なんで思いつかなかったんだ！？あんなものを置くなんてどれだけ自己中心的なんだと思ってましたが、ちゃんと意味があったとは！
Lost Soles#024.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#025.src: So, there was a sign telling you to look for stone in the corner? Hm...intriguing!
Lost Soles#025.dst: つまり、隅で石を探せという看板があったと？ふむ… 興味深い！
Lost Soles#025.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#026.src: Whoever placed down that sign might have a secret way up to the second floor. It hasn't been accessible for a fairly long while, not since the stairs collapsed. Except for Leacen, but she's a bit crazy...
Lost Soles#026.dst: その看板を置いた人は、二階への秘密の道を持っていたのかも。階段が崩れて以来、ずいぶん長いこと上がれていないんです。Leacen は別ですが、彼女はちょっと変わってて…
Lost Soles#026.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#027.src: Anyway, seems they guessed that we would have to search for a way to return the boots, and made preparations. Good thing, that.
Lost Soles#027.dst: とにかく、私たちが長靴を返す方法を探すことになると見越して、準備していたようですね。ありがたいことです。
Lost Soles#027.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#028.src: As I said, the stairs are all broken. I mean, I certainly couldn't climb up those rotten scraps of wood. Suppose it might be best to look for that stone, hm?
Lost Soles#028.dst: 言った通り、階段は全部壊れてます。あんな腐った木くずを登るなんて私には無理です。まずはその石を探すのがよさそうですね？
Lost Soles#028.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#029.src: But where could it be...oh? Is this a hint? I just noticed this on the next page.
Lost Soles#029.dst: でも、どこにあるんでしょう… おや？これもヒントかな？次のページで今気づきました。
Lost Soles#029.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#030.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret".
Lost Soles#030.dst: 「色の違う絨毯が、食卓の秘密を明かす石を示す」。
Lost Soles#030.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#031.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret"
Lost Soles#031.dst: 「色の違う絨毯が、食卓の秘密を明かす石を示す」

Lost Soles#032.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings
Lost Soles#032.dst: Grandon と話し、見つけたことを伝える

Lost Soles#033.src: Sheesh! Quite the engineers, these old fellows! Never would've imagined any of this in the house. Anyway, was there a message? What did it say?
Lost Soles#033.dst: いやはや！大した技術者ですね、ご先祖様たちは！家にこんなものがあるなんて思いもしなかった。で、伝言はありましたか？何と？
Lost Soles#033.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#034.src: The hole nobody wanted? He can only mean the little rat hole in the back part of this hall. Though, it's more just a hole anymore, all the rats are gone.
Lost Soles#034.dst: 誰も欲しがらない穴？この広間の奥にある小さなネズミ穴のことでしょう。もうネズミはいないので、ただの穴ですが。
Lost Soles#034.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#035.src: Well, details, details. We never checked it any more than just laying mouse traps, so I suppose there could be something in there given how complex these contraptions have been.
Lost Soles#035.dst: まあ、細かいことはいいでしょう。ネズミ捕りを置いた以外は調べたことがないので、これまでの凝った仕掛けを思えば何かあるかもしれません。
Lost Soles#035.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#036.src: I would say, you look into the hole and then search on top of the blue flags!
Lost Soles#036.dst: 私なら、まず穴の中を覗いて、それから青い旗の上を探しますね！
Lost Soles#036.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#037.src: But if that's the way up to the second floor, what does the diary mean by this?
Lost Soles#037.dst: でも、それが二階への道なら、日記のこれはどういう意味でしょう？
Lost Soles#037.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#038.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"? Wait, that probably means the code to the basement! Come back to me at once when you've done that, I have more to tell you!
Lost Soles#038.dst: 「壁の地図の後ろに何かを投げると暗号の一部が現れる」？待って、たぶん地下室の暗号のことだ！終わったらすぐ戻ってきてください、まだ話があります！
Lost Soles#038.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#039.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"
Lost Soles#039.dst: 「壁の地図の後ろに何かを投げると暗号の一部が現れる」

Lost Soles#040.src: You found a piece of the code!? Hahah, excellent! I must say, you've made more progress in a few minutes than I have in a few years! You humans really are something!
Lost Soles#040.dst: 暗号の一部を見つけたんですか！？ははっ、素晴らしい！数分で私の数年分より進みましたよ！人間って本当にすごい！
Lost Soles#040.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#041.src: Now, the diary now says you must make your way to the second floor to find the other {~} digits of the code.
Lost Soles#041.dst: さて、日記によれば、暗号の残り {~} 桁を見つけるには二階へ行かないといけないそうです。
Lost Soles#041.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#042.src: Remember, to get up to the second floor you need to use the button in the rat hole to open the passage above the blue flags hanging from the ceiling.
Lost Soles#042.dst: 忘れずに。二階へ上がるには、ネズミ穴のボタンで、天井から下がる青い旗の上の通路を開くんです。
Lost Soles#042.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#043.src: It doesn't say where they are, just that they're well hidden and that there are additional clues around the house. The other {~} digits should all be up there on the second floor! Maybe Leacen has seen something about them while she's been up there, as well.
Lost Soles#043.dst: 場所は書いてなくて、うまく隠してあることと、家のあちこちに追加の手がかりがあることだけ。残りの {~} 桁は全部二階にあるはずです！Leacen が上にいる間に何か見てるかもしれません。
Lost Soles#043.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#044.src: Once you've found the whole code, head to the basement. Just follow the path and signs outside the manor once you have it.
Lost Soles#044.dst: 暗号が全部そろったら地下室へ。手に入れたら、屋敷の外の道と看板に従って進むだけです。
Lost Soles#044.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#045.src: Open the secret passage above the flags by reaching into the unwanted hole
Lost Soles#045.dst: 誰も欲しがらない穴に手を入れて、旗の上の隠し通路を開く

Lost Soles#046.src: Bring back [{~} Boot Container] and [Abysso Galoshes] to Ferndor
Lost Soles#046.dst: [{~} Boot Container] と [Abysso Galoshes] を Ferndor に持ち帰る

Lost Soles#047.src: Darn, I thought for sure one of these books would open a secret shelf...oh, heya Humie. Did you manage to climb up the stairs too?
Lost Soles#047.dst: ちぇっ、この本のどれかで隠し棚が開くと思ったのに… あ、やっほーヒューミー。あんたも階段を登ってきたの？
Lost Soles#047.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#048.src: Oh wow, a secret passage! Not as impressive as gettin' to climb the way up, but still nice job! I'm guessing that you're looking for the code hints?
Lost Soles#048.dst: わあ、隠し通路！登ってくるほどカッコよくはないけど、よくやったじゃん！暗号のヒントを探してるんでしょ？
Lost Soles#048.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#049.src: Yeah, I've been trying for a while too. I thought I was on to somethin' a couple of times, too! Like in here. Not one of these books opens a secret passage, can you believe it?
Lost Soles#049.dst: うん、あたしもしばらく頑張ってるんだ。何度か、いい線いってると思ったんだけどね！ここもそう。この本、一冊も隠し通路を開かないの、信じられる？
Lost Soles#049.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#050.src: Plus, I lost my notebook, so I can't even write down my notes. I just put it on the pillow for two seconds, and then it disappeared!
Lost Soles#050.dst: しかもノートをなくしちゃって、メモも取れないの。枕の上に二秒置いただけなのに、消えちゃったんだよ！
Lost Soles#050.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#051.src: Tell you what, Humie. You help us out, and I'll give you some information you might be interested in hearing. Sound good to you?
Lost Soles#051.dst: じゃあこうしよう、ヒューミー。あたしたちを手伝ってくれたら、あんたが知りたそうな情報をあげる。どう？
Lost Soles#051.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#052.src: On the upper floor are some bedrooms, and a spiral staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Head to the top of the staircase, which will take you to the roof of the manor. The sign can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], at the edge of the roof, and says "{~} is the first".
Lost Soles#052.dst: 上の階にはいくつか寝室と、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] から始まるらせん階段がある。階段の上まで行くと屋敷の屋根に出る。看板は屋根の端の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にあり、「{~} is the first」と書かれている。
Lost Soles#052.speaker: First Digit

Lost Soles#053.src: The second digit's sign is the one you find in stage {~}, revealing that the second digit is {~} when you throw any item into the map near Grandon.
Lost Soles#053.dst: 二つ目の数字の看板は第 {~} 段階で見つかるもの。Grandon の近くの地図に何かアイテムを投げると、二つ目の数字が {~} だと分かる。
Lost Soles#053.speaker: Second Digit

Lost Soles#054.src: On the second floor, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], there is an iron door with a button next to it. Press the button to open the door and enter the small room; you should find a sign which reads "He told us that the blue flowers are special...". Back in the area outside the iron door, there is one blue flower on a high shelf next to a button at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The button opens up a ladder leading to a bedroom in the corner of the room, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The third sign is on the wall of the room the ladder leads to, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and says "{~} is the third".
Lost Soles#054.dst: 二階の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] に、横にボタンのある鉄の扉がある。ボタンを押して扉を開け、小部屋に入ると「He told us that the blue flowers are special...」と書かれた看板がある。鉄の扉の外に戻ると、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のボタンの横の高い棚に青い花が一輪ある。そのボタンで、部屋の隅の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある寝室へのはしごが現れる。三つ目の看板ははしごの先の部屋の壁、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にあり、「{~} is the third」と書かれている。
Lost Soles#054.speaker: Third Digit

Lost Soles#055.src: On the third floor is a staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and leads to a walkway crossing over a hallway. Jumping off the walkway through a gap in the railings on the north side, you can get into a small hole with a sign saying "He always hid something underneath his pillow...". Drop back down to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and, as the clue suggests, throw an emerald on the pillow. This opens up a small room behind a high shelf, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], leading to the final sign, which says "{~} is the fourth". Note that if you aren't quick enough to get into the room, you can throw an emerald over to the pillow while standing on top of the shelf.
Lost Soles#055.dst: 三階には [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] から始まり、廊下をまたぐ通路へ続く階段がある。通路の北側の手すりの隙間から飛び降りると小さな穴に入れ、「He always hid something underneath his pillow...」と書かれた看板がある。[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の主寝室に降り、ヒントの通り枕にエメラルドを投げる。すると [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の高い棚の裏に小部屋が開き、「{~} is the fourth」と書かれた最後の看板がある。部屋に入るのが間に合わなければ、棚の上に立ったまま枕へエメラルドを投げてもよい。
Lost Soles#055.speaker: Fourth Digit

Lost Soles#056.src: You found the container? I wish I would have gone with you...
Lost Soles#056.dst: 入れ物を見つけたんですか？一緒に行けばよかった…
Lost Soles#056.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#057.src: At least we can stop the manor's slow decay! Let me just put the boots into the container...
Lost Soles#057.dst: これで屋敷がゆっくり腐朽していくのを止められます！長靴を入れ物に入れますね…
Lost Soles#057.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#058.src: That was easy. I still can not believe that such a small thing can cause so much trouble.
Lost Soles#058.dst: 簡単でしたね。こんな小さな物がこれほどの騒ぎを起こすなんて、まだ信じられません。
Lost Soles#058.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#059.src: Well, I can not just let you stand there without a reward, right?
Lost Soles#059.dst: さて、お礼もなしにそこに立たせておくわけにはいきませんよね？
Lost Soles#059.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#060.src: Here, how about some emeralds, and these boots? They're heirlooms given to my family by the Sodeta Guild who once owned this mansion. I promise they aren’t evil! Feel free to visit us at any time!
Lost Soles#060.dst: さあ、エメラルドと、このブーツをどうぞ。かつてこの屋敷を所有していた Sodeta ギルドから家に贈られた家宝です。呪われてはいませんよ！いつでも遊びに来てください！
Lost Soles#060.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Tower#000.dst: {p} の [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる Laen と話す。

Lost Tower#001.src: Hey adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#001.dst: やあ、冒険者さん！少し手を貸してもらえませんか？ちょっと困っていまして。
Lost Tower#001.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#002.src: A while ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#002.dst: 昔、{p} が滅びる前、うちの一族は面白い本を持っていました。強大な場所や存在の知識が記された本です。
Lost Tower#002.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#003.src: Unfortunately, a creature stole it from them during the attack that led to the destruction of {p}, and no one has seen it since.
Lost Tower#003.dst: でも {p} を滅ぼした襲撃の最中に怪物に盗まれて、それきり誰も見ていないんです。
Lost Tower#003.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#004.src: If you are willing to help, bring me [{~} Book of the Bones], I believe this book is now between the hands of skeletons, in an old tower in {p}.
Lost Tower#004.dst: 手伝ってくれるなら [{~} Book of the Bones] を持ってきてください。今は {p} の古い塔で、骸骨の手にあるはずです。
Lost Tower#004.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#005.src: See if you can find this tower, one of the skeletons probably has the book somewhere in there.
Lost Tower#005.dst: その塔を探してみてください。中の骸骨のどれかが本を持っているはずです。
Lost Tower#005.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#006.src: Find the lost tower in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lost Tower#006.dst: {p} の [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある失われた塔を見つける。

Lost Tower#007.src: Find the book in the tower, and bring it back to Laen.
Lost Tower#007.dst: 塔の中で本を見つけ、Laen に届ける。

Lost Tower#008.src: Bring back the book to Laen.
Lost Tower#008.dst: 本を Laen に届ける。

Lost Tower#009.src: Great! This will be very interesting to read, thank you!
Lost Tower#009.dst: すばらしい！これは読みごたえがありそうです、ありがとう！
Lost Tower#009.speaker: Laen

Maltic's Well#000.src: Talk to Rynend located in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Maltic's Well#000.dst: {p} の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる Rynend と話す

Maltic's Well#001.src: Please help us! We called for a {p} guard days ago, but Humans tend to forget this little village.
Maltic's Well#001.dst: どうか助けてください！何日も前に {p} へ衛兵を頼んだのに、人間はこの小さな村を忘れがちで。
Maltic's Well#001.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#002.src: Last week, an evil witch found refuge in our old well. Normally this wouldn't be a problem...
Maltic's Well#002.dst: 先週、邪悪な魔女が村の古井戸に住みつきました。普段ならそれほど問題ではないのですが…
Maltic's Well#002.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#003.src: But she's lured my child into the well! My only child! He was born in Wynn, that makes him a Wynn citizen!
Maltic's Well#003.dst: でも息子を井戸に誘い込んだんです！たった一人の息子を！Wynn 生まれだから Wynn の市民なんですよ！
Maltic's Well#003.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#004.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of importance to you humans, being a Villager settlement, but...my son!
Maltic's Well#004.dst: どうにかしてください！村人の集落の {p} など人間には大事じゃないでしょうが…息子が！
Maltic's Well#004.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#005.src: Investigate the old {p} well at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] to Rynend
Maltic's Well#005.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある {p} の古井戸を調べ、[{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] を Rynend に届ける

Maltic's Well#006.src: Help me! Someone! The witch is being mean!!
Maltic's Well#006.dst: 助けて！誰か！魔女がいじわるするんだ！！
Maltic's Well#006.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#007.src: I wondered when they'd send the famous {p} guards. You'll never get me!
Maltic's Well#007.dst: 有名な {p} の衛兵がいつ来るかと思ってたわ。私は捕まらないわよ！
Maltic's Well#007.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#008.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!
Maltic's Well#008.dst: なんで魔女呼ばわりされるのかしら。魔法なんてどこにでもあるのに。この子の父親が私の見た目を笑ったから、息子を Grook に変えてやるの！
Maltic's Well#008.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#009.src: Treat me like a witch, I'll act like one, darn it! You'll have to pass through my dastardly magical defenses to find me!
Maltic's Well#009.dst: 魔女扱いするなら魔女らしくしてやるわよ、もう！私の極悪な魔法の守りを突破しなきゃ会えないわよ！
Maltic's Well#009.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#010.src: Oh...drat. I never could get that spell right. Well, now you'll have to guess the way, um, you fool! Turn back now, for, uh...
Maltic's Well#010.dst: あら…しまった。あの呪文、いつも上手くいかないのよね。じゃあ道は自分で当てなさい、えっと、このおバカ！今すぐ引き返しなさい、だって、その…
Maltic's Well#010.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#011.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The, um...the Beast-What-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!! Totally!
Maltic's Well#011.dst: …だって扉を間違えたら獣のもとに送られるのよ、世にも恐ろしい獣に！その、えー…{p} の衛兵をブランチに食べる獣！！ほんとよ！
Maltic's Well#011.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#012.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing pointy hats, and have warts.
Maltic's Well#012.dst: あら…これで騙せるとは思ってなかったけど。実はね、魔法は全然得意じゃないの。とんがり帽子が好きで、イボがあるだけ。
Maltic's Well#012.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#013.src: Maybe if the people of this village weren't so mean to me, I wouldn't have been forced to live here.
Maltic's Well#013.dst: この村の人たちが意地悪じゃなかったら、こんな所に住まずに済んだのに。
Maltic's Well#013.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#014.src: I know it's a crime, but his father and the rest of the villagers here hunt me like I'm a rabid dog!
Maltic's Well#014.dst: 罪なのは分かってる。でもあの子の父親も村人たちも、私を狂犬みたいに追い回すのよ！
Maltic's Well#014.speaker: Witch
