Overture to Despair#145.src: This... this wind chime. Look at it.
Overture to Despair#145.dst: この… この風鈴。見て。
Overture to Despair#145.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#146.src: ...what? No, I'm looking at a wall. What do you think I was looking at?
Overture to Despair#146.dst: …え？違う、壁を見てるの。何を見てると思ったの？
Overture to Despair#146.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#147.src: These wind chimes. They're... a symbol of resistance in the {p}. S... um, Syndra told us about them.
Overture to Despair#147.dst: この風鈴。これは… {p} での抵抗の象徴なの。S… えっと、Syndra が教えてくれた。
Overture to Despair#147.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#148.src: The wind represents... freedom, and free will. But I wouldn't have expected the chimes to have made it all the way here...?
Overture to Despair#148.dst: 風は… 自由と、自由意志を表してる。でも、風鈴がこんな所まで伝わってるなんて…？
Overture to Despair#148.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#149.src: Could... could this mean what I think it does?
Overture to Despair#149.dst: これって… 私が思ってる通りの意味？
Overture to Despair#149.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#150.src: I was right... I was right! It's a symbol of resistance, th-that means {p} must have its own resistance!!
Overture to Despair#150.dst: やっぱり… やっぱりそうだ！抵抗の象徴、つ、つまり {p} にもレジスタンスがあるはず！！
Overture to Despair#150.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#151.src: We... we need to seek them out, {u}!
Overture to Despair#151.dst: 私たち… 彼らを探さなきゃ、{u}！
Overture to Despair#151.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#152.src: ...oh. Right. Um, sorry. I just... got excited.
Overture to Despair#152.dst: …あ。そうだね。えっと、ごめん。ちょっと… 興奮しちゃった。
Overture to Despair#152.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#153.src: ...oh. Oops. Let's um, hope I wasn't too loud...
Overture to Despair#153.dst: …あ。しまった。えっと、大声じゃなかったといいけど…
Overture to Despair#153.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#154.src: A-anyway. I think there's... an inscription on the wind chime.
Overture to Despair#154.dst: と、とにかく。風鈴に… 何か文字が刻まれてる。
Overture to Despair#154.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#155.src: "The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores."
Overture to Despair#155.dst: 「変革の風は西より吹き、真実の波を我らの岸へ打ち寄せる」
Overture to Despair#155.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#156.src: ...that must be where the resistance is! Let's- let's find them!
Overture to Despair#156.dst: …そこがレジスタンスの居場所だ！さ、探しに行こう！
Overture to Despair#156.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#157.src: Find the location specified on the wind chime in {p}: The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores.
Overture to Despair#157.dst: {p} で風鈴に示された場所を探す：変革の風は西より吹き、真実の波を我らの岸へ打ち寄せる。

Overture to Despair#158.src: ...oh. There... doesn't seem to be a resistance here. Just another wind chime.
Overture to Despair#158.dst: …あれ。ここには… レジスタンスはいないみたい。また風鈴があるだけ。
Overture to Despair#158.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#159.src: Does this one also have something written on it?
Overture to Despair#159.dst: これにも何か書いてある？
Overture to Despair#159.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#160.src: Find the next location: Rooted deep atop the house of wealth and greed, the branches hear the whispers on the breeze.
Overture to Despair#160.dst: 次の場所を探す：富と強欲の館の頂に深く根を張り、枝は風のささやきを聞く。

Overture to Despair#161.src: Find the next location: The whispers speak of unity, called forth where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#161.dst: 次の場所を探す：ささやきは団結を語り、埋もれた鋼の線で地域が交わる場所に呼び起こされる。

Overture to Despair#162.src: Find the next location: Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed.
Overture to Despair#162.dst: 次の場所を探す：日ごと声は探求者を迎える。真実を見極め、刷られた秘密を読め。

Overture to Despair#163.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#163.dst: いらっしゃい、いらっしゃい！上等な新聞はいかが？今日は雑誌がお好みかな― おいしいゴシップがありますよ。
Overture to Despair#163.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#164.src: What? {u}, what are you doing? That's not...
Overture to Despair#164.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#165.src: ...um. We're very interested in your... um, your wind chimes.
Overture to Despair#165.dst: …えっと。私たち、あなたの… えっと、風鈴にすごく興味があって。
Overture to Despair#165.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#166.src: Windchimes? I'm sorry? I haven't the foggiest idea what you mean. I've certainly heard of them down in the {p}, but here? What an odd thing to say.
Overture to Despair#166.dst: 風鈴？はい？何のことだかさっぱり。{p} の方にあるとは聞きますが、ここで？妙なことをおっしゃる。
Overture to Despair#166.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#167.src: But still, perhaps I can get you a paper. Out of curiosity... where might you two be from? I don't think I've seen you around here before!
Overture to Despair#167.dst: それはさておき、新聞はいかが？ちなみに… お二人はどちらから？この辺りでは見かけない顔ですね！
Overture to Despair#167.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#168.src: Haha, oh dear. I asked where you were from, not the way you got here. So, let's try that one again! Where are you two from?
Overture to Despair#168.dst: ははは、おやおや。どうやって来たかじゃなく、どこから来たかを聞いたんです。もう一度！どちらのご出身で？
Overture to Despair#168.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#169.src: Ah, yes, and I found a gold bar in my mailbox today! Haha, you'll have to try harder to pull one over on me like that- no one's lived in the {p} for ages! Now, be serious! I was genuine in asking.
Overture to Despair#169.dst: ええ、私も今日郵便受けで金の延べ棒を見つけましたよ！ははは、その手には乗りません― {p} にはもう何百年も誰も住んでいない！さあ、真面目に！本気で聞いてるんです。
Overture to Despair#169.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#170.src: So too we all do- from nothing but milk and love, as I've heard it's said, but if we were to talk about the origins of the universe we'd be here all night. So, where are you really from?
Overture to Despair#170.dst: 誰だってそうです― ミルクと愛から生まれた、とか言いますね。でも宇宙の起源の話をしたら夜が明けちゃう。で、本当はどこから？
Overture to Despair#170.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#171.src: Ahaaa, I see! So you're looking for the people who seek the truth. A noble endeavour, certainly.
Overture to Despair#171.dst: あはぁ、なるほど！真実を求める人々をお探しなんですね。立派な志です。
Overture to Despair#171.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#172.src: We'd, um, love to meet some more of these... truth... seekers...?
Overture to Despair#172.dst: 私たち、えっと、その… 真実を… 求める人に… もっと会いたいな…？
Overture to Despair#172.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#173.src: There's many a like-minded individual if you know where to look. So allow me to catch your eye with the Aelumia Times! It's the best way to keep up with current events.
Overture to Despair#173.dst: 探す場所さえ分かれば、同志は大勢いますよ。というわけで、『Aelumia 新聞』をおすすめします！時事を追うには一番です。
Overture to Despair#173.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#174.src: Column {~} will often print the phrase of the day. Read up, and pay close attention! Things will kick off here at midnight.
Overture to Despair#174.dst: 第 {~} 欄にはよく「今日の合言葉」が載ります。よく読んで、注意深く！ここでは深夜零時に始まります。
Overture to Despair#174.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#175.src: I wish you two good luck on your endeavours. May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#175.dst: お二人の志に幸運を。久しく埋もれし真実を掘り起こし、変革をもたらさん。
Overture to Despair#175.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#176.src: Th-thank you. Um... may we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change!
Overture to Despair#176.dst: あ、ありがとう。…久しく埋もれし真実を掘り起こし、変革をもたらさん！
Overture to Despair#176.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#177.src: Leave the shop and discuss the next steps.
Overture to Despair#177.dst: 店を出て次の手を話し合う。

Overture to Despair#178.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.
Overture to Despair#178.dst: 久しく埋もれし真実を掘り起こし、変革をもたらさん。決して忘れずに。
Overture to Despair#178.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#179.src: Finally! Finally, finally, something good is happening!
Overture to Despair#179.dst: やっと！やっと、やっと、いいことが起きた！
Overture to Despair#179.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#180.src: I didn't even think there'd be a resistance in {p}... it just seems so... idyllic, here. Like... um, like they don't really have... issues.
Overture to Despair#180.dst: {p} にレジスタンスがあるなんて思わなかった… ここはすごく… のどかに見えるし。まるで… えっと、何の問題もないみたいに。
Overture to Despair#180.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#181.src: But... I guess we don't know what life is like here... um, either way, if they're a resistance, they have to have intel.
Overture to Despair#181.dst: でも… ここの暮らしは分からないよね… えっと、どっちにしろ、レジスタンスなら情報を持ってるはず。
Overture to Despair#181.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#182.src: Here, hand me that newspaper. Okay... Column {~}... looks like today's phrase of the day is... "No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot?"
Overture to Despair#182.dst: ほら、その新聞貸して。えっと… 第 {~} 欄… 今日の合言葉は…「緑の Squirmle Pot なんて存在しない？」
Overture to Despair#182.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#183.src: Weird. But... I guess nobody's going to guess it!
Overture to Despair#183.dst: 変なの。でも… これなら誰にも当てられないね！
Overture to Despair#183.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#184.src: Okay. Okay... th-this is happening! Majin Thalas, "number one" Sovereign, we're coming for you...
Overture to Despair#184.dst: よし。よし… つ、ついに始まる！Majin Thalas、「筆頭」の君主、今行くからね…
Overture to Despair#184.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#185.src: I'm feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#185.dst: だいぶ気分が良くなった。えっと… じゃあ今は何しよう？深夜零時を… 待つあいだ。
Overture to Despair#185.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#186.src: Yes... um, thinking about it now, I guess I am kind of starving...
Overture to Despair#186.dst: うん… えっと、考えてみたら、お腹ぺこぺこかも…
Overture to Despair#186.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#187.src: I remember seeing a restaurant earlier! Follow me.
Overture to Despair#187.dst: さっきレストランを見かけたの！ついてきて。
Overture to Despair#187.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#188.src: I... I guess I could use a nap...
Overture to Despair#188.dst: 私… ちょっと昼寝したいかも…
Overture to Despair#188.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#189.src: Okay. I'll meet you in our room.
Overture to Despair#189.dst: わかった。部屋で会おう。
Overture to Despair#189.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#190.src: Head to the restaurant and wait at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#190.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のレストランへ行って待つ。

Overture to Despair#191.src: Oh... this is quite cozy, actually. It... it, ha, doesn't really... compare to the Red Fox... but it works.
Overture to Despair#191.dst: わあ… 意外と居心地いいね。まあ、はは… 赤狐亭には… かなわないけど… 悪くない。
Overture to Despair#191.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#192.src: Maybe it's... better that it, isn't the same. I'm not sure I could...
Overture to Despair#192.dst: たぶん… 同じじゃないほうがいいのかも。私、耐えられるか…
Overture to Despair#192.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#193.src: Hello, hello! Welcome to the Peacock Inn! What can I get started for you this evening?
Overture to Despair#193.dst: いらっしゃいませ！孔雀亭へようこそ！今夜はまず何をお持ちしましょう？
Overture to Despair#193.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#194.src: Today's special dishes are fish tacos, fish miso soup, and yak curry! All locally sourced from our lovely {p}, naturally.
Overture to Despair#194.dst: 本日のおすすめは、魚のタコス、魚の味噌汁、ヤクのカレー！もちろん、どれも愛しの {p} の地元産です。
Overture to Despair#194.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#195.src: Um... I'll take the tacos, please.
Overture to Despair#195.dst: えっと… タコスをお願い。
Overture to Despair#195.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#196.src: Coming right up! It'll just be a few minutes.
Overture to Despair#196.dst: かしこまりました！数分でお持ちします。
Overture to Despair#196.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#197.src: ...it's nice here, isn't it? I hadn't... really let myself notice that before. I can see why people talk about the {p} so much...
Overture to Despair#197.dst: …ここ、いいところだね。今まで… 気づかないようにしてた。みんなが {p} の話ばかりする理由が分かる…
Overture to Despair#197.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#198.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even, even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#198.dst: 私… もう。まだすごく腹が立つ。何もかもに！王家にも、君主にも… {p} の人たちにも！！世界が終わったみたいなのに、ふ、普通に暮らしてるから。
Overture to Despair#198.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#199.src: ...but we have some hope. F-finally. Rex and Zeph... there's still a chance we'll get to see them again.
Overture to Despair#199.dst: …でも、少し希望が見えた。や、やっと。Rex と Zeph に… また会えるかもしれない。
Overture to Despair#199.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#200.src: And... is it weird that I kind of miss the Canopy, too? Even though they were... annoying, and overbearing, and- and kind of... scary?
Overture to Despair#200.dst: それに… 樹冠が恋しいって、変かな？うるさくて、偉そうで… ちょっと… 怖かったのに？
Overture to Despair#200.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#201.src: ...and Yusanu. I hope he's alright. I- I, ha, I really hope he can free his family too. I... I, um, don't want him to lose anyone either.
Overture to Despair#201.dst: …それに Yusanu。無事だといいな。私… はは、家族を助け出せるといいな。私… えっと、あの人にも誰も失ってほしくない。
Overture to Despair#201.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#202.src: ...I hope he doesn't hate me. After what I said to him.
Overture to Despair#202.dst: …恨まれてないといいな。あんなこと言っちゃったし。
Overture to Despair#202.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#204.src: Um... while we wait. Is there anything you want to talk about?
Overture to Despair#204.dst: えっと… 待ってるあいだ、何か話したいことある？
Overture to Despair#204.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#205.src: ...it's weird. It feels like the ocean is... raging. Thundering storms and crashing waves, and... and still, it doesn't feel like it's at risk of drowning me?
Overture to Despair#205.dst: …変なの。海が… 荒れ狂ってる感じがする。雷鳴の嵐と打ち寄せる波。なのに… 溺れる気がしないの。
Overture to Despair#205.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#206.src: Like... like I could take as much as I want and it wouldn't change a thing. And, ha, it scares me, a little. It's so... different, to how it was before, but...
Overture to Despair#206.dst: まるで… いくら汲み取っても何も変わらないみたい。はは、ちょっと怖い。前とは… 全然違う。でも…
Overture to Despair#206.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#207.src: ...it feels right. Like this is how it always was supposed to be, and I just... didn't realize.
Overture to Despair#207.dst: …これが正しい気がする。最初からこうあるべきで、私が… 気づいてなかっただけ。
Overture to Despair#207.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#208.src: Once it's... over...? I... I hadn't... let myself think about that...
Overture to Despair#208.dst: 終わったら…？私… まだ… 考えないようにしてた…
Overture to Despair#208.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#209.src: I, um. I actually... had a dream last night. But, ha, it was- it was just that. Just a dream.
Overture to Despair#209.dst: 私、えっと。実は… 昨夜夢を見たの。でも、はは、ただの― ただの夢だよ。
Overture to Despair#209.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#211.src: All of us... Rex, Zeph, the- the Roughworks boys... um, Mora, a-and Syndra... we were all laughing and, and having a good time at the Auburn Festival.
Overture to Despair#211.dst: みんないて… Rex、Zeph、Roughworks の男の子たち… えっと、Mora、そ、それに Syndra… みんなで Auburn の祭りで笑って、楽しんでた。
Overture to Despair#211.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#212.src: We ate good food... Yuman played music, while Rex and Zeph were b-bickering... Yusanu and Mora were t-talking about his latest invention, and...
Overture to Despair#212.dst: おいしいものを食べて… Yuman は演奏して、Rex と Zeph はけ、口げんか… Yusanu と Mora は彼の新しい発明の話をしてて…
Overture to Despair#212.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#214.src: When I... when I woke up, I- ha, I was c-crying. I- I know, I know! It's... stupid. It's stupid.
Overture to Despair#214.dst: 目が… 目が覚めたら、私― はは、な、泣いてた。わ、分かってる！ばかみたい。ばかみたいだよね。
Overture to Despair#214.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#215.src: ...it's, um, hard to pick out one moment. She's been like a mother to me ever since I was... {~} years old.
Overture to Despair#215.dst: …えっと、一つには選べない。{~} 歳の頃から、ずっと母親みたいな人だったから。
Overture to Despair#215.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#216.src: M-maybe the first time I really met her. After I discovered my... my gift, I thought my life was over.
Overture to Despair#216.dst: さ、最初にちゃんと会った時かな。自分の… 力に気づいて、人生終わったと思ってた。
Overture to Despair#216.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#217.src: I- I was cursed! And I knew what h-happened to the cursed. Taken away, never to be seen again... or, or killed outright. I had nowhere to go.
Overture to Despair#217.dst: わ、私は呪われてた！呪われし者がどうなるか知ってた。連れ去られて二度と戻らないか… その場で殺される。行く所なんてなかった。
Overture to Despair#217.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#218.src: I, um... I'd seen Syndra around before. I... I knew she talked to Mora, before he... l-left our family. So... I, ha, I guess I thought... maybe she'd help me too.
Overture to Despair#218.dst: 私、えっと… Syndra は前から見かけてた。Mora が… か、家を出る前、彼女と話してたのも知ってた。だから… はは、私も助けてもらえるかもって。
Overture to Despair#218.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#219.src: A-and she did! She wasn't scared, she didn't report me. She just... embraced me in a hug and welcome me to her home.
Overture to Despair#219.dst: そ、そしたら助けてくれた！怖がらず、通報もせず。ただ… 抱きしめて、家に迎えてくれた。
Overture to Despair#219.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#220.src: She, um, reunited me with Mora again. After... f-five long years alone. She... she saved me, and now... and now she's...
Overture to Despair#220.dst: えっと、Mora とも再会させてくれた。ご、五年も一人だった後で。私を… 救ってくれたのに、今は…
Overture to Despair#220.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#221.src: ...I never got to tell her how much she meant to me.
Overture to Despair#221.dst: …どれだけ大切だったか、伝えられなかった。
Overture to Despair#221.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#222.dst: 私… そうだといいな。
Overture to Despair#222.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#225.src: And here we are with your orders! You fish tacos, young lady - sturgeon head packed with tangy cabbage, tossed in rice vinegar, crispy seaweed, and punchy umami sauce.
Overture to Despair#225.dst: お待たせしました！お嬢さんには魚のタコス― チョウザメの頭に酸味のキャベツ、米酢、パリパリの海苔、旨味たっぷりのソース！
Overture to Despair#225.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#226.src: And another order of fish tacos for you! Please, enjoy!
Overture to Despair#226.dst: こちらにも魚のタコスを！どうぞごゆっくり！
Overture to Despair#226.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#227.src: And for you, the Bubble Heckel Miso Soup! A hearty broth simmered with today's catch and miso paste that ties all the flavours together! Enjoy!
Overture to Despair#227.dst: そしてこちら、Bubble Heckel の味噌汁！今日の漁獲と味噌でじっくり煮込んだ、風味をまとめる濃厚スープです！
Overture to Despair#227.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#228.src: And for you, the Yak Potato Curry! A rich, aromatic dish seasoned with wild heather. Tender yak meat and new potatoes! You're in for a treat!
Overture to Despair#228.dst: そしてこちら、ヤクとジャガイモのカレー！野生のヒースで香り豊かに。柔らかいヤク肉と新ジャガ！ご堪能あれ！
Overture to Despair#228.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#229.src: Um... so this is a taco...?
Overture to Despair#229.dst: えっと… これがタコス…？
Overture to Despair#229.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#230.src: I, I guess I don't know what I expected, but... um. Not this.
Overture to Despair#230.dst: 私、何を期待してたのか分からないけど… えっと。これじゃない。
Overture to Despair#230.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#232.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のホテルの部屋に戻り、集会の前に休む。

Overture to Despair#254.src: Return to the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Overture to Despair#256.src: Oh, is it night time already...? We should get back to the newspaper merchant then.
Overture to Despair#256.dst: あれ、もう夜…？じゃあ新聞売りのところに戻らないと。
Overture to Despair#256.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#257.src: {u}, before we head in. Let's just... observe, a-and not ask too many questions.
Overture to Despair#257.dst: {u}、入る前に。とにかく… 観察して、あ、あまり質問しないでおこう。
Overture to Despair#257.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#258.src: Ah, terribly sorry! We're just closing out for the day was on my way out the door. Oh did you find the paper to be enlightening?
Overture to Despair#258.dst: ああ、申し訳ない！今日はもう店じまいで、ちょうど出るところでして。おや、新聞で何かひらめきましたか？
Overture to Despair#258.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#259.src: No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot.
Overture to Despair#259.dst: 緑の Squirmle Pot なんて存在しない。
Overture to Despair#259.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#260.src: Good, good! Glad to hear you're interested in cutting through the weeds, hearing the stories that matter.
Overture to Despair#260.dst: 結構、結構！雑草をかき分けて大事な話を聞く気がおありとは、嬉しいですね。
Overture to Despair#260.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#261.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#261.dst: 集会はまもなく始まります― 私の後ろの階段を下へどうぞ。
Overture to Despair#261.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#262.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#262.dst: 集会はまもなく始まります― 私の後ろの階段を下へどうぞ。
Overture to Despair#262.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#263.src: That ought to be all of us. Let's begin, everyone!
Overture to Despair#263.dst: これで全員だな。さあ、始めよう！
Overture to Despair#263.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#264.src: We have some new members joining us today. Please welcome them to our society, The Blossom of Blades.
Overture to Despair#264.dst: 今日は新しい仲間が来ている。我らが結社「刃の花」へ歓迎しよう。
Overture to Despair#264.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#265.src: Now, Bleeding Rose. You were so excited to start us off earlier. You've been so quiet normally- how about you share first today?
Overture to Despair#265.dst: さて、血濡れの薔薇。さっきは一番手を張り切っていたね。普段は静かなんだし、今日は最初に話してみては？
Overture to Despair#265.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#266.src: ...thank you, Dusk Garden. I...I think this is pretty alarming, actually... Comparing the prices day to day, bread suddenly spiked. {~} more than just a week ago, with no word of warning.
Overture to Despair#266.dst: …ありがとう、黄昏の庭。わ、私、これはかなり深刻だと思う… 日々の値段を比べると、パンが急に値上がりしてる。一週間前より {~} も、何の予告もなく。
Overture to Despair#266.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#267.src: I'm not sure what we can...really do about that, but shouldn't we...y-y'know... ... ...do... ...something...?
Overture to Despair#267.dst: それに対して何が… できるか分からないけど、私たち… そ、その… …何か… …すべき…じゃ…？
Overture to Despair#267.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#268.src: Ugh, again? It isn't an unlivable increase yet, but the poorer among us will definitely be feeling that. Thank you for speaking up, now it's someone else's turn.
Overture to Despair#268.dst: はあ、またか？まだ暮らせないほどの値上がりじゃないけど、貧しい者には確かにこたえる。発言ありがとう、では次の人。
Overture to Despair#268.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#270.src: Psst. What the hell is going on here?
Overture to Despair#270.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#272.src: Oh, oh! The news from {p}!! It's- well, I don't know if it's a disaster, or a good thing, really!
Overture to Despair#272.dst: ねえ、ねえ！{p} からのニュース！！それが― 災難なのか朗報なのか、正直分からない！
Overture to Despair#272.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#273.src: Well, I barely had time to read the Aelumia Times to get the passcode. Fill me in, would you?
Overture to Despair#273.dst: 合言葉のために『Aelumia 新聞』を読むのがやっとだったの。教えてくれる？
Overture to Despair#273.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#274.src: This wasn't in the Aelumia Times... Anonymous sources have stated that Sovereign Soosu defied Her Majesty, openly!!
Overture to Despair#274.dst: これは『Aelumia 新聞』には載ってない… 匿名の情報筋によると、君主 Soosu が女王陛下に公然と逆らったって！！
Overture to Despair#274.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#276.src: What- What do you mean?! Defied, like...went off-script during a speech, or-
Overture to Despair#276.dst: な― どういうこと？！逆らったって… 演説で台本を外れたとか―
Overture to Despair#276.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#277.src: She allowed terrorists to escape! At least three of them, according to my sources! Word is, too, that... That she was... Executed!!
Overture to Despair#277.dst: テロリストを逃がしたの！情報筋によると少なくとも三人！しかも噂じゃ… 彼女は… 処刑されたって！！
Overture to Despair#277.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#278.src: I- You guys! A Sovereign went against the Queen! What...what do you think that means, for us? what do you think we should do? If she can do something that big-
Overture to Despair#278.dst: わ― みんな！君主が女王に逆らったんだよ！それって… 私たちにとってどういう意味？どうすべきだと思う？彼女があんな大きなことができるなら―
Overture to Despair#278.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#279.src: And get executed for it?! Then who would do the work we do? Soosu has always been a bit of a loose cannon anyways. It isn't that surprising.
Overture to Despair#279.dst: で、処刑されろって？！そしたら誰が私たちの活動をするの？Soosu は昔から危なっかしい人だったし。大して驚かない。
Overture to Despair#279.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#280.dst: でも彼女は… …私… … …私たちなら―
Overture to Despair#280.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#281.src: In other news! Sovereign Majin was supposedly seen with an unknown man this Saturday. They were out on a walk, but we all know what that really means.
Overture to Despair#281.dst: 他のニュース！君主 Majin が今週の土曜、謎の男と一緒にいたらしい。散歩してたって。でもそれが何を意味するか、分かるよね。
Overture to Despair#281.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#282.src: -up for you next time, Rose- Ah. That- I heard that was just a new servant. Nothing too important.
Overture to Despair#282.dst: ―次は話させてあげるから、Rose― あ。それね― ただの新しい使用人らしいよ。大したことない。
Overture to Despair#282.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#283.src: Well, I'll be publishing it in the Majin Monthly anyways. Maybe I could spin a scandal out of this one! ...probably not, but you never know.
Overture to Despair#283.dst: まあ、どっちみち『月刊 Majin』に載せるけどね。スキャンダルに仕立てられるかも！…たぶん無理だけど、分からないでしょ。
Overture to Despair#283.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#284.src: Um... I actually had a question about Sovereign Majin.
Overture to Despair#284.dst: えっと… 君主 Majin について聞きたいことがあるの。
Overture to Despair#284.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#285.src: Oh, absolutely! I keep tabs on him, so you could consider me an expert on all things Majin, uh...miss...what was your code name again?
Overture to Despair#285.dst: ええ、もちろん！彼の動向は追ってるから、Majin のことなら何でも専門家よ。えっと… あなた… コードネーム、何だっけ？
Overture to Despair#285.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#286.src: Oh, my... code... name... um. Right. It's- Water Grass. That's my name.
Overture to Despair#286.dst: あ、私の… コード… ネーム… えっと。そう。それは― 水草。それが私の名前。
Overture to Despair#286.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#287.src: ...alright. That... That doesn't follow our naming scheme perfectly but- You know, whatever. What's your question?
Overture to Despair#287.dst: …そう。それは… 命名規則とはちょっと違うけど― まあ、いいか。質問は？
Overture to Despair#287.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#288.src: I... um, I heard a rumor that he'd picked up some prisoners from the {p}.
Overture to Despair#288.dst: 私… えっと、彼が {p} から囚人を連れてきたって噂を聞いたの。
Overture to Despair#288.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#289.src: Ah! You spoiled my juicy scoop for tomorrow's edition! Yes, the rumour is true.
Overture to Despair#289.dst: ああ！明日の号の特ダネをばらしちゃって！そう、その噂は本当。
Overture to Despair#289.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#290.src: Supposedly, he took these prisoners to his castle in the east. There is, according to other rumour, a dungeon underneath it. It'd make sense- why wouldn't a dictator have a dungeon for dissidents?
Overture to Despair#290.dst: 噂じゃ、その囚人は東の彼の城に連れていかれた。別の噂だと、城の地下には地下牢がある。まあ当然よね― 独裁者が反逆者用の地下牢を持たないわけがない。
Overture to Despair#290.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#291.src: R-really? What else do you know?
Overture to Despair#291.dst: ほ、本当？他に何を知ってる？
Overture to Despair#291.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#292.src: That there were specifically two prisoners, and, to bring it back around to Thorn Blade's news, that they're part of the {p} Terrorists! Because of that, the guard around House Thalas is particularly tight recently.
Overture to Despair#292.dst: 囚人はちょうど二人。で、茨の刃のニュースに話を戻すと、{p} テロリストの一味なの！だから最近は Thalas 家の周りの警備が特に厳重。
Overture to Despair#292.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#293.src: Incidentally, I was planning on selling this piece to the Aelumia Times. So, don't any of you go writing in before me.
Overture to Despair#293.dst: ついでに言うと、この記事は『Aelumia 新聞』に売るつもりなの。だから、誰も先に投稿しないでよ。
Overture to Despair#293.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#294.src: Well, ah, I heard one of them was that runaway House Athassa girl! Remember the tabloids a few years ago? It was a whole scandal.
Overture to Despair#294.dst: ええと、そのうち一人は、Athassa 家から逃げ出したあの娘だって聞いた！何年か前のゴシップ紙、覚えてる？大スキャンダルだったよ。
Overture to Despair#294.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#295.src: Goodness, Boundless Cherry's sister? I hadn't realized she was involved! Tsk, what a shame that reason doesn't run in the family.
Overture to Despair#295.dst: まあ、果てなき桜の妹？関わってたなんて知らなかった！ちっ、分別は家系に受け継がれないのね。
Overture to Despair#295.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#296.src: What does it matter?! You never shut up about the "one that got away," and- and there's so much more important to b-
Overture to Despair#296.dst: それが何なの？！「逃げ出したあの子」の話ばっかりして、もっと大事なことが―
Overture to Despair#296.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#297.src: I do not! Crimson Dagger, please, back me up-
Overture to Despair#297.dst: そんなことない！紅の短剣、ほら、何か言ってよ―
Overture to Despair#297.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#298.src: What are we going to DO?! We just- I came here because I thought together we-
Overture to Despair#298.dst: 私たち、何を「する」の？！ただ― みんなで一緒なら何かできると思って来たのに―
Overture to Despair#298.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#299.src: Ah! Ah ah!! Did you guys hear that we aren't getting any freebies this festival? This is absolutely appalling.
Overture to Despair#299.dst: あっ！ねえねえ！！今度の祭り、無料の配り物がないって聞いた？ほんとにひどい。
Overture to Despair#299.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#302.src: ...shoot! Me and... um, Shadow Bush... forgot to turn off the stove! We'll, um, see you guys at the next meeting! May we reveal secrets buried and bring change!
Overture to Despair#302.dst: …やばい！私と… えっと、影の茂みが… コンロを消し忘れた！えっと、次の集会でね！埋もれた秘密を暴き、変化をもたらさんことを！
Overture to Despair#302.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#303.src: Uhm- it's "May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change..." People never get it right-
Overture to Despair#303.dst: えっと― 「久しく埋もれし真実を掘り起こし、変革をもたらさん…」よ。みんな間違えるんだから―
Overture to Despair#303.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#304.src: She's going to do something! I, I know she's going to- I have to- Guys, can't you see th-
Overture to Despair#304.dst: あの子、何かする気だ！わ、私には分かる― 私も― みんな、分からないの―
Overture to Despair#304.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#305.src: You don't know that! And if you try and convince her to, we won't be having you here anymore! Enough about this, do you have any kind of plan?
Overture to Despair#305.dst: そんなの分からないでしょ！それに彼女を焚きつけたら、もうここには置いておけない！その話はもういい、何か計画でもあるの？
Overture to Despair#305.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#306.src: Every time I try and think of one, I get shut down! I know I don't have much, but...but, if we work toge-
Overture to Despair#306.dst: 考えようとするたびに潰される！私に大した力はないけど… でも、みんなで協力―
Overture to Despair#306.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#307.src: Enough of that already, Bleeding Rose! We can't reveal the secrets of the monarchy if we're imprisoned! And don't even try to say "what secrets?" This is big news!!
Overture to Despair#307.dst: もういいでしょ、血濡れの薔薇！投獄されたら王家の秘密を暴けないじゃない！それと「何の秘密？」なんて言わないで。これは大ニュースなんだから！！
Overture to Despair#307.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#308.src: Speak with Sui outside the Newspaper Shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#308.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の新聞屋の外で Sui と話す。

Overture to Despair#310.src: I... wanted to stay for the whole meeting. But after that, I... I couldn't.
Overture to Despair#310.dst: 私… 最後までいたかった。でもあの後は… いられなかった。
Overture to Despair#310.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#311.src: We know where they are. We know where to find them!
Overture to Despair#311.dst: 二人の居場所が分かった。どこに行けば会えるか分かった！
Overture to Despair#311.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#312.src: I didn't realize all their names would be so... weird and edgy. I had to come up with something! Just be glad it wasn't something worse, okay?
Overture to Despair#312.dst: みんなの名前があんなに… 変で尖ってるとは思わなかった。何か考えなきゃいけなかったの！もっとひどくなかっただけましでしょ？
Overture to Despair#312.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#313.src: Look. I had to think on the spot, okay! I just needed a way out.
Overture to Despair#313.dst: だから。とっさに考えなきゃいけなかったの！逃げ出す口実が欲しかっただけ。
Overture to Despair#313.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#314.src: ...was that really it? That's the resistance group around here...?
Overture to Despair#314.dst: …あれで本当に全部？この辺のレジスタンスって、あれ…？
Overture to Despair#314.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#315.src: All they're doing is... is... is sitting around, gossiping about trivial problems! Like... like it's the end of the world!
Overture to Despair#315.dst: やってることは… ただ… ただ座って、くだらない問題のうわさ話！まるで… 世界の終わりみたいに！
Overture to Despair#315.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#316.src: An increase in bread prices...? No freebies from the festival...? Who cares?! People are... p-people are dying!!
Overture to Despair#316.dst: パンの値上がり…？祭りの配り物なし…？どうでもいい！人が… ひ、人が死んでるのに！！
Overture to Despair#316.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#317.src: And... and the one person who was trying to do something kept... k-kept getting shut down... ugh! Why did I think something could f-finally go right...
Overture to Despair#317.dst: それに… 何かしようとしてた唯一の人は… ず、ずっと潰されてた… もう！なんで、や、やっと何かうまくいくなんて思ったんだろ…
Overture to Despair#317.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#318.src: Whatever. At least their gossip got us some useful leads... we- we know for sure where Rex and Zeph are!
Overture to Despair#318.dst: まあいい。少なくともうわさ話で役に立つ手がかりが… Rex と Zeph の居場所は、ま、間違いなく分かった！
Overture to Despair#318.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#319.src: So... let's head to the castle, and- and take back our friends.
Overture to Despair#319.dst: だから… 城へ行って、と、友達を取り戻そう。
Overture to Despair#319.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#320.src: Violent Heather mentioned, um, a dungeon. That's probably where they're being kept... I- I can get them.
Overture to Despair#320.dst: 猛きヒースが、えっと、地下牢のことを言ってた。二人はたぶんそこ… わ、私が助け出せる。
Overture to Despair#320.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#321.src: But... if we just go in, then... there'll probably be too many guards to take out. We need a distraction.
Overture to Despair#321.dst: でも… そのまま入ったら… 見張りが多すぎて片付けきれない。陽動が必要。
Overture to Despair#321.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#322.src: Could you... draw their attention at the front gates? I, um, I know you're strong enough for it, so... could you do that?
Overture to Despair#322.dst: あなたが… 正門で注意を引いてくれる？私、えっと、あなたは十分強いって知ってる。だから… お願いできる？
Overture to Despair#322.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#323.src: A-alright. Good. Good, good, good. Come on, let's save our friends!
Overture to Despair#323.dst: よ、よし。いいね。いい、いい、いい。行こう、友達を救うよ！
Overture to Despair#323.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#324.src: Well... well, too bad. I need you to do it anyway. Come on.
Overture to Despair#324.dst: そう… 残念だけど。それでもやってもらうから。行くよ。
Overture to Despair#324.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#325.src: Head the Majin's castle to the east at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#325.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の東にある Majin の城へ向かう。

Overture to Despair#326.src: Come on, let's save our friends!
Overture to Despair#326.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#328.src: Oh, what I'd give to just... just... stick him full of spikes... ugh, but I can't.
Overture to Despair#328.dst: ああ、あいつを… あいつを… トゲだらけにできたら… もう、でもできない。
Overture to Despair#328.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#329.src: I'll... search for them in the dungeons while you, um, cause a distraction.
Overture to Despair#329.dst: 私は… 地下牢で二人を探す。あなたは、えっと、陽動をお願い。
Overture to Despair#329.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#330.src: However you... um, do that. Storm the castle, or... or whatever. Just... stay safe.
Overture to Despair#330.dst: やり方は… えっと、任せる。城に攻め込むとか… なんでもいい。とにかく… 気をつけて。
Overture to Despair#330.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#331.src: We'll meet back at the Crown Jewel once we're done. If... if either of us don't make it, then...
Overture to Despair#331.dst: 終わったら王冠の宝石で落ち合おう。もし… どっちかが戻らなかったら…
Overture to Despair#331.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#334.src: Okay... okay. L-let's get them back!
Overture to Despair#334.dst: よし… よし。と、取り戻そう！
Overture to Despair#334.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#335.src: Okay. Y-yeah. Just... um, hurry back here once you are.
Overture to Despair#335.dst: わかった。う、うん。とにかく… えっと、できたら急いで戻ってきて。
Overture to Despair#335.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#336.src: Head the Majin's castle to the east at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#336.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の東にある Majin の城へ向かう。

Overture to Despair#337.src: Oh my, but if it isn't the province's most wanted criminal, striding forth into my House entirely of your own volition! Her predictions are as accurate as ever, it would seem.
Overture to Despair#337.dst: おやおや、地方一のお尋ね者ではないか、自らの意思で我が屋敷に堂々と踏み込んでくるとは！彼女の予測は相変わらず正確なようだ。
Overture to Despair#337.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#338.src: Quite a foolish thing to do, if you ask me... though I do suppose you have proven yourself something of a wild card these past weeks!
Overture to Despair#338.dst: 実に愚かな真似だと私は思うがね… もっとも、ここ数週間で君が予測不能な札だと証明したのは確かだ！
Overture to Despair#338.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#339.src: But of course! We do hold the leverage here... you must have come in search of your dear imprisoned friends, haven't you?
Overture to Despair#339.dst: 当然だとも！こちらには切り札がある… 君は囚われた大切な友を探しに来たのだろう？
Overture to Despair#339.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#340.src: What a simple lure... but effective, evidently! It has drawn you in, right where we want you.
Overture to Despair#340.dst: なんと単純な餌… だが明らかに効果的だ！狙った場所へ、まんまと君を誘い込んだ。
Overture to Despair#340.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#341.src: Oh, really! My my, I would have never guessed - to think, holding them captive might draw you in! What an astonishing revelation.
Overture to Despair#341.dst: ほう、本当かね！いやはや、思いもしなかった― 二人を捕らえておけば君が来るかもしれないとは！なんと驚くべき発見か。
Overture to Despair#341.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#342.src: They are here, certainly. But you will not be seeing them. There are greater plans in motion, it would seem!
Overture to Despair#342.dst: 確かにここにいる。だが会わせはしない。どうやら、もっと大きな計画が動いているのでね！
Overture to Despair#342.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#343.src: Fight you?! and ruin my decor? Ha! Ahahahaha! Goodness, no, of course not. If I were, you would already be dead.
Overture to Despair#343.dst: 君と戦う？！内装を台無しにして？はっ！あはははは！まさか、とんでもない。その気なら君はとうに死んでいる。
Overture to Despair#343.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#344.src: Perhaps at some later date I might be more amenable to wiping the floor with you! But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
Overture to Despair#344.dst: いずれ、君を叩きのめす気になる日も来るかもしれんがね！あいにく我々には用事があるのだよ。
Overture to Despair#344.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#345.src: Oh, take that dour look off your face. Perhaps if all goes well, we might be willing to discuss returning those friends of yours! I certainly have no need to keep them.
Overture to Despair#345.dst: おや、その陰気な顔はやめたまえ。万事うまくいけば、君の友人を返す相談に応じてもいい！手元に置いておく必要など、まったくないのでね。
Overture to Despair#345.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#346.src: I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waster my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
Overture to Despair#346.dst: だって本当に、あの二人に何の使い道があった？すでに知っている情報を絞り出すのに労力を費やせと？
Overture to Despair#346.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#347.src: It was pathetic, honestly. The two of them, sitting in front of me, sniveling like little babies...
Overture to Despair#347.dst: 正直、哀れだったよ。二人して私の前に座り、赤ん坊のようにめそめそと…
Overture to Despair#347.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#348.src: "Spare me, great Sovereign! Spare me, great Sovereign!"
Overture to Despair#348.dst: 「お許しを、偉大なる君主様！お許しを、偉大なる君主様！」
Overture to Despair#348.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#349.src: As if that would save them! Ha! Hahahahahaha!
Overture to Despair#349.dst: それで助かるとでも！はっ！はははははは！
Overture to Despair#349.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#350.src: Oh, but what does it matter? They are not important, but you... it would seem Her Majesty has taken interest in you, heavens know why.
Overture to Despair#350.dst: おや、だがそれが何だというのだ？あの二人は重要ではない。だが君は… 陛下が君に興味をお持ちのようだ、なぜかは知らんが。
Overture to Despair#350.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#351.src: But before that, seeing as you are a guest of honour here in House Thalas... allow me to lead you on a tour of the castle!
Overture to Despair#351.dst: だがその前に、君は Thalas 家の賓客なのだから… 城を案内させてもらおう！
Overture to Despair#351.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#352.src: You should feel honoured. Receiving such a personalized tour is quite an uncommon occurrence around here! Do feel free to write about it in your memoirs... if you ever get the chance.
Overture to Despair#352.dst: 光栄に思いたまえ。ここで直々の案内を受けるなど、そうあることではない！回顧録にでも書くといい… 書く機会があればだがね。
Overture to Despair#352.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#353.src: Oh no, dear guest, I'm afraid you are not. You do not have a choice in the matter, in fact!
Overture to Despair#353.dst: いやいや、客人よ、残念ながら違う。実のところ、君に選択肢はないのだよ！
Overture to Despair#353.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#354.src: Oh, but I rather do insist! You've come this far, haven't you? And you're a guest of the House- it would be quite rude for you to decline.
Overture to Despair#354.dst: おや、だが是非にと言っているのだ！ここまで来たのだろう？しかも屋敷の客だ― 断るのはずいぶん無礼というものだ。
Overture to Despair#354.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#355.src: So come along, now. There's much to see, much to do! And we wouldn't want to keep her waiting, would we?
Overture to Despair#355.dst: さあ、ついて来たまえ。見るものも、やることも山ほどある！彼女を待たせたくはないだろう？
Overture to Despair#355.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#356.src: Oh, did I forget to mention? There's someone who would like to meet you! Our Spymaster has finally returned from abroad, and she has much to say to you.
Overture to Despair#356.dst: おや、言い忘れていたかな？君に会いたがっている方がいる！我らが密偵長がようやく国外から戻られてね、君に話が山ほどあるそうだ。
Overture to Despair#356.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#357.src: Follow Majin on the tour of his castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#357.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Majin について城を見学する。

Overture to Despair#358.src: Now. To begin with, to your left you'll see my personal library!
Overture to Despair#358.dst: では。まず左手に見えますは、私の個人図書室！
Overture to Despair#358.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#359.src: I've amassed quite a large collection, you see. Numerous books written by famous writers from all over the province! Some of my personal work is also featured here.
Overture to Despair#359.dst: ご覧の通り、かなりの蔵書を集めてね。地方中の著名な作家の本が数えきれないほど！私自身の著作もいくつか並んでいる。
Overture to Despair#359.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#360.src: And straight ahead, we'll reach my secret, not-so-secret, tower of magical tomes and scrolls.
Overture to Despair#360.dst: そして正面に見えるのが、秘密の― さほど秘密でもない― 魔導書と巻物の塔だ。
Overture to Despair#360.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#361.src: Over the years, I've acquired much... hm, shall we say, "forbidden" literature of that variety. The Cursed simply will not stop trying, no matter how foolish the act!
Overture to Despair#361.dst: 長年にわたり、その手の… ふむ、いわば「禁書」をたくさん手に入れてね。呪われし者どもは、どれほど愚かでも試すのをやめないのだよ！
Overture to Despair#361.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#362.src: I'd say I have mastered... ah, about half of the spells and rituals featured here? It depends on your definitions- goodness knows the psionics have it rough.
Overture to Despair#362.dst: ここにある呪文や儀式の… ああ、半分ほどは極めたかな？定義次第だがね― 超能力のほうは本当に厄介なのだよ。
Overture to Despair#362.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#363.src: Oh, good grief, don't play dumb. I know full well that you understand the term. You all out there in Wynn make great use of it, or so I've been told.
Overture to Despair#363.dst: おやおや、とぼけるのはよしたまえ。君がその言葉を分かっているのは知っている。Wynn の君たちは大いに活用していると聞くぞ。
Overture to Despair#363.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#364.src: It truly is a wonder you manage to get anything done out there! Where is the control, the coordination?! No, I much prefer how we handle things here in Fruma, thank you.
Overture to Despair#364.dst: 向こうで物事が片付くのが本当に不思議だ！統制は？連携は？！いや、私はここ Fruma のやり方のほうがずっと好きだね。
Overture to Despair#364.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#365.src: Yes, the Psionics... old history, that is. Sometime during the RA years, I believe? They had been mistaken for the cursed, and were exterminated by the crown for it.
Overture to Despair#365.dst: そう、超能力者… 昔の話だ。RA の時代だったかな？呪われし者と間違われ、王家に根絶やしにされたのだよ。
Overture to Despair#365.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#366.src: A mistake, if you ask me! Psionic abilities certainly should not be considered the same as magic, they're quite different in how they manifest... but alas, it is what it is.
Overture to Despair#366.dst: 私に言わせれば間違いだ！超能力は魔法と同一視すべきではない、現れ方がまるで違うのでね… だが、まあ、仕方あるまい。
Overture to Despair#366.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#367.src: Cursed?! Ha! Oh, no no no, I was not "cursed". I believe you and I both understand the meaninglessness of that terminology, hm?
Overture to Despair#367.dst: 呪われた？！はっ！いやいやいや、私は「呪われて」などいない。その言葉が無意味なのは、君も私も分かっているだろう？
Overture to Despair#367.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#368.src: Curses, blessings... a means of controlling the public. A rather useful one, at that - though I never did follow the rules.
Overture to Despair#368.dst: 呪いに祝福… 民衆を支配する手段だ。実に便利な手段だよ― もっとも、私は規則に従ったためしがないがね。
Overture to Despair#368.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#369.src: In the end, magic is but another way to obtain power over the weak... is it not natural to seek it out oneself, in order to achieve greatness?
Overture to Despair#369.dst: 結局、魔法は弱者を支配する力を得る手段の一つにすぎん… 偉大さを得るため自ら求めるのは、自然なことではないかね？
Overture to Despair#369.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#370.src: I don't suppose you would understand. You don't seem the type to have ever reached such heights. Regardless, let us press onward!
Overture to Despair#370.dst: 君には分からんだろうな。そんな高みに達したことのある人間には見えん。ともかく、先へ進もう！
Overture to Despair#370.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#371.src: Hm... I shall leave you to peruse my collections for the time being. The tour shall continue at the top of these stairs! Don't take too long, would you?
Overture to Despair#371.dst: ふむ… しばらく私のコレクションを自由に見てくれたまえ。案内はこの階段の上で再開する！あまり待たせないでくれよ？
Overture to Despair#371.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#372.src: Ah... this before you is my planetarium. Quite the marvel, don't you think? On my journey in developing my magical prowess, I developed quite the interest in the cosmos.
Overture to Despair#372.dst: ああ… 目の前にあるのが私のプラネタリウムだ。見事だろう？魔法の腕を磨く旅の中で、私は宇宙に強い興味を抱いてね。
Overture to Despair#372.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#373.src: It was this very room in which I discovered the comet which would be named after me! Majin's Comet... this year will be the third time I see its purple shine fly through the night sky.
Overture to Despair#373.dst: まさにこの部屋で、後に私の名を冠する彗星を発見したのだ！Majin 彗星… 今年で三度目、その紫の輝きが夜空を駆けるのを見ることになる。
Overture to Despair#373.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#374.src: In truth, it fascinates me... the power and mystery lying dormant behind each and every star, just waiting to be tapped into!
Overture to Despair#374.dst: 実のところ、心惹かれるのだよ… 星の一つ一つの裏に眠る力と神秘が、汲み出されるのを待っているのだから！
Overture to Despair#374.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#375.src: Well, I suppose it wasn't much of a surprise when that was the shape Her Majesty's blessing took on, once I received it on ascension.
Overture to Despair#375.dst: まあ、君主に昇った際に陛下の祝福を賜り、それがあの形になったのも、さほど驚きではなかったがね。
Overture to Despair#375.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#376.src: As I said before, it's quite uncommon for me to personally give a tour of the castle. I take the opportunity to speak on my many accomplishments whenever I can!
Overture to Despair#376.dst: 先ほども言ったが、私が直々に城を案内するのは珍しい。機会があれば、いつでも数々の功績を語ることにしているのだよ！
Overture to Despair#376.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#377.src: Oh, and you mean to tell me that if you had a voice like mine, you wouldn't do the very same? Ha! Perhaps someday, you'll understand.
Overture to Despair#377.dst: おや、私のような声を持っていたら、君は同じことをしないとでも？はっ！いつか分かる日が来るかもしれんね。
Overture to Despair#377.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#378.src: Ah, the Sovereigns' blessings... they truly are an assorted bunch. Each taking on a distinct shape based on the person receiving it.
Overture to Despair#378.dst: ああ、君主たちの祝福… 実に様々だ。受ける者によって、それぞれ異なる形をとる。
Overture to Despair#378.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#379.src: I wonder, what could yours have looked like? Anything would be more interesting than that of your friend's... oh yes, "Intention." How passive, how boring.
Overture to Despair#379.dst: 君のはどんな形になったろうね？君の友人のよりは何でも面白いだろう… ああそう、「意志」だったか。なんと受け身で退屈な。
Overture to Despair#379.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#380.src: But I suppose it's just as well, given his... shall we say, transience. Quite the mission he's signed himself up for! What a relief that I have no need to concern myself with it.
Overture to Despair#380.dst: まあ、それもちょうどいいか。彼の… いわば、儚さを思えばね。大層な任務を自ら引き受けたものだ！私が気にかける必要がなくて何よりだよ。
Overture to Despair#380.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#381.src: ...oh, yes, this here is my hobby tower! I had it constructed - what was it, {~} years ago? - in order to store all my various projects. I'm a man of many interests, you see.
Overture to Despair#381.dst: …おお、そうだ、ここは私の趣味の塔！建てたのは― いつだったか、{~} 年前？― 様々な計画をしまうためにね。私は多趣味な男なのだよ。
Overture to Despair#381.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#382.src: As of late, I've been experimenting with gardening, of all things. Incredibly boring, mind you - a word of advice? Don't bother. It is not worth your time.
Overture to Despair#382.dst: 最近は、よりにもよって園芸を試していてね。ひどく退屈だよ― 忠告を一つ？やめておきたまえ。時間の無駄だ。
Overture to Despair#382.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#383.src: Ah... a better view than this is hard to come by. The {p}, in all their glory! Who needs the {p} when you have this!
Overture to Despair#383.dst: ああ… これ以上の眺めはそうない。{p}、その栄光のすべて！これがあれば {p} など要らん！
Overture to Despair#383.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#384.dst: さて、着いたぞ。ご機嫌よう、密偵長。
Overture to Despair#384.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#385.src: Sovereign Majin. And {u}. I've been expecting you.
Overture to Despair#385.dst: 君主 Majin。そして {u}。待っていた。

Overture to Despair#386.src: Talk to Sovereign Majin and the Spymaster at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#386.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で君主 Majin と密偵長と話す。

Overture to Despair#387.src: It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it? And you've been busy.
Overture to Despair#387.dst: 直接顔を合わせるのは久しぶりだ。ずいぶん忙しくしていたようだね。

Overture to Despair#388.src: So in the end you made the choice to search for your answers... bold, I'll admit. You've caused quite the disruption thus far.
Overture to Despair#388.dst: 結局、自ら答えを探す道を選んだか… 大胆だと認めよう。ここまでずいぶんと波風を立ててくれた。

Overture to Despair#389.src: I am the Second, the Spymaster. You may call me Two.
Overture to Despair#389.dst: 私は第二、密偵長。Two と呼べばいい。

Overture to Despair#390.src: You've quite the set of accomplishments, it turns out. Careless work by our inquisitors, perhaps, that we did not know beforehand... with some exceptions, granted.
Overture to Despair#390.dst: 調べてみれば、なかなかの功績だ。事前に知らなかったのは審問官の手抜かりか… いくつか例外はあるが。
Overture to Despair#390.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#391.src: To think, the Shade was struck blind by your hand! At no small cost, of course... but a shattered soul means little in the wider stage.
Overture to Despair#391.dst: まさか、あなたの手で影が盲目にされるとは！無論、代償は小さくなかった… だが砕けた魂など、大きな舞台では些事だ。
Overture to Despair#391.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#392.src: Had we known, would you have been given greater consideration? Perhaps. Or perhaps not. Each flaw remains as damning as before.
Overture to Despair#392.dst: 知っていれば、もっと考慮されたか？かもしれない。そうでないかもしれない。欠点はどれも、依然として致命的だ。
Overture to Despair#392.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#393.src: Oh, get to the point, would you? I have more important things to attend to then this frivolous attempt at information gathering.
Overture to Despair#393.dst: おい、要点を言ってくれんかね？こんな軽薄な情報収集ごっこより大事な用があるのだよ。
Overture to Despair#393.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#394.dst: よかろう。手短に話そう。
Overture to Despair#394.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#395.src: Of all your accomplishments, of all your history, of each point along your storied trail, there is but one we cannot see. A place we cannot go.
Overture to Despair#395.dst: あなたの功績、経歴、その輝かしい足跡のすべての中で、見えないものが一つだけある。行けない場所が。
Overture to Despair#395.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#396.src: You and the Light's Scion entered the Realm of Light. At a time pinpointed to have transpired during your stay within, the spread of Gavel's Decay abruptly ceased.
Overture to Despair#396.dst: あなたと光の末裔は光の領域に入った。あなたが中にいたと特定される時期に、Gavel の腐朽の拡大が突然止まった。
Overture to Despair#396.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#397.src: You would later return to your numerous adventures, not a sign of ever having traversed the realms at all. She has not been seen since.
Overture to Despair#397.dst: その後あなたは冒険の日々に戻った、領域を渡った痕跡すら見せずに。彼女はそれ以来、姿を見せていない。
Overture to Despair#397.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#398.src: I do not expect you to share this information freely. That is why we are here. To make an... exchange, of sorts.
Overture to Despair#398.dst: この情報を素直に話すとは思っていない。だから我々はここにいる。いわば… 取引をするために。
Overture to Despair#398.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#399.src: I should rather like to know the same thing myself! The way I see it, it hardly impacts the wider scope of your schemes.
Overture to Despair#399.dst: 私もぜひ同じことを知りたいものだ！私が見るに、君の企みの大局にはほとんど影響せんがね。
Overture to Despair#399.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#400.src: I do like to be meticulous. Each additional defined variable helps with the accuracy of my predictions.
Overture to Despair#400.dst: 私は綿密でありたいのでね。定義された変数が一つ増えるたび、予測の精度が上がる。
Overture to Despair#400.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#401.src: Regardless - the request comes directly from Her Majesty. It appears she is just as interested in the answer as I am.
Overture to Despair#401.dst: ともかく― この要請は陛下直々のものだ。陛下も私と同じく答えに関心がおありらしい。
Overture to Despair#401.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#402.src: My goodness, what a question! How does the Spymaster know these things? What a conundrum - perhaps the title should clue you in?
Overture to Despair#402.dst: おやおや、なんという質問だ！密偵長がなぜそんなことを知っているか？難問だねえ― 肩書きがヒントになるのでは？
Overture to Despair#402.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#403.src: There is little I do not keep track of in this world. Mostly, my inquisitors work to collect information beyond our gates...
Overture to Despair#403.dst: この世界で私が把握していないことは少ない。たいていは、審問官たちが我らの門の外で情報を集めている…
Overture to Despair#403.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#404.src: Though, in special circumstances, I have been known to do so myself. Such as the one we find ourselves in now.
Overture to Despair#404.dst: もっとも特別な場合には、私自ら動くこともある。今まさにこの状況のように。
Overture to Despair#404.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#405.src: Entry to their Claims is not such an easy task if uninvited. You've seen the portal that lies at the end of the Expanse, haven't you? Still active, yet... sealed shut.
Overture to Despair#405.dst: 招かれていなければ、彼らの領分に入るのは容易ではない。Expanse の果てにある門を見ただろう？まだ動いているが… 固く封じられている。
Overture to Despair#405.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#406.src: It seems the Shade did not take well to losing its Sight. An act of caution, blocking your access to its domain. The Light is much the same.
Overture to Despair#406.dst: 影は「視覚」を失ったのがよほど堪えたらしい。あなたの立ち入りを封じたのは用心だ。光もほぼ同じ。
Overture to Despair#406.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#407.src: Awestruck, are we? I do suppose such is the natural consequence of being in the vicinity of the crown's two strongest Sovereigns!
Overture to Despair#407.dst: おや、畏れ入ったかね？王家最強の君主二人のそばにいれば、当然そうなるだろうとも！
Overture to Despair#407.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#408.src: But I'm afraid we do need you to speak up, so do get over yourself, would you?
Overture to Despair#408.dst: だが残念ながら話してもらわねば困る。しっかりしたまえ。
Overture to Despair#408.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#409.src: And so, we return to the exchange. If you tell us what we wish to know, I will offer some valuable information in return. I trust it will be of interest to you.
Overture to Despair#409.dst: では、取引に戻ろう。知りたいことを話してくれれば、見返りに価値ある情報を渡す。きっと興味を持つはずだ。
Overture to Despair#409.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#410.src: Well, do we have a deal?
Overture to Despair#410.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#411.src: You always have a choice. But sometimes, there is a right and a wrong choice to make. The decision is yours.
Overture to Despair#411.dst: 選択肢は常にある。だが時に、正しい選択と誤った選択がある。決めるのはあなただ。
Overture to Despair#411.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#412.src: So tell me. What happened in the Realm of Light? What could we not see?
Overture to Despair#412.dst: では聞かせてもらおう。光の領域で何があった？我々に見えなかったものは？
Overture to Despair#412.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#414.src: How very interesting. To think, the Shade has enough trust in War's lost Scion to send him to defend its trump card...
Overture to Despair#414.dst: 実に興味深い。影が、戦の失われし末裔にそこまで信を置き、切り札の守りに送り込むとは…
Overture to Despair#414.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#415.src: I had wondered when he might finally show his ugly face again. Heavens know we'd had enough of him already.
Overture to Despair#415.dst: あいつがいつまた醜い顔を見せるかと思っていたよ。もう十分うんざりしていたというのに。
Overture to Despair#415.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#416.src: And the Dawn is freed from the Dusk's assault... but its Scion is lost to the Dark's Claim... a step forward, and a step back alike.
Overture to Despair#416.dst: そして暁は黄昏の猛攻から解き放たれた… だがその末裔は闇の領分に囚われた… 一歩前進、一歩後退だ。
Overture to Despair#416.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#417.src: A step back, perhaps, but it could also be a boon in disguise. She could serve as a potential ally for your... whatever, if you could only locate her.
Overture to Despair#417.dst: 後退かもしれんが、思わぬ幸運かもしれんぞ。彼女は君の… 何であれ、味方になりうる。見つけられればの話だがね。
Overture to Despair#417.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#418.src: Certainly, she could. This will shift the trajectory of certain shards of possibility... I'll have to dive deeper into the consequences.
Overture to Despair#418.dst: 確かに、そうなりうる。これで可能性の欠片のいくつかの軌道が変わる… 結果をもっと深く探らねば。
Overture to Despair#418.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#419.src: Regardless, this has been enlightening. Her Majesty will certainly be interested in these developments.
Overture to Despair#419.dst: ともかく、有益だった。陛下もこの展開にはきっと関心を持たれるだろう。
Overture to Despair#419.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#420.src: You refer to the War of the Realms, I presume?
Overture to Despair#420.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#421.src: I suppose it must. Beyond the wider scope, why do we care? Wynn's corruption is at a safe distance, and both Light and Dark are far, far away.
Overture to Despair#421.dst: そうだろうね。大局は別として、なぜ気にする？Wynn の腐敗は安全な距離にあり、光も闇も遥か彼方だ。
Overture to Despair#421.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#422.src: I can answer your question. But first, a tale.
Overture to Despair#422.dst: その問いには答えよう。だがまず、一つの物語を。
Overture to Despair#422.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#423.src: Once, there were two twins orbiting one another, each laying claim to their own piece of the void they were given.
Overture to Despair#423.dst: かつて、互いの周りを巡る双子がいた。それぞれが与えられた虚無の一片を己の領分とした。
Overture to Despair#423.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#424.src: The first was bright, radiant, overwhelming. The other was dark, shadowed, suffocating. Gazing through the abyss, they saw one another - each a mirror image of the other.
Overture to Despair#424.dst: 一方は明るく、眩く、圧倒的。もう一方は暗く、翳り、息苦しい。深淵越しに見つめ合い、互いを見た― それぞれがもう一方の鏡像だった。
Overture to Despair#424.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#425.src: The twins grew to hate each other. They built forms all their own, denying the truth of their reflections. They tried, and tried, and tried to break their bonds...
Overture to Despair#425.dst: 双子は互いを憎むようになった。それぞれ独自の姿を築き、映し合う真実を否定した。何度も、何度も、絆を断とうとした…
Overture to Despair#425.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#426.src: ...but in the end, they could do naught but orbit - holding influence in their own right, but possessing nothing to exert it on.
Overture to Despair#426.dst: …だが結局は巡り続けるしかなかった― それぞれ力を持ちながら、それを振るう対象を何も持たずに。
Overture to Despair#426.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#427.src: Until... they found it. A miraculous world, of magic and life, and all of a sudden, nothing became something.
Overture to Despair#427.dst: やがて… 見つけた。魔法と生命に満ちた奇跡の世界を。そして突如、無は有となった。
Overture to Despair#427.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#429.src: And in so doing, they came to shatter the mirror which once held their reflections. A building pressure of light and dark and hate, until finally enough was enough...
Overture to Despair#429.dst: そうするうちに、かつて互いを映していた鏡を砕いた。光と闇と憎しみの圧が高まり、ついに限界を迎えるまで…
Overture to Despair#429.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#430.src: And from those uncountable shattered pieces of their battleground, War came to be.
Overture to Despair#430.dst: そして戦場の無数の欠片から、「戦」が生まれた。
Overture to Despair#430.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#431.src: War, Chaos, Hate... call it what you will. It was lesser, holding less control over itself than the twins from which it was birthed.
Overture to Despair#431.dst: 戦、混沌、憎悪… 呼び名は何でもいい。それは劣った存在で、生みの親の双子ほど自らを制御できなかった。
Overture to Despair#431.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#432.src: All it knew was the hatred of the twins, directed towards one another, never acknowledging the battlefield they had made. All it knew was the pain of being.
Overture to Despair#432.dst: 知っていたのは、双子が互いに向ける憎しみだけ。自らが作った戦場を顧みることはない。知っていたのは、存在する苦しみだけ。
Overture to Despair#432.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#433.src: Until, one day... it all stopped. The twins had lost their connection to their world of influence, and could no longer sustain their endless War.
Overture to Despair#433.dst: ある日… すべてが止まるまでは。双子は影響を及ぼす世界とのつながりを失い、終わりなき戦を続けられなくなった。
Overture to Despair#433.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#434.src: It was in that silence that War could finally sense beyond itself, could feel the world the twins had taken for granted, the beauty they had discarded in their race for victory.
Overture to Despair#434.dst: その静寂の中で、戦はようやく己の外を感じ取れた。双子が当然と思っていた世界を、勝利を競う中で捨てた美しさを。
Overture to Despair#434.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#435.src: And so, when the connections emerged once more, it took its chance.
Overture to Despair#435.dst: だから、つながりが再び現れたとき、それは好機を掴んだ。
Overture to Despair#435.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#436.src: It broke through the endless void, forcing its own connection unto the world, following in the twins' example.
Overture to Despair#436.dst: 果てなき虚無を突き破り、双子にならって、その世界へ自らのつながりを押し付けた。
Overture to Despair#436.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#437.src: Finally, it saw the world beyond... sprawling plains, forests, seas. Saw towns, cities, farmlands- war, destruction, tainted by the human desperation to live.
Overture to Despair#437.dst: ついに、外の世界を見た… 広がる平原、森、海。町、都市、農地― 戦争、破壊、生きようとする人の必死さに汚されたものを。
Overture to Despair#437.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#438.src: And it began to dream of that desperation itself.
Overture to Despair#438.dst: そして、その必死さそのものを夢見るようになった。
Overture to Despair#438.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#440.src: Her Majesty is War - was War. But it is no longer hers - instead, she has chosen to lay claim to this world's protection.
Overture to Despair#440.dst: 女王陛下は戦だ― 戦だった。だが今はもう違う― この世界を守ることを己の領分に選ばれた。
Overture to Despair#440.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#441.src: And in the meanwhile, the twins continue to take and take and take. If left unchecked, they will take until there is nothing left to fight over.
Overture to Despair#441.dst: その間も双子は奪い、奪い、奪い続ける。放っておけば、争うものが何も残らなくなるまで奪うだろう。
Overture to Despair#441.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#442.src: ... Will that do for your answer?
Overture to Despair#442.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#443.src: You've a streak for the dramatic, don't you... Was that truly all necessary? We could have always laid it out simply- on that note, why even answer at all?
Overture to Despair#443.dst: 君は芝居がかったのが好きだねえ… 本当にあれが全部必要だったのかね？簡単に説明できたろうに― そもそもなぜ答える？
Overture to Despair#443.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#444.src: I believe the context to be important.
Overture to Despair#444.dst: 文脈が重要だと考えている。
Overture to Despair#444.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#445.src: Of course you would... well then, are we finished here?
Overture to Despair#445.dst: 君ならそう言うだろうな… では、これで終わりかね？
Overture to Despair#445.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#446.src: I suppose we are. We may consider this interrogation adjourned.
Overture to Despair#446.dst: そのようだ。この尋問は閉会としよう。
Overture to Despair#446.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#447.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast. Certainly, neither of us will deign to stop your escape... but the troops lying in wait will have no such reservations.
Overture to Despair#447.dst: おっと、待ちたまえ！急くでない。確かに、我々はわざわざ君の逃亡を止めはせん… だが待ち伏せている兵たちは遠慮などせんぞ。
Overture to Despair#447.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#448.src: Now, see yourself out, would you? You are dismissed.
Overture to Despair#448.dst: さあ、自分で出ていってくれたまえ。下がってよろしい。
Overture to Despair#448.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#450.src: ...oh, would you take your leave already? You're ruining the view.
Overture to Despair#450.dst: …おい、さっさと出ていってくれんかね？眺めが台無しだ。
Overture to Despair#450.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#451.src: I believe we'll meet once again very soon.
Overture to Despair#451.dst: すぐにまた会うことになるだろう。
Overture to Despair#451.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#452.src: Regroup at the Crown Jewel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#452.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の王冠の宝石で合流する。

Overture to Despair#454.dst: ぶ、無事… だったんだ。よ、よかった…
Overture to Despair#454.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#456.src: We're alive, so... better than nothing, huh?
Overture to Despair#456.dst: 生きてるし… ないよりまし、でしょ？
Overture to Despair#456.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#458.dst: まだ生きてる。いろいろあったけど。
Overture to Despair#458.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#460.src: ...yeah. Gods, I... I can't believe they're gone.
Overture to Despair#460.dst: …うん。まったく… あの二人がいないなんて信じられない。
Overture to Despair#460.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#461.src: S...Syndra, a- and Mora... and we, we c...couldn't do an- any- anything!
Overture to Despair#461.dst: S… Syndra、そ、それに Mora… なのに僕たち、な、何も、何もできなかった！
Overture to Despair#461.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#462.src: Ugh, how stupid could we have been...? Of course they knew what we were planning. A group that big...
Overture to Despair#462.dst: はあ、なんてバカだったんだろ…？計画がバレてて当然だよ。あんな大人数じゃ…
Overture to Despair#462.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#463.src: What was Syndra thinking? We should've called it off the minute we knew there would be another Sovereign...
Overture to Despair#463.dst: Syndra は何を考えてたの？君主がもう一人来るって分かった時点で中止すべきだったのに…
Overture to Despair#463.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#464.src: What was so important to her that she'd risk all of our lives like that...?
Overture to Despair#464.dst: あたしたち全員の命を賭けてまで、何がそんなに大事だったんだろ…？
Overture to Despair#464.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#465.src: I don't... care. It- it doesn't matter now. She's... dead. We don't need to talk about this.
Overture to Despair#465.dst: 私は… どうでもいい。い、今さら関係ない。彼女は… 死んだ。この話はしなくていい。
Overture to Despair#465.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#466.src: ...S...Sui, h...how are you ho- holding up? It c- couldn't have b...been easy, on y- your own-
Overture to Despair#466.dst: …S、Sui、だ、大丈夫…？ひ、一人でた、大変だったよね―
Overture to Despair#466.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#467.src: I'm fine, Zeph. We've got you two back now, so... so everything's alright. It is.
Overture to Despair#467.dst: 平気だよ、Zeph。二人が戻ってきたんだから… だから全部大丈夫。本当に。
Overture to Despair#467.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#468.src: Are you sure? I don't think I've ever seen you this wound up before.
Overture to Despair#468.dst: 本当に？そんなに張り詰めてるの、初めて見た気がする。
Overture to Despair#468.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#469.src: Stop. Stop that. I'm fine, I am, everyone's safe who- who can be, so... so that's it. We can, um, start planning ahead!!!
Overture to Despair#469.dst: やめて。やめてよ。平気、本当に。助かる人は… み、みんな助かった。だから… それでいいの。えっと、次の計画を立てよう！！！
Overture to Despair#469.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#471.src: ...please stop looking at me like that.
Overture to Despair#471.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#472.src: ...fine. When Zeph and I were caught at the festival, we were split up from the others.
Overture to Despair#472.dst: …わかった。祭りで Zeph とあたしが捕まった時、他のみんなとは引き離されたんだ。
Overture to Despair#472.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#473.src: I- I o...overheard them t- talking about... a- about D...Deraj Prison.
Overture to Despair#473.dst: ぼ、僕… き、聞いちゃったんだ… D… Deraj 監獄の話を。
Overture to Despair#473.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#474.src: We, um, heard the same. Yusanu... he- might be working on it. I don't know for sure. We... parted ways in the {p}.
Overture to Despair#474.dst: 私たちも、えっと、同じことを聞いた。Yusanu が… 動いてるかも。確かじゃないけど。{p} で… 別れたから。
Overture to Despair#474.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#476.src: With the Canopy. They're... safe is maybe the wrong word. But, um, he's protected. So... I think he can do it.
Overture to Despair#476.dst: 樹冠と一緒。あそこは… 無事って言葉は違うかも。でも、えっと、守られてる。だから… きっとやれる。
Overture to Despair#476.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#477.src: ...s- so you th...think they'll be al- alright...?
Overture to Despair#477.dst: …じゃ、じゃあ、み、みんな無事だと思う…？
Overture to Despair#477.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#478.src: We don't really have a choice but to trust that they will, since... we're up here, and they're not.
Overture to Despair#478.dst: 信じるしかないよ。だって… あたしたちはここで、向こうはそうじゃないんだから。
Overture to Despair#478.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#479.src: So. So, so, so. I've had a lot of time to think while imprisoned. About the past, the present, the future, all of it.
Overture to Despair#479.dst: で。で、で、で。捕まってる間、考える時間はたっぷりあった。過去、今、未来、全部について。
Overture to Despair#479.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#480.src: I've come up with lots and lots of possible plans to take down the crown! To, uh, limited success...
Overture to Despair#480.dst: 王家を倒す計画をいっぱい、いっぱい考えたんだ！まあ、成果は… いまいち…
Overture to Despair#480.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#481.src: Lots of pitfalls. There's so many ways things can go wrong. So, so many...
Overture to Despair#481.dst: 落とし穴だらけ。うまくいかない道が多すぎる。本当に、多すぎる…
Overture to Despair#481.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#482.src: ...I think I'll need to sort through them again, with... with our new information. And... and our losses.
Overture to Despair#482.dst: …新しい情報と… 失ったものを踏まえて、全部整理し直さないと。
Overture to Despair#482.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#484.src: I- I'm going to, um, go out for... for a little. I, ha, I need some air, I think.
Overture to Despair#484.dst: わ、私、えっと、ちょっと… 外に出てくる。はは、外の空気が吸いたい。
Overture to Despair#484.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#487.src: She's definitely not taking Mora's loss well, that's for sure... {u}, how long has she been like this?
Overture to Despair#487.dst: Mora のことをちゃんと受け止められてないのは確か… {u}、いつからあんな感じなの？
Overture to Despair#487.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#488.src: SHE k...killed a S- Sovereign?! She d...didn't tell us that...
Overture to Despair#488.dst: か、彼女が君、君主を殺した？！そ、そんなこと言ってなかった…
Overture to Despair#488.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#489.src: ...does it have to do with the ice? She's been... kind of cagey about it.
Overture to Despair#489.dst: …あの氷と関係ある？あのことになると… なんか口が重いんだよね。
Overture to Despair#489.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#490.src: H...her magic used t- to be so... s...so beautiful, so s- serene...
Overture to Despair#490.dst: か、彼女の魔法は前は… と、とてもきれいで、お、穏やかだったのに…
Overture to Despair#490.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#491.src: A- and- and n...now it looks... d- dangerous. Lethal.
Overture to Despair#491.dst: な、なのに… い、今は危なっかしい。命取りだ。
Overture to Despair#491.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#492.src: The p...poet in me can't h- help but see it as a r...reflection of her n- new- newfound coldness...
Overture to Despair#492.dst: 僕の中の、し、詩人は… あれを彼女の新たなつ、冷たさの映し鏡だと思わずにいられない…
Overture to Despair#492.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#493.src: Sorry, say that again? The poet in you? What poet?!
Overture to Despair#493.dst: ごめん、もう一回？僕の中の詩人？どこの詩人よ？！
Overture to Despair#493.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#494.src: I've ch...changed, Rex... th- there's a, pfft, a- a d...darkness inside me now...
Overture to Despair#494.dst: 僕は、か、変わったんだよ、Rex… 僕の中には、ぷっ、や、闇が…
Overture to Despair#494.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#495.src: Oh, het over yourself! I was there too, idiot!
Overture to Despair#495.dst: は、何言ってんの！あたしもそこにいたでしょ、バカ！
Overture to Despair#495.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#496.src: ...oh, {u}, before I forget. When we got here, there was an envelope left for you on your bed.
Overture to Despair#496.dst: …あ、{u}、忘れないうちに。ここに着いた時、あんたのベッドに封筒が置いてあったよ。
Overture to Despair#496.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#497.src: I haven't read it, but... be careful, okay?
Overture to Despair#497.dst: 読んでないけど… 気をつけてね？
Overture to Despair#497.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#498.src: We c...can talk to Sui wh- when she gets back.
Overture to Despair#498.dst: Sui がも、戻ってきたら話そう。
Overture to Despair#498.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#499.src: Head to the location mentioned in the letter at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#499.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の手紙に書かれた場所へ向かう。

Overture to Despair#500.src: I- I- I st...still can't believe you're r...real. That we're... fr...free.
Overture to Despair#500.dst: ぼ、ぼ、僕、君が本物だってま、まだ信じられない。僕たち… じ、自由なんだ。
Overture to Despair#500.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#503.src: I... I th- think so. It was b...bad, but it- it's o...over now.
Overture to Despair#503.dst: た… たぶん。ひどかったけど、も、もう終わった。
Overture to Despair#503.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#504.src: Seeing S...Sui back there was... i- in- incredible. It was like a m...miracle. It st...still feels... surreal.
Overture to Despair#504.dst: あそこで S… Sui を見た時は… す、すごかった。き、奇跡みたいだった。今でも… 現実じゃないみたい。
Overture to Despair#504.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#506.src: It's the w...worst thing I've ev- ever been th...through.
Overture to Despair#506.dst: 今までで、い、一番ひどい経験だった。
Overture to Despair#506.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#507.src: I- I- I d...don't want to, t...talk about it. I w- want to f- for- forget all the- th- the little details, and- A- AND-
Overture to Despair#507.dst: ぼ、ぼ、僕、そ、その話はしたくない。こ、細かいことはぜ、全部忘れたい、そ、それに― そ、それに―
Overture to Despair#507.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#509.src: I'm glad Gikyo's d...dead. They d- des- deserved it, a- and... worse.
Overture to Despair#509.dst: Gikyo がし、死んでよかった。当然のむ、報いだ、い、いや… それ以上の。
Overture to Despair#509.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#511.src: Sigh... I can't wait to sleep in a nice bed again.
Overture to Despair#511.dst: はあ… 早くいいベッドでまた寝たい。
Overture to Despair#511.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#513.src: What's with the stupid questions? No, dumbass, of course not.
Overture to Despair#513.dst: 何そのバカな質問？違うよ、バカ、当たり前でしょ。
Overture to Despair#513.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#514.src: Being kept in a cage, it... it reminded me too much of living back home.
Overture to Despair#514.dst: 檻に閉じ込められるのは… 実家での暮らしを思い出しすぎて。
Overture to Despair#514.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#515.src: And... now we're here! So. You know.
Overture to Despair#515.dst: で… 今はここにいる！だから。ね。
Overture to Despair#515.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#516.src: Oh, boy. If I'm being honest... time sort of blended together.
Overture to Despair#516.dst: うわ。正直言うと… 時間の感覚がごちゃまぜになってる。
Overture to Despair#516.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#517.src: They took my bow from me almost immediately. I... I couldn't focus on anything. It was like I was barely even there. I just... dreamt.
Overture to Despair#517.dst: 弓はほとんどすぐに取り上げられた。何にも… 集中できなかった。そこにいないみたいだった。ただ… 夢を見てた。
Overture to Despair#517.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#518.src: I dreamed of Auburn, of my brother, of my new family, of the people I've lost, of... of my bow.
Overture to Despair#518.dst: Auburn の夢、兄さんの夢、新しい家族の夢、失った人たちの夢… あたしの弓の夢。
Overture to Despair#518.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#519.src: I got used to it, eventually. Like losing a limb! It didn't stop feeling like a loss, but... I figured out how to live without my bow by my side.
Overture to Despair#519.dst: 結局は慣れたよ。手足をなくすみたいに！喪失感は消えなかったけど… 弓なしで生きる方法は分かった。
Overture to Despair#519.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#520.src: I think... I think I was the lucky one. I was never really present, so everything they did to us, it... it feels like a hazy memory of a dream.
Overture to Despair#520.dst: あたしは… あたしは運がよかったんだと思う。ずっと上の空だったから、あいつらにされたことは全部… ぼんやりした夢の記憶みたい。
Overture to Despair#520.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#521.src: Zeph... he, uh, couldn't distance himself. But I won't speak for him. Ask him yourself, if you really want to.
Overture to Despair#521.dst: Zeph は… えっと、割り切れなかった。でもあたしが代わりには話さない。本当に知りたいなら本人に聞いて。
Overture to Despair#521.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#522.src: Ugh. You met those idiots? They're just a glorified book club, honestly.
Overture to Despair#522.dst: うえ。あのバカたちに会ったの？正直、ただの名ばかりの読書会だよ。
Overture to Despair#522.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#523.src: Sure, they're not all bad, but for the most part... they're performative.
Overture to Despair#523.dst: まあ、全員が悪いわけじゃないけど、ほとんどは… 格好だけ。
Overture to Despair#523.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#524.src: I only heard about them through my brother, and he was always complaining. But I guess they were the only people he could find who agreed with him, so...
Overture to Despair#524.dst: 兄さんから聞いただけで、兄さんはいつも愚痴ってた。でも、考えが合う人があそこしか見つからなかったんだろうね…
Overture to Despair#524.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#526.src: Whatever. I'm glad you managed to get something out of them, at least.
Overture to Despair#526.dst: まあいいや。少なくとも何か聞き出せてよかった。
Overture to Despair#526.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#527.src: They're all over the place! In some of them, we all storm the gates of the citadel and break through their defenses...
Overture to Despair#527.dst: 計画はバラバラ！あるのは、みんなで城塞の門に攻め込んで防衛線を突破する案とか…
Overture to Despair#527.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#528.src: ...in others, I get to put an arrow through the eyes of each and every Sovereign myself.
Overture to Despair#528.dst: …あたしが君主全員の目を、一人残らず自分で射抜く案とか。
Overture to Despair#528.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#529.src: They're... mostly unusable. I just needed to do something with my head. I think there's probably something I can salvage, but for the most part...
Overture to Despair#529.dst: ほとんど… 使えない。とにかく頭を動かしていたかっただけ。使えるものも少しはあると思うけど、大半は…
Overture to Despair#529.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#530.src: Eh. We've got time. Still another week until the festival, after all...
Overture to Despair#530.dst: まあ。時間はある。祭りまでまだ一週間あるしね…
Overture to Despair#530.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#531.src: Good luck. Come back to us alive, alright? We only just all reunited, it'd suck having to go save you instantly.
Overture to Despair#531.dst: 気をつけて。生きて帰ってきてよ？再会したばかりなのに、すぐ助けに行くなんてごめんだから。
Overture to Despair#531.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#534.src: ...you should know. She told me. That mission. That damned mission, the one I-
Overture to Despair#534.dst: …知ってるはずだ。彼女から聞いた。あの任務。あの忌々しい任務、僕が―
Overture to Despair#534.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#535.src: So I'll ask you again. Is. It. True?
Overture to Despair#535.dst: だからもう一度聞く。本当。なのか？
Overture to Despair#535.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#536.src: And you didn't SAY ANYTHING?! Not a word.
Overture to Despair#536.dst: なのに何も「言わなかった」のか？！一言も。
Overture to Despair#536.speaker: Sovereign Tasim
