Overture to Despair#537.src: All this time, I've been wondering how he's doing, where he is- while you... you... you knew. And you chose to stay silent.
Overture to Despair#537.dst: ずっと、彼がどうしてるか、どこにいるか考えてた― なのに君は… 君は… 知ってた。そして黙ってた。
Overture to Despair#537.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#538.src: The right time. Of course. Of course! You just needed to find the right time to tell me you KILLED HIM!!!
Overture to Despair#538.dst: しかるべき時。そうだろうな。そうだろうとも！彼を「殺した」と伝える、しかるべき時を探してたってわけか！！！
Overture to Despair#538.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#539.src: So, now what?! Your "right time" has come and gone, and now we're here.
Overture to Despair#539.dst: で、どうする？！君の「しかるべき時」は過ぎて、今こうなってる。
Overture to Despair#539.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#540.src: I don't care what it was, {u}!! I don't care what you saw happen, or why you think it had to happen, I care that he's gone!!!
Overture to Despair#540.dst: 何があったかなんてどうでもいい、{u}！！何を見たかも、なぜそうなるしかなかったかもどうでもいい、彼がいないことが問題なんだ！！！
Overture to Despair#540.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#541.src: I don't have much, you know? A couple of acquaintances in Gavel, maybe. No one to really keep up with!
Overture to Despair#541.dst: 僕には大したものはないんだ。Gavel に知り合いが少しいるくらい。本当に付き合いのある人なんていない！
Overture to Despair#541.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#542.src: But I had him. And you TOOK HIM from me!!!!
Overture to Despair#542.dst: でも彼がいた。それを君が「奪った」んだ！！！！
Overture to Despair#542.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#543.src: He was all I had left, and you took him from me...
Overture to Despair#543.dst: 彼は僕に残された全てだった。それを君が奪った…
Overture to Despair#543.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#544.src: Why you? Why did it have to be you? If only the roles had been reversed- If only he were here instead of YOU!!!
Overture to Despair#544.dst: なぜ君なんだ？なぜ君でなきゃならなかった？立場が逆だったら― 君じゃなく彼がここにいたら！！！
Overture to Despair#544.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#545.src: He would have understood. He would have. He always did. He wouldn't have been so... so... STUBBORNLY, OVERWHELMINGLY, WRONG!!!
Overture to Despair#545.dst: 彼なら分かってくれた。絶対に。いつもそうだった。こんなに… こんなに… 「頑固で、とことん、間違って」はいなかった！！！
Overture to Despair#545.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#547.src: ...of course. Of course I am. What are you trying to suggest?
Overture to Despair#547.dst: …もちろん。もちろんだ。何が言いたい？
Overture to Despair#547.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#548.src: Don't you dare say that to my face. I didn't know him?! When you're the one who- who-
Overture to Despair#548.dst: よくも面と向かってそんなことを。僕が彼を知らなかった？！君こそが― 君こそが―
Overture to Despair#548.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#549.src: You're right!! You're right, he isn't - and WHOSE fault is that?!
Overture to Despair#549.dst: その通りだ！！その通り、彼はいない― それは「誰の」せいだ？！
Overture to Despair#549.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#550.src: It's not the crown's, no matter what you want to pin on them. It certainly isn't mine. So who does that leave?! WHO?!
Overture to Despair#550.dst: 王家じゃない、君がどれだけ押し付けたくても。僕のせいでもない。なら残るのは誰だ？！誰だ？！
Overture to Despair#550.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#552.src: Of course you have nothing to say. You always were a coward.
Overture to Despair#552.dst: 何も言えないに決まってる。君はずっと臆病者だった。
Overture to Despair#552.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#553.src: We're done here. Whatever... whatever we had- friendship, acquaintances- it doesn't matter. It's through. Get out of my sight.
Overture to Despair#553.dst: もう終わりだ。僕たちの間に何があったにせよ― 友情でも、知り合いでも― どうでもいい。終わりだ。消えてくれ。
Overture to Despair#553.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#554.src: ...before I change my mind and throw you off this dam myself.
Overture to Despair#554.dst: …気が変わって、このダムから君を突き落とす前に。
Overture to Despair#554.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#555.src: Goodbye, {u}. I hope you find your new friendships just as fulfilling as you found ours.
Overture to Despair#555.dst: さよなら、{u}。新しい友人たちとの関係が、僕たちのと同じくらい満ち足りたものになるといいね。
Overture to Despair#555.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#559.src: She told me about Aledar. Missing some details, but...
Overture to Despair#559.dst: 彼女から Aledar のことを聞いた。細かいところは抜けてたけど…
Overture to Despair#559.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#560.src: ...I don't know why she'd do it, if not to try and turn me against you.
Overture to Despair#560.dst: …僕を君と敵対させるため以外に、なぜそんなことをするのか分からない。
Overture to Despair#560.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#561.src: ...pfft, hah did it yeah, {u}, it worked. We're now bitter enemies, till the day we die.
Overture to Despair#561.dst: …ぷっ、はは、うまくいった― ああ、{u}、成功だ。僕たちは今や、死ぬまで憎み合う宿敵さ。
Overture to Despair#561.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#562.src: You put a blade through my through his chest, and I can never forgive you! I will now... dedicate the rest of my life to avenging him!
Overture to Despair#562.dst: 君は僕の― 彼の胸に刃を突き立てた、絶対に許さない！これから… 残りの人生をかけて彼の仇を討つ！
Overture to Despair#562.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#565.src: No, I... it wasn't your fault. Or... no more your fault than his.
Overture to Despair#565.dst: いや、僕は… 君のせいじゃない。少なくとも… 彼以上に君のせいじゃない。
Overture to Despair#565.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#567.src: ...of course, I... I already knew. So, it... wasn't a surprise.
Overture to Despair#567.dst: …もちろん、僕は… もう知ってた。だから… 驚きはしなかった。
Overture to Despair#567.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#568.src: I... it wasn't your fault. Or... no more your fault than his.
Overture to Despair#568.dst: 僕は… 君のせいじゃない。少なくとも… 彼以上に君のせいじゃない。
Overture to Despair#568.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#569.src: It just stings. That he's... he's... he's really gone. That I'll never hear his voice, see his smile, feel his warmth... that for the rest of time, he'll... only ever be a memory.
Overture to Despair#569.dst: ただ、胸が痛むんだ。彼が… 彼が… 本当にいなくなった。声も、笑顔も、ぬくもりも、もう二度と… これから先ずっと、彼は… 思い出でしかない。
Overture to Despair#569.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#570.src: He's gone, and... he isn't ever coming back. He was the best thing that had ever happened to me, and...
Overture to Despair#570.dst: 彼は逝ってしまって… もう戻らない。僕の人生で最高の出来事だったのに…
Overture to Despair#570.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#572.src: I'm... glad you're here, at least. I'm glad to have someone I know.
Overture to Despair#572.dst: 少なくとも… 君がいてくれてよかった。知ってる人がいてよかった。
Overture to Despair#572.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#574.src: I really... can't stop thinking about it. If only he could have been here with us. What would he have done? Which side would he have taken?
Overture to Despair#574.dst: 本当に… 考えずにいられない。彼がここに一緒にいられたら。彼ならどうした？どっちの側についた？
Overture to Despair#574.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#577.src: I guess it doesn't matter, does it? He isn't here. And... he never will be.
Overture to Despair#577.dst: どうでもいいことか。彼はここにいない。そして… これからも。
Overture to Despair#577.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#579.src: We're nearing a final confrontation, you know. Your side's taking action... and so is ours. Next we meet, we'll be enemies.
Overture to Despair#579.dst: 最後の対決が近づいてる。君たちの側が動いて… 僕たちもだ。次に会う時は、敵同士だ。
Overture to Despair#579.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#580.src: ...ha. You would say that, wouldn't you?
Overture to Despair#580.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#581.src: But I can't. Not anymore. The moment I took the blessing, I made the choice. I have to see it through.
Overture to Despair#581.dst: でも無理だ。もう無理なんだ。祝福を受けた瞬間、僕は選んだ。最後までやり遂げなきゃ。
Overture to Despair#581.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#582.src: It was given for a purpose, and... I can't back out now. I can't.
Overture to Despair#582.dst: 目的があって授かったものだ… 今さら降りられない。無理だ。
Overture to Despair#582.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#584.src: Sigh... goodbye, {u}. I'm sure I'll see you soon.
Overture to Despair#584.dst: はあ… さよなら、{u}。きっとすぐまた会う。
Overture to Despair#584.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#586.src: I am. There's too much at stake to just... turn back now. I've made this choice, and now... I have to see it through.
Overture to Despair#586.dst: そうだ。懸かっているものが大きすぎて… 今さら引き返せない。僕はこの道を選んだ。だから… やり遂げなきゃ。
Overture to Despair#586.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#587.src: I... don't see a way to save the world, if not with her. I don't know if anyone else could stand against what we're facing.
Overture to Despair#587.dst: 僕には… 彼女なしで世界を救う方法が見えない。僕たちが直面しているものに、他の誰が立ち向かえるか分からない。
Overture to Despair#587.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#589.src: ... Goodbye, {u}. I'm sure I'll see you soon.
Overture to Despair#589.dst: …さよなら、{u}。きっとすぐまた会う。
Overture to Despair#589.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#591.src: What... what is Fruma to you, if you don't mind me asking? If you're... you know. Why are you here, instead of there?
Overture to Despair#591.dst: 君にとって… Fruma って何なんだ？聞いてよければ。もし君が… その。なぜ向こうじゃなく、ここにいる？
Overture to Despair#591.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#593.src: There is little more I would like than to forget that... place, that cage entirely.
Overture to Despair#593.dst: あの… 場所を、あの檻を、すっかり忘れられるなら、それ以上の望みはありません。
Overture to Despair#593.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#594.src: ...from the moment of conception. It was given nothing. It was Their hatred, Their disdain, Their battlefield, suddenly given the mind to think and form to feel.
Overture to Despair#594.dst: …生まれた瞬間から。それには何も与えられなかった。それは「彼ら」の憎悪、「彼ら」の侮蔑、「彼ら」の戦場。突然、考える心と感じる形を与えられただけ。
Overture to Despair#594.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#595.src: ...and oh, how It grew to hate that cage, to hate those who had put It there to rot.
Overture to Despair#595.dst: …そしてああ、それはどれほどあの檻を憎み、そこで朽ちさせた者たちを憎んだことか。
Overture to Despair#595.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#596.src: Its only solace was found in glimpses of a world beyond. Mere specks reflected off the scattered shards of War.
Overture to Despair#596.dst: 唯一の慰めは、外の世界の垣間見。「戦」の散らばった欠片に映った、ほんのかすかな光。
Overture to Despair#596.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#597.src: I took that cage and shattered Its bars. I freed myself from what It was made to be.
Overture to Despair#597.dst: わたくしはその檻を取り、格子を砕きました。それが作られた姿から、自らを解き放ったのです。
Overture to Despair#597.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#598.src: This province... I have made it a home. It is everything I could have ever dreamed could be mine. It is... everything, to me.
Overture to Despair#598.dst: この地方を… わたくしは故郷にしました。わたくしのものになりうると夢見たすべて。わたくしの… すべてなのです。
Overture to Despair#598.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#599.src: But now, I have something I could lose. Something to protect at any cost. I would give anything to ensure its safety...
Overture to Despair#599.dst: けれど今、わたくしには失うものがある。何を犠牲にしても守るべきもの。その安全のためなら何でも差し出しましょう…
Overture to Despair#599.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#600.src: ... Tasim looks down at the ground.
Overture to Despair#600.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#601.src: I think I know the feeling.
Overture to Despair#601.dst: その気持ち、分かる気がする。
Overture to Despair#601.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#000~1.src: - No weaponry or blessed equipment in common areas.
Overture to Despair#000~1.dst: - 共用エリアでの武器や祝福された装備は禁止。

Overture to Despair#002~1.src: No matter, it can be sorted ou-
Overture to Despair#002~1.dst: まあいい、どうにでもな-

Overture to Despair#005~1.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#005~1.dst: 長く埋もれた真実を掘り起こし、変革をもたらさんことを。

similar.text: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.

Overture to Despair#006~1.src: Different plants require different soils, temperatures and water requirements.
Overture to Despair#006~1.dst: 植物ごとに適した土、温度、水の量が違う。

Overture to Despair#007~1.src: At first, I was afraid of being labeled as cursed. But power does not come without risk. I am willing to risk everything for power.
Overture to Despair#007~1.dst: 最初は呪われた者の烙印を押されるのが怖かった。だが力には危険がつきもの。力のためなら全てを賭ける覚悟がある。

Overture to Despair#009~1.dst: ミニクエスト開始: 白ユリを集める

Overture to Despair#010~1.src: I only serve customers with something to show me.
Overture to Despair#010~1.dst: 見せる物がある客しか相手にしないよ。

Overture to Despair#012~1.src: Do you want to play a song?

Overture to Despair#013~1.src: - Late checkout will come with a {~}  fine.
Overture to Despair#013~1.dst: - チェックアウトが遅れた場合は {~}  の罰金。

Overture to Despair#014~1.src: You open a page at random...
Overture to Despair#014~1.dst: 適当なページを開いてみる…

Overture to Despair#015~1.src: Unsurprisingly, it's talking about Majin's love life. You look inside.
Overture to Despair#015~1.dst: 案の定、Majin の恋愛事情の話だ。中を見てみる。

Overture to Despair#017~1.src: The painting most likely symbolises the destruction of the Auburn of old and the hope of a better time to come.
Overture to Despair#017~1.dst: この絵はおそらく、かつての Auburn の破壊と、より良い時代への希望を象徴している。

Overture to Despair#018~1.src: Painted in {~}NA by Piju Rae. This oil masterpiece embraces revolutionary color techniques using pigments sourced from the highland dye production.
Overture to Despair#018~1.dst: {~}NA に Piju Rae が描いた作品。高地の染料産地の顔料を用い、革新的な色彩技法を取り入れた油彩の傑作。

Overture to Despair#019~1.src: Yes, hello, you staring at me from across the desk, give me a moment I've ran out of ink.
Overture to Despair#019~1.dst: はいはい、机の向こうからじっと見てるあなた、ちょっと待って、インクが切れたの。

Overture to Despair#020~1.src: To a lesser extent we also monitor trade between the other districts in Fruma, including anything transported via rail.
Overture to Despair#020~1.dst: 副次的には、鉄道で運ばれる物も含め、Fruma の他の地区間の交易も監視しています。

Overture to Despair#022~1.dst: 命は力のために築かれる

Overture to Despair#023~1.src: Heather is a simple starting plant to grow in the {p}. Any acidic soil from the {p} can be used in the gardening bed or flower pot.
Overture to Despair#023~1.dst: ヘザーは {p} で育てやすい入門向けの植物だ。{p} の酸性の土なら、花壇でも植木鉢でも使える。

Overture to Despair#024~1.src: Excuse me. It has been a long day. Again, any questions?
Overture to Despair#024~1.dst: 失礼。長い一日でしたので。改めて、何かご質問は？

Overture to Despair#025~1.src: To keep it working as intended, the power to issue death sentences should be limited. Giving one trusted official, besides Her Majesty, the right to pass
Overture to Despair#025~1.dst: 意図どおりに機能させるには、死刑を宣告する権限は制限すべきです。女王陛下のほかに、信頼できる役人一人にだけ権利を与え

Overture to Despair#026~1.dst: 花びらは運命に舞い落ちる

Overture to Despair#027~1.src: Would you like to keep reading?

Overture to Despair#028~1.src: Right. that is the thirty first time I have had to write that sentence today, the third pot of ink I've been through, and my hands are starting to shake.
Overture to Despair#028~1.dst: はい。今日この文を書くのはこれで三十一回目、インクは三瓶目、手が震えてきたわ。

Overture to Despair#029~1.src: Do you want to get some ice?

Overture to Despair#030~1.src: Paper published and written by Majin in {~}IA.
Overture to Despair#030~1.dst: {~}IA に Majin が執筆・発表した論文。

Overture to Despair#033~1.src: You are gripped by terror. You can't bear to read more.
Overture to Despair#033~1.dst: 恐怖に襲われる。これ以上は読んでいられない。

Overture to Despair#034~1.src: "SO YEAH, OF COURSE WE'RE GOING TO REPEAT A FEW QUESTIONS. ALRIGHT? GET OVER YOURSELVES."
Overture to Despair#034~1.dst: 「だからそう、当然いくつか質問は繰り返すの。わかった？いい加減にして。」

Overture to Despair#035~1.src: There's a picture of a funny looking fish. The headline reads as follows:
Overture to Despair#035~1.dst: 変な顔の魚の写真が載っている。見出しはこうだ:

Overture to Despair#036~1.src: New Chapter Started: Blossom of Blades

Overture to Despair#037~1.src: "Fish Experts Warn Dangerous New Invasive Fish Headed For {p}. Its Diet? Your-"
Overture to Despair#037~1.dst: 「魚の専門家が警告、危険な新外来魚が {p} へ。その餌は？あなたの-」

Overture to Despair#106~1.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} .
Overture to Despair#106~1.dst: どうぞ、うちで一番安いものです。合計で…{~} です。
Overture to Despair#106~1.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#107~1.src: Where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#107~1.dst: 地域が埋もれた鋼の線で交わる場所。

Overture to Despair#125~1.src: I see. I see. That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#125~1.dst: なるほど。なるほど。それは確かに厄介ですね…
Overture to Despair#125~1.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#126~1.src: "Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed."
Overture to Despair#126~1.dst: 「日ごと、声は探求者を迎える。真実を見極め、刷られた秘密を読め。」

Overture to Despair#227~1.src: I'm... feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#227~1.dst: もう…だいぶ楽になった。えっと…じゃあ今から何する？真夜中を…待つ間。
Overture to Despair#227~1.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#228~1.src: I long for a worthy opponent, someone I can fully explore the depths of the endless cosmos with. Maybe then my hunger will be satiated.
Overture to Despair#228~1.dst: 私は相応しい好敵手を渇望している。果てなき宇宙の深淵を共に探求できる者を。そうすれば、この飢えも満たされるだろう。

Overture to Despair#242~1.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even... even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#242~1.dst: 私…ああもう。まだすごく腹が立つ。全部に！王家にも、君主たちにも…{p} の人たちにも！！世界が終わったみたいなのに…まだ普通に暮らしてるなんて。
Overture to Despair#242~1.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#392~1.src: I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waste my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
Overture to Despair#392~1.dst: つまりだね、あの二人に何の使い道があったというのかね？知っている情報を聞き出すのに労力を無駄にしろと？
Overture to Despair#392~1.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#393~1.src: You tell her how you finally killed it. How it fought, and fought, and fought, but could not take you down. How the Light was freed from the Shadows.
Overture to Despair#393~1.dst: ついにそれを倒した経緯を話す。それが戦って、戦って、戦い抜いても、あなたを倒せなかったこと。光が影から解き放たれたことを。

Overture to Despair#642.src: ...from the moment of conception, It was given nothing. It was Their hatred, Their disdain, Their battlefield, suddenly given the mind to think and form to feel.
Overture to Despair#642.dst: …宿った瞬間から、それには何も与えられなかった。それは彼らの憎しみ、彼らの侮蔑、彼らの戦場。そこへ突然、考える心と感じる形が与えられたのです。
Overture to Despair#642.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#643.src: ...but we have some hope. F-finally. Rex and Zeph... there's still a chance. There's still a chance we'll get to see them again.
Overture to Despair#643.dst: …でも希望はある。や、やっと。Rex と Zeph…まだチャンスがある。また二人に会えるチャンスがまだあるの。

Overture to Despair#644.src: "Rooted deep atop the house of wealth and greed, the branches hear the whispers on the breeze."
Overture to Despair#644.dst: 「富と強欲の館の上に深く根を張り、枝は風のささやきを聞く。」

Overture to Despair#645.src: You tell her about entering the portal with Lari. About seeing the realm's connections severed, made smaller.
Overture to Despair#645.dst: Lari と共にポータルに入ったことを話す。その領域のつながりが断たれ、小さくされていたことを。

Overture to Despair#646.src: "The whispers speak of unity, called forth where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel."
Overture to Despair#646.dst: 「ささやきは団結を語る。地域が埋もれた鋼の線で交わる場所で呼び起こされる。」

Overture to Despair#647.src: You tell her about fighting through the nexus. About the battle between Light and Dark ongoing within.
Overture to Despair#647.dst: 結節点を戦い抜いたことを話す。その中で今も続く光と闇の戦いのことを。

Overture to Despair#648.src: Casting simple spells drawing power from the cosmos feels like holding fragile explosives in my hand. One wrong move and I'm afraid it will swallow me, or the world, whole.
Overture to Despair#648.dst: 宇宙から力を引き出す簡単な呪文でさえ、壊れやすい爆薬を手に持っている気分だ。一歩間違えば、私も世界も丸ごと呑み込まれそうで怖い。

Pirate's Trove#000.dst: {p} の外、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Damiral と話す

Pirate's Trove#001.src: Lo, adventurer! Welcome to the great province of Gavel, home of the villager race, and yours truly. You'll be headed into the grand citadel of {p} soon!
Pirate's Trove#001.dst: おお、冒険者よ！偉大なる Gavel 地方へようこそ。村人族の故郷であり、この俺の故郷だ。もうすぐ壮大な城塞都市 {p} に入るぞ！
Pirate's Trove#001.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#002.src: But enough with the pleasantries. Tell me... have you ever heard the tale of the great pirate, Captain Hastor? Sailed the seas a long time ago.
Pirate's Trove#002.dst: だが挨拶はこのへんにしよう。なあ…大海賊 Hastor 船長の話を聞いたことはあるか？遥か昔に海を渡った男だ。
Pirate's Trove#002.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#003.src: Legend says that when {p} was rebuilt all those years ago, he hid his fortune within the walls someplace!
Pirate's Trove#003.dst: 伝説によれば、昔 {p} が再建されたとき、奴は城壁のどこかに財宝を隠したそうだ！
Pirate's Trove#003.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#004.src: I'm a retired sailor now, but I could still do with a few extra emeralds from that treasure. Perhaps, if you're up to it... we could come to an agreement?
Pirate's Trove#004.dst: 俺はもう引退した船乗りだが、その財宝から少しエメラルドをいただけるならありがたい。どうだ、やる気があるなら…取引といかないか？
Pirate's Trove#004.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#005.src: I have a riddle, the first of a number of clues that are supposed to lead to where Hastor hid his fortune, but I can't for the life of me figure it out.
Pirate's Trove#005.dst: 謎かけを一つ持っている。Hastor の隠し場所へ導く手がかりの最初の一つなんだが、どうしても解けんのだ。
Pirate's Trove#005.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#006.src: Maybe you'll be able to solve it. If you can, I'll make sure to split the treasure with you!
Pirate's Trove#006.dst: お前なら解けるかもしれん。解けたら、財宝は必ず山分けにしよう！
Pirate's Trove#006.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#007.src: This first riddle goes like so: “Toward the sunset, among the northern flowers shaded by quartz”.
Pirate's Trove#007.dst: 最初の謎はこうだ。「日の沈む方、石英に陰る北の花々の間に」。
Pirate's Trove#007.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#008.src: I do wish you good luck, adventurer! Remember, everything you need to solve the clues should be found somewhere inside {p}.
Pirate's Trove#008.dst: 幸運を祈るぞ、冒険者！いいか、手がかりを解くのに必要なものは、すべて {p} の中のどこかにあるはずだ。
Pirate's Trove#008.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#009.src: Clue I: Toward the sunset, among northern flowers shaded by quartz
Pirate's Trove#009.dst: 手がかり I: 日の沈む方、石英に陰る北の花々の間に

Pirate's Trove#010.src: Clue II: In a place of identity, above the leaves and between the glass
Pirate's Trove#010.dst: 手がかり II: 身元の場所にて、葉の上、ガラスの間に

Pirate's Trove#011.src: Clue III: In an emerald fountain, surrounded by the wealth of the villagers
Pirate's Trove#011.dst: 手がかり III: エメラルドの泉にて、村人の富に囲まれて

Pirate's Trove#012.src: Clue IV: Beneath the cowl of an eastern titan, keeping watch over our heads
Pirate's Trove#012.dst: 手がかり IV: 東の巨人の頭巾の下、我らの頭上を見守る

Pirate's Trove#013.src: Aha! I'd come to ask how it was coming when I saw you jump over here!
Pirate's Trove#013.dst: おお！様子を聞きに来たら、お前がこっちへ跳んでくるのが見えたぞ！
Pirate's Trove#013.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#014.src: Phenomenal work, my compatriot. Though, do remember our deal?
Pirate's Trove#014.dst: 見事な働きだ、相棒よ。ところで、約束は覚えているな？
Pirate's Trove#014.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#015.src: You find the treasure, I give you a cut. I'll just take my part and be on my way!
Pirate's Trove#015.dst: 財宝を見つけたら分け前をやる。俺は自分の分をもらって行くとしよう！
Pirate's Trove#015.speaker: Damiral

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#000.dst: {p} にいる Merloni と話す [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.src: Would you like to hear the tale of the pit of the dead?
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.dst: 死者の穴の話を聞きたいか？
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.src: It is the pit where the corpses of the poor miners who discovered the Portal by the {p} are buried.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.dst: それは {p} のそばでポータルを見つけた哀れな鉱夫たちの亡骸が埋められた穴だ。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.src: Those that had not already died had to be executed due to the insanity brought on from the corruption.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.dst: まだ死んでいなかった者も、腐敗による狂気のせいで処刑するしかなかった。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.src: Their spirits still haunt the grave and infect the minds of people who disturb them. It isn't pretty.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.dst: 彼らの霊は今も墓に取り憑き、邪魔する者の心を蝕む。見られたものではない。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.src: However, I heard rumours of those who were able to bathe in their waters and be accepted by them, to show no fear of the dead is to be admired.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.dst: だが、その水に身を浸し、彼らに受け入れられた者がいるという噂も聞く。死者を恐れぬ姿は称賛に値する。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.src: Maybe this shrine that I keep hearing about has something to do with it? It's apparently hidden deep inside the pit.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.dst: よく耳にする祠が関係しているのかもしれん。穴の奥深くに隠されているらしい。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#007.src: Soldier, the pit is located south east of {p}, across the bridge behind us. I will write down the coordinates inside your quest book.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#007.dst: 兵士よ、穴は {p} の南東、背後の橋を渡った先だ。座標はクエストブックに書いておこう。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#007.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#008.src: Enter the pit. Learn it's mysteries, then come back to me.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#008.dst: 穴に入り、その謎を解き明かしてから戻ってこい。
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#008.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#009.src: Explore the pit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the shrine
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#009.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の穴を探索し、祠を見つける

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#010.src: Go back to {p} and tell Merloni that you succeeded
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#010.dst: {p} に戻り、Merloni に成功を伝える

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.src: Very impressive! Here's your reward. I found it a while ago while walking around {p}. It probably fell off a skeleton!
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.dst: 見事だ！これが報酬だ。少し前に {p} を歩いていて拾ったものだ。骸骨から落ちたのだろう！
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.speaker: Merloni

Point of No Return#000.src: Live well, {u}. That is all I ask.
Point of No Return#000.dst: よく生きろ、{u}。私が望むのはそれだけだ。

Point of No Return#001.src: Retrace the steps of your soul to keep up...
Point of No Return#001.dst: 遅れぬよう、魂の足跡をたどれ…

Point of No Return#004.src: Holding the Soul Retainer seems to switch your location with your soul...
Point of No Return#004.dst: 魂の保持具を持つと、自分と魂の位置が入れ替わるようだ…

Point of No Return#007.src: You... could it be...? Are you... real?
Point of No Return#007.dst: お前…まさか…？本物…なのか？
Point of No Return#007.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#008.src: Ha... ha... you should not have come here.
Point of No Return#008.dst: は…は…ここへ来るべきではなかった。
Point of No Return#008.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#009.src: Have you seen the others? Barely clinging on to life... hollowed, empty.
Point of No Return#009.dst: 他の者を見たか？かろうじて生にしがみつき…虚ろで、空っぽだ。
Point of No Return#009.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#010.src: Only I persist. And, now... you, too, have been ensnared.
Point of No Return#010.dst: 残っているのは私だけ。そして今…お前も囚われた。
Point of No Return#010.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#011.src: Fight against your fate, if you so choose... it makes no difference in the end. Ha... ha... ha...
Point of No Return#011.dst: 望むなら運命に抗うがいい…結局は何も変わらない。は…は…は…
Point of No Return#011.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#020.dst: この幸せな {p} を探索する。

Point of No Return#021.dst: ああ…新顔か？ようこそ、ようこそ。
Point of No Return#021.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#022.src: Do not worry, you are safe here. The Obelisk protects us all.
Point of No Return#022.dst: 心配いらない、ここは安全だ。オベリスクが皆を守ってくれる。
Point of No Return#022.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#023.src: An beacon of safety amidst the terror outside... what a miracle, to have found it awaiting us in our time of need.
Point of No Return#023.dst: 外の恐怖の中に灯る安全の光…困った時に待っていてくれたとは、なんという奇跡だろう。
Point of No Return#023.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#024.src: Rest well, friend. You have made it home. Feel free to familiarize yourself with it.
Point of No Return#024.dst: ゆっくり休むといい、友よ。ここが家だ。自由に見て回ってくれ。
Point of No Return#024.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#025.src: How long has it been since a new face has joined us? I can't quite seem to recall...
Point of No Return#025.dst: 新しい顔が加わるのはいつ以来だろう？どうにも思い出せない…
Point of No Return#025.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#026.src: Don't be fooled - everything you see around you is very real.
Point of No Return#026.dst: 惑わされるな。周りに見えるものはすべて本物だ。
Point of No Return#026.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#031.src: You look different in the mirror. It is a reflection of your inner self.
Point of No Return#031.dst: 鏡の中の自分が違って見える。内なる自己の姿だ。

Point of No Return#033.src: Something must be left behind. And you must leave.
Point of No Return#033.dst: 何かを残していかねばならない。そして去らねばならない。

Point of No Return#034.src: ...more than anything beyond, at least. The Obelisk protects us, after all.
Point of No Return#034.dst: …少なくとも、外の何よりはな。何しろオベリスクが守ってくれるのだから。
Point of No Return#034.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#035.src: Do you feel its pull? It calls to us all, when we arrive.
Point of No Return#035.dst: 引力を感じるか？ここに来た者を皆、呼んでいるんだ。
Point of No Return#035.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#036.src: Why would anyone choose to resist? The world is twisted, wrong... we do not belong there.
Point of No Return#036.dst: なぜ抗おうとする？あの世界は歪み、間違っている…私たちの居場所ではない。
Point of No Return#036.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#037.src: It is by the Bovine's grace that the Obelisk has seen fit to bless us with this sanctuary.
Point of No Return#037.dst: オベリスクがこの聖域を授けてくださったのは、牛神様のご加護あってこそだ。
Point of No Return#037.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#038.src: There is no fault in giving in. It only wants to protect us. Is that so wrong?
Point of No Return#038.dst: 身を委ねるのは悪くない。守ろうとしているだけだ。それがいけないことか？
Point of No Return#038.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#039.src: Why would you ever want to leave?
Point of No Return#039.dst: なぜ出ていきたいなど思う？
Point of No Return#039.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#043.src: If you truly want to leave... no one here will stop you. But are you really willing to go through with it?
Point of No Return#043.dst: 本当に去りたいなら…誰も止めはしない。だが、本当にその覚悟があるのか？
Point of No Return#043.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#044.src: Talk to the {p} Citizen who sent you on this journey.
Point of No Return#044.dst: この旅に送り出した {p} の市民と話す。

Point of No Return#045.src: Ha... I saw it there. That flicker in your eyes...
Point of No Return#045.dst: は…見えたぞ。お前の目に宿った、その揺らめき…
Point of No Return#045.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#046.src: You have been... shattered. Just like me, ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#046.dst: お前は…砕けてしまった。私と同じだ、は、は、は…
Point of No Return#046.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#047.src: The others... all have given into its pull. Our band of survivors... left behind, abandoned...
Point of No Return#047.dst: 他の者は…皆あの引力に屈した。私たち生き残りは…置き去りにされ、見捨てられた…
Point of No Return#047.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#048.src: I cannot blame them. Such a loss must seem a blessing, compared to life out here...
Point of No Return#048.dst: 彼らを責められない。ここで生きるのに比べれば、あの喪失は恵みに思えるだろう…
Point of No Return#048.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#049.src: How long has it been, since we found ourselves trapped here...? Longer than anyone has any right to live... ha, ha...
Point of No Return#049.dst: ここに閉じ込められて、どれほど経ったか…？誰にも許されぬほど長く生きた…は、は…
Point of No Return#049.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#050.src: Perhaps I am already gone. More dead than alive. Hollowed out...
Point of No Return#050.dst: 私はもう消えているのかもしれない。生きているより死に近い。空っぽだ…
Point of No Return#050.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#051.src: All it does is take. More, and more, and more, until nothing is left... ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#051.dst: 奪うばかりだ。もっと、もっと、もっと、何も残らなくなるまで…は、は、は…
Point of No Return#051.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#001~1.src: The passage to the next area has opened...
Point of No Return#001~1.dst: 次のエリアへの通路が開いた…

Point of No Return#002~1.src: When soul and body synchronize, the way is opened...
Point of No Return#002~1.dst: 魂と体が同調すると、道が開く…

Point of No Return#003.src: {u}. {u}, {u}, {u}. You can hear me. For once, for one small moment, we are nearly as one again.
Point of No Return#003.dst: {u}。{u}、{u}、{u}。聞こえているな。一度だけ、ほんの一瞬、我らはほぼ一つに戻っている。

Point of No Return#004~1.src: Tying you to something you no longer are.
Point of No Return#004~1.dst: もはやそうではない何かに、お前を縛りつけている。

Point of No Return#006~1.src: And then, when it was done, we lost what little still was left.
Point of No Return#006~1.dst: そしてそれが終わると、わずかに残っていたものまで失った。

Point of No Return#007~1.src: Did your soul just stop following you?
Point of No Return#007~1.dst: 魂がついて来なくなった？

Point of No Return#009~1.src: Something which can no longer leave.
Point of No Return#009~1.dst: もう去ることのできない何か。

Point of No Return#010~1.src: ... Maybe you should talk to that citizen again.
Point of No Return#010~1.dst: …あの住人ともう一度話したほうがいいかも。

Point of No Return#012~1.dst: お前は…自由だ。だが、何かが…

Potion Making#000.src: Talk to The Assistant in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Potion Making#001.dst: へへ…旅の人。あなたの…助けが要るかも…
Potion Making#001.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#002.src: My master...wishes to create a very dangerous potion...a transformative elixir of invincibility...
Potion Making#002.dst: 師匠が…とても危険な薬を作ろうとしている…無敵になる変身の霊薬を…
Potion Making#002.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#003.src: I was...in support of this... but then, he accrued essence of...the corruption. I had to run away...
Potion Making#003.dst: 私も…賛成していた…でも、師匠は…腐敗のエッセンスを手に入れた。逃げるしかなかった…
Potion Making#003.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#004.src: I fear...that he may be going...too far. I need your help...
Potion Making#004.dst: 怖い…師匠は…やりすぎているかもしれない。助けてほしい…
Potion Making#004.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#005.src: I want...to stop him...but I need you to...get me the necessary ingredients... to neutralize the potion...
Potion Making#005.dst: 止めたい…でも、あなたに…薬を中和する…材料を集めてほしい…
Potion Making#005.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#006.src: Get me...[{~} Red Mushroom], they can be found outside the east gate behind me.
Potion Making#006.dst: 持ってきて…[{~} 赤いキノコ]。私の後ろの東門の外で見つかる。
Potion Making#006.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#007.src: Slay Mooshrooms near and bring [{~} Red Mushrooms] to The Assistant in {p}
Potion Making#007.dst: 近くのムーシュルームを倒し、[{~} 赤いキノコ] を {p} の助手に届ける

Potion Making#008.src: Quickly, get me... [{~} Red Mushroom] as I asked... go through the {p} outside the east gate from here.
Potion Making#008.dst: 早く…頼んだ [{~} 赤いキノコ] を…ここから東門を出て {p} を抜けて。
Potion Making#008.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#011.dst: いい…よし。キノコを持ってきた。
Potion Making#011.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#012.src: I'll... return to my master's house...and sneak the mushrooms into...his potion. Wait for me here...
Potion Making#012.dst: 私は…師匠の家に戻って…薬にこっそりキノコを…混ぜる。ここで待っていて…
Potion Making#012.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#013.src: I...have returned... He came back...just as I finished slipping the mushrooms in and...told me...to get out.
Potion Making#013.dst: 戻った…キノコを入れ終えたところで…師匠が帰ってきて…出ていけと…言われた。
Potion Making#013.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#014.src: You must...ensure that it has worked. You...are much stronger than I, stranger...
Potion Making#014.dst: 効いたか…確かめてほしい。あなたは…私よりずっと強い、旅の人…
Potion Making#014.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#015.src: Did you see the orange witch hat roofed hut when you were gathering the mushrooms?
Potion Making#015.dst: キノコを集めていた時、オレンジの魔女帽みたいな屋根の小屋を見た？
Potion Making#015.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#016.src: That is my master's house, you...must go back out the east gate and enter the hut.
Potion Making#016.dst: あれが師匠の家。あなたは…また東門を出て、あの小屋に入って。
Potion Making#016.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#017.src: You must...make sure...he has not managed...to become invincible... Do what has to be done....
Potion Making#017.dst: 師匠が…無敵に…なっていないか…確かめて…やるべきことを、やって…
Potion Making#017.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#018.src: Enter the hut at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and slay Essren, and take his coat.
Potion Making#018.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の小屋に入り、Essren を倒して上着を奪う。

Potion Making#019.src: You must go back out the east gate and enter the hut, it is my master's house.
Potion Making#019.dst: また東門を出て、小屋に入って。そこが師匠の家。
Potion Making#019.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#020.src: Don't forget... Do what you must...
Potion Making#020.dst: 忘れないで…やるべきことを…
Potion Making#020.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#021.src: Ah, you must be the one my assistant told me about.
Potion Making#021.dst: ああ、君が助手の言っていた者だな。
Potion Making#021.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#022.src: If you are trying to stop me, it's too late. I already drank the pot...
Potion Making#022.dst: 私を止めに来たのなら、もう遅い。薬はすでに飲ん…
Potion Making#022.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#023.src: What is this taste? Mushrooms? This can't b
Potion Making#023.dst: 何だこの味は？キノコ？ありえな
Potion Making#023.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#025.src: What have you done to this potion, human?! You will pay for it!
Potion Making#025.dst: 薬に何をした、人間？！この報いは受けてもらうぞ！
Potion Making#025.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#026.src: Bring back Essren's Dusty Coat to The Assistant in {p}
Potion Making#026.dst: Essren の埃っぽい上着を {p} の助手に届ける

Potion Making#027.dst: あなたに…感謝しないと、旅の人…
Potion Making#027.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#028.src: Don't believe...everything people tell you... If master managed to...discover invincibility... No...too...dangerous.
Potion Making#028.dst: 人の言うことを…すべて信じないで…師匠が本当に…無敵を見つけていたら…いや…危険すぎる。
Potion Making#028.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#030.src: Now. I...do not want you saying anything about...these events. Take these, and...never speak of this again.
Potion Making#030.dst: さて。私は…この件を…誰にも話してほしくない。これを受け取って…二度と口にしないで。
Potion Making#030.speaker: The Assistant

Purple and Blue#000.dst: {p} 近くの [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Korun と話す。

Purple and Blue#001.src: W-Woah there, short nose! What are you doing, barging into my home?!
Purple and Blue#001.dst: う、うわっ、鼻ぺちゃ！何してるんだ、人の家に押し入って？！
Purple and Blue#001.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#002.src: Did {p} send you? Well, welcome to {p}! I could actually make use of some assistance.
Purple and Blue#002.dst: {p} に言われて来たのか？まあ、{p} へようこそ！ちょうど手伝いがほしかったんだ。
Purple and Blue#002.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#003.src: The magic here in this place is so potent; you can actually see the mystical properties!
Purple and Blue#003.dst: ここの魔力はすごく強くて、神秘的な性質が目に見えるほどなんだ！
Purple and Blue#003.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#004.src: I've been a scientist for many years, but I have never seen anything like this lake.
Purple and Blue#004.dst: 僕は長年科学者をやってきたけど、こんな湖は見たことがない。
Purple and Blue#004.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#005.src: That's why I set up a small laboratory and started living here to study the place. It's pretty rudimentary but it does the job done.
Purple and Blue#005.dst: だから小さな研究所を建てて、ここに住んで調べ始めたんだ。粗末だけど、役には立ってる。
Purple and Blue#005.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#006.src: The deeper into the lake you dive, the stronger the magical power becomes. I think something strange is happening at the heart of the lake. I believe a lot of answers lie inside.
Purple and Blue#006.dst: 湖の深くに潜るほど魔力が強くなる。湖の中心で何か妙なことが起きていると思う。答えの多くはそこにあるはずだ。
Purple and Blue#006.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#007.src: Alright, that's enough context! You see, there's another... "scientist" across the lake. We're kind of rivals? The guy's awful, I hate him, AND... Well...
Purple and Blue#007.dst: よし、前置きはここまで！実は湖の向こうにもう一人…「科学者」がいてね。まあライバルかな？ひどい奴で、大嫌いだし、それに…その…
Purple and Blue#007.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#009.src: And while I somewhat hope he's gotten himself in trouble, he might've figured out something about the lake.
Purple and Blue#009.dst: 痛い目に遭ってればいいと少し思ってるけど、奴は湖について何かつかんだのかもしれない。
Purple and Blue#009.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#010.src: I suspect he's gone in to the heart of the lake... Come with me a moment, please.
Purple and Blue#010.dst: 湖の中心に入ったんじゃないかと疑ってる…ちょっと一緒に来てくれ。
Purple and Blue#010.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#011.src: Alright, this leads underwater where the heart is. How about you try and enter?
Purple and Blue#011.dst: よし、ここから水中の中心部へ行ける。入ってみてくれないか？
Purple and Blue#011.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#012.src: ...just as I thought, you can't get in just like me. We'll need to gather more information.
Purple and Blue#012.dst: …思った通り、君も僕と同じで入れない。もっと情報を集めないと。
Purple and Blue#012.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#013.src: Human, investigate Nikoler's house for me. It's north down the coast.
Purple and Blue#013.dst: 人間、Nikoler の家を調べてくれ。海岸沿いに北へ行った所だ。
Purple and Blue#013.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#014.src: Where could he be... There's no way he found access to- Hey!
Purple and Blue#014.dst: どこにいるんだ…入る方法を見つけたはずが…おい！
Purple and Blue#014.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#015.src: Don't just listen to me mumbling! Have you found Nikoler?!
Purple and Blue#015.dst: 僕の独り言を聞いてる場合か！Nikoler は見つかったのか？！
Purple and Blue#015.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#016.src: Investigate Nikoler's house for clues at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#016.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Nikoler の家で手がかりを探す。

Purple and Blue#017.src: Follow the hints in the cellar to the mysterious cave.
Purple and Blue#017.dst: 地下室のヒントをたどり、謎の洞窟へ向かう。

Purple and Blue#018.src: Enter and explore the mysterious cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#018.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の謎の洞窟に入り、探索する。

Purple and Blue#019.src: Return to Korun in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#019.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の家にいる Korun のもとへ戻る。

Purple and Blue#020.src: Y-you've actually found a lead?! There was clues in his basement? And you found a... talisman? This must be it, then!
Purple and Blue#020.dst: ほ、本当に手がかりを見つけたのか？！地下室に？それに…お守りまで？それだ、間違いない！
Purple and Blue#020.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#021.src: This might very well be the key to enter the heart, especially if it was as well-guarded with cosmic creatures as you say.
Purple and Blue#021.dst: これこそ中心に入る鍵かもしれない。君の言う通り、宇宙の生き物に厳重に守られていたならなおさらだ。
Purple and Blue#021.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#022.src: Alright then! This might be too dangerous for me, so I'm entrusting this task to you once more. Enter the tunnel in my basement, and explore as much as you can!
Purple and Blue#022.dst: よし！僕には危険すぎるかもしれないから、また君に任せるよ。僕の家の地下室のトンネルから入って、できる限り探索してくれ！
Purple and Blue#022.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#023.src: If you can bring me samples of any kind, I'll try to reward you handsomely. However, if you find Nikoler alive... Please bring him back.
Purple and Blue#023.dst: どんなものでもサンプルを持ち帰ってくれたら、たっぷり礼をするよ。でも、もし Nikoler が生きていたら…連れ帰ってくれ。
Purple and Blue#023.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#024.src: As for the talisman, make sure to hold it whilst in the tunnel. Be careful, you're in uncharted territory from now on.
Purple and Blue#024.dst: お守りはトンネルの中で必ず手に持っていてくれ。気をつけて、ここから先は未知の領域だ。
Purple and Blue#024.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#025.src: Good luck, human. Please bring me back Nikoler, or any sample you might find.
Purple and Blue#025.dst: 幸運を、人間。Nikoler か、見つけたサンプルを持ち帰ってくれ。
Purple and Blue#025.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#026.src: Enter the heart of Gylia from under the lake.
Purple and Blue#026.dst: 湖の下から Gylia の心臓部に入る。

Purple and Blue#027.dst: Gylia の心臓部を探索する。

Purple and Blue#028.src: The drill should be ready by now... In just a little bit, I'll have single-handedly conquered the heart of the mountain...!
Purple and Blue#028.dst: そろそろドリルの準備ができたはず…あと少しで、この俺が独りで山の心臓部を制覇するのだ…！

Purple and Blue#029.src: A human!? W...What? Did you read the notes I left for Korun? I'll have you know that's theft!! I - you...!
Purple and Blue#029.dst: 人間！？な…何だ？俺が Korun に残したメモを読んだのか？言っておくがそれは窃盗だぞ！！俺は…お前…！
Purple and Blue#029.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#030.src: Don't get any closer!! I'll destroy the path if I have to!!
Purple and Blue#030.dst: それ以上近づくな！！いざとなったら道を壊すぞ！！
Purple and Blue#030.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#031.src: This is MY story! Don't you dare interfere!!
Purple and Blue#031.dst: これは「俺の」物語だ！邪魔したら許さないぞ！！
Purple and Blue#031.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#032.src: You're... persistent. Are you trying to steal from these meteors I'VE found?! Do you have any idea how much research I did to get this far??
Purple and Blue#032.dst: しつこい奴だな…。「俺が」見つけた隕石を盗む気か？！ここまで来るのにどれだけ研究したと思ってる？？
Purple and Blue#032.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#033.src: It's too late! I've already drilled a piece. Once I show Korun, I'll be known as the better researcher...
Purple and Blue#033.dst: もう遅い！すでに一欠片削り取った。Korun に見せれば、俺のほうが優れた研究者だと認められる…
Purple and Blue#033.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#036.src: No no no no no no! This CAN'T be happening!
Purple and Blue#036.dst: いやいやいやいやいや！こんなことありえない！
Purple and Blue#036.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#037.src: Tampering with the meteors must be making the cave instable! I... I thought this'd happen and yet-
Purple and Blue#037.dst: 隕石をいじったせいで洞窟が不安定になってるんだ！こ…こうなると思ってたのに—
Purple and Blue#037.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#038.src: This is all YOUR fault! Why'd you have to come and make me panic? We're both DOOMED!
Purple and Blue#038.dst: 全部「お前の」せいだ！なんで来て俺を焦らせたんだ？二人とも終わりだ！
Purple and Blue#038.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#039.src: No... I can't die here, I can't die now, what will he think...
Purple and Blue#039.dst: いや…ここで死ねない、今は死ねない、あいつがどう思うか…
Purple and Blue#039.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#040.src: I... We might still have a shot at escaping... And then, human, I'll report you to the authorities!!
Purple and Blue#040.dst: お…俺たち、まだ逃げられるかもしれない…そしたら人間、お前を役人に突き出してやる！！
Purple and Blue#040.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#041.src: I'm STUCK! Urgh... No... Not like this, please, not like this...
Purple and Blue#041.dst: はさまった！くそっ…いやだ…こんな終わり方、頼む、こんなのは…
Purple and Blue#041.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#042.src: You... Why? You came to get me? Not the... meteors?
Purple and Blue#042.dst: お前…なぜ？俺を助けに来たのか？…隕石じゃなくて？
Purple and Blue#042.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#043.src: I... Fine then. Let's make a run for it, human!
Purple and Blue#043.dst: お…わかったよ。一緒に逃げるぞ、人間！
Purple and Blue#043.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#044.dst: Gylia の心臓部から脱出する。

Purple and Blue#045.src: Rats! That dynamite went and backfired on us! Quick, try to run in to the rubble with me, we need to hurry!
Purple and Blue#045.dst: くそっ！ダイナマイトが裏目に出た！早く、俺と一緒に瓦礫の中へ走り込め、急ぐぞ！
Purple and Blue#045.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#047.src: Welcome back! I see you're completely drenched! How did things go? I assume you explored the place thoroughly.
Purple and Blue#047.dst: おかえり！全身びしょ濡れじゃないか！どうだった？しっかり探索してきたんだろうね。
Purple and Blue#047.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#049.src: ...were you worrying about me? What a fool. This mountain could never do so much as scratch me!
Purple and Blue#049.dst: …俺を心配してたのか？馬鹿な奴だ。この山ごときに俺がかすり傷ひとつ負うものか！
Purple and Blue#049.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#050.src: This human right here actually saved me, right after endangering me. You don't mean to tell me you sent him for me?
Purple and Blue#050.dst: こいつが俺を危ない目に遭わせた直後に、助けてくれたんだ。まさか、お前がこいつを寄越したのか？
Purple and Blue#050.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#051.src: Well, it's very simple. Where's the fun in our rivalry if you just go off and die somewhere?
Purple and Blue#051.dst: 簡単なことさ。君がどこかで勝手に死んだら、僕らのライバル関係に何の面白みがある？
Purple and Blue#051.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#052.src: That aside, what did you find in there? What happened?
Purple and Blue#052.dst: それはさておき、中で何を見つけた？何があったんだ？
Purple and Blue#052.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#053.src: I found them, Korun. I found the meteors! The still seemed potent somehow, but the cave collapsed and...
Purple and Blue#053.dst: 見つけたんだ、Korun。隕石を見つけた！まだ力を秘めていたようだが、洞窟が崩れて…
Purple and Blue#053.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#054.src: That's... fine. We can always go back and try clearing the rubble. There's always opportunities to take a hold of. Next time, please don't just go off on your own!
Purple and Blue#054.dst: そう…大丈夫だ。いつでも戻って瓦礫をどかせばいい。チャンスはいつだってつかめる。次は頼むから、一人で勝手に行かないでくれ！
Purple and Blue#054.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#055.src: Human, you made the right choice... Without Nikoler, our efforts would have been in vain. I'll try to work with him a bit more, as it seems the logical course of action now. Thank you.
Purple and Blue#055.dst: 人間、君の選択は正しかった…Nikoler がいなければ、僕らの努力は無駄になっていた。今は理にかなった道だし、もう少し彼と協力してみるよ。ありがとう。
Purple and Blue#055.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#056.dst: お、おい！俺は同意なんて—
Purple and Blue#056.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#057.src: I see you're completely drenched! There's this odd aura around you... What happened?
Purple and Blue#057.dst: 全身びしょ濡れじゃないか！それに妙な気配をまとってる…何があったんだ？
Purple and Blue#057.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#058.src: You... You actually found a meteor shard! That's amazing! That's... that's... um...
Purple and Blue#058.dst: き…君、本当に隕石の欠片を見つけたのか！すごいよ！それは…それは…えっと…
Purple and Blue#058.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#059.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died...?
Purple and Blue#059.dst: え、い、今なんて言った？洞窟が崩れて、Nikoler が死、死んだ…？
Purple and Blue#059.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#060.src: That's, um, haha... That doesn't sound right, he can't die, he can't leave like that, he can't-
Purple and Blue#060.dst: それは、その、はは…おかしいな、あいつが死ぬわけない、そんなふうにいなくなるわけ、あいつは—
Purple and Blue#060.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#061.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. I do have to thank you for the shard...
Purple and Blue#061.dst: ご、ごめん。ちょっと驚いただけだ。欠片のことは礼を言わないと…
Purple and Blue#061.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#062.src: A-at the very least, you saw this through... I have to commend you for that... I think.
Purple and Blue#062.dst: せ、せめて君は最後までやり遂げた…それは褒めないとな…たぶん。
Purple and Blue#062.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#063.src: Just take these, and go. I have much to think about.
Purple and Blue#063.dst: これを持って、行ってくれ。考えることがたくさんある。
Purple and Blue#063.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#064.src: You explored thoroughly, and couldn't find a shard? Well, we still have much to discover I suppose.
Purple and Blue#064.dst: しっかり探索したのに欠片が見つからなかった？まあ、まだ発見すべきことは多いんだろう。
Purple and Blue#064.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#065.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died..?
Purple and Blue#065.dst: え、い、今なんて言った？洞窟が崩れて、Nikoler が死、死んだ…？
Purple and Blue#065.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#066.src: That's, um, haha... That doesn't sound right, he can't die, he can't leave like that, he can't-
Purple and Blue#066.dst: それは、その、はは…おかしいな、あいつが死ぬわけない、そんなふうにいなくなるわけ、あいつは—
Purple and Blue#066.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#067.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. And you came back empty-handed... This was just a loss with everyone involved.
Purple and Blue#067.dst: ご、ごめん。ちょっと驚いただけだ。しかも手ぶらで帰ってきた…関わった全員が損をしただけか。
Purple and Blue#067.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#068.src: A-at the very least, you saw this through... I have to commend you for that... I think.
Purple and Blue#068.dst: せ、せめて君は最後までやり遂げた…それは褒めないとな…たぶん。
Purple and Blue#068.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#069.src: Just take these, and go. I have much to think about.
Purple and Blue#069.dst: これを持って、行ってくれ。考えることがたくさんある。
Purple and Blue#069.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#070.src: I see you're completely drenched, so I suppose you thoroughly explored the place. How did it go?
Purple and Blue#070.dst: 全身びしょ濡れだし、しっかり探索してきたんだろう。どうだった？
Purple and Blue#070.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#071.src: You found... Nothing? Really? And the meteors were too unstable to temper with?
Purple and Blue#071.dst: 何も…見つからなかった？本当に？隕石も不安定すぎて手を出せなかった？
Purple and Blue#071.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#072.src: Actually, how would you know about tempering with the- wait...
Purple and Blue#072.dst: 待てよ、なんで手を出せるかどうかなんて知って—待って…
Purple and Blue#072.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#073.src: Did you find him? Please... please tell me you found him, there's no way he'd die just like that. I...
Purple and Blue#073.dst: あいつを見つけたのか？頼む…見つけたと言ってくれ、あいつがあっさり死ぬわけがない。僕は…
Purple and Blue#073.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#074.src: W-what? The whole cave COLLAPSED on him? And you couldn't even save him?! N-no, it can't be your fault, I... I'm sorry.
Purple and Blue#074.dst: な、何だって？洞窟がまるごとあいつの上に崩れた？それで助けることもできなかった？！い、いや、君のせいじゃない、僕は…すまない。
Purple and Blue#074.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#075.src: This is all way too much to take in for me, but I suppose you've explored and served the purpose I gave you.
Purple and Blue#075.dst: 僕にはとても受け止めきれないけど、君は探索して、頼んだ役目を果たしてくれたんだろう。
Purple and Blue#075.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#076.src: Here's your reward, then. Now please, just leave me be. There's a lot I have to think about.
Purple and Blue#076.dst: じゃあ、これが報酬だ。今はどうか、一人にしてくれ。考えなきゃいけないことが山ほどある。
Purple and Blue#076.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#077.src: It's you! Glad to have crossed paths again!
Purple and Blue#077.dst: お前か！また会えて嬉しいぞ！
Purple and Blue#077.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#078.src: Since the incident, I've decided to start fishing as a hobby.
Purple and Blue#078.dst: あの一件以来、趣味で釣りを始めることにしたんだ。
Purple and Blue#078.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#079.src: Take this- for all I care, you can own this!
Purple and Blue#079.dst: これをやる—俺はどうでもいいから、お前のものにしろ！
Purple and Blue#079.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#080.dst: ありがとう…助けてくれて。
Purple and Blue#080.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#081.src: Check up on Korun from time to time for me, will you?
Purple and Blue#081.dst: たまに Korun の様子を見てやってくれないか？
Purple and Blue#081.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#082.src: I'm still taking a break from all the science stuff... But he definitely hasn't seen the last of me!
Purple and Blue#082.dst: 科学からはまだ休憩中だが…あいつが俺を見るのはこれが最後じゃないぞ！
Purple and Blue#082.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#083.src: After all, I'm the one who got to the heart of the mountain! I'm even able to sleep soundly knowing that I've won...
Purple and Blue#083.dst: 何しろ、山の心臓部にたどり着いたのは俺だからな！勝ったと思うとぐっすり眠れるくらいだ…
Purple and Blue#083.speaker: Nikoler

Queen's Recruit#001.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#001.dst: Tasim が {p} の [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で話したがっている。

Queen's Recruit#002.src: {u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
Queen's Recruit#002.dst: {u}！やあ！ここで会えるなんてついてるな。
Queen's Recruit#002.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#003.src: It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
Queen's Recruit#003.dst: 久しぶりだね？積もる話もあるし！君もたくさん冒険してきたんだろう？
Queen's Recruit#003.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#004.src: But before that... I've just got to find...
Queen's Recruit#004.dst: でもその前に… 探さないと…
Queen's Recruit#004.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#005.src: Huh? What am I oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#005.dst: え？何を… ああそうだ。Aledar を探してるんだ。
Queen's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#006.src: He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
Queen's Recruit#006.dst: 偵察任務に… 一緒に来てくれって手紙をくれたんだ。でも見つからなくて。
Queen's Recruit#006.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#007.src: It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
Queen's Recruit#007.dst: ここに来るまで時間がかかったから… もう別の場所に行ったのかも。Aegis 提督も任務は中止になったって言ってたし…
Queen's Recruit#007.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#008.src: But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
Queen's Recruit#008.dst: でもここにいないなら、街中を探し回るのはやめたほうがいいか。兵舎に伝言を残しておくよ。
Queen's Recruit#008.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#009.src: We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
Queen's Recruit#009.dst: 酒場で話そう！ああ、Rusty Recruit の酒が恋しかった… あのバーテンはどこも同じだって言うけど、全然違うんだ！あんな風に注げる人は他にいない。
Queen's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#010.src: Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#010.dst: 失礼、ちょっと通して！通りますよ！ああ、お二人さん！ちょうど探してたんです。
Queen's Recruit#010.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#012.src: Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
Queen's Recruit#012.dst: いや、名指しってほどでも。探す人のリストがあって、お二人も載ってるんです！Tasim さんと {u} さんですよね？
Queen's Recruit#012.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#013.src: I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
Queen's Recruit#013.dst: {p} から大事な書状です。王様直々ですよ、ええ！
Queen's Recruit#013.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#014.src: Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
Queen's Recruit#014.dst: 本当に？あれ以来会ってもいないのに… 僕たちに何の用だろう？
Queen's Recruit#014.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#015.src: I'm not privy to the details I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned visitors to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
Queen's Recruit#015.dst: 詳しいことは存じません！ベテランの皆さんを何人も城に呼んで、何かの会議をなさるそうです。
Queen's Recruit#015.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#016.src: Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
Queen's Recruit#016.dst: とにかく、まだ探す人がいるので、手紙を渡して失礼しますね！何の件にせよ、ご健闘を！
Queen's Recruit#016.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#018.src: Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks for later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
Queen's Recruit#018.dst: うーん。妙だよね？飲みに行くのはお預けか… そのほうがいいかも。その前に彼をつかまえられるかな…
Queen's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#019.src: Oh, uh- you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
Queen's Recruit#019.dst: あ、えっと… 先に行ってて。僕は兵舎に寄らないと。{p} で合流しよう？
Queen's Recruit#019.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#020.src: I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
Queen's Recruit#020.dst: {p} で合流しよう。先に兵舎で片付けることがあるんだ。
Queen's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#021.src: Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#021.dst: {p} の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で王との会議に出席する。

Queen's Recruit#022.src: ...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
Queen's Recruit#022.dst: …あ、いた。僕より先に出たんじゃなかった？
Queen's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#023.src: I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
Queen's Recruit#023.dst: ここの人はほとんど知らないから、しばらく君と一緒にいるよ。
Queen's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#024.src: ...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for
Queen's Recruit#024.dst: …で、全部崩れてくるだろ？だからゾンビを押し返して、子供をつかんで跳んで
Queen's Recruit#024.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#025.src: Wait, wait wait wait you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
Queen's Recruit#025.dst: 待った待った待った、子供がいたってのかい？それでも爆弾を起動したって？！
Queen's Recruit#025.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#026.src: Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I
Queen's Recruit#026.dst: そうだよ！もう言ったよな？それこそが俺が
Queen's Recruit#026.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#027.src: Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
Queen's Recruit#027.dst: こほん。話は一旦止めて、Linton。お客さんよ。
Queen's Recruit#027.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#028.src: Well if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
Queen's Recruit#028.dst: おや、{u} じゃないか！ここで顔なじみに会えて嬉しいよ。
Queen's Recruit#028.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#029.dst: 何だよ、俺は顔なじみじゃないのか？
Queen's Recruit#029.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#030.src: I do try to keep my distance.
Queen's Recruit#030.dst: あんたとは距離を置いてるからね。
Queen's Recruit#030.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#031.src: So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
Queen's Recruit#031.dst: あなたたちも召集を受けたの？王はずいぶん人を集めたみたい。興味深いわ。
Queen's Recruit#031.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#032.src: We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
Queen's Recruit#032.dst: うん、受けたよ。それに、名簿にはまだ探してる人がたくさんいるみたいだった。
Queen's Recruit#032.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#033.src: Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
Queen's Recruit#033.dst: あら、ごめんなさい、気づかなかったわ。{u} のお友達かしら？
Queen's Recruit#033.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#034.src: I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#034.dst: うん！Wynn へは同じ馬車で来たんだ。僕は Tasim。
Queen's Recruit#034.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#036.src: So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#036.dst: じゃあお前が Aledar がいつも話してたやつか！Gavel に行ってたんじゃないのか？
Queen's Recruit#036.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#037.src: I... was. How do you all know him?
Queen's Recruit#037.dst: 僕は… 行ってた。みんなはどうして彼を？
Queen's Recruit#037.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#038.src: I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
Queen's Recruit#038.dst: 初めて会ったのは、{p} の兵舎を反逆した指揮官から取り戻す任務だったと思う。それから何度か顔を合わせたわ。
Queen's Recruit#038.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#039.src: Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
Queen's Recruit#039.dst: とにかく、やっと会えて嬉しいよ！話はたくさん聞いてる！手紙に返事しないとか何とか…？
Queen's Recruit#039.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#040.src: Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
Queen's Recruit#040.dst: あ… うん。それは、その… 解決したよ。
Queen's Recruit#040.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#041.src: But speaking of have any of you seen him recently?
Queen's Recruit#041.dst: それより… 最近誰か彼を見た？
Queen's Recruit#041.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#042.src: 'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
Queen's Recruit#042.dst: 残念ながら。最後に会ったのは… {p} の包囲戦だったかな？たぶんそう。
Queen's Recruit#042.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#043.src: I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
Queen's Recruit#043.dst: 一か月前に {p} で見たぞ！何してるのか、手伝えるか聞いたらあしらわれた。変だろ？
Queen's Recruit#043.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#044.src: Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
Queen's Recruit#044.dst: ふむ。いいえ、彼らしいわ。前回あなたの悪ふざけに懲りたのよ。
Queen's Recruit#044.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#045.src: What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
Queen's Recruit#045.dst: 何だと？！俺は有能だ。なあ Mel、俺は有能だって言ってくれよ。
Queen's Recruit#045.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#046.src: Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by
Queen's Recruit#046.dst: Linton、あんたさっき神殿をまるごと崩した話を
Queen's Recruit#046.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#047.src: Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
Queen's Recruit#047.dst: わかった！わかったわかった、他の話にしよう、何でもいい！Tasim だっけ？その… えーと…
Queen's Recruit#047.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#048.src: ...so, your... no, no, give me a moment you were... and... um... oh, right...
Queen's Recruit#048.dst: …で、お前の… いや待て、ちょっと待って、お前は… で… えーと… あ、そうだ…
Queen's Recruit#048.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#051.src: Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Queen's Recruit#051.dst: Linton！！いきなり聞くことじゃないよ！！
Queen's Recruit#051.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#053.src: It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
Queen's Recruit#053.dst: 会えてよかったわ、Tasim。この任務で一緒に働けるのを楽しみにしてる。
Queen's Recruit#053.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#054.src: ...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#054.dst: …こちらこそ。Aledar の友達に会えるのはいつも嬉しいよ。
Queen's Recruit#054.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#055.src: Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
Queen's Recruit#055.dst: おう、見違えたな！最後に話してからずいぶん経つ。もう下水掃除なんぞする身分じゃないな？
Queen's Recruit#055.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#056.src: I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
Queen's Recruit#056.dst: お前の活躍は耳にしてる。見事、見事だ。
Queen's Recruit#056.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#057.src: And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
Queen's Recruit#057.dst: それに… ふむ。お前は何も言わずに Gavel へ出ていったやつじゃないか？今回選ばれるとは思わなかったぞ。
Queen's Recruit#057.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#058.src: I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
Queen's Recruit#058.dst: 僕も… 思ってなかった。正直、王様が僕を覚えてるとも思わなかった。
Queen's Recruit#058.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#059.src: Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get or so Kymer's been sayin'.
Queen's Recruit#059.dst: ふむ。まあ理由はどうあれ、今はここにいる。どういう道でたどり着いたかは大して問題じゃない。今は人手がいくらでも要る… と Kymer が言ってた。
Queen's Recruit#059.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#060.src: Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#060.dst: おやおや！見間違いでなければ！{u} と Tasim ではないか！
Queen's Recruit#060.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#061.src: I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#061.dst: いやはや、君たちを探し出せるとは思わなかった！なにせ Gavel での… 長い滞在があったからな。
Queen's Recruit#061.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#062.src: I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
Queen's Recruit#062.dst: それはこっちのセリフだよ、隊長。戦争が終わって {p} では用済みになったのかい？
Queen's Recruit#062.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#063.src: Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
Queen's Recruit#063.dst: ああ… そんなことはない。そもそも私はあちらへ {p} の使節として派遣されたのだよ！王が外交問題を片付けたいとき、真っ先に頼るのがこの私だ。
Queen's Recruit#063.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#064.src: Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've entered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
Queen's Recruit#064.dst: だからこそ… 今ここにいるわけだ。数週間前、突然呼び戻されてね。どうやら我々は… 隣の地方と厄介な状況にあるらしい。
Queen's Recruit#064.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#065.src: But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
Queen's Recruit#065.dst: だが！王がお見えになるまでは何も言うまい。問題はすべて王が話してくださる。解決できるといいのだが。
Queen's Recruit#065.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#066.src: ...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
Queen's Recruit#066.dst: …なるほど。じゃあ僕たちはこれで。
Queen's Recruit#066.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#067.src: If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
Queen's Recruit#067.dst: マナの流れを水に合わせて、横に少しずらせば、あるいは… ああ Reynauld、例のメモを… くそ、何だったか… そうだ、回復期間だ！あれを取ってくれ。
Queen's Recruit#067.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#068.src: ...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#068.dst: …博士、それならもう左手に持っていますよ。
Queen's Recruit#068.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#069.src: Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half where did I leave the rest...
Queen's Recruit#069.dst: そうかね！確かに… おや、だがこれは前半だけだ… 残りはどこに置いたか…
Queen's Recruit#069.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#070.src: Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't
Queen's Recruit#070.dst: はあ… 整理を任せてくれれば、こんなことには
Queen's Recruit#070.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#071.src: And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have
Queen's Recruit#071.dst: そして私の独自の分類法を台無しにしろと？！いや Reynauld、今のままで完璧に機能しているとも、どうもありがとう！さて、どこに
Queen's Recruit#071.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#072.src: Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
Queen's Recruit#072.dst: おお！君たち！よし、よく来た… ここで記憶を取り戻した者が Reynauld だけかと心配していたんだ！
Queen's Recruit#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#073.src: What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
Queen's Recruit#073.dst: えっ、僕たちが去ったあと、他の誰にも試さなかったの？
Queen's Recruit#073.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#074.src: Test it on no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
Queen's Recruit#074.dst: 他人に試す… まさか！あんなものを見た後で？いやいや、そんな危険は冒せない。完璧だと確信するまで新しい被験者はなしだ！
Queen's Recruit#074.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#075.src: I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
Queen's Recruit#075.dst: 代わりに自分自身に使っているのだよ！しかも聞いてくれ、私が成し遂げた発見を… 学ぶべきことは山ほどある。
Queen's Recruit#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#076.dst: それって… 安全なの？
Queen's Recruit#076.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#077.src: Pah! "Safety" a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects certainly! But it has all been worth it.
Queen's Recruit#077.dst: ふん！「安全」… 進歩を妨げるためだけの無意味な言葉だ。副作用は… もちろんあった！だが全て報われたよ。
Queen's Recruit#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#078.src: Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
Queen's Recruit#078.dst: さて、書類に戻らねば… 王がお見えになる前に仕上げたい式があるのでね…
Queen's Recruit#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#079.src: Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#079.dst: ふむ。君がここにいるとは思わなかったよ、Tasim。
Queen's Recruit#079.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#080.src: Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#080.dst: まあ… 運命は別の計画を用意してたみたい。君は？ずっと {p} にいたの？
Queen's Recruit#080.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#081.src: Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
Queen's Recruit#081.dst: ほとんどね。任務であちこち移ったこともあるが、結局いつも戻ってきた。
Queen's Recruit#081.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#082.src: ...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
Queen's Recruit#082.dst: …しばらく話していなかったな。元気か…？記憶とはどう折り合いをつけている？
Queen's Recruit#082.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#084.src: As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
Queen's Recruit#084.dst: まあ、それなりにね。最初の数か月はきつかった。そのうち慣れたよ。
Queen's Recruit#084.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#085.src: How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
Queen's Recruit#085.dst: 君はどう？こんな任務に君が来るとも思わなかった。
Queen's Recruit#085.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#086.src: Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
Queen's Recruit#086.dst: 君と同じさ。Caid と話し合えたのが助けになった。時々会って、そのことを話すんだ。彼は妹の話をする。いつか見つけ出したいと。
Queen's Recruit#086.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#087.dst: それは… よかった。嬉しいよ。
Queen's Recruit#087.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#088.src: Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
Queen's Recruit#088.dst: ふむ。君も顔を出したらいい。助けになるかもしれない。
Queen's Recruit#088.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#089.src: I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#089.dst: 考えて… おくよ。また会えてよかった、Reynauld。
Queen's Recruit#089.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#090.src: Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
Queen's Recruit#090.dst: また兵士か？召集状を見せてもらおう。
Queen's Recruit#090.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#091.src: ...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
Queen's Recruit#091.dst: …よし。入れ、{u}。王はまもなくお見えになる。
Queen's Recruit#091.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#093.src: If you insist. Don't take too long.
Queen's Recruit#093.dst: どうしてもと言うなら。長くかかるなよ。
Queen's Recruit#093.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#094.src: Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
Queen's Recruit#094.dst: ああ… そろったな。急な呼び出しにもかかわらず来てくれて感謝する。多くの者と会うのは久しぶりだ。
Queen's Recruit#094.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#095.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#095.dst: …単刀直入に言おう。隣の地方 Fruma との関係において、我々は非常に微妙な立場にある。
Queen's Recruit#095.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#096.src: We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once they have chosen to do so.
Queen's Recruit#096.dst: 我々は送られてくる新兵に大きく頼っているが、あちらと連絡を取る手段がない。向こうから、向こうがそう決めたときにしか接触できぬのだ。
Queen's Recruit#096.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#097.src: ...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#097.dst: …数週間前、外れからフードをかぶった訪問者が来た。Fruma の者で、君主の一人だと名乗った。
Queen's Recruit#097.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#098.src: We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
Queen's Recruit#098.dst: 我々はいわば招待を受けた。これまで受け入れた新兵の中から最も優れた者を選び、Fruma での何かの祝典に送れというのだ。
Queen's Recruit#098.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#099.src: Is that who we are? The greatest?
Queen's Recruit#099.dst: それが僕たち？最も優れた？
Queen's Recruit#099.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#100.src: The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove
Queen's Recruit#100.dst: 少なくとも連絡がついた中ではな！もっと優れた者もいたかもしれんが、君たちのような者の放浪癖は周知の通り、探し出すのは実に
Queen's Recruit#100.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#101.src: Ugh, we're not going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#101.dst: うげ、まさか本当に従うわけじゃないよな？
Queen's Recruit#101.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#103.src: What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
Queen's Recruit#103.dst: 何だよ？怪しさ満点の妙な要求をしてきてるんだぞ、なんでそのまま受けなきゃならないんだ？
Queen's Recruit#103.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#104.src: I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
Queen's Recruit#104.dst: 残念だが、我々に選択の余地はない。言った通り、受け入れる新兵はこの地方の存続を左右する。もしこの招待を断れば…
Queen's Recruit#104.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#105.src: ...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
Queen's Recruit#105.dst: …向こうが送るのをやめない保証はない、ってわけか。厳しいな。
Queen's Recruit#105.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#106.src: Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
Queen's Recruit#106.dst: それに、この好機を考えてみたまえ！あの壁の向こうを、正式に招かれて見られるのだ！脅しがあろうと、受けないのは愚か者だけだ！
Queen's Recruit#106.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#107.src: Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
Queen's Recruit#107.dst: その通りだ。こんな頼みをせねばならぬのは心苦しいが… 他に道はない。この招待を受けてくれ。
Queen's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#108.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences of the province?
Queen's Recruit#108.dst: …あの地方にいい思い出のない俺たちもか？
Queen's Recruit#108.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#109.src: I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
Queen's Recruit#109.dst: すまぬ… だが行ってもらわねばならん。私にはどうにもできぬのだ。
Queen's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#110.src: I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
Queen's Recruit#110.dst: つまり、中にいる間に Fruma の情報をできる限り集めろということね？
Queen's Recruit#110.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#111.src: That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#111.dst: まさにその通り！詳しくは向こうで説明するが、確か時間制限があるのでしたな？
Queen's Recruit#111.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#112.src: You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
Queen's Recruit#112.dst: その通りだ、博士。西岸にある Fruma の王家の門で、代表者が皆を出迎えると聞いている。
Queen's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#113.src: I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
Queen's Recruit#113.dst: {p} へ先に使いを出し、地元の船長たちに行き先を伝えてある。
Queen's Recruit#113.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#114.src: {p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
Queen's Recruit#114.dst: {p}… そこに知り合いの船長がいるんだ。{u}、一緒に来る？
Queen's Recruit#114.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#115.src: Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
Queen's Recruit#115.dst: ついに… あの地方の内情を垣間見られる… この答えをどれほど探し求めてきたことか？
Queen's Recruit#115.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#116.src: So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
Queen's Recruit#116.dst: 数々の仮説… いくつが正しく、いくつが間違っているのか？知るのが待ちきれない！
Queen's Recruit#116.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#117.src: Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
Queen's Recruit#117.dst: はあ… こうなるとわかっていた。でなければ博士が呼ばれるはずがない。だが外れてほしかった。
Queen's Recruit#117.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#118.src: Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
Queen's Recruit#118.dst: 厄介な状況だろう？Fruma の連中は隠し事だらけだ…
Queen's Recruit#118.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#119.src: But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
Queen's Recruit#119.dst: だがなんとかなる。ここにいるのは腕利きばかりだからな。
Queen's Recruit#119.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#120.src: Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
Queen's Recruit#120.dst: ふむ… 実に厄介な状況に置かれたものだ！外交は私の専門だが、私の経験もこれには… 備えがない。
Queen's Recruit#120.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#121.src: Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford to let up their position.
Queen's Recruit#121.dst: Fruma は望みをわかっているし、交渉を降りても困らぬほど強いと承知している。
Queen's Recruit#121.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#122.src: Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
Queen's Recruit#122.dst: また極秘任務かよ？しかも爆薬の持ち込みも禁止？
Queen's Recruit#122.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#123.src: It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
Queen's Recruit#123.dst: まあ、面白くはあるな！前の任務よりずっとマシだ…
Queen's Recruit#123.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#124.src: This mission's a big deal, huh? Lot's o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
Queen's Recruit#124.dst: 今回の任務は大ごとだね？少なくとも強い人がたくさん呼び戻されてる。
Queen's Recruit#124.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#125.src: Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
Queen's Recruit#125.dst: 正直、ちょっと緊張するよ！
Queen's Recruit#125.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#126.src: Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Queen's Recruit#126.dst: Fruma… あまり考えたことはなかった。謎ではあるけど、答えの得られない謎だもの。
Queen's Recruit#126.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#127.src: Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
Queen's Recruit#127.dst: まあ、今までは、ね。注意すべき点のリストを作っておかないと…
Queen's Recruit#127.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#128.src: And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
Queen's Recruit#128.dst: またしても、皆を危険へ送り出さねばならぬ… 今回は種類が違うが、危険には変わりない。
Queen's Recruit#128.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#129.src: I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
Queen's Recruit#129.dst: この城を通った顔はすべて覚えている。再び会えることはめったにないが。
Queen's Recruit#129.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#130.src: But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. Your mission lies ahead of you.
Queen's Recruit#130.dst: だが今回は… また会えると信じている。行け、若き英雄よ。使命は君の前にある。
Queen's Recruit#130.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#131.src: ...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
