Queen's Recruit#553.dst: ふむ。白紙… 外の世界を、その輝きも欠点もすべて見ることができ、避けられぬ破滅の深く根ざした種を直に目撃できる… それには価値があるのです。
Queen's Recruit#553.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#554.src: You have seen it, haven't you? Forces beyond any of us vie for control of our world, caring not for what destruction they instill.
Queen's Recruit#554.dst: あなたも見たでしょう？我々の誰をも超える力が世界の支配を争い、自らもたらす破壊など気にも留めない。
Queen's Recruit#554.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#555.src: And it truly is a beautiful world, isn't it? To think, it could be destroyed, taken for their ceaseless war which holds no meaning, no purpose...
Queen's Recruit#555.dst: そして、本当に美しい世界でしょう？それが意味も目的もない果てしない戦争のために壊され、奪われるかもしれないなんて…
Queen's Recruit#555.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#556.src: Then you have seen firsthand the benefits. The province is unburdened by those who may cause problems, and Wynn's front in its war is bolstered.
Queen's Recruit#556.dst: ならば利点も直に見たはずです。地方は問題を起こしかねない者から解放され、Wynn の戦線は強化される。
Queen's Recruit#556.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#557.src: Of course, many will refuse the call. Many more will grow stagnant in their newfound roles. Yet, in a select few... there is potential for much, much more.
Queen's Recruit#557.dst: もちろん、多くは呼びかけを拒むでしょう。さらに多くは新たな役目で停滞する。けれど、ほんの一握りには… はるかに大きな可能性があるのです。
Queen's Recruit#557.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#558.dst: さて… あなたはどちらかしら？
Queen's Recruit#558.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#559.src: That will be all. Return to your chambers for the night. I will be sending for the other finalist shortly.
Queen's Recruit#559.dst: 以上です。今夜は部屋に戻りなさい。もう一人の決勝進出者もまもなく呼びにやります。
Queen's Recruit#559.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#560.src: Return to room W-{~} and talk to Tasim at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#560.dst: W-{~} 号室に戻り、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] で Tasim と話す。

Queen's Recruit#561.dst: どうぞ、お下がりなさい。
Queen's Recruit#561.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#562.src: You're back! Still in one piece?
Queen's Recruit#562.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#563.src: ...I was getting a little worried. You were up there a while.
Queen's Recruit#563.dst: …ちょっと心配してたんだ。ずいぶん長くいたから。
Queen's Recruit#563.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#564.dst: 彼女は何の用だったの？
Queen's Recruit#564.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#565.dst: …そうか。変な会話だったんだね？
Queen's Recruit#565.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#566.src: Ha. Well, now I'm a little nervous.
Queen's Recruit#566.dst: はは。今度は僕が緊張してきた。
Queen's Recruit#566.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#568.src: I'll... need to ask some follow-up questions.
Queen's Recruit#568.dst: 僕も… いくつか聞いてみないと。
Queen's Recruit#568.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#570.src: Oh, this is a disaster. We've been separated, and now we're stuck in here.
Queen's Recruit#570.dst: ああ、最悪だ。みんなと引き離されて、ここに閉じ込められた。
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#571.src: We need to come up with a plan... is there a way we could
Queen's Recruit#571.dst: 計画を立てないと… 何か方法は
Queen's Recruit#571.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#572.src: Tasim! Her Majesty will speak with you now.
Queen's Recruit#572.dst: Tasim！女王陛下がお呼びです。
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#574.src: Okay, wish me luck. I'll be back.
Queen's Recruit#574.dst: よし、幸運を祈ってて。戻るよ。
Queen's Recruit#574.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#575.src: Don't... stay up waiting for me. You can go rest. I'll be... fine, probably.
Queen's Recruit#575.dst: 僕を… 待って起きてなくていいから。休んで。僕は… たぶん平気。
Queen's Recruit#575.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#580.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#580.dst: まあ… 普通だったかな。君に言ったのと… ほとんど同じことを言われたと思う。
Queen's Recruit#580.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#583.src: Could I ask you a favor?
Queen's Recruit#583.dst: 頼みがあるんだけど、いい？
Queen's Recruit#583.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#584.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#584.dst: 手合わせしない？試合だよ、その… 明日の前に。昔みたいに。
Queen's Recruit#584.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#585.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#585.dst: 準備ができたら闘技場で会おう。いい？
Queen's Recruit#585.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#586.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#586.dst: 僕… うん。大丈夫。ただ… 手合わせしない？試合を、明日の… 前に。昔のよしみでさ。
Queen's Recruit#586.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#587.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#587.dst: とにかく… 準備して闘技場で会おう。いい？
Queen's Recruit#587.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#590.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#590.dst: まあ… 普通だったかな。君に言ったのと… ほとんど同じことを言われたと思う。
Queen's Recruit#590.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#593.src: I was going to ask if I could ask you a favor.
Queen's Recruit#593.dst: 頼みごとをしてもいいか聞こうとしてたんだ。
Queen's Recruit#593.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#594.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#594.dst: 手合わせしない？試合だよ、その… 明日の前に。昔みたいに。
Queen's Recruit#594.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#595.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#595.dst: 準備ができたら闘技場で会おう。いい？
Queen's Recruit#595.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#596.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#596.dst: 僕… うん。大丈夫。ただ… 手合わせしない？試合を、明日の… 前に。昔のよしみでさ。
Queen's Recruit#596.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#597.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#597.dst: とにかく… 準備して闘技場で会おう。いい？
Queen's Recruit#597.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#599.dst: 彼が… ち、違う、そんな
Queen's Recruit#599.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#602.dst: 僕… 僕… わからないよ。
Queen's Recruit#602.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#603.src: He's... what what happened? How do you know? How how could you know?
Queen's Recruit#603.dst: 彼が… 何… 何があったの？どうして知ってるの？どうして… どうして君が？
Queen's Recruit#603.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#611.src: I... Gods. And, you you've been tr-trying to
Queen's Recruit#611.dst: 僕は… なんてことだ。それに、君は… ずっと言お、言おうと
Queen's Recruit#611.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#613.src: I I need to go. I need some space. I'll I'm going to the arena. I need to... to...
Queen's Recruit#613.dst: 僕… 行かなきゃ。一人になりたい。僕は… 闘技場へ行く。少し… その…
Queen's Recruit#613.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#614.src: No. No, d-don't. Don't do that. Not now, not not now. If... if you need me... you'll you'll know where I am.
Queen's Recruit#614.dst: いや。いや、や、やめて。そんなことしないで。今は、今は… やめて。もし… もし僕が必要なら… 居場所は、わかるよね。
Queen's Recruit#614.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#615.src: Head to the arena for a training match against Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#615.dst: 闘技場へ行き、Tasim と練習試合をする。

Queen's Recruit#616.src: Get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#616.dst: 準備ができたら闘技場で会おう。いい？
Queen's Recruit#616.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#617.src: It's... quiet. No guards in sight.
Queen's Recruit#617.dst: 静か… だね。衛兵もいない。
Queen's Recruit#617.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#619.src: Sigh. There's no point in trying to get out of here. We have to just see it through to the end.
Queen's Recruit#619.dst: はあ。ここから逃げようとしても無駄だ。最後までやり抜くしかない。
Queen's Recruit#619.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#621.src: What do you think? About what she said? About... forces destroying the world.
Queen's Recruit#621.dst: どう思う？彼女の話。世界を壊そうとしてる… 力のこと。
Queen's Recruit#621.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#622.src: She's right. I've seen it I know you've seen it. It's... getting worse.
Queen's Recruit#622.dst: 彼女は正しい。僕も見た… 君も見たよね。どんどん… ひどくなってる。
Queen's Recruit#622.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#623.src: But... the recruits. The recruits. I can't get over that. It's so...
Queen's Recruit#623.dst: でも… 新兵のこと。新兵のことが。どうしても受け入れられない。あまりにも…
Queen's Recruit#623.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#625.src: Let's just get down there and fight. Usual spots, right?
Queen's Recruit#625.dst: とにかく下りて戦おう。いつもの位置でいいよね？
Queen's Recruit#625.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#628.src: No words. Let's fight. Just just a training battle. To... test our skills.
Queen's Recruit#628.dst: 言葉はいらない。戦おう。ただの… ただの練習試合だ。腕を… 試すための。
Queen's Recruit#628.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#631.dst: やっぱり君には勝てないか…
Queen's Recruit#631.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#632.src: I guess we know how tomorrow will turn out, then.
Queen's Recruit#632.dst: じゃあ、明日どうなるかはわかったね。
Queen's Recruit#632.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#633.src: No don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#633.dst: いや… 否定しないで。お互いわかってるだろ。
Queen's Recruit#633.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#635.src: She gave me a choice, you know?
Queen's Recruit#635.dst: 彼女は僕に選択肢をくれたんだ。
Queen's Recruit#635.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#636.src: A choice. I don't know what to do with it. And... I'm afraid of taking either option.
Queen's Recruit#636.dst: 選択肢。どうすればいいかわからない。それに… どちらを選ぶのも怖いんだ。
Queen's Recruit#636.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#637.src: I... I need to think over it some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#637.dst: 僕は…もう少し考えたい。それに二人とも休まないと。
Queen's Recruit#637.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#638.src: Huh? I... yes. I think I am. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#638.dst: え？僕は… うん。大丈夫だと思う。ただ考えることが多くて。
Queen's Recruit#638.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#639.src: I'll... tell you in the morning. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#639.dst: 朝に… 話すよ。ただ考えることが多くて。
Queen's Recruit#639.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#640.src: Ha. You're you're good. Oof. I'll be feeling that one for... for a while.
Queen's Recruit#640.dst: はは。君は… 強いね。うっ。これはしばらく… しばらく響きそうだ。
Queen's Recruit#640.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#642.src: Why did it have to come to this? Why couldn't why couldn't we all have just been happy?
Queen's Recruit#642.dst: どうしてこんなことに？どうして… どうしてみんなで幸せにいられなかったんだ？
Queen's Recruit#642.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#643.src: He he sent me a letter for that mission, you know. Did I tell you that? It's why I went back to Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#643.dst: 彼は… 彼はあの任務のことで手紙をくれたんだ。話したっけ？だから僕は Wynn に戻ったんだ。
Queen's Recruit#643.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#644.src: And, it turns out he was already... already gone. And you were there, and I wasn't.
Queen's Recruit#644.dst: なのに、彼はもう… もういなかった。君はそこにいて、僕はいなかった。
Queen's Recruit#644.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#646.src: I want to blame you for it. I want to be able to be mad, to hate you. But... I can't. I just can't.
Queen's Recruit#646.dst: 君のせいにしたい。怒って、君を憎めたらいいのに。でも… できない。どうしてもできないんだ。
Queen's Recruit#646.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#647.src: I wish I could've been there. I wish I could've done it better. Maybe I could have or maybe it would've just gone the same way.
Queen's Recruit#647.dst: 僕もその場にいたかった。もっとうまくやれたらよかった。できたかもしれない… それとも、同じ結果だったのかも。
Queen's Recruit#647.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#649.src: And now we're both here in the place we were all exiled from! But he's he isn't. He's gone, and and we're still here.
Queen's Recruit#649.dst: そして今、僕たちは二人とも追放されたこの場所にいる！でも彼は… 彼はいない。いなくなって、僕たちは… まだここにいる。
Queen's Recruit#649.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#650.src: ...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? About all of this?
Queen's Recruit#650.dst: …僕はどうすればいい？僕たちはどうすればいいんだ？この全部に。
Queen's Recruit#650.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#652.dst: 彼女は僕に選択肢をくれた。
Queen's Recruit#652.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#653.src: I asked a lot of questions. I didn't like all the answers, but... she left me with a choice.
Queen's Recruit#653.dst: たくさん質問したよ。答えが全部気に入ったわけじゃないけど… 彼女は選択肢を残してくれた。
Queen's Recruit#653.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#655.src: I don't know what to do. I need to... to... I need to think.
Queen's Recruit#655.dst: どうすればいいかわからない。僕は… その… 考えないと。
Queen's Recruit#655.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#656.src: Give me some space, please. I'll see you in the morning.
Queen's Recruit#656.dst: 少し一人にしてほしい。また朝に。
Queen's Recruit#656.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#657.src: Return to your room and sleep for the night.
Queen's Recruit#657.dst: 部屋に戻って夜を過ごす。

Queen's Recruit#659.src: Read the note Tasim left you before heading out.
Queen's Recruit#659.dst: 出発する前に、Tasim が残したメモを読む。

Queen's Recruit#660.src: Head to Her Majesty's office for her decision.
Queen's Recruit#660.dst: 女王陛下の執務室へ行き、決定を聞く。

Queen's Recruit#662.src: You've already failed, you know. You did not meet her criteria for selection.
Queen's Recruit#662.dst: あなたはもう失敗したのよ。彼女の選考基準を満たさなかった。

Queen's Recruit#663.src: But is dismissing you outright an error? Certainly, you're powerful. Perhaps even more so than you should be, given the circumstances.
Queen's Recruit#663.dst: でも、あなたを即座に切り捨てるのは誤りかしら？確かにあなたは強い。状況を考えれば、本来あるべき以上に。

Queen's Recruit#664.src: Still. You lack the drive, the perspective. The dedication. The understanding.
Queen's Recruit#664.dst: それでも。あなたには意欲も、視点もない。献身も。理解も。

Queen's Recruit#665.src: And, most critically - you're unpredictable. And that makes you dangerous.
Queen's Recruit#665.dst: そして何より… あなたは予測できない。だから危険なの。

Queen's Recruit#666.src: Ah! It seems Her Majesty and I have come to the same conclusion. Wonderful.
Queen's Recruit#666.dst: あら！陛下と私は同じ結論に至ったようね。素晴らしい。

Queen's Recruit#667.src: So, where does that leave you? Cast out, discarded?
Queen's Recruit#667.dst: で、あなたはどうなるのかしら？追放、廃棄？

Queen's Recruit#668.src: All the unanswered questions. Will you choose to let go? Dismiss the possibilities?
Queen's Recruit#668.dst: 答えの出ない疑問の数々。あなたは手放すことを選ぶ？可能性を捨てる？

Queen's Recruit#669.src: And if not? What would you do for a glimpse of the truth? For a chance of receiving answers?
Queen's Recruit#669.dst: もしそうでないなら？真実を垣間見るために何をする？答えを得る機会のためなら？

Queen's Recruit#670.src: Hm. Whatever the case, the choice is yours. Perhaps you'll surprise me, after all! Wouldn't that be exciting?
Queen's Recruit#670.dst: ふふ。いずれにせよ、選ぶのはあなた。もしかしたら驚かせてくれるかもね！わくわくするでしょう？

Queen's Recruit#671.src: {u}, under order of Her Majesty, you are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#671.dst: {u}、女王陛下の命により、ただちに Fruma から護送退去させる。
Queen's Recruit#671.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#672.src: Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province. Comply, and no one will be hurt.
Queen's Recruit#672.dst: 反抗すれば、Wynn 地方から Fruma への正式な脅威とみなす。従えば誰も傷つかない。
Queen's Recruit#672.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#673.src: You hold no power here. This choice is not yours. You will follow orders, or face the consequences.
Queen's Recruit#673.dst: ここにお前の権限はない。これはお前が選ぶことではない。命令に従うか、報いを受けるかだ。
Queen's Recruit#673.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#000~1.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E{~}.
Queen's Recruit#000~1.dst: Mel と Lanu は E{~} だ。

Queen's Recruit#001~1.src: Room W{~}... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#001~1.dst: W{~} 号室…さあ行って。割り当てる部屋がまだたくさんあるんだ…

Queen's Recruit#012~1.src: Pardon me, excuse me- coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#012~1.dst: 失礼、すみません- 通ります！通ります！ああ、お二人！ちょうど探していたんです。
Queen's Recruit#012~1.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#098~1.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to our relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#098~1.dst: …単刀直入に言おう。隣の地方 Fruma との関係において、我々は非常に微妙な立場にある。
Queen's Recruit#098~1.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#101~1.src: Good. I guess that makes two of us.
Queen's Recruit#101~1.dst: よかった。僕も同じだよ。

Queen's Recruit#102~1.src: It sounds very suspicious. Why the sudden interest? Why now?
Queen's Recruit#102~1.dst: すごく怪しいな。なんで急に興味を？なんで今？

Queen's Recruit#108~1.src: Ugh, we're not just going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#108~1.dst: うげ、まさか本当に従うわけじゃないよな？
Queen's Recruit#108~1.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#115~1.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences with the province?
Queen's Recruit#115~1.dst: …あの地方にいい思い出のない俺たちもか？
Queen's Recruit#115~1.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#118~1.src: That is the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#118~1.dst: まさにその計画だとも！詳しくは着いてから説明するが、時間制限があるのだったね？
Queen's Recruit#118~1.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#186~1.src: Linton and Kymer are in W{~}.
Queen's Recruit#186~1.dst: Linton と Kymer は W{~} だ。

similar.text: Linton and Kymer are in W2.

Queen's Recruit#232~1.src: There are others. Though, none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#232~1.dst: 他にもいます。ただ、この催しには誰も出られませんでした- それぞれ任務で手が離せないのです。
Queen's Recruit#232~1.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#233~1.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W{~}... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#233~1.dst: ああ、あった。Tasim と {u}、君たちは W{~} 号室…西棟だ。

Queen's Recruit#234~1.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#234~1.dst: 足が速くて隠密が得意だからさ。もう行かないと、衛兵に目をつけられたくない。W{~} 号室だからな！

Queen's Recruit#291~1.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So... what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited just for this?
Queen's Recruit#291~1.dst: でも、まあ、今は二人きりだ。で…トーナメントのこと実際どう思う？変だよね？なんでこれだけのために招待されたんだろう？
Queen's Recruit#291~1.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#309~1.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I’m a little excited, too. I haven’t had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it’ll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#309~1.dst: はは！うん、そうだね。僕も少しわくわくしてる。親善試合なんて久しぶりだし、力試しにいいかも。
Queen's Recruit#309~1.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#319~1.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room- so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#319~1.dst: Picard が今わかってることを話し合おうってさ。部屋に来るのも時間をずらせって- だから数分待ってから来てくれ！
Queen's Recruit#319~1.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#349~1.src: Seems likely to me they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#349~1.dst: 安心させて信用させたいんだろうよ。見たもん全部話すってわかってるはずだ、なら好印象を残しとこうってな？
Queen's Recruit#349~1.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#350~1.src: A strong spell should get through this wood without a problem.
Queen's Recruit#350~1.dst: 強い呪文なら、この木材は問題なく壊せそうだ。

Queen's Recruit#357~1.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them- though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#357~1.dst: ああ、そうだとも…さて、最も有望な手がかりは君主たちのようだ。彼らに的を絞ろう- ただし一般情報もおろそかにするな。Fruma についてはできるだけ知っておきたい。
Queen's Recruit#357~1.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#417~1.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do- you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#417~1.dst: ええ、すぐに誰か来る。脇に座って指でもいじっていたまえ、何でもいい- もう君は私の問題ではないのでね。
Queen's Recruit#417~1.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#554~1.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported from the {p}, and the vegetables came from our royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#554~1.dst: Fruma 料理をもう一品…肉は {p} からの輸入、野菜は王家の庭で採れたものです。
Queen's Recruit#554~1.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#567~1.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers - a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#567~1.dst: Wynn の最も偉大な者…範囲が広すぎます。数を絞る必要があった- 力比べがうまくその役を果たしました。
Queen's Recruit#567~1.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#585~1.dst: …そっか。じゃあ、変な会話だった？
Queen's Recruit#585~1.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#654~1.src: No- don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#654~1.dst: いや- 否定しないで。僕が正しいのはお互いわかってる。
Queen's Recruit#654~1.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#658~1.src: I... I need to think it over some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#658~1.dst: 僕は…もう少し考えたい。それに二人とも休まないと。
Queen's Recruit#658~1.speaker: Tasim

Recipe For Disaster#000.src: Meet up with Chef Hamsey in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#000.dst: {p} の [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で料理長 Hamsey と会う。

Recipe For Disaster#001.src: Ah, bonjour! Welcome to my restaurant, allow me to lead you to your seat-
Recipe For Disaster#001.dst: Ah, bonjour！ようこそ我が店へ。お席へご案内を—
Recipe For Disaster#001.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#002.src: Oh do my eyes deceive me? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.dst: おや、目の錯覚かな？Serais-ce possible？！
Recipe For Disaster#002.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#003.src: It is you... the novice soldier turned hero of legends! Who would have thought?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.dst: 君は…新米兵士から伝説の英雄になった、あの！誰が想像できただろう？！
Recipe For Disaster#003.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#004.src: I have heard tales of your exploits across the lands, mon ami! Je suis honore! Someone like you sitting in my restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.dst: 各地で君の武勇伝は聞いているよ、mon ami！Je suis honore！君ほどの人物が私の店にいるとは！
Recipe For Disaster#004.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#005.src: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Famed across the lands for my flavors, as you are for your weapon!
Recipe For Disaster#005.dst: 私こそ、bien sur…Le Chef Hamsey！君が武器で名高いように、私は味で名高いのだ！
Recipe For Disaster#005.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#006.src: I boast, I boast. Je peu t'offrir un plat... but perhaps I have a different proposition for us both.
Recipe For Disaster#006.dst: 自慢が過ぎたね。Je peu t'offrir un plat…だが、二人のための別の提案があるのだよ。
Recipe For Disaster#006.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#007.src: You may have mastered the art of battle, my friend, but what of... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.dst: 戦いの技は極めたかもしれないね、友よ。だが…L'Art de la Cuisine はどうかな？！
Recipe For Disaster#007.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#008.src: Follow me into the kitchen behind me, and I will tell you more.
Recipe For Disaster#008.dst: 後ろの厨房へついて来たまえ、詳しく話そう。
Recipe For Disaster#008.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#009.src: Find Chef Hamsey in his kitchen.
Recipe For Disaster#009.dst: 厨房にいる料理長 Hamsey を見つける。

Recipe For Disaster#010.src: Welcome to my kitchen! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.dst: 我が厨房へようこそ！C'est beau, non？
Recipe For Disaster#010.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#011.src: It may be on fire, but... que serais la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.dst: 燃えてはいるが…que serais la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh？！
Recipe For Disaster#011.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#012.src: So, back to the challenge. What do you say to a bit of friendly competition, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.dst: さて、挑戦の話に戻ろう。ちょっとした腕比べはどうかね、ふふ？
Recipe For Disaster#012.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#013.src: You can work with one of my three best chefs on a dish and present it to me once you're done!
Recipe For Disaster#013.dst: 選りすぐりの料理人三人の誰かと組んで一皿作り、できたら私に出してくれたまえ！
Recipe For Disaster#013.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#014.src: I, of course, will judge your dish based on the twenty-nine Principes de Cuisine - texture, presentation, originality...
Recipe For Disaster#014.dst: もちろん私が二十九の Principes de Cuisine で審査する—食感、盛り付け、独創性…
Recipe For Disaster#014.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#015.src: ... aroma, magical ability... oh, and flavour!
Recipe For Disaster#015.dst: …香り、魔法の力…おっと、それに味もね！
Recipe For Disaster#015.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#016.src: S'il te plait! Go introduce yourself to each of my chefs and return once you have decided who to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#016.dst: S'il te plait！料理人たちに挨拶して、誰と組むか決めたら戻ってきたまえ！
Recipe For Disaster#016.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#017.src: Speak to all three chefs in Hamsey's kitchen.
Recipe For Disaster#017.dst: Hamsey の厨房にいる三人の料理人全員と話す。

Recipe For Disaster#018.src: Heya! You must be the adventurer that Hamsey told me about. You know, he was almost ecstatic, but don't tell him I said that!
Recipe For Disaster#018.dst: やっほー！Hamsey が話してた冒険者さんね。あの人ったら大はしゃぎだったんだよ、私が言ったってのは内緒ね！
Recipe For Disaster#018.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#019.src: Oh, a cook-off? How exciting! I'll gladly help you out. Maybe this way I can prove myself a bit more to the others...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.dst: え、料理対決？わくわくする！喜んで手伝うよ。これでみんなに少しは認めてもらえるかも…？
Recipe For Disaster#019.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#020.src: If we work together, we can make a Seasoned Voidroot Stew, how does that sound?
Recipe For Disaster#020.dst: 一緒なら Seasoned Voidroot Stew が作れるよ、どうかな？
Recipe For Disaster#020.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#021.src: You need to talk to the other chefs before deciding what to make, though!
Recipe For Disaster#021.dst: でも何を作るか決める前に、ほかの料理人とも話してきてね！
Recipe For Disaster#021.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#022.src: Good friend of Hamsey's, are you? I'll believe it when - no, if - you somehow win this competition.
Recipe For Disaster#022.dst: Hamsey の親友だと？信じてやるよ、お前がこの勝負に勝ったら—いや、勝てたらな。
Recipe For Disaster#022.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any amateurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.dst: 俺が腕を振るってる時に、お前みたいな素人に邪魔されたくないんだよ！
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.dst: まだいたのか？頼むから…他の奴とおしゃべりしてこい。
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.dst: よう、兄弟。オレは Frank。Hamsey とは超長い付き合いなんだって？Hamsey のダチならオレのダチだ。
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.dst: 何を作るかはまだ決めてねえや。まあ、その時になりゃ何か思いつくっしょ。
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.dst: パイとかどう？手間かかんねえし、大失敗もしねえだろ？
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#028.dst: Hamsey と話して、組む料理人を選ぶ。

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiners? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.dst: Ah、tous mes cuisiners には挨拶したかね？誰と組みたいのかな？！
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.dst: Ah、Brie！優秀な料理人…そしてもっと優秀なチーズ！冗談、冗談。君たちならきっと息が合うよ。
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.dst: Ah、Kale。最も才能ある料理人の一人だが、時々頑固でね！
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.dst: Frank！時々…のんびりしすぎに見えるかもしれんが、実に有能な料理人だと保証するよ！
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maitenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.dst: Maitenant, mon ami、君の料理人のところへ行って調理開始だ！
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about the dish.
Recipe For Disaster#034.dst: 選んだ料理人と料理について話す。

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.dst: また会ったね！私と Seasoned Voidroot Stew 作るの？やった！
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.dst: 見た目ほど簡単じゃないけど、二人ならきっと何とかなるよ。
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.dst: 前に言った、認めてもらう話だけど…私はこの厨房で一番の新入りで、私のアイデアを認めない料理人もいるの。これはチャンスかも！
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been perfecting the recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.dst: 何か月もかけて Voidroot Stew のレシピを磨いてきたの。やっと実力をみんなに見せられる！
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first one is some [Snail Slime] available on Snail Island! We only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.dst: 一つ目は [Snail Slime]、Snail Island で手に入るよ！この料理には一つだけでいいの。
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.dst: 次は [Voidroot]、虚無の奥深くに生える超レアな根っこ。{p} に、そこへ連れてってくれる人がいるらしいよ。
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.dst: 最後は [Moonsalt]、手に入れにくいので有名なの。幸い、自称「宇宙の魔法使い」Astralaus が持ってるはずだから、塔に行って分けてもらって！
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.dst: これで揃うはず！レシピ本をあげるね、右クリックで開けば食材を確認できるよ。頑張って！
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.dst: チッ。俺の邪魔をしなけりゃ、うまくやっていけるさ。
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.dst: 役に立て、必要な物を全部持ってこい。おしゃべりする気分じゃない。
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.dst: お前みたいな奴のせいで俺の評判に傷がつくのはごめんだ…
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.dst: よく聞け、二度とは「言わない」。メモしろ。
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.dst: 俺の絶品オムレツの決め手はもちろん [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] だ。当然お前は知らなかっただろうがな。
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.dst: 二つ目は [Snail Slime]、もちろん Snail Island にある。経験のある料理人なら誰でも知ってることだ。
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.dst: 最後に [Talking Mushroom]。沼地の空島にある—お前の目がちゃんと見えてればな。
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.dst: もう忘れたのか？？メモしろって言っただろ！
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.dst: 運がいいな、ここには少なくとも一人まともな奴がいる。全部このレシピ本に書いた。右クリックで開け。さっさと食材を持ってきて失せろ！
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.dst: 組めてマジ嬉しいぜ、兄弟！Hamsey の度肝を抜いてやろうぜ。
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.dst: うーん、さて、どんなパイを焼くかな？
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.dst: オレはちょいと怠け者だけど、料理を見る目はあるんだ。で、兄弟？お前はまさに Skyhigh Pie って感じの奴だな！へへっ。
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.dst: ま、シンプルな Skyhigh Pie の作り方くらい知ってるよな？行ってこい、食材が揃ったらここで待ってるぜ。
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.dst: へへ、からかっただけだって、兄弟！今の顔、見せてやりたかったぜ。
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.dst: まず粉が要るな。[Sunrise Flour] がちょいとありゃ十分だ。
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.dst: でかめの [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] でちょいとパンチを効かせる。まあ、卵を盗むところを Grook に見られたら、もっと強烈なパンチを食らうけどな！
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.dst: 最後に隠し味—[Skyhigh Raspberry]。マジで美味いけど、けっこう遠いんだ。ちょっと歩くくらい平気っしょ？オレは行ったことねえけど。
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.dst: ん、物覚えが悪い？オレもだよ、兄弟。ほらレシピ本だ、右クリックで開けば食材のありかがわかるぜ！
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.dst: 全部揃ったらここに戻ってこい。じゃあな、兄弟！
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#062.src: Collect [{~} {Ingredient}] at [X, Y, Z] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#062.dst: [X, Y, Z] で [{~} {Ingredient}] を集めるか、レシピ本を確認する。

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.dst: Astralus の星の館へようこそ！重力を反転させて頂上まで来られるかね？
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.dst: 天文学的な進歩だ！だが、これはまだ始まりにすぎん！
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.dst: 我輩の Moonsalt だと？ばかばかしい！我輩は自分で集めた、お前も自分で集めろ！それが公平だ。
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.dst: まったく人間どもは聞く耳を持たん！言ったはずだ…自。分。で。取れ。
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick elsewhere strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.dst: 何がヨソモノをここへ？どんな名付けを持つ？ニン・ゲン？我々はニンゲソを名乗る！悪い選び、他で拾え、ヨソモノ！
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Investigating for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observers, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.dst: 調べるに手伝うため？なんと多くの便利！ニンゲソは助け化を必要！観察者よ、ニンゲソ飛び失敗して大きい穴ぼこ岩に落ちた！
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.dst: 燃えミルク尽きた、取り戻す一つの方向は moonsalt！我々は幸運カケラを掘り当て、穴ぼこ岩で moonsalt 発見！
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.dst: 精錬 moonsalt は宇宙ビューンの燃えミルクくれる！不便化、宇宙ビューン壊れた。ニンゲソはちっぽけ宇宙ビューン作る！
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom in given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.dst: 今の宇宙ビューン、単数ニンゲソだけ入る。ヨソモノ手伝えばヨソモノ入れる。ニンゲソ時間あれば新しい宇宙ビューン作れる！
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result of death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.dst: ニンゲソ今は穴ぼこ岩に住む、つまり待つは死の結果でない！
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.dst: Moonsalt は北の塩洞窟で発見、ヨソモノ道を辿れ！
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.dst: 燃えミルクには [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] だけ必要、残りはヨソモノ取ってよし！
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.dst: ヨソモノ moonsalt 持ったら、ニンゲソ横の装置で精錬、宇宙ビューンでビューン行け！
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.dst: こんにちはーっ、世紀のレース場へようこそ！
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.dst: 勝者は一人、敗者も一人。そして Usnail Bolt は敗者を朝飯に食らう。
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.dst: 朝飯？待てよ、朝飯食ったっけ？軽く朝ごはんってのも悪くな—
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.dst: まあいい。どうだい、冒険者？Usnail Bolt とのレースに出てみないか。優勝賞品は Snail Slime だ！
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.dst: 残念、いいレースになったろうに。またな、冒険者！
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.dst: おやおやおや…どうやら今回も Usnail Bolt の勝ちだ。またしてもな。
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.dst: 今日はツイてなかったな、人間。まあ、負けの代償は知ってるだろ。衛兵！
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.dst: うおお！驚きのレース展開、人間が Usnail Bolt の鼻先からトップを奪い取ったぞ！
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human. Take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.dst: ほら、人間。賞品のスライムだ。
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.dst: いやあ、実に素晴らしいね。人間だって？！誰が予想できたかな。
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.dst: 今日オレの前を通ったのはお前で七人目、ほかの連中と何も変わらない。
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.dst: どいつもこいつも間抜けな顔でさ、しゃべるキノコがそんなに珍しいかっての。
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.dst: 勘弁してくれ、オレを引っこ抜いて無礼を働く連中にはうんざりだ。プライベートって言葉、聞いたことある？
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.dst: なんで頑張っちゃうかな。お前を見ろよ！何もわかってない奴の見本だ。で、空の島々を巡るイカれた大冒険にでも連れてく気？
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.dst: そう考えてるなら勘弁してほしいね。今日はもう、どこかのバカにかじられて軸を一本失ったんだ…生きたままだぞ！
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.dst: まさか、空の島々を巡るイカれた大冒険に連れてく気？なんて素敵なんだ。
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.dst: 厨房だって？まあ、この苦しみをさっさと終わらせてくれるなら、いいんじゃない。
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.dst: 待て、なんでカバンに詰め込む？こんな中でどうやって息しろってんだ？！
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead you some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.dst: やあ！その顔は Sunrise Flour を「こね」がってるね？
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.dst: 今すぐ要る？心配ないよ、「パン」と引き受けた！
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.dst: いやはや、こりゃ「焼き」が回った。粉を切らしちゃって、もう全然残ってないんだ。
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I see to just be loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.dst: ぼんやり「発酵」してるように見えたらごめん。でも追加の作り方なら知ってるよ。
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.dst: パン屋の隣の小麦畑、見えるかい？小麦を刈って、粉ひき機に入れればいい。
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.dst: 隣の「パン」…じゃない、隣の道具屋で鎌をもらって作業開始だ！
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.dst: 好きなだけ作っていいよ、今日の分のパンはもう焼いたから。
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.dst: やあ、相棒！Skyhigh Raspberries をお探しかい？パイにぴったりだよ！
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.dst: 興味があれば、ほんの {~} エメラルドで島に渡れるよ。
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.dst: 人間、稼がなきゃ生きていけない。だから実がなる島まで一直線の大砲システムを作ったのさ！
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.dst: で、どうする？ちょっとの金でちょっとした冒険、しかもラズベリー食べ放題だ！
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head on over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.dst: よしきた！隣の島に行って大砲に飛び込むだけ—絶対安全、約束するよ！
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon and come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.dst: 島を登って、ラズベリーを好きなだけ摘んでくれ！済んだら大きな大砲に飛び込めば岸に戻れるよ！
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.dst: よしきた、気にしないで。食べたくなったらいつでもおいで！
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.
Recipe For Disaster#110.dst: 選んだ料理人に食材を渡す。

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.dst: 食材は全部揃った？すごい！
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you set back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.dst: じゃあ下がってて、料理は私に任せて。食材を渡してね！
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.dst: あはっ！これでいいはず！全部ちゃんとできてるといいけど…でもわあ、このスープの色見て！
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.dst: Hamsey に持っていって、感想を聞いてみて！
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.dst: 全部揃ったか？ずいぶん遅かったな。
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.dst: 始めるぞ。他はもう全員終わってる。俺が魔法をかける間、下がってろ。
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.dst: んまっ！俺の傑作が完成だ。料理長に出してこい、きっと気に入るぞ！
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.dst: 運ぶ時は「気をつけろ」。俺が有名になったら、これは「数百」の値打ちだぞ！
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.dst: 全部揃った？最高だぜ、兄弟。
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.dst: このラズベリー、ちょーっとだけもらうぜ—料理人の手数料ってやつ？じゃ、始めるか！
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.dst: はい完成。Hamsey も気に入るぜ。
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.dst: ほらよ、兄弟。一緒にやれて楽しかったぜ—Hamsey に見せて感想を聞いてこい。途中でつまみ食いして「なくす」なよ—売り物に手を出すなって言うだろ？
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.
Recipe For Disaster#123.dst: 完成した料理を持って Hamsey と話す。

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.dst: Ah、料理ができたのかね？では、il est temps de goûter！
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.dst: 私の特別室へ移ろう…こちらだ！
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#126.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の食堂で Hamsey と会う。

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've return with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.dst: おかえり、mon ami！料理を手に戻ってきたね！
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.dst: シチューかね？素朴に見えるが、素朴なものほど le meilleur になりうる！
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.dst: 冒険者よ、本当に君が作ったのかね？これほど美味いなら店をたたんでもいいくらいだ！
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.dst: 君にはいつも驚かされるよ、友よ。さあ、このエプロンを。真の料理人に欠かせないものだ。
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.dst: おや、君の料理ができているようだね！
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.dst: 君の料理を味見して、私のものも披露しよう！Mon dieu, une omelette？
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: Je suis déçu, ami。ラバの derrière にかじりつくほうがましだ！こんな物…Gert だって手をつけん！
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: 料理の腕はまるで上達していないようだね。放っておいてくれ、美味いとは何かを学んでから来たまえ！
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: 戻ってきたね、しかも手ぶらではない。さあ、君が作ったものを見せてくれたまえ！
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: パイかね？おや、Frank に手伝ってもらったね。彼はパイ作りに目がないんだ！
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: 君の compétences culinaires はよく磨かれているね！
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: まだ真の料理人とは呼べんが、très bien だ！祝いにこの褒美を受け取りたまえ！
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Reclaiming the House#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Temporary Camp で Elphaba の任務に加わる

Reclaiming the House#001.src: Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
Reclaiming the House#001.dst: おや、こんな片田舎に Wynn の兵士？正直、まさに必要な人材だ—手が空いているなら、力を貸してくれないか？
Reclaiming the House#001.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#002.src: Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
Reclaiming the House#002.dst: よし、ありがとう。説明の前に、まず野営地を封鎖させてくれ。
Reclaiming the House#002.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#003.src: My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
Reclaiming the House#003.dst: 私は Elphaba。Gavel の軍でもう何年も働いている。
Reclaiming the House#003.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#004.src: I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
Reclaiming the House#004.dst: この先の {p} Outpost の指揮官だ。オークの首都を監視するための戦略要塞だよ。
Reclaiming the House#004.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#005.src: It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
Reclaiming the House#005.dst: 長いこと安全だったが、特に最近はオークがずっと大胆で攻撃的になった。
Reclaiming the House#005.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#006.src: They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
Reclaiming the House#006.dst: 奴らに前哨基地を制圧された—撤退して野営地を張り、奴らを見張るための場所を見張る羽目になった！
Reclaiming the House#006.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#007.src: I need more firepower if I'm going... to get...
Reclaiming the House#007.dst: もっと火力が要る、もし…取り…戻すなら…
Reclaiming the House#007.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#008.src: ...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!
Reclaiming the House#008.dst: …まずい。ほら、こういうことだ！オークが来る！
Reclaiming the House#008.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#009.src: Brace yourself, soldier! Protect the camp!
Reclaiming the House#009.dst: 構えろ、兵士！野営地を守れ！
Reclaiming the House#009.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#010.src: Kill the mobs raiding the Camp.
Reclaiming the House#010.dst: 野営地を襲撃するモンスターを倒す。

Reclaiming the House#011.src: This is the third attack in three days! How many reinforcements have they got?!
Reclaiming the House#011.dst: 三日で三度目の襲撃だ！奴らの援軍はどれだけいるんだ？！
Reclaiming the House#011.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#012.src: Gah! Their casters are strong, careful!
Reclaiming the House#012.dst: くっ！術師が強い、気をつけろ！
Reclaiming the House#012.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#013.src: Talk to Elphaba for information on the upcoming attack.
Reclaiming the House#013.dst: Elphaba と話して、次の攻撃について聞く。

Reclaiming the House#014.src: Ugh, I think that was all of them... Come here now, I'll start up where we left off.
Reclaiming the House#014.dst: ふう、これで全部片付いたか…こっちへ。さっきの続きを話そう。
Reclaiming the House#014.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#015.src: Not sure I could have done that myself. I'm lucky you came around when you did, soldier.
Reclaiming the House#015.dst: 私一人じゃ切り抜けられなかったかもな。いい時に来てくれて助かったよ、兵士。
Reclaiming the House#015.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#016.src: Anyway, it's clear I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
Reclaiming the House#016.dst: とにかく、あの前哨基地を取り戻すには、もっと火力が必要なのは明らかだ。
Reclaiming the House#016.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#017.src: You've certainly got the fighting chops, so I'd appreciate the aid, but we've got to come up with a plan, fast.
Reclaiming the House#017.dst: 君の腕は確かだ、助けてくれるならありがたい。だが急いで作戦を立てないと。
Reclaiming the House#017.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#018.src: There's an old tower near the outpost- some old storage silo. It was built taller than the fort, so we might be able to spy on them from there.
Reclaiming the House#018.dst: 前哨基地の近くに古い塔がある—古い貯蔵サイロだ。砦より高く建てられているから、そこから偵察できるかもしれない。
Reclaiming the House#018.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#019.src: It's a risk though, since it's so close by, but we have no other options. Meet me at the tower southeast of here so we can survey the situation.
Reclaiming the House#019.dst: 近すぎて危険だが、ほかに手はない。ここから南東の塔で落ち合おう、状況を確かめるんだ。
Reclaiming the House#019.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#020.src: Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.
Reclaiming the House#020.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の見張り塔へ行き、攻撃の作戦を立てる。

Reclaiming the House#021.src: Soldier! I'm right behind you. You can see our outpost- and the tower I mentioned.
Reclaiming the House#021.dst: 兵士！すぐ後ろにいるぞ。私たちの前哨基地が見えるだろう—それに話した塔も。
Reclaiming the House#021.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#022.src: We need to find a way in. A lot of soldiers were caught unaware during the Orcs' assault, too.
Reclaiming the House#022.dst: 中へ入る道を探さないと。オークの襲撃で不意を突かれた兵士も大勢いる。
Reclaiming the House#022.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#023.src: If there's any survivors in there, we should make rescuing them a priority.
Reclaiming the House#023.dst: 中に生存者がいるなら、救出を最優先にすべきだ。
Reclaiming the House#023.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#024.src: After all, it means more manpower for us. We can't count on that being the case, though...
Reclaiming the House#024.dst: なにしろ、こちらの戦力が増えるからな。まあ、当てにはできないが…
Reclaiming the House#024.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#025.src: Come on, hurry inside before one of the orcs spots us!
Reclaiming the House#025.dst: さあ、オークに見つかる前に急いで中へ！
Reclaiming the House#025.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#026.src: Enter to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.
Reclaiming the House#026.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の見張り塔に入り、攻撃の作戦を立てる。

Reclaiming the House#027.src: Alright, this is a pretty clear view. Let's see what's going on in there...
Reclaiming the House#027.dst: よし、よく見える。中の様子を見てみよう…
Reclaiming the House#027.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#028.src: Wh- I'm shocked! In the middle there- they just caged the soldiers instead of killing them? That's... kind of a relief.
Reclaiming the House#028.dst: な—驚いた！真ん中だ—奴ら、兵士を殺さずに檻に入れたのか？それは…少しほっとした。
Reclaiming the House#028.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#029.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza for us to take down on our own...
Reclaiming the House#029.dst: 広場のオークは多すぎて、二人じゃとても倒しきれない…
Reclaiming the House#029.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#030.src: ...but that cage is held up by those ropes. If we can cut them, the other soldiers should be able to help!
Reclaiming the House#030.dst: …だが、あの檻はロープで吊られている。切れば、兵士たちが加勢できるはずだ！
Reclaiming the House#030.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#031.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may no be an option...
Reclaiming the House#031.dst: よし、あとは二人でどう潜り込むかだ…外周に見張りがいるから、越えていくのは無理かもしれない…
Reclaiming the House#031.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#032.src: Maybe we can keep an eye out on their sentry patterns and look for an opening-
Reclaiming the House#032.dst: 見張りの巡回を観察して、隙を探せば—
Reclaiming the House#032.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#033.src: Humans on old tower! Junhur will shoot! This our place now, get out!!
Reclaiming the House#033.dst: 古い塔に人間！Junhur 撃つ！ここ今は我らの場所、出ていけ！！
Reclaiming the House#033.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#034.src: Aw, not now! I knew this was a risk, no time to get out... Brace for impact!!
Reclaiming the House#034.dst: ああ、よりによって今！危険は承知だった、逃げる時間はない…衝撃に備えろ！！
Reclaiming the House#034.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#035.src: Old tower fall! Junhur is best cannon shooter!!
Reclaiming the House#035.dst: 古い塔、倒れた！Junhur 一番の大砲撃ち！！
Reclaiming the House#035.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#036.src: Agh, soldier!! Are you alright, where'd you fall?!
Reclaiming the House#036.dst: くっ、兵士！！無事か、どこに落ちた？！
Reclaiming the House#036.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#037.src: Ah... Wow. You barely look scratched, you must've gotten really lucky.
Reclaiming the House#037.dst: ああ…すごい。かすり傷もないじゃないか、よほど運がよかったんだな。
Reclaiming the House#037.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#038.src: Not so much here... I'm pretty battered after that. At least one of us is in good condition...
Reclaiming the House#038.dst: こっちはそうもいかない…かなりやられた。少なくとも一人は無事でよかった…
Reclaiming the House#038.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#039.src: Unfortunately, that means figuring a way in is up to you. We can't examine their sentry patterns from down here.
Reclaiming the House#039.dst: あいにく、中への道を探すのは君に任せるしかない。ここからじゃ見張りの巡回が見えない。
Reclaiming the House#039.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#040.src: I'll survive, sure, but I won't be able to walk around and defend myself for a while.
Reclaiming the House#040.dst: 死にはしない、だがしばらくは歩くことも身を守ることもできない。
Reclaiming the House#040.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#041.src: I hate leaving you on your own like this, but if it's any consolation, you should be tough enough, or lucky enough, to get through.
Reclaiming the House#041.dst: 君を一人にするのは心苦しいが、慰めになるなら—君は十分強いか、十分運がいい。きっと切り抜けられる。
Reclaiming the House#041.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#042.src: Explore the perimeter of the outpost. Try to find a way in, but be careful, okay?
Reclaiming the House#042.dst: 前哨基地の外周を探ってくれ。中への道を探すんだ、でも気をつけて、いいな？
Reclaiming the House#042.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#043.src: Explore the outpost's surroundings to find another way in.
Reclaiming the House#043.dst: 前哨基地の周囲を探索し、別の侵入経路を探す。

Reclaiming the House#044.src: Follow the trail of mud left by the orc. It leads to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#044.dst: オークが残した泥の跡をたどる。[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟へ続いている

Reclaiming the House#045.src: Enter the outpost while covered in mud.
Reclaiming the House#045.dst: 泥まみれのまま前哨基地に入る。

Reclaiming the House#046.dst: また泥だらけのオーク？早く入れ！
Reclaiming the House#046.speaker: Orc Guard

Reclaiming the House#047.src: Cut the ropes to free the guards from the cage.
Reclaiming the House#047.dst: ロープを切って、檻から衛兵を解放する。

Reclaiming the House#049.src: Good thinking with the mud disguise, soldier! They never suspected a thing, now come help us out over here!
Reclaiming the House#049.dst: 泥の変装とは名案だ、兵士！奴らまったく疑わなかった。さあ、こっちを手伝ってくれ！
Reclaiming the House#049.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#050.src: Kill the Orcish Overtakers, we'll help keep the other ones off you!
Reclaiming the House#050.dst: Orcish Overtaker を倒せ、他の奴らは俺たちが食い止める！
Reclaiming the House#050.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#051.src: Open the gate with a spell

Reclaiming the House#052.src: The Overtakers are down, the other Orcs are flailing! Open the outpost's entrance with a spell now, we've got this under control!
Reclaiming the House#052.dst: Overtaker は倒れた、他のオークは総崩れだ！呪文で前哨基地の入口を開けてくれ、ここは俺たちが抑える！
Reclaiming the House#052.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#054.src: Phew... That's some fine work there, soldier! The outpost is back under our control!
Reclaiming the House#054.dst: ふう…見事だったぞ、兵士！前哨基地は我々の手に戻った！
Reclaiming the House#054.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#055.src: Glad to see some more capable Wynnic hands over here. Though, I didn't catch your name. Would you mind?
Reclaiming the House#055.dst: 頼れる Wynn の人手が増えて嬉しいよ。ところで、名前をまだ聞いていなかった。教えてくれるか？
Reclaiming the House#055.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#056.src: {u}, huh? I'll remember that. You barely even needed my help, heh... Wish I hadn't been such a burden, but at least it worked out.
Reclaiming the House#056.dst: {u}、か。覚えておくよ。君は私の助けなんてほとんど要らなかったな、はは…足手まといになってすまない、でも結果オーライだ。
Reclaiming the House#056.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#057.src: Here- it's some of my own personal spending money, as a thank-you gift.
Reclaiming the House#057.dst: これを—私の個人的な小遣いだ、お礼として。
Reclaiming the House#057.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#058.src: Alright everyone, let's get this place ship-shape! Everything needs to be repaired in case of another attack!!
Reclaiming the House#058.dst: よし皆、ここを整えるぞ！次の襲撃に備えて、全部修理するんだ！！
Reclaiming the House#058.speaker: Elphaba

Recover the Past#000.src: ...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
Recover the Past#000.dst: …彼は知らない。君から伝えなければ。

Recover the Past#001.src: Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then-
Recover the Past#001.dst: ふん。もっと出力が要るだけかも…呪文に込められる魔力を増やせば—

Recover the Past#002.src: In the meantime, with our subject gone, we'll have to make do with another. There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#002.dst: その間、被験者がいなくなった以上、別の者で間に合わせるしかない。今日は斥候 Reynauld が勤務中だ。君と同じく元は Fruma 出身だよ。

Recover the Past#004.src: It's puzzling, to be sure... if only we could see further. I'll get to work immediately- we must know more!
Recover the Past#004.dst: 確かに不可解だ…もっと先が見えれば。すぐに取りかかる—もっと知らねばならん！

Recover the Past#005.src: Use your Movement Keys to Preview your move, then press Jump to Confirm.
Recover the Past#005.dst: 移動キーで動きをプレビューし、ジャンプで決定。

Recover the Past#006.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Picard 博士と話す。

Recover the Past#007.src: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
Recover the Past#007.dst: 成功だ！成功、成功、成・功！私は天才だ、世界一賢い男だ！
Recover the Past#007.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#008.src: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
Recover the Past#008.dst: そこの君、通りすがりの人！君は魔法の奇跡を目撃したのだ！私はたった今、何年も前の記憶を取り戻すことに成功した！
Recover the Past#008.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#009.src: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
Recover the Past#009.dst: 君も Fruma から来たのだろう？ならば私同様、昔の人生の記憶が消えていることを知っているはずだ。ポン。消えた！
Recover the Past#009.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#010.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the you get the point.
Recover the Past#010.dst: だがこの装置があれば…それを変えられる！失ったものを取り戻す！過去を取り…まあ、わかるだろう。
Recover the Past#010.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#011.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need to be more certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#011.dst: さて、被験者がどうしても必要でね…君でも務まるが、この装置が確かに動くともっと確信したい。
Recover the Past#011.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#012.src: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
Recover the Past#012.dst: 聞きたまえ！提案がある。記憶を取り戻したいだろう？被験者を十分連れてくれば、君が失ったものを見せてあげよう！
Recover the Past#012.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#013.src: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
Recover the Past#013.dst: えーと、えーと…元 Fruma 出身の者が必要だ。この辺りに何人かいる。
Recover the Past#013.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#014.src: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past {p}- follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#014.dst: まずは船乗り志望の Caid からだ。{p} を過ぎたところにいる—道を川までたどれば会える。
Recover the Past#014.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#015.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still in here? Get going!
Recover the Past#015.dst: その間、私はここで調整を続ける…まだ完璧ではない。私自身の記憶もまだ大部分が欠けている…ん？まだいたのか？さっさと行きたまえ！
Recover the Past#015.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#016.src: Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#016.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の船のそばにいる船乗り Caid を見つける。

Recover the Past#017.src: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#017.dst: で？任務は与えたはずだ、なぜまだここにいる？船乗り Caid を探したまえ。{p} を過ぎて、道を川までたどれば会える。
Recover the Past#017.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#018.src: Huh? Oh! I ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
Recover the Past#018.dst: え？おっと！いや、何でもない！ただ…ただ自慢の船を眺めてただけさ！
Recover the Past#018.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#019.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in the tower? Huh. Good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#019.dst: Picard が？塔にこもってるあいつか？へえ。やっと研究が終わったんだな。でも俺に何の用だ？
Recover the Past#019.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#020.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about...
Recover the Past#020.dst: …Fruma の記憶を見る、ねえ？そいつはどうかな。消えてるなら、消えてる理由があるんだろ。お、俺はここで満足してる！何も知る必要なんて…
Recover the Past#020.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#021.src: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
Recover the Past#021.dst: …ああ、わかったよ。記憶を見てもらいに行く。ただ、その前に一つ頼まれてくれよ？
Recover the Past#021.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#022.src: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
Recover the Past#022.dst: 俺はちょっとした造り手でさ。船でも造ってみるかって思って、これがそうだ！なかなかだろ？
Recover the Past#022.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#023.src: That's what I'm talkin' about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
Recover the Past#023.dst: そうこなくちゃ、見たか Reynauld！気に入る奴がいるって思ってたんだ！
Recover the Past#023.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#024.dst: Shift 長押しでリセット。

Recover the Past#025.src: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
Recover the Past#025.dst: おい！へへ、まあ間違っちゃいない。そこらで拾ったガラクタでつぎはぎしたんだ。それでもガラクタの山にしちゃ大したもんだろ？
Recover the Past#025.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#026.src: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
Recover the Past#026.dst: Reynauld には言わないって約束してくれよ…珍しい部品のいくつかは衛兵の宿舎から来てるんだ。大したことない！上前をちょいとはねただけさ…
Recover the Past#026.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#027.src: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived at the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
Recover the Past#027.dst: あと部品一つで完成なんだが、その、ほら…鍛冶屋にちょうど荷が届いたところでさ…言いたいこと、わかるだろ？
Recover the Past#027.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#028.src: Get me the part from the blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#028.dst: 鍛冶屋から部品を持ってきてくれたら、Picard の塔に一緒に行くよ。愛しの船を未完成のまま放っていけないだろ？
Recover the Past#028.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#029.src: Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#029.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の鍛冶屋の家から箱を盗む。

Recover the Past#030.src: Have you gotten the box yet? It's at the blacksmith's, a short walk away from here in {p}. Just, don't get spotted!
Recover the Past#030.dst: 箱はもう手に入れたか？ここからすぐの {p} の鍛冶屋にある。とにかく見つかるなよ！
Recover the Past#030.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#031.src: Bring the package to Caid at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#031.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Caid に包みを届ける。

Recover the Past#032.src: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
Recover the Past#032.dst: …戻ったか！どうだった？ほら、品物をよこせ。
Recover the Past#032.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#033.src: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
Recover the Past#033.dst: 鍛冶屋には見られてないよな？Reynauld に目をつけられてる気がしてさ…
Recover the Past#033.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#034.src: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Recover the Past#034.dst: ああ、まあいい！やっとこの船の仕上げだ！
Recover the Past#034.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#035.src: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
Recover the Past#035.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#036.src: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
Recover the Past#036.dst: そのとおり！まともな船には鐘がつきものだ。それがなきゃ締まらない。
Recover the Past#036.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#037.src: What's with the attitude! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
Recover the Past#037.dst: 何だよその態度！まともな船には鐘がつきものなんだよ、わかるか？渡し船が鐘なしで出航すると思うか？だろうな！
Recover the Past#037.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#038.src: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
Recover the Past#038.dst: とにかく…約束は果たしてもらったし、俺も果たすしかないな！
Recover the Past#038.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#039.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Recover the Past#039.dst: Picard の塔まで案内してくれ！このでかい頭に何が隠れてるか見てやろうじゃないか。
Recover the Past#039.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#040.src: Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#040.dst: Caid を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の塔にいる Picard 博士のもとへ連れていく。

Recover the Past#041.dst: Caid の過去を見届ける。

Recover the Past#042.src: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
Recover the Past#042.dst: おお！戻ったか！よしよし、私の調整のいい試験になる…
Recover the Past#042.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#043.src: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
Recover the Past#043.dst: …なるほど。で、この博士に俺の記憶を任せるのか？
Recover the Past#043.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#044.src: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
Recover the Past#044.dst: まあまあ、私の天才を侮るな。大丈夫だ！たぶん。成功率は九十五、いや、九十パーセントだな。さあ、ここに立ちたまえ。
Recover the Past#044.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#045.src: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
Recover the Past#045.dst: わかった…自分が何してるかわかってるんだよな、博士…
Recover the Past#045.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#046.src: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
Recover the Past#046.dst: さて、あとは…ここで呪文を起動して、あそこのスイッチを押して、そして…
Recover the Past#046.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#048.src: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
Recover the Past#048.dst: よし、何があるか見てみるか…Edwin、そっちの木箱を調べてくれるか？
Recover the Past#048.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#049.src: Sure thing. Say Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#049.dst: いいよ。ねえ Caid。どうやってこういう物を手に入れ続けてるの？高い部品が入ってるし、君に買える値段じゃなさそうだけど。
Recover the Past#049.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#050.src: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
Recover the Past#050.dst: まあ…衛兵向けの最新の補給品が、本来よりちょっと軽くなってる、とだけ言っとくよ。
Recover the Past#050.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#051.src: Wait what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't
Recover the Past#051.dst: え、何だって？Caid、まさか衛兵から盗んでないよね。わかってるだろ、あいつらは
Recover the Past#051.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#052.src: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
Recover the Past#052.dst: Edwin、落ち着け。補給品の上前をちょいとはねてるだけさ。三十個のうち一つ二つ消えても気づきやしない。
Recover the Past#052.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#053.src: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
Recover the Past#053.dst: それに、俺はあいつらなんか怖くない。俺たちを守るためにいるんだろ？今までみたいに警告だけで済ませてくれるさ。
Recover the Past#053.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#054.src: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
Recover the Past#054.dst: そ…そう言うなら。君の言うとおりかもね。本当はあんなに補給品は要らないし。僕らのほうがずっと有効に使える！
Recover the Past#054.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#055.src: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo
Recover the Past#055.dst: そのとおり！わかってくれて嬉しいよ。で、何かいい物は見つか
Recover the Past#055.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#056.src: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
Recover the Past#056.dst: 貴様ら！動くな、逮捕する！
Recover the Past#056.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#058.src: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa
Recover the Past#058.dst: エ、Edwin！戻ってこい、この臆病
Recover the Past#058.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#059.src: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
Recover the Past#059.dst: 貴様はもう黙れ。お前たち二人、共犯者を追え。
Recover the Past#059.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#062.src: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
Recover the Past#062.dst: Caid、帝国の財産を繰り返し盗んだ罪で、貴様を逮捕する。
Recover the Past#062.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#063.src: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
Recover the Past#063.dst: 記録によれば、以前の行為で何度も警告を受けている。これが最後の機会だったが、貴様はそれを完全に無駄にした。
Recover the Past#063.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#064.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#064.dst: 監獄へ連行してさらに尋問し、処遇を決めろ。
Recover the Past#064.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#065.src: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
Recover the Past#065.dst: おい！もしもし？通行人改め助手！ぼんやりしてないで戻ってきたまえ、話がある。
Recover the Past#065.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#066.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there...I wonder what we'd see if we could
Recover the Past#066.dst: ふむ。ふむふむ。記憶はそこで途切れた…もしもっと見られたら何が
Recover the Past#066.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#068.src: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu
Recover the Past#068.dst: ああ、そのようだ…だが、出力を上げられれば、きっと…そうだ！私は天
Recover the Past#068.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#069.src: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
Recover the Past#069.dst: 俺はそれだけの人間なのか？！ただの泥棒…それしか取り柄がないのか？
Recover the Past#069.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#072.src: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
Recover the Past#072.dst: ああ！通行人改め助—もういい、助手と呼ぶことにしよう。やっと我に返ったようだね。
Recover the Past#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#073.src: But that's of no importance now! What, however, is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will change the world!
Recover the Past#073.dst: だが、今それはどうでもいい！重要なのは今見たものだ！記憶が鮮明に再体験された！この装置は本当に世界を変えるぞ！
Recover the Past#073.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#074.src: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested- so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
Recover the Past#074.dst: …とはいえ、だ。出来事の時系列が少々わからん。Caid は逮捕された—ならどうして Wynn で兵士になっている？
Recover the Past#074.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#075.src: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#075.dst: 真相を突き止めるには、もっと被験者が必要だ！今日は斥候 Reynauld が勤務中だ。彼も君と同じく元は Fruma 出身だよ。
Recover the Past#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#076.src: Yes, hm. You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Recover the Past#076.dst: そう、ふむ。{p} への橋の近くにいるはずだ。彼を実験に参加させるよう説得してくれたまえ。科学の名のもとに！
Recover the Past#076.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#077.src: Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#077.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} への橋の近くで斥候 Reynauld を見つける。

Recover the Past#078.src: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
Recover the Past#078.dst: ふむ…この障壁はどこにある？魔法の力が足りず突破できないのか？出力を上げれば、あるいは…
Recover the Past#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#079.src: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}.
Recover the Past#079.dst: うわっ！助手！ここで何をしている？斥候 Reynauld とはもう話したか？{p} への橋の近くにいるぞ。
Recover the Past#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#080.dst: ほっといてくれ…いいな？
Recover the Past#080.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#081.src: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
Recover the Past#081.dst: ああ、こんにちは。どうしました？私に何か用がありそうな顔ですね。
Recover the Past#081.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#082.src: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
