Recover the Past#082.dst: ん？あの変わった博士が私に会いたいと？記憶を取り戻すため？あの男はあまり信用できませんが…本当に効くのかは気になります。
Recover the Past#082.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#083.src: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? {p} would be left defenseless.
Recover the Past#083.dst: ですが残念ながら、お断りします。持ち場を空けるわけにはいきません。腐敗した者が襲ってきたら？{p} は無防備になります。
Recover the Past#083.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#084.src: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
Recover the Past#084.dst: ふむ、そうですね。少しの間だけなら大丈夫かもしれません。襲撃が起きたら手を貸すと約束してくれるなら。
Recover the Past#084.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#085.src: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
Recover the Past#085.dst: では決まりです。博士に会いに行きましょう。ですが、まず見張りを任せる人が必要です。心当たりはありますか？
Recover the Past#085.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#086.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do. I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#086.dst: Caid？あの…ろくでなしか。補給品を盗んでるんです、間違いない。証拠がないだけで。でも、あなたが彼でいいと思うなら大丈夫でしょう。
Recover the Past#086.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#087.src: I saw him heading to the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#087.dst: 少し前、彼が神殿のほうへ行くのを見ました。心変わりしたのかもしれません。Caid のところへ案内を、すぐ後ろについて行きます。
Recover the Past#087.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#088.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Reynauld のもとへ戻る。

Recover the Past#089.src: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You lead the way to him, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#089.dst: Caid が心変わりしたのかもしれません。彼のところへ案内してください、すぐ後ろについて行きます。
Recover the Past#089.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#090.src: Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#090.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で、橋の見張りをするよう Caid を説得する。

Recover the Past#091.src: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Recover the Past#091.dst: なんだ、またお前か。何の用だ？
Recover the Past#091.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#092.src: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
Recover the Past#092.dst: 私たちです、あなたに頼みがあります。こちらの共通の友人が、私をある実験に誘おうとしていまして。
Recover the Past#092.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#093.src: Only, my participation would leave {p} undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
Recover the Past#093.dst: ただ、私が参加すると {p} の守りが空きます。そこで、私が手を離せない間、見張りを引き受けてくれないかと。
Recover the Past#093.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#094.src: Really? You're asking me to guard {p}?
Recover the Past#094.dst: 本気か？俺に {p} を守れって？
Recover the Past#094.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#095.src: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of {p} in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third
Recover the Past#095.dst: 誤解しないでください、{p} の安全を泥ぼ…あなたのような人の手に委ねたくはない。控えめに言っても第一候補ではなかった、第二でも、第三でも
Recover the Past#095.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#098.src: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
Recover the Past#098.dst: やるのですか？思ったより簡単でしたね。いいですか、襲撃の兆しが見えたら、すぐ博士の塔まで走って知らせてください。戦いは専門家に任せて。
Recover the Past#098.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#099.src: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#099.dst: 言われなくてもそうするさ！でも Reynauld、過去は理由があって忘れられてるのかもしれないぜ。
Recover the Past#099.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#100.src: Well, I suppose that settles that. Let's hurry to the doctor. I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#100.dst: さて、これで決まりですね。急いで博士のもとへ。{p} の安全を、あの手癖の悪い男に必要以上に預けたくありません。
Recover the Past#100.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#101.src: Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#101.dst: 助けてくれてありがとう、Tasim と {u}。それに Caid も…

Recover the Past#102.src: Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#102.dst: Reynauld を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の塔にいる Picard 博士のもとへ連れていく。

Recover the Past#103.src: Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#103.dst: 急いで博士のもとへ。{p} の安全を、あの手癖の悪い男に必要以上に預けたくありません。
Recover the Past#103.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#104.dst: Reynauld の過去を見届ける。

Recover the Past#105.src: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
Recover the Past#105.dst: おお、助手！おかえり、次の被験者を連れてきたようだね！素晴らしい！
Recover the Past#105.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#107.src: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
Recover the Past#107.dst: まあまあ、前へ。遠慮はいらん！さあこっちへ！オーブをまっすぐ見つめて、思い出すことに集中したまえ。
Recover the Past#107.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#108.dst: これ、安全なんですよね？
Recover the Past#108.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#109.src: Yes, yes! Not to worry, the device has been extensively tested on Caid. Very quickly, I just need to activate this... cast a spell here... and...
Recover the Past#109.dst: ああ、もちろん！心配いらん、Caid で徹底的に試験済みだ。すぐ済む、これを起動して…ここで呪文を唱えて…そして…
Recover the Past#109.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#111.src: H-huh? Hey, who's there? Why are you knocking at this hour
Recover the Past#111.dst: ん、んん？おい、誰だ？こんな時間にノックなんて
Recover the Past#111.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#113.src: Yes, it's me. Mind if I step inside?
Recover the Past#113.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#114.src: N-no, of course not- Uh. It would have been nice if, you know, you warned me you would be coming!
Recover the Past#114.dst: い、いや、もちろん—その。来るなら前もって、ほら、知らせてくれりゃよかったのに！
Recover the Past#114.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#115.src: You know that isn't how this works. Now, where are the goods?
Recover the Past#115.dst: そういう決まりではないでしょう。さて、品物はどこです？
Recover the Past#115.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#116.src: Right... always straight to business with you. Never oh, how was your week? Always just-...
Recover the Past#116.dst: はいはい…あんたはいつもすぐ本題だ。「今週どうだった？」の一言もなし。いつも…
Recover the Past#116.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#117.src: Fine. It's up and over here.
Recover the Past#117.dst: わかったよ。こっちの上だ。
Recover the Past#117.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#118.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#118.dst: 近くの…ええと、工場の一つから部品を拾ってきた。これが…たぶん必要な物だと思う。
Recover the Past#118.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#119.src: ... Hm. One of the factories, you say? And you're sure you weren't spotted doing it? If I were caught speaking to a known criminal, you know the consequences for both of us.
Recover the Past#119.dst: …ふむ。工場の一つ、ですか？誰にも見られていないのは確かですね？前科者と話しているところを見られたら、二人ともどうなるかわかっているでしょう。
Recover the Past#119.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#120.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#120.dst: み、見られてない。その…用心した。夜に入ったんだ。わかるだろ。
Recover the Past#120.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#122.src: S-so... is that enough? I've gotten you what you asked for.
Recover the Past#122.dst: そ、それで…これで足りるか？頼まれた物は持ってきたぞ。
Recover the Past#122.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#123.src: Well... it is that, yes. But, Caid, you know the risk I take every time I come out here to speak with you. I'll need more than just the bare minimum to guarantee your safety.
Recover the Past#123.dst: まあ…確かに持ってきましたね。ですが Caid、ここへ来るたびに私がどれほど危険を冒しているか知っているでしょう。あなたの安全を保証するには、最低限では足りません。
Recover the Past#123.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#124.src: I hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#124.dst: 俺—ふん。わかった、わかったよ、エメラルドも—上乗せする。色をつけるよ。
Recover the Past#124.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#125.src: Excellent. A pleasure doing business, as always. I'll be back in a few weeks.
Recover the Past#125.dst: 結構。いつもどおり、良い取引でした。数週間後にまた来ます。
Recover the Past#125.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#126.dst: 隊長、お呼びでしょうか？
Recover the Past#126.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#127.src: Ah, Reynauld. Good to see you. Come in, come in.
Recover the Past#127.dst: ああ、Reynauld。よく来た。入れ、入れ。
Recover the Past#127.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#128.src: Might I ask what this meeting is for, sir?
Recover the Past#128.dst: この面談の目的をお聞きしても、隊長？
Recover the Past#128.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#129.src: Oh, nothing too special. I just wanted to have a quick chat about your performance.
Recover the Past#129.dst: なに、大したことではない。君の勤務ぶりについて少し話したくてな。
Recover the Past#129.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#130.src: You understand that those of us who serve Her Majesty in such well regarded positions have a certain... strict code of honor we must follow, yes?
Recover the Past#130.dst: 女王陛下にお仕えする、これほど尊敬される地位の者には、守るべき厳格な…名誉の規範がある。わかるな？
Recover the Past#130.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#131.src: Otherwise, how could we be certain our ranks are pure of any misdeeds? We must set an example for the people of our great province.
Recover the Past#131.dst: さもなくば、我らの隊列に不正がないとどうして言い切れる？我らはこの偉大な州の民の模範とならねばならん。
Recover the Past#131.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#132.src: Now, what do you think might happen if one of our own happened to... bend, or break that code of honour? What sort of a precedent would that set?
Recover the Past#132.dst: では、もし身内の誰かが…その名誉の規範を曲げたり破ったりしたら、どうなると思う？どんな前例になる？
Recover the Past#132.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#134.src: It is with no great pleasure that I inform you that you, Reynauld, are to be stripped of your rank and arrested under charges of dishonour and conspiracy against Her Majesty.
Recover the Past#134.dst: 大変遺憾ながら通告する。Reynauld、君は階級を剥奪され、不名誉および女王陛下への陰謀の罪で逮捕される。
Recover the Past#134.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#135.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your own secrets.
Recover the Past#135.dst: 君の共犯者、あの供給役が先日捕まった。聞けば、ほとんど迷うことなく君の秘密を洗いざらい話したそうだ。
Recover the Past#135.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#136.src: There is no place for your spot in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#136.dst: 君の居場所は我らの隊列にはない、Reynauld。こうなってしまって残念だ。
Recover the Past#136.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#137.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! There's more to discuss.
Recover the Past#137.dst: 助手！しっかりしたまえ！まだ話すことがある。
Recover the Past#137.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#139.src: Marvelous! Assistant, you've done very well so far! We're closer than ever to uncovering the mystery of Fruma!
Recover the Past#139.dst: 素晴らしい！助手、ここまで実によくやった！Fruma の謎の解明にかつてなく近づいているぞ！
Recover the Past#139.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#141.src: {u}!? Didn't think I'd stumble upon you all the way out here!
Recover the Past#141.dst: {u}！？こんな遠くで君に会うなんて思わなかったよ！
Recover the Past#141.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#142.src: There's time for pleasantries later. Tasim? Why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#142.dst: 挨拶は後で。Tasim？なぜここに？Caid はどこです？
Recover the Past#142.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#143.src: The Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defenses. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#143.dst: 提督に {p} の防衛を強化するよう言われて来たんだ。橋で君に会うと思ってたけど、いたのは Caid だけだった。
Recover the Past#143.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#144.src: He said there was an assault on {p} gathering and that you were here, then he ran away.
Recover the Past#144.dst: {p} を狙う部隊が集まってて、君がここにいるって言って、それから逃げていったんだ。
Recover the Past#144.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#145.src: That damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#145.dst: あの忌々しい泥棒め！離れるべきではなかった…すべて間違いだった…くそ。
Recover the Past#145.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#146.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go, Tasim and {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#146.dst: もう一刻の猶予もありません。行きましょう、Tasim、{u}。{p} を救わねば。
Recover the Past#146.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#147.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. For science of course! Now, now, be off. {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#147.dst: あの Tasim とやら、彼も Fruma 出身だろう？君の仲間なら、我々のささやかな実験に誘いたまえ。もちろん科学のためだ！さあさあ、行きたまえ。{p} を救わねば！
Recover the Past#147.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#148.src: Rush to defend {p} from the incursion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#149.src: Assistant! What are you still doing here? Your friends seem to be in need of your assistance!
Recover the Past#149.dst: 助手！まだここで何をしている？友人たちが君の助けを必要としているようだぞ！
Recover the Past#149.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#150.src: Besides, this might be an opportunity to recruit that Tasim to our experiment! Hm, yes, he would certainly be an interesting specimen to examine!
Recover the Past#150.dst: それに、あの Tasim を実験に誘う好機かもしれん！ふむ、そうだ、実に興味深い標本になるに違いない！
Recover the Past#150.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#151.src: They'll be coming for this bridge any minute now. We will need to stand ready.
Recover the Past#151.dst: 敵はいつこの橋に来てもおかしくありません。備えましょう。
Recover the Past#151.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#152.dst: {u}、{p} を守る準備はいいですか？
Recover the Past#152.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#153.src: Good answer, soldier. We'll take them down, no matter how many they throw at us!
Recover the Past#153.dst: いい返事です、兵士。何体来ようと、すべて倒します！
Recover the Past#153.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#154.src: Do whatever you have to first, but be quick. The enemy might arrive at any moment.
Recover the Past#154.dst: 先に済ませることがあれば済ませてください、ただし急いで。敵はいつ来てもおかしくない。
Recover the Past#154.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#155.dst: 腐敗した者たちの侵攻から {p} を守れ！

Recover the Past#156.src: Tasim, you take the front, I'll provide cover from behind.
Recover the Past#156.dst: Tasim、前を頼みます。私は後ろから援護します。
Recover the Past#156.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#157.src: It would be my pleasure, Reynauld!
Recover the Past#157.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#158.src: Shouldn't be much longer now... If only Aledar was here, it'd be like old times again. Don't you think?
Recover the Past#158.dst: もうすぐのはず…Aledar もここにいたら、昔みたいだったのにな。そう思わない？
Recover the Past#158.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#159.src: I have eyes on the target! Corrupted forces incoming!
Recover the Past#159.dst: 目標を捕捉！腐敗した軍勢が来ます！
Recover the Past#159.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#161.src: Damn it. That leader looks shielded! How do we take it down?
Recover the Past#161.dst: くそ。あの首領、盾で守られているようです！どう倒せば？
Recover the Past#161.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#162.src: The spikes must be its weak point!
Recover the Past#162.dst: あのトゲが弱点に違いない！
Recover the Past#162.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#163.src: You're right! Tasim, {u}. As long as you can keep the enemy away from me, I can line up a good shot at the spikes. That's our only chance at taking this thing down.
Recover the Past#163.dst: そのとおりです！Tasim、{u}。敵を私から遠ざけてくれれば、トゲを狙って確実に撃ち抜けます。あれを倒す唯一のチャンスです。
Recover the Past#163.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#164.src: ... Ah. Turns out this might be a little tougher than expected. But, let's give it our all!
Recover the Past#164.dst: …あ。思ったより手強いかも。でも、全力でいこう！
Recover the Past#164.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#165.src: Just... a little more... to the right...
Recover the Past#165.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#166.src: That's it! It's got to be...
Recover the Past#166.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#167.src: Reynauld! What do we do now? We can't beat it like this...
Recover the Past#167.dst: Reynauld！どうする？このままじゃ勝てない…
Recover the Past#167.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#168.src: I'm trying to think but... I've never...
Recover the Past#168.dst: 考えているが…こんなのは初めて…
Recover the Past#168.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#169.src: Tasim, {u}, you continue to hold them off. I'll think of something, anything...
Recover the Past#169.dst: Tasim、{u}、そのまま食い止めてください。何か考えます、何でもいい…
Recover the Past#169.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#170.src: We can't give up now, not while {p} is still in danger!
Recover the Past#170.dst: 今は諦められない、{p} がまだ危ないのに！
Recover the Past#170.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#171.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Recover the Past#171.dst: Reynauld、効いてない！次々来る…何か別の手を…打たないと、もたないよ！
Recover the Past#171.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#172.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. Three men alone can't defeat this!
Recover the Past#172.dst: そうですね。撤退して {p} に援軍を頼むしかない。三人だけでは倒せません！
Recover the Past#172.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#173.dst: でも、三人だけじゃないぜ！
Recover the Past#173.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#175.src: Caid, what are you doing here!? It's too dangerous, leave this one to the professionals!
Recover the Past#175.dst: Caid、なぜここに！？危険すぎる、これは専門家に任せなさい！
Recover the Past#175.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#176.src: I'm done, I'm done letting my future slip out of my fingers!
Recover the Past#176.dst: もうたくさんだ、未来が指の間からこぼれていくのはもうたくさんだ！
Recover the Past#176.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#177.dst: Caid、よせ！君には…無理だ、そんな
Recover the Past#177.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#180.src: Now, Reynauld! Shoot! For goodness' sake, shoot! While it's distracted!
Recover the Past#180.dst: 今だ、Reynauld！撃て！頼むから撃ってくれ！気を取られてるうちに！
Recover the Past#180.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#181.src: It-It's coming down! Now's our chance!
Recover the Past#181.dst: た、倒れるぞ！今がチャンスだ！
Recover the Past#181.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#182.src: We did it... We really did it!
Recover the Past#182.dst: やった…本当にやったんだ！
Recover the Past#182.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#186.src: Caid! You made it! You're a hero!
Recover the Past#186.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#187.src: That's all well and good but, what about your boat?
Recover the Past#187.dst: それは何よりですが、あなたの船はどうするんです？
Recover the Past#187.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#188.src: I can always build another one, can't I?
Recover the Past#188.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#189.src: Ha. But not using my belongings this time.
Recover the Past#189.dst: はは。ですが今度は私の物を使わないでくださいよ。
Recover the Past#189.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#190.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough, considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case. Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#190.dst: さて、状況を考えれば Caid はまずまず無事なようです。念のため診てもらいに連れていきます。助けてくれてありがとう、Tasim と {u}。それに Caid も…
Recover the Past#190.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#191.src: You must be wanting to take Tasim with you for your experiment. After all you've done today, I can hardly object. But, Tasim...
Recover the Past#191.dst: Tasim を実験に連れていきたいのでしょう。今日のあなたの働きを思えば、反対はできません。ですが Tasim…
Recover the Past#191.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#192.src: Think carefully before looking into that crystal. For some, the past is filled with things they'd rather forget.
Recover the Past#192.dst: あの水晶を覗く前によく考えなさい。人によっては、過去は忘れたいことだらけです。
Recover the Past#192.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#193.src: Recovering memories from Fruma, huh... I guess that's something I'd be interested in. I've had a strange feeling about it, ever since we first realized we lost them.
Recover the Past#193.dst: Fruma の記憶を取り戻す、か…それは確かに興味がある。記憶をなくしたと初めて気づいた時から、ずっと妙な感じがしてたんだ。
Recover the Past#193.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#194.src: You were there, remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
Recover the Past#194.dst: 君もいたよね？Wynn に来たばかりで…Aledar も一緒で、あいつ初日に死にかけたんだ！向こうでもっと気をつけてるといいけど…
Recover the Past#194.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#195.src: Well, anyway. Please, lead the way to the doctor. I'm intrigued to see what it's all about.
Recover the Past#195.dst: まあ、とにかく。博士のところへ案内してくれるかな。どういうことか、ぜひ見てみたい。
Recover the Past#195.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#196.src: Bring Tasim to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#196.dst: Tasim を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の塔にいる Picard 博士のもとへ連れていく。

Recover the Past#197.dst: Tasim の過去を見届ける。

Recover the Past#198.src: ... Oh, {u}, you're back with yet another subject I see! Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb.
Recover the Past#198.dst: …おお、{u}、また新しい被験者を連れてきたね！素晴らしい、素晴らしい。さあ、オーブの前へ。
Recover the Past#198.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#199.src: So, doctor. You're certain this is safe? Reynauld warned me that
Recover the Past#199.dst: それで、博士。本当に安全なんですか？Reynauld が言うには
Recover the Past#199.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#200.src: Oh, yes, yes. We've tested it with two subjects before, haven't we, {u}? Besides, I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#200.dst: ああ、もちろんだ。前に二人の被験者で試したとも、なあ {u}？それに計算もした！すべて問題なしだ！
Recover the Past#200.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#201.src: There's only the tiniest bit of instability. Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then
Recover the Past#201.dst: ほんのわずかに不安定なだけだ。ふん。もっと出力が要るだけかも…呪文に込められる魔力を増やせば
Recover the Past#201.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#202.src: Hold on. You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?
Recover the Past#202.dst: 待って。もう不安定なのに、さらに魔力を込めたいって？
Recover the Past#202.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#203.src: Don't you want to know what your life was like before? Even if it's not what you want to see, isn't it better to know?
Recover the Past#203.dst: 以前の自分の人生がどんなだったか、知りたくないのかね？見たくないものだとしても、知っているほうがいいだろう？
Recover the Past#203.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#204.src: Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but I'll do it.
Recover the Past#204.dst: わかった。僕の記憶を見てもいい。その考えに賛成かはわからないけど…やるよ。
Recover the Past#204.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#205.src: Excellent, I'm glad to hear that! Now. Activating in three... two... one... go!
Recover the Past#205.dst: 素晴らしい、そう言ってくれて嬉しい！では。起動まで三…二…一…それ！
Recover the Past#205.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#206.src: All hands on deck! Arrest that insurgent!
Recover the Past#206.dst: 総員配置につけ！あの反逆者を捕らえろ！
Recover the Past#206.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#208.src: Grr... He couldn't have gotten far. All of you, search the city! Leave no corner unturned! Don't let him get away!
Recover the Past#208.dst: ぐぬ…遠くへは行けんはずだ。全員、街を捜索しろ！隅々まで調べ上げろ！逃がすな！
Recover the Past#208.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#209.src: I- oh, this is bad... What can I...
Recover the Past#209.dst: 僕…ああ、まずい…どうすれば…
Recover the Past#209.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#210.src: ...Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's...
Recover the Past#210.dst: …くそ。何もかもくそだ。このまま出血で死なせるわけにはいかない、たとえこいつが…
Recover the Past#210.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#212.src: It's fine, you'll be fine... I know what to do, even if I really shouldn't...
Recover the Past#212.dst: 大丈夫、きっと助かる…どうすればいいかはわかる、本当はやっちゃいけないけど…
Recover the Past#212.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#213.src: G-gah! Wh-where am I? Who are you? I need to get
Recover the Past#213.dst: う、うわっ！こ、ここはどこだ？お前は誰だ？早く行かな

Recover the Past#214.dst: ああ。お前…お前、呪われし者か。
Recover the Past#214.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#215.src: He's in here! And he has an accomplice! Arrest them both!
Recover the Past#215.dst: ここにいるぞ！共犯者もいる！二人とも逮捕しろ！
Recover the Past#215.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#216.src: My magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...
Recover the Past#216.dst: 魔法が持ちこたえられん…だが、まだ見るべきものがあるのは明らかだ！出力を上げる…
Recover the Past#216.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#217.src: So, what? I should have just let you bleed out in my home? Don't be ridiculous.
Recover the Past#217.dst: だから何？家で君が出血して死ぬのを放っておけばよかったって？馬鹿言うなよ。
Recover the Past#217.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#218.src: Yes! You should have! Because now, not only have I been arrested for crimes against the crown, but you've also been outed as one of the cursed. Wouldn't have happened if you had just... stood by.
Recover the Past#218.dst: そうだ！そうすべきだったんだ！おかげで俺は王家への罪で捕まり、お前まで呪われし者だとバレた。お前がただ…黙って見てれば、こうはならなかった。
Recover the Past#218.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#219.src: ...It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.
Recover the Past#219.dst: …あれが正しかったんだ。助けられることがあるのに、黙って見てるなんてできなかった。
Recover the Past#219.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#220.src: Well, a lot of good that's done us. You know no one gets out of here, right? When they take you, you're never heard from again! So, that's where we're at.
Recover the Past#220.dst: ああ、おかげで大助かりだよ。ここから出た奴はいないって知ってるだろ？連れていかれたら、二度と消息は聞かない！それが今の俺たちだ。
Recover the Past#220.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#222.src: Tasim. It's your time. Follow me.
Recover the Past#222.dst: Tasim。お前の番だ。ついて来い。
Recover the Past#222.speaker: Royal Guard

Recover the Past#223.src: Good luck out there, Tasim. You'll need it.
Recover the Past#223.dst: 外でも達者でな、Tasim。運が要るぞ。
Recover the Past#223.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#224.src: See you on the other side, Aledar.
Recover the Past#224.dst: 向こう側でまた会おう、Aledar。
Recover the Past#224.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#225.src: Ahem. We're ready for the process. Prepare the Adjustor.
Recover the Past#225.dst: おほん。処置の準備が整った。アジャスターを用意しろ。
Recover the Past#225.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#226.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to
Recover the Past#226.dst: な—何だって？僕に何をするつも
Recover the Past#226.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#227.src: Silence. Before we begin, I want to make one thing clear. We do not need your ilk in Fruma. We do not want your ilk in Fruma.
Recover the Past#227.dst: 黙れ。始める前に一つ明言しておく。Fruma にお前のような輩は必要ない。Fruma はお前のような輩を望まない。
Recover the Past#227.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#228.src: What we will do with you today is a kindness, a mercy. If the world were to have its way, you would be far worse off. Remember that as we continue.
Recover the Past#228.dst: 今日お前に施すのは慈悲であり、情けだ。世の意のままにされれば、お前はもっと酷い目に遭う。続ける間、それを覚えておけ。
Recover the Past#228.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#230.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents would be useful.
Recover the Past#230.dst: お前は新兵であり、戦争に加わるため Wynn 地方へ送られる。自分の特異な…才能が役立つと考え、志願したのだ。
Recover the Past#230.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#231.src: Fruma is nothing but a speck in your history. A fact set in stone, with details lost to the hypothetical past. You think of it fondly, but remember nothing.
Recover the Past#231.dst: Fruma はお前の過去の一点にすぎない。石に刻まれた事実だが、詳細は仮初めの過去に失われた。懐かしく思うが、何も覚えていない。
Recover the Past#231.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#232.src: You will fight in their war. You will live for it, you will die for it. You will be of Wynn forever, and Fruma will be glad to be rid of you.
Recover the Past#232.dst: お前は彼らの戦争で戦う。そのために生き、そのために死ぬ。お前は永遠に Wynn のものとなり、Fruma はお前を厄介払いできて喜ぶだろう。
Recover the Past#232.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#235.src: Must I repeat myself? Do you understand?
Recover the Past#235.dst: 繰り返させる気か？わかったか？
Recover the Past#235.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#236.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
Recover the Past#236.dst: もう一度だけ問う。指令は理解したか？
Recover the Past#236.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#238.src: Wonderful. Take this one to the caravan. It looks like we'll be able to fit in two more for today's batch.
Recover the Past#238.dst: 結構。こいつを馬車隊へ連れていけ。今日の分にはあと二人入りそうだ。
Recover the Past#238.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#243.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! You've gone in too deep, the memory is sucking you in!
Recover the Past#243.dst: 助手！しっかりしたまえ！深入りしすぎだ、記憶に飲み込まれているぞ！
Recover the Past#243.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#244.src: Good grief- there you are! Do you understand how dangerous that was?!
Recover the Past#244.dst: やれやれ—戻ったか！今のがどれほど危険だったかわかっているのか？！
Recover the Past#244.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#245.src: What do you think happens to me if one of my assistants gets trapped in their memories forever! Nothing good!
Recover the Past#245.dst: 助手が記憶に永遠に閉じ込められたら、私がどうなると思う！ろくなことにならん！
Recover the Past#245.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#246.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! Come on, come over here, we have much to discuss.
Recover the Past#246.dst: …まあ、いい。おかげで情報は増えた。だが二度とやるなよ！さあ、こっちへ来たまえ、話すことが山ほどある。
Recover the Past#246.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#247.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm... I'm not sure what to do with this information.
Recover the Past#247.dst: …ふん。正直、私は…この情報をどう扱えばいいかわからん。
Recover the Past#247.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#248.src: The memory restorification orb worked as well as I could expect for a single use... but, good grief, that was upsetting to watch.
Recover the Past#248.dst: 記憶復元化オーブは一回の使用としては期待どおりに働いた…だが、やれやれ、見ていて気が滅入った。
Recover the Past#248.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#249.src: It stands to reason both Caid and Reynauld also experienced this... and my magic couldn't break through that wall...
Recover the Past#249.dst: Caid と Reynauld も同じ目に遭ったと考えるのが自然だ…そして私の魔法はあの壁を破れなかった…
Recover the Past#249.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#250.src: Is this what they're doing to their criminals out there, in Fruma? Casting them out to fight in Wynn's war?
Recover the Past#250.dst: これが Fruma で罪人にしていることなのか？追放して Wynn の戦争で戦わせると？
Recover the Past#250.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#251.src: ... I'll have to think on how much I want to delve into memories. In any case! At the very start of this, I promised you we could view your memories.
Recover the Past#251.dst: …記憶をどこまで掘り下げるか、考えねばならん。とにかく！最初に、君の記憶を見せると約束したな。
Recover the Past#251.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#252.src: The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Just step up to the orb, like the others did.
Recover the Past#252.dst: その申し出はまだ有効だ、望むならね。ほかの者と同じくオーブの前に立ちたまえ。
Recover the Past#252.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#253.src: Well? The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Simply step up to the orb, just like the others did.
Recover the Past#253.dst: で？申し出はまだ有効だ、望むならね。ほかの者と同じように、オーブの前に立つだけだ。
Recover the Past#253.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#254.src: H-huh?! The orb! My beautiful memory restorification orb! It's ruined!
Recover the Past#254.dst: え、ええっ？！オーブが！私の美しい記憶復元化オーブが！壊れた！
Recover the Past#254.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#255.src: ... Oh, whatever. I have the blueprints stored somewhere around here. I can always make another... but still.
Recover the Past#255.dst: …まあ、いい。設計図はこの辺りにしまってある。また作ればいい…とはいえな。
Recover the Past#255.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#257.src: Oh! Oh, right! My apologies, I completely forgot to check in with you! Are you alright?
Recover the Past#257.dst: おお！そうだった！すまない、君の様子を確かめるのをすっかり忘れていた！大丈夫かね？
Recover the Past#257.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#258.src: None of the other test subjects experienced this powerful a reaction... strange. It's almost like we're accessing memories that didn't exist.
Recover the Past#258.dst: ほかの被験者はこれほど強い反応を示さなかった…妙だ。まるで存在しなかった記憶にアクセスしているかのようだ。
Recover the Past#258.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#259.src: ... Well. Ehem. In any case, I'll need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
Recover the Past#259.dst: …さて。ごほん。とにかく、研究を続けねば。まだ学ぶことがあるはずだ…
Recover the Past#259.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#260.src: As thanks for your help. Here, a reward. Ah, also... I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him.
Recover the Past#260.dst: 手伝ってくれた礼だ。ほら、報酬を。ああ、それと…君の友人が塔のすぐ外にいるはずだ。様子を見てきたらどうかね。
Recover the Past#260.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#261.src: Find Tasim outside Dr. Picard's tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#261.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Picard 博士の塔の外で Tasim を見つける。

Recover the Past#263.src: Cursed. He called me cursed. What does that mean for me...?
Recover the Past#263.dst: 呪われし者。あいつは僕をそう呼んだ。それって僕にとって何を意味するんだ…？
Recover the Past#263.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#264.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.
Recover the Past#264.dst: それにあの異端審問官…どう考えればいいかわからない。僕たち全員が Wynn に着いた時に知ってると思ってたこと…どれも本当じゃなかった。
Recover the Past#264.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#265.src: ... Did the two of us really meet through sheer random luck? He was running from something, and... fell straight into my life.
Recover the Past#265.dst: …僕たち二人は本当にただの偶然で出会ったのか？あいつは何かから逃げてて…僕の人生に転がり込んできた。
Recover the Past#265.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#266.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.
Recover the Past#266.dst: 僕—少し一人で考えたい。見つめ直したいんだ。お願いだから…このことは Aledar に言わないで。
Recover the Past#266.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#267.src: He doesn't need to know about all of this. He's- he's better off not knowing.
Recover the Past#267.dst: あいつはこんなこと知らなくていい。あいつは—知らないほうがいいんだ。
Recover the Past#267.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#268.src: ... I'm going to head for the Gavel Province, I think. It's across the ocean, far enough from... From all of this.
Recover the Past#268.dst: …Gavel 地方へ向かおうと思う。海の向こうで、ここから…このすべてから十分遠いから。
Recover the Past#268.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#269.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll run into each other, eventually.
Recover the Past#269.dst: 強くなったら、君も行くといい。いつかまた会えるかもしれない。
Recover the Past#269.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#270.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.
Recover the Past#270.dst: じゃあ、ひとまずお別れだね。永遠じゃない、ひとまずだ。またね、{u}。
Recover the Past#270.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#271.src: ... I'm just resting here, a little. I'll be on my way soon.
Recover the Past#271.dst: …ここで少し休んでるだけ。すぐに出発するよ。
Recover the Past#271.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#272.src: It's the box Caid was talking about...
Recover the Past#272.dst: Caid が言っていた箱だ…

Recover the Past#001~1.dst: ぐ、ぐわっ！何が起きてる？

Recover the Past#002~1.src: Well. Bystander-turned-assis- you know what, I'll just call you my assistant- not quite the response I was looking for... a shame, too- I truly believe we were on to something.
Recover the Past#002~1.dst: ふむ。通行人改め助- いや、もう助手と呼ぼう- 期待した反応ではないな…残念だ- 本当に何かをつかみかけていたと思うのだが。

Recover the Past#089~1.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do, I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#089~1.dst: Caid？あの…ろくでなしか。補給品を盗んでるんです、間違いない。証拠がないだけで。でも、あなたが彼でいいと思うなら大丈夫でしょう。
Recover the Past#089~1.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#090~1.src: Yes, fine, I understand you've taken issue with my methodology. But it works! This has worked thrice now!
Recover the Past#090~1.dst: ああ、わかった、私の手法に異論があるのは承知だ。だが効果はある！もう三度も成功しているのだ！

Recover the Past#091~1.src: Sigh... all of that, and we still weren't able to see what comes next! I swear, I was able to see more when I looked at my own memories! It's ridicu-
Recover the Past#091~1.dst: はあ…あれだけやって、まだ続きが見られないとは！誓って言うが、自分の記憶を見た時はもっと見えたのだ！ばかげて-

Recover the Past#141~1.src: There is no place for your sort in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#141~1.dst: 我らの隊に貴様のような者の居場所はない、Reynauld。こうなったのは残念だ。
Recover the Past#141~1.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#216~1.src: ... Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's-...
Recover the Past#216~1.dst: …くそっ。何もかも。見殺しにはできない、たとえこいつが-…
Recover the Past#216~1.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#217~1.src: ... You really shouldn't have gotten involved, you know.
Recover the Past#217~1.dst: …本当は関わるべきじゃなかったんだよ。

Recover the Past#218~1.src: Besides, we have used the spell on two subjects already, and it has gone perfectly fine for both of them... eh, for the most part. There's only the slightest bit of instability.
Recover the Past#218~1.dst: それに、この呪文はもう二人の被験者に使ったが、二人とも完璧にうまくいった…まあ、おおむね。ほんのわずかに不安定なだけだ。

Redbeard's Booty#000.src: Talk with Marston in the ocean at [-{~} {~} -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#000.dst: [-{~} {~} -{~}] の海上で Marston と話す

Redbeard's Booty#001.src: Ah, ahoy matey! Are ye here to get a glimpse of ol' Redbeard's sunken galleon as well?
Redbeard's Booty#001.dst: おう、よう相棒！お前さんも老 Redbeard の沈んだガレオン船を拝みに来たのか？
Redbeard's Booty#001.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#002.src: A fine ship it once was, aye? Accordin' to the stories, it sank in one o' the greatest sea battles in history! The cap'n sank beneath the waves, ne'er to be seen again!
Redbeard's Booty#002.dst: かつては立派な船だったろう？言い伝えじゃ、史上最大の海戦の一つで沈んだそうだ！船長は波の下へ沈み、二度と姿を見せなかった！
Redbeard's Booty#002.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#003.src: ...Say. Have ye ever wanted to go on a real treasure hunt? Ye look like someone with an eye for treasure, aye?
Redbeard's Booty#003.dst: …なあ。本物の宝探しに行きてえと思ったことはねえか？お前さん、お宝を見る目がありそうだ。
Redbeard's Booty#003.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#004.src: Good for ye then! I bought meself a real treasure map on Pirate Cove, a fine deal if ye ask me. And, if the jack wasn't fibbing, it leads to the feared Redbeard's real treasure!
Redbeard's Booty#004.dst: そいつはいい！俺は海賊の入り江で本物の宝の地図を買ったんだ、いい買い物だったぜ。あの野郎が嘘をついてなきゃ、恐るべき Redbeard の本物の財宝につながってる！
Redbeard's Booty#004.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#005.src: I ventured 'round, spied some fine jacks at the island, and I collected a crew to join me on me grand, fantastic voyage!
Redbeard's Booty#005.dst: あちこち回って、島で腕の立つ連中を見つけて、俺の壮大で素晴らしい航海の仲間を集めたのさ！
Redbeard's Booty#005.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#006.src: O' course, there always be room for another! Ye joinin'? We could use another hand.
Redbeard's Booty#006.dst: もちろん、もう一人分の席はいつだってある！乗るか？人手はもっと欲しい。
Redbeard's Booty#006.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#007.src: Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever you landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.
Redbeard's Booty#007.dst: よし！お宝を見つけて金貨を持ち帰ろうぜ！これが手に入れた地図だ。泳ぐなり何なり、陸モンのやり方で海賊の入り江まで来い。着いたら右手の一軒目の家だ。
Redbeard's Booty#007.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#008.src: Find Marston's crew on Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#008.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の海賊の入り江で Marston の船員を見つける

Redbeard's Booty#009.src: And that be when ye will...
Redbeard's Booty#009.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#010.src: Cor lad...ye don' look like a pirate ta me, and I be but a young lass!
Redbeard's Booty#010.dst: おやまあ坊や…あんた海賊には見えないね、あたいはただの若い娘だけどさ！
Redbeard's Booty#010.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#011.src: 's right, bucko. Who be ye, bargin' into our home in yer fancy armour 'n whatnot?
Redbeard's Booty#011.dst: そのとおりだ、兄ちゃん。洒落た鎧で俺らの家に乗り込みやがって、何者だ？
Redbeard's Booty#011.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#012.src: Ah, ye be accompanyin' Marston, eh? Well if ye insist on that, where be the man 'himself?
Redbeard's Booty#012.dst: ああ、Marston の連れか？そう言い張るなら、当の本人はどこだ？
Redbeard's Booty#012.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#013.src: Comin' later? Hm. Well, more hands always be helpful. Let us go down to me ship, the Black Ring.
Redbeard's Booty#013.dst: 後から来るって？ふうん。まあ、人手は多いほど助かるよ。あたいの船、ブラックリング号へ下りようじゃないか。
Redbeard's Booty#013.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#014.src: So he told ye about the plan? We'll bathe in doubloons when we get back! Ah, me fair lass will be so happy.
Redbeard's Booty#014.dst: じゃあ計画は聞いたんだな？戻ったら金貨風呂だぜ！ああ、俺の可愛い娘っ子も大喜びだ。
Redbeard's Booty#014.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#015.src: Hop aboard the Black Ring down at the dock of Pirate Cove.
Redbeard's Booty#015.dst: 海賊の入り江の桟橋でブラックリング号に乗り込む。

Redbeard's Booty#017.src: Aha, quick on yer feet, lad! Ye got 'ere before us!
Redbeard's Booty#017.dst: あはっ、足が速いね坊や！あたいらより先に着いたのかい！
Redbeard's Booty#017.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#018.dst: Marston の姿はまだねえか？
Redbeard's Booty#018.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#019.src: How's about we wait up fer him? He's the one who's givin us the opportunity fer this hunt, anyways.
Redbeard's Booty#019.dst: あいつを待ってやらねえか？そもそもこの宝探しの機会をくれたのはあいつだしよ。
Redbeard's Booty#019.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#020.src: I be getting impatient... The whole crew is 'ere, 'cept fer him!
Redbeard's Booty#020.dst: イライラしてきたぜ…あいつ以外、船員は全員そろってるってのに！
Redbeard's Booty#020.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#021.src: Argh! Where be our mate? It be getting dark out! We will have to leave Marston at land.
Redbeard's Booty#021.dst: ちっ！あの仲間はどこ行ったんだい？暗くなってきた！Marston は陸に置いてくしかないね。
Redbeard's Booty#021.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#022.src: Do ya have the map Marston bought?
Redbeard's Booty#022.dst: Marston が買った地図、持ってるかい？
Redbeard's Booty#022.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#023.src: Let us take a looksie at the map and see where to go.
Redbeard's Booty#023.dst: 地図をちょいと見て、どこへ行くか決めようぜ。
Redbeard's Booty#023.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#024.src: It seems like one of these islands have the treasure... A'ight, yer in charge, landlubber! Set us on a course fer an island!
Redbeard's Booty#024.dst: どうやらこの島のどれかに宝があるらしい…よし、お前が仕切れ、陸モン！島へ針路を取れ！
Redbeard's Booty#024.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#025.src: Ahoy, this must be the booty. Fret not, Argus is keepin' the ship prepared so we can leave.
Redbeard's Booty#025.dst: おおい、これがお宝に違いないよ。心配いらない、Argus がすぐ出航できるよう船を見てる。
Redbeard's Booty#025.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#026.src: A'ight, let's us dig it up, jacks!
Redbeard's Booty#026.dst: よし、掘り出すぞ、野郎ども！
Redbeard's Booty#026.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#027.src: Aha, I see somethin' gleaming in there! Methinks we hit gold, lads.
Redbeard's Booty#027.dst: あはっ、中で何か光ってる！こいつは金を掘り当てたね、あんたたち。
Redbeard's Booty#027.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#028.src: Now Martim, knock the lubber out.
Redbeard's Booty#028.dst: Martim、陸モンをのしちまいな。
Redbeard's Booty#028.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#029.src: What? Another clue! The be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...
Redbeard's Booty#029.dst: 何だって？また手がかり！とんだ Grook 追いの無駄骨だよ、本物のお宝はどこだい？！鍵の山で金持ちになった奴なんていないよ！！くっついてる宝石なら売れるかもね…
Redbeard's Booty#029.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#030.src: Wait, there be a clue on the key! Presented to the ruined Galleon, a true path forward will arise.
Redbeard's Booty#030.dst: 待て、鍵に手がかりがあるぞ！「朽ちたガレオン船に捧げよ、さすれば真の道が開かれん」
Redbeard's Booty#030.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#031.src: Garh...I be losin' my patience. Argus arrived, let's ditch the lubber before they awake, hm? This island be hidden by magic, ain't no way they're gettin' found.
Redbeard's Booty#031.dst: ぐぬ…我慢の限界だ。Argus が来た、陸モンが起きる前に置いてこうぜ？この島は魔法で隠されてる、見つかりっこねえ。
Redbeard's Booty#031.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#032.src: Arright! This key... We might be able to bring Redbeard 'imself back to life... He'll strike terror in the seas again, and we will be 'is crew!
Redbeard's Booty#032.dst: よっしゃ！この鍵で…Redbeard 本人を蘇らせられるかもしれない…あの人がまた海を恐怖に陥れて、あたいらがその船員になるんだ！
Redbeard's Booty#032.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#033.src: Leave the hidden island and stop the pirates from stealing Redbeard's Booty.
Redbeard's Booty#033.dst: 隠された島を離れ、海賊たちが Redbeard の財宝を盗むのを阻止する。

Redbeard's Booty#034.src: Talk to Marston about his crew at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Redbeard's Booty#034.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Marston と船員について話す。

Redbeard's Booty#035.src: Can't say I expected all that... Those dogs are quick, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#035.dst: こんなことになるとはな…あの野郎ども、手が早えな？
Redbeard's Booty#035.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#036.src: Fer a landlubber, ye sure are quick. When I got ta Pirate Cove, ye were already but a speck on the horizon.
Redbeard's Booty#036.dst: 陸モンにしちゃ、本当に足が速えな。俺が海賊の入り江に着いた時にゃ、お前さんはもう水平線の点だった。
Redbeard's Booty#036.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#037.src: Speakin' of, what'n the name o' Davy Jones' Locket happened out there?!
Redbeard's Booty#037.dst: そういや、海の悪魔にかけて、あっちで一体何があったんだ？！
Redbeard's Booty#037.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#038.src: Ye look a bit bruised! Reckon ye ran aground o' trouble with 'em too, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#038.dst: ちょいと傷だらけじゃねえか！お前さんもあいつらと揉めたんだろ？
Redbeard's Booty#038.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#039.src: Well, lad! Methinks ye oughta go in after 'em! We may be a rowdy lot, but a mutiny's somethin' ye don't tolerate.
Redbeard's Booty#039.dst: よし、兄弟！あいつらを追いかけるべきだと思うぜ！俺たちゃ荒くれだが、反乱だけは許せねえ。
Redbeard's Booty#039.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#040.src: They don't deserve that treasure, lad! It ain't be mine either, since I missed ye. That gold be yours fer the takin...so take it!
Redbeard's Booty#040.dst: あいつらにあの宝の資格はねえ、兄弟！お前さんに追いつけなかった以上、俺のもんでもねえ。その金はお前さんのもんだ…持ってけ！
Redbeard's Booty#040.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#041.src: Speakin' of...I ain't got much a penny ta my name, but I found this fish while ye were gone. I hear it sells for a decent haul, so here.
Redbeard's Booty#041.dst: そういや…俺は一文無し同然だが、お前さんがいない間にこの魚を釣ったんだ。いい値で売れるらしい、ほらよ。
Redbeard's Booty#041.speaker: Marston

Reincarnation#000.src: Talk to Batelu in Bob's Tomb.
Reincarnation#000.dst: Bob の墓で Batelu と話す。

Reincarnation#001.src: Hello adventurer! I see you want to solve the mystery of Bob's tomb also? Glad to meet you.
Reincarnation#001.dst: やあ冒険者！君も Bob の墓の謎を解きたいのかい？会えて嬉しいよ。
Reincarnation#001.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#002.src: My name is Batelu. Lately, I've been studying these strange symbols on the walls.
Reincarnation#002.dst: 私は Batelu。最近、壁のこの奇妙な記号を研究しているんだ。
Reincarnation#002.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#003.src: It's about Bob. Hopefully you do not believe the stories of his death, right? Bob couldn't have died so easily. Not to something so mundane as a wolf.
Reincarnation#003.dst: Bob のことさ。まさか彼の死の噂を信じてはいないだろう？Bob があっさり死ぬはずがない。狼なんてありふれたものに。
Reincarnation#003.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#004.src: He wasn't only strong, he was absolutely un-killable, a master in almost every skill.
Reincarnation#004.dst: 彼はただ強いだけじゃない、決して殺せない男だった。ほぼ全ての技の達人さ。
Reincarnation#004.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#005.src: I believe he knew he was about to die. How? What of? Nobody knows, but he left this world prepared.
Reincarnation#005.dst: 彼は死期を悟っていたと思う。なぜ？何で？誰も知らないが、備えてこの世を去ったんだ。
Reincarnation#005.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#006.src: You see, it says here Bob had three loyal animals. Before dying, he scattered them across the ocean.
Reincarnation#006.dst: ほら、Bob には忠実な動物が三匹いたとある。死ぬ前に海の各地へ散らしたんだ。
Reincarnation#006.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#007.src: I think those animals are the key to accessing his real tomb...
Reincarnation#007.dst: その動物たちこそ本当の墓に入る鍵だと思う…
Reincarnation#007.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#008.src: You see that little gap right there? It's the entrance...
Reincarnation#008.dst: そこの小さな隙間が見えるかい？あれが入口だ…
Reincarnation#008.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#009.src: Unfortunately, nobody was able to remove the spell blocking it.
Reincarnation#009.dst: 残念ながら、塞いでいる呪文を解けた者はいない。
Reincarnation#009.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#010.src: But I do. I know how to open the passage to Bob. This is where the animals come in useful...
Reincarnation#010.dst: だが私は違う。Bob への道を開く方法を知っている。そこで動物たちの出番さ…
Reincarnation#010.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#011.src: I believe Bob did something to those animals. I think if we could reunite them in some way, we could open the passage.
Reincarnation#011.dst: Bob は動物たちに何かしたはずだ。何らかの形で再び揃えれば、道が開けると思う。
Reincarnation#011.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#012.src: Bring me {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool & {~} Mooington's Skin if you can find them.
Reincarnation#012.dst: 見つけたら Cluckles の羽根 {~}、Baab の羊毛 {~}、Mooington の皮 {~} を持ってきてくれ。
Reincarnation#012.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#013.src: I am sure that together, we can open the passage. Good luck.
Reincarnation#013.dst: 力を合わせれば、きっと道は開ける。幸運を。
Reincarnation#013.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#014.src: Bring back {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool, and Mooington's Skin to Batelu.
Reincarnation#014.dst: Cluckles のお気に入りの羽根、Baab の羊毛、Mooington の皮 {~} 個を Batelu に届ける。

Reincarnation#015.src: Wonderful! We can now open the passage to the true tomb of Bob...
Reincarnation#015.dst: 素晴らしい！これで Bob の本当の墓への道が開ける…
Reincarnation#015.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#016.src: I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, merely read it. You shall go alone, be careful.
Reincarnation#016.dst: 私に入る資格はない。動物の試練を果たしたのではなく、読んだだけだからね。一人で行くんだ、気をつけて。
Reincarnation#016.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#018.src: I am Bob, master of the arts of Wynn.
Reincarnation#018.dst: 我は Bob、Wynn の技の達人。
Reincarnation#018.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#019.src: Let me explain why you are here.
Reincarnation#019.dst: 汝がここにいる訳を話そう。
Reincarnation#019.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#020.src: My animals, were my greatest allies in my travels through the world.
Reincarnation#020.dst: 我が動物たちは、世界を巡る旅の最大の味方であった。
Reincarnation#020.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#021.src: I travelled too far, mined too deep, and of course challenged what should not be challenged. My time in Wynn was coming to an end.
Reincarnation#021.dst: 我は遠くへ行きすぎ、深く掘りすぎ、挑むべきでないものに挑んだ。Wynn での我が時は尽きかけていた。
Reincarnation#021.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#022.src: I knew so, too. But I refused to leave without giving the power i had attained to those worthy of it.
Reincarnation#022.dst: それは我も分かっていた。だが得た力をふさわしい者に託さずに去ることは拒んだ。
Reincarnation#022.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#023.src: Using what ability I had left to me, I transferred my power to my animals, in three pieces. In the hope that those worthy to harness it will seek them out.
Reincarnation#023.dst: 残された力で、我が力を三つに分けて動物たちに移した。扱うにふさわしい者が探し出すことを願って。
Reincarnation#023.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#024.src: The spell I placed on the door to this realm will only break to the one who collects my power. But it cannot have escaped your notice, you do not have my power.
Reincarnation#024.dst: この領域の扉にかけた呪文は、我が力を集めた者にのみ破られる。だが気づいておろう、汝は我が力を持っておらぬ。
Reincarnation#024.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#025.src: The truth is, you must pass a test, the ultimate test. Hone your skills you have learnt throughout your travels, and face me. Face me, and earn your place amongst soldiers of Wynn.
Reincarnation#025.dst: 実のところ、汝は究極の試練を越えねばならぬ。旅で学んだ技を磨き、我と対峙せよ。我に挑み、Wynn の戦士の列に加わる資格を得よ。
Reincarnation#025.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#026.src: Bring back {~} Bob's Seal of Approval to Batelu.
Reincarnation#026.dst: Bob の認可の印 {~} 個を Batelu に届ける。

Reincarnation#027.src: Ah! You have returned! Tell me, what did you find within?
Reincarnation#027.dst: おお！戻ったか！中で何を見つけたんだい？
Reincarnation#027.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#028.src: ...You faced Bob himself in combat? And you triumphed? That's quite remarkable!
Reincarnation#028.dst: …Bob 本人と戦った？しかも勝った？これは驚いた！
Reincarnation#028.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#029.src: And he gave you his Seal of Approval... Hm. If that is the case, then there is something I may do for you.
Reincarnation#029.dst: それに認可の印まで授かったのか… ふむ。それなら、私にもできることがある。
Reincarnation#029.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#030.src: Before Bob passed, he left his mythical weapons with a trusted friend. They were, so he said, to be kept for one who would be worthy to wield them...
Reincarnation#030.dst: Bob は亡くなる前、神話級の武器を信頼する友に預けた。振るうにふさわしい者のために取っておけ、と言ってね…
Reincarnation#030.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#031.src: Yes... Yes, I am certain. You have proven yourself worthy. Take this relic, the Stone of Myths, and bring it to the Temple of the Legends.
Reincarnation#031.dst: そう… そうだ、間違いない。君はふさわしいと証明した。この遺物、神話の石を伝説の神殿へ持って行くんだ。
Reincarnation#031.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#032.src: Within, you will find a merchant who will offer you a weapon in exchange for it. I wish you luck with your future travels.
Reincarnation#032.dst: 中にいる商人が、それと引き換えに武器をくれるだろう。君の今後の旅に幸運を。
Reincarnation#032.speaker: Batelu

Revelations in Fall#001.src: Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#001.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のレジスタンスの拠点で会議に出る。

Revelations in Fall#002.src: Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
Revelations in Fall#002.dst: みんな、今日は集まってくれてありがとう。
Revelations in Fall#002.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#003.src: It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#003.dst: ここにいても Fruma に大きな影響を与えるのは難しい。それがはっきりしてきた。
Revelations in Fall#003.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#004.src: We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
Revelations in Fall#004.dst: 私たちは Auburn の人々のために良いことをしてきた！でも資源は限られ、行動の機会はもっと限られている。
Revelations in Fall#004.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#005.src: Additionally, the risks of our operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#005.dst: それに活動の危険は日に日に増している。{u} を迎えたことは後悔していないけど、より注目を集めるのは周知の事実よ。
Revelations in Fall#005.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#006.src: Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Revelations in Fall#006.dst: Zeph と {u} は昨日、異端審問官がこの一帯に来ると知った。目的は不明だけど、その存在は私たちの活動をさらに危うくする。
Revelations in Fall#006.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#007.src: At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine they're called the Steel Feather.
Revelations in Fall#007.dst: 祭りで Roughworks の協力者から知らせを受けたの。向こうにも似た組織があって、私の旧友が率いる鋼の羽根というの。
Revelations in Fall#007.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#008.src: They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
Revelations in Fall#008.dst: 彼らには私たちにない資源があり、立場もずっと有利。Roughworks へ渡れれば、迎え入れて次の手を一緒に考えてくれるそうよ。
Revelations in Fall#008.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#009.src: So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
Revelations in Fall#009.dst: で、次の手って？ここでできないことを向こうで何をしろって言うの？
Revelations in Fall#009.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#010.src: I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#010.dst: まだ案を練っているけど、王冠祭に関わることよ。急げば Roughworks の王冠祭に間に合うわ。
Revelations in Fall#010.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#011.src: Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
Revelations in Fall#011.dst: もちろん、別の地区へ行くのには相応の危険がある… 残りたい人がいれば、その決断を尊重するわ。
Revelations in Fall#011.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#012.src: Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
Revelations in Fall#012.dst: はは！あなた一人に作戦を練らせろと？こうなると予見して、仕事の方はもう手を打ってあります。お供しますよ、お嬢さん。
Revelations in Fall#012.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#013.src: An I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#013.dst: あたしも絶対に行くよ、冗談でしょ？どこへでもついていくよ、Syndra。
Revelations in Fall#013.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#014.src: I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#014.dst: ぼ、僕も行く！ぼ、僕らの大、大義に使わないなら、ま、魔法がある意味なんてないよ！
Revelations in Fall#014.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#015.src: Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
Revelations in Fall#015.dst: ふむ。正直、外じゃわしはあまり役に立たんよ、Synny。それに留守の間、誰かが砦を守らにゃならん。だからわしは残る。
Revelations in Fall#015.speaker: Kaio

Revelations in Fall#016.src: That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
Revelations in Fall#016.dst: 助かるわ、Kaio。風の葉をあなたに任せられるなら、安心して発てる。
Revelations in Fall#016.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#019.src: You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
Revelations in Fall#019.dst: みんな… 私の薬が要るよね。だから行く…
Revelations in Fall#019.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#020.src: Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you
Revelations in Fall#020.dst: Sui… 残りたければ残っていいのよ。無理強いはしたくない
Revelations in Fall#020.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#021.src: N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#021.dst: う、ううん！一緒に行きたい！ただ… 何人かにお別れを言わなきゃ。出発する前に。
Revelations in Fall#021.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#022.dst: …わかった。あなたがそう言うなら。
Revelations in Fall#022.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#024.src: I'm forever in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
Revelations in Fall#024.dst: 一生かかっても返せない恩ね。力を貸してくれて、改めてありがとう。
Revelations in Fall#024.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#025.src: In Wynn, we have stories of people who could use magic like you. It came naturally to them, and they didn't need a focus for it.
Revelations in Fall#025.dst: Wynn には、君のように魔法を使えた人々の伝承がある。生まれつきで、触媒も必要なかった。

Revelations in Fall#026.src: Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
Revelations in Fall#026.dst: はあ… 反論したいけど。あなたの言う通り、あなたの力が必要よ。
Revelations in Fall#026.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#027.src: I still need to make preparations before we leave- namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
Revelations in Fall#027.dst: 出発前にまだ準備があるの。つまり国境越えの手配。協力者がいて… 説得できるといいけど。
Revelations in Fall#027.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#028.src: You- you can't pos- possibly mean
Revelations in Fall#028.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#029.src: Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
Revelations in Fall#029.dst: ええ、Zeph、そのまさかよ。大丈夫。
Revelations in Fall#029.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#030.src: As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
Revelations in Fall#030.dst: 他のみんなも各自準備をして。好機がいつまで続くか分からないから、残りの時間を大切にね。
Revelations in Fall#030.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#031.src: Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
Revelations in Fall#031.dst: ふむ… Zeph、何を心配しているのです？Syndra 嬢が心得ているのは皆知っているでしょう！任せろと言うなら疑う理由はありません！
Revelations in Fall#031.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#033.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u} of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#033.dst: まあ、いいでしょう！さあ他の子たちも… もちろん {u} も！皆で別れの挨拶をしましょう。いつ戻れるか分かりませんからね！
Revelations in Fall#033.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#034.src: If we'll be back at all...
Revelations in Fall#034.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#035.src: Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Revelations in Fall#035.dst: Sui… 必ず戻ります。私が保証しますよ！こういう約束を私が守るのは知っているでしょう。
Revelations in Fall#035.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#036.src: We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
Revelations in Fall#036.dst: 大丈夫だよ、Sui。いつもそうでしょ。
Revelations in Fall#036.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#038.src: Talk with Zeph outside the base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#038.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の拠点の外で Zeph と話す。

Revelations in Fall#040.src: I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
Revelations in Fall#040.dst: じゅ、準備ができてるか分からない。
Revelations in Fall#040.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#041.src: But I have to be! I... I have to.
Revelations in Fall#041.dst: でも、やるしかない！私… やるしか。
Revelations in Fall#041.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#043.src: So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#043.dst: あのさ… ぼ、僕は君主を全然信用してなくて、Syndra に、な、何かするんじゃないかって、こ、怖いんだ。
Revelations in Fall#043.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#044.src: It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
Revelations in Fall#044.dst: ば、馬鹿みたいだけど… 君と僕で、あいつに頼まずに壁を越える方法を見、見つけられたら、しょ、衝突を避けられる。
Revelations in Fall#044.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#045.src: And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
Revelations in Fall#045.dst: それに、ど、どうせ他にやることもないし…
Revelations in Fall#045.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#046.src: So! L- let's head into town, and s- s- see if we can
Revelations in Fall#046.dst: だから！ま、町へ行って、で、できるか確かめ
Revelations in Fall#046.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#047.src: Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt I overheard you were... going into town?
Revelations in Fall#047.dst: えっと… ご、ごめんね、邪魔して。二人が町に… 行くって聞こえて？
Revelations in Fall#047.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#048.src: Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
Revelations in Fall#048.dst: Sui！う、うん、そのつもりだよ。
Revelations in Fall#048.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#049.src: If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
Revelations in Fall#049.dst: もし… もし迷惑じゃなければ… 一緒に行ってもいい？あの… お別れを言いたい人たちが… いて。
Revelations in Fall#049.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#050.src: Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
Revelations in Fall#050.dst: ああ… あ、赤… 赤狐の人たち？
Revelations in Fall#050.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#051.src: It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
Revelations in Fall#051.dst: えっと… よく行くお店なの。店主さんたちが… 優しくて。いろいろ、ふふ、お礼を言いたくて。
Revelations in Fall#051.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#052.src: It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
Revelations in Fall#052.dst: {p} で一番高い木の、ひ、ひとつの上に建ってて… ぼ、僕の考えにもぴったりなんだ。{p} の門のす、すぐ外だよ。
Revelations in Fall#052.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#053.src: Head to the Red Fox treetop café at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#053.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の樹上カフェ「赤狐」へ向かう。

Revelations in Fall#054.src: L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
Revelations in Fall#054.dst: あ、赤狐カフェで集合しよう。{p} の門のそ、外のすぐそばだよ。
Revelations in Fall#054.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#056.src: So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
Revelations in Fall#056.dst: で、ど、どう？ここからの眺め、い、いいでしょ？
Revelations in Fall#056.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#057.src: I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...
Revelations in Fall#057.dst: みんなを… よくここに連れてくるの。{p} で、えっと、一番おいしいお店なの…
Revelations in Fall#057.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#058.src: Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
Revelations in Fall#058.dst: うん… 夜食の買い出し、さ、寂しくなるな。へへ。
Revelations in Fall#058.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#060.src: S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can
Revelations in Fall#060.dst: S、Sui、僕らに… の、残ってほしい？一緒に
Revelations in Fall#060.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#061.src: N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll go find Chen on my own. You two, um, hand something you were going to do, right?
Revelations in Fall#061.dst: う、ううん！大丈夫… 平気。Chen には一人で会いに行く。二人は、えっと、何かやることがあるんでしょ？
Revelations in Fall#061.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#062.src: We did... uh, if y- you're sure, Sui. We'll see you l- la- later?
Revelations in Fall#062.dst: あるけど… えっと、ほ、本当にいいなら。じゃあ、ま、また後で？
Revelations in Fall#062.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#063.src: Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
Revelations in Fall#063.dst: う… うん。えっと、が… 頑張って！
Revelations in Fall#063.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#064.src: ...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
Revelations in Fall#064.dst: …よし。{u}、こ、ここに来た理由は… ここからだと、や、屋根に簡単に上れるんだ。
Revelations in Fall#064.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#065.src: I w- w- I want to see if we can ge- get over the wall. If we st- stick to the roofs, we should be able to av- avoid suspicion...
Revelations in Fall#065.dst: か、壁を越えられるか試したい。や、屋根伝いに行けば、あ、怪しまれずに済むはず…
Revelations in Fall#065.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#067.src: Follow Zeph to the tree branch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#067.dst: Zeph について [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の木の枝へ行く。

Revelations in Fall#068.src: Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!
Revelations in Fall#068.dst: おお、Sui！いつ見ても会えて嬉しいよ！
Revelations in Fall#068.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#069.src: Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Revelations in Fall#069.dst: Chen… お店は、えっと、順調？
Revelations in Fall#069.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#070.src: Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
Revelations in Fall#070.dst: ふむ、望める限りは上々といったところだね！祭りはいつも客が押し寄せる。さて、いつものを作ろうか？
Revelations in Fall#070.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#071.src: Oh. Um... that's very kind of you, but, no, not today. Thank you.
Revelations in Fall#071.dst: あ。えっと… ありがとう、でも今日はいいの。ごめんね。
Revelations in Fall#071.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#072.src: Very well, very well. Well, since you're here, might I ask if you've had a thought about my job offer?
Revelations in Fall#072.dst: そうかい、そうかい。ところで、せっかく来たんだ、例の仕事の話は考えてくれたかな？
Revelations in Fall#072.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#073.src: You basically know our menu inside and out by this point, so I do truly think you'd be a great fit.
Revelations in Fall#073.dst: 君はもううちのメニューを隅々まで知ってる。本当にぴったりだと思うんだよ。
Revelations in Fall#073.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#074.dst: そう… えっと。そ、そのことなんだけど…
Revelations in Fall#074.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#075.src: Okay, so... just f- fo- follow the green trails !
Revelations in Fall#075.dst: よし、じゃあ… み、緑の道筋をた、辿って！
Revelations in Fall#075.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#076.src: If you g- get lost, meet me back here.
Revelations in Fall#076.dst: ま、迷ったらここに戻って来て。
Revelations in Fall#076.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#077.src: Travel across the roof tops of {p} starting from .
Revelations in Fall#077.dst: {p} の屋根の上を から渡っていく。

Revelations in Fall#079.src: Do you, uh, w- want to take a break?
Revelations in Fall#079.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#080.src: Alright, g- good luck! Just re- remember to follow the green trail.
Revelations in Fall#080.dst: よし、が、頑張って！緑の道筋を辿るのを、わ、忘れずにね。
Revelations in Fall#080.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#081.src: I- I'll follow you soon, I'm just w- war- warming up a bit first.
Revelations in Fall#081.dst: ぼ、僕もすぐ追いかける。ちょっと、じゅ、準備運動してから。
Revelations in Fall#081.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#083.src: Just re- return here when you're ready to st- start again.
Revelations in Fall#083.dst: また始める準備ができたら、こ、ここに戻って来て。
Revelations in Fall#083.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#084.src: Ha, I- I guess you got here b- be- before me this time!
Revelations in Fall#084.dst: はは、こ、今回は君の方がさ、先に着いたね！
Revelations in Fall#084.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#086.dst: よし… と、跳び越えよう。
Revelations in Fall#086.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#087.src: Aah! I... I... th- that was... c- cl- close.
Revelations in Fall#087.dst: うわっ！ぼ、僕… い、今の… あ、危なかった。
Revelations in Fall#087.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#088.src: That was... th- that was m- magic, wasn't it...? It was l- li- it was like my whole body was... w- was en- engulfed by a, a g- ge- gentle breeze...
Revelations in Fall#088.dst: 今のは… ま、魔法、だよね…？まるで全身が… や、優しいそよ風に、つ、包まれたみたいだった…
Revelations in Fall#088.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#089.src: I... ha. Th- that was- e- e- exhilarating, but... b- but... Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#089.dst: ぼ、僕… はは。す、すごくスリルがあったけど… で、でも… こ、この屋根を伝って越えるのは、む、無理だよ… 危ない目は一度で、じゅ、十分。
Revelations in Fall#089.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#090.src: Ugh... l- let's just... get back to the R- Red Fox...
Revelations in Fall#090.dst: うう… あ、赤狐に… 戻ろう…
Revelations in Fall#090.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#091.src: Return to The Red Fox and talk to Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#091.dst: 赤狐に戻り、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Zeph と話す。

Revelations in Fall#092.src: I just... I- I- I don't like it. I don't like that S- Syn- Syndra's putting herself in- in danger like that!
Revelations in Fall#092.dst: ぼ、僕はただ… い、嫌なんだ。S、Syndra があんな風に自分を、き、危険にさらすのが！
Revelations in Fall#092.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#093.src: I... I owe her a lot. If it weren't for her, I- I- I'd still be st- stuck on the... the st- str- streets. It's thanks to her that I'm still... here.
Revelations in Fall#093.dst: 僕は… 彼女に大きな恩がある。彼女がいなかったら、ぼ、僕は今も、ろ、路上暮らしだった。僕が今… ここにいるのは彼女のおかげ。
Revelations in Fall#093.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#094.src: Yeah... I, uh, grew up in a- a small village. S- someone was accused of being c- cursed, and... my people refused to h- ha- hand them over without a- a- wi- without a fight.
Revelations in Fall#094.dst: うん… ぼ、僕は、ち、小さな村で育ったんだ。あ、ある人が呪われてると訴えられて… 村のみんなは、た、戦わずに引き渡すのを拒んだ。
Revelations in Fall#094.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#095.src: ...actually, wh- where is she? I th- thought she'd wait for us before...
Revelations in Fall#095.dst: …そ、そういえば、彼女はどこ？ま、待っててくれると思ってたのに…
Revelations in Fall#095.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#096.src: Ah, Zeph, is that you I hear?
Revelations in Fall#096.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#097.src: Oh, h- hey Chen. I need to get going, but have you seen Sui? We were g- go- going to meet up here.
Revelations in Fall#097.dst: あ、や、やあ Chen。もう行かなきゃだけど、Sui を見なかった？こ、ここで待ち合わせてたんだ。
Revelations in Fall#097.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#098.src: Yes, Sui... she left not long ago. The poor girl, clearly something is weighing on her...
Revelations in Fall#098.dst: ああ、Sui… 少し前に出て行ったよ。かわいそうに、何か思い悩んでいるようだった…
Revelations in Fall#098.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#099.src: I believe she would have gone to the pond to the southeast... that is where she usually goes when she needs some air.
Revelations in Fall#099.dst: たぶん南東の池に行ったんじゃないかな… 気分を変えたい時、あの子はいつもそこへ行くんだ。
Revelations in Fall#099.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#100.src: Oh, I s- see. Th- thank you for the help!
Revelations in Fall#100.dst: そ、そっか。て、手伝ってくれてありがとう！
Revelations in Fall#100.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#101.src: Of course, anything for you children. Stop by again soon, would you? I'll make you all the family platter, on the house.
Revelations in Fall#101.dst: いいんだよ、君たちのためなら。また近いうちにおいで。家族盛り合わせをご馳走するよ、店のおごりでね。
Revelations in Fall#101.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#102.src: I... y- yeah, we... we will! Thanks for the off- offer.
Revelations in Fall#102.dst: ぼ、僕… う、うん… 来るよ！さ、誘ってくれてありがとう。
Revelations in Fall#102.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#104.src: {u}, can I ask you a f- fa- favour?
Revelations in Fall#104.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#105.src: Could you ch- check on Sui for me, p- please? I... I don't know h- how to help her, right now...
Revelations in Fall#105.dst: Sui の様子を、み、見てきてくれない？今の僕じゃ… ど、どう助ければいいか分からなくて…
Revelations in Fall#105.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#106.src: S- some- something's on her mind, but... b- but she won't tell me about it. I've tr- tried asking, but...
Revelations in Fall#106.dst: な、何か悩んでるんだけど… で、でも話してくれないんだ。き、聞いてはみたけど…
Revelations in Fall#106.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#107.src: ...but if you ask, ma- maybe she'll tell you? I- I don't know. It's worth a try, at- at least, r- r- right?
Revelations in Fall#107.dst: …でも君が聞けば、は、話してくれるかも？わ、分からないけど。試す価値は、あ、あるよね？
Revelations in Fall#107.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#108.src: Th- thanks, {u}. Chen said she w- was at the pond to the southeast.
Revelations in Fall#108.dst: あ、ありがとう、{u}。Chen の話だと南東の池にいるって。
Revelations in Fall#108.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#109.src: Meet up with Sui near the pond at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#109.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の池のそばで Sui と会う。

Revelations in Fall#111.src: O-oh, {u}! I didn't... um, expect to see you here.
Revelations in Fall#111.dst: あ、{u}！こんな所で… えっと、会うとは思わなかった。
Revelations in Fall#111.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#112.src: Oh... right. I just... needed some air. It's, hah, kind of a lot. L-leaving Auburn, I mean! I've never... known anywhere else.
Revelations in Fall#112.dst: あ… うん。ちょっと… 外の空気が吸いたくて。いろいろ、ふふ、あって。Auburn を、は、離れるなんて！他の場所… 知らないから。
Revelations in Fall#112.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#114.src: Can I... tell you something? I was... I wanted to talk to you, earlier, but, um, I... I couldn't build up the courage.
Revelations in Fall#114.dst: 話… 聞いてくれる？さっきも… 話したかったんだけど、えっと… 勇気が出なくて。
Revelations in Fall#114.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#116.src: S-sorry, I should just... go for it. It- it might be easier if I just, show you, hah...
Revelations in Fall#116.dst: ご、ごめん、思い切って… 言うね。み、見せた方が早いかも、ふふ…
Revelations in Fall#116.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#117.src: You're the first, um, cursed one I've ever... seen. And- and everyone being so kind, about, all of it...
Revelations in Fall#117.dst: あなたは、えっと、私が初めて… 会った呪われし者なの。それに、み、みんなが優しくて、その全部に…
Revelations in Fall#117.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#118.src: And, I thought, maybe... maybe you could... help. Me. W-with figuring it all out.
Revelations in Fall#118.dst: だから… あなたなら… 助けてくれるかもって。わ、私が答えを見つけるのを。
Revelations in Fall#118.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#120.src: But... I don't use, um, a focus. To... to control water. S-so, that means I'm, one of the... d-dangerous ones. That's... th-that's what Mora said, um, earlier.
Revelations in Fall#120.dst: でも… 私、えっと、触媒を使わずに… 水を操れるの。だ、だから、私は… き、危険な方ってこと。さっき、えっと、Mora がそう言ってた。
Revelations in Fall#120.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#121.dst: そ、そんなの分からないよ！
Revelations in Fall#121.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#123.dst: あなたの友達… その人は…？
Revelations in Fall#123.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#124.src: Oh... g-good. That's- that's good. I'm glad.
Revelations in Fall#124.dst: あ… よ、良かった。それなら、良かった。
Revelations in Fall#124.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#125.src: Oh... that's, ha, a big thing to do for someone. B-breaking into a province? I can't imagine, um, doing something like that...
Revelations in Fall#125.dst: そっか… それって、ふふ、すごいことだね。ち、地方に乗り込むなんて？私には、えっと、想像もできない…
Revelations in Fall#125.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#127.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#127.dst: 私… 怖いの。使おうとしたら… だ、誰かを傷つけちゃうんじゃないかって…
Revelations in Fall#127.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#128.src: I'm... not very brave, haha. I didn't, really, join the resistance because... because I wanted to stand up against the crown!
Revelations in Fall#128.dst: 私… 勇敢じゃないの、ふふ。レジスタンスに入ったのも… 王家に立ち向かいたかったからじゃない！
Revelations in Fall#128.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#129.src: Something like that, it feels... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#129.dst: そんなこと、とても… 無理に思える。
Revelations in Fall#129.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#130.src: ... I'm only here because I followed Mora. He's the brave one! N-not- not me. I just, ha, had nowhere else to go.
Revelations in Fall#130.dst: …ここにいるのは Mora についてきたから。勇敢なのは Mora！わ、私じゃない。他に、ふふ、行く所がなかっただけ。
Revelations in Fall#130.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#131.src: And- and everyone else is so, excited about m-ma-magic! Even, um, Mora. And here I am, too afraid to- to even try!
Revelations in Fall#131.dst: それに、み、みんな魔、魔法に夢中で！Mora まで。なのに私は、た、試すのも怖いなんて！
Revelations in Fall#131.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#133.src: Yeah, but... it- it wouldn't feel, um, right. If the rest of my family is going, then, ha, how could I not go with them?
Revelations in Fall#133.dst: うん、でも… それは、えっと、違う気がする。家族のみんなが行くなら、ふふ、私だけ残れないよ。
Revelations in Fall#133.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#134.src: WHat if... something happened to them to you and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#134.dst: もし… みんなや、あなたに何かあって、そ、その時私がいなかったら？私… 自分を、ゆ、許せない！
Revelations in Fall#134.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135.src: So... s-so, even if I'm scared... I can't stay behind.
Revelations in Fall#135.dst: だから… だ、だから、怖くても… 残るわけにいかない。
Revelations in Fall#135.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#136.src: ...I'm, um, not much of a fighter. But I'm still good with m-medicine, and healing. So... I can help.
Revelations in Fall#136.dst: …私、えっと、戦うのは苦手。でも、く、薬と手当ては得意だから。だから… 役に立てる。
Revelations in Fall#136.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#137.src: Let's... get back home. I should tell Zeph I'm alright.
Revelations in Fall#137.dst: 帰ろう… 家に。Zeph に大丈夫って伝えなきゃ。
Revelations in Fall#137.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#138.src: Return to the Leaves in the Wind at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#139.src: Thank you for listening to me.
Revelations in Fall#139.dst: 話を聞いてくれてありがとう。
Revelations in Fall#139.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#140.src: I... I want to help. I'm just... scared.
Revelations in Fall#140.dst: 私… 役に立ちたい。ただ… 怖いの。
Revelations in Fall#140.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#141.src: Hrmm... ah, {u}, just the leaf I was looking to find!
Revelations in Fall#141.dst: ふむ… おお、{u}、ちょうど探していた葉っぱですよ！
Revelations in Fall#141.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#142.src: I am nearly finished with preparations for our expedition. Supplies packed, goodbyes said, and so on and so forth.
Revelations in Fall#142.dst: 遠征の準備はほぼ終わりました。荷造りも、別れの挨拶も、何やかやと済ませましてね。
Revelations in Fall#142.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#143.src: There is... one last thing, however. If I may ask you for a favor?
Revelations in Fall#143.dst: ただ… 最後にひとつ。頼みごとをしてもよろしいですか？
Revelations in Fall#143.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#144.src: Excellent! I thank you for your time.
Revelations in Fall#144.dst: 素晴らしい！お時間に感謝します。
Revelations in Fall#144.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#145.src: ...ah, a busy day, I take it? I promise it will be quick, if you would hear me out.
Revelations in Fall#145.dst: …おや、お忙しいようで？すぐ済みますから、話だけでも聞いてください。
Revelations in Fall#145.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#146.src: I had mentioned previously, your words on magic had resonated with me! I have been taking some time to practice, with the aid of cursory knowledge of military blessings.
Revelations in Fall#146.dst: 前にも言いましたが、魔法についてのあなたの言葉が心に響きましてね！軍の祝福の知識を少し頼りに、練習を重ねていたのです。
Revelations in Fall#146.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#147.src: But such training will do me little good in a true combat scenario. So, in the interest of improvement, I would ask for a sparring match against you!
Revelations in Fall#147.dst: ですが、そんな修練は実戦ではあまり役に立ちません。そこで上達のため、あなたに手合わせを願いたい！
Revelations in Fall#147.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#148.src: It will help me to spot and shore up my weaknesses. Perhaps it will do the same for you!
Revelations in Fall#148.dst: 自分の弱点を見つけて補えます。あなたにとってもそうかもしれませんよ！
Revelations in Fall#148.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#149.src: Come, follow me to our sparring arena!
Revelations in Fall#149.dst: さあ、稽古場までついて来てください！
Revelations in Fall#149.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#150.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Mora と手合わせする。

Revelations in Fall#151.dst: よろしい！始めましょう！
Revelations in Fall#151.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#152.src: Oof... you are very talented, I must say!
Revelations in Fall#152.dst: うっ… 実に才能がおありだ！
Revelations in Fall#152.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#153.src: No wonder miss Syndra is so invested in you, having battled you herself!
Revelations in Fall#153.dst: Syndra 嬢があなたに入れ込むわけです、自ら戦っただけに！
Revelations in Fall#153.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#154.src: Now, tell me, how did I perform?
