Revelations in Fall#154.dst: さて、私の戦いぶりはどうでした？
Revelations in Fall#154.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#155.src: Really! In the moment, it did not feel like I stood much of a chance, but I suppose I am still learning to wield it!
Revelations in Fall#155.dst: 本当に！その時は勝ち目がないと感じましたが、まだ扱い方を学んでいる途中なのでしょう！
Revelations in Fall#155.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#156.src: It is odd, though. I have only learned of it recently, yet it fels as though the magic has been with me all along! It is like... muscle memory, I suppose? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#156.dst: しかし妙です。知ったのはつい最近なのに、この魔法はずっと私と共にあったように感じる！いわば… 体が覚えている、とでも？考えさせられますね。
Revelations in Fall#156.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#157.src: Ha! No need to sugarcoat it. I have always specialized in heavy attacks, so I struggle against swift opponents. Rarely have I managed to best Zeph in a spar!
Revelations in Fall#157.dst: はは！お世辞は結構。私は昔から重い一撃が得意で、素早い相手は苦手なのです。手合わせで Zeph に勝てたことはほとんどありません！
Revelations in Fall#157.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#158.src: Perhaps therein lies the value of this magic... finding methods to raise area of effect, or slow targets down? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#158.dst: この魔法の価値はそこにあるのかもしれません… 攻撃範囲を広げる、敵の動きを鈍らせる方法を探すとか？考えさせられますね。
Revelations in Fall#158.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#159.src: An excellent question, though I have no true answers. Perhaps some of what I had learned from military sources has stuck with me?
Revelations in Fall#159.dst: 良い質問ですが、本当の答えは持ち合わせていません。軍の資料で学んだことが身についているのかも？
Revelations in Fall#159.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#160.src: I do trust it will come to Zeph with time. He is persistent! That trait will serve him well for these purposes.
Revelations in Fall#160.dst: Zeph もいずれ身につけると信じていますよ。彼は粘り強い！その資質がきっと役立ちます。
Revelations in Fall#160.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#161.src: Hey, Mora! Have you seen- oh, there you are. I've been looking for you.
Revelations in Fall#161.dst: ねえ、Mora！見なかった― あ、いた。探してたんだよ。
Revelations in Fall#161.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#162.src: I had a friend... he was also from Fruma, and he was "cursed." And he was also struggling with that label, like you.
Revelations in Fall#162.dst: 友達がいた… 彼も Fruma 出身で、「呪われて」いた。そして君と同じく、その烙印に苦しんでいた。

Revelations in Fall#163.src: But he found ways to make peace with it. He used his abilities to strengthen himself and his allies. He made a difference.
Revelations in Fall#163.dst: でも彼は折り合いをつける方法を見つけた。能力で自分と仲間を強くし、変化をもたらしたんだ。

Revelations in Fall#164.src: Alright, {u}, come with me. We are SORTING through our problems before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#164.dst: よし、{u}、ついて来て。出発前に問題を「整理」するよ。
Revelations in Fall#164.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#165.src: Come on, come on! To the giant tree stump, I don't have all day!
Revelations in Fall#165.dst: ほら、早く早く！大きな切り株まで、暇じゃないんだから！
Revelations in Fall#165.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#166.src: ... Ah. Oh dear. She appears to be in a mood today! I suppose that would make sense, given...
Revelations in Fall#166.dst: …ああ。おやおや。今日の彼女はご機嫌斜めのようだ！まあ、無理もありませんが…
Revelations in Fall#166.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#167.src: Hmm, how should I put it...? Ah, nevermind. You'd best follow her to the tree, see what she wants.
Revelations in Fall#167.dst: ふむ、何と言えばいいか…？ああ、いいです。木までついて行って、用件を聞いてあげてください。
Revelations in Fall#167.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#168.src: Keep an eye on her for me, would you? Make sure she gets home safely.
Revelations in Fall#168.dst: 彼女を見ていてあげてくれますか？無事に帰れるように。
Revelations in Fall#168.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#169.src: Find Rex at the old tree stump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#169.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の古い切り株で Rex を探す。

Revelations in Fall#170.src: Keep an eye on Rex, would you? I haven't seen her this worked up in a while...
Revelations in Fall#170.dst: Rex を見ていてくれますか？あんなに興奮した彼女は久しぶりで…
Revelations in Fall#170.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#171.src: Good, you came. Took you long enough!
Revelations in Fall#171.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#172.src: So, here's the deal! You are a problem.
Revelations in Fall#172.dst: で、話はこう！あんたが問題なの。
Revelations in Fall#172.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#173.src: Sure, you've proven yourself a hundred times over! Over and over and over again, you've shown you're on our side.
Revelations in Fall#173.dst: そりゃ、あんたは百回も証明したよ！何度も何度も何度も、こっちの味方だって示してきた。
Revelations in Fall#173.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#174.src: And that's great! That's great and all! But. But but but but but! You're still. From. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#174.dst: それはいいの！すごくいいの！でも。でもでもでもでも！あんたは。Wynn から。来た。
Revelations in Fall#174.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#175.src: Or... originally from Fruma, whatever. That's actually the problem! If you were just from Wynn, maybe it wouldn't be so bad!
Revelations in Fall#175.dst: それか… 元は Fruma 出身、どっちでもいい。それが問題なんだって！Wynn 出身なだけなら、そこまでじゃなかったかも！
Revelations in Fall#175.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#176.src: There's oh so many people from Fruma who were shipped off to Wynn! They really like sending off the problem children whenever they can't deal with them anymore.
Revelations in Fall#176.dst: Fruma から Wynn に送られた人は山ほどいる！手に負えない問題児がいると、すぐ送り出したがるんだから。
Revelations in Fall#176.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#177.src: So I get it! I do! It makes sense! But still... still, why, why... why does it get to be YOU here, and not- not...!
Revelations in Fall#177.dst: だから分かる！本当に！筋は通ってる！でもさ… なんで、なんで… ここにいるのが「あんた」で、あの人じゃ…！
Revelations in Fall#177.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#180.src: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Revelations in Fall#180.dst: ちょっと、そんな目で見ないで。
Revelations in Fall#180.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#181.src: So I had a brother, right? And sure, he was an idiot sometimes, but- but he was the only one there who really understood me.
Revelations in Fall#181.dst: あたしには兄さんがいたの。時々バカだったけど― でも、あそこで本当にあたしを分かってくれたのは兄さんだけだった。
Revelations in Fall#181.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#182.src: He's the one who carved my bow for me. He heard I was interested in archery, so he... when everyone else told me to just focus on schoolwork, he helped me learn.
Revelations in Fall#182.dst: この弓は兄さんが削ってくれたの。弓に興味があるって聞いて… みんなが勉強だけしてろって言う中、兄さんが教えてくれた。
Revelations in Fall#182.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#183.src: He really hated all the rules we had up there. So he liked to break them. A lot. And eventually, the crown got sick of it. Packed him up, sent him to the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#183.dst: 兄さんは上の規則が大嫌いで、よく破ってた。何度も。そのうち王家がうんざりして、兄さんを荷物みたいに Roughworks へ送った。
Revelations in Fall#183.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#184.src: The worst part was, our parents agreed to it! Said it'd be good for him, to get some real hard work!
Revelations in Fall#184.dst: 最悪なのは、親が賛成したこと！本当の重労働は兄さんのためになるって！
Revelations in Fall#184.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#185.src: I never liked it there anyway. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually I stole some of our money and bought a ticket to take me there.
Revelations in Fall#185.dst: どうせあそこは好きじゃなかった。勇気を出すのに時間がかかったけど、結局家のお金を盗んで、向こう行きの切符を買った。
Revelations in Fall#185.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#186.src: I didn't pack a whole lot. I guess I expected to find him and live with him! Stupid. Should've thought ahead more.
Revelations in Fall#186.dst: 荷物はろくに持たなかった。兄さんと一緒に暮らせると思ってたんだろうね！バカみたい。もっと考えるべきだった。
Revelations in Fall#186.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#187.src: He wasn't there, obviously. Heard from some of his friends that he kept being stupid over there. Got caught by the crown, and they decided to stop giving him second chances.
Revelations in Fall#187.dst: もちろん兄さんはいなかった。友達の話じゃ、向こうでもバカを続けてたって。王家に捕まって、もう次のチャンスはないと決められた。
Revelations in Fall#187.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#188.src: So, he's gone! He promised he'd see me again someday, and and of course he didn't follow through. I guess I wasn't important enough to remember.
Revelations in Fall#188.dst: だから、いなくなった！いつかまた会うって約束したのに、当然守らなかった。あたしは覚えておくほど大事じゃなかったんだろうね。
Revelations in Fall#188.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#189.src: Yes, I know. I just... I guess I just hoped I'd be an exception.
Revelations in Fall#189.dst: うん、分かってる。ただ… 自分は例外だと思いたかったんだと思う。
Revelations in Fall#189.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#191.src: I haven't been very fair to you, have I? It's not your fault you're here and he isn't.
Revelations in Fall#191.dst: あんたにずっと不公平だったよね？あんたがここにいて兄さんがいないのは、あんたのせいじゃない。
Revelations in Fall#191.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#193.src: So... sorry. For all of that.
Revelations in Fall#193.dst: だから… ごめん。いろいろと。
Revelations in Fall#193.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#195.src: Give me some time, would you? I need to... I don't know. I just need some space.
Revelations in Fall#195.dst: 少し時間をくれる？あたし… 分かんない。ただ一人になりたい。
Revelations in Fall#195.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#196.dst: はは！兄さんなら、そう言うよね…
Revelations in Fall#196.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#197.src: Okay. I... won't take too long. Nobody ever comes here, anyway.
Revelations in Fall#197.dst: うん。あたし… すぐ戻る。どうせここには誰も来ないし。
Revelations in Fall#197.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#198.src: Return to the camp and finish packing up at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#198.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の拠点に戻り、荷造りを終える。

Revelations in Fall#200.src: I just hope he's still out there, somewhere...
Revelations in Fall#200.dst: どこかで、まだ生きてるといいな…
Revelations in Fall#200.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#201.src: Th- there you are! We, uh, got worried s- some- something bad might've happened.
Revelations in Fall#201.dst: こ、ここにいた！ぼ、僕ら、な、何かあったんじゃないかって心配してたんだ。
Revelations in Fall#201.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#202.src: I... I mean... th- they got worried.
Revelations in Fall#202.dst: ぼ、僕… いや… み、みんなが心配してた。
Revelations in Fall#202.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#204.src: We were just talking. Gods, you guys and your overeager imaginations...
Revelations in Fall#204.dst: 話してただけ。まったく、みんな想像力がたくましすぎ…
Revelations in Fall#204.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#206.src: I am afraid not. We have heard nothing since the meeting this morning.
Revelations in Fall#206.dst: 残念ながら。今朝の会議以来、何の知らせもありません。
Revelations in Fall#206.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#207.dst: えっと… じゃあ、荷ほどき… する？
Revelations in Fall#207.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#208.src: Let us just continue to place our trust in Syndra, as we have done many times before! She can handle herself.
Revelations in Fall#208.dst: これまで何度もそうしてきたように、Syndra を信じ続けましょう！彼女なら大丈夫です。
Revelations in Fall#208.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#209.src: Ugh! I knew t- tr- trusting the Sovereign w- was a mistake! We n- n- need to go
Revelations in Fall#209.dst: うう！く、君主を信じるのはま、間違いだって分かってた！い、い、行かないと
Revelations in Fall#209.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#210.src: Excuse me- the Sovereign? What do you mean the S-
Revelations in Fall#210.dst: ちょっと― 君主？君主ってどういう―
Revelations in Fall#210.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#212.src: Sigh... I'm just a little too late, I see.
Revelations in Fall#212.dst: はあ… 少し遅かったみたいね。
Revelations in Fall#212.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#213.src: Well, since it's out in the open, I might as well explain myself. Firstly, I owe you all an apology for this.
Revelations in Fall#213.dst: まあ、知られてしまったなら、説明しておくわ。まず、みんなに謝らないといけない。
Revelations in Fall#213.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#215.src: Mora, it's alright. I was going to reveal this secret anyway.
Revelations in Fall#215.dst: Mora、いいの。どのみちこの秘密は明かすつもりだった。
Revelations in Fall#215.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#216.src: The contact I mentioned earlier today - it's the Sovereign Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#216.dst: 今朝話した協力者― それは君主 Zhiraok よ。
Revelations in Fall#216.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#218.src: What?! How long have you been- wait, Mora, you knew?
Revelations in Fall#218.dst: はあ？！いつから― 待って、Mora、知ってたの？
Revelations in Fall#218.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#219.src: It was a secret kept out of necessity. As for how long... let's say a while, and leave it at that. But we're leaving the {p}, so I see no need to keep it hidden anymore.
Revelations in Fall#219.dst: 必要があって隠していた秘密よ。いつからかは… しばらく前から、とだけ言っておく。でも {p} を離れる以上、もう隠す必要はないわ。
Revelations in Fall#219.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#220.src: I know you all worry about me... and I did not want to add another variable to stress over today. I apologize.
Revelations in Fall#220.dst: みんなが私を心配しているのは分かってる… 今日、心配の種を増やしたくなかったの。ごめんなさい。
Revelations in Fall#220.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#221.dst: それで… パスポートは？
Revelations in Fall#221.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#222.src: Yes, I have them. Zhiraok provided me with enough for all of us. We'll need to move fast, though I want to cross into the Roughworks before he suspects what's going on.
Revelations in Fall#222.dst: ええ、手に入れた。Zhiraok が全員分用意してくれたわ。でも急がないと― 彼に勘づかれる前に Roughworks へ渡りたいの。
Revelations in Fall#222.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#223.src: ...s- so you're safe? It all w- went fine?
Revelations in Fall#223.dst: …じゃ、じゃあ無事なんだね？う、うまくいったの？
Revelations in Fall#223.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#224.src: Yes, Zeph, I am safe. Are you all packed? Crossing the border will take some time, so we need to start going to {p} now.
Revelations in Fall#224.dst: ええ、Zeph、無事よ。みんな荷造りは済んだ？国境越えには時間がかかるから、今すぐ {p} へ向かわないと。
Revelations in Fall#224.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#225.src: Come on, let's hurry. Let us leave this chapter behind.
Revelations in Fall#225.dst: さあ、急ぎましょう。この章は置いていくの。
Revelations in Fall#225.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#226.src: Walk through the gate to the Roughworks at in {p}.
Revelations in Fall#226.dst: {p} の にある Roughworks への門をくぐる。

Revelations in Fall#228.src: I-I a-am ready for this. I have to be.
Revelations in Fall#228.dst: じゅ、準備はできてる。やるしかないんだ。
Revelations in Fall#228.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#229.src: I guess this is really happening...
Revelations in Fall#229.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#231.src: Let's meet up at the gate to the Roughworks and walk through together!
Revelations in Fall#231.dst: Roughworks への門で合流して、一緒にくぐりましょう！
Revelations in Fall#231.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#232.src: Oh... there you are. The, um, line was really long when we got here, so, we... started queuing.
Revelations in Fall#232.dst: あ… 来たね。着いた時、えっと、列がすごく長くて、だから… 先に並んでたの。
Revelations in Fall#232.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#233.src: Everything's... fine, so far. I think. I... hope.
Revelations in Fall#233.dst: 今のところ… 大丈夫。たぶん。そう… 願ってる。
Revelations in Fall#233.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#235.dst: あ、ご、ごめんなさい、ごめんなさい、私
Revelations in Fall#235.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#236.dst: これ！私の、えっと、パスポート。
Revelations in Fall#236.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#238.src: All good. Keep it moving. NEXT!
Revelations in Fall#238.speaker: Passport Officer

Revelations in Fall#243.src: We're through. That went... smoothly enough.
Revelations in Fall#243.dst: 抜けたわ。まあ… 順調だったわね。
Revelations in Fall#243.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#244.dst: い、今のは… き、緊張した。
Revelations in Fall#244.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#247.src: Enough of that, children. Miss Syndra, we've reached the Roughworks, yes?
Revelations in Fall#247.dst: そこまでです、子どもたち。Syndra 嬢、Roughworks に着いたのですね？
Revelations in Fall#247.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#248.src: We have. We'll follow the plan regroup outside {p}, the city in the region. We need to move quickly, I don't know how much time we have before
Revelations in Fall#248.dst: ええ。計画通り、この地域の都市 {p} の外で合流する。急がないと、どれだけ時間があるか分からない、その前に
Revelations in Fall#248.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#249.src: Zero, Syndra. You've got zero time.
Revelations in Fall#249.dst: ゼロだ、Syndra。君の時間はゼロだ。
Revelations in Fall#249.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#250.src: ... Sovereign. Fast and efficient as always, I see.
Revelations in Fall#250.dst: …君主。相変わらず速くて効率的ね。
Revelations in Fall#250.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#251.src: Naturally, you completely miscalculated, thinking you could sneak by like this. An unwanted variable isn't an unexpected one.
Revelations in Fall#251.dst: 当然だ、こんな風にすり抜けられると思うとは、完全な計算違いだな。望まぬ変数は、予期せぬ変数ではない。
Revelations in Fall#251.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#252.src: It was worth a shot, even if unlikely.
Revelations in Fall#252.dst: 望み薄でも、試す価値はあった。
Revelations in Fall#252.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#253.src: What garbage. Translating yourself into the Roughworks completely nulls the crown's pact... As if you wouldn't be spotted.
Revelations in Fall#253.dst: 戯言を。Roughworks へ自分を平行移動すれば、王家との協定は完全に無効だ… 見つからないとでも思ったか。
Revelations in Fall#253.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#254.src: I'm the one who really miscalculated though! Your angle was so obvious, but I just kept overlooking it. Kept trusting you. Kept hoping you'd settle, you'd terminate this sequence.
Revelations in Fall#254.dst: だが本当に計算を誤ったのは私だ！君の狙いは明白なのに見過ごし続けた。信じ続けた。君が落ち着き、この数列を終わらせると願い続けた。
Revelations in Fall#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#255.src: And here you are...associating with a mass murderer! The cursed that caused the Torann massacre!! What kind of lowest-order logic is this?! What were you THINKING?!
Revelations in Fall#255.dst: それがこれか… 大量殺人者とつるむとは！Torann の虐殺を起こした呪われし者だぞ！！何という最低次の論理だ？！何を「考えて」いた？！
Revelations in Fall#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#257.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I was Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#257.dst: 分かりきっているでしょう、君主？女王陛下の失脚を望んでいたの。帝国が崩れ落ちるのを。
Revelations in Fall#257.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#258.src: Your job was to infiltrate, not sum to the resistance!! Since when did you switch to the other side of the equation?! You're subtracting your only chance, you're You're wasting everything I've done for you!
Revelations in Fall#258.dst: 君の任務は潜入で、レジスタンスに加算されることではない！！いつ方程式の反対側に移項した？！唯一の機会を引き算している、君は― 私が君にしてきた全てを無駄にしている！
Revelations in Fall#258.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#259.src: So after everything She did to me, you expected me to just go along with it?! To accept the scraps I was left with, to forgive and forget?!
Revelations in Fall#259.dst: 女王が私にしたことの後で、ただ従うと思っていたの？！残りかすを受け入れて、水に流せと？！
Revelations in Fall#259.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#260.src: Maybe you were the fool all along, Zhiraok, for believing it.
Revelations in Fall#260.dst: 最初から愚かだったのはあなたかもね、Zhiraok。それを信じたのだから。
Revelations in Fall#260.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#262.src: ...so it was all imaginary? Nothing real? I cared about you, as a friend. A confidant. Did you? Or...was I just a convenient tool for you?
Revelations in Fall#262.dst: …では全部虚数だったと？何ひとつ実在しないと？私は友として君を大切に思っていた。腹心として。君は？それとも… 私は都合のいい道具か？
Revelations in Fall#262.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#264.src: Does it...matter. ...ha. Does it matter!! Do you know how much weight you carried in my day to day operations? I wonder how much I carried in yours!!
Revelations in Fall#264.dst: 重要か…だと。…はっ。重要か、だと！！日々の業務で君がどれだけ重みを占めていたか分かるか？私は君の中でどれほどだったのだろうな！！
Revelations in Fall#264.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#265.src: It doesn't make me happy to do this. Your resistance is under arrest for the crime of conspiracy against the crown and your cursed, slated for execution.
Revelations in Fall#265.dst: こんなことをしても嬉しくはない。君のレジスタンスは王家への陰謀の罪で逮捕、そして君の呪われし者は処刑予定だ。
Revelations in Fall#265.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#266.src: I can still pull some strings, Syndra. Round this all out. I might be able to keep you as part of the remainder if you turn yourself in. We can still
Revelations in Fall#266.dst: まだ手は回せる、Syndra。全部丸めてやる。自首すれば、君を余りとして残せるかもしれない。我々はまだ
Revelations in Fall#266.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#267.src: We won't give in without a fight!
Revelations in Fall#267.dst: 戦わずに屈したりしない！
Revelations in Fall#267.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#268.src: ...why...do I even bother. A cursed compared to me...absolute trash. Let's get this over with.
Revelations in Fall#268.dst: …なぜ… 私はこうも構うのか。呪われし者など私と比べれば… ゴミ同然。さっさと片付けよう。
Revelations in Fall#268.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#269.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で君主 Zhiraok を倒す。

Revelations in Fall#270.dst: 終わった… 終わったわ。
Revelations in Fall#270.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#271.src: S- Syndra, are- are y- you
Revelations in Fall#271.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#277.src: Let's move. Everyone, remember the meeting point, just
Revelations in Fall#277.dst: 行くわよ。みんな、合流地点を忘れないで、ただ
Revelations in Fall#277.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#278.src: Are we really glossing over you killing a Sovereign????
Revelations in Fall#278.dst: 君主を殺したこと、本当にスルーするの？？？？
Revelations in Fall#278.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#279.src: Yes, Rex, because he won't stay down for long- that's why we need to move, now!
Revelations in Fall#279.dst: ええ、Rex、彼はすぐ起き上がるから― だから今すぐ動かないといけないの！
Revelations in Fall#279.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#280.src: Split up, stay safe, don't get caught. We meet in three days now, GO!
Revelations in Fall#280.dst: 散って、無事でいて、捕まらないで。三日後に合流よ、行って！
Revelations in Fall#280.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#281.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, sir! You have a visitor here!
Revelations in Fall#281.dst: 君主 Zhiraok 閣下！お客様です！
Revelations in Fall#281.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#282.src: Send them in, and if you could process these files, please-and-thank-you? I need the inquisitor to weigh in on the problem.
Revelations in Fall#282.dst: 通してくれ。それとこの書類を処理してもらえるかな、よろしく頼む。この件は異端審問官の意見が要る。
Revelations in Fall#282.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#283.src: I have a finite value of time for this, so let's keep this short
Revelations in Fall#283.dst: これに割ける時間は有限だ、手短に頼む
Revelations in Fall#283.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#285.src: Hello, Sovereign. Sorry to interrupt you during your working hours once again.
Revelations in Fall#285.dst: こんにちは、君主。また勤務中にお邪魔してごめんなさい。
Revelations in Fall#285.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#286.src: I'll add it to the tally! Bringing the trouble straight to my office, too You've got me nervous with the number of times it's happened recently.
Revelations in Fall#286.dst: 集計に加えておこう！しかも厄介事を執務室に直接持ち込むとは― 最近の回数の多さに緊張してきたよ。
Revelations in Fall#286.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#287.src: Let's cut to the chase, then. Tell me what your angle Ugh. What your request is.
Revelations in Fall#287.dst: では本題に入ろう。君の狙いを― はあ。君の要望を言ってくれ。
Revelations in Fall#287.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#288.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#288.dst: 我慢しないで、胃潰瘍になるわよ。手短に― Roughworks への通行許可が要るの。私と、他に五人分。
Revelations in Fall#288.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#289.src: ...you're really asking me to square the circle here. Why do you need to do this, go there? And so suddenly? Why?
Revelations in Fall#289.dst: …円を正方形にしろと言っているようなものだぞ。なぜそんなことを、あそこへ？しかも急に？なぜだ？
Revelations in Fall#289.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#290.src: I... I need to find her. I don't know how much more time I'll have to try.
Revelations in Fall#290.dst: 私… 彼女を見つけないと。あとどれだけ試す時間があるか分からない。
Revelations in Fall#290.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#291.src: I know, I know!! Quit being obtuse, you know the consequences if you break the mandate, for both of us!!
Revelations in Fall#291.dst: 分かっている、分かっている！！鈍いふりはやめろ、命令に背けばどうなるか分かっているだろう、二人ともだ！！
Revelations in Fall#291.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#293.src: ...Is that all I get? What about the other five?
Revelations in Fall#293.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#295.src: Of course. You and your strays. Why can't you just... There has to be another solution, if we If you I
Revelations in Fall#295.dst: 当然だな。君と迷い子たち。なぜ君はただ… 別の解があるはずだ、もし我々が― もし君が― 私が
Revelations in Fall#295.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#297.src: ...why do I even bother. Fine. You want it so badly, fine!! You know what this will take. Just... Remember. Remember what I've done for you.
Revelations in Fall#297.dst: …なぜ私はこうも構うのか。いいだろう。そこまで望むなら、いいだろう！！何が必要か分かっているな。ただ… 覚えておけ。私が君に何をしてやったか。
Revelations in Fall#297.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#298.src: Thank you, Zhiraok. I won't let your kindness go to waste.
Revelations in Fall#298.dst: ありがとう、Zhiraok。あなたの厚意は無駄にしないわ。
Revelations in Fall#298.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#299.src: Sovereign Zhiraok! Inquisitor Renn has some concerns
Revelations in Fall#299.dst: 君主 Zhiraok 閣下！異端審問官 Renn が懸念を
Revelations in Fall#299.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#300.src: Xao, I need you to clear my schedule. There's a higher priority now, he can wait.
Revelations in Fall#300.dst: Xao、予定を空けてくれ。今はもっと優先すべきことがある、彼は待たせればいい。
Revelations in Fall#300.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#301.src: Oh! Um, of course! If you insist, sir!! Inquisitor Renn won't be happy, but your orders are top
Revelations in Fall#301.dst: あっ！は、はい、もちろんです！閣下がそうおっしゃるなら！！Renn 殿はご不満でしょうが、閣下のご命令が最優
Revelations in Fall#301.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#302.src: No, you're right, I'm being irrational. You're always right. Clear everything but that, it's fine. I'll get back to it later. Unexpected variables, extenuating circumstances...
Revelations in Fall#302.dst: いや、君の言う通りだ、私は非合理的だった。君はいつも正しい。それ以外は全部空けてくれ、それでいい。後で戻る。予期せぬ変数、酌量すべき事情…
Revelations in Fall#302.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#303.src: Sov ...Zhi-Zhi? Is everything okay? You...you look rattled, was it something she said? Should I have not brought her
Revelations in Fall#303.dst: 閣… …Zhi-Zhi？大丈夫ですか？動揺して見えます、彼女に何か言われましたか？お通しすべきでは
Revelations in Fall#303.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#304.src: You didn't do anything wrong. She gave me a prime opportunity anyway. A warning before throwing my sequence out of line.
Revelations in Fall#304.dst: 君は何も悪くない。むしろ彼女は絶好の機会をくれた。私の数列を乱す前に警告をな。
Revelations in Fall#304.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#305.src: Xao, I trust you. I need to leave Auburn in your care for a bit while I solve this. Please. Can you handle that?
Revelations in Fall#305.dst: Xao、君を信頼している。この件を解くまで、しばらく Auburn を任せたい。頼む。できるか？
Revelations in Fall#305.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#306.src: ...oh my, I... It's an honor! I won't let you down, sir!! I'll keep things ship-shape! But, why do you need me for this?
Revelations in Fall#306.dst: …まあ、私… 光栄です！ご期待に背きません、閣下！！万事きっちり整えておきます！でも、なぜ私に？
Revelations in Fall#306.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#307.src: ...I need to converge at the Roughworks, handle her work for a while. That, and the next Crown Festival is soon. I feel like...it'd be a disservice to miss it.
Revelations in Fall#307.dst: …Roughworks に収束しなければならない。しばらく彼女の仕事を肩代わりする。それに次の王冠祭も近い。見逃すのは… 職務怠慢な気がしてね。
Revelations in Fall#307.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#000~1.src: They had the potential to be dangerous. Sometimes, they were. But more often than not, they were heroes. They used their power to protect people in need.
Revelations in Fall#000~1.dst: 彼らは危険になり得た。時には実際そうだった。だが多くの場合、彼らは英雄だった。困っている人々を守るために力を使ったのだ。

Revelations in Fall#006~1.src: Additionally, our risks of operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#006~1.dst: それに、私たちの活動の危険は日に日に増している。{u} を仲間にしたことは後悔していないけど、ここにいることで目をつけられやすいのは明らかよ。
Revelations in Fall#006~1.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#034~1.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u}, of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#034~1.dst: ああ、構いません！さあ、他の子たちも…もちろん {u} も！皆で別れの挨拶をしましょう。いつ戻れるかわかりませんからね！
Revelations in Fall#034~1.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#128~1.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll, h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#128~1.dst: 私…怖いの。もし、もし使ったら、誰かを、き、傷つけそうで…
Revelations in Fall#128~1.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135~1.src: What if... something happened to them- to you - and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#135~1.dst: もしみんなに- あなたに- 何かあって、それで、それで- 私がそこにいなかったら？絶対に、じ、自分を許せない！
Revelations in Fall#135~1.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#258~1.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I want Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#258~1.dst: 明らかでしょう、君主？女王陛下を退位させたいの。彼女の帝国を崩壊させたい。
Revelations in Fall#258~1.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#289~1.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick- I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#289~1.dst: 我慢しないで、胃に穴が開くわよ。手短に言う- Roughworks への通行許可が必要なの。私と、あと五人分。
Revelations in Fall#289~1.speaker: Syndra

Rise of the Quartron#001.src: Shipment {~}A and {~}B, fully accounted for... shipments {~}C and {~}A...missing {~} of quartz content?!
Rise of the Quartron#001.dst: 出荷 {~}A と {~}B、数は合ってる… 出荷 {~}C と {~}A… 石英が {~} 足りない？！
Rise of the Quartron#001.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#002.src: Agh, this is getting worse! There's never been so much loss...whoever this is, thy're getting bold...
Rise of the Quartron#002.dst: ああ、ひどくなる一方！こんなに減ったことはない… 誰だか知らないけど、図に乗ってきたね…
Rise of the Quartron#002.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#003.src: Ugh, go AWAY! Quit hovering over my shoulder like that- wait, a Human? Since when did you get here?
Rise of the Quartron#003.dst: もう、あっち行って！肩越しにうろうろしないで― 待って、人間？いつからここに？
Rise of the Quartron#003.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#004.src: What, you like listening to the melodious sound of my voice or something? Or do you intend to help out?
Rise of the Quartron#004.dst: 何、あたしの美声を聞いてたいわけ？それとも手伝う気？
Rise of the Quartron#004.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#005.src: Well, I'm flattered either way, and I could certainly use the help. Quartz is going missing from my shipments.
Rise of the Quartron#005.dst: まあ、どっちでも光栄だし、助けは本当に欲しい。出荷分の石英が消えてるの。
Rise of the Quartron#005.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#006.src: Obviously one of the laborers is siphoning it to someplace, and I can't have that happening. So, be a private eye, humie.
Rise of the Quartron#006.dst: どう見ても作業員の誰かがどこかへ横流ししてる、そんなの許せない。だから探偵をやってよ、人間さん。
Rise of the Quartron#006.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#007.src: This is actually pretty dire- quartz has some magicality to it, see. It likes to soak up magic power, which means it can be weaponized.
Rise of the Quartron#007.dst: これ実はかなりまずいの― 石英には魔力があってね。魔力を吸い込むから、武器にもできちゃう。
Rise of the Quartron#007.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#008.src: We tend not to use it for weapons since it can overcharge, but that's neither here nor there, is it?
Rise of the Quartron#008.dst: 過充填するから普通は武器には使わないけど、まあそれは置いといて、でしょ？
Rise of the Quartron#008.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#009.src: Every siphoned shipment has gone through Dado. Interrogate him! He hangs out past the big red tent, near the house with red flags.
Rise of the Quartron#009.dst: 抜かれた出荷は全部 Dado を通ってる。問い詰めて！大きな赤いテントの先、赤い旗の家の近くにいるから。
Rise of the Quartron#009.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#010.src: Talk to Dado and see if he is the culprit.
Rise of the Quartron#010.dst: Dado と話し、犯人かどうか確かめる。

Rise of the Quartron#011.src: Okay, these go to division P, and...look, I'm busy allocating these deliveries to {p}. Go pester someone else, okay?
Rise of the Quartron#011.dst: よし、これは P 区画行きで… おい、{p} への配送を割り振るので忙しいんだ。他を当たれ、な？
Rise of the Quartron#011.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#012.src: ...what. You...think I... Pfff... Pffhahaaaah! Ohhh, that's RICH coming from a human of all things!
Rise of the Quartron#012.dst: …は？お前… 俺が… ぷっ… ぷははははっ！よりによって人間様がそれを言うか！
Rise of the Quartron#012.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#013.src: "Oh, me, the hired gun species that kills for money, will accuse you, a storied worker of seven years, of illegal activity!" Wow, you HYPOCRITE!
Rise of the Quartron#013.dst: 「金のために殺す雇われ種族の私が、勤続七年のあなたを不正で訴えます！」うわ、この偽善者！
Rise of the Quartron#013.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#014.src: I'm hardly even angry about this! But, yeah, you freak. You got the wrong guy, surprise! Your brain workin' right in there?
Rise of the Quartron#014.dst: 怒る気にもならねえよ！でもな、変人。人違いだ、残念でした！頭ちゃんと動いてるか？
Rise of the Quartron#014.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#015.src: I bet you got some wires crossed in there, huh? Go scuttle on back to town and kill someone's Wybel for pocket change or something.
Rise of the Quartron#015.dst: 頭の配線がこんがらがってんだろ？さっさと町に戻って、小遣い稼ぎに誰かの Wybel でも殺してきな。
Rise of the Quartron#015.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#016.src: Go back to Nasea and tell her about Dado’s response.
Rise of the Quartron#016.dst: Nasea のもとへ戻り、Dado の反応を伝える。

Rise of the Quartron#017.src: I'm just going to take a wild guess and say that asking him nicely whether he committed theft didn't bring up any answers.
Rise of the Quartron#017.dst: 当ててみようか。盗んだかどうか優しく聞いても、答えは出てこなかったんでしょ。
Rise of the Quartron#017.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#018.src: What, he brushed you off like THAT? Jeez, I knew he was a jerk, but really? That's just uncalled for.
Rise of the Quartron#018.dst: 何、そんな風にあしらわれたの？うわ、嫌な奴だとは知ってたけど、本当に？それはあんまりでしょ。
Rise of the Quartron#018.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#019.src: We have to make him talk...if shipments keep going missing, my contractors are going to look elsewhere!
Rise of the Quartron#019.dst: 口を割らせないと… 出荷が消え続けたら、取引先がよそへ行っちゃう！
Rise of the Quartron#019.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#020.src: We need to prove that he's guilty...wait, you came to ME for ideas? This is why I asked you for help! Am I really back to square one?
Rise of the Quartron#020.dst: 有罪を証明しないと… 待って、あたしに案を聞きに来たの？だからあんたに頼んだんじゃない！振り出しに戻ったってこと？
Rise of the Quartron#020.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#022.src: I...what are you doing here, uh...Larry? Were you missing quartz too??
Rise of the Quartron#022.dst: あ… なんでここに、えっと… Larry？あんたも石英がなくなったの？？
Rise of the Quartron#022.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#023.src: Ah, it's...Lari. No, the quartz shipment found its way fine...
Rise of the Quartron#023.dst: ええと… Lari です。いいえ、石英は無事に届きました…
Rise of the Quartron#023.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#024.src: But, there was hardly an effect. Your idea was, unfortunately, a dead end.
Rise of the Quartron#024.dst: でも、ほとんど効果がなくて。残念ながら、あなたの案は行き止まりでした。
Rise of the Quartron#024.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#025.src: Well, I did warn you that it was only an idea. I manage the mine, I don't practice purification magic. Don't pin anything on me for that.
Rise of the Quartron#025.dst: だから、ただの案だって言ったでしょ。あたしは鉱山の管理者で、浄化魔法の使い手じゃない。あたしのせいにしないでよ。
Rise of the Quartron#025.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#026.src: I did not intend to imply that. Your help was appreciated, fate simply had opposing plans...
Rise of the Quartron#026.dst: そういうつもりではありません。助けには感謝しています、ただ運命が逆を向いていただけで…
Rise of the Quartron#026.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#027.src: ...is this human a part of your operations, miss?
Rise of the Quartron#027.dst: …この人間は、あなたの仕事の方ですか？
Rise of the Quartron#027.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#028.src: Well, in a sense. Someone's siphoning quartz, but our suspect wasn't intimidated by the ten tons of armor, so we're at a loss. Any ideas?
Rise of the Quartron#028.dst: まあ、ある意味ね。誰かが石英を抜いてるんだけど、容疑者は十トンの鎧にもビビらなくて、お手上げなの。何か案ある？
Rise of the Quartron#028.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#029.src: ...as a matter of fact, I do have a solution. Elven botany describes a flower that grows decently close by, the "Tattytale" flower.
Rise of the Quartron#029.dst: …実は、手があります。エルフの植物学に、この近くに生える「Tattytale」という花が記されています。
Rise of the Quartron#029.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#030.src: It weakens the will of those who catch a whiff of its petals, making them pliable to questions. It's...unpleasant, but if it is needed, I suppose.
Rise of the Quartron#030.dst: 花びらの香りを嗅いだ者は意志が弱まり、質問に素直に答えるようになる。気は進みませんが、必要ならば。
Rise of the Quartron#030.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#031.src: There is a cave infested with spiders, and covered with webs in the western mountain. It is the only place it grows outside of {p}, unfortunately.
Rise of the Quartron#031.dst: 西の山に、蜘蛛がはびこり巣に覆われた洞窟があります。残念ながら、{p} の外で咲くのはそこだけです。
Rise of the Quartron#031.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#032.src: Nasea, since it didn't help, I've returned the quartz. I thank you for your help...and I shall bid you both adieu.
Rise of the Quartron#032.dst: Nasea、役に立たなかったので、石英はお返ししました。ご協力に感謝を… では、お二人ともごきげんよう。
Rise of the Quartron#032.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#034.src: Make Dado confess by using the Tattytale Flower.
Rise of the Quartron#034.dst: Tattytale の花を使い、Dado に白状させる。

Rise of the Quartron#035.src: Hey, everyone's least-favorite attack dog! Here boy! You want the emerald? Go kill all the flies in my house! Come on boy!
Rise of the Quartron#035.dst: よう、みんなの嫌われ者の番犬じゃねえか！ほら来い！エメラルドが欲しいか？うちのハエを全部殺してこい！ほら、いい子だ！
Rise of the Quartron#035.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#036.src: Aw, flowers. How sweet of you! Sorry, but I don't cave to psychopaths or flattery, hehehee!
Rise of the Quartron#036.dst: おや、花か。優しいねえ！悪いが、サイコにもおだてにも屈しないんでね、へへへっ！
Rise of the Quartron#036.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#037.src: I...huff... What was THAT for?! Are you offended that I don't like your flo- What? What am I doing with the quartz?
Rise of the Quartron#037.dst: はあ… はあ… 何しやがる？！花が気に入らなかったからって― 何？石英で何してるかって？
Rise of the Quartron#037.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#038.src: Uh, isn't it obvious? I'm working overtime and sending it up to Popo, duh. Where else would I be sending it?
Rise of the Quartron#038.dst: え、見りゃ分かるだろ？残業して Popo に送ってんだよ、当たり前。他にどこへ送るってんだ？
Rise of the Quartron#038.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#039.src: What- Where's Popo sending it? Um...no clue. Whoever it is, they're super rich though. They pay me more than my house is worth every shipment!
Rise of the Quartron#039.dst: 何― Popo がどこへ送ってるか？えーと… 知らね。でも誰だか知らないが、すげえ金持ちだ。毎回、俺の家より高い金をくれるんだぜ！
Rise of the Quartron#039.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#040.src: Not sure why you need to- What? Where's Popo? Uh, he said he'd meet me at the cart track overpass, near the teal flags.
Rise of the Quartron#040.dst: なんでそんなこと― 何？Popo の居場所？えっと、青緑の旗の近く、トロッコ線路の陸橋で会うって言ってた。
Rise of the Quartron#040.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#041.src: This was going to be our first meeting, so I don't know what he looks like, and likewise he's never seen me.
Rise of the Quartron#041.dst: 初めて会う予定だったから、俺はあいつの顔を知らないし、あいつも俺を見たことがない。
Rise of the Quartron#041.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#042.src: ...uh. Okay, I haave no clue why I told you all of that...um, have you got any more of those flowers though? It was actually really good...
Rise of the Quartron#042.dst: …あれ。なんで全部しゃべっちまったんだ… なあ、あの花もっとないか？実はすげえ良かったんだけど…
Rise of the Quartron#042.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#043.src: Go up the minecart hill and find Popo.
Rise of the Quartron#043.dst: トロッコの坂を上り、Popo を探す。

Rise of the Quartron#044.src: Ah, you must- Wait, never mind. I was expecting a visit from someone else.
Rise of the Quartron#044.dst: ああ、お前が― 待て、違うな。別の奴が来るはずだった。
Rise of the Quartron#044.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#045.src: Wait, you're Dado? I guess humans have more brain capacity than orcs after all, hehah!
Rise of the Quartron#045.dst: 待て、お前が Dado？人間ってオークより脳みそがあるんだな、へへっ！
Rise of the Quartron#045.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#046.src: Okay, down to business. I'm gonna look busy to cover for you while you get to the base for briefing. You'll get the details there.
Rise of the Quartron#046.dst: よし、本題だ。お前が基地で説明を受ける間、俺は忙しいふりしてごまかしとく。詳しくは向こうで聞け。
Rise of the Quartron#046.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#047.src: You stick out like a sore thumb, but thankfully humans like to get into lots of weird spots, so it won't look too out of place.
Rise of the Quartron#047.dst: お前はめちゃくちゃ目立つが、人間は変な所に入り込むのが好きだから、そう不自然でもないだろ。
Rise of the Quartron#047.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#048.src: Use the small rail here, flick the lever. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.
Rise of the Quartron#048.dst: ここの小さいレールを使え、レバーを引くんだ。怪しまれずに… 人間らしいことしてるように見える。
Rise of the Quartron#048.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#049.src: Ride the minecart to the bandit mansion.
Rise of the Quartron#049.dst: トロッコに乗って盗賊の屋敷へ向かう。

Rise of the Quartron#050.src: Hop on the minecart, it's leaving! But act natural!
Rise of the Quartron#050.dst: トロッコに乗れ、出るぞ！でも自然にな！
Rise of the Quartron#050.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#051.src: Interesting, a human's been swept up in our plans. Hadn't expected the work force to diversify so fast.
Rise of the Quartron#051.dst: 面白い、人間が我々の計画に巻き込まれたか。労働力がこんなに早く多様化するとはね。
Rise of the Quartron#051.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#052.src: Time for the rundown, oh I love explaining this! I think you'll find what I have to say quite interesting, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#052.dst: 説明の時間だ、ああ説明するのは大好きなんだ！私の話はきっと実に興味深いと思うよ、そうそう！
Rise of the Quartron#052.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#053.src: You see, quartz is a powerful magical material- moreso than many know! It can absorb and harness magical energy, but what more? I had to find out!
Rise of the Quartron#053.dst: いいかね、石英は強力な魔法素材だ― 皆が思う以上にな！魔力を吸収し活用できる、だがそれ以上は？確かめずにいられなかった！
Rise of the Quartron#053.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#054.src: The rubes in my research department got me kicked out for suggesting we further our research. What kind of scientist is scared to make advancements?!
Rise of the Quartron#054.dst: 研究部の間抜けどもは、研究を進めようと提案した私を追い出した。進歩を恐れる科学者がどこにいる？！
Rise of the Quartron#054.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#055.src: But without a board of directors breathing down my neck, my research has led me exactly where I'd hoped, and even more, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#055.dst: だが首根っこを押さえる理事会がいなくなり、研究はまさに望んだ所へ、いやそれ以上へ辿り着いた、そうそう！
Rise of the Quartron#055.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#056.src: Oi. Got a guest taking the secret passage.
Rise of the Quartron#056.dst: おい。秘密の通路を使ってる客がいるぞ。
Rise of the Quartron#056.speaker: Guard

Rise of the Quartron#058.src: Harnort! I'M Dado! This sicko mugged me for info! They're gonna ruin us both!
Rise of the Quartron#058.dst: Harnort！俺が Dado だ！この変態が俺から情報を奪った！二人とも破滅だぞ！
Rise of the Quartron#058.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#059.src: Guards!! GUARDS!! Capture them! Stop them! Tie them up, do something!! Our research can't go to waste, not at this vital point!!
Rise of the Quartron#059.dst: 衛兵！！衛兵！！捕まえろ！止めろ！縛り上げろ、何とかしろ！！我々の研究を無駄にはできない、この大事な時に！！
Rise of the Quartron#059.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#060.src: HA! That's what you get for showing me that amazi- HORRIBLE flower! Outta here!
Rise of the Quartron#060.dst: はっ！あのすげえ― ひでえ花を嗅がせた報いだ！あばよ！
Rise of the Quartron#060.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#061.src: Break into the laboratory and stop Harnort.
Rise of the Quartron#061.dst: 研究所に侵入し、Harnort を止める。

Rise of the Quartron#062.src: ...so, it's come to this then. I knew the names of all those guards. I didn't hurt anyone to meet my goal.
Rise of the Quartron#062.dst: …そうか、こうなるのか。衛兵たちの名前は全員知っていた。目的のために誰も傷つけなかったのに。
Rise of the Quartron#062.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#063.src: You...I won't let their sacrifices be in vain! {p} needs to see what quartz is truly capable of! I MUST show them.
Rise of the Quartron#063.dst: 貴様… 彼らの犠牲を無駄にはさせない！{p} に石英の真の力を見せねば！必ず見せるのだ。
Rise of the Quartron#063.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#064.src: My Quartrons are the future! They need to see it! It will have been worth the scheming, and the thieving, and the burnt bridges!
Rise of the Quartron#064.dst: 私の Quartron こそ未来だ！皆が見なくては！策略も、盗みも、断った縁も、全てその価値があったことになる！
Rise of the Quartron#064.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#065.src: But you- you couldn't leave well enough alone. You stepped in, and callously threw away a hundred lives to stop the inevitable!
Rise of the Quartron#065.dst: なのに貴様は― 放っておけなかった。首を突っ込み、避けられぬものを止めるため、百の命を冷酷に捨てた！
Rise of the Quartron#065.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#066.src: One live for a hundred is a fair trade!!
Rise of the Quartron#066.dst: 百のために一つの命、公平な取引だ！！
Rise of the Quartron#066.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#067.src: Take down the Quartron and return to nasea with the news.
Rise of the Quartron#067.dst: Quartron を倒し、Nasea に知らせに戻る。

Rise of the Quartron#068.src: Aaah! Not responding?! You- You... YOU! You've destroyed the future! MY future! GAVEL'S future!!!
Rise of the Quartron#068.dst: ああっ！反応しない？！貴様― 貴様… 貴様！未来を壊した！「私の」未来を！Gavel の未来を！！！
Rise of the Quartron#068.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#069.src: The futures of a hundred men or more!! You humans deserve to burn in hell for your careless destruction!
Rise of the Quartron#069.dst: 百人以上の未来を！！無神経な破壊をする人間どもは地獄で焼かれるがいい！
Rise of the Quartron#069.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#070.src: The energy output by the detonations is overcharging the quartz in the walls... This entire lab is a deathtrap now! Do us all a favor- SIT STILL AND DIE ALREADY!!
Rise of the Quartron#070.dst: 爆発のエネルギーが壁の石英を過充填している… この研究所はもう死の罠だ！皆のために頼む― おとなしく座って死ね！！
Rise of the Quartron#070.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#071.src: ...you've got some serious explaining to do. First you disappear to get that Tattle flower, or whatever it was.
Rise of the Quartron#071.dst: …ちゃんと説明してもらうからね。まず、あんたはあの Tattle の花だか何かを取りに消えた。
Rise of the Quartron#071.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#072.src: Then Dado ran through here screaming that he was drugged or nugged, and ran off to the east ridge.
Rise of the Quartron#072.dst: それから Dado が薬を盛られたとか何とか叫びながら駆け抜けて、東の尾根へ走ってった。
Rise of the Quartron#072.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#073.src: Then, he came back, asking me if I'd found any more of those flowers, and while he was blabbering the ENTIRE MOUNTAIN SHOOK.
Rise of the Quartron#073.dst: それからまた戻ってきて、あの花がもっとないかって聞いてきて、あいつがわめいてる間に「山全体が揺れた」。
Rise of the Quartron#073.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#074.src: So, spill it. I wanted you to figure out where my quartz was going, and you made one of my workers an addict and caused a freaking landslide!!
Rise of the Quartron#074.dst: さあ、白状して。石英の行き先を突き止めてって頼んだのに、作業員を中毒にして、とんでもない土砂崩れまで起こした！！
Rise of the Quartron#074.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#075.src: ...uh huh. Mhm. ... ...yeah, go on. Uh, okay, I can buy that... I'd never believe you if you hadn't given me the proof.
Rise of the Quartron#075.dst: …ふーん。うん。… …うん、続けて。え、まあ、信じられなくもない… 証拠がなかったら絶対信じないけど。
Rise of the Quartron#075.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#076.src: A militarized quartz mech...yeesh. That guy sounds like a piece of work. Guess that wasn't really your fault after all.
Rise of the Quartron#076.dst: 軍事用の石英メカ… うわ。そいつ相当な曲者だね。結局あんたのせいじゃなかったみたい。
Rise of the Quartron#076.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#077.src: I'll round up the police to get all those guards and them. ...what's with that look? Almost looks like you don't think anyone'll be there. Anyways...
Rise of the Quartron#077.dst: 警察を集めて、衛兵とかを全員捕まえてもらう。…何その顔？まるで誰も残ってないと思ってるみたい。とにかく…
Rise of the Quartron#077.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#078.src: Okay, so I'll out you a quick deal. I'll pay you now for figuring this out, and if you do justt one more thing for me then you'll get something extra.
Rise of the Quartron#078.dst: じゃあ手短に取引ね。解決してくれた分は今払う、もう一つだけ頼みを聞いてくれたら、おまけもつける。
Rise of the Quartron#078.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#079.src: Take the elevator past the yellow flags and go into the private site, you have my permission. I'll meet you up there.
Rise of the Quartron#079.dst: 黄色い旗の先のエレベーターで私有地に入って、許可するから。上で会おう。
Rise of the Quartron#079.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#080.src: Join Nasea at the end of the minecart track.
Rise of the Quartron#080.dst: トロッコの線路の終点で Nasea と合流する。

Rise of the Quartron#082.src: This is the newest mining annex, but we've hit a bit of a brick wall. Well...a gravel wall.
Rise of the Quartron#082.dst: ここが一番新しい採掘区画なんだけど、壁にぶち当たっちゃって。まあ… 砂利の壁にね。
Rise of the Quartron#082.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#083.src: So, if you can open up this area, you'll get access to the mine and whatever you find in it.
Rise of the Quartron#083.dst: だから、この区画を開けてくれたら、鉱山とその中で見つけた物はあんたのもの。
Rise of the Quartron#083.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#084.src: I have to be off though, lots of work to get to. Hm. It looks like the core you showed me folded up into a ring. Really high-tech stuff, but I can't use it, so you can take it.
Rise of the Quartron#084.dst: でもあたしはもう行かなきゃ、仕事が山積みでね。ん。見せてくれたコア、指輪に畳まれたみたい。すごい技術だけどあたしには使えないし、持ってっていいよ。
Rise of the Quartron#084.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#085.src: Suppose that's all, then! Here's your payment. I'll see you around.
Rise of the Quartron#085.dst: じゃあ、これで全部かな！はい、報酬。またね。
Rise of the Quartron#085.speaker: Nasea

Rogue Wyrmling#000.dst: この事は二度と口にするな… よそ者。

Royal Trials#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Skyraider Guard と話す。

Royal Trials#001.src: Back off! No'ne enters 'til the pirate queen is chosen. What's a landwalker like you doin' here?
Royal Trials#001.dst: 下がりな！海賊女王が決まるまで誰も入れないよ。あんたみたいな陸の者がここで何してんだい？
Royal Trials#001.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#002.src: Participate? Are ye crazy? Ain't no way a landlubber is wearing the crown.
Royal Trials#002.dst: 参加？正気かい？陸者が王冠をかぶるなんてありえないね。
Royal Trials#002.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#003.src: Off with ya now! Before I call the gals to gut you. And dun' go wandering around chatting to any skyraiders!
Royal Trials#003.dst: とっとと失せな！仲間を呼んで腹を裂かせる前にね。それと Skyraider に話しかけてうろつくんじゃないよ！
Royal Trials#003.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#005.src: Yer wantin' to be pirate queen, ye? Don' worry, I can help ye.
Royal Trials#005.dst: 海賊女王になりたいんだろ？心配すんな、あたいが手を貸すよ。
Royal Trials#005.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#006.src: Y'see, the other pirates ain't fit for the role. They're dumb 'n weak. All they've got is looks.
Royal Trials#006.dst: いいかい、他の海賊どもはその器じゃない。バカで弱い。見た目だけさ。
Royal Trials#006.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#007.src: Yer got the lot! Looks and talent.
Royal Trials#007.dst: あんたは全部持ってる！見た目も才能も。
Royal Trials#007.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#008.src: Y'know, the guard, she's dumb too. A simple disguise will fool 'er. Issue is, ye dun' look like a skyraider at all!
Royal Trials#008.dst: あの見張りもバカでね。簡単な変装で騙せる。問題は、あんたが Skyraider に全然見えないことさ！
Royal Trials#008.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#009.src: Yer in luck, though. A skyraider will sell anything for a price - just look around the town and see if ye can persuade anyone to part with their outfit.
Royal Trials#009.dst: でも運がいいね。Skyraider は金さえ出せば何でも売る― 町を回って、誰かに服を譲ってもらえないか頼んでみな。
Royal Trials#009.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#010.src: Look around the skyraider town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find a pirate outfit.
Royal Trials#010.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Skyraider の町を回り、海賊の服を手に入れる。

Royal Trials#011.src: Aye? A landwalker, wanderin' around our base? Whatcha' want?
Royal Trials#011.dst: ああ？陸の者がうちの基地をうろついてる？何の用だい？
Royal Trials#011.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#013.src: ... aye, I suppose I could be tempted to pass it on to ye... for a price.
Royal Trials#013.dst: …まあ、譲ってやらなくもないね… 代わりのもんがあれば。
Royal Trials#013.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#014.src: Here, these are what I'd trade it to ye for.
Royal Trials#014.dst: ほら、これと交換なら譲るよ。
Royal Trials#014.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#015.src: If yer thinkin' emeralds... [{~} Emerald Blocks] seems like a fair price, heh.
Royal Trials#015.dst: エメラルドなら… [{~} Emerald Blocks] ってとこが妥当だね、へへ。
Royal Trials#015.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#016.src: Of course, if you're running low on funds, how about ye grab me [{~} Dragonling Eggs] instead? Y'know, the ingredient. I'm 'oping to raise some 'o the lil critters!
Royal Trials#016.dst: もちろん金欠なら、代わりに [{~} Dragonling Eggs] を持ってきな。ほら、素材のやつさ。あのちっこいのを何匹か育ててみたいんだ！
Royal Trials#016.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#017.src: But if neither of them tickle ye fancy... I've always wanted [{~} Shiny Shell] - they're just so sparkly! Ye can find them in the cave south-east of here, beside the ladders.
Royal Trials#017.dst: どっちも気に入らなきゃ… ずっと [{~} Shiny Shell] が欲しかったんだ― キラキラしてんのさ！ここから南東の洞窟、はしごの横で見つかるよ。
Royal Trials#017.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#018.src: Ye can get me one o' those three, landwalker, and ye can have my outfit!
Royal Trials#018.dst: その三つのどれか一つを持ってきな、陸の者。そしたらこの服はあんたのもんだ！
Royal Trials#018.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#019.src: Give an item to Egpla at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Royal Trials#019.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Egpla にアイテムを渡す。

Royal Trials#020.src: So, landwalker, are ye ready to pay up? I can see emeralds in ye pocket, hand 'em over.
Royal Trials#020.dst: さて陸の者、払う気になったかい？ポケットにエメラルドが見えてるよ、よこしな。
Royal Trials#020.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#021.src: Alrigh'! Those're exactly what I've been lookin' for. Give it here, lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#021.dst: よし！まさに探してたもんだ。こっちによこしな、見せてみ…
Royal Trials#021.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#022.src: Aye, landwalker! Is that the sparkle of a shiny shell I spot in ye pocket?! Lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#022.dst: おや、陸の者！ポケットで光ってるのは shiny shell かい？！見せてみな…
Royal Trials#022.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#023.src: Alright, landwalker. Ye can have me outfit. 'ere, lemme just get changed inside.
Royal Trials#023.dst: よし、陸の者。服はあんたにやるよ。ほら、中で着替えてくるから。
Royal Trials#023.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#024.src: Here ye go, landlubber. I hope ye get some kinda use out of it, whatever ye want it for.
Royal Trials#024.dst: ほらよ、陸者。何に使うか知らないが、役に立つといいね。
Royal Trials#024.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#026.src: Another contestant, eh? That outfit looks a bit funny on ye, but I'll let yer in. Hurry up!
Royal Trials#026.dst: また参加者かい？その服、ちょっと妙に見えるけど、通してやるよ。急ぎな！
Royal Trials#026.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#028.src: Ugh! Ye can't be the queen, ye can barely fly an airship!
Royal Trials#028.dst: はっ！あんたが女王になれるもんか、飛行船もろくに飛ばせないくせに！
Royal Trials#028.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#029.src: No! I'll be the queen! I'm much more qualified than any of you sky rats!
Royal Trials#029.dst: 違う！女王はあたしだ！空のドブネズミどもよりずっとふさわしいよ！
Royal Trials#029.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#030.src: Listen to the Trials Overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#030.dst: 試練監督官の演説を聞く。

Royal Trials#031.src: Gather round, ladies. The next Queen is about to be selected!
Royal Trials#031.dst: 集まりな、お嬢さんたち。次の女王がいよいよ選ばれるよ！
Royal Trials#031.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#032.src: As ye know, our previous queen suffered a... nasty fate, murdered on her very own airship by a Wynn soldier.
Royal Trials#032.dst: 知っての通り、先代の女王は… ひどい最期を遂げた。自分の飛行船で Wynn の兵士に殺されたんだ。
Royal Trials#032.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#033.src: But in the ashes of her honor, a new queen shall rise! Three trials. That's what ye all face now.
Royal Trials#033.dst: だが彼女の誇りの灰から、新たな女王が立つ！試練は三つ。それがあんたらの挑むものさ。
Royal Trials#033.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#034.src: Only one, who passes all trials laid before her, will pass and gain the title of Skyraider Queen.
Royal Trials#034.dst: 課された試練を全て越えた一人だけが、Skyraider の女王の称号を得る。
Royal Trials#034.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#035.src: Now, I introduce ye all to the first trial, to test yer capability at a vital skill for queenship - combat!
Royal Trials#035.dst: では最初の試練を紹介しよう。女王に欠かせない技― 戦闘の腕を試すよ！
Royal Trials#035.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#037.src: Defeat the armory room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#037.dst: 戦闘の試練の武器庫の部屋を突破する。

Royal Trials#038.src: Defeat the brig room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#038.dst: 戦闘の試練の営倉の部屋を突破する。

Royal Trials#039.src: Defeat the cockpit room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#039.dst: 戦闘の試練の操縦室の部屋を突破する。

Royal Trials#040.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#040.dst: 試練監督官の演説を聞く。

Royal Trials#041.src: Arr, that weeded out the weak. A queen must be strong to lead.
Royal Trials#041.dst: よし、弱い奴はふるい落とされた。女王は強くなきゃ率いられない。
Royal Trials#041.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#042.src: Now, to the second challenge - the task of flight! Ye can't be a queen if ye can't fly yer airship!
Royal Trials#042.dst: さて、二つ目の試練― 飛行だ！自分の飛行船を飛ばせなきゃ女王にはなれないよ！
Royal Trials#042.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#043.src: Make sure ye bring yer eyes, girls, one false move and death awaits.
Royal Trials#043.dst: しっかり目を開けときな、お嬢さんたち。一つのミスが命取りだよ。
Royal Trials#043.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#044.src: This task should get rid of the rest of ye unworthy.
Royal Trials#044.dst: これで残りの半端者も片付くだろうね。
Royal Trials#044.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#045.dst: 飛行の試練を突破する。

Royal Trials#046.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#046.dst: 試練監督官の演説を聞く。

Royal Trials#047.src: Well lookie here, an amateur made it through her flight.
Royal Trials#047.dst: おやおや、素人が飛行を越えてきたね。
Royal Trials#047.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#048.src: Well let’s see how you hold up in the final task ladies.
Royal Trials#048.dst: さて、最後の試練でどこまで耐えられるか見せてもらおうか。
Royal Trials#048.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#049.src: Yer ain’ a pirate at all if ye can't steal, but this is different.
Royal Trials#049.dst: 盗めなきゃ海賊じゃないが、今回はわけが違う。
Royal Trials#049.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#050.src: This is the real deal. Stealin’ from a highly secure mansion.
Royal Trials#050.dst: 今回は本番だ。厳重な屋敷からの盗みさ。
Royal Trials#050.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#051.src: Yer job is to steal a priceless treasure from the richest family in the sky.
Royal Trials#051.dst: 空一の金持ち一家から、値のつけられない宝を盗むんだ。
Royal Trials#051.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#052.src: We'll be waiting with a getaway airship at the extraction point, everyone else'll left behind.
Royal Trials#052.dst: 脱出地点で逃走用の飛行船を待たせとく、他の奴らは置いてくよ。
Royal Trials#052.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#053.src: Remember, this be the real thing, and the consequences of failure will be severe. Good luck, ladies.
Royal Trials#053.dst: いいかい、これは本番だ、失敗すりゃただじゃ済まない。幸運を、お嬢さんたち。
Royal Trials#053.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#054.src: This here is the garden you we'll tunnel into, and yer'll 'ave to find a way into the Mansion, maybe yer can just ask nicely, heh.
Royal Trials#054.dst: ここが地下から掘って入る庭だ。屋敷への入り方は自分で探しな、丁寧に頼めば入れてくれるかもね、へへ。
Royal Trials#054.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#055.src: Then yer'll have to sneak through these corridors to reach the treasure - and don't let the guards find yer, or they'll lock yer up and throw away the key.
Royal Trials#055.dst: それからこの廊下を忍んで宝まで行く― 衛兵に見つかるんじゃないよ、牢にぶち込まれて鍵を捨てられちまう。
Royal Trials#055.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#056.src: This, o' course, is the mythical treasure that yer gonna want to grab and get outta here, stat. I'm sure there'll be some extra defenses, though.
Royal Trials#056.dst: で、これがもちろん、ひっつかんで即ずらかるべき伝説の宝だ。まあ、守りは余分についてるだろうけどね。
Royal Trials#056.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#057.src: And finally yer'll have to escape outta this window right 'ere - I'll be waitin' with an airship to carry all of ye out.
Royal Trials#057.dst: 最後にこの窓から脱出する― あたしが飛行船で待ってて、全員を運び出すよ。
Royal Trials#057.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#059.src: Aye', think ye ready to try grabbin' that treasure, eh? Just 'ead outta this hole and try to find yer way into the mansion.
Royal Trials#059.dst: よう、宝を取りに行く気になったかい？この穴から出て、屋敷への入り方を探しな。
Royal Trials#059.speaker: Skyraider

Royal Trials#060.src: Sneak past the guards and steal the treasure.
Royal Trials#060.dst: 衛兵をかわして宝を盗む。

Royal Trials#061.src: Oi', you! Whatcha' think yer' doin' sneakin' around these parts? This be a restricted area! Yer' headed to the jail cell!
Royal Trials#061.dst: おい、そこのお前！こんな所をこそこそ何してる？ここは立入禁止区域だ！牢屋行きだぞ！
Royal Trials#061.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#062.src: Get the treasure to the trials overseer outside of the mansion's window.
Royal Trials#062.dst: 屋敷の窓の外にいる試練監督官へ宝を届ける。

Royal Trials#063.src: Aye', men! Tha' treasure has been stolen! Prepare the defenses!
Royal Trials#063.dst: おい、野郎ども！宝が盗まれた！守りを固めろ！
Royal Trials#063.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#064.src: Aye, we caught the nasty thief! We'll be lockin' him up till' he rots!
Royal Trials#064.dst: よし、薄汚い泥棒を捕まえたぞ！朽ち果てるまで閉じ込めてやる！
Royal Trials#064.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#065.src: Ah, I thought yer might be the first one back. Yer got a queenly look about ye...
Royal Trials#065.dst: おや、一番に戻るのはあんただと思ってたよ。女王の風格があるね…
Royal Trials#065.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#066.src: Head to the airship behind me, lassie. We'll wait a second before the others.
Royal Trials#066.dst: 後ろの飛行船に乗りな、嬢ちゃん。他の奴らを少し待つよ。
Royal Trials#066.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#067.src: Exit the Mansion onto the airship outside.
Royal Trials#067.dst: 屋敷を出て、外の飛行船に乗る。

Royal Trials#068.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#068.dst: 試練監督官の演説を聞く。

Royal Trials#069.src: Aha! I figured it'd be ye to win o'er the rest of that lot… Ye've earned the proper sovereignty of bein' our ruler, our queen of the Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#069.dst: はは！残りの連中に勝つのはあんただと思ってたよ… 我らの支配者、Skyraider の女王の座を見事に勝ち取ったね。
Royal Trials#069.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#070.src: Don't be worryin', we got this airship armoured somethin' heavy, and we’re miles away from their cannons… Nothin' to be afraid of, we're safe in this ship.
Royal Trials#070.dst: 心配いらないよ、この飛行船はがっちり装甲してあるし、奴らの大砲から何マイルも離れてる… 怖がることはない、この船なら安全さ。
Royal Trials#070.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#071.src: But, first things first, let’s take a look inside that fancy box ye got, see what mythical treasures lay guarded behind those grubby guardsmen, shall we?
Royal Trials#071.dst: でもまずは、あんたが手に入れた立派な箱の中を見てみようか。薄汚い衛兵どもが守ってた伝説の宝ってのは何なのか、ね？
Royal Trials#071.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#073.src: I hafta wonder now if this weren't bein' guarded for a bit of a nefarious reason. This be... Quite the weapon. It'd be deadly if this got used.
Royal Trials#073.dst: こいつは何か悪だくみのために守られてたんじゃないかと思えてきたよ。これは… 大した武器だ。使われたら恐ろしいことになる。
Royal Trials#073.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#074.src: Well, thanks to ye, us Skyraiders might have it now, but using this weapon against civilization would be beyond terrible. We might be pirates but we ain't heartless!
Royal Trials#074.dst: まあ、あんたのおかげで Skyraider のものになったかもしれないが、この武器を文明に向けるなんてひどすぎる。海賊だけど、心まで無くしちゃいないよ！
Royal Trials#074.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#075.src: I think we'll just have to keep this locked up nice n' tight once we get back. We'll be sure to tie this little cataclysm-in-a-box down much safer th'n those idiot men did.
Royal Trials#075.dst: 戻ったら、こいつはしっかり封じておくしかないね。この箱入りの大災厄は、あのバカな男どもよりずっと厳重に縛っとくよ。
Royal Trials#075.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#076.src: Aha! Just gettin' back now. Let's head down and start the ceremony, shall we?
Royal Trials#076.dst: はは！ちょうど戻ったね。降りて式を始めようか？
Royal Trials#076.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#077.src: I am pleased to introduce our {~}th Skyraider Queen. Fer the sake of our people, let her reign last more than two weeks.
Royal Trials#077.dst: 我らが第 {~} 代 Skyraider の女王を紹介しよう。民のためにも、今度の治世は二週間より長く続きますように。
Royal Trials#077.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#078.src: I, on behalf on the rest of the Skyraider people, have the honor of decoratin' you with the highest decoration of the Skyraiders, The Queen's Headpiece.
Royal Trials#078.dst: Skyraider の民を代表して、Skyraider 最高の栄誉、The Queen's Headpiece を授ける光栄にあずかる。
Royal Trials#078.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#079.src: Please use your sovereignty to lead us to the riches we deserve.
Royal Trials#079.dst: どうかその統治で、我らをふさわしい富へ導いておくれ。
Royal Trials#079.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#081.src: Yer Majesty. What an honour to have such a beautiful queen.
Royal Trials#081.dst: 陛下。こんなに美しい女王を戴けるとは光栄です。
Royal Trials#081.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#082.src: Now, we must crown ye, and give you yer reward.
Royal Trials#082.dst: さあ、戴冠して、褒美を授けないとね。
Royal Trials#082.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#083.src: Benefits of being a queen I 'spose.
Royal Trials#083.dst: 女王になった特典ってやつかね。
Royal Trials#083.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#084.dst: どうぞお受け取りください、陛下。
Royal Trials#084.speaker: Trials Overseer

Shattered Minds#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} にいる Likeru と話す。

Shattered Minds#001.src: Aha, perfect! You'll be perfect! Lucky a human decided to come here!
Shattered Minds#001.dst: あはっ、完璧！君ならぴったり！人間が来てくれるなんてツイてる！
Shattered Minds#001.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#002.src: I'll get to the point- I want you to go get something for me, and then bring it back here. Simple, right?
Shattered Minds#002.dst: 単刀直入に言うね。取ってきてほしい物があるの。ここへ持ち帰るだけ。簡単でしょ？
Shattered Minds#002.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#003.src: When you do that, I'm going to fix it up and try something out on you. Something magically enlightening!
Shattered Minds#003.dst: 持ってきたら、それを加工して君で試したいことがあるんだ。魔法で悟りが開けるやつ！
Shattered Minds#003.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#004.src: Oh, don't give me that look, it should be perfectly safe! Unless you've been mired in darkness for the past however many years...
Shattered Minds#004.dst: ちょっと、そんな顔しないで、安全なはずだから！ここ何年も闇にどっぷり浸かってたなら別だけど…
Shattered Minds#004.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#005.src: Anyway, what I need is a specific kind of mushroom that grows close by, the Bluecap Mushroom.
Shattered Minds#005.dst: とにかく、近くに生える特別なキノコが要るの。ブルーキャップっていうんだ。
Shattered Minds#005.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#006.src: They grow underground- in a cave out the gate northwest of here. I'll even pay you if you bring it back, so what have you got to lose?
Shattered Minds#006.dst: 地下に生えてるの。ここから北西の門を出た先の洞窟ね。持ってきたらお礼もするよ、損はないでしょ？
Shattered Minds#006.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#007.src: Bring Likeru the mushrooms from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shattered Minds#007.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟からキノコを Likeru に届ける。

Shattered Minds#008.src: Figure out how to get out of the cave, and return to Likeru.
Shattered Minds#008.dst: 洞窟から出る方法を見つけ、Likeru の所へ戻る。

Shattered Minds#009.src: Looks like someone rolled about the air fuzz too much, so indeed hello! A light hello to yourself, {u}, and a greetings to Professor Eih, which is me!
Shattered Minds#009.dst: 空の綿毛で転げ回りすぎた者がいるようだ、ならばこんにちは！{u}、君に軽やかな挨拶を、そして私こと Eih 教授にもご挨拶を！

Shattered Minds#010.src: I don't rhyme all the instances, I feel the need to say. But what do you say? Very little! But I bet you're wondering where you are.
Shattered Minds#010.dst: 毎回韻を踏むわけではないと言っておこう。で、君は何と言う？ほぼ無言！だがここがどこか気になっているだろう。
Shattered Minds#010.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#011.src: I am no gambling man, but the chips are down and it is time to play {~}-Pickup with the puzzle pieces, and I'll eat my bowtie if you aren't ready.
Shattered Minds#011.dst: 私は博打打ちではないが、勝負の時だ。パズルのピースで{~}枚拾いといこう。君の準備ができていなければ蝶ネクタイを食べてやる。
Shattered Minds#011.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#012.src: The betting pool says the way to go is the opposite of in front, so that leaves someplace we can't talk about in front of the kids as your path!
Shattered Minds#012.dst: 賭け屋いわく、進むべきは前の反対。つまり子供の前では口にできない場所こそ君の道だ！
Shattered Minds#012.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#013.src: I will be around! Or asquare, as it were. Technically amultiplesquares, replete with alines! And abevels! And other some such things like-
Shattered Minds#013.dst: 私はそこらに居る！いや、そこら四角に。正確には複数四角に、線も添えて！斜面も！その他もろもろ例えば―
Shattered Minds#013.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#014.src: The punks scramble like eggs, and your skillet is sizzling! Certainly the heat in the kitchen is too much- so where is the fire extinguisher?
Shattered Minds#014.dst: チンピラどもは卵のように散り、君のフライパンはジュウジュウ！台所は明らかに熱すぎる― では消火器はどこだ？
Shattered Minds#014.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#015.src: It won't rocket you! The hole in the shape of a door looms out of your transparent grasp- frogs can't skip leg day, so be froggy! Bounce and jump!
Shattered Minds#015.dst: ロケットで飛ばしはしない！扉の形の穴が透明な手の先に迫る― カエルは脚の日をサボれない、カエルになれ！跳ねて跳べ！
Shattered Minds#015.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#016.src: Swoosh and sprint! Speed and non-slip shoes! With a CLICK upon me I give you all but one, as much as you need!
Shattered Minds#016.dst: シュッと走れ！速さと滑らない靴！私をカチッとすれば、一つを除いて全部、必要なだけ授けよう！
Shattered Minds#016.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#017.src: The colors! Shimmering as a prism- oh, no one likes those things. The writing is on the wall, but the window mugs it for pocket change! The inhumanity!
Shattered Minds#017.dst: 色だ！プリズムのように揺らめく― おっと、あれは誰も好かん。文字は壁に書いてあるが、窓が小銭目当てに襲う！なんと非道！
Shattered Minds#017.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#018.src: Use your eyes as ears and hear what I shall write! The cockpit is missing ground control and the cornfields all look the same in endless rows!
Shattered Minds#018.dst: 目を耳にして、私の書くことを聞け！操縦席には地上管制がなく、トウモロコシ畑は果てなく同じ列が続く！
Shattered Minds#018.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#019.src: So Eih, esquire professor PhD, will provide the coordinates in helpfully non-literal fashion, and one's joystick shall lead the holder to bliss!
Shattered Minds#019.dst: ゆえに教授にして博士たる Eih 殿が、親切にも比喩で座標を授けよう。操縦桿は持つ者を至福へ導く！
Shattered Minds#019.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#020.src: At one's boots, the colors paint themselves towards an orientation. Above one's head, the lights match and fling you the same!
Shattered Minds#020.dst: 足元では色が自ら方角を描く。頭上では光が揃い、君を同じ方へ放り投げる！
Shattered Minds#020.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#021.src: I'm all out of airplane food, but the goal is more than peanuts- it's progress, just opposite our position. Fly well!
Shattered Minds#021.dst: 機内食は品切れだが、目標はピーナッツ以上― 前進だ、我らの位置の真向かいにな。良い空の旅を！
Shattered Minds#021.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#022.src: WOW. Just, WOW! Your brain being frazzled doesn't excuse this failure! Time is money and we're swimming in a river called DEBT!
Shattered Minds#022.dst: わお。ただただ、わお！脳が焦げていてもこの失敗は許されん！時は金なり、我々は「借金」という川で泳いでいる！
Shattered Minds#022.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#023.src: I'm just going to stand here and you're gonna go into the teleporters I'm NOT in, and you're gonna like it!
Shattered Minds#023.dst: 私はここに立っているから、君は私のいない転送装置に入るのだ、そして気に入るのだ！
Shattered Minds#023.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#024.src: Explore the strange forest to find Likeru.
Shattered Minds#024.dst: 奇妙な森を探索し、Likeru を見つける。

Shattered Minds#025.src: Hey, look to your left for a moment.
Shattered Minds#025.dst: おい、ちょっと左を見てみな。

Shattered Minds#026.src: I hope you've got a note pad with you, if you want me to teach you the ways of a master you'll need to write a lot down!
Shattered Minds#026.dst: メモ帳は持ってるか？俺に達人の道を教わりたいなら、たくさん書き留めることになるぞ！
Shattered Minds#026.speaker: Steve

Shattered Minds#027.src: It doesn't matter that we're on a {~}-match losing streak, we'll never give up!
Shattered Minds#027.dst: {~}連敗中だろうが関係ない、俺たちは絶対に諦めない！
Shattered Minds#027.speaker: Erd

Shattered Minds#028.src: C'mon Beakmeister, we've ventured together for years now! Why won't you listen to me?
Shattered Minds#028.dst: 頼むよ Beakmeister、何年も一緒に冒険してきたじゃないか！なんで言うこと聞いてくれないんだ？
Shattered Minds#028.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#029.src: I don't think she's even listening to me anymore. She's a free spirit!
Shattered Minds#029.dst: もう俺の話なんて聞いてないな。自由な魂なんだよ！
Shattered Minds#029.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#030.src: Familiar to the nursing home, with no IV in sight! Phenomenal, and now my gambling metaphors will be apropos!
Shattered Minds#030.dst: 老人ホームにおなじみ、なのに点滴は見当たらない！素晴らしい、これで私の賭け事の比喩もぴったりだ！
Shattered Minds#030.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#031.src: A solid, {~} pure, statue-made-out-of-tons-of-things what looks like me! I call it, “Ill Of The Ooze, Young!” And it begets your path amongst the lilypads.
Shattered Minds#031.dst: 堅牢で{~}純度、山ほどの物でできた私そっくりの像！名付けて「若き日の軟泥の病！」それが睡蓮の間の道を生む。
Shattered Minds#031.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#032.src: Likeru? No, no, she can’t find you here- her eyes deceive her. But I won't! Not any more than the film reel degrades, and the theater is ahead!
Shattered Minds#032.dst: Likeru？いやいや、彼女はここで君を見つけられん― 目が欺いている。だが私は違う！フィルムが劣化するほどにはな、劇場は前方だ！
Shattered Minds#032.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#033.src: Now, don't tell the kids about this one either! The way forward is through my masterpiece- but I can't imagine a gullet glorious!
Shattered Minds#033.dst: さて、これも子供には内緒だ！進む道は私の傑作の中― だが栄光の喉袋など想像もつかん！
Shattered Minds#033.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#034.src: Enter the giant frog and escape.
Shattered Minds#034.dst: 巨大なカエルの中に入り、脱出する。

Shattered Minds#035.src: Don't come any closer... I don't want to have to fight...
Shattered Minds#035.dst: それ以上近づかないで…戦いたくないの…

Shattered Minds#036.src: I-I'm warning you. You'll stand no match against me...
Shattered Minds#036.dst: け、警告するよ。あなたじゃ私には敵わない…

Shattered Minds#038.src: There we are! Snapped out of it! Though perhaps writing in the mud was better- Soon it will dry.
Shattered Minds#038.dst: それでいい！正気に戻った！だが泥に書いた方が良かったかも― じきに乾く。
Shattered Minds#038.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#039.src: Without the static of the fungal caps, the radio station will be off-air- and the device unplugged!
Shattered Minds#039.dst: 菌の傘の雑音がなければ、ラジオ局は放送停止― そして装置のプラグも抜ける！
Shattered Minds#039.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#040.src: Scratch it in your eyelids- the lightbulb screwed between the arches, and the feather-duster's sunset shades will reveal my deepest compatriot. Quick now, wake!
Shattered Minds#040.dst: まぶたに刻め― アーチの間にねじ込まれた電球、はたきの夕焼け色が、私の最も深い同胞を明かす。さあ急げ、目覚めよ！
Shattered Minds#040.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#041.src: Ugh. Rats chewing the roots. They've their place, it simply isn't here. Neither is your place in the koi pond, stranger.
Shattered Minds#041.dst: やれやれ。根をかじるネズミだ。居場所はあるが、ここではない。お前の居場所も鯉の池ではないぞ、よそ者。
Shattered Minds#041.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#042.src: I believe Likeru tossed you into the deep end without meaning, so to speak. I understand your being overwhelmed, but still...
Shattered Minds#042.dst: Likeru は悪気なくお前を深みに放り込んだのだろう、いわばな。圧倒されたのは分かるが、それでも…
Shattered Minds#042.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#043.src: Speaking of which, it might behoove you to let her know you've recovered. Though, should you need rest, you may take it here.
Shattered Minds#043.dst: そういえば、回復したと彼女に知らせるとよい。だが休みが要るなら、ここで休んでいくがいい。
Shattered Minds#043.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#044.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} にいる Likeru の所へ戻る。

Shattered Minds#045.src: Ehm. Okay, that was...a bad idea. Should NOT have done that with a human. Uh, noted for the futu- oh, you're actually alright?!
Shattered Minds#045.dst: えっと。うん、あれは…悪い考えだった。人間でやっちゃダメだった。今後のために記録― えっ、ほんとに無事なの？！
Shattered Minds#045.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#046.src: You came back and just leapt into the koi pond! I thought you'd drowned down there!
Shattered Minds#046.dst: 戻ってくるなり鯉の池に飛び込むんだもん！下で溺れたかと思ったよ！
Shattered Minds#046.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#047.src: I guess the spores from the Bluecaps got to you before you could bring them back. I wonder what you saw?
Shattered Minds#047.dst: 持ち帰る前にブルーキャップの胞子にやられちゃったみたいだね。何を見たんだろう？
Shattered Minds#047.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#048.src: You reacted like you were crazy when I tried to talk with you... You were supposed to get visions of the light! A deep connection!
Shattered Minds#048.dst: 話しかけても、君はおかしくなったみたいに反応してた…光の幻視を見るはずだったのに！深いつながりを！
Shattered Minds#048.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#049.src: Wait, maybe it's cause of that portal...the signals got mixed? I'll have to look into this more...but hey, I got the Bluecap, anyways, so...
Shattered Minds#049.dst: 待って、あのポータルのせいかも…信号が混ざった？もっと調べなきゃ…でもまあ、ブルーキャップは手に入ったし…
Shattered Minds#049.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#050.src: Here, your payment- and a little extra I whipped up too. Um, really sorry about all that!
Shattered Minds#050.dst: はい、お礼― それとちょっとしたおまけも作ったよ。えっと、ほんとにごめんね！
Shattered Minds#050.speaker: Likeru

Shrouded in Mist#000.src: New Chapter Started: Amongst the Canopy

Shrouded in Mist#001.src: There's a thin layer of dust on top of the bed.
Shrouded in Mist#001.dst: ベッドの上に薄くほこりが積もっている。

Shrouded in Mist#002.src: The monitor is keeping the machine running.
Shrouded in Mist#002.dst: モニターが機械を動かし続けている。

Shrouded in Mist#003.src: Maybe something sharp can break it...
Shrouded in Mist#003.dst: 鋭い物なら壊せるかも…

Shrouded in Mist#004.src: - Entry {~}: Stayed in and slept all day. Was very tired.
Shrouded in Mist#004.dst: - 記録{~}：一日中家で寝ていた。とても疲れていた。

Shrouded in Mist#005.src: - Entry {~}: Slept in. Boss wasn't happy with me, has me working extra shifts next week.
Shrouded in Mist#005.dst: - 記録{~}：寝坊。親方の機嫌を損ね、来週は追加の勤務だ。

Shrouded in Mist#008.src: The entries stop after this point...
Shrouded in Mist#008.dst: 記録はここで途切れている…

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: This must be where Nisen lives...
Shrouded in Mist#009.dst: ここが Nisen の家に違いない…

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#010.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で残りの仲間と合流する。

Shrouded in Mist#015.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#015.dst: 何を？今この状況で何を考えることが―
Shrouded in Mist#015.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#016.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#016.dst: 分かんないよ、Yusanu！次にどうするか、とか？どうやって― ど、どうやって―
Shrouded in Mist#016.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#017.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#017.dst: 何もできやしない！知らない土地で孤立して、家族も仲間もみんな捕まったか、それか― もっと悪い―
Shrouded in Mist#017.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#018.dst: やめて。そんなこと言わないで。
Shrouded in Mist#018.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#019.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#019.dst: くそっ！こんな物を盗む価値があるなんて、あいつに言いくるめられるなんて！盗まなけりゃ…協定も破談にならず、こんなことには―
Shrouded in Mist#019.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#020.dst: Rex のせいにしないで。あの君主が言ってたでしょ、あいつらは― ず、ずっと前から私たちの計画を知ってたって！
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#021.dst: …なら、最初から俺たちを巻き込まなきゃよかったんだ。
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#023.dst: 侵入者だ！フクロウ隊、構え！

Shrouded in Mist#026.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?
Shrouded in Mist#026.dst: おっとっとっと！はいはい、みんな一歩下がろうか？

Shrouded in Mist#027.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.
Shrouded in Mist#027.dst: フクロウ隊！下がれ！いきなり暴力とは飛躍しすぎだ― それは明らかな王家寄りの連中用さ、えへへ。

Shrouded in Mist#028.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#028.dst: 自己紹介させてもらおう！僕は Rurie、樹冠の一員にしてフクロウ隊の隊長さ！手荒な真似は失礼、今日はみんな張り切りすぎでね？
Shrouded in Mist#028.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#030.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#030.dst: 質問、質問！残念ながら先にこっちの番だ― フクロウ隊はしばらく下げたが、まだ許されたと思わないことだ、お嬢さん！
Shrouded in Mist#030.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#031.dst: …隊長、本当によろしいので？こいつら、スパイかもしれませんよ―
Shrouded in Mist#031.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#032.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#032.dst: ちっちっち！手順を信じたまえ、友よ。スパイだろうとなかろうと、情報には価値がある。
Shrouded in Mist#032.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#033.dst: それに！スパイの…ええと、始末の仕方は心得てるからね。リスクは最小限さ！
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#034.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
Shrouded in Mist#034.dst: で…何だ、あんたらも抵抗―
Shrouded in Mist#034.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#035.src: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
Shrouded in Mist#035.dst: そこまでだ、君！聞こえなかったかい？ここではまず僕らが質問するんだ。
