Supply and Delivery#046.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#046.dst: その補給品を {p} に届けてくれ。そしたら。まあ。なんとかなるさ。
Supply and Delivery#046.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#048.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#048.dst: いや、つまりさ。本当にやりたくないんだ。だからやらない！
Supply and Delivery#048.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#049.src: So you either run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#049.dst: だから、お前が補給品を {p} まで運ぶか…二人で逃げて新しい人生を始めて、やらかしの責任から逃げるかだ！
Supply and Delivery#049.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#050.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#050.dst: …嫌？嫌か。そうか。言ってみただけだ。道はもう分かるよな！俺が、その、邪魔することもない！へへ…
Supply and Delivery#050.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#051.src: He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
Supply and Delivery#051.dst: あいつが買ってくれたのか？よし。よしよし、よし。ふう！思ったより…大変だったな。
Supply and Delivery#051.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#052.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#052.dst: よし！じゃあ第二段階だ。つまり、この荷物はまだ {p} まで届けなきゃならない…
Supply and Delivery#052.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#053.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#053.dst: で。まあ。箱を持ってるのはお前で、俺じゃない！だから…な？
Supply and Delivery#053.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#054.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#054.dst: よし！道はもう分かってるよな！俺が、その、邪魔する必要もないだろ！
Supply and Delivery#054.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#055.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#055.dst: その補給品を {p} に届けてくれ。そしたら。まあ。なんとかなるさ。
Supply and Delivery#055.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#057.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#057.dst: いや、つまりさ。本当にやりたくないんだ。だからやらない！
Supply and Delivery#057.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#058.src: So you either run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#058.dst: だから、お前が補給品を {p} まで運ぶか…二人で逃げて新しい人生を始めて、やらかしの責任から逃げるかだ！
Supply and Delivery#058.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#059.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#059.dst: …嫌？嫌か。そうか。言ってみただけだ。道はもう分かるよな！俺が、その、邪魔することもない！へへ…
Supply and Delivery#059.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#060.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#060.dst: 補給箱を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} にいる Alvin 村長に届ける。

Supply and Delivery#061.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#061.dst: おや、こんにちは！何かご用かね？
Supply and Delivery#061.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#062.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#062.dst: ああ…そうか。Ope に取りに行かせたはずなんだが…
Supply and Delivery#062.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#063.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#063.dst: またあの子の悪ふざけだろう。二度も付き合わせてしまって、すまないね。
Supply and Delivery#063.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#064.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#064.dst: 村に戻ってきたら、あの子とはよく話さないと…ああ、もちろん、君の苦労には報いねばね。
Supply and Delivery#064.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#065.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#065.dst: このエメラルドで足りるといいが。それと…壊れていた馬車を最近直してね、{p} との間を行き来しているんだ。
Supply and Delivery#065.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#066.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#066.dst: いつでも自由に使ってくれたまえ！ここまでしてくれたお礼だよ。
Supply and Delivery#066.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#067.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.
Supply and Delivery#067.dst: あの子は…難しくてね。私の姉の息子なんだが、姉は少し前に不幸にも蜘蛛に殺されてしまった。
Supply and Delivery#067.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#068.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken a toll on us both.
Supply and Delivery#068.dst: 父親もいなくなって、私が引き取るしかなかった。もう大人だがね…あの喪失は、私たち二人にこたえたのだと思う。
Supply and Delivery#068.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#069.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys sometime soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
Supply and Delivery#069.dst: こんな馬鹿げた企みはそろそろやめてほしいと心から思う…だが、厳しく叱る以上のことはどうしてもできなくてね。
Supply and Delivery#069.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#070.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#070.dst: 根はいい子なんだ、本当に。心からそう信じている。だが君がそう思わなくても構わない。関わりたくないなら、無理にとは言わないよ。
Supply and Delivery#070.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#071.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#071.dst: おやおや…この職に就いたのは、確か十五年ほど前だ。前の村長が退いた時にね。
Supply and Delivery#071.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#072.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#072.dst: 親切な人で、いつも町の人々を気にかけていた。だが引退する頃には、この小さな町に落ち着かなくなっていたようだ。
Supply and Delivery#072.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#073.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#073.dst: それで私に職を譲るや否や、すぐに {p} へ行って軍に入ったんだ！今は兵士の訓練をしていると聞くよ。
Supply and Delivery#073.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#074.src: Ah, but I've tried lived up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#074.dst: ああ、だが私も彼の跡に恥じぬよう努めてきた。村長としてよくやれていると思いたいね！
Supply and Delivery#074.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#075.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#075.dst: 旅にはいい日和だ！ゆっくりしていってくれ。
Supply and Delivery#075.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Taking the Tower#000.src: Speak to Aledar in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} 兵舎で Aledar と話す。

Taking the Tower#001.src: Oh, {u}! Hey! It's good to see you and Tasim again. Hope you didn't have too many adventures without me!
Taking the Tower#001.dst: あ、{u}！やあ！君と Tasim にまた会えてうれしいよ。僕抜きで冒険しすぎてないといいけど！
Taking the Tower#001.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#002.src: Tasim's gone off to the training room, if you were looking for him. He's really jumping straight into it, which... is good! We all need to get stronger so we can defend the province.
Taking the Tower#002.dst: Tasim を探してるなら、訓練室に行ったよ。すっかりのめり込んでて…いいことだよね！この地方を守るため、みんな強くならなきゃ。
Taking the Tower#002.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#003.src: Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been there to help!
Taking the Tower#003.dst: 君たちが倒した腐敗者の部隊のこと、Tasim から全部聞いたよ。僕もその場で手伝いたかった！
Taking the Tower#003.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#004.src: ...Oh! Since you're here- I was about to head out to join Lieutenant Van's squad to take back a tower overtaken by corrupteds. You should come with us, too!
Taking the Tower#004.dst: …そうだ！ちょうどいい。これから Van 中尉の分隊に合流して、腐敗者に占拠された塔を奪還しに行くんだ。君も来なよ！
Taking the Tower#004.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#005.src: Well? What do you think? Want to get some real combat experience? It shouldn't take long.
Taking the Tower#005.dst: で、どう？本物の戦闘経験を積みたくない？そんなに時間はかからないよ。
Taking the Tower#005.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#006.src: Perfect. Well, no time better than the present! Let's get going.
Taking the Tower#006.dst: よかった。善は急げだ！さあ行こう。
Taking the Tower#006.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#007.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Powder Master!
Taking the Tower#007.dst: あ、待って。先に寄る所があるんだ。パウダーマスターの所までついてきて！
Taking the Tower#007.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#009.src: Well, I'll still be here for a while. If you change your mind, let me know!
Taking the Tower#009.dst: しばらくはここにいるから。気が変わったら言ってね！
Taking the Tower#009.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#010.src: Hey, you're back! Have you changed you mind? Want to join a raid on a corrupted tower?
Taking the Tower#010.dst: やあ、戻ったんだ！気が変わった？腐敗した塔の襲撃に加わらない？
Taking the Tower#010.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#011.src: Follow Aledar to the Powder Master at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#011.dst: Aledar について [{~}, {~}, -{~}] のパウダーマスターのもとへ行く。

Taking the Tower#012.src: Alright, so. There's something I've been told about the tower we're going to be attacking which we can prepare for!
Taking the Tower#012.dst: さて。これから攻める塔について、前もって準備できることを聞いたんだ！
Taking the Tower#012.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#013.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to damage! And so, here we are at the Powder Master.
Taking the Tower#013.dst: どうやら塔の頂上の親玉は ダメージに弱いらしい！だからパウダーマスターの所に来たってわけ。
Taking the Tower#013.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#014.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons here, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.
Taking the Tower#014.dst: ここでは色々な属性のパウダーを武器に付けられる。そうすると今まで出せなかった種類のダメージを与えられるんだ。
Taking the Tower#014.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#015.src: In this case, you can apply a powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!
Taking the Tower#015.dst: 今回は パウダーを付ければ、塔の腐敗した敵にもっと効くようになるよ！
Taking the Tower#015.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#016.src: I, uh... don't remember the whole elemental speech off the top of my head. If you want to know more about those, you'll have to talk to Captain Ragon in the barracks. He has a whole course about it!
Taking the Tower#016.dst: 僕、えっと…属性の話を全部そらでは言えなくて。詳しく知りたいなら兵舎の Ragon 隊長に聞いて。まるまる一つの講座があるから！
Taking the Tower#016.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#017.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and talk to the Powder Master to apply it. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#017.dst: …とにかく、はい。この属性パウダーを持って、パウダーマスターに付けてもらって。終わったら教えて！
Taking the Tower#017.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#018.src: Apply a Water Powder to your weapon, then let Aledar know at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#018.dst: 武器に水のパウダーを付け、[{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Aledar に知らせる。

Taking the Tower#019.src: Got the powder on your weapon? Good, that means we're ready.
Taking the Tower#019.dst: パウダーは付けた？よし、これで準備完了だ。
Taking the Tower#019.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#020.src: Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p} Suburbs- you probably saw it on your way in.
Taking the Tower#020.dst: Van 中尉たちは {p} 郊外の家が集まってる辺りにいる。来る途中で見かけたんじゃないかな。
Taking the Tower#020.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#021.src: Lead the way! I'll be right behind you.
Taking the Tower#021.dst: 先導して！すぐ後ろにつくから。
Taking the Tower#021.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#022.src: Meet up with Lieutenant Van's squad near the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#022.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の怒れる塔の近くで Van 中尉の分隊と合流する。

Taking the Tower#023.src: Ah, Aledar! Good to see you here. Who's this with you?
Taking the Tower#023.dst: おお、Aledar！よく来た。一緒にいるのは誰だ？
Taking the Tower#023.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#024.src: This is {u}, sir. They're here to join our assault, if you'll allow it.
Taking the Tower#024.dst: {u} です。お許しいただければ、突撃に加わりたいとのことです。
Taking the Tower#024.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#025.src: Hm... Well, I don't see why not. The more the merrier, that's what I say.
Taking the Tower#025.dst: ふむ…断る理由はないな。人数は多いほどいい、というのが私の持論だ。
Taking the Tower#025.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#026.src: If everyone's here, we can begin. Here's the plan! We'll need to fight off some of the forces near the base of the tower, so that someone can climb to the top.
Taking the Tower#026.dst: 全員そろったなら始めよう。作戦はこうだ！塔の麓の敵を一部片付け、誰かが頂上まで登れるようにする。
Taking the Tower#026.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#027.src: It doesn't matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!
Taking the Tower#027.dst: 誰がやるかは問わん、成し遂げればいい。好機を見たら、行け！
Taking the Tower#027.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#028.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here!| Understood?
Taking the Tower#028.dst: 撤退が必要な時や腐敗者を倒した時は、ここに集合！分かったか？
Taking the Tower#028.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#043.src: Good. Alright soldiers, let's take back that tower!
Taking the Tower#043.dst: よし。では兵士諸君、あの塔を取り戻すぞ！
Taking the Tower#043.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#031.src: Go on, head for the tower! If we're lucky, we'll be able to clear out the corrupteds who have taken over it.
Taking the Tower#031.dst: さあ、塔へ向かえ！運がよければ、あそこを占拠した腐敗者どもを一掃できる。
Taking the Tower#031.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#032.src: Assault the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the monster at the top.
Taking the Tower#032.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の怒れる塔を攻め、頂上の怪物を倒す。

Taking the Tower#033.src: Alright. It's time to take on the tower! We've got this, {u}.
Taking the Tower#033.dst: よし。塔に挑む時だ！僕たちならやれるよ、{u}。
Taking the Tower#033.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#034.src: Report back to Lieutenant Van about your success at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Taking the Tower#034.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Van 中尉に戦果を報告する

Taking the Tower#035.src: We did it, we killed the corrupted! Come on, let's get back to Lieutenant Van with the news!
Taking the Tower#035.dst: やった、腐敗者を倒したぞ！さあ、Van 中尉に知らせに戻ろう！
Taking the Tower#035.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#036.src: It seems everyone has returned. Well? Have the corrupted forces been vanquished?
Taking the Tower#036.dst: 全員戻ったようだな。どうだ？腐敗者の部隊は討ち取ったか？
Taking the Tower#036.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#037.src: They have, lieutenant. {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
Taking the Tower#037.dst: はい、中尉。{u} と僕で頂上に辿り着き、腐敗者を倒しました。
Taking the Tower#037.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#038.src: Fine work, soldiers! Another great victory for the {p} army. With the leader killed, it shouldn't be too difficult to clear out the rest of them.
Taking the Tower#038.dst: 見事だ、兵士諸君！{p} 軍のまた一つの大勝利だ。頭を討った以上、残りを片付けるのも難しくないだろう。
Taking the Tower#038.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#039.src: I'll let the Admiral know of your victory today, soldiers. And- here, some payment for your work.
Taking the Tower#039.dst: 今日の勝利は提督に伝えておこう。それと…ほら、働きへの報酬だ。
Taking the Tower#039.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#040.src: The two of you have a promising future. I look forward to serving with you in the future!
Taking the Tower#040.dst: 君たち二人には有望な未来がある。いずれ共に戦える日を楽しみにしているよ！
Taking the Tower#040.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#042.src: We'll take care of the remaining stragglers, don't you worry. Thank you for your work today, soldier.
Taking the Tower#042.dst: 残党は我々が片付ける、心配するな。今日はご苦労だった、兵士よ。
Taking the Tower#042.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taproot#001.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Lari を見つける

Taproot#002.src: ...oh. {u}, you're back. Ehm...I have to say, I'm...rather busy at the moment.
Taproot#002.dst: …あ。{u}、戻ったのね。ええと…正直、今は…ちょっと忙しいの。
Taproot#002.speaker: Lari

Taproot#003.src: I have...important things to do. This accursed Decay...I have to end it. This all needs to stop.
Taproot#003.dst: やるべき…大事なことがあるの。この忌まわしい腐朽を…終わらせなきゃ。全部止めないと。
Taproot#003.speaker: Lari

Taproot#004.src: I am thankful for your aid with the...the Grootslang, but I do not believe you will be able to help with this- Simply a matter of scale.
Taproot#004.dst: Grootslang の…件では助かったわ。でも今回はあなたには無理だと思う。単に規模の問題よ。
Taproot#004.speaker: Lari

Taproot#005.src: I apologize, but I need to focus on my task here. If, perhaps, you could come back another time? And, I do mean that sincerely...
Taproot#005.dst: ごめんなさい、今はここの仕事に集中したいの。また今度来てもらえる？本当に、心からそう思ってるの…
Taproot#005.speaker: Lari

Taproot#006.src: I can't even recall how many attempts this will make...but all my knowledge has gone into this. This must work.
Taproot#006.dst: もう何度目の挑戦かも思い出せない…でも知識は全部つぎ込んだ。今度こそ成功させないと。
Taproot#006.speaker: Lari

Taproot#007.src: Follow Lari to the black spot next to her camp.
Taproot#007.dst: Lari について野営地の横の黒い染みへ行く。

Taproot#008.src: ...I suppose I can't fault you for being curious. You may have seen a large, dark-looking patch of ground on your way here- I am trying to tend to it once more.
Taproot#008.dst: …気になるのも無理ないわね。来る途中、大きく黒ずんだ地面を見たかもしれない。もう一度そこを癒やそうとしているの。
Taproot#008.speaker: Lari

Taproot#009.src: It is...the most obvious stain of the decay, and very intense...if I can scrub this out, the rest should follow.
Taproot#009.dst: あれは…腐朽の一番目立つ染みで、とても濃い…あそこを清められれば、他も良くなるはず。
Taproot#009.speaker: Lari

Taproot#010.src: This concoction of mine should...do the trick!
Taproot#010.dst: 私の調合したこの薬なら…きっと効く！
Taproot#010.speaker: Lari

Taproot#011.src: It...it's working!! I can feel it, the land is reacting positively!
Taproot#011.dst: き…効いてる！！感じるわ、大地が良い反応をしてる！
Taproot#011.speaker: Lari

Taproot#012.src: I...I... It was...it was working, a-and... Agh, why can't I get this RIGHT?!
Taproot#012.dst: わ…私… 効いてたのに、そ、それで… ああ、どうしてうまくいかないの？！
Taproot#012.speaker: Lari

Taproot#013.src: How many decades have I been doing this? How much time have I wasted, just...flailing like this?!
Taproot#013.dst: 何十年これを続けてきたの？どれだけの時間を…こうしてもがくだけで無駄にしたの？！
Taproot#013.speaker: Lari

Taproot#014.src: Look, {u}, I...I don't know what you expect to do against this. The Wyrm was one thing, but...this is beyond your comprehension.
Taproot#014.dst: ねえ、{u}、あなたがこれに何をするつもりか…分からない。Wyrm とはわけが違う…これはあなたの理解を超えてるの。
Taproot#014.speaker: Lari

Taproot#015.src: I think you sh... Should...w-what is... Now, of all times? As I fail?!
Taproot#015.dst: あなたはも… もう…な、何…？よりによって今？失敗した時に？！
Taproot#015.speaker: Lari

Taproot#016.src: The road, look! He's contacting me! A-are you finally giving me the answers I've asked for?
Taproot#016.dst: 道よ、見て！あの方が呼びかけてる！つ、ついに求めてきた答えをくださるの？
Taproot#016.speaker: Lari

Taproot#017.src: Follow the trail of magic leading from the black spot.
Taproot#017.dst: 黒い染みから伸びる魔法の跡をたどる。

Taproot#018.src: Talk to Lari outside the weird gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Taproot#018.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の奇妙な門の外で Lari と話す

Taproot#019.src: ...I followed you seeking answers...and here, I am presented with more questions. Why did he bring us here?
Taproot#019.dst: …答えを求めてついてきたのに…ここで増えたのは疑問ばかり。どうしてあの方は私たちをここへ？
Taproot#019.speaker: Lari

Taproot#020.src: This gate has appeared, immovable and impassable, since the moment that...that everything started.
Taproot#020.dst: この門は…すべてが始まったその時から現れて、動かせず、通れないの。
Taproot#020.speaker: Lari

Taproot#021.src: I don't...is he trying to remind me of what's at stake? Did he want to show y- No, that's...he wouldn't know you...but then, what IS this about?!
Taproot#021.dst: わからない…何が懸かっているか思い出させたいの？あなたに見せ…いえ、あの方があなたを知るはずない…なら、これは何なの？！
Taproot#021.speaker: Lari

Taproot#022.src: Rrgh... ANSWER ME! PLEASE! I've begged you for so long to answer!
Taproot#022.dst: うう…答えて！お願い！ずっと答えてと願ってきたのに！
Taproot#022.speaker: Lari

Taproot#023.src: You gave me my task and your light but never told me what to DO! I've tried everything I can think of!!
Taproot#023.dst: 使命と光をくださったのに、何を「する」かは教えてくれなかった！思いつくことは全部試したのに！！
Taproot#023.speaker: Lari

Taproot#024.src: Tell me! Please, just t-tell me already!! I don't know how much longer I can stand this!!
Taproot#024.dst: 教えて！お願い、もう教えてよ！！これ以上耐えられるか分からない！！
Taproot#024.speaker: Lari

Taproot#025.src: I...a-another one? Where are you leading me now?
Taproot#025.dst: え…ま、また？今度はどこへ導くの？
Taproot#025.speaker: Lari

Taproot#026.src: It...the gateway...? Are you...I can't understand! Why this, again?
Taproot#026.dst: これ…門…？あなたは…わからない！どうしてまたこれを？
Taproot#026.speaker: Lari

Taproot#027.src: You showed me this before... At first, when you first contacted me. I made the choice...
Taproot#027.dst: 前にもこれを見せてくれた…最初、初めて呼びかけてくれた時に。私は選択をした…
Taproot#027.speaker: Lari

Taproot#028.src: Must I make it again? Is that it, do I need to prove myself to you once more?
Taproot#028.dst: もう一度選べというの？また自分を証明しなきゃいけないの？
Taproot#028.speaker: Lari

Taproot#029.src: I...what? You...you present me with this, but refuse to let me do what you want?
Taproot#029.dst: え…何？これを見せておいて、望むことをさせてくれないの？
Taproot#029.speaker: Lari

Taproot#030.src: ...please, can you investigate the doorway? There must be something wrong that I don't understand.
Taproot#030.dst: …お願い、あの扉を調べてくれない？私には分からない何かがおかしいはず。
Taproot#030.speaker: Lari

Taproot#033.src: My pulse... Human. I must inquire to you. I present you a test. Guide your attention to those you see.
Taproot#033.dst: 我が脈動よ…人間よ。問わねばならぬ。試練を与えよう。目に映る者たちに注意を向けよ。

Taproot#034.src: I must see the rhythm your heart beats. Listen well.
Taproot#034.dst: お前の心臓が刻む律動を見ねばならぬ。よく聞け。

Taproot#035.src: This has gone far enough. I can't do this anymore! I can't give you any more and I refuse to apologize for it!
Taproot#035.dst: もう限界だ。これ以上は無理だ！もう何も差し出せないし、それを謝るつもりもない！
Taproot#035.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#036.src: You know our deal. Remember what good you are doing by following the plans I've laid out for you.
Taproot#036.dst: 我々の取り決めは分かっているだろう。私の敷いた計画に従えば、どれほどの善をなしているか思い出したまえ。
Taproot#036.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#037.src: Are you going to let your emotions cloud your judgment? You're a smarter man than that, Mr. Mayor.
Taproot#037.dst: 感情で判断を曇らせるつもりかね？君はそれほど愚かではないはずだ、市長殿。
Taproot#037.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#038.src: You can't possibly believe that throwing away the lives of innocent people is right! I can't go on with this on my conscience!
Taproot#038.dst: 罪なき人々の命を捨てるのが正しいなど、本気で思えるはずがない！こんな良心の呵責を抱えては続けられない！
Taproot#038.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#039.src: Detective Hart WILL be hearing from me, and he'll be hearing everything. We can't keep sacrificing our own like this!
Taproot#039.dst: Hart 探偵に「必ず」話す、それも洗いざらいな。こんな風に身内を犠牲にし続けるわけにはいかん！
Taproot#039.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#040.src: Our golems have single-handedly turned the tide of the Humans' corruption war. You would save ten here and sentence a thousand to die overseas?
Taproot#040.dst: 我々のゴーレムは、人間の腐敗との戦争の流れを独力で変えたのだ。ここで十人救って、海の向こうの千人を死なせるのかね？
Taproot#040.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#041.src: You're a sick, twisted man, Urelix. I will not abide by this a moment longer.
Taproot#041.dst: Urelix、お前は病んだ歪んだ男だ。もう一瞬たりとも従わんぞ。
Taproot#041.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#042.src: My pulse, you must decide. Three paths diverge upon your road.
Taproot#042.dst: 我が脈動よ、決めねばならぬ。お前の道は三つに分かれる。

Taproot#043.src: You may leave. The rays of fate will see to destiny unfolding.
Taproot#043.dst: 去ってもよい。運命の光が、定めの成り行きを見届けよう。

Taproot#044.src: You may end this "Mayor's" life. Blood upon your hands in many ways.
Taproot#044.dst: この「市長」の命を絶ってもよい。その手は幾重にも血に染まろう。

Taproot#046.src: You may end the life of Urelix. Heartbeats ceased by a bleeding heart.
Taproot#046.dst: Urelix の命を絶ってもよい。情けに血を流す心が、鼓動を止めるのだ。

Taproot#047.src: Which way does your heart beat? How will you cast your light? Can you see?
Taproot#047.dst: お前の心臓はどちらへ鼓動する？光をどう投げかける？見えるか？

Taproot#049.src: My pulse... The blood of a bleeding heart has poisoned me. Even if you believe the sun should shine elsewhere, you must direct it yourself.
Taproot#049.dst: 我が脈動よ…血を流す心の血が、私を蝕んだ。太陽は別の所を照らすべきと思おうとも、お前自身の手で導かねばならぬ。

Taproot#050.src: You must realize what is needed. You must see light through my lens.
Taproot#050.dst: 何が必要か悟らねばならぬ。我がレンズを通して光を見よ。

Taproot#051.src: To leave... As destiny unfolds, the sun shall set.
Taproot#051.dst: 去るならば…定めが展開し、日は沈むであろう。

Taproot#052.src: To end this Mayor's life... To snuff out one whose heart aches is painful.
Taproot#052.dst: この市長の命を絶つならば…痛む心を消すのは辛きことだ。

Taproot#053.src: To end the life of Urelix... The shadows of war shall engulf all.
Taproot#053.dst: Urelix の命を絶つならば…戦の影がすべてを呑み込もう。

Taproot#054.src: My pulse, there is only one choice. You must do what is required, I beg of you.
Taproot#054.dst: 我が脈動よ、選択は一つのみ。なすべきことをなせ、頼む。

Taproot#055.src: Ah, you recognize necessity. That couldn't have been pleasant...but what's needed isn't pleasant, in the end.
Taproot#055.dst: ああ、必要性を理解したか。愉快ではなかったろう…だが結局、必要なことは愉快ではないものだ。
Taproot#055.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#056.dst: 我が脈動よ、お前は相応しい！

Taproot#058.src: ...I didn't think you would be able to help, but I had to ask. So...was this for nothing?
Taproot#058.dst: …助けになるとは思ってなかったけど、頼まずにはいられなかった。じゃあ…全部無駄だったの？
Taproot#058.speaker: Lari

Taproot#059.src: Wait...y-you...had a choice? He gave you the choice too?! A-Already?!
Taproot#059.dst: 待って…あ、あなたにも…選択が？あの方があなたにも？も、もう？！
Taproot#059.speaker: Lari

Taproot#060.src: Wh- I don't understand! You...you just arrived to Gavel! You haven't seen its decline! Felt its pain!
Taproot#060.dst: な…わからない！あなたは…Gavel に来たばかりじゃない！衰退も見てない！痛みも感じてない！
Taproot#060.speaker: Lari

Taproot#061.src: What did you do?! The gate is opening? YOU did this?! I know your heart is in the right place, but you're a stranger to this land!
Taproot#061.dst: 何をしたの？！門が開いてる？「あなた」が？！善意なのは分かる、でもあなたはこの地のよそ者なのよ！
Taproot#061.speaker: Lari

Taproot#062.src: I...I...rrrgh... AAAAGH!! This isn't fair!! I've worked for decades and the light just...throws me to the wayside?!
Taproot#062.dst: わ…私…ううう… ああああ！！不公平よ！！何十年も尽くしたのに、光は私を…見捨てるの？！
Taproot#062.speaker: Lari

Taproot#064.src: My pulse, you must leave her be. Her heart's emotions have overpowered her mind's judgement. She must learn to separate them as you have.
Taproot#064.dst: 我が脈動よ、彼女は放っておけ。心の感情が頭の判断を上回ってしまった。お前のように両者を分けることを学ばねばならぬ。

Taproot#065.src: Please... You can't DO this to me!!
Taproot#065.dst: お願い… こんな仕打ち、ひどい！！
Taproot#065.speaker: Lari

Taproot#066.src: Why do you want this human to enter the Taproot?! What's special about them, what's their connection? What have they done that I haven't?! Tell me, please! Let me be useful!!
Taproot#066.dst: どうしてこの人間を Taproot に入れたいの？！何が特別なの、何の繋がりが？私にできなかった何をしたの？！教えて、お願い！役に立たせて！！
Taproot#066.speaker: Lari

Taproot#068.dst: 奇妙な領域を探索する

Taproot#069.src: Your heartbeat beats in time with mine. Your mind is unclouded, despite the fury you have been steeped in. My pulse, you are needed.
Taproot#069.dst: お前の鼓動は我が鼓動と拍を合わせる。怒りに浸されてなお、お前の心は曇らぬ。我が脈動よ、お前が必要だ。

Taproot#070.src: Your eyes cannot see the scope of the realms. You must allow me to shed light upon them- You must see the connections.
Taproot#070.dst: お前の目には諸領域の広がりが見えぬ。私に光を当てさせよ。お前はその繋がりを見ねばならぬ。

Taproot#071.src: Light... Dark... We oppose. I am light. It is dark. Our places reflect this land...and it is plain- The sun is setting. Light is fading
Taproot#071.dst: 光…闇…我らは対立する。私は光。あれは闇。我らの在り方はこの地を映す…そして明白だ。日は沈み、光は消えゆく

Taproot#072.src: The land you visit warps with the slow siphoning of my light, my blood. It becomes outlandish and strange- Oppressive and alien.
Taproot#072.dst: お前が訪れる地は、我が光、我が血がゆっくり吸われるにつれ歪む。異様で奇怪に、重苦しく異質なものとなる。

Taproot#073.src: Perhaps you should try interacting with this thing?
Taproot#073.dst: これを調べてみてはどうだろう？

Taproot#074.src: As dusk approaches- As darkness spreads- My heart slows and stops. My pulse, you are needed. You shall be as one with me, and you shall see.
Taproot#074.dst: 黄昏が迫り、闇が広がり、我が心臓は緩み、止まる。我が脈動よ、お前が必要だ。お前は我と一つとなり、見るであろう。

Taproot#075.src: {p} needs life anew- A new pulse. It need you.
Taproot#075.dst: {p} には新たな命が要る。新たな脈動が。お前が要るのだ。

Taproot#077.src: Our light is synchronous! You may see what I must have you see...
Taproot#077.dst: 我らの光は同調した！見せねばならぬものを見られよう…

Taproot#078.src: Follow the road. You must witness the reason behind my trial.
Taproot#078.dst: 道をたどれ。我が試練の理由を目撃せねばならぬ。

Taproot#079.src: See my memories. The memories of the realm. See...and be enlightened.
Taproot#079.dst: 我が記憶を見よ。この領域の記憶を。見よ…そして悟れ。

Taproot#080.src: Witness it... The Equinox. Learn why you are needed, my pulse.
Taproot#080.dst: 見届けよ…The Equinox を。我が脈動よ、お前が必要な訳を知れ。

Taproot#081.dst: 見届けよ。邪なる出現を…

Taproot#082.dst: 腐朽の始まりを見届けよ。

Taproot#083.src: My light...I won't let you down!
Taproot#083.dst: 我が光よ…失望させません！
Taproot#083.speaker: Lari

Taproot#084.dst: あなた！ここにいるべきじゃない！
Taproot#084.speaker: Lari

Taproot#085.src: Wah! Back away, I don't want to hurt you!
Taproot#085.dst: わっ！下がって、傷つけたくないの！
Taproot#085.speaker: Lari

Taproot#086.src: I can do this... Orphion, lend me your voice!
Taproot#086.dst: 私ならできる…Orphion、声をお貸しください！
Taproot#086.speaker: Lari

Taproot#087.src: Return to your realm in peace!
Taproot#087.dst: 安らかに自分の領域へ帰って！
Taproot#087.speaker: Lari

Taproot#088.src: Your power is blinded by light. You cannot win!
Taproot#088.dst: あなたの力は光に目を眩まされてる。勝てないわ！
Taproot#088.speaker: Lari

Taproot#089.src: Peace, strange creature! You must be peaceful!
Taproot#089.dst: 静まって、奇妙な生き物！落ち着きなさい！
Taproot#089.speaker: Lari

Taproot#090.src: Why isn't this working? Even Orphion's voice...
Taproot#090.dst: どうして効かないの？Orphion の声でさえ…
Taproot#090.speaker: Lari

Taproot#091.src: It's scarring the land... I need to end this, quickly...
Taproot#091.dst: 大地に傷が…早く終わらせないと…
Taproot#091.speaker: Lari

Taproot#092.src: His light... This power... I can do this!
Taproot#092.dst: あの方の光…この力…私ならできる！
Taproot#092.speaker: Lari

Taproot#093.src: The embodiment of light supports me!
Taproot#093.dst: 光の化身が私を支えてる！
Taproot#093.speaker: Lari

Taproot#094.src: You cannot fight the focus of pure light!
Taproot#094.dst: 純粋な光の集中には抗えない！
Taproot#094.speaker: Lari

Taproot#095.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
Taproot#095.dst: 終わりよ！Orphion の光で縛る！
Taproot#095.speaker: Lari

Taproot#096.dst: 待って… ど、どうして効かないの？！
Taproot#096.speaker: Lari

Taproot#097.src: Lari... A conflicted heart failed to channel my light. She refused to battle.
Taproot#097.dst: Lari… 迷える心は我が光を導けなかった。彼女は戦いを拒んだ。

Taproot#098.src: The vile intruder was weak... But every opportunity to strike, exchanged for words to the deaf.
Taproot#098.dst: 邪なる侵入者は弱かった…だが討つ好機はすべて、聾者への言葉に費やされた。

Taproot#099.src: My pulse... It pains me. Her light simply fails to shine where it is needed, and so we are here.
Taproot#099.dst: 我が脈動よ…心が痛む。彼女の光は必要な所を照らせぬ。ゆえに我らはここにいる。

Taproot#100.src: The Realm of Light needs life anew- A new pulse. It needs you.
Taproot#100.dst: 光の領域には新たな命が要る。新たな脈動が。お前が要るのだ。

Taproot#101.src: Talk to Lari outside the Taproot gate.
Taproot#101.dst: Taproot の門の外で Lari と話す。

Taproot#102.src: I... I...hope you'll forgive me, {u}. My anger wasn't with you. I...j-just...
Taproot#102.dst: 私…許してくれるといいけど、{u}。怒ってたのはあなたにじゃないの。私…た、ただ…
Taproot#102.speaker: Lari

Taproot#103.src: I work for untold years, trying to save this province, to save a Realm... All to so little avail. To the sound of silence from the one I'm trying to help.
Taproot#103.dst: 数え切れない年月、この地方を、ひとつの領域を救おうとしてきた…ほとんど実を結ばずに。助けたい相手からは沈黙だけ。
Taproot#103.speaker: Lari

Taproot#104.src: And then, you appear, and... I still haven't ever been in there. I'd...I'd ask what it was like, but it's...probably private, right?
Taproot#104.dst: そこにあなたが現れて…私はまだ一度も中に入ったことがない。どんな所か聞きたいけど…きっと秘密よね？
Taproot#104.speaker: Lari

Taproot#105.src: At...at least I have an ally now, r-right? But...I'm afraid that... N-no, it's silly, you don't need to hear me fretting.
Taproot#105.dst: せ…せめて今は仲間がいる、よ、よね？でも…怖いのは… い、いえ、馬鹿みたい。私の心配なんて聞かなくていいわ。
Taproot#105.speaker: Lari

Taproot#106.src: I... I promise I can still be useful. I'll... I'll find a way. I promise you. I'll...get out of your way, for now.
Taproot#106.dst: 私…まだ役に立てるって約束する。きっと…方法を見つける。約束するわ。今は…邪魔しないでおくね。
Taproot#106.speaker: Lari

Taproot#107.src:
Lari
Please... You can't DO this to me!!
Taproot#107.dst:
Lari
お願い… こんな仕打ち、ひどい！！
Taproot#107.speaker: Lari

Taproot#000.src: You should follow Lari. There has to be something you can do.
Taproot#000.dst: Lari についていこう。何かできることがあるはずだ。

Taproot#063~1.src:
Lari
PLEASE! Just let me in!
Taproot#063~1.speaker: Lari

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends, close to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]、{p} 近くの伝説の神殿の入口で Kelight と話す

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.src: I see you want to enter this mighty temple! Do not deny it, I see it in your eyes.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.dst: この荘厳な神殿に入りたいようだな！否定しても無駄だ、目に書いてある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.src: It is only natural, after all, to want to join the esteemed ranks of the Legends, such as myself!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.dst: 当然だろう、何しろ私のような伝説の栄えある一員になりたいのだからな！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.src: You will need to prove yourself by fighting a powerful beast, hidden deep in this cave beside me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.dst: 力を示すには、私の傍らの洞窟の奥に潜む強大な獣と戦わねばならん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.src: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! Let me see if you are even worth my time.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.dst: だが伝説たる私は多忙でね、サインだの何だの、それに門番の務めもある！私の時間を割く価値があるか見てやろう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.src: Hm... At a glance, you don't look anything special! Why, you may as well be a common soldier, for all I can imagine!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.dst: ふむ…一見、何の取り柄もなさそうだ！どう見てもただの一兵卒ではないか！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.src: Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.dst: 言ってみたまえ、なぜ君に機会を与えねばならん？今のところ、感心できんな。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.dst: 頑固だと？はっ！笑わせるな。見せるものもなく入ろうとしたのが君が初めてだとでも？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.dst: 当然違う。さあ、行きたまえ。本当に感心させるものを持って出直すことだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.src: ...And? Surely you do not hope to bribe me, do you? What use would I have for whatever meager wealth you have?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.dst: …で？まさか買収する気ではあるまいな？君のわずかな財産など、私に何の役に立つ？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.src: I'm a Legend! I have everything I could possibly need for the rest of my life! Now, run along. Return when you have something concrete to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.dst: 私は伝説だぞ！一生分必要なものは全て揃っている！さあ行きたまえ。確かなものを見せられるようになったら戻ってこい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.src: Ha! You? A Legend?! What a joke. You aren't the first to have tried that, by the way. I know each and every member of our ranks, and you are not one of them.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.dst: はっ！君が？伝説だと？！笑わせる。ちなみにそう言ったのは君が初めてではない。仲間は一人残らず知っているが、君はその中にいない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.src: Ah, truly, being a gatekeeper of the Temple is an entertaining position. Run along, now. Return when you have something real to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.dst: ああ、神殿の門番とは実に愉快な役目だ。さあ行きたまえ。本物を見せられるようになったら戻ってこい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.src: Hmph. Ridiculous. I don't need you to convince me of anything! Clearly, you are nothing but a pretender.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.dst: ふん。馬鹿馬鹿しい。君に説得される必要などない！明らかに、君はただの偽物だ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.src: Run along, now. If you don't have anything to show for yourself, don't waste my time!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.dst: さあ、行きたまえ。見せるものがないなら、私の時間を無駄にするな！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.src: ...But- ah. Since you are still here. Perhaps- no, no, don't be ridiculous, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.dst: …だが…ああ。まだいるのか。ひょっとして…いや、馬鹿を言うな、Kelight。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.src: Come on, Kelight, don't do this, you can't just let them get you with the silent treatment...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.dst: しっかりしろ、Kelight、黙っていられるだけで折れるわけにはいかんぞ…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.src: Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.dst: ええい、分かった。興味が湧いた。君の何が特別なんだ？ただの一兵卒に見えるが、それでも…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.src: Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.dst: よろしい。試練への挑戦を許そう。そうすれば、力を証明できるかもしれん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.src: Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.dst: 近くの洞窟の奥深くに、比類なき獣が潜んでいる。腐敗してはいるが、これまでの敵とはまるで違う。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.src: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Nether Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.dst: 噂では、その怪物は最初にネザーポータルへ踏み込んだ鉱夫の一人だとか…無論、伝説たる私はそんな話は気にせんがね。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.src: In any case, its power cannot be underestimated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.dst: いずれにせよ、その力は侮れん。洞窟に入るだけで、最高の装備でも大きく弱体化してしまう！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.src: Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light which is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.dst: 近づけばすぐに腐敗してしまう、だから守りが要る。獣がやって来たのと同じ領域の光でなければ効かんのだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.src: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Nether.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.dst: というわけで、伝説への旅の第一歩は…ネザーを研究している私の友人を訪ねることだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.src: His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.dst: 名は Jorkin、あの領域について私の知る誰よりも詳しい。{p} の {p} 近くで彼を探し、助力を頼め。私の紹介だと言うといい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.src: Find a way to get Kelight to allow you entry into the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.dst: Kelight に [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の伝説の神殿へ入れてもらう方法を探す。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.src: So you return! Very interesting. That certainly puts you a level beyond any others who have tried... But it is not enough.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.dst: 戻ってきたか！実に興味深い。確かにこれまでの挑戦者より一段上だ…だが、まだ足りん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.src: So? Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.dst: で？言ってみたまえ、なぜ君に機会を与えねばならん？今のところ、感心できんな。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.dst: 頑固だと？はっ！笑わせるな。見せるものもなく入ろうとしたのが君が初めてだとでも？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.dst: 当然違う。さあ、行きたまえ。本当に感心させるものを持って出直すことだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.src: So you are! And so am I. You will not get past me that easily, I'm afraid.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.dst: そうか！私もだ。残念だが、そう簡単に私は通さんぞ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.src: Off you go, then. Don't come back unless you have something to show!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.dst: では行きたまえ。見せるものがないなら戻ってくるな！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.src: Yes, I'm starting to get that impression. You are such a headache, you know that?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.dst: ああ、そんな気がしてきたよ。君は本当に頭痛の種だな、分かっているか？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.src: Fine! Fine. I'll give you a chance. I'm certain you won't succeed, but anything to get you to stop bothering me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.dst: 分かった！分かったよ。機会をやろう。成功するとは思えんが、君が付きまとうのをやめるなら何でもいい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.src: Ahem. Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.dst: コホン。近くの洞窟の奥深くに、比類なき獣が潜んでいる。腐敗してはいるが、これまでの敵とはまるで違う。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.dst: しっかりしろ、Kelight、黙っていられるだけで折れるわけにはいかんぞ…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.src: Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.dst: ええい、分かった。興味が湧いた。君の何が特別なんだ？ただの一兵卒に見えるが、それでも…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.src: Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.dst: よろしい。試練への挑戦を許そう。そうすれば、力を証明できるかもしれん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.src: Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.dst: 近くの洞窟の奥深くに、比類なき獣が潜んでいる。腐敗してはいるが、これまでの敵とはまるで違う。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.src: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Nether Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.dst: 噂では、その怪物は最初にネザーポータルへ踏み込んだ鉱夫の一人だとか…無論、伝説たる私はそんな話は気にせんがね。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.src: In any case, its power cannot be underestimated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.dst: いずれにせよ、その力は侮れん。洞窟に入るだけで、最高の装備でも大きく弱体化してしまう！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.src: Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light which is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.dst: 近づけばすぐに腐敗してしまう、だから守りが要る。獣がやって来たのと同じ領域の光でなければ効かんのだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.src: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Nether.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.dst: というわけで、伝説への旅の第一歩は…ネザーを研究している私の友人を訪ねることだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.src: His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.dst: 名は Jorkin、あの領域について私の知る誰よりも詳しい。{p} の {p} 近くで彼を探し、助力を頼め。私の紹介だと言うといい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.src: Talk to Jorkin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Light Dust.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Jorkin に Light Dust について聞く。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.src: Ah, hello soldier. What brings you to my humble abode today?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.dst: やあ、兵士さん。今日はこのあばら家に何のご用で？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.src: Oh my. You...you want to attack HIM? Th-that horrid beast! Are you mad?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.dst: なんと。き、君は…「あいつ」を攻めたいと？あ、あの恐ろしい獣を！正気か？！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.src: Urgh, Kelight keeps sending adventurers like you to their deaths with his asinine tasks!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.dst: ああもう、Kelight はあの馬鹿げた課題で君みたいな冒険者を死に送り続けている！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.src: Fine. If you're really so determined to walk to your death, I can tell you where to go.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.dst: わかった。そこまで死にに行きたいなら、行き先を教えよう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.src: Down in the Roots, there is a cave full of the Light Dust you'll need.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.dst: the Roots を下った先に、必要な Light Dust だらけの洞窟がある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.src: Powerful corrupteds live in that cave, so be very careful retrieving it, and bring it back to me once you find it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.dst: あの洞窟には強い腐敗者が棲んでいる。取る時はくれぐれも用心して、見つけたら持ってきてくれ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.src: Find the lightdust cavern located near the Portal at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] のポータル近くにある光の塵の洞窟を見つける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.src: Retrieve [{~} Light Dust] from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring it back to Jorkin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.dst: [{~} Light Dust] を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟から取り、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Jorkin に届ける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.src: You have the Light Dust, then? Hand it here, I want to see something.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.dst: Light Dust を手に入れたか？こっちへ。確かめたいことがある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.src: Ah, just as I thought. Even this light has been tainted by Corruption. Sorry, looks like you can't fight him, go home.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.dst: ああ、思った通りだ。この光さえ腐敗に汚されている。残念だが戦うのは無理だ、帰りなさい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.src: ...urgh, there's no fooling you, is there? You really are committed to trying to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.dst: …うう、君はごまかせないな？本気であいつと戦う気なんだな。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.src: Well, I wasn't lying when I said the Light Dust was corrupted, but there is a way to purify it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.dst: まあ、Light Dust が腐敗しているのは嘘じゃない。だが浄化する方法はある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.src: An old acquaintance of mine, Rayshyroth, has a method. He lives on {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.dst: 古い知人の Rayshyroth が方法を知っている。{p} に住んでいる。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.src: He knows even more about that...thing, than I do in my years of studying the Nether. Maybe he'll be able to talk you out of this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.dst: あの…ものについては、私が長年ネザーを研究してきた以上に詳しい。君を思いとどまらせてくれるかもな。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.src: Visit Rayshyroth on {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to purify the dust
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} にいる Rayshyroth を訪ね、塵を浄化してもらう

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.src: Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you to our quiet lonely island, let alone all the way up here?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.dst: おや？これはどうも。静かで寂しいこの島に、しかもこんな上まで何のご用です？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.src: ...I see. Yes, the corruption of the blasted Nether Portal is rather potent. I'm not surprised this would need purification.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.dst: …なるほど。ええ、忌々しいネザーポータルの腐敗はかなり強力です。浄化が必要なのも当然でしょう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.src: Well, I can certainly do it, but I'll need the materials to do so. Shouldn't be anything you can't handle by now, right?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.dst: もちろんできますが、材料が要ります。今のあなたなら難しくないはずですよ？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.src: You see, below my house here, there is a wellspring from which a powerful magic flux generates.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.dst: 実はこの家の下に泉がありましてね、そこから強い魔力の流れが湧いているのです。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.src: It creates a unique magic vapor if disrupted, which I can use to purify the dust for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.dst: それを乱すと独特の魔法の蒸気が生じます。それで塵を浄化してあげましょう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.src: I would say, given how badly corrupted this is, I will need at least [{~} Sky Vapor] for the task.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.dst: これほど腐敗がひどいと、少なくとも [{~} Sky Vapor] は必要ですね。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.src: Find the cave on {p} where the Sky Flux gathers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある、{p} の Sky Flux が集まる洞窟を見つける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.src: Give [{~} Sky Vapor] to Rayshyroth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.dst: [{~} Sky Vapor] を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Rayshyroth に渡す。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.src: Aha, you're back with the Sky Vapor! Sorry about the climb, even I find it rather inconvenient at times.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.dst: おお、Sky Vapor を持って戻りましたね！登るのは大変だったでしょう、私も時々不便に感じます。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.src: While I perform the ritual to purify this, I'd like to ask you something. Do you know, exactly, what it is you'll be fighting?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.dst: 浄化の儀式をする間に、一つ聞きたい。あなたは自分が何と戦うのか、正確に分かっていますか？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.src: Don't look so surprised, I know exactly what you need Light Dust for. The corruption warding helmet...to allow you to fight the Corrupter of Worlds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.dst: そう驚かないで。Light Dust の用途は分かっています。腐敗除けの兜…Corrupter of Worlds と戦うためでしょう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.src: Yes, yes. I imagine that Kelight didn't bother telling you that was his title. I also surmise that you were given few details of how he came to be...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.dst: ええ、ええ。Kelight はそれが奴の称号だと教えなかったのでしょう。奴の成り立ちもろくに聞いていないはずだ…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.src: The beast now known as the Corrupter of Worlds used to be a simple mining captain, during the expeditions that uncovered the Nether Portal. He was the first to enter that wicked realm.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.dst: 今 Corrupter of Worlds と呼ばれる獣は、かつてネザーポータルを見つけた遠征の一介の採掘隊長でした。あの邪悪な領域に最初に入った男です。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.src: The poor man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Nether, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.dst: 哀れな男は二度と消息がなかった…ネザーから腐敗者の群れが溢れ出すまでは。先頭にいたのが彼です。皮肉でしょう？生前は鉱夫を、死後は腐敗者を率いたのですから。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.src: His mining crew there lasted hardly minutes. He personally slaughtered every single one of his original crew, and thousands more. The energies of the Nether have made him monstrously powerful.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.dst: 彼の採掘隊は数分ともたなかった。元の隊員を一人残らず自ら惨殺し、さらに何千もの命を奪った。ネザーの力が彼を途方もなく強くしたのです。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.src: ...although, the stories differ. Some say that Bak'al was the first to enter the portal, and the Corrupter of Worlds was simply a beast from the Nether. But the unclear truth doesn't change his strength.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.dst: …もっとも、話はさまざまです。最初にポータルに入ったのは Bak'al で、Corrupter of Worlds はネザーの獣にすぎないという説も。ですが真相が曖昧でも、奴の強さは変わりません。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.src: Just remember that no one, aside from that snooty Kelight, will think less of you should you choose not to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.dst: 覚えておいて。あの高慢な Kelight 以外、戦わないと決めてもあなたを見下す者はいません。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.src: Show the [Purified Light Dust] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.dst: [Purified Light Dust] を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の伝説の神殿入口にいる Kelight に見せる。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.src: Hah. Took you long enough. This is the light dust, I presume?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.dst: はっ。ずいぶんかかったな。これが光の塵かね？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.src: I'll hold onto this for now. While it is a vital ingredient for your protection, it is not enough on its own.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.dst: これはひとまず預かろう。君の守りに欠かせない材料だが、これだけでは足りん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.src: You'll need an item to focus the magic around yourself, preferably something you'd wear. Hm... How about a helmet? Certainly, it'd do wonders for your poor sense of style.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.dst: 魔力を身の回りに集める品が要る、身に着ける物がいい。ふむ…兜はどうだ？君のひどいセンスにも大いに役立つだろう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.src: Ahem. As for creating it... I know only one man capable of crafting a piece of armor good enough to ensure your safety.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.dst: コホン。作り手だが…君の安全を保証できる防具を作れる男は、一人しか知らん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.src: Unfortunately, he will be hard to reach. His name was Garull, and he was the finest craftsman I'd ever met! A bit on the eccentric side, though.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.dst: あいにく、会うのは難しい。名は Garull、私が会った中で最高の職人だった！少々変わり者だがね。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.src: He was always ranting and raving about Creepers... he really thought they were real, can you imagine? What complete and utter nonsense.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.dst: いつもクリーパーのことをわめき散らしていてな…本当にいると思っていたんだ、信じられるか？まったくの戯言だ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.src: When I suggested the notion to be absurd, he seemed upset by my comments, and stopped visiting. Truly, I did not know what I did wrong. What a ridiculous man.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.dst: 馬鹿げていると言ったら機嫌を損ねたようで、来なくなった。私の何が悪かったのか、本当に分からん。困った男だ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.src: As it stands, I have no idea where you could find him. He spoke of wanting to research the Pigman Ravines several times, though none of our rank had ever seen him there.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.dst: 今となっては、どこにいるか見当もつかん。Pigman Ravines を研究したいと何度か言っていたが、仲間の誰もそこで彼を見ていない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.src: In any case, it is somewhere to begin your search! Should you manage to find him, and convince him to craft you the helmet, return here and we can proceed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.dst: ともかく、探し始める場所にはなる！見つけて兜を作るよう説得できたら、ここに戻れ。そこから先へ進もう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.src: Find Garull, the Creeper obsessed craftsman, somewhere in the {p} located around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 付近の {p} で、クリーパーに執着する職人 Garull を見つける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.src: GWUH! Oh god, don't scare me like that! Who... Who even are you?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.dst: うわあっ！びっくりさせるなよ！だ…誰なんだあんた？！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.src: Ah, you were sent from Kelight for a protection helmet? I can do that, sure, but there's a few complications.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.dst: ああ、Kelight に言われて防護の兜を？作れるとも、ただいくつか厄介なことがある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.src: See, I usually use something called Touroto Hide to make my armor. It's extremely resilient, magic resistant and tough to break.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.dst: 俺は防具にふつう Touroto Hide ってのを使う。すごく丈夫で、魔法に強く、なかなか破れない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.src: But, this also makes the Touroto themselves almost impossible to kill. Getting Touroto Hide is extremely difficult. I do know of a black market for it in {p}, but...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.dst: でもそのせいで Touroto 自体がほぼ殺せない。Touroto Hide を手に入れるのは至難の業だ。{p} に闇市があるのは知ってるが…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.src: They only sell useless Old Touroto Hide, gotten from ones that died of old age. It's almost no better than just plain leather.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.dst: 売ってるのは老衰で死んだ個体から取った、役立たずの Old Touroto Hide だけ。ただの革とほとんど変わらない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.src: So, for me to craft you this helmet, I'll need you to bring me not just the [Old Touroto Hide], but also the means to restore it to its previous power. Do listen up, there's a lot to tell you!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.dst: だから兜を作るには、[Old Touroto Hide] だけじゃなく、元の力を取り戻す材料も持ってきてほしい。よく聞けよ、話すことは山ほどある！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.src: There's the [Aseado Leaf], grown someplace in the {p}... it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.dst: まず [Aseado Leaf]、{p} のどこかに生えてる…強い薬効があって、老化を逆戻りさせるらしい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.src: Then, a [Maro's Eye Jewel], which is an amazing magical focus from...well, where else, the {p}. Using its dust, I'll be able to return its magical resilience manually.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.dst: 次に [Maro's Eye Jewel]、すごい魔法の焦点具で…出どころはもちろん {p} だ。その粉で、魔法の耐性を手作業で戻せる。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.src: Finally, I'll need a [Coral of Nelfors], which can be found in the {p}. This is what I need to use to enchant the hide to be magically resistant.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.dst: 最後に [Coral of Nelfors]、{p} で見つかる。これで皮に魔法耐性の付呪をするんだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.src: I wrote all that down in your content book. If you can get it all, come back to see me, but don't be so sneaky about coming up to me please!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.dst: 全部コンテンツブックに書いといた。揃ったら会いに来てくれ、でも頼むからこっそり近づくのはやめてくれよ！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.src: Bring the [Old Touroto Hide], [Aseado Leaf], [Maro's Eye Jewel], and [Coral of Nelfors] to Garull in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.dst: [Old Touroto Hide]、[Aseado Leaf]、[Maro's Eye Jewel]、[Coral of Nelfors] を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟にいる Garull に届ける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.src: Thank you for listening to me about not being so quiet coming over here. I'm guessing you've got everything?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.dst: 今度はそっと来ないでくれてありがとな。全部揃ったんだろ？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.src: Alright, this should go quickly. For however pompous Kelight is, he's right in sending you to me to craft this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.dst: よし、すぐ済む。Kelight はいくら偉そうでも、俺に作らせに来させたのは正解だ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.src: Now, I want to warn you about something. I've heard stories about the enemy you need this helmet to face, none of them good.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.dst: さて、一つ警告しておきたい。その兜で立ち向かう敵の噂を聞いたが、どれもろくな話じゃない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.src: While I have seen people return from killing the "beast" he talks about, it isn't often. Be very careful, should you choose to fight it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.dst: あいつの言う「獣」を倒して戻った奴も見たことはあるが、めったにいない。戦うなら十分気をつけろ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.src: Bring the [Helmet of the Legends] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.dst: [Helmet of the Legends] を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の伝説の神殿入口にいる Kelight に届ける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.src: ...Hm? Oh, it's you again. Did you actually manage to find the blighter? Good to know he isn't dead, at least.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.dst: …む？ああ、また君か。本当にあの変人を見つけたのか？少なくとも生きていると分かってよかった。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.src: You have the helmet, I presume? Hand it over, here. I'll quickly apply the light dust. Then, you'll be able to enter the cave.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.dst: 兜は持っているのだろう？こちらへ。すぐに光の塵を施そう。そうすれば洞窟に入れる。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.src: Hopefully you'll do better than that last group that tried to fight him. Six fighters strong... never came back.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.dst: 奴に挑んだ前の一団よりはうまくやってほしいものだ。六人の戦士が…誰も戻らなかった。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.src: ...Well, good luck! I'm certain you'll either succeed, or you'll fail spectacularly. Either or, really.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.dst: …では、健闘を祈る！成功するか、盛大に失敗するか、どちらかだろう。まあ、どちらでも。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.src: Bring me concrete proof of your triumph over the beast, and I will grant you passage into the Temple of the Legends! Do be quick, would you?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.dst: 獣に勝った確かな証拠を持ってこい、そうすれば伝説の神殿への通行を許そう！急いでくれたまえよ？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.src: Kill the Corrupter of Worlds in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring proof of its death to Kelight at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟で Corrupter of Worlds を倒し、その死の証を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Kelight に届ける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#132.dst: …き、君が…倒した？ど、どうやって？！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#132.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.src: Even one so brave and powerful as myself could not possibly survive against-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.dst: 私のように勇敢で強大な者でさえ、あれを相手に生き延びるなど―
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.src: Er... I mean, of course you were able to defeat the beast! I believed in you from the very start!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.dst: あ…いや、もちろん君なら獣を倒せると思っていた！最初から信じていたとも！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.src: ...Ehm. I suppose you are welcome in the Temple of the Legends, now! You have... certainly proven yourself. My apologies for misjudging you. Feel proud of your accomplishment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.dst: …コホン。これで伝説の神殿に歓迎しよう！君は…確かに力を示した。見くびってすまなかった。その功績を誇りたまえ！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.src: Hm? What are these oddities you have with you? Curious, yet useless. Allow me to dispose of them for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.dst: む？その妙な物は何だ？珍しいが役に立たんな。私が処分してやろう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.speaker: Kelight

Tempo Town Trouble#001.src: Hey, excuse me! I'm in need of- ...yeah, just walk right by me. Maybe I shoulda gone to {p} for help, these people here have enough problems...
Tempo Town Trouble#001.dst: おーい、すまん！助けが…って、素通りかよ。{p} に頼みに行きゃよかったか、ここの連中も手一杯だしな…
Tempo Town Trouble#001.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#002.src: Don't suppose you'd be willing to help, huh? Bet you're busy- Wait, you've got spare time? Criminy, only took a week of asking! Good to meet ya.
Tempo Town Trouble#002.dst: 手伝ってくれる気は…ないよな？忙しいだろうし…え、暇がある？うわ、一週間頼み続けた甲斐があった！よろしくな。
Tempo Town Trouble#002.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#003.src: Alright, My name is Tyko, and I got asked to find a capable soldier for- well, lemme explain. So, I'm from a place called {p}, by {p}. It's a recent establishment.
Tempo Town Trouble#003.dst: よし、俺は Tyko。腕の立つ兵士を探すよう頼まれてて…まあ説明させてくれ。俺は {p} って所から来た。{p} のそばの、できたばかりの場所だ。
Tempo Town Trouble#003.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#004.src: I'm buddies with the mayor- he set up {p} as kind of a homeless shelter for people whose homes got ruined by corrupted attacks, since {p} doesn't seem corrupted.
Tempo Town Trouble#004.dst: 町長とは仲がよくてさ。町長は {p} を、腐敗者に家を壊された人の避難所にしたんだ。{p} は腐敗してないみたいだからな。
Tempo Town Trouble#004.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#005.src: Some old guy with jaundice or something swings by, some kind of keeper- Says to set up on a ridge overlooking a lake. So, we did! Everything was going well for a bit.
Tempo Town Trouble#005.dst: 黄疸だか何だかの爺さんが通りかかって、番人か何かでさ、湖を見下ろす尾根に住めって言うんだ。だからそうした！しばらくは順調だった。
Tempo Town Trouble#005.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#006.src: And then some freaky time monster starts showing up in the middle of the night and tries to bust down our doors! We were told that ridge was safe, but that was clearly a lie.
Tempo Town Trouble#006.dst: そしたら変な時間の化け物が夜中に現れて、うちの扉をぶち破ろうとするんだ！あの尾根は安全だって言われたのに、真っ赤な嘘だった。
Tempo Town Trouble#006.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#007.src: So, that's why I'm here. No one at {p} is tough enough to kill that thing, so I ran over here to ask for some backup. Glad I ran into ya!
Tempo Town Trouble#007.dst: それで俺はここにいる。{p} にはあいつを倒せる強い奴がいないから、応援を頼みに走ってきたんだ。会えてよかった！
Tempo Town Trouble#007.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#008.src: Lemme write down the coordinates for ya in your book. I'm gonna stick around and see if anyone else feels like helping.
Tempo Town Trouble#008.dst: 本に座標を書いとくよ。俺はここに残って、他にも手伝ってくれる奴がいないか探す。
Tempo Town Trouble#008.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#009.src: The coordinates to where you need to go should be in your book. Help us out, yeah?
Tempo Town Trouble#009.dst: 行き先の座標は本に書いてあるはずだ。助けてくれるよな？
Tempo Town Trouble#009.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#011.src: Hello- Welcome to {p}, friend! Established only two months ago, I'm proud to provide aid to those displaced by corrupted raids.
Tempo Town Trouble#011.dst: こんにちは、{p} へようこそ！まだ二か月前にできたばかりですが、腐敗者の襲撃で住まいを失った人々を支援しています。
Tempo Town Trouble#011.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#012.src: Come to think of it, you look like a {p} representative... Can I bother you to deliver some paperwork to the castle about getting officially established here?
Tempo Town Trouble#012.dst: そういえば、{p} の代表の方に見えますね…ここを正式に設立する書類を、城まで届けていただけませんか？
Tempo Town Trouble#012.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#013.src: ...Repeat that? ...OH! Oh, no wonder you- Agh, my mind's all over the place from stress, I'm so relieved he found help finally!
Tempo Town Trouble#013.dst: …もう一度？…ああ！なるほど、だから―ああ、心労で頭がぐちゃぐちゃで。彼がやっと助けを見つけてくれて本当によかった！
Tempo Town Trouble#013.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#014.src: Alright, Tyko told you about the monster, right? We were told by that old man Martyn to settle on this ridge because there weren't any dangerous creatures here!
Tempo Town Trouble#014.dst: Tyko から化け物のことは聞きましたよね？あの Martyn という老人に、危険な生き物がいないからこの尾根に住めと言われたんです！
Tempo Town Trouble#014.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#015.src: Oh, not that kind of soldier? That's too bad... But- oh, this is a shot in the dark, but... maybe you'd be the type of soldier to take out a monster for us?
Tempo Town Trouble#015.dst: あ、そういう兵士さんじゃない？残念…でも…ダメ元ですが…化け物を退治してくれるような兵士さんだったりしませんか？
Tempo Town Trouble#015.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#016.src: You- you would!? Oh, thank goodness you arrived when you did! You see- we were told by that old man Martyn to settle on this ridge because there apparently weren't any dangerous creatures here!
Tempo Town Trouble#016.dst: え、やってくれるんですか！？ああ、ちょうどいい時に来てくださった！実は、あの Martyn という老人に、危険な生き物はいないはずだからこの尾根に住めと言われたんです！
Tempo Town Trouble#016.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#017.src: But every night, the same monster emerges from one of the ruins, and tries to smash the buildings down! Every single night, at the same time!
Tempo Town Trouble#017.dst: でも毎晩、同じ化け物が遺跡の一つから出てきて、建物を壊そうとするんです！毎晩、同じ時刻に！
Tempo Town Trouble#017.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#018.src: The guards are getting run ragged, and I refuse to be responsible for any deaths when I'm trying to save these folks!
Tempo Town Trouble#018.dst: 衛兵はへとへとですし、人々を救おうとしているのに死者を出すわけにはいきません！
Tempo Town Trouble#018.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#019.src: We found the ruin it came out of, too- Er, one of the folks here, Doug, did! Here, let me write down the location for you- no, no, I insist, let me do it!
Tempo Town Trouble#019.dst: 出てきた遺跡も見つけました…いえ、ここに住む Doug が見つけたんです！場所を書きますね…いえいえ、ぜひ私に書かせてください！
Tempo Town Trouble#019.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#020.src: There's the coordinates in case you forget, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
Tempo Town Trouble#020.dst: 忘れた時のための座標です。でも丘を登ってすぐの神殿の中です！どうか、どうか急いであの恐ろしい化け物を片付けてください！
Tempo Town Trouble#020.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#021.src: The coordinates are in your book, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
Tempo Town Trouble#021.dst: 座標は本に書いてありますが、丘を登ってすぐの神殿の中です！どうか、どうか急いであの恐ろしい化け物を片付けてください！
Tempo Town Trouble#021.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#023.src: Grr... I KNOW I saw that beast go in here, where the heck is it?!
Tempo Town Trouble#023.dst: くそ…あの獣がここに入るのを確かに見たんだ、どこ行きやがった？！
Tempo Town Trouble#023.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#024.src: Hey soldier, does that disk look like some type of door to you?
Tempo Town Trouble#024.dst: おい兵士、あの円盤、何かの扉に見えないか？
Tempo Town Trouble#024.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#025.src: I saw some creature that I've been tracking for a few days disappear around here, and I think it's somewhere behind this disk...
Tempo Town Trouble#025.dst: 何日も追ってた生き物がこの辺で消えたんだ。たぶんこの円盤の奥のどこかにいる…
Tempo Town Trouble#025.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#026.src: There's probably some kind of wacky magic keeping it shut, since I can't get it open at all!
Tempo Town Trouble#026.dst: 妙な魔法で閉じてるんだろう、まったく開かないからな！
Tempo Town Trouble#026.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#027.src: Hey, you're able to use magic, right? Maybe using one of your fancy spells on the disk will get it open?
Tempo Town Trouble#027.dst: なあ、お前は魔法が使えるんだろ？円盤にご自慢の呪文でも撃てば開くんじゃないか？
Tempo Town Trouble#027.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#028.src: Stand on the disk and cast any spell. That should probably get it open, then we can finally kill that freak of nature lurking inside of there!
Tempo Town Trouble#028.dst: 円盤の上に立って何か呪文を唱えてくれ。それで開くはずだ、そしたら中に潜んでる化け物をやっと仕留められる！
Tempo Town Trouble#028.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#029.src: Let's see... What kind of secrets do these odd temples house?
Tempo Town Trouble#029.dst: さて…この妙な神殿にはどんな秘密があるのやら？
Tempo Town Trouble#029.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#030.src: Use spells to break open the temple at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Tempo Town Trouble#030.dst: 呪文で [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の神殿をこじ開ける

Tempo Town Trouble#031.src: What was going through your noggin, {u}?
Tempo Town Trouble#031.dst: 何を考えておったのじゃ、{u}？
Tempo Town Trouble#031.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#032.src: Do you have any idea what you were doing? Bashing around that room I just sealed off for good?
Tempo Town Trouble#032.dst: 自分が何をしておったか分かっておるのか？わしが封じたばかりの部屋で暴れおって？
Tempo Town Trouble#032.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#033.src: You need to be careful, soldier! This Valley's secrets are NOT to be meddled with.
Tempo Town Trouble#033.dst: 気をつけねばならんぞ、兵士よ！この谷の秘密に手を出してはならん。
Tempo Town Trouble#033.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#034.src: I assume the mayor of that place called {p} sent you here. You are going to have to tell that lad that his problems just got worse.
Tempo Town Trouble#034.dst: {p} とかいう所の長に頼まれて来たのじゃろう。あの若造に、厄介事がさらに増えたと伝えねばならんぞ。
Tempo Town Trouble#034.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#035.src: The monster you killed was known as a Time Trouble. They're odd creatures that were forced into a day-long temporal loop by some fools long ago.
Tempo Town Trouble#035.dst: お前が倒した化け物はタイムトラブルと呼ばれる。遥か昔、愚か者どもに一日の時の輪へ押し込められた奇妙な生き物じゃ。
Tempo Town Trouble#035.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#036.src: The only way to keep them at bay effectively is to seal them, like I just did here. But now, that stunt you just pulled sent ripples across the entire Valley. Now, every single Time Trouble is responding to this one's termination!
Tempo Town Trouble#036.dst: 奴らを確実に抑える唯一の手は、わしが今ここでしたように封じることじゃ。じゃが今の無茶のせいで谷じゅうに波紋が広がり、全てのタイムトラブルがこやつの死に反応しておる！
Tempo Town Trouble#036.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#037.src: Now, one Time Trouble I can handle, but this? I can't keep them all at bay... and now, you went and awakened every single one of those critters.
Tempo Town Trouble#037.dst: 一匹ならわしでも手に負えるが、これは？全部は抑えきれん…しかもお前が一匹残らず目覚めさせてしもうた。
Tempo Town Trouble#037.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#038.src: I can fix this seal, so you'll have one less to deal with, but the rest of the Troubles will have to be taken down daily with brute force.
Tempo Town Trouble#038.dst: この封印は直せるから一匹は減るが、残りのトラブルは毎日力ずくで倒すしかない。
Tempo Town Trouble#038.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#039.src: You're going to have to deal with those, soldier. I have far too much to take care of in this valley.
Tempo Town Trouble#039.dst: そっちはお前が片付けるのじゃ、兵士よ。わしはこの谷で手一杯でな。
Tempo Town Trouble#039.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#040.src: They'll have to be exterminated every single day. Now, I'm sure the work won't be thankless, perhaps you'll be rewarded by the townsfolk of {p} for taking care of them.
Tempo Town Trouble#040.dst: 奴らは毎日退治せねばならん。まあ骨折り損にはなるまい、{p} の住人が礼をくれるかもしれんぞ。
Tempo Town Trouble#040.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#041.src: Now please, be careful in the Valley. I already have to look after one person, nevermind the mess of time that the Olm were so-
Tempo Town Trouble#041.dst: ともかく、谷では用心するのじゃぞ。わしはすでに一人の面倒を見ておる、Olm どもがこしらえた時の混乱は言うまでも―
Tempo Town Trouble#041.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#042.src: ...I digress, I'm just rambling again. Now, let me bring us back outside this temple, and you should head back to that shanty town.
Tempo Town Trouble#042.dst: …話がそれた、また長話じゃ。さて、神殿の外へ連れ出してやろう。お前はあの掘っ立て小屋の町へ戻るがよい。
Tempo Town Trouble#042.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#043.src: Report back to the mayor in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Tempo Town Trouble#044.src: You're back! I heard some kind of weird chime coming from the temple on the hill- is that a good sign?
Tempo Town Trouble#044.dst: お帰りなさい！丘の神殿から妙な鐘の音が聞こえました…いい兆しですか？
Tempo Town Trouble#044.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#045.src: You did?! Oh, thank goodness... Honestly, Martyn told us he would deal with it, but then he just disappeared off into nowhere!
Tempo Town Trouble#045.dst: やったんですか？！ああ、よかった…正直、Martyn は自分が何とかすると言ったのに、どこかへ消えてしまって！
Tempo Town Trouble#045.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#046.src: Oh, he actually showed his face after you took care of that thing? What, did you beat him to the punch or something?
Tempo Town Trouble#046.dst: え、あなたが片付けた後で顔を出したんですか？何です、先を越したとか？
Tempo Town Trouble#046.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#047.src: Wait... What? He was... trying to seal the thing away, instead of killing it, and... you destroying it broke the seal?
Tempo Town Trouble#047.dst: 待って…え？あの人は…殺すんじゃなく封印しようとしていて…あなたが倒したせいで封印が壊れた？
Tempo Town Trouble#047.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#048.src: And now there's more of them? Why didn't he just tell us?! Now they'll need to be stopped every day to keep them in check!!
Tempo Town Trouble#048.dst: しかも増えた？どうして言ってくれなかったの？！これじゃ毎日抑え込まないといけないじゃないですか！！
Tempo Town Trouble#048.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#049.src: Gah, this is a disaster... It isn't your fault, you didn't know- Wait, what's that boxy thing you have? A [Time Fragment]? ...oh, so the monster dropped it.
Tempo Town Trouble#049.dst: ああ、大変なことに…あなたのせいじゃありません、知らなかったんですし…あれ、その四角いのは？[Time Fragment]？…ああ、化け物が落としたんですね。
Tempo Town Trouble#049.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#050.src: Interesting... One of the townsfolk likes to collect those sorts of things! He's that Mysterious Merchant just behind me.
Tempo Town Trouble#050.dst: 面白い…町にそういう物を集めるのが好きな人がいるんです！私の後ろにいる謎の商人ですよ。
Tempo Town Trouble#050.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#051.src: Go talk with him about those! He might give you something worth your while if you trade them with him.
Tempo Town Trouble#051.dst: その件で彼と話してみてください！交換すれば、いい物をくれるかもしれません。
Tempo Town Trouble#051.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#052.src: ...also, while you were away, that strange magic stone up on the hill started glowing. We're not sure what to do with it, really! Might be worth your attention.
Tempo Town Trouble#052.dst: …それと、あなたがいない間に、丘の上の不思議な魔法の石が光り出したんです。どうしたらいいのか分からなくて！見ておく価値があるかも。
Tempo Town Trouble#052.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#053.src: ...though, this is a bit awkward- I don't have a reward ready for you. Making this place took a lot of money... Hopefully gratitude is enough- thank you, sincerely!
Tempo Town Trouble#053.dst: …ただ、少し気まずいのですが…お礼を用意できていないんです。この場所を作るのにお金がかかって…感謝の気持ちで足りれば…本当にありがとう！
Tempo Town Trouble#053.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#054.src: Heya! Heard from the mayor that you helped out the town! Can't thank you enough for that.
Tempo Town Trouble#054.dst: よう！町長から、町を助けてくれたって聞いたぜ！いくら感謝しても足りないよ。
Tempo Town Trouble#054.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#055.src: Oh hey, it's you! I hope you've been keeping those Time Troubles at bay.
Tempo Town Trouble#055.dst: あ、あなたでしたか！タイムトラブルを抑えてくれているといいのですが。
Tempo Town Trouble#055.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#056.src: Oh, hey! I hope that monster wasn't too difficult for you to defeat.
Tempo Town Trouble#056.dst: おっ、よう！あの化け物、倒すのに苦労しなかったならいいが。
Tempo Town Trouble#056.speaker: Scout

The Bigger Picture#000.src: Talk to Psilo in the mushroom cave.
The Bigger Picture#000.dst: キノコの洞窟で Psilo と話す。
