The Cursed One#178.dst: 特別に鍛えた武器、ですと？お嬢さん、作るのに特に必要なものはありますか？素材さえあれば、Zeph に必要なものを私が鍛えてみせますよ。
The Cursed One#178.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#179.src: A- a new weapon? That I ca- can cast ma- magic with?
The Cursed One#179.dst: あ、新しい武器？ま、魔法が使える？
The Cursed One#179.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#180.src: I could see it coming in use. We'll want more sturdy materials than usual- preferably something that is magical in and of itself... Zeph, do you think you could-
The Cursed One#180.dst: 役に立ちそうね。普通より丈夫な素材が要るわ― できればそれ自体に魔力のあるもの… Zeph、あなた探して
The Cursed One#180.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#181.src: Yes!!! I- I mean, uh, y- yes, I can do that.
The Cursed One#181.dst: うん！！！あ、いや、その、う、うん、できるよ。
The Cursed One#181.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#182.src: ...Okay! {u}, I kn- I- I know where to start! Me- meet me by the big tree to the n- nor- northeast! The one for the riddle!
The Cursed One#182.dst: …よし！{u}、ど、ど、どこから始めるか分かってる！ほ、北東のお、大きな木のそばで会おう！なぞなぞのあの木だよ！
The Cursed One#182.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#183.src: Head to the big tree and find Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#183.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の大きな木へ行き、Zeph を見つける。

The Cursed One#184.src: I suppose I should get around to firing up the forge... Sui, will you need me for anything?
The Cursed One#184.dst: 私はそろそろ炉に火を入れるとしましょう… Sui、何か手伝いは要りますか？
The Cursed One#184.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#185.src: Um... n-no, I don't think so.
The Cursed One#185.dst: えっと… う、ううん、大丈夫だと思う。
The Cursed One#185.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#186.src: He's taken to it remarkably well, hasn't he? Better than I could have hoped.
The Cursed One#186.dst: あの子、驚くほどうまく馴染んだわね。期待以上だわ。
The Cursed One#186.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#187.src: {u}... you have opened a path for me that I never could have imagined. Thank you.
The Cursed One#187.dst: {u}… あなたは想像もしなかった道を私に開いてくれた。ありがとう。
The Cursed One#187.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#189.dst: 相変わらず張り切ってるよね、あいつ。
The Cursed One#189.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#192.src: Never in my life did I expect to have my whole world view challenged, hoh!
The Cursed One#192.dst: まさか世界観そのものを覆される日が来ようとは、ほほう！
The Cursed One#192.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#193.src: Admittedly, this information will take some time to progress...
The Cursed One#193.dst: 正直なところ、この話を消化するには時間がかかりそうです…
The Cursed One#193.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#194.src: I'll most likely seek you out later with some follow up questions.
The Cursed One#194.dst: おそらく後ほど、いくつか質問を持って伺うことになるでしょう。
The Cursed One#194.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#195.src: ...well, Synny, don't suppose any of this changes your usual approach?
The Cursed One#195.dst: …で、Synny。これでいつものやり方が変わるわけじゃあるまいな？
The Cursed One#195.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#196.src: Sigh... You know it does, Kaio. If there's a possibility more of our members could wield magic, then...
The Cursed One#196.dst: はあ… 変わるって分かってるでしょう、Kaio。もっと多くの仲間が魔法を扱えるかもしれないなら…
The Cursed One#196.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#198.src: ... I don't know. I don't know if it'll work, yet.
The Cursed One#198.dst: …分からない。うまくいくかどうかも、まだ分からないの。
The Cursed One#198.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#200.dst: あなたは何でも嫌がるじゃない、Kaio。
The Cursed One#200.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#201.src: Yes, well, I especially don't like this. Don't like the ideas you're gettin' all up there in your head. It's a risk.
The Cursed One#201.dst: ああ、だがこいつは特に気に入らん。お前さんの頭ん中に湧いとる考えもな。危険だ。
The Cursed One#201.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#202.src: Everything is a risk. But it doesn't matter yet. It'll depend on what Quill has to tell me during the festival.
The Cursed One#202.dst: 何だって危険よ。でも今はまだ関係ない。祭りの間に Quill が何を伝えてくるか次第ね。
The Cursed One#202.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#204.src: When I m- ma- when I make my weapon... do you think I'll be a- a- able to cast real spells? And not just... poofs of sp- s- sparkles?
The Cursed One#204.dst: ぼ、僕が武、武器を― 武器を作ったら… 本物の呪文がつ、使えるようになると思う？ただの… ぽんっていうひ、火花じゃなくて？
The Cursed One#204.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#207.src: Sigh... I was h- h- hoping that- that- that I could do... I- I don't know! Something! A- any- anything to help. But... you're right.
The Cursed One#207.dst: はあ… ぼ、ぼ、僕は、そ、その… わ、分からないけど！何か！な、何でもいいから役に立ちたかったんだ。でも… 君の言う通りだね。
The Cursed One#207.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#208.src: Oh. O- okay! That means it- it m- might help me, too. Thank you.
The Cursed One#208.dst: あっ。わ、分かった！それならぼ、僕の助けにもなるかもね。ありがとう。
The Cursed One#208.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#209.src: Oh! R- ri- right! Well, Syndra said we sh- should find something magical, right? Well, I- I don't know for- f- for sure if it's magical or not, but...
The Cursed One#209.dst: あっ！そ、そうだった！Syndra は魔法のものを探せって言ってたよね？えっと、ほ、本当に魔法かどうかは、わ、分からないけど…
The Cursed One#209.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#210.src: A long, long time ago, th- this- this tree was more than just a stump! It had long arms st- str- stretching out over the whole forest, watching over th- the people and w- wi- wildlife.
The Cursed One#210.dst: ずっとずっと昔、こ、この木はただの切り株じゃなかった！森じゅうにの、長い腕を伸ばして、人々とや、野生の生き物を見守ってたんだ。
The Cursed One#210.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#211.src: When anyone was hurt, o- or- or unwell, the tree would reach out with its br- branches and grow fruit- fruit that was said to he- h- heal all injuries and illnesses.
The Cursed One#211.dst: 誰かがけ、怪我をしたり、び、病気になったりすると、木はえ、枝を伸ばして実をつけた― ど、どんな傷も病もな、治す実だったって。
The Cursed One#211.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#212.src: It took care of the people, and the p- people took care of the tree. But then- then the c- cur- curse took hold of the people.
The Cursed One#212.dst: 木は人々を守り、人々も木を守った。でもそ、その後、の、呪いが人々をとらえたんだ。
The Cursed One#212.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#213.src: In the chaos and d- des- destruction caused by the cursed ones, the tree was hurt. It stopped gr- grow- growing its gifts, and went to sleep... f- forever.
The Cursed One#213.dst: 呪われし者が起こした混乱とは、破壊の中で、木は傷ついた。恵みをみ、実らせるのをやめて、眠りについた… え、永遠に。
The Cursed One#213.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#214.src: Even after the Queen arrived a- and blessed the people, the tree di- didn't- didn't wake up. Its trust had been broken...
The Cursed One#214.dst: 女王が来て人々をしゅ、祝福した後も、木はめ、目覚めなかった。信頼が壊れてしまったから…
The Cursed One#214.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#215.src: Ev- even though it's just a story... I hope s- some- someday the tree can trust us again. We could- c- could- we could really use its help, these days...
The Cursed One#215.dst: た、ただの物語だけど… いつかこの木がまた僕らを信じてくれたらって思う。今こそ、ほ、本当にその助けがほしいのに…
The Cursed One#215.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#216.src: ... A- a- anyway! The cavern you met Syndra in is also said to be s- sa- sacred. And the feel of the crystals reminds me of h- how I feel there.
The Cursed One#216.dst: …と、と、とにかく！君が Syndra に会った洞窟も、せ、神聖な場所だって言われてる。水晶の感じが、そこにいる時のか、感じに似てるんだ。
The Cursed One#216.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#217.src: So- s- so if we can find our way into the tree... we co- could find some m- ma- s- some magical wood. Follow me!
The Cursed One#217.dst: だ、だから木の中に入れたら… ま、魔法の木材が見つかるかも。ついてきて！
The Cursed One#217.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#218.src: Head to the top of the giant tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#219.src: Hey! F- faster than last time! Keep up the im- im- improvement, and maybe soon I'll have to put in mo- more than {~}!
The Cursed One#219.dst: へえ！ま、前より速い！その調子でじょ、上達すれば、そのうち {~} 以上のハンデが要るかもね！
The Cursed One#219.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#220.src: Ha... yeah... Um, earlier you m- me- mentioned that magic can be found in- in everything.
The Cursed One#220.dst: はは… うん… えっと、さっき魔法はば、万物にあるって言ってたよね。
The Cursed One#220.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#221.src: So... so ma- maybe we didn't need to come to- to- to this old tree... But- b- but it feels right to me.
The Cursed One#221.dst: だから… わざわざこ、この古い木に来る必要はなかったのかも… で、でも、僕にはこれがしっくりくるんだ。
The Cursed One#221.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#222.src: ... Thank you for c- c- coming along.
The Cursed One#222.dst: …つ、ついて来てくれてありがとう。
The Cursed One#222.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#223.src: It's a breath of fresh air, having someone n- n- new around! I don't know, having you around just f- fe- feels... good! Like- like anything is possible!
The Cursed One#223.dst: あ、新しい人がいると、新鮮な気分になるよ！よく分からないけど、君がいると、なんか… い、いい感じ！な、何でもできそうな気がする！
The Cursed One#223.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#224.src: ... Oh, I- I- I'm getting too sappy. Sorry, sorry!
The Cursed One#224.dst: …あ、ぼ、僕、くさいこと言いすぎた。ごめん、ごめん！
The Cursed One#224.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#225.src: Well... my h- h- my heart is telling me that this wood is what I w- w- what I want!
The Cursed One#225.dst: えっと… ぼ、僕の心が、この木材こそほ、欲しいものだって言ってる！
The Cursed One#225.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#226.src: That old tale... it's one of the o- o- only things I still remember from my childhood.
The Cursed One#226.dst: あの昔話は… 子供の頃のことで、ぼ、僕がまだ覚えてるす、数少ないものの一つなんだ。
The Cursed One#226.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#227.src: So, s- so this is definitely what I want my w- we- weapon to be made out of.
The Cursed One#227.dst: だ、だから、ぶ、武器は絶対これで作りたい。
The Cursed One#227.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#228.src: Oh... y- y- yeah. Maybe you're right...
The Cursed One#228.dst: あ… う、うん。君の言う通りかも…
The Cursed One#228.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#229.src: I just thought... choosing s- some- something special to me would- would be b- best.
The Cursed One#229.dst: た、ただ… 自分にとってと、特別なものを選ぶのが一番だと思って。
The Cursed One#229.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#230.src: B- but we're here now any- a- anyway, aren't we? So we can just use the- the- the wood here...
The Cursed One#230.dst: で、でも、どうせもうここに来てるんだし？だからこ、ここの木材を使えばいいよね…
The Cursed One#230.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#231.src: So, we've gotta find a way into the tr- the tree...
The Cursed One#231.dst: じゃあ、木の中にはい、入る方法を探さないと…
The Cursed One#231.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#232.src: Ha, I- I'm not exactly a wood- woodcutting expert... maybe it'd have been smart to ask Mora t- to- to join us?
The Cursed One#232.dst: はは、ぼ、僕は木こりのせ、専門家じゃないし… Mora にもつ、ついて来てもらえばよかったかな？
The Cursed One#232.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#233.src: ... Do- do you have any ideas? May- maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#233.dst: …な、何かいい考えある？じゅ、呪文で突き破れるかも？
The Cursed One#233.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#234.src: Cast a spell ontop of the tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#234.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の木の上で呪文を唱える。

The Cursed One#235.src: Maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#235.dst: じゅ、呪文で突き破れるかも？
The Cursed One#235.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#237.src: ... Do- do you think the t- tr- the tree heard me earlier? Is it...
The Cursed One#237.dst: …き、木がさっきの僕の話をき、聞いてたのかな？もしかして…
The Cursed One#237.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#238.src: This- th- this has to be a sign! Come on, let's go in!
The Cursed One#238.dst: こ、これはきっとお告げだ！さあ、中に入ろう！
The Cursed One#238.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#239.src: Find the wood Zeph wants at the end of the root system.
The Cursed One#239.dst: 根の奥で Zeph が欲しがっている木材を見つける。

The Cursed One#240.src: Th- th- there! That should- sh- should be a big enough chunk for Mora... right?
The Cursed One#240.dst: あ、あ、あった！Mora にはあ、あれくらいの大きさで足りる… よね？
The Cursed One#240.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#241.src: A- and- you're still not fast enough to beat me to th- th- to the end!
The Cursed One#241.dst: そ、それに― 君はまだ、お、奥までぼ、僕に勝てるほど速くないね！
The Cursed One#241.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#242.src: Okay, next... We- weapons are usually made of m- me- metal, right? That's why Mora has a f- fo- a forge.
The Cursed One#242.dst: よし、次は… ぶ、武器って普通はき、金属でできてるよね？だから Mora にはろ、炉があるんだ。
The Cursed One#242.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#243.src: ...I have a- an- an idea! Let's meet up near {p}, wh- where we first met.
The Cursed One#243.dst: …い、いい考えがある！{p} の近く、ぼ、僕らが初めて会った場所で落ち合おう。
The Cursed One#243.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#244.dst: {p} の近くで Zeph を見つける。

The Cursed One#245.src: O- okay, so. The crown usually uses t- ti- titanium for their equipment. Th- that's what Mora says, at least.
The Cursed One#245.dst: よ、よし。王家はふつう装備にチ、チタンを使うんだ。す、少なくとも Mora はそう言ってた。
The Cursed One#245.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#246.src: But- b- but, it can be hard to come by, b- be- because the crown keeps most of it for themselves.
The Cursed One#246.dst: で、でも手に入りにくい。お、王家がほとんど独り占めしてるから。
The Cursed One#246.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#247.src: Luckily, it's F- F- Festival time, so a bunch of m- merchants are in town! And they're fr- from all over the p- pr- province, not just here!
The Cursed One#247.dst: 運のいいことに、い、今はま、祭りの時期だから、しょ、商人がたくさん町に来てる！しかも地方のあ、あちこちから！
The Cursed One#247.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#248.src: So someone m- must have titanium, somewhere... we'll j- just- just have to look around.
The Cursed One#248.dst: だから誰かがチタンを持ってるは、はず… み、見て回るしかないね。
The Cursed One#248.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#249.src: Ah! Th- that- that's the Sovereign!
The Cursed One#249.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#250.src: ...and alongside that, does she really think it's safe to hold the festival right now, sir? That opens up a really big risk!
The Cursed One#250.dst: …それに、閣下、陛下は本当に今祭りを開いても安全だとお考えなのでしょうか？とても大きな危険を招きます！
The Cursed One#250.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#251.src: What do you th- th- think they're t- talking about? Come on, let- l- let's shadow them.
The Cursed One#251.dst: な、何の話をしてるんだろう？ほら、あ、後をつけよう。
The Cursed One#251.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#252.src: If the cursed thinks they can get past both myself and Her Majesty, they're out of their vector. You don't need to worry about the people.
The Cursed One#252.dst: 呪われし者が私と女王陛下の両方を出し抜けると思っているなら、ベクトルを見誤っている。民の心配はいらんよ。
The Cursed One#252.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#253.src: I was more worried about... ...um... W-well, never mind that! If you think we'll all be safe, sir, I'll take you at your word!
The Cursed One#253.dst: 私が心配していたのはむしろ… …その… い、いえ、何でもありません！閣下が皆無事だとおっしゃるなら、そのお言葉を信じます！
The Cursed One#253.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#254.src: Let me rephrase- you don't need to worry about anyone. ...heh. Any- wait. What's that noise?
The Cursed One#254.dst: 言い直そう― 誰の心配もいらない。…ふっ。誰も― 待て。今の音は何だ？
The Cursed One#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#255.src: Just someone out on a random walk? Back to the point is everything for the festival shaping up according to schedule?
The Cursed One#255.dst: ランダムウォーク中の誰かか？本題に戻ろう― 祭りの準備は予定通り進んでいるか？
The Cursed One#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#256.src: Oh yes! Yes it is, sir! The vendors have all been assigned, the game stands have all been constructed, we've commissioned a local band... The one you liked last year!
The Cursed One#256.dst: はい！予定通りです、閣下！出店の割り当ても済み、遊戯の屋台も組み上がり、地元の楽団も手配しました… 閣下が去年お気に入りだったあの楽団です！
The Cursed One#256.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#257.src: Golden. That rendition of "CHASE" is what really sold me on them.
The Cursed One#257.dst: 黄金比の出来だ。あの「CHASE」の演奏が決め手だったよ。
The Cursed One#257.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#258.src: That just leaves your speech, sir! Have you Oh, who am I kidding, you already have it memorized.
The Cursed One#258.dst: 残るは閣下の演説です！もう― ああ、何を言っているんでしょう、とっくに暗記済みですよね。
The Cursed One#258.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#259.src: Naturally, Xao. We have the whole festival set down to the last point, it looks like. Any more business to factor out?
The Cursed One#259.dst: 当然だ、Xao。祭りは最後の一点まで決まったようだな。他にくくり出す案件は？
The Cursed One#259.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#260.src: Yes, sir! I've received word that Inquisitor Renn will be arriving tonight, as you sent me to request for!
The Cursed One#260.dst: はい、閣下！ご依頼の通り、Renn 審問官が今夜到着するとの知らせを受けました！
The Cursed One#260.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#261.src: Fantastic job. I have to remember that the Inquisitors aren't like me. When they're busy they can't just go triple-time... Still, good to have that problem solved.
The Cursed One#261.dst: 見事だ。審問官は私とは違うのを忘れてはいかんな。忙しいときに三倍速で動けるわけではない… それでも、その問題が解けてよかった。
The Cursed One#261.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#262.src: You know, they should check your work. This is proof positive they can keep pace with me like you can.
The Cursed One#262.dst: 審問官たちも君の答案を見習うべきだな。君のように私についてこられる、確かな証明になる。
The Cursed One#262.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#263.src: Well! Sir! You know I've had to insist you stop and rest sometimes, and Inquisitors do serve the whole of the province, so...
The Cursed One#263.dst: まあ！閣下！時々無理にでも休んでいただかないといけないのはご存じでしょう。それに審問官は地方全体に仕える方々ですし…
The Cursed One#263.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#264.src: Hmm... ev- even with us r- r- raiding Nixeph, he isn't concerned...
The Cursed One#264.dst: うーん… ぼ、僕らが Nixeph を襲撃したのに、ぜ、全然気にしてない…
The Cursed One#264.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#265.src: A- and- an Inquisitor! Th- that- that's not good. We need to tell the others to be c- ca- careful...
The Cursed One#265.dst: そ、それに審問官まで！そ、それはまずい。みんなにき、気をつけるよう伝えないと…
The Cursed One#265.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#266.src: Oh! R- r- right! You're not from here. They're, uh, b- b- bad news. They're sent to d- d- deal with... um, c- cursed ones, and other s- si- similar stuff.
The Cursed One#266.dst: あっ！そ、そ、そうだった！君はここの人じゃないもんね。あいつらは、その、や、厄介者なんだ。呪われし者とか、に、似たようなもののしょ、処理に送られてくる。
The Cursed One#266.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#267.src: If one's a- around... we have to b- be careful. But, since w- we- since we're here, we should still find the t- ti- titanium.
The Cursed One#267.dst: 近くにいるなら… き、気をつけないと。でも、せ、せっかく来たんだし、チ、チタンは探そう。
The Cursed One#267.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#268.src: There's a b- b- bazaar in the tunnel... if anyone wi- will have it, they'll be there.
The Cursed One#268.dst: トンネルにバ、バザーがあるんだ… 誰かが持ってるなら、そ、そこだよ。
The Cursed One#268.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#270.src: Fine quality metals, fine quality metals for- Ah, hello, hello! Might you be interested in my stock, friends?
The Cursed One#270.dst: 上質な金属、上質な金属は― おお、こんにちは、こんにちは！お二方、品物にご興味は？
The Cursed One#270.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#271.src: I've got all sorts for sale. Ingots, pre-made bangles and bracelets and trinkets I've got hold of this lovely iron leaf, in fact. Quite fine decor, I might think!
The Cursed One#271.dst: 何でも取り揃えておりますよ。インゴットに既製の腕輪、装身具… 実はこの素敵な鉄の葉も手に入れましてね。なかなかの飾りかと！
The Cursed One#271.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#272.src: Hello! We're a- ac- actually looking for titanium! Would you h- ha- happen to have any in stock?
The Cursed One#272.dst: こんにちは！ぼ、僕ら実はチタンを探してるんだ！も、もしかして在庫ある？
The Cursed One#272.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#273.src: Aha, you're in luck then! I've managed to obtain some from a passing {p} merchant! Straight from the {p} and so I'm told, quite good quality!
The Cursed One#273.dst: ははあ、それは運がいい！通りすがりの {p} の商人から少々手に入れましてね！{p} 直送で、聞くところでは品質も上々！
The Cursed One#273.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#274.src: I think the man was struck dumb by the offer of leaves I handed in return, he left with such a bewildered face- but I digress! Would you like ingots, or anything pre-hewn?
The Cursed One#274.dst: 代わりに葉を差し出したら、その男は言葉を失ったようで、困惑顔で去っていきました― いや、話がそれました！インゴットにしますか、加工済みにしますか？
The Cursed One#274.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#275.src: Uh... just- j- just some ingots would be fine.
The Cursed One#275.dst: えっと… イ、インゴットだけでいいよ。
The Cursed One#275.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#276.src: Indeed, then! It is always fine to see those interested in the crafting trades. For this, I might say ten Liff Leaves would be an agreeable price, yes?
The Cursed One#276.dst: かしこまりました！ものづくりに興味のある方を見るのはいつも嬉しいものです。こちらは Liff の葉十枚が妥当なお値段かと、いかがです？
The Cursed One#276.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#277.src: Ten!? Oh, f- fine... you said it's h- high- high quality? It's pr- probably worth the price. Here.
The Cursed One#277.dst: 十枚！？う、うう、分かった… 品質がい、いいんだよね？た、たぶんその価値はある。はい。
The Cursed One#277.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#278.src: Indeed, friend, so I have been assured! May you have fine fortune in your endeavors!
The Cursed One#278.dst: ええ、お客様、そう保証されておりますとも！あなた方の行く先に幸運を！
The Cursed One#278.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#280.src: Hm... I d- don't- I don't think titanium is meant to have th- these purple streaks...
The Cursed One#280.dst: うーん… チタンにこ、こんな紫の筋が入ってるものなのかな…
The Cursed One#280.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#281.src: But I- I- I'm not the blacksmith, so... a- a- and it's not like anyone else is s- se- selling titanium, so.
The Cursed One#281.dst: でもぼ、僕は鍛冶屋じゃないし… そ、それに他にチタンをう、売ってる人もいないし。
The Cursed One#281.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#282.src: Huh? Oh, r- r- right, I keep forgetting you don't know e- ev- everything around here.
The Cursed One#282.dst: え？あ、そ、そうだった、君はここのことをぜ、全部知ってるわけじゃないんだった。
The Cursed One#282.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#283.src: The Auburn F- Fo- Forest may be a poorer area, so we d- do- don't have many emeralds...
The Cursed One#283.dst: Auburn のも、森は貧しい地域だから、エメラルドはあ、あまり持ってないんだ…
The Cursed One#283.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#284.src: But we make up for it by u- u- using all the varied m- materials from the forest! People here v- val- value things from the wild more than e- em- emeralds.
The Cursed One#284.dst: でも、森のいろんな素材をつ、使って補ってる！ここの人は、エ、エメラルドより野生の恵みを大事にするんだ。
The Cursed One#284.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#285.src: Liff Leaves especially are in high d- d- demand due to their versatility.
The Cursed One#285.dst: 特に Liff の葉は使い道が広いから、じゅ、需要が高いんだ。
The Cursed One#285.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#286.src: You don't need a- an- anything else? Then I'm r- ready to go.
The Cursed One#286.dst: ほ、他に何も要らない？なら僕はい、いつでも行けるよ。
The Cursed One#286.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#287.src: Want to tr- travel back with me?
The Cursed One#287.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#289.src: Okay! I'll m- m- meet you later, then.
The Cursed One#289.dst: 分かった！じゃあ、あ、後でね。
The Cursed One#289.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#290.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#290.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のレジスタンスの野営地に戻る。

The Cursed One#292.src: Ah! Good, you're just in time.
The Cursed One#292.dst: あら！ちょうどいいところに来たわ。
The Cursed One#292.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#293.src: Uh... in time for wh- what? A- and- and where is everybody?
The Cursed One#293.dst: え… な、何にちょうどいいの？そ、それにみんなは？
The Cursed One#293.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#294.src: Have you forgotten? The Festival of the Queen is about to start!
The Cursed One#294.dst: 忘れたの？女王祭がもうすぐ始まるのよ！
The Cursed One#294.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#295.src: Wh- th- that was today?! Oh, man, I g- g- got so excited about the m- m- the ma- magic... I forgot!
The Cursed One#295.dst: な― きょ、今日だったの？！ああもう、ま、ま、魔法に夢中になって… 忘れてた！
The Cursed One#295.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#296.src: Wait... w- wait, before I go Syndra, we o- ov- overheard something in town. The S- S- Sovereign said an In- Inquisitor would be arriving t- t- tonight!
The Cursed One#296.dst: 待って… ま、待って、行く前に Syndra、町でた、立ち聞きしたんだ。く、君主が今夜し、審問官が来るって言ってた！
The Cursed One#296.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#297.src: ...ah. Well, that pushes ahead our timeline significantly...
The Cursed One#297.dst: …そう。それなら計画をかなり前倒ししないと…
The Cursed One#297.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#298.src: Hopefully, they're just here to clear out that cave you found the crystals in, but... better to be safe than sorry.
The Cursed One#298.dst: あなたたちが水晶を見つけた洞窟の掃除に来るだけならいいけど… 用心に越したことはないわ。
The Cursed One#298.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#299.src: That can wait until after the festival, though. You should go on ahead an enjoy yourself.
The Cursed One#299.dst: でもそれは祭りの後でいい。先に行って楽しんでらっしゃい。
The Cursed One#299.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#300.src: ...if you s- s- say so, Syndra. {u}, you should c- come to the festival too! See you there!
The Cursed One#300.dst: …そ、そう言うなら、Syndra。{u}、君も祭りにお、おいでよ！向こうでね！
The Cursed One#300.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#301.src: Ah... there he goes. Well, what do you say? Will you join us for the festival?
The Cursed One#301.dst: あら… 行っちゃった。それで、どう？一緒に祭りに来る？
The Cursed One#301.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#302.src: It is a celebration of the crown... but you have a limited time here, and it is still a part of our culture. You wouldn't want to miss it.
The Cursed One#302.dst: 王家を祝う催しではあるけど… ここにいられる時間は限られているし、これも私たちの文化の一部。見逃す手はないわ。
The Cursed One#302.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#303.src: It's a day for everyone to relax and enjoy themselves. The children certainly do... it's good for them, I think, to have some normalcy.
The Cursed One#303.dst: 皆がくつろいで楽しむ日なの。子供たちは特にね… たまに普通の暮らしを味わうのは、あの子たちにいいことだと思う。
The Cursed One#303.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#304.src: I'll finish packing some things here, then I'll head on over. You should meet me there. If you head south, the river will lead you right to it.
The Cursed One#304.dst: ここで荷物をまとめたら私も向かうわ。向こうで会いましょう。南へ行けば、川がそのまま連れて行ってくれる。
The Cursed One#304.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#305.src: Join Syndra at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#305.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の祭りで Syndra と合流する。

The Cursed One#306.src: I'll head on over soon. I just need to take care of some things before I leave.
The Cursed One#306.dst: 私もすぐ向かうわ。出る前に少し片付けることがあるの。
The Cursed One#306.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#307.src: You're here! Allow me to welcome you to the annual Festival of the Crown.
The Cursed One#307.dst: 来たわね！毎年恒例の王冠祭へようこそ。
The Cursed One#307.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#308.src: I have some business to attend to, so Zeph, would you be able to show {u} around?
The Cursed One#308.dst: 私は用事があるから… Zeph、{u} を案内してあげられる？
The Cursed One#308.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#310.src: So there's some g- games over there... and right here is the f- foo- food and beverages s- s- stand!
The Cursed One#310.dst: あっちにゲ、ゲームがあって… ここがた、食べ物と飲み物のや、屋台！
The Cursed One#310.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#311.src: They sell re- r- regional food and drinks. And, a- ac- according to Rex... they've even im- im- imported some fancy alcohol from the h- high- highlands!
The Cursed One#311.dst: 地元の食べ物や飲み物を売ってる。それに、Rex によると… こ、高地から高級なお酒までゆ、輸入してるんだって！
The Cursed One#311.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#312.src: Here are some at- attractions, and an animal exhibit! I, uh, d- d- don't- I don't like the Mudkins game very much...
The Cursed One#312.dst: ここはア、アトラクションと動物の展示！ぼ、僕は、その、Mudkin のゲームはあ、あんまり好きじゃない…
The Cursed One#312.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#313.src: I th- think I saw Sui back there, so... I'm gonna h- ha- hang out with her. You sh- should check out some of the stalls!
The Cursed One#313.dst: あっちで Sui を見た気がするから… ぼ、僕は一緒に遊んでくる。き、君は屋台を見て回るといいよ！
The Cursed One#313.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#314.dst: 祭りのアクティビティを {~} 個達成する。

The Cursed One#315.src: ...thank you, Jiro. It's always good to hear from
The Cursed One#315.dst: …ありがとう、Jiro。いつも知らせを聞けるのは
The Cursed One#315.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#316.dst: おっと！やあ、よそ者さん。
The Cursed One#316.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#317.src: Hm? Oh, that's just {u} they're who I was hoping to write to Quill about. {u}, this is Jiro, my contact from the Roughworks.
The Cursed One#317.dst: ん？ああ、ただの {u} よ― Quill に知らせたかったのがこの人。{u}、こちらは Jiro、Roughworks での連絡役よ。
The Cursed One#317.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#318.src: Ah. Well, it's good to meet you then.
The Cursed One#318.dst: ああ。なら、会えてよかった。
The Cursed One#318.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#319.src: Quill is... an old friend. It can be hard for us to stay in contact... discretely... so we often send messages this way.
The Cursed One#319.dst: Quill は… 古い友人よ。人目を忍んで連絡を取り合うのは難しくて… だからよくこうして伝言を送るの。
The Cursed One#319.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#320.src: Wasn't going to use my yearly rail pass for anything anyway, so might as well.
The Cursed One#320.dst: どうせ年間の鉄道パスも使い道がなかったし、ちょうどいいさ。
The Cursed One#320.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#321.src: Well, it's more than I'm able to do, so I appreciate it. In any case, Quill runs his own... organization, shall we say.
The Cursed One#321.dst: それでも私にはできないことだから、感謝してる。ともかく、Quill は自分の… 組織を率いているの、とでも言っておくわ。
The Cursed One#321.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#323.src: The Roughworks is the region directly to the south of here, just past the wall. Officially, it's known as the {p}.
The Cursed One#323.dst: Roughworks はここの真南、壁のすぐ向こうの地域よ。正式には {p} と呼ばれているわ。
The Cursed One#323.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#324.src: I can fill you in on it later. This isn't the place for it.
The Cursed One#324.dst: 詳しくは後で話すわ。ここで話すことじゃない。
The Cursed One#324.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#325.src: ...ahem. Should we get back to it then?
The Cursed One#325.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#326.src: We should. {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#326.dst: そうね。{u}、屋台を見て回って、また後で来て。
The Cursed One#326.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#327.src: {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#327.dst: {u}、屋台を見て回って、また後で来て。
The Cursed One#327.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#329.src: You're here visiting too I see!
The Cursed One#329.dst: あなたも観光に来たのね！
The Cursed One#329.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#330.src: I plan on touring the whole festival this year around. Next up for me is the {p}!
The Cursed One#330.dst: 今年は祭りを全部回るつもりなの。次は {p} よ！
The Cursed One#330.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#331.src: But the Auburn festival is known for the best food and beverages around the province. Trust me! Those rumours are true.
The Cursed One#331.dst: でも Auburn の祭りは、地方で一番おいしい料理と飲み物で有名なの。本当よ！噂は本当だった。
The Cursed One#331.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#332.src: Will that be enough boar meat, ma'am?
The Cursed One#332.dst: イノシシ肉、これで足りますか？
The Cursed One#332.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#333.src: Yes, dear. Thank you for always being so kind-hearted, helping us out each and every year.
The Cursed One#333.dst: ええ、ありがとうね。毎年毎年手伝ってくれて、本当に優しい子だよ。
The Cursed One#333.speaker: Food Merchant

The Cursed One#334.src: No worries, Oya! Hope you sell... oh. It's you.
The Cursed One#334.dst: いいって、Oya！よく売れると… あ。あんたか。
The Cursed One#334.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#337.src: Huh? I'm just here with a delivery. Nothing much.
The Cursed One#337.dst: は？配達に来ただけ。大したことじゃない。
The Cursed One#337.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#338.dst: …ったく、なんで相手してんだろ？！
The Cursed One#338.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#339.src: Just cause you've got everyone else wrapped around your finger, doesn't mean I have to be fine with you!
The Cursed One#339.dst: みんなを手玉に取ってるからって、あたしまであんたを認めなきゃいけないわけじゃない！
The Cursed One#339.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#340.src: Everything was fine until you showed up. I- I- I'd gotten over it! I made a home here, and now- and now, you
The Cursed One#340.dst: あんたが来るまで全部うまくいってた。あ、あ、あたしは乗り越えたんだ！ここを家にしたのに、今― 今、あんたが
The Cursed One#340.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#341.src: And- and sure, I'm happy for Zeph, but your- your- your everything, it's got Syndra plotting, and- and we were safe, and you've ruined that.
The Cursed One#341.dst: そりゃ― そりゃ Zeph のことはよかったと思うよ、でもあんたの― あんたの― 何もかもが Syndra に企みを抱かせて、あたしたち安全だったのに、あんたが台無しにした。
The Cursed One#341.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#342.src: So... so, no, I don't have to be okay with you. I don't trust you, I don't trust where you're from, and I definitely don't trust your... your c
The Cursed One#342.dst: だから… だから、あんたを認める必要なんてない。あんたも、あんたの出身も信用しないし、特にあんたの… あんたの呪
The Cursed One#342.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#345.src: Have you seen an- any- anyone else yet?
The Cursed One#345.dst: ほ、他のみんなにはもう会った？
The Cursed One#345.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#346.src: I was, um, looking for Mora... earlier. I, ah, didn't find him.
The Cursed One#346.dst: 私、えっと、さっき Mora を探してて… あ、見つからなかった。
The Cursed One#346.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#347.src: We, uh, s- saw Rex run past just a bit ago. Did s- so- something happen?
The Cursed One#347.dst: ぼ、僕らさっき Rex が走っていくのを見たんだ。な、何かあったの？
The Cursed One#347.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#348.src: I can... um, take a guess.
The Cursed One#348.dst: その… えっと、見当はつくかな。
The Cursed One#348.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#349.src: An- anyway, how are you liking the f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#349.dst: と、ともかく、ま、祭りはどう？
The Cursed One#349.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#350.src: Hey, th- that's good to hear!
The Cursed One#350.dst: へえ、そ、それはよかった！
The Cursed One#350.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#351.src: Have you, um, had the chance to, to taste any of the food? From the... food stall?
The Cursed One#351.dst: えっと、もう食べ物は食べた？その… 屋台の？
The Cursed One#351.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#352.src: Hahaha, as if th- th- there's any left after y- you- you ate so much!
The Cursed One#352.dst: あはは、き、君があれだけ食べた後に残ってるわけないよ！
The Cursed One#352.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#353.src: Okay... well, I, I was hungry! That's... not my fault.
The Cursed One#353.dst: だって… お、お腹空いてたんだもん！それは… 私のせいじゃない。
The Cursed One#353.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#354.src: Oh... finally, someone else who, um, who gets it.
The Cursed One#354.dst: あ… やっと、えっと、分かってくれる人がいた。
The Cursed One#354.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#355.src: Wh- wh- what?! Sui, you don't like the f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#355.dst: な、な、何だって？！Sui、ま、祭りが好きじゃないの？
The Cursed One#355.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#356.src: I- I didn't, say that. It's just... a little boring. There's, um, not much to do.
The Cursed One#356.dst: そ、そんなこと、言ってない。ただ… ちょっと退屈なだけ。えっと、やることがあんまりなくて。
The Cursed One#356.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#357.src: There's good f- food, fun rides a- and- and games... okay, m- maybe except the Mudkin g- game...
The Cursed One#357.dst: おいしいた、食べ物に、楽しい乗り物に、ゲ、ゲームも… ま、まあ Mudkin のゲ、ゲームは別だけど…
The Cursed One#357.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#358.src: Why don't you, um, like the Mudkins? I... I think they're fun.
The Cursed One#358.dst: どうして、えっと、Mudkin が嫌いなの？私は… 楽しいと思うけど。
The Cursed One#358.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#359.src: They're s- s- so- there's no strategy! You j- just pick a random one, and- a- and sometimes you win!
The Cursed One#359.dst: あれはさ、さ― 作戦がないんだ！適当にえ、選ぶだけで、と、時々勝つんだよ！
The Cursed One#359.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#360.dst: えっと… うん？それで？
The Cursed One#360.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#361.src: Unbelievable. {u}, a- a- are you hearing this?
The Cursed One#361.dst: 信じられない。{u}、い、い、今の聞いた？
The Cursed One#361.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#362.src: Okay, wh- whatever... Sui, let's go t- try out the zipline. I wonder if th- th- they changed it this year.
The Cursed One#362.dst: もう、い、いいよ… Sui、ジップラインに乗りに行こう。こ、今年は変わったかな。
The Cursed One#362.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#363.src: ...could we, um, get food first? I'm hungry.
The Cursed One#363.dst: …えっと、先に何か食べていい？お腹空いた。
The Cursed One#363.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#364.src: A- ag- again?! No, we should do the z- z- zipline first. I don't want you th- thr- throwing up all over me.
The Cursed One#364.dst: ま、また？！だめ、先にジ、ジップラインだ。ぼ、僕の上に吐かれたくないし。
The Cursed One#364.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#366.src: You kn- know I'm right! Oh, uh, {u}, you can j- j- join us if you want! It's fun, I pr- promise.
The Cursed One#366.dst: ぼ、僕が正しいって分かってるくせに！あ、えっと、{u}、よかったらき、君もおいでよ！楽しいよ、や、約束する。
The Cursed One#366.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#367.dst: この音楽、ほんとに大好き。
The Cursed One#367.speaker: Festival Goer

The Cursed One#368.src: The {p} orchestra is definitely the best in all of Fruma! Well, not that I've heard any other orchestras.
The Cursed One#368.dst: {p} の楽団は間違いなく Fruma 一だよ！まあ、他の楽団は聞いたことないけど。
The Cursed One#368.speaker: Festival Goer

The Cursed One#369.src: Aha! Hello there, {u}! Enjoying our festival, are you?
The Cursed One#369.dst: おお！これは {u}！祭りを楽しんでいますか？
The Cursed One#369.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#370.src: I trust you and Zeph have acquired all the necessary materials in the time since we last spoke?
The Cursed One#370.dst: 前にお話ししてから、Zeph と必要な素材はすべてそろえたのでしょうね？
The Cursed One#370.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#371.src: As soon as the festival concludes, I shall get right to smithing. I have a good feeling about this one!
The Cursed One#371.dst: 祭りが終わり次第、すぐに鍛冶に取りかかります。今回はいい予感がしますよ！
The Cursed One#371.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#372.src: I, ah... am still learning. But I have greatly improved since I started, worry not!
The Cursed One#372.dst: 私も、その… まだ修行中の身でして。ですが始めた頃よりずっと上達しました、ご心配なく！
The Cursed One#372.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#373.src: ...ehm. I suppose I should return to my report...
The Cursed One#373.dst: …コホン。そろそろ記録に戻らねば…
The Cursed One#373.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#374.src: Hm? Ah, yes, I forget this is your first year. First week, even.
The Cursed One#374.dst: ん？ああ、そうでした、あなたは今年が初めてでしたね。いや、まだ一週目でしたか。
The Cursed One#374.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#375.src: I am... gathering data. Recording the changes since last year's festival guard positioning and numbers, types of stands, amount of attendees and so on.
The Cursed One#375.dst: 私は… データを集めているのです。去年の祭りからの変化― 衛兵の配置と数、屋台の種類、来場者数などを記録しています。
The Cursed One#375.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#376.src: It is... perhaps unnecessarily thorough. Much of this data has not proven to be useful thus far... but it is something for me to do, and I do it well.
The Cursed One#376.dst: これは… 必要以上に綿密かもしれません。今のところ大半は役に立っていませんが… 私にできて、得意なことですから。
The Cursed One#376.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#377.src: These festivals... I suppose our discomfort is something Syndra and I share. It can be hard for us to enjoy ourselves, knowing what we do.
The Cursed One#377.dst: この祭りは… 居心地の悪さは Syndra と私に共通するものかもしれません。知っていることを思えば、楽しむのは難しい。
The Cursed One#377.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#378.src: I am grateful that the younger Leaves can still find joy here. Perhaps you might as well, given your... relative lack of history.
The Cursed One#378.dst: 若い葉たちがここでまだ喜びを見出せるのはありがたい。あなたも楽しめるかもしれませんね、その… 過去のしがらみが比較的ないのですから。
The Cursed One#378.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#379.src: Ah, but I am rambling. If you will excuse me, I need to get back to... counting all the new food items... hm.
The Cursed One#379.dst: おっと、また長話を。失礼、私は戻らねば… 新しい食べ物を全部数えに… ふむ。
The Cursed One#379.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#380.src: Welcome. Can I interest you in buying anything?
The Cursed One#380.dst: いらっしゃいませ。何かお求めですか？
The Cursed One#380.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#381.src: Perhaps you would like to hear what we have to offer?
The Cursed One#381.dst: よろしければ、品書きをお聞きになりますか？
The Cursed One#381.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#383.src: We are selling both the raw ingredients and some freshly brewed tea.
The Cursed One#383.dst: 生の素材と、淹れたてのお茶の両方をご用意しています。
The Cursed One#383.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#384.src: Let me bring you on a history lesson to learn about the finest ingredients the forest has to offer.
The Cursed One#384.dst: 森が誇る最高の素材について、歴史のお話をいたしましょう。
The Cursed One#384.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#385.src: Tea is very popular in Auburn and the people have managed to make tea out of almost any plant you can find! Some are... more tasty than others.
The Cursed One#385.dst: Auburn ではお茶がとても人気で、人々は見つかるほとんどの植物をお茶にしてきました！中には… 他よりおいしいものも。
The Cursed One#385.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#386.src: The Reishi Mushroom for example! Brewing tea of the mushroom alone often turns... bitter. With the help of herbs and spices it goes from a bitter to a rich spicy flavour!
The Cursed One#386.dst: たとえば霊芝！このキノコだけで淹れると、たいてい… 苦くなります。ハーブと香辛料を加えれば、苦味が濃厚でスパイシーな味わいに変わるのです！
The Cursed One#386.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#387.src: The mushroom itself is said to keep you healthy. It is also said to boost your resistances!
The Cursed One#387.dst: このキノコ自体に健康を保つ効果があるそうです。抵抗力を高めるとも言われていますよ！
The Cursed One#387.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#388.src: The Tea Tree Mushroom on the other hand is perfect for a good tea blend. The mushroom alone gives it a sweet and earthy flavour.
The Cursed One#388.dst: 一方、茶樹茸はブレンドにぴったり。このキノコだけで、甘く土の香りのする風味になります。
The Cursed One#388.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#389.src: The mushroom is also said to regenerate you back to health and alleviate the feeling of tiredness! How amazing.
The Cursed One#389.dst: このキノコは体力を回復させ、疲れを和らげるとも言われています！素晴らしいでしょう。
The Cursed One#389.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#390.src: If you feel like buying something, please talk to my assistant.
The Cursed One#390.dst: 何かお求めでしたら、助手にお声がけください。
The Cursed One#390.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#391.dst: かしこまりました！お楽しみください。
The Cursed One#391.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#392.dst: *ヒック* よう、らっしゃい！
The Cursed One#392.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#393.src: It's festival time! *hic* that means... drinking time!!!
The Cursed One#393.dst: 祭りの時間だ！*ヒック* つまり… 飲む時間だ！！！
The Cursed One#393.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#394.src: Inteeeerested in any of our mouth-watering beverages?
The Cursed One#394.dst: 口がとろけそうな飲み物に、きょーみあるかい？
The Cursed One#394.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#396.src: *Hic* Todaaaay, we have a couple of imported drinks as well as our classic Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#396.dst: *ヒック* きょーうは、輸入酒がいくつかと、うちの定番「秋のアマレット」があるよ。
The Cursed One#396.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#397.src: Seen them blue fruits in the trees around here? Most of 'em are inedible Liffberries, buuut, some of 'em are actually a more edible fruit called Autumn Fruit, which carry a high value!
The Cursed One#397.dst: この辺の木になってる青い実、見たかい？ほとんどは食べられない Liff ベリーだけど、なーかには秋の果実っていう食べられる実もあって、高く売れるんだ！
The Cursed One#397.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#398.src: The Amaretto is made from Autumn Fruit kernels! We have aaaalso mixed in some Liff Leaves which *hic* gives it its warm colour and slightly bitter and metallic taste.
The Cursed One#398.dst: アマレットは秋の果実の種から作るんだ！それにぃ Liff の葉も混ぜてあってね、*ヒック* それがあったかい色と、ちょっぴり苦くて金属っぽい味になるのさ。
The Cursed One#398.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#399.dst: 酒造りってきょーみ深いだろ *ヒック*！
The Cursed One#399.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#400.src: We have also imported the faaaamed Heather Beer from the rich highlands.
The Cursed One#400.dst: それから、豊かな高地から取り寄せた、かのゆうめーいな Heather Beer もあるよ。
The Cursed One#400.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#401.src: A beer infused with the most beautiful heather grown across the highlands. *hic* You can almost taste the richness of the aristocrats.
The Cursed One#401.dst: 高地じゅうに咲く一番きれいなヘザーを漬け込んだビールさ。*ヒック* 貴族の贅沢な味がしそうだろ。
The Cursed One#401.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#402.src: *hic* If I were you, I would deeefinitely try this drink. Stuff like this doesn't come to Auburn often.
The Cursed One#402.dst: *ヒック* 俺があんたなら、ぜーったいこいつを試すね。こういうのは Auburn にはめったに来ないんだ。
The Cursed One#402.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#403.src: If you feel like blessing your taste buds, talk to my brother over there. *hic*
The Cursed One#403.dst: 舌に祝福を授けたいなら、あっちの兄弟に言ってくれ。*ヒック*
The Cursed One#403.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#405.dst: いらっしゃい。小腹がすいたかい？
The Cursed One#405.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#406.src: We have freshly cooked and baked regional goods.
The Cursed One#406.dst: できたての煮物や焼き物、地元の品がそろってるよ。
The Cursed One#406.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#407.src: Would you like to hear about our menu, dear?
The Cursed One#407.dst: 献立の話を聞いてくかい？
The Cursed One#407.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#408.src: Just perfect! Auburn is famous for their bold, earthy and cosy flavours!
The Cursed One#408.dst: いいねえ！Auburn は力強くて素朴で、ほっとする味で有名なんだよ！
The Cursed One#408.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#409.src: We also love to cook using our wild animals and resources, but I'm sure you already know all of this, haha.
The Cursed One#409.dst: 野生の動物や森の恵みを使った料理も大好きでね。まあ、あんたももう知ってるだろうけど、ははは。
The Cursed One#409.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#410.src: Let me go over some of our special dishes for today, dear.
The Cursed One#410.dst: 今日の特別料理をいくつか紹介しようかね。
The Cursed One#410.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#411.src: The most important dish in Auburn, is of course the "Gift of the Forest". A wonderful meat and fruit mixture inside a steamed leaf wrap.
The Cursed One#411.dst: Auburn で一番大事な料理といえば、もちろん「森の恵み」。肉と果実を混ぜて、蒸した葉で包んだ絶品さ。
The Cursed One#411.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#412.src: We have hand wrapped all of our gifts this morning and they are steamed to go!
The Cursed One#412.dst: 今朝ぜんぶ手で包んだから、蒸したてを持ち帰れるよ！
The Cursed One#412.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#413.src: If that doesn't interest you, we also have the classic "Forest Feast". A grilled piece of boar meat with a mud-kin salad.
The Cursed One#413.dst: それが気に入らなきゃ、定番の「森のごちそう」もあるよ。イノシシ肉のグリルに Mudkin サラダ添えさ。
The Cursed One#413.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#414.src: I'm afraid we have run out of ingredients at the moment. Please come back later!
The Cursed One#414.dst: あいにく今は材料を切らしちまってね。また後で来ておくれ！
The Cursed One#414.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#416.src: Hey! You look like a tourist to me!
The Cursed One#416.dst: やあ！君、観光客っぽいね！
The Cursed One#416.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#417.src: I'm glad you decided to check out my little exhibition here.
The Cursed One#417.dst: 僕のささやかな展示を見に来てくれてうれしいよ。
The Cursed One#417.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#418.src: Is it your first time in this part of the region? Would you perhaps want to hear some fun facts about our animals?
The Cursed One#418.dst: この辺りは初めてかい？うちの動物たちの面白い豆知識、聞いていくかい？
The Cursed One#418.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#420.src: First we have our Roly-bugs here! These little buggers are a pest to the people here.
The Cursed One#420.dst: まずはこの Roly 虫！このちびすけたちは、ここの人々にとって厄介者なんだ。
The Cursed One#420.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#421.src: They love gnawing on our houses. Luckily, we built most of our structures on stilts aaaand those bugs can't climb.
The Cursed One#421.dst: 家をかじるのが大好きでね。幸い建物はほとんど高床にしてあって、しかーもこいつらは登れないんだ。
The Cursed One#421.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#422.src: Now! Frogs! The north-western bog is the best place for frog-watching. Just be careful of the bog monster.
The Cursed One#422.dst: お次は！カエル！北西の沼地がカエル観察には一番。沼の怪物にだけは気をつけて。
The Cursed One#422.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#423.src: Frogs might be a good source of food but we like to see them more as... pets!
The Cursed One#423.dst: カエルは食料にもなるけど、僕らはむしろ… ペットとして見たいんだ！
The Cursed One#423.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#424.src: Lastly, we have foxes! These little cuties are very shy in nature. But beware, there are bigger versions of them, known as Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#424.dst: 最後はキツネ！このかわいい子たちは生まれつきとても臆病なんだ。でも気をつけて、フォックスハウンドという大型の仲間もいるからね。
The Cursed One#424.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#425.src: Those are not as shy... or peaceful, as their smaller cousins. They are just as cute though!
The Cursed One#425.dst: あっちは小さないとこほど臆病でも… 穏やかでもない。かわいさは同じだけどね！
The Cursed One#425.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#426.src: Please have a looksie around! You can also pet them.
The Cursed One#426.dst: ゆっくり見ていってね！なでてもいいよ。
The Cursed One#426.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#428.src: Howdy and welcome to a mudkin farm!
The Cursed One#428.dst: よう、Mudkin 農場へようこそ！
The Cursed One#428.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#429.src: Mudkins are popular vegetables in food around here. They grow underground and you have to yoikn em' out!
The Cursed One#429.dst: Mudkin はこの辺の料理じゃ人気の野菜さ。土の中で育つから、引っこ抜かにゃならん！
The Cursed One#429.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#430.src: Are ya interested in a game of Mudkin Picking?
The Cursed One#430.dst: 「Mudkin 引き」ゲームをやってくかい？
The Cursed One#430.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#431.src: Basically, ye goal is to get as many points as possible before the time runs out.
The Cursed One#431.dst: 要するに、時間切れまでにできるだけ多く点を取るのが目標だ。
The Cursed One#431.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#432.src: There are three sizes of Mudkins, each size gives a set of points. However! There are two ginger roots that give negative points.
The Cursed One#432.dst: Mudkin は大きさが三種類で、それぞれ点数が決まっとる。ただし！マイナス点になるショウガの根が二つあるぞ。
The Cursed One#432.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#433.src: Simply click on the dirt particles appearing in the field. There are five spots for ya to pick.
The Cursed One#433.dst: 畑に出てくる土の粒をクリックするだけだ。引っこ抜ける場所は五か所ある。
The Cursed One#433.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#436.src: Return to Syndra at or keep exploring the festival.
The Cursed One#436.dst: Syndra のもとへ戻るか、祭りの見物を続ける。

The Cursed One#437.src: Ah. There you are. Have you been enjoying yourself?
The Cursed One#437.dst: あら。そこにいたのね。楽しんでる？
The Cursed One#437.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#439.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.**
The Cursed One#439.dst: 祭りは王家が中心だけど、私たちの文化を表しているところは昔から好きなの。
The Cursed One#439.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#440.src: I hope your experience with the crown has not ruined your perception of our province... there are still many things to celebrate.
The Cursed One#440.dst: 王家とのいきさつで、この地方への印象が台無しになっていないといいけど… 祝うべきものはまだたくさんあるの。
The Cursed One#440.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#441.src: Sometimes, it can be nice to set aside your woes, and... take things as they are. Breathe, a little.
The Cursed One#441.dst: 時には悩みを脇に置いて… ありのままを受け入れるのもいいものよ。少し、息をついて。
The Cursed One#441.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#442.dst: 何もないよりはまし、かしらね。
The Cursed One#442.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#443.src: It's hard to enjoy yourself with your experiences with the crown weighing you down, isn't it? I know the feeling.
The Cursed One#443.dst: 王家との経験がのしかかっていると、楽しむのは難しいでしょう？その気持ちは分かるわ。
The Cursed One#443.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#444.src: Mmn. I'd suggest to take what you can get. Happy moments like this can be fleeting, in my experience.
The Cursed One#444.dst: うん。手に入るものは受け取っておくことね。私の経験では、こういう幸せな時はすぐに過ぎ去るから。
The Cursed One#444.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#445.src: If there's even the smallest spark of joy... take hold of it before it's gone. Cherish it while you still can. Try not to grow old and jaded like I have, would you?
The Cursed One#445.dst: ほんの小さな喜びの火花でもあったら… 消える前につかまえて。大切にできるうちに大切にして。私みたいに老けてすれてしまわないようにね？
The Cursed One#445.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#446.src: Ha! It's alright. Neither have I.
The Cursed One#446.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#447.src: Every year... every single year, the crown hosts these festivals. Starting here, and moving around in a ring around the province.
The Cursed One#447.dst: 毎年… 毎年欠かさず、王家はこの祭りを開くの。ここから始まって、地方をぐるりと一周するのよ。
The Cursed One#447.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#448.src: The festival's a holiday, a day of rest, of celebration. What a gift it is, not needing to work for a time! How generous.
The Cursed One#448.dst: 祭りは休日、休息と祝いの日。しばらく働かなくていいなんて、なんという恵みでしょう！なんと寛大な。
The Cursed One#448.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#449.src: I can't stand it here... Every year, I convince myself I can bear it. The reminder it brings, of memories long passed. Every year, I'm proven wrong.
The Cursed One#449.dst: ここは耐えられない… 毎年、耐えられると自分に言い聞かせる。遠い記憶を呼び起こされても。そして毎年、間違いだと思い知るの。
The Cursed One#449.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#450.src: ...Ah. It's time. The main event is about to begin.
The Cursed One#450.dst: …ああ。時間ね。メインイベントが始まるわ。
The Cursed One#450.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#451.src: Why, Her Majesty's annual speech, of course! It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown if she didn't make an appearance, would it?
The Cursed One#451.dst: もちろん、女王陛下の毎年恒例の演説よ！陛下がお出ましにならなきゃ、王冠祭とは言えないでしょう？
The Cursed One#451.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#452.src: Ha! No, no. Of course not. It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown without a speech from Her Majesty herself, would it?
The Cursed One#452.dst: はは！いえ、いえ。もちろん違うわ。女王陛下ご本人の演説なしに、王冠祭とは言えないでしょう？
The Cursed One#452.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#453.src: Now... observe. Behold our enemy, take note of how she presents herself, what she says, what she doesn't say.
The Cursed One#453.dst: さあ… 見ていて。敵をよく見るの。どう振る舞い、何を言い、何を言わないのか。
The Cursed One#453.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#454.src: Ah... beloved people of the {p}! What a joy, what an honor it is to stand amongst you once again.
The Cursed One#454.dst: ああ… 愛する {p} の民よ！再び皆の中に立てるとは、なんという喜び、なんという光栄でしょう。
The Cursed One#454.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#455.src: Some will claim the stunning {p} to be our most beautiful region, with its vibrant blossoming trees and grand historic castles...
The Cursed One#455.dst: 見事な {p} こそ最も美しい地域だと言う者もいるでしょう。咲き誇る木々と壮大な歴史ある城を持つ地だと…
The Cursed One#455.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#456.src: But I've always held a special regard for this place. The leaves and their warm shades, blowing in the soft breeze... all the woes of the world would be worth this sight.
The Cursed One#456.dst: ですが、わたくしはこの地に特別な思いを抱いてきました。暖かな色の葉が、そよ風に揺れる… 世のあらゆる憂いも、この眺めのためなら惜しくありません。
The Cursed One#456.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#457.src: If I were able, perhaps I could stay here year-round! Ah, but alas... work in the Citadel keeps us all occupied!
The Cursed One#457.dst: できることなら一年中ここにいたいほど！ああ、ですが… 城塞での務めが皆を忙しくさせるのです！
The Cursed One#457.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#458.src: We have many plans for the coming year. Increased imports from the other regions, easier access to travel for all, and additional openings in military positions!
The Cursed One#458.dst: 来年に向けて多くの計画があります。他地域からの輸入の拡大、誰もがより旅しやすくすること、そして軍の職のさらなる募集です！
The Cursed One#458.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#459.src: More will be revealed soon. Now, some words from your beloved Sovereign.
The Cursed One#459.dst: 詳しくは近く発表します。では、皆の敬愛する君主から一言を。
The Cursed One#459.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#460.src: ...ah. The one thing I miscalculated. The mic height. Oh well- Testing, testing, one two three...
The Cursed One#460.dst: …ああ。唯一の計算違いだ。マイクの高さ。まあいい― テスト、テスト、ワン、ツー、スリー…
The Cursed One#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#461.src: Welcome one and all! I'm your Sovereign, Zhiraok. It's an honor to be here before you all again today.
The Cursed One#461.dst: ようこそ、皆さん！君主の Zhiraok だ。今日再び皆さんの前に立てて光栄だよ。
The Cursed One#461.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#462.src: Two decades of work in the {p}. Twenty years. It feels like I've been here for so much longer this place, these people, really have become my home.
The Cursed One#462.dst: {p} で二十年働いてきた。二十年だ。もっと長くいる気がする― この地、この人々は、本当に私の故郷になった。
The Cursed One#462.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#463.src: My duty is not just to serve the Crown, but also to serve you. To make your lives better, to raise this region we live in to new heights.
The Cursed One#463.dst: 私の務めは王家に仕えるだけでなく、皆さんに仕えることでもある。暮らしを良くし、この地域を新たな高みへ押し上げることだ。
The Cursed One#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#464.src: Whether that's by increasing production of Liff Leaves to share our resources and knowledge the province over, which we owe to your hard work...
The Cursed One#464.dst: 皆さんの勤勉さのおかげで Liff の葉の生産を増やし、資源と知識を地方全体に分かち合うことであれ…
The Cursed One#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#465.src: ...or through sharpening our infrastructure to exponentiate your quality of life, in thanks for what you do!
The Cursed One#465.dst: …あるいは基盤を磨き上げ、皆さんの働きへの感謝として、生活の質を指数関数的に高めることであれ！
The Cursed One#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#466.src: I'd be here all day listing the improvements over the last year, but I'll summarize Multiple major road improvements, countless new job opportunities, multiplying guard patrols to keep you safe...
The Cursed One#466.dst: この一年の改善を並べたら一日かかるので、まとめよう― 主要道路の数々の改修、無数の新たな雇用、皆さんの安全を守る衛兵巡回の倍増…
The Cursed One#466.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#467.src: The place we came from twenty years ago is unrecognizable now. My vow is that twenty years ahead, I can say the same thing for how much more we, together, improve our home.
The Cursed One#467.dst: 二十年前の出発点は、今や見る影もない。私の誓いは、二十年後にも、皆で共にこの故郷をどれだけ良くしたかを同じように語れることだ。
The Cursed One#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#468.src: 'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p} Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
The Cursed One#468.dst: {p} の壮大さに総和が届くその日まで― ありがとう！祭りを楽しんでくれ！
The Cursed One#468.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#469.src: What fine work Sovereign Zhiraok has done for our province! Truly, there could have been no better choice to fill that role!
The Cursed One#469.dst: 君主 Zhiraokは地方のためになんと見事な働きをしたことでしょう！その役にこれ以上の人選はなかったでしょう！
The Cursed One#469.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#470.src: The {p} flourishes under his governance, and I could not be more pleased by the progress he has made.
The Cursed One#470.dst: {p} は彼の統治のもとで栄え、その成果にわたくしはこの上なく満足しています。
The Cursed One#470.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#471.src: One final message before we conclude. These past years, we have seen fewer and fewer reports of the cursed - a sign of our strength as a people.
The Cursed One#471.dst: 最後にひとつ。ここ数年、呪われし者の報告はどんどん減っています― 民としての我らの強さの証です。
The Cursed One#471.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#472.src: And it is all thanks to you! Your diligent reporting of suspicious activity makes all the difference in keeping our province safe.
The Cursed One#472.dst: それもすべて皆のおかげ！怪しい動きを熱心に報告してくれることが、地方の安全を守る決め手なのです。
The Cursed One#472.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#473.src: We must stand strong, together! We will not allow this evil its victory, we will not let our province fall like so many others have beyond our walls!
The Cursed One#473.dst: 共に強く立たねばなりません！この悪に勝利は許さない。壁の外の多くの地のように、この地方を陥落させはしません！
The Cursed One#473.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#474.src: With that, let the celebrations begin!
The Cursed One#474.dst: それでは、祝宴を始めましょう！
The Cursed One#474.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#475.dst: ふむ… いつも通りね。
The Cursed One#475.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#476.src: Did anything stand out to you?
The Cursed One#476.dst: 何か気になったことは？
The Cursed One#476.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#477.src: Indeed, it is. It's quite puzzling, isn't it? It's a sort of reverence she never displays elsewhere.
The Cursed One#477.dst: そうね。不思議でしょう？ほかでは決して見せない敬意のようなものよ。
The Cursed One#477.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#478.src: And if there's one thing I'm certain she's being truthful about, it's this. Which only makes it all the stranger.
The Cursed One#478.dst: それに、彼女が本心を言っていると確信できることがあるとしたら、それよ。だからこそ余計に奇妙なの。
The Cursed One#478.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#479.src: Yes, yes... improvements. Life has improved since he ascended to that position. I'll give him that. He's invested in Auburn.
The Cursed One#479.dst: ええ、ええ… 改善ね。彼があの地位に就いてから暮らしは良くなった。それは認めるわ。彼は Auburn に本気で向き合っている。
The Cursed One#479.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#480.src: But he is still working under the crown. Don't forget that. For every improvement he has made, there's another he has left ignored.
The Cursed One#480.dst: でも、あくまで王家の下で働いているの。忘れないで。彼が一つ改善するたびに、放置されたものがもう一つあるのよ。
The Cursed One#480.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#481.src: No, I suppose they wouldn't. Better to leave the public unaware of such failures.
The Cursed One#481.dst: いいえ、言わないでしょうね。そんな失敗は民に知らせないほうが都合がいいもの。
The Cursed One#481.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#482.src: But rest assured that internally, they have not forgotten. They will keep searching for you.
The Cursed One#482.dst: でも安心して、内部では忘れていない。あなたを探し続けるわ。
The Cursed One#482.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#483.src: Yes... the cursed. The crown needs to keep the people afraid. If there's another enemy out there that the crown supposedly protects them from...
The Cursed One#483.dst: ええ… 呪われし者。王家は民を怯えさせておく必要があるの。王家が守ってくれるという敵が他にもいるなら…
The Cursed One#483.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#484.src: There's a reason they want people to believe the outside world is destroyed. Any contact could break the illusion.
The Cursed One#484.dst: 外の世界が滅びたと民に信じさせたいのには理由がある。どんな接触でも幻想が崩れかねないから。
The Cursed One#484.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#485.src: They'll be closing out the festival soon... so, our work here is done. We should be leaving before the crowd thins enough for us to be spotted.
The Cursed One#485.dst: もうすぐ祭りも締めくくりね… 私たちの用は済んだ。人が減って見つかる前に引き上げましょう。
The Cursed One#485.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#486.src: I've scheduled a meeting for tomorrow I'd like for you to attend. It'll be about our next steps, now that the crown has moved on. I'll see you there.
The Cursed One#486.dst: 明日集会を開くから、あなたにも出てほしいの。王家が去った今、次の手についての話よ。そこで会いましょう。
The Cursed One#486.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#488.src: I think I've had just about enough of people sneaking into my office. Care to knock next time?
The Cursed One#488.dst: 執務室に忍び込まれるのはもううんざりだ。次はノックしてくれないか？
The Cursed One#488.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#489.src: Mmn. It's more interesting this way. I have news from the capital - your request for additional troops has been granted. Reassignments should come through by the end of the week.
The Cursed One#489.dst: ふむ。このほうが面白い。首都から知らせだ― 増援の要請が承認された。配置換えは週末までに届くはずだ。

The Cursed One#490.src: Well, that'll solve some problems. But that's not the whole message, is it? What obtuse remark has he got for me this time?
The Cursed One#490.dst: ほう、それでいくつか問題が解ける。だが伝言はそれだけじゃないだろう？今回はどんな鈍角な嫌味を寄こした？
The Cursed One#490.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#491.src: Merely a reminder to... "get your act together," as it were.
The Cursed One#491.dst: 単なる念押しだ… 彼の言葉を借りれば「しっかりしろ」とな。

The Cursed One#492.src: Get my act toge That floundering fractal's developed less in his quadrant in a hundred-fifty years than I've done in two, in the last ten!
The Cursed One#492.dst: しっかりし― あのもがくフラクタルめ、自分の象限で百五十年かけた分より、私がこの十年のうち二年でやった分のほうが多いぞ！
The Cursed One#492.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#493.src: I Ugh, focus, Z... He's not even here, don't let him get under your skin...
The Cursed One#493.dst: 私は― くっ、集中しろ、Z… 奴はここにいない、挑発に乗るな…
The Cursed One#493.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#494.src: I'll get off that tangent. If that was all you had to say, it'd be a waste of your time. What do you need to say that a courier can't send in a letter?
The Cursed One#494.dst: 接線から戻ろう。言いたいことがそれだけなら、君の時間の無駄だ。伝令の手紙では送れない話とは何だ？
The Cursed One#494.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#495.src: The intruder. Does your administration believe it can get the situation under control?
The Cursed One#495.dst: 侵入者だ。君の行政は事態を収拾できると考えているのか？

The Cursed One#496.src: There it is. Listen, I've got their number, alright? There's no way in or out of the district where they won't be detected. We'll track them down.
The Cursed One#496.dst: やはりそれか。いいか、奴の数は割れている。この地区に、探知されずに出入りできる道はない。必ず追い詰める。
The Cursed One#496.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#497.src: Though unlike some people, my ego isn't so massive I can't recognize when an ally can be of use. Your types have an expertise here, so if you could spare a set or two of eyes it'd be much appreciated.
The Cursed One#497.dst: だが誰かさんと違って、味方が役立つ時を見抜けないほど自尊心は大きくない。君の同類はこの手の専門家だ。目を一組か二組貸してもらえるとありがたい。
The Cursed One#497.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#498.src: I'll see what I can do. There happens to be an ongoing operation in the area already, we can discuss redirecting the agent once it's concluded.
The Cursed One#498.dst: 考えておこう。ちょうどこの一帯で進行中の作戦がある。それが片付いたら、その工作員を回す相談をしよう。

The Cursed One#499.src: One last thing- the identity of the intruder has been made clear to you already, yes?
The Cursed One#499.dst: 最後に一つ― 侵入者の正体は、すでに君に明かされているな？

The Cursed One#500.src: Mhm. Like I said, I've got their number.
The Cursed One#500.dst: ああ。言っただろう、奴の数は割れている。
The Cursed One#500.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#501.src: Then you will understand Her Majesty's order not to speak of this ordeal to our newest. Ascension is a difficult process, and it would be... unwise to add additional distractions to it.
The Cursed One#501.dst: ならば、この件を我らの新入りに話すなという女王陛下の命令も分かるだろう。昇華は困難な過程だ。余計な気を散らすのは… 賢明ではない。

The Cursed One#502.src: Wouldn't want to distract a hard worker like him, right. But if that's everything, Spymaster? My to-do list is getting more added by the minute.
The Cursed One#502.dst: 彼みたいな働き者の気を散らしたくはないな、確かに。だが話はそれで全部か、密偵長？私のやることリストは刻一刻と増えているんだ。
The Cursed One#502.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#115~1.src: Even more reason to try something new, then! This... magic, as you call it- if indeed it is what you have described, though I still have my doubts-
The Cursed One#115~1.dst: なおさら新しいことを試す理由になります！この…魔法とやら- 本当にあなたの言うとおりのものなら、ですが。まだ疑っていますよ-
The Cursed One#115~1.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#141~1.src: Um... not to interrupt, or, anything, but... I missed the c- magic. Could you... show us some more?
The Cursed One#141~1.dst: えっと…邪魔するつもりは、ないんだけど…の、呪- 魔法を見逃しちゃって。もう少し…見せてくれる？
The Cursed One#141~1.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#313~1.src: I th- think I saw Sui back there, so... I'm gonna go h- ha- hang out with her. You sh- should check out some of the stalls!
The Cursed One#313~1.dst: あ、あっちに Sui がいた気がするから…い、一緒に過ごしてくる。君は屋台でも、み、見てきたら！
The Cursed One#313~1.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#468~1.src: 'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p}- Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
The Cursed One#468~1.dst: 我らが {p} の壮大さに並ぶその日まで- 皆、ありがとう！祭りを楽しんでくれ！
The Cursed One#468~1.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Dark Descent#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Graken 将軍と話す

The Dark Descent#001.src: Ah, hello there chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.
The Dark Descent#001.dst: やあ、君！まさか {p} の古巣の連隊の者にこんな所で会えるとはな。
The Dark Descent#001.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#002.src: I am General Graken, leader of the {p} militia. Charmed to meet you!
The Dark Descent#002.dst: 私は Graken 将軍、{p} 民兵団の長だ。お会いできて光栄だ！
The Dark Descent#002.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#003.src: You've seen all the bloody zombies faffing about everywhere, yes? They're all seeming to come from this massive skull.
The Dark Descent#003.dst: そこら中をうろつくゾンビどもを見ただろう？どうもあの巨大な髑髏から湧いてくるらしい。
The Dark Descent#003.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#004.src: I'm putting together a crack team for an expedition inside, but we haven't got any bleedin' idea what's down there!
The Dark Descent#004.dst: 中を探る精鋭部隊を編成中だが、下に何があるのか皆目見当がつかんのだ！
The Dark Descent#004.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#005.src: If you're up for it, chap, we could absolutely do with some recon 'round the old town, look for clues and the like.
The Dark Descent#005.dst: もし乗り気なら、旧市街を偵察して手がかりを探してくれると大いに助かる。
The Dark Descent#005.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#006.src: I took a gander earlier, and one of the ol' houses caught my eye - it had a bloomin' great skull right over the door!
The Dark Descent#006.dst: さっき覗いてみたら、古い家の一軒が気になってな。扉の上にどでかい髑髏があったんだ！
The Dark Descent#006.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#007.src: I didn't have time to look in proper, but I'd start the investigation there, chap.
The Dark Descent#007.dst: じっくり見る暇はなかったが、調べるならまずそこからだな。
The Dark Descent#007.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#008.src: It's just south of here. The house still had solid wood boarding in it, despite the age, so look lively, chum!
The Dark Descent#008.dst: ここのすぐ南だ。古い家だが板張りはまだ頑丈だ。気を引き締めていけよ！
The Dark Descent#008.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#010.src: Oh, sod it, I knew I was forgetting something! Steady there, chum! I'm on my way!
The Dark Descent#010.dst: しまった、何か忘れていると思ったんだ！踏ん張れ、君！今行くぞ！
The Dark Descent#010.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#011.src: Drat! Too late, it seems. Yes, I forgot to mention the floor was in poor condition. Up here! You took quite the tumble, are you alright?
The Dark Descent#011.dst: くそっ！遅かったか。そう、床が傷んでいると言い忘れていた。上だ！派手に落ちたな、大丈夫か？
The Dark Descent#011.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#012.src: Well, there's some good news, I suppose. Still though, seems I sent you a ticket to a bit of a sticky wicket! Do you see a way out anywhere down there?
The Dark Descent#012.dst: まあ、良い知らせもあるにはある。とはいえ、とんだ窮地に送り込んでしまったな！下に出口は見えるか？
The Dark Descent#012.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#013.src: There's a tunnel? Aha, spiffing! I suggest you take it immediately. I'll have to return to my post now, post-haste!
The Dark Descent#013.dst: トンネルがある？ははっ、上出来だ！すぐにそこを進みたまえ。私は急ぎ持ち場に戻らねばならん！
The Dark Descent#013.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#014.src: Good luck, chum! Now, back, you cads! Back I say!
The Dark Descent#014.dst: 幸運を祈るぞ、君！さあ下がれ、この悪党ども！下がれと言っている！
The Dark Descent#014.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#015.src: Keheh... Come further, little human... Step into the shadows...
The Dark Descent#015.dst: ケヘヘ…もっと奥へおいで、小さな人間…影の中へ…

The Dark Descent#016.src: Explore the tunnel in the basement of the house.
The Dark Descent#016.dst: 家の地下室にあるトンネルを探索する。

The Dark Descent#017.dst: 奇妙な闇の領域を調べる。

The Dark Descent#019.src: Scout! Report your findings, immediately! How many corrupteds are coming?
The Dark Descent#019.dst: 斥候！直ちに報告しろ！腐敗した者はどれだけ来ている？
The Dark Descent#019.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#020.dst: あっちに…多すぎる…す、数千は…少なくとも…
The Dark Descent#020.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#021.src: Thousands...? This is far worse than I expected. Men! Prepare for-
The Dark Descent#021.dst: 数千…？思ったよりずっとひどい。総員！迎撃準備――
The Dark Descent#021.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#022.dst: 無駄だ…俺たちは…もう終わりだ…
The Dark Descent#022.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#023.src: Wait, w-what's going on? What's happening to you?!
The Dark Descent#023.dst: 待て、な、何だ？お前、どうしたんだ？！
The Dark Descent#023.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#024.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace! What did we ever do to deserve this?!
The Dark Descent#024.dst: お願い、やめて！誰だか知らないけど、私と家族を放っておいて！私たちが何をしたっていうの？！
The Dark Descent#024.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#025.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! They have already left this mortal coil...oh, what a shame.
The Dark Descent#025.dst: ああ、もっと早く言ってくれれば！彼らはもうこの世を去ったよ…いや、実に残念だ。

The Dark Descent#026.dst: あ、あなた…家族は…ああ、そんな…
The Dark Descent#026.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#027.src: Hush now. I will ensure that you and your family are reunited. You will even be able to partake in...keheh...family outings, under my watchful eye...
The Dark Descent#027.dst: 静かに。お前と家族は必ず再会させてやろう。私の見守る下で…ケヘヘ…家族でお出かけもできるぞ…

The Dark Descent#028.src: Wha...you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone! I don't want to die!!
The Dark Descent#028.dst: な…それって… い、いや、お願い！誰も傷つけたくない！死にたくない！！
The Dark Descent#028.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#029.src: Aha, naive girl. How cute, you believe you have a choice in the matter. What you want, is not what I need.
The Dark Descent#029.dst: はは、世間知らずの娘だ。選べると思っているとは可愛いものだ。お前の望みなど、私には関係ない。

The Dark Descent#030.dst: ヘヘ…これで分かったか？

The Dark Descent#031.src: Do you see how easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master? And how I could simply dispose of you without a second thought?
The Dark Descent#031.dst: この地がいかに容易く落ちたか分かるか？私がいかに早く支配者となったか？そしてお前など造作もなく始末できることが？

The Dark Descent#032.src: Hundreds slaughtered in mere moments... only to rise again as my soldiers in infinite amounts.
The Dark Descent#032.dst: 数百人が一瞬で虐殺され…無尽蔵の我が兵として蘇ったのだ。

The Dark Descent#033.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think you can enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?
The Dark Descent#033.dst: 地上ですら辛うじて食い止めているのに、私の領域に踏み込み、冥界で私に挑めると思っているのか？

The Dark Descent#034.src: You will fail, and I will be free to string your body up like a puppet and make you dance for me.
The Dark Descent#034.dst: お前は敗れ、私はその体を操り人形のように吊るし、私のために踊らせてやろう。

The Dark Descent#035.src: So enter the mouth of the skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...
The Dark Descent#035.dst: ならば髑髏の口に入れ、兵士よ。地の底へ進むがいい。次に会うのを楽しみにしているぞ、ケヘヘヘ…

The Dark Descent#036.dst: 奇妙な闇の領域から出る。

The Dark Descent#037.src: Return the ruby to Graken at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Dark Descent#037.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Graken にルビーを返す

The Dark Descent#038.src: Return to your world, now. And if you still want to challenge me... I'll be waiting.
The Dark Descent#038.dst: さあ、自分の世界へ帰るがいい。それでもまだ私に挑むなら…待っているぞ。

The Dark Descent#039.src: Hey! Come on, come over here! Quit milling about with the zombies, chap!
The Dark Descent#039.dst: おい！こっちだ、こっちへ来い！ゾンビどもとうろうろするのはやめたまえ！
The Dark Descent#039.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#040.src: Oi! Hallo?! Chum? Why're you wandering round all bog-eyed? Come back to me now!
The Dark Descent#040.dst: おーい！聞こえるか？！君？なぜ虚ろな目でさまよっている？戻ってこい！
The Dark Descent#040.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#041.src: Come on, pip pip! Let's see a bit more colour in your eyes- There we are! Back now, chap?
The Dark Descent#041.dst: しっかりしろ、ほら！目に少し生気を――よし、それでいい！戻ったか、君？
The Dark Descent#041.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#042.src: Capital! You had me quite worried for a spot, there. Do bubble about just what went on down there, mm?
The Dark Descent#042.dst: 素晴らしい！一時はひどく心配したぞ。で、下で何があったのか聞かせてくれるか？
The Dark Descent#042.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#043.src: But, you were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.
The Dark Descent#043.dst: だが君はボケた老婆のようによろめいて、目は真っ白、Charon がどうとかずっと呟いていたぞ。
The Dark Descent#043.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#044.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a jolly good success!
The Dark Descent#044.dst: 君を連れ回したのはそいつか？まあ、死んではいないのだから、この作戦は大成功と言っていいだろう！
The Dark Descent#044.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#045.src: Your discoveries fit in jolly-well with what we already know - and I'm convinced. To stop all these bleedin' zombos, we're going to have to go down under.
The Dark Descent#045.dst: 君の発見は我々の情報とぴたりと合う――確信したよ。この忌々しいゾンビどもを止めるには、地下へ行くしかない。
The Dark Descent#045.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#046.src: Preliminary expeditions have brought back some real nasty bits, brains and such - but also some fancy-as-you-like jewellery!
The Dark Descent#046.dst: 先遣隊が脳みそなど実に不快な物を持ち帰ったが――なかなか見事な宝飾品もあったぞ！
The Dark Descent#046.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#047.src: Take some with you, remind you what we're up against. But keep your eyes on the prize!
The Dark Descent#047.dst: いくつか持っていけ。我々の敵を忘れぬようにな。だが目的は見失うなよ！
The Dark Descent#047.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#048.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along again in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!
The Dark Descent#048.dst: 準備ができたら、また地の底への遠征に加わってもらえると嬉しいぞ、友よ！
The Dark Descent#048.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#000~1.src: I have an entire undead army at my service. Do you really think you stand a chance?
The Dark Descent#000~1.dst: 我が配下にはアンデッドの軍勢がいる。本当に勝ち目があると思っているのか？

The Envoy Part I#000.src: It's an independant island to the west. In fact... If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#000.dst: 西にある独立した島だよ。実はね…行きたいなら…

The Envoy Part I#001.src: The boat is down at the dock.

The Envoy Part I#002.src: It's really hard to miss. Just hop on!
The Envoy Part I#002.dst: 見逃しようがないさ。乗るだけ！

The Envoy Part I#003.src: And don't get me sterted on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#003.dst: わしらの建築の話を始めさせるなよ！

The Envoy Part I#004.src: Mo'in, Wynn traveller! Come speak to me.
The Envoy Part I#004.dst: Mo'in、Wynn の旅人！こっちで話そう。

The Envoy Part I#005.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#005.dst: 北では武器と薬が買える。門を抜けると先住の Avos に会えるよ。

The Envoy Part I#006.src: West, you can buy armour, and there is another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#006.dst: 西では防具が買えて、薬屋へのもう一つの入口もある。

The Envoy Part I#007.src: Something is going on at the diner, you should hurry.
The Envoy Part I#007.dst: 食堂で何か起きてる。急いだ方がいい。

The Envoy Part I#008.src: Psst! You! Over here, behind the logs!
The Envoy Part I#008.dst: しっ！君！こっち、丸太の裏だ！

The Envoy Part I#009.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you!
The Envoy Part I#009.dst: Mo'in、Wynn の人。止められてよかった！

The Envoy Part I#010.src: The diner is being raided by mechs...
The Envoy Part I#010.dst: 食堂がメカに襲われてる…

The Envoy Part I#011.src: You don't know, huh? Of course you don't. Let me explain.
The Envoy Part I#011.dst: 知らないのか？そりゃそうだよな。説明するよ。

The Envoy Part I#012.src: The name's Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#012.dst: ちなみに僕は Maxie。よろしく。

The Envoy Part I#013.src: This town is usually full of life...
The Envoy Part I#013.dst: この町は普段は活気があるんだ…

The Envoy Part I#014.src: Look... I know you're a stranger, but... If you want to help, talk to me.
The Envoy Part I#014.dst: なあ…よそ者なのは分かってる。でも…手伝ってくれるなら声をかけて。

The Envoy Part I#015.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic...
The Envoy Part I#015.dst: よし、電磁魔法で扉を開けるよ…

The Envoy Part I#018.src: Look, I-I'm sorry for slowing you down. It's just...
The Envoy Part I#018.dst: ご、ごめん、足を引っ張って。ただ…

The Envoy Part I#019.src: Oh, two paths. Well, I'm not sure which way it is, so let's split up. I'll go to the right.
The Envoy Part I#019.dst: お、道が二つ。どっちか分からないから手分けしよう。僕は右へ行く。

The Envoy Part I#020.src: Mo'in. Sorry, had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#020.dst: Mo'in。ごめん、ちょっと問題が――

The Envoy Part I#022.src: Don't worry about the guards, they're disabled for now. Follow me!
The Envoy Part I#022.dst: 衛兵は気にしないで、今は止まってる。ついて来て！

The Envoy Part I#023.src: We saw a mech… A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#023.dst: メカを見たんだ…新型のメカを！見た目が違って、まるで――

The Envoy Part I#024.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by themselves.
The Envoy Part I#024.dst: 僕らの客人が…たった一人で Despermech を何体も倒したんだ。

The Envoy Part I#025.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#025.dst: レベル {~} になったら僕の家へ。これが鍵だ。工場に突入する準備をしないと。

The Envoy Part I#027.dst: さぞ素敵だったろうね。

The Envoy Part I#030.dst: この格好が気になるかい？
The Envoy Part I#030.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#031.src: I'm not from around here. In fact I am from Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#031.dst: 私はこの辺りの者じゃない。実は Corkus から来たんだ。
The Envoy Part I#031.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#032.src: It's an independent island to the west. In fact.. If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#032.dst: 西にある独立した島だよ。実はね…行きたいなら…
The Envoy Part I#032.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#033.src: We're looking for Wynn representatives. Head to the C.S.S Wavebreaker down at the dock if you want to experience Corkus. Enjoy Corkus if you go!
The Envoy Part I#033.dst: Wynn の代表者を探している。Corkus を体験したいなら港の C.S.S Wavebreaker へ。行くなら楽しんで！
The Envoy Part I#033.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#034.src: Speak to C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain at the {p} docks.
The Envoy Part I#034.dst: {p} の港で C.S.S Wavebreaker の船長と話す。

The Envoy Part I#035.dst: ようこそ C.S.S Wavebreaker へ！
The Envoy Part I#035.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#036.src: The only boat that'll take ye directly to {p}.
The Envoy Part I#036.dst: {p} へ直行する唯一の船だぜ。
The Envoy Part I#036.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#037.src: Just hop aboard and make yerself comfy.
The Envoy Part I#037.dst: 乗り込んで楽にしてくれ。
The Envoy Part I#037.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#039.src: Welcam aboard me ship, I'll bring ye directly to Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#039.dst: わしの船へようこそ、Corkus まで直行だ。
The Envoy Part I#039.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#040.src: Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
The Envoy Part I#040.dst: Gavel や Wynn よりずっとすげえ所だぜ。機械まであるんだ！
The Envoy Part I#040.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#041.src: And don't get me started on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#041.dst: わしらの建築の話を始めさせるなよ！
The Envoy Part I#041.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#042.src: Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
The Envoy Part I#042.dst: きっと滞在を楽しめるぜ。
The Envoy Part I#042.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#045.src: It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
The Envoy Part I#045.dst: Wynn の兵士に我が島を訪れていただけるとは光栄です。
The Envoy Part I#045.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#046.src: We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
The Envoy Part I#046.dst: 正式な使節を期待していましたが、あなたでも構いません。
The Envoy Part I#046.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#047.src: If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
The Envoy Part I#047.dst: ついて来てください、街をご案内します。
The Envoy Part I#047.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#048.src: We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
The Envoy Part I#048.dst: 私たちが初めて Corkus に来たのは {~} 年前です。
The Envoy Part I#048.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#049.src: The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
The Envoy Part I#049.dst: Corkus 人も、あなた方と同じく元は Fruma の出身で…
The Envoy Part I#049.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#050.dst: …まあ、その話はやめましょう。
The Envoy Part I#050.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#051.src: Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
