The Price of Ingenuity#425.dst: 今日、T おじさんが大けがをした。すごく、すごく、すごくひどいけが。
The Price of Ingenuity#425.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.dst: お母さんは T おじさんは大丈夫だって。きっと大丈夫。
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#427.dst: 締め切りって、実は簡単なのかも？
The Price of Ingenuity#427.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#428.dst: よし。大きなことが起きてる！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#428.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.dst: 城塞は最高だった！！！いつか上に行くのがずっと夢だった… そして行けた！！
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.dst: エ・レ・キ計画は進行中(そう、名前変わった… 前の名前、君主が気に入らなかったの… ちぇっ。)、すごく順調！！
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#431.dst: よし！！！落ち着いて！！！！でも大変なことが！起きてる！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#432.dst: なんだか… 変な気分。
The Price of Ingenuity#432.speaker: 0 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#433.src: Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.dst: この記録を読み返すと、私… 空っぽな気がする。
The Price of Ingenuity#433.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#434.src: Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#434.dst: 数日前、お母さんが病気で亡くなった。前から分かってたらしいけど… それでもショックだった。
The Price of Ingenuity#434.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#435.dst: もうこれを書く意味なんてある？何を書けばいいか分からない。計画のことや進歩のことは書けるけど、全部空っぽに感じる。
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#436.dst: 何年経ったんだろう？日付を見れば分かるけど… 見たくない。
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.dst: 決して忘れるな、創り続けろ、決して屈するな！
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#438.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.dst: あった… こうして見ると、本当にすごいな。
The Price of Ingenuity#438.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#439.dst: もう一回聞くけど、本当に何のためのものか知らないの？それより、誰が運ぶ？
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#440.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.dst: 安全な所に出るまでは {u} が持つべきだと思う。それと… 本当に、全然知らないんだ。Soosu に詳しく聞くたび、はぐらかされてた。
The Price of Ingenuity#440.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.dst: そう。何にせよ、王家が欲しがるならろくなものじゃない。{u}、準備はいい？
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#442.dst: 待って。あの音、聞こえる？足音？
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#443.dst: それしかない― しかも二人分。Soosu が来てる、でも誰と…？
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.dst: …本当にこれが最善か？議論と君の… 計画に注意を割くのは… 過去にうまくいった試しがない。
The Price of Ingenuity#444.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#445.dst: あのね、Zhiraok、「みーんな」が何もかも放り出して自分の地域を離れる暇があるわけじゃないの。あたしたちには仕事があるのよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.dst: あら、ここにいたのね、Flowers！起きて起きて、お寝坊さん― 見張りのお仕事に戻るのよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.dst: 注意しろ、Soosu！急に止まるなら一言くれないか？
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.dst: ん？あ、ごめんごめん、でも親友とばったり会えるなんてすっごく嬉しいんだもん！その頭にもそれを分かる余地くらいあるでしょ、ね？
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#450.dst: Soosu… それは解決済みの問題だ！何度言えば分かる？…まあいい、それは脱線だ。本当に伝えたいのは―
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.dst: 見つからずに工房から脱出する。

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.dst: Soosu が来た？しかもよりによって Zhiraok と？！今すぐ出なきゃ！
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#453.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#453.dst: うん、でも Soosu はきっと Flowers を厳戒態勢にしてる！魔法は使わないで、何があっても見つからないで！
The Price of Ingenuity#453.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.dst: 待って― 何、Flowers？侵入者？！装置室のすぐそば？！
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#455.dst: …！！呪われし者だ！！彼女には指一本触れさせんぞ、分かったか？！
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: Wh-what the helix Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.dst: な、何事だ、侵入者め！今度こそ逃がさんぞ！
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#457.dst: Yusanu？！一緒にいるのは誰？待って、装置を盗む気？！
The Price of Ingenuity#457.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#458.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.dst: ちょっと、逃げるとこでしょ！真面目にやってる？！
The Price of Ingenuity#458.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#459.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.dst: …君ほど賢ければ繰り返す必要などないはずだ！分かっているだろう！頼む、問題を真剣に考えてくれ！
The Price of Ingenuity#459.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#460.src: A set of criminals is in your quadrant, the Cursed behind the Torann massacre is with them, they're infil-
The Price of Ingenuity#460.dst: 君の象限に犯罪者の一団がいる。Torann の虐殺を起こした呪われし者も一緒だ、奴らは潜入―
The Price of Ingenuity#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#461.src: Oh my god, Z, I get it!!! All you do is yap yap yap yap YAP!!! Give me some room to think!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.dst: もう、Z、分かったってば！！！あんたはいつもベラベラベラベラ「ベラ」！！！考える余裕をちょうだい！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#461.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#462.src: Bla bla criminals, bla bla cursed one!!!! Yes, I know how important it is! Flowers, hold this steady for me, won't you?
The Price of Ingenuity#462.dst: 犯罪者がどうの、呪われし者がどうの！！！！そう、大事なのは分かってる！Flowers、これしっかり押さえててくれる？
The Price of Ingenuity#462.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#463.src: As long as your focus is on the solutions, not your... But, Soosu, I haven't heard anything from you. There was key information I had to learn offhand!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.dst: 君の焦点が解決策にあるならいい、君の… だがな、Soosu、君から何の報告も受けていない。重要な情報を人づてに知る羽目になった！
The Price of Ingenuity#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: One of your commanders summarized the topic for me. I should've heard it from you! So...what's your angle? It feels like you're ignoring the issue.
The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: 君の指揮官の一人が要点をまとめてくれた。君から聞くべきだった！で… 君の狙いは何だ？問題を無視しているように見える。
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.dst: …Soosu？Soosu、聞いているのか？質問したんだぞ！
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#466.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#466.dst: ん？はいはい、そうね。ねえ、ボルト取ってくれる？
The Price of Ingenuity#466.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#467.dst: …分かった、いいだろう― だが頼む、この件に決着をつけねば、Soosu。君も関わるんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#469.dst: あ、そうだ、Flowers のこと。歩いてる間に使えそうな部品を拾ってないか見てきてくれる？
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#471.dst: ここで作業させるのは不合理だと分かっていた。君のおもちゃより大きな問題の総和があるんだ！子供のように振る舞っているが、君は子供じゃない！
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#472.dst: 本気を出せば素晴らしい仕事ができるのは分かっている！なぜ高位の離反者と呪われし者が互いの脅威を指数的に増しているのを無視する？！
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#474.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#474.dst: 自分の方があたしより上だと思ってるの、Zhiraok？
The Price of Ingenuity#474.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#475.dst: ほら見て、Soosu はいつも不注意で何も分かってない、いつも自分の管区の事情を無視して、いつも研究室にこもってる。
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#476.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#476.dst: 彼女の仕事なんて誰が気にする？任された計画なんて？！彼女が知ってるってことなんて誰が気にするの、知ってる、「知ってる」のに！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#476.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#477.dst: …ふん！あんたの方が上なのかもね、Z。そうじゃなかったら、あたしたち今こんな所にいないかも！！
The Price of Ingenuity#477.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#478.dst: 私は… … …すまない、Soosu。それは… 私の意図じゃない、そんなつもりは―
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#479.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#479.dst: でも言ったでしょ！歯車 C-{~} 取ってくれる？
The Price of Ingenuity#479.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#480.dst: …分かった。この数列の終わりに早くたどり着きたいだけだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#480.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#481.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#481.dst: それはお互い様。今やってるの。いちいちせっつかないで！！
The Price of Ingenuity#481.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your shoulders. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#482.dst: …もっと気を配るべきだったか。彼女の計画が君の肩にこれほど負担をかけていたとは。手を貸すと約束したのに…
The Price of Ingenuity#482.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#484.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Yusanu のトンネルを通って鋼の羽根に戻る。

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#485.dst: …今の何？！あいつら、あそこで何してたの？！
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#486.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#486.dst: ぼ― ぼ― 僕も知らないよ！抜き打ちの訪問？そんな… そんなの思ってもみなかった…
The Price of Ingenuity#486.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#487.dst: で、「うっぷん晴らし」だっけ？！ええ、そうね、君主 Zhiraok まで連れてくるなんて！！いいじゃない！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#488.dst: 捕まるとこだった！あたしたち― ああもう、あたしたち… 捕まるとこだった…
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#489.dst: …何やってるんだろ？なんで― なんであんなことしたの？あれは本当に…
The Price of Ingenuity#489.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#490.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#490.dst: 「僕」に聞くの？！そうだよ Rex、なんであんなことしたんだろうね？！
The Price of Ingenuity#490.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#491.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#491.dst: やめて。ちょっと… やめて。考え… させて。
The Price of Ingenuity#491.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#492.dst: …くそっ。くそ、くそ、くそ！バカで、衝動的で… もう！！
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#494.dst: ううん、大丈夫じゃない。ごめん、あたし― もう分かってなきゃいけないのに…
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#495.dst: もう… どうでもいい。今さら取り消せない。これを… 切り札に使える。Yusanu、それが何か突き止められるって言って。
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#496.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#496.dst: 僕も… 分からない。深く関わったことがないから… 全然見当がつかない。調べれば何か分かるかも。でも…
The Price of Ingenuity#496.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#497.dst: 十分だよ、たぶん。さあ、戻ろう。あたしは… Mora を探さなきゃ。あんたはみんなに自分がしてたことを話して。
The Price of Ingenuity#497.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#498.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#498.dst: …今日のことを隠しとくって選択肢はないの？
The Price of Ingenuity#498.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#499.dst: で、後になってしっぺ返しを食らうの？お断り。行くよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#500.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#500.dst: ねえ Rex、本当に… 大丈夫？君がこんなふうになるの、見たこと―
The Price of Ingenuity#500.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#501.dst: やめて。しつこくしないで。今は。
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#502.dst: おい！お前ら三人、一日中どこ行ってたんだよ？！
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#504.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#504.dst: ええ、実に不思議ですね！たまたま Syndra と話したのですが、あなた方にそんな「大事な用」は頼んでいないそうです！彼女は何も知らない様子でした！
The Price of Ingenuity#504.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#505.dst: …ああ、Rex… 何があったのです？
The Price of Ingenuity#505.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#506.dst: 何があったか分かるでしょ、Mora。あたし― しくじった。また。
The Price of Ingenuity#506.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#507.dst: は？どういう意味だよ、また―
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.dst: ああ、Yuman、Yusanu を連れて、私たちは会議に少し遅れると皆さんに伝えてもらえますか？今日は他にも知らせがありそうです。
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#509.dst: あー… いいけど。Yus、歩きながら何があったか教えてくれよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#511.dst: …さて、どれほどひどいのです？
The Price of Ingenuity#511.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#512.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#512.dst: …ひどい。君主の工房から重要な物を盗んだの。話せば… 長くなる。Yusanu が自分の分は話すべき。でも…
The Price of Ingenuity#512.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#513.dst: なるほど。すみません、Rex、もっと気を配るべきでした。
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#514.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#514.dst: 違う！違う、あんたのせいじゃない。あたしが― 衝動的になってるって気付くべきだった、あたし… まともに考えられてなかった。
The Price of Ingenuity#514.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#515.dst: ああ。そうでした、あなたはご存じないのですね。前にこうなったときにお伝えすべきでした…
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#516.dst: Rex には時々こういう… ええ、「気分」がありまして、過度に興奮して衝動的に… なるのです。何度もそれで厄介事に。
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#517.dst: うう、もう分かってなきゃいけないのに！特にここで、特に今、こんなときに…
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#518.dst: まあ、済んだことは済んだこと。とにかく前に進まねば。皆さんと会議に合流しましょう。Syndra から大事な話があります。
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#519.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#519.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の鋼の羽根で会議に出席する。

The Price of Ingenuity#520.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#520.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#521.dst: Syndra、それは後にしましょう。夕食もずいぶん待たせてしまいました。皆さん揃ったなら始めましょう。まず― Yusanu、話したいこととは何ですか？
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.dst: …はあ。始める前にはっきりさせておきたい― 僕は鋼の羽根のために最善だと思うことをしてたんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.dst: おう、いい出だしだな… 安心感すげえわ。
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#524.dst: Yuman、頼む… 最後まで言わせて。口を挟まないで。
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.dst: つまり。その、その… 王家が僕らをここで放っておいたのは、僕が君主 Soosu の下で働いてたからなんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#527.dst: ちょっと！話させてあげて。
The Price of Ingenuity#527.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#528.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#528.dst: こんなに長く目をつけられずに済んだのも、これのおかげなんだよ、Yulie。
The Price of Ingenuity#528.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#529.dst: ここに住めるのも、家を出られたのも、街の電気を使えるのも… 僕の協力のおかげなんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#530.dst: 彼女は僕に才能を見出したって。工房で手伝えば… みんなここで安全に暮らせるって言われた。
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.dst: 誰にも言わなかったのは、分かってもらえないと思ったから。バカで危険で最悪の考えだって思うだろ。僕らの問題の元凶と… 手を組むなんて。
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#532.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#532.dst: 危険なのは分かってた。本当に。でも僕がしくじっても、罰を受けるのは僕だけだと思ってた。みんなは安全だって。
The Price of Ingenuity#532.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#533.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#533.dst: …さて。皆さん気持ちが高ぶっているのは分かります。一歩引いて、筋道立てて考え、冷静に―
The Price of Ingenuity#533.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#534.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#534.dst: 正気か、Yusanu？！数ある秘密の中で、よりによって―
The Price of Ingenuity#534.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#535.dst: おい、兄貴、そっとしといてやれよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#535.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#536.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#536.dst: いや、そうはいかない！警報はそのせいだったのか？いつから続いてた？決めたとき何を考えてたんだ―
The Price of Ingenuity#536.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#537.dst: 兄貴だってずっと同じことしてるくせに！全部自分一人で背負って、誰にも頼ろうとしないで！！
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#538.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.dst: だから― まあ、オレもちょっと怒ってる。相談すべきだった！でも… 今話してくれてる。今助けを求めてるんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#538.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#540.dst: 残念だけど、話はもっと悪くなる。
The Price of Ingenuity#540.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#542.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#542.dst: 昨日の兵士との衝突のあと… Soosu は責任者を差し出せって言ってる。僕は… そんなことできない。
The Price of Ingenuity#542.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#543.dst: 今日、Rex と {u} に彼女と話してるところを見られた。だから… だから話してるんだ。
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#544.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#544.dst: …うん。彼女と手を切って、みんなに全部話すよう説得したの。
The Price of Ingenuity#544.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#545.dst: それと… 彼女と Yusanu が作ってた重要な装置を盗んだ。女王がすごく力を入れてた物。
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#546.dst: それが何で、何をするのか分からない。何のための物かも。分かってるのは女王が完成を求めてることだけ。Soosu はずっとそれだけに… 何か月も。
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#547.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.dst: 空いた時間に正体を調べてみる。役に立つかもしれない！僕は… そう願ってる。
The Price of Ingenuity#547.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#548.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#548.dst: Yulie、Yuman… ちゃんと謝らないと。後で二人きりで話せるけど… 今は会議を続けよう。
The Price of Ingenuity#548.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#549.dst: いてっ… うん、これは当然だ。
The Price of Ingenuity#549.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#550.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#550.dst: …確かに色々あったわね。幸い、君主を怒らせたことは結局問題にならないかもしれない。計画通りなら… 祭りの終わりに王家は倒れる。
The Price of Ingenuity#550.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.dst: 私の目標はいつも通り、王家の支配を打ち砕き、この地方を解放する道を探すこと。今度の祭りこそ、その好機だと思う。
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.dst: 王家の祭りの間に、女王陛下は死ぬ。
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.dst: 落ち着いて、皆さん、落ち着いて！どうか Syndra に続けさせてください。
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.dst: 簡単ではないわ。でも油断した隙を突いて不意を打てば、可能だと思う。
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#555.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.dst: あなたたちをいくつかの班に分けて、祭りまでに済ませる任務を割り振るわ。
The Price of Ingenuity#555.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.dst: Quill と私で出した結論は、仕留めに行くのは私一人。そうすれば何かあっても… 他の誰も責任を負わずに済む。
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.dst: 詳細は明日話すわ。今日は… もう十分騒ぎがあったから。不満もそれまで取っておいて。
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#558.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#558.dst: こほん。ええ、まったく。私たちも夕食にしましょうか。
The Price of Ingenuity#558.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.dst: Yuman… 無理なお願いかもしれませんが、今夜一曲弾いてもらえませんか？一緒に過ごせる日はもう多くありません。
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#560.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.dst: ああ… ああ、もちろん。任せとけ。
The Price of Ingenuity#560.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#561.dst: では、残りの時間を共に楽しみましょう！
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#562.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Yuman の演奏を見る。

The Price of Ingenuity#563.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#563.dst: よう、みんな！いやー、えっと… 今日はお客さん少ないな？
The Price of Ingenuity#563.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.dst: おっ、あれ Jiro か？よう！その… 来るとは思ってなかったぜ。
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#566.dst: いや、ほら、昨日のあと… 兵士の件で、オレにあんまりいい顔してなかったからさ。
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#567.src: ... Oh! Yeah. No worries. Water under the bridge.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.dst: …ああ！はい。気にしないでください。もう水に流しましたよ。
The Price of Ingenuity#567.speaker: Jiro

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: If... if you say so! Don't think you've heard this one before, so tell me how you like it!
The Price of Ingenuity#568.dst: そ、そう言うなら！この曲は聴いたことないと思うから、感想聞かせてくれよ！
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: But first... Yus. Yusanu. Look, I... I'm not one to hold grudges. So I don't need any more apologies from you! I get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#569.dst: でもその前に… Yus。Yusanu。オレ… 根に持つタイプじゃない。だからもう謝らなくていい！分かってるから。
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#570.src: I just... want you to trust us more, 'kay? You and Yulie both, haha! 'Cause... I want to help!
The Price of Ingenuity#570.dst: ただ… もっとオレたちを信じてほしいんだ、な？お前も Yulie もだぞ、はは！だって… 力になりたいから！
The Price of Ingenuity#570.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#571.src: I had a think, and yeah. It sucks you didn't tell us. But your deal with Soosu- it saved us! Gave us a home, gave us a future!
The Price of Ingenuity#571.dst: 考えたんだ。話してくれなかったのはムカつく。でも Soosu との取引が― オレたちを救ったんだ！家も未来もくれた！
The Price of Ingenuity#571.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#572.src: So... this song's dedicated to you. Hope you like it.
The Price of Ingenuity#572.dst: だから… この曲はお前に捧げる。気に入ってくれよな。
The Price of Ingenuity#572.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: No... no no no no no, where is it, where IS IT?! I can't... I need to find it, I-
The Price of Ingenuity#573.dst: ない… ないないないない、どこ、どこにあるの？！そんな… 見つけなきゃ、あたし―
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#574.dst: みっともないですよ、君主。
The Price of Ingenuity#574.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#575.src: EEP! Y- your Majesty, I- I- I wasn't expecting you until... tomorrow. Wh- what're you doing here?
The Price of Ingenuity#575.dst: ひっ！じょ― 女王陛下、わ― わ― 明日までいらっしゃらないと… な、なぜここに？
The Price of Ingenuity#575.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#576.src: My schedule freed up, so I decided to check in early. Is something wrong, Sovereign?
The Price of Ingenuity#576.dst: 予定が空いたので、早めに様子を見に来たのです。何か問題でも、君主？
The Price of Ingenuity#576.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#578.src: Don't bother. How incompetent must you be, to have lost it from your own workshop?!
The Price of Ingenuity#578.dst: 結構。自分の工房から失くすとは、どれほど無能なのです？！
The Price of Ingenuity#578.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#579.src: I- I- I don't understand how, my golems haven't been disturbed! They didn't detect anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#579.dst: わ― わ― 分かりません、ゴーレムは何も乱されてないんです！何も検知しなかったのに！
The Price of Ingenuity#579.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#580.src: Perhaps if you focused more on efficiency instead of playing around with your toys, this could have been prevented.
The Price of Ingenuity#580.dst: おもちゃ遊びではなく効率に心を砕いていれば、防げたかもしれませんね。
The Price of Ingenuity#580.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#581.src: I'll- I'll fix this, I promise! I promise I promise I promise, I can fix it! I can... I can restart! I still have all the research notes, and I-
The Price of Ingenuity#581.dst: な― 直します、約束します！約束、約束、約束します、直せます！やり… やり直せます！研究ノートは全部残ってますし、あたし―
The Price of Ingenuity#581.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#582.src: Enough. I have been lenient with your performance maintaining your district, because I had faith there would be results.
The Price of Ingenuity#582.dst: もう結構。あなたの管区の運営ぶりには寛大でいました。成果が出ると信じていたからです。
The Price of Ingenuity#582.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#583.src: Restarting the Resonance Weaver project... it cannot be done. That artifact I entrusted you with... that magic is a lost art. It cannot be replicated.
The Price of Ingenuity#583.dst: 共鳴の織機計画をやり直す… それは不可能です。わたくしが託した遺物… あの魔法は失われた技。複製はできません。
The Price of Ingenuity#583.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#584.src: N- no, I have the notes, I- I know how it works, I can do it, just- just give me a chance! I can fix this!
The Price of Ingenuity#584.dst: ち― 違います、ノートがあります、し― 仕組みは分かってます、やれます、ただ― 一度だけ機会を！直せます！
The Price of Ingenuity#584.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#585.src: I must prepare for the festival. I will expect your presence there, as usual. Please... clean yourself up before that.
The Price of Ingenuity#585.dst: 祭りの準備があります。いつも通り出席するように。その前に… 身なりを整えなさい。
The Price of Ingenuity#585.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#588.src: Consider our agreement null. You have failed me. You will continue your service as Sovereign indefinitely... with your blessing intact.
The Price of Ingenuity#588.dst: 我々の取り決めは無効とします。あなたはわたくしを失望させた。君主の務めは無期限に続けなさい… 祝福はそのままに。
The Price of Ingenuity#588.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#589.src: ...what? No- no, no no no, you- you can't, you can't, you can't!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#589.dst: …え？いや― いや、いやいやいや、そんな― そんなのダメ、ダメ、ダメ！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#589.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#000.dst: 棚には「研究ノート」と書かれている。

The Price of Ingenuity#053~1.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#053~1.dst: わあ、ぴかぴかで珍しい小物ばっかり！Zeph が起きてたら大喜びしただろうなあ。残念！
The Price of Ingenuity#053~1.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#054~1.src: This is a fun one! It's a passion project, inspired by one of my favorite books, an intriguing story of a girl and her friends saving the world.
The Price of Ingenuity#054~1.dst: これは楽しいよ！大好きな本に影響された趣味の作品でね、女の子と友達が世界を救う面白い話なんだ。

The Price of Ingenuity#301~1.dst: 君も — 今の — 見た？
The Price of Ingenuity#301~1.speaker: Sparkles

The Price of Ingenuity#302~1.src: Approximately {~} of the input fuel energy is lost as heat. This results in a poor overall performance.
The Price of Ingenuity#302~1.dst: 投入した燃料エネルギーの約 {~} が熱として失われる。その結果、全体の性能が低くなっている。

The Price of Ingenuity#489~1.src: Preliminary results suggest significantly improved utilization of energy, and reduced pollution. (Cleaner air? May help.)
The Price of Ingenuity#489~1.dst: 予備結果によれば、エネルギー効率が大幅に向上し、汚染も減少している。(空気がきれいに？役立つかも。)

The Price of Ingenuity#505~1.src: You collectively decide that leaving Flowers be is probably best for everyone involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#505~1.dst: Flowers はそっとしておくのが皆にとって一番だろう、と全員で決めた。

The Price of Ingenuity#506~1.src: These vents are broken, and were blocked off for a reason. Proceeding further will be dangerous!
The Price of Ingenuity#506~1.dst: この通気口は壊れていて、わけあって塞がれている。これ以上進むのは危険だ！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.src: I see another lost soul has found their way to The {p}!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.dst: また迷える魂が {p} に辿り着いたか！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.src: I can't say I am overwhelmed by your appearance. Here, the birth of many powerful and magical monsters take place.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.dst: 見た目には大して感心せんな。ここでは強大で魔力を帯びた魔物が数多く生まれるのだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.src: Gavel's governments can not stop Mistress Qira. I doubt you can either.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.dst: Gavel の政府でも Qira 様は止められん。お前にも無理だろう。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.src: If you want to meet her, you will have to defeat each division of her army.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.dst: あの方に会いたくば、軍の各部隊をすべて倒すことだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.src: Although powerful, she is not without honour. After every floor you complete, you will receive a token for a reward from the shop. Good luck, adventurer-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.dst: 強大なれど、あの方は礼節を欠かぬ。一層突破するごとに、店で褒美と交換できるトークンを授けよう。健闘を祈る、冒険者―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.src: Wh- Oh, Mistress, am I? My apologies...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.dst: な―主様、私がですか？失礼を…
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.src: Begin, the Thunder Division! Strike quickly and move on, for those within will warp your very mind should you stray for too long!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.dst: 始めよ、雷の部隊！素早く討ち、先へ進め。長居すれば中の者どもに心を歪められるぞ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.src: Heeheehahaaah! I see you! You humans have such easily influenced minds, but I'll settle for beating you within an inch of your life! Come through, come through!!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.dst: ひひひはははっ！見ーつけた！人間の頭ってほんと操りやすいよね、でも今回は半殺しで我慢してあげる！おいで、おいで！！！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.src: Feh, you're no fun, you little cheater! I was supposed to beat you, not the other way around!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.dst: ちぇっ、つまんないの、このズル！あたしが勝つはずだったのに、逆じゃん！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.src: I hate you so much. Just get out and talk to that idiot servant already!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.dst: 大っ嫌い。さっさと出てって、あのバカな召使いと話してよ！！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.src: You have completed the Thunder floor? How surprising. They were some of Mistress Qira's earliest successes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.dst: 雷の層を突破したと？意外だな。あれは Qira 様の最初期の成功作なのだが。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.src: I agree, Mistress. As promised, here is a Thunder Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.dst: 承知しました、主様。約束通り、Thunder Voucher だ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.src: Take it to the shop to claim your prize. It is located at the base of the Hive. The servant there will have important information for you regarding your prizes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.dst: 店へ持って行き、褒美と交換しろ。店は巣の最下層にある。そこの召使いが褒美について大事な話をするだろう。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.src: I doubt you are still worth Mistress's time, however. She has much to tend to here, as you might guess.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.dst: とはいえ、お前がまだ主様の時間に値するとは思えん。察しの通り、あの方はここで多忙なのだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.src: She made a deal with Gavel's people long ago, after they foolishly attempted to lay siege to our Hive.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.dst: かつて Gavel の者どもが愚かにも我らの巣を包囲しようとした後、あの方は彼らと盟約を結んだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.src: She could continue her unethical and possibly evil work...and in return, she would allow the people of Gavel to remain undisturbed by her.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.dst: あの方は非道で、邪悪とも言える研究を続けてよい…その代わり、Gavel の民には手を出さない、とな。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.src: Next you must tackle the Air division, featuring some of her tougher creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.dst: 次は風の部隊だ。あの方の中でも手強い創造物が揃っている。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.src: Begin, the Air Division! Fight freely with the wind, for the coming storm shall claim you for my own if you cannot spread your wings here!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.dst: 始めよ、風の部隊！風と共に自在に戦え。ここで翼を広げられねば、来たる嵐がお前を我がものとするぞ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.src: Well, nice work getting this far! Don't tell anyone, but I'm gonna pull my punches here, okay? I'm rooting for you, so let's have fun with this! Come on through!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.dst: わあ、ここまで来るなんてすごい！内緒だけど、ここは手加減してあげるね？応援してるから、楽しくやろう！さあ、どうぞ！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.src: Heehee, maybe I didn't need to hold back after all? You did really well, really well!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.dst: えへへ、手加減いらなかったかも？すっごく、すっごく良かったよ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.src: A lot of people say I'm the roughest we have to offer, so you've got this! I'm sorry you have to go talk to Yansur of all people now, though.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.dst: あたしが一番手強いってよく言われるから、もう大丈夫！でも、よりによって Yansur と話さなきゃなのは気の毒だね。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.src: Hrm, perhaps we have underestimated you. The creations of Air have defeated thousands, particularly-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.dst: ふむ、見くびっていたか。風の創造物は数千人を倒してきた、特に―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.src: ...yes. Here is the promised Air Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.dst: …はい。約束の Air Voucher だ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.dst: 店に褒美が用意してある。店の召使いとまだ話していないなら、次に行った時に話せ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.src: You still have a long way to go. It is not easy to gain an audience with Mistress Qira.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.dst: 先はまだ長い。Qira 様に謁見するのは容易ではないぞ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.src: Your next objective is to clear the Earth division. Some of the most powerful, raw creatures ever hatched.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.dst: 次の目標は地の部隊の制圧だ。かつて孵った中で最も強く、荒々しい生き物たちだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.src: Begin, the Earth Division! You must withstand both sheer force and deadly toxins! Be quick on your feet, or you will return to the dust of the earth!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.dst: 始めよ、地の部隊！圧倒的な力と猛毒に耐えよ！足を止めるな、さもなくば大地の塵に還るぞ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.src: Creatures of the earth were not enough for you... Mistress's most rawly powerful... Destroyed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.dst: 地の生き物でも足りぬとは…主様の最も荒々しく強い者たちが…滅ぼされた。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.src: Well, here is your Earth Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.dst: 店に褒美が用意してある。店の召使いとまだ話していないなら、次に行った時に話せ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.src: It is impressive to see how far you have come. Many have failed at this point.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.dst: よくぞここまで来たものだ。多くの者がここで倒れた。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.src: It is of no consequence, however, for the Water division is your next challenge. I am sure you will not succeed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.dst: だが関係ない、次の試練は水の部隊だ。お前が成功するとは思えん。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.src: Begin, the Water Division! If you will not withstand the crashing waves, the creatures that lurk within shall ensure you never emerge from the abyss!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.dst: 始めよ、水の部隊！打ち寄せる波に耐えられねば、潜む者どもがお前を深淵から二度と出さぬぞ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.src: You have been judged worthy enough to face me in combat. However, I know your strength, and I do not believe it enough to defeat me. Come forth now. Make your attempt to prove me wrong.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.dst: そなたは我と戦うに値すると判定された。だがそなたの力は知っている。我を倒すには足りぬと見る。前へ出よ。我が誤りを証明してみせよ。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.src: Seems my judgment was incorrect. In this case, however, it is refreshing to see.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.dst: 我が判定は誤りだったか。だがこの場合、清々しいものだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.src: Continue forwards, honourable human. Perhaps your intellect and respect will rub off on that insufferable Yansur.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.dst: 進め、誇り高き人間よ。そなたの知性と敬意が、あの鼻持ちならぬ Yansur に移ればよいのだが。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.src: Impossible. Not even the most tactically advanced monsters could defeat you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.dst: ありえん。最も戦術に長けた魔物でもお前を倒せぬとは。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#037.dst: …お待ちかねの Water Voucher だ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#037.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.dst: 店に褒美が用意してある。店の召使いとまだ話していないなら、次に行った時に話せ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.src: We are intrigued by your determination... But we are not worried. We do not expect you to make it past the next floor.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.dst: お前の決意には興味をそそられる…だが心配はしていない。次の層を越えられるとは思っておらん。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.src: Now you must face some of the toughest creatures of Mistress Qira's imagination!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.dst: 次は Qira 様の想像が生んだ、最も手強い生き物たちに挑むのだ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.src: You must now face the division of Fire, and it will be sure to burn you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.dst: 次は火の部隊だ。必ずやお前を焼き尽くすだろう。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.src: Begin, the Fire Division! Summon your courage, and brave the heat of the volcanoes and blow away in the breeze!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.dst: 始めよ、火の部隊！勇気を奮い、火山の熱に立ち向かえ―さもなくば風に散る灰となれ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.src: Impressive, making it this far. I am your final test. Let us fight fairly, then. An honourable end to your challenge is only fitting, whether that be triumph or defeat. Come forward and face me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.dst: ここまで来るとは見事だ。我こそ最後の試練。ならば正々堂々と戦おう。勝利であれ敗北であれ、挑戦には誇り高き結末こそふさわしい。前へ出て我と向き合え。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.src: Defeat feels strange, after so long. You fought valiantly, and with great zeal, however. It would be a lie to say I am disappointed. Impart these traits onto Mistress's servant, if you would, and claim your final prize.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.dst: 久しく味わわなかった敗北は奇妙なものだ。だがそなたは勇敢に、熱意をもって戦った。失望したと言えば嘘になる。よければその美徳を主様の召使いにも授け、最後の褒美を受け取るがよい。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.src: All that is left is to talk to Mistress's servant, and claim your final prize. Surely he will not be as great an obstacle as I was.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.dst: 残るは主様の召使いと話し、最後の褒美を受け取ることだけだ。あの者は我ほどの障害ではあるまい。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.src: This is unprecedented. You have defeated some of the most recent and powerful creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.dst: 前代未聞だ。最新にして最強の創造物を倒すとは。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.src: Here you are then, the Fire Voucher!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.dst: 店に褒美が用意してある。店の召使いとまだ話していないなら、次に行った時に話せ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.src: This is unorthodox, as no one has made it this far. But I suppose this means that you have earned an audience with-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.dst: 異例のことだ、ここまで来た者はいないのでな。だがこれで、お前は謁見の資格を得たことに―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.src: Hah! Incredible! Mistress wishes to battle you herself! You astound me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.dst: はっ！信じられん！主様が自らお前と戦うと仰せだ！驚いたぞ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.src: Be warned, however. This will be your toughest battle yet. Mistress Qira is the most feared being in Gavel.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.dst: だが心せよ。これまでで最も過酷な戦いとなる。Qira 様は Gavel で最も恐れられる存在だ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.src: You will die...but consider it the greatest honour to die by her hand.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.dst: お前は死ぬ…だがあの方の手で死ねるのは至上の栄誉と思え。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.src: How cowardly! After defeating so many in the Hive, and receiving such praise, you've the gall to upstand Mistress's request?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.dst: なんと臆病な！巣で多くを倒し、称賛まで受けておきながら、主様の申し出を蹴るとは！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.src: I had begun to think highly of you, but after such a disgusting display-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.dst: 見直しかけていたのに、こんな醜態を見せられては―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.src: Wha...that- No, that can't possibly be correct, you are-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.dst: な…それは―いや、そんなはずはない、お前は―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.src: ...Masterful...Have we been cooped up in this Hive so long that our army is outdated?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.dst: …見事だ…我らは巣に籠もりすぎて、軍が時代遅れになっていたのか？
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.src: To be defeated by a human of Wynn... I am not sure whether to be disappointed or amazed. Our ultimate challenge has been bested.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.dst: Wynn の人間に敗れるとは…失望すべきか、驚嘆すべきか。我らの最終試練が破られた。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.src: Here is your voucher, then. The back room in the shop will have your rewards. If you still have not talked to the servant at the shop...well. You should know by now.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.dst: では引換券だ。褒美は店の奥の部屋にある。まだ店の召使いと話していないなら…まあ。もう分かっているだろう。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.src: Mistress...if I may tell the tale? She was once called upon to help stop the decay of the forest.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.dst: 主様…この話をしてもよろしいですか？あの方はかつて、森の腐朽を止める手助けを請われた。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.src: With her boundless knowledge and magic, she surely could have cured it. But she declined.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.dst: 無限の知識と魔法があれば、きっと治せたはずだ。だがあの方は断った。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.src: She instead chose to create, obsessed with preparing for some sort of war.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.dst: 代わりに創造を選び、何かの戦争への備えに執着した。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.src: Mistress never elaborated, but it seems like she knows something we don't.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.dst: 主様は詳しく語らないが、我らの知らぬ何かをご存じのようだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.speaker: Yansur

The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.src: ... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.dst: …achara…あなたにしたことは、決して償えないと思う。謝るだけじゃ全然足りない。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.src: As infuriating as what you did was, you were following orders... I had every right to be angry, but to try and take your life was ten steps too far.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.dst: 腹立たしくはあっても、あなたは命令に従っただけ…怒る権利はあったけど、命を奪おうとしたのはやりすぎどころじゃなかった。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.src: Even though it is not enough, I will say I am sorry for the pain I caused you. The Guardian was right, in the end.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.dst: 足りないとしても言わせて。苦しめてしまってごめんなさい。結局、守護者が正しかった。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.src: Without you carrying out Orphion's will, we would not be here. You truly are necessary in this, and I believe I have finally made peace with that.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.dst: あなたが Orphion の意志を果たさなければ、ここまで来られなかった。あなたは本当に必要な存在で、ようやくそれを受け入れられた気がする。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.src: It has been a long time since I had a partner willing to help me in this way. I was unused to it, I suppose... Still.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.dst: こんなふうに手を貸してくれる仲間は久しぶり。慣れてなかったのかもね…それでも。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.src: If you'll be willing to aid me, it would be a great relief. It has been a thousand years since I entered the Realm of Light...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.dst: 力を貸してくれるなら、本当に心強い。私が光の領域に入ってから、もう千年になる…
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.src: I can only hope things have not changed much. I remember how it was, right down to the last petal...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.dst: あまり変わっていないといいけど。最後の花びら一枚まで、あの頃の姿を覚えてる…
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#009.src: Walk towards the portal with Lari.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#009.dst: Lari と一緒にポータルへ向かう。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.src: Wait a moment, {u}. I have one more thing I would like to say before we enter.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.dst: 待って、{u}。入る前にもう一つ言いたいことがあるの。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.src: I... I need to thank you. For helping, as you have. For staying by me as you have. There was one other before you like that...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.dst: 私…お礼を言わなきゃ。こうして助けてくれて。そばにいてくれて。あなたの前にも、そういう人が一人いた…
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.src: I promise that you will not meet the same fate as him. I will fight with you to the bitter end, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.dst: 約束する、あなたを彼と同じ運命にはさせない。最後まで一緒に戦うわ、achara。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.src: It's time, then. To visit Orphion.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.dst: 時間ね。Orphion に会いに行こう。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#014.src: Jump into the portal after Lari.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#014.dst: Lari の後に続いてポータルに飛び込む。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#015.src: Talk to Lari at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] in the Realm of Light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#015.dst: 光の領域の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Lari と話す。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.src: Welcome to the Realm of Light then, {u}. Once you've re-oriented yourself, come over here.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.dst: 光の領域へようこそ、{u}。落ち着いたらこっちに来て。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.src: It's so much smaller than it used to be! There used to be many more landmasses, all connected to each other...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.dst: 昔よりずっと小さくなってる！前はもっとたくさんの陸地があって、全部つながってたのに…
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.src: I feel... I feel everything in here. With Orphion's light, I can tap into the very core of the realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.dst: 感じる…ここにあるすべてを。Orphion の光で、この領域の核そのものに触れられる。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.src: And I can feel disturbances. There are dark creatures here, where there should be none!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.dst: そして乱れも感じる。いるはずのない闇の生き物が、ここにいる！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.src: I mean, even look at this creature. The light emanating from it is-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.dst: だって、この生き物を見て。放っている光が―
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.src: Wait. Wh... Why is it attacking you!?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.dst: 待って。な…なぜ襲ってくるの！？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.src: Its mind was addled by darkness. Poor thing was terrified... Nothing for it though.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.dst: 闇に心を乱されてた。かわいそうに、怯えてたのね…でも仕方ない。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.src: I suppose your more ruthless nature is a good thing, in this case. We each will need to fight, if this is as widespread as it feels.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.dst: 今回は、あなたの容赦のなさが役に立つかも。感じる通りに広がっているなら、二人とも戦わなきゃ。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.src: I'll have to prepare myself for that... Being willing to take action will not make it any easier on my conscience.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.dst: 私も覚悟しないと…動く決意をしても、良心が楽になるわけじゃないけど。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.src: But I will set that aside, until the day this all becomes a memory. We'll both need to seek the Nexus of Light, Orphion's home. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.dst: でも、すべてが思い出になる日まで、それは置いておく。二人で Orphion の住まい、光のネクサスを目指そう。ついてきて！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.src: Follow Lari to Orphion's Nexus of Light at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.dst: Lari について [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Orphion の光のネクサスへ向かう

The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.src: I should have expected this. With the connections severed, of course the bridge to the Nexus would be gone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.dst: 予想しておくべきだった。つながりが断たれたなら、ネクサスへの橋も消えて当然ね。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.src: This must be because of that horrid parasite... The Guardian of the Forest informed me of the situation afterwards.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.dst: きっとあのおぞましい寄生体のせい…後で森の守護者が状況を教えてくれた。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.src: The gap may be too far for me to carry you over... Is there a way I can bypass this, I wonder?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.dst: この隙間は、あなたを抱えて渡るには遠すぎるかも…どうにか回り道できないかな？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.src: Perhaps I can try to bridge the gap myself. Let's see if this will work.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.dst: 私が自分で隙間をつなげられるかも。試してみる。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.src: ...hm. That ought to have worked! Is the Nexus too far to reach?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.dst: …ん。うまくいくはずなのに！ネクサスが遠すぎるの？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.src: There has to be some way over... Maybe the direct method is- Hm? Another creature?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.dst: 何か渡る方法があるはず…直接行く方法なら―ん？また生き物？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.src: This one doesn't seem hostile, {u}... I'll try and talk with it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.dst: この子は敵意がなさそう、{u}…話しかけてみる。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.src: Its mind is whole, but it's wary of your presence. You should stay back, just in case.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.dst: 心は無事だけど、あなたを警戒してる。念のため下がっていて。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.src: So tell me, achara. What is it you sought me for?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.dst: さあ教えて、achara。私に何の用？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.src: Ahh, I see. You wish to see your master once more as well...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.dst: ああ、そういうこと。あなたもご主人にもう一度会いたいのね…
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.src: The monoliths? Are they what's severed the connections?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.dst: モノリス？それがつながりを断ったの？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.src: Ahh, I understand. I assure you, we will fix this!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.dst: ああ、わかった。約束する、必ず直すわ！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.src: It said that the connections to the rest of the realm were severed intentionally by Orphion, in order to protect them.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.dst: 領域の他の場所とのつながりは、守るために Orphion がわざと断ったんだって。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.src: Two monoliths on this landmass controlled the connections, and they are being drained of their light- As such, they closed the bridges.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.dst: この陸地の二つのモノリスがつながりを制御していて、光を吸われている―だから橋を閉じたの。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.src: The light is still there- But it must be drawn back out. We have our task ahead of us now, achara. We need to go to the first monolith. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.dst: 光はまだある―でも引き出さないと。やることは決まったわ、achara。最初のモノリスへ行こう。ついてきて！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#043.src: Search for the monolith Lari was talking about at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Realm of Light (Quest)#043.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Lari が話していたモノリスを探す。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.src: I never knew the monoliths kept the realm together as they did. You can see that it is inactive, yes?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.dst: モノリスがこうして領域をまとめていたなんて知らなかった。止まってるの、わかるよね？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.src: There should be bright bands of color going along it, and light pouring from it. This is where we play our roles, {u}!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.dst: 明るい色の帯が走って、光があふれているはずなの。ここが私たちの出番よ、{u}！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.src: It may be getting drained, but there is certainly still light within it, and if that parasite is battling Orphion we should be able to recharge it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.dst: 光を吸われてはいても、中にはまだ光がある。寄生体が Orphion と戦っているなら、充填できるはず。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.src: I'll tap into the monolith... You'll need to enter it, and find its core. I'll send a part of Orphion's light with you to activate it once you do.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.dst: 私がモノリスとつながる…あなたは中に入って核を見つけて。見つけたら、起動のために Orphion の光の一部を送るわ。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.src: The damage here is minor- Nothing that can't be fixed, thankfully.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.dst: ここの損傷は軽い―幸い、直せないものはない。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.src: Its aura is lowered- Now your soul must enter. I will keep you safe, {u}.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.dst: オーラが弱まった―次はあなたの魂が入る番。私が守るわ、{u}。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.src: Allow my magic to open your senses... Good luck, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.dst: 私の魔法で感覚を開いてあげる…気をつけてね、achara。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#053.src: Find a way to fill the monolith with light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#053.dst: モノリスを光で満たす方法を見つける。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#054.src: Follow Lari to the next monolith at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Realm of Light (Quest)#054.dst: Lari について [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の次のモノリスへ向かう。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.src: Welcome back, {u}. I had few troubles dealing with the creatures trying to get close. Did you have issues inside?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.dst: おかえり、{u}。近寄ってくる生き物の相手は楽だったわ。中で何か困ったことはあった？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.src: The light is starting to pulse out from the monolith again, so I would say you've succeeded. I suppose we do make a decent team?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.dst: モノリスからまた光が脈打ち始めてる、成功したみたいね。私たち、なかなかいい組み合わせかも？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.src: Look! The colours are returning to the monolith! It's definitely reactivated. I'll run ahead and get to the other monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.dst: 見て！モノリスに色が戻ってきた！完全に再起動したわ。先に行って、もう一つのモノリスへ向かうね。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.src: Follow the path! The way there is up the big cliff where we first entered the Realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.dst: 道に沿って来て！行き先は、最初に領域に入った大きな崖の上よ。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.src: I'm unsure if you can feel the light returning from the monolith, but I can. I almost feel reborn, with all this energy!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.dst: あなたにも感じるかわからないけど、モノリスから光が戻ってくる。力があふれて生まれ変わった気分！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.src: The rift ahead ought to take us to the second monolith, but it doesn't seem to be working, and I'm unsure why.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.dst: この先の裂け目で二つ目のモノリスへ行けるはずなのに、動いてないみたい。理由はわからない。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.src: See? It's inert, which is... Odd. These aren't connected to the energy of the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.dst: ほら？反応がない、これは…変ね。モノリスのエネルギーとつながってないんだ。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.src: It shouldn't be inactive as it is. There's some dark influence around here, but I can't seem to place it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.dst: こんなふうに止まっているはずがない。近くに闇の影響があるけど、場所がつかめない。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.src: My only guess is that it's interfering with the rift's energy. I've already scoured the hill though- No dark patches to be seen.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.dst: たぶんそれが裂け目のエネルギーを妨げてる。でも丘はもう探し尽くした―闇の跡はどこにもない。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.src: Do you think you could take a second look-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.dst: もう一度見てもらえる―
The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.src: ...maybe you won't need to, after all. That was...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.dst: …その必要はなさそう。今のは…
The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.src: We've found the disturbance... Even beyond this, I'll need to charge the rift with energy to activate it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.dst: 乱れの正体を見つけた…それとは別に、裂け目を起動するにはエネルギーを込めないと。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.src: Go in peace, tortured ones! Be at one with the light!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.dst: 安らかに、苦しむ者たち！光とひとつになって！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.src: Get the rest of them, {u}! I'll charge the rift!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.dst: 残りは任せた、{u}！私は裂け目を充填する！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.src: Defeat the darkened creatures and progress to the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.dst: 闇に染まった生き物を倒し、モノリスへ進む。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.src: Thank you, achara. The rift is charged again- Just walk into it!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.dst: ありがとう、achara。裂け目が戻った―そのまま入って！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#073.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で二つ目のモノリスに入る。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.src: The process here should be roughly the same. I bring down the barrier, you enter and charge it with the light I provide.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.dst: やり方はだいたい同じ。私が障壁を下ろし、あなたが入って私の光で満たすの。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.src: I'll need to focus the energies of the monoliths to reconnect the Nexus of Light to the mainland here, so you'll be alone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.dst: モノリスの力を集めて光のネクサスをこっちの本土につなぎ直すから、あなたは一人になるわ。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.src: I'll leave a barrier around you. Few creatures live on these cliffs, but best to be certain, of course.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.dst: 周りに障壁を張っておく。この崖に生き物はほとんどいないけど、念のためね。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.src: Once you're done, meet me at the cliff near the Nexus. If we're to free Orphion from the parasite, having you along would be a great help.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.dst: 終わったら、ネクサス近くの崖で落ち合おう。Orphion を寄生体から解放するなら、あなたがいると心強い。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.src: Good luck, achara. I will see you soon.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.dst: 気をつけて、achara。またすぐに。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#080.dst: 気をつけて、{u}！少し下がって！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#080.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.src: There. The connection to the Nexus is established, and so we'll cross.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.dst: よし。ネクサスへのつながりができた、渡ろう。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.src: Wait! Something... Something's not quite right...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.dst: 待って！何か…何かがおかしい…
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.src: Interfere?! You're one of the dark!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.dst: 干渉？！あなたこそ闇の者でしょ！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.src: You're the one trespassing in realms not your own!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.dst: 自分のものでもない領域に踏み込んでるのはそっちよ！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.src:
Lari:
{u}. I think. I found someone.
Who deserves to be killed. Help me out?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.dst: {u}。たぶん。見つけた。殺されるべき者を。手伝って？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.src: Continue up the road towards Orphion's Nexus of Light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.dst: 道を上り、Orphion の光のネクサスへ進み続ける。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.src: {u}!! Stay back! I'm keeping up but he'll destroy you if you get close!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.dst: {u}！！下がって！私は平気、でも近づけば殺される！！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.src: AGH, ENOUGH OF THIS! You aren't allowed here, foul thing!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.dst: ああ、もうたくさん！ここはお前の来る所じゃない、汚らわしい奴！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.src: No! You won't run- I'll kill you before that!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.dst: 逃がさない―その前に殺してやる！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#092.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light
The Realm of Light (Quest)#092.dst: 新しいクエスト開始: 光の領域 V - 光の領域

The Realm of Light (Quest)#094.src: Or something that another person wants you to see?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#094.dst: それとも、誰かがあなたに見せたいもの？

The Realm of Light (Quest)#096.src: You. Elf girl. You are to be eliminated.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#096.dst: お前。エルフの娘。排除する。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.src: Fool. The Beast quakes with our influence. This land is ours.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.dst: 愚か者。獣は我らの影響に震えている。この地は我らのものだ。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#098.src: I will not waste my time with that specimen. Now. Face death.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#098.dst: その標本に割く時間はない。さあ。死を迎えよ。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.src: You shall not. Surely your god will smile seeing me leave.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.dst: させぬ。我が去るのを見れば、お前の神も喜ぶだろう。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.src: YOU DON'T GET TO TALK ABOUT ORPHION LIKE THAT!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.dst: ORPHION のことをそんなふうに言うな！

The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.src: We have already won. Your peon is outmatched.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.dst: 我らはもう勝った。お前の手下では相手にならぬ。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.src: It's not over... IT CAN'T BE, DON'T YOU- TAKE THIS!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.dst: まだ終わってない…終わるはずがない、あなた―これでも食らえ！

The Realm of Light (Quest)#104.src: There's a faint buzzing in your ears...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#104.dst: 耳元でかすかにブーンと音がする…

The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.src: I have a slight idea of where I'm headed, but... If I'm able to handle him, then maybe I'm powerful enough for this.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.dst: 行き先はなんとなくわかる、でも…彼を相手にできるなら、私にもこれをやれる力があるのかも。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.src: I've never been one to say goodbyes, but thank you for everything. I know you'll find people just as strong as you are to rescue Orphion in my place.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.dst: 別れの挨拶は苦手だけど、全部ありがとう。私の代わりに Orphion を救える、あなたと同じくらい強い人たちがきっと見つかる。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#107.src: I- I see the end of this... Tunnel. There's- Wait...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#107.dst: こ、このトンネルの…終わりが見える…そこに―待って…

The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.src: {u}... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.dst: {u}…Achara…あなたにしたことは、決して償えないと思う。謝るだけじゃ全然足りない。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#110.src: You need to defeat the mob before you can progress!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#110.dst: 先に進むにはモンスターを倒す必要がある！

The Scarred Springs#000.src: Talk to Maripe at Pishlas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Pishlas で Maripe と話す。

The Scarred Springs#001.src: Oh! Well, hello there, tourist! I have to assume you're a tourist, anyways. That doesn't look like local dress, anyways. I suppose you've heard about the hot springs!
The Scarred Springs#001.dst: おっ！やあ、観光客さん！まあ観光客だと思うんだ。地元の服装には見えないし。温泉のことを聞いて来たんでしょ！
The Scarred Springs#001.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#002.src: Well, ah...unfortunately, Pishlas is closed for renovations. You see, it's been closed for a long time... My family has run it for generations, but trouble started.
The Scarred Springs#002.dst: えっと、あー…残念ながら Pishlas は改装中で休業なんだ。もう長いこと閉まってて…うちの家族が代々経営してきたんだけど、問題が起きてね。
The Scarred Springs#002.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#003.src: With my mother having been stricken ill for so long, my father and all our family, we've had to abandon this place to care for her. It's fallen into disrepair.
The Scarred Springs#003.dst: 母さんが長いこと病気で、父さんも家族もみんなで看病するためにここを離れるしかなかった。それで荒れ果てちゃったんだ。
The Scarred Springs#003.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#004.src: She's well enough now that she doesn't need someone looking after her every hour, so I'm taking it on myself to return this place to its former glory!
The Scarred Springs#004.dst: 今はずっと付き添わなくていいくらい元気になったから、僕がこの場所を昔の輝きに戻すって決めたんだ！
The Scarred Springs#004.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#005.src: It's been hard work...and it should be opening soon- but I'm not quite done. Again, I'm so sorry you came all this way for nothing.
The Scarred Springs#005.dst: 大変な作業で…もうすぐ開けられるはずなんだけど、まだ終わってない。わざわざ来てくれたのに、本当にごめんね。
The Scarred Springs#005.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#006.src: I- excuse me? You want to...
The Scarred Springs#006.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#007.src: That'd... That'd be absolutely fantastic!! I've been working alone on this for months now!! I'm NEARLY done, but-
The Scarred Springs#007.dst: そ…それは最高だよ！！何か月も一人でやってたんだ！！あとちょっとなんだけど―
The Scarred Springs#007.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#008.src: Come on, come on! I'll show you around! Let's go, let's go!!
The Scarred Springs#008.dst: さあ、さあ！案内するよ！行こう、行こう！！
The Scarred Springs#008.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#009.src: Hopefully you'll be able to visit before you have to go home then!
The Scarred Springs#009.dst: 帰る前に一度入りに来られるといいね！
The Scarred Springs#009.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#010.src: Okay, okay, what's next on the list... C'mon, think like Sovereign Zhiraok!
The Scarred Springs#010.dst: よし、よし、リストの次は何だっけ…ほら、君主 Zhiraokみたいに考えろ！
The Scarred Springs#010.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#011.src: Let Maripe show you around at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#011.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Maripe に案内してもらう。

The Scarred Springs#012.src: Okay, so! These are the main pools- Frankly, I have no idea how all these frogs got here, given the bog is clear across the whole forest...
The Scarred Springs#012.dst: よし、じゃあ！ここが主浴場―正直、このカエルたちがどこから来たのか全然わからない。沼は森の反対側なのに…
The Scarred Springs#012.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#013.src: But they've got to go. Sure, they're cute, but no one's going to want to take a soak with them... Or with all these fallen leaves in the pools.
The Scarred Springs#013.dst: でも出てってもらわないと。可愛いけど、カエルと一緒に浸かりたい人はいないよ…湯に落ちた葉っぱとも。
The Scarred Springs#013.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#014.src: The side pool over here is just as important to clean out. Need to have clear pools for the guests! And maybe even for the Sovereign!
The Scarred Springs#014.dst: こっちの脇の湯船も掃除が大事。お客さんには澄んだお湯じゃないと！君主様だって来るかも！
The Scarred Springs#014.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#015.src: I've already put a lot of time into fixing up these huts. I do carpentry work. These used to be in so much worse shape... I'm a little glad my grandparents didn't end up seeing it like this.
The Scarred Springs#015.dst: この小屋の修理にはもうずいぶん時間をかけた。僕、大工なんだ。前はもっとひどい状態で…祖父母がこの有様を見ずに済んで、ちょっとほっとしてる。
The Scarred Springs#015.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#016.src: I have such fond memories of playing around here when I was younger... What would they think, seeing it fall apart? That thought has been giving me motivation this whole time.
The Scarred Springs#016.dst: 小さい頃ここで遊んだ思い出がたくさんあって…崩れていくのを見たら、二人はどう思うかな？その思いがずっと僕の原動力なんだ。
The Scarred Springs#016.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#017.src: It'd be a disgrace to let Pishlas fall completely apart. Even Sovereign Zhiraok agreed! Did you know he dropped by, when I was first starting- Oh, wait! There's one other place!
The Scarred Springs#017.dst: Pishlas を完全に崩れさせるなんて恥だよ。君主 Zhiraokも賛成してくれた！始めた頃に寄ってくれたって知ってる―あっ、待って！もう一か所あった！
The Scarred Springs#017.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#018.src: The teahouse! Refreshments, hot drinks, a place to sit out of the water... This is one of the big remaining projects. I'll take care of this- but, back about the Sovereign?
The Scarred Springs#018.dst: 茶屋だ！軽食に温かい飲み物、湯から上がって座れる場所…これが残ってる大仕事の一つ。ここは僕がやる―で、君主の話だっけ？
The Scarred Springs#018.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#019.src: He visited one day, while I was starting on fixing the place, and he told me this would be a fantastic community service! Since it's been so long since Pishlas has been usable, I mean.
The Scarred Springs#019.dst: 改装を始めた頃のある日に来てくれて、これは素晴らしい地域奉仕になるって言ってくれたんだ！Pishlas がずっと使えなかったからね。
The Scarred Springs#019.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#020.src: This used to be a big community center. Losing it was a blow to all Auburn residents... He's promised some great things if I can clean this all up! So let's get to it!
The Scarred Springs#020.dst: ここは昔、大事な地域の集いの場だった。失って Auburn の住民はみんな落ち込んだ…全部片付けたら、すごいご褒美を約束してくれたんだ！さあ始めよう！
The Scarred Springs#020.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#021.src: You go gather up the frogs! There's a pond to the you can drop them off at. Then...the leaves! Pick them out of the pools. Then...then come back and we'll see where we're at!
The Scarred Springs#021.dst: 君はカエルを集めてきて！の方に放せる池があるから。それから…葉っぱ！湯船から拾い出して。それから…戻ってきたら、進み具合を確認しよう！
The Scarred Springs#021.speaker: Maripe
