The Strong Survive#492.src: The will to do something means nothing, no matter how strong it is, if you do not have the ability to do it.
The Strong Survive#492.dst: 何かを成そうとする意志など、どれほど強くても、成す力がなければ無意味だ。
The Strong Survive#492.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#493.src: He would have just gotten himself killed, or worse, gotten others killed. What I did was serve Fruma to the best of my ability, I am no monster.
The Strong Survive#493.dst: 奴は自分が死ぬだけだった、悪くすれば他人を死なせていた。私は力の限り Fruma に尽くしたまでだ、怪物ではない。
The Strong Survive#493.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#494.src: No true soldier would ever intentionally injure an ally... Let's go, this conversation is over.
The Strong Survive#494.dst: 本物の兵士なら、仲間をわざと傷つけたりしない…行こう、話は終わりだ。
The Strong Survive#494.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#496.src: Are you the one who told him to ask me about that? Who are you exactly?
The Strong Survive#496.dst: あの件を聞けと彼に言ったのは君か？君は一体何者だ？
The Strong Survive#496.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#497.src: Come sit next to me, I want to discuss what just happened.
The Strong Survive#497.dst: 隣に座ってよ、今のことを話し合いたいんだ。
The Strong Survive#497.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#498.src: I expected the worst yet was still surprised by that... That fiend really did it on purpose, and Commander Ferreo let it happen...
The Strong Survive#498.dst: 最悪を覚悟してたけど、それでも驚いたよ…あの悪党は本当にわざとやったんだ、しかも Ferreo 司令官はそれを許した…
The Strong Survive#498.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#499.src: I suppose we should talk about how the shield challenge went. That might end up making me angrier, but I should tell you...
The Strong Survive#499.dst: 盾の試練がどうだったか話そうか。余計に腹が立つかもしれないけど、話しておくべきだと思う…
The Strong Survive#499.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#500.src: I started the test, confident, ready to make that instructor eat his words, show him that I am not a failure. And I still couldn't block a single arrow.
The Strong Survive#500.dst: 自信満々で試験を始めたんだ、あの教官に前言撤回させて、僕が落ちこぼれじゃないと示してやるって。なのに、やっぱり矢を一本も防げなかった。
The Strong Survive#500.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#501.src: He wouldn't even let me retry it, just told me to leave the room. I protested, I said that wasn't fair, but he insisted...
The Strong Survive#501.dst: やり直しもさせてくれず、部屋を出ろと言われただけ。不公平だと抗議したけど、聞き入れてもらえなかった…
The Strong Survive#501.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#502.src: And what about you, how did the shield challenge go?
The Strong Survive#502.dst: 君はどう、盾の試練はどうだった？
The Strong Survive#502.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#503.src: That's great to hear, maybe you can show me how you did it sometime-
The Strong Survive#503.dst: それはよかった、今度どうやったのか教えて――
The Strong Survive#503.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#504.src: I'm sorry to hear about that, we're in this together-
The Strong Survive#504.dst: それは残念だったね、僕らは一緒に――
The Strong Survive#504.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#505.src: I-I was just wondering... No need to get-
The Strong Survive#505.dst: ぼ、僕はただ気になって…そんなに――
The Strong Survive#505.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#506.src: Ah, you again... I've decided that I won't be going with you, I have done nothing to deserve such punishment, and will not stand to be treated like this.
The Strong Survive#506.dst: ああ、またあなたですか…決めました、一緒には行きません。こんな罰を受ける覚えはないし、こんな扱いは我慢できません。
The Strong Survive#506.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#507.src: Don't talk to him like he's one of your servants, Arnol. Your family name means nothing here, if he asks you to go with him, you must go!
The Strong Survive#507.dst: Arnol、彼を使用人のように扱うな。ここでは家名など何の意味もない、ついてこいと言われたら行くのだ！
The Strong Survive#507.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#508.src: This childish tantrum of yours will be noted. Now come with me before you start a scene. You are here to serve us, not the other way around.
The Strong Survive#508.dst: この子供じみた癇癪は記録しておく。騒ぎになる前についてこい。お前は我々に仕えるためにいるんだ、逆じゃない。
The Strong Survive#508.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#509.src: Wow, I didn't think Arnol had it in him to talk back to someone like that... Anyway, are you ready for dueling? Follow me.
The Strong Survive#509.dst: おお、Arnol があんな相手に口答えする度胸があるとは…ともかく、決闘の準備はいいか？ついてこい。
The Strong Survive#509.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#510.src: Poor Arnol, he's going to become a soldier and yet he still can't control his temper tantrums.
The Strong Survive#510.dst: 哀れな Arnol、兵士になろうというのにまだ癇癪を抑えられないとはな。
The Strong Survive#510.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#511.src: What's next? Is he going to ask Commander Ferreo if he can change his diaper for him?
The Strong Survive#511.dst: 次は何だ？Ferreo 司令官におむつを替えてもらえるか頼むのか？
The Strong Survive#511.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#512.src: Head to the challenge room and recieve instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#512.dst: [-{~}, {~}, {~}] の試練の間へ行き、今日最後の試練の説明を受ける。

The Strong Survive#513.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#513.dst: こんにちは新兵さん！何かお困りですか？
The Strong Survive#513.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#514.src: If you're done with your lunch then wait for Recruiter Effal to pick you up for the next challenge in the cafeteria.
The Strong Survive#514.dst: 昼食が済んだら、食堂で Effal 募兵官が次の試練へ迎えに来るのを待ってください。
The Strong Survive#514.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#515.src: And if Recruiter Effal already came to pick you and your group up then... you should be with him in the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#515.dst: Effal 募兵官がもうあなたの班を迎えに来たなら…彼と一緒に決闘の間にいるはずですよ。
The Strong Survive#515.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#516.src: This will be the last of your training for today. Singular melee combat against another recruit.
The Strong Survive#516.dst: 本日最後の訓練だ。他の新兵との一対一の近接戦である。
The Strong Survive#516.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#517.src: The rules are the same as the day prior. Grab a training sword if you have not from the table and enter the large door when you are ready.
The Strong Survive#517.dst: 規則は前日と同じだ。まだなら台から訓練用の剣を取り、準備ができたら大扉から入れ。
The Strong Survive#517.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#518.src: I will be unable to oversee your challenges today as there is somthing I must attend to. I have asked another instructor to do so, they are waiting in the dueling rooms.
The Strong Survive#518.dst: 本日は所用があり、試練を監督できない。別の教官に頼んである、決闘の間で待っている。
The Strong Survive#518.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#519.src: Now go start the duels, good luck recruits.
The Strong Survive#519.dst: では決闘を始めよ、健闘を祈る新兵諸君。
The Strong Survive#519.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#520.src: Enter the next room and complete the final challenge of the day.
The Strong Survive#520.dst: 次の部屋に入り、今日最後の試練を完了する。

The Strong Survive#521.src: Remember not to take things too seriously here. Being a good soldier is not always about winning.
The Strong Survive#521.dst: ここではあまり深刻に考えすぎないで。良い兵士とは、勝つことだけじゃないのよ。
The Strong Survive#521.speaker: Recruiter Alena

The Strong Survive#522.src: Commander Ferreo wants to speak with you, don't keep him waiting.
The Strong Survive#522.dst: Ferreo 司令官が君と話したいそうだ、待たせるなよ。
The Strong Survive#522.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#523.src: Don't tell him I said this, but my brother, Robin, has the advantage over me in this challenge.
The Strong Survive#523.dst: 本人には内緒だけど、この試練では弟の Robin のほうが有利なの。
The Strong Survive#523.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#524.src: As long as I never go up against him though, he won't realize that, that's why I am letting him go on ahead without me.
The Strong Survive#524.dst: でも私が一度も当たらなければ、あいつは気づかない。だから先に行かせてるの。
The Strong Survive#524.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#525.src: Maybe if I win against my opponent and he loses, he might be convinced that I am stronger!
The Strong Survive#525.dst: 私が相手に勝って、あいつが負ければ、私のほうが強いって納得するかも！
The Strong Survive#525.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#527.src: I don't want you to start the duel yet, your opponent has yet to arrive. Let's wait together for him.
The Strong Survive#527.dst: まだ決闘は始めるな、相手が来ていない。共に待とう。
The Strong Survive#527.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#528.src: There you are, Arnol. I was told that you had an outburst during lunch. You will come to know that such things are unacceptable here.
The Strong Survive#528.dst: 来たか、Arnol。昼食時に騒ぎを起こしたそうだな。ここではそのような真似は許されんと知ることになる。
The Strong Survive#528.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#529.src: This is who you'll be dueling against Arnol. You two are friends, yes? Well this duel will surely teach both of you a valuable lesson.
The Strong Survive#529.dst: Arnol、これが君の決闘相手だ。二人は友人だな？ならばこの決闘は、二人に貴重な教訓を与えるだろう。
The Strong Survive#529.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#530.src: Valuable lesson? What is that supposed to mean Commander? Is this a trick? What is the point of me dueling my friend?
The Strong Survive#530.dst: 貴重な教訓？どういう意味ですか司令官？罠ですか？友達と決闘させて何になるんです？
The Strong Survive#530.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#531.src: You should know better than to question the orders of your superior, Arnol. Now both of you, into the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#531.dst: 上官の命令に疑問を挟むものではないぞ、Arnol。さあ二人とも、決闘の間へ入れ。
The Strong Survive#531.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#532.dst: あの小僧に思い知らせてやれ。
The Strong Survive#532.speaker: Millitary Guard

The Strong Survive#533.src: Step up, and the duel may begin. If either of you hold back, I will make you start the duel again, as many times as is needed.
The Strong Survive#533.dst: 前へ出ろ、決闘を始める。どちらかが手加減すれば、何度でも決闘をやり直させる。
The Strong Survive#533.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#534.src: You did better than expected Arnol. Yet the result was still what I imagined it would be.
The Strong Survive#534.dst: 予想以上だったぞ、Arnol。だが結果はやはり思った通りだ。
The Strong Survive#534.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#535.src: Then what was the point of this duel, if you knew I would lose! Were you trying to humiliate me further? Haven't you done that enough already?!
The Strong Survive#535.dst: 負けると分かっていたなら、この決闘に何の意味が！もっと辱めたかったんですか？もう十分でしょう？！
The Strong Survive#535.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#536.src: Your arrogance truly has no bounds. How many punishments will I have to give you until you start to take things here seriously?
The Strong Survive#536.dst: 君の傲慢さは本当に際限がないな。どれほど罰を与えれば、ここを真剣に受け止めるようになる？
The Strong Survive#536.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#537.src: You're becoming a lost cause, Arnol. Now go, there is something I would like to discuss with in private.
The Strong Survive#537.dst: もう見込みがなくなりつつあるぞ、Arnol。行け、内密に話したいことがある。
The Strong Survive#537.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#538.src: Your kindness towards him is doing him no favour. Arnol must know what pain is like before he can become stronger, and your friendship is preventing that.
The Strong Survive#538.dst: 君の優しさは彼のためにならん。Arnol は強くなる前に痛みを知らねばならず、君との友情がそれを妨げている。
The Strong Survive#538.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#539.src: For both of your sakes, I insist you sever your bond with him.
The Strong Survive#539.dst: 二人のためにも、彼との縁を切るよう求める。
The Strong Survive#539.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#540.src: Leave the dueling room, then go to the barracks to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#540.dst: 決闘の間を出て、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] の宿舎で眠る。

The Strong Survive#541.src: Do not take my advice for granted.
The Strong Survive#541.dst: 私の忠告を軽んじるな。
The Strong Survive#541.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#542.src: Am I the only one who is unimpressed with these challenges? They don't seem that related to being a soldier.
The Strong Survive#542.dst: この試練に感心してないのは俺だけか？兵士になることとあまり関係なさそうだけど。
The Strong Survive#542.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#543.src: Eh, oh well. At least they're kind of fun, I'll give them that. I just wish the other recruits took them less seriously.
The Strong Survive#543.dst: まあいいか。少なくとも結構楽しいのは認めるよ。他の新兵がもう少し気楽に構えてくれたらな。
The Strong Survive#543.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#544.src: Well done, you kept your promise to get a better ranking! I am sure Commander Ferreo and Recruiter Olissy are proud.
The Strong Survive#544.dst: よくやったわ、順位を上げる約束を守ったわね！Ferreo 司令官も Olissy 募兵官もきっと誇りに思ってる。
The Strong Survive#544.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#545.src: I used my shame from my first ranking as a driver to try harder on today's challenges. I am happy that I did poorly initially, because now I know must be constantly trying to improve!
The Strong Survive#545.dst: 最初の順位の恥を原動力に、今日の試練をもっと頑張ったの。最初に失敗してよかった、常に上達を目指さなきゃいけないって分かったから！
The Strong Survive#545.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#546.src: I will set the same promise now, tomorrow my ranking will be higher than it is now!
The Strong Survive#546.dst: また同じ約束をするわ、明日の順位は今より上よ！
The Strong Survive#546.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#547.src: I've failed... Now I'll never be able to become a Wings soldier...
The Strong Survive#547.dst: 失敗した…これでもう翼部隊の兵士にはなれない…
The Strong Survive#547.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#548.src: Don't you think you're being a bit over dramatic? I think you did great, it's not like you're at the bottom of the ranking.
The Strong Survive#548.dst: ちょっと大げさじゃない？よくやったと思うよ、順位が最下位ってわけでもないし。
The Strong Survive#548.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#549.src: Easy for you to say... You're already in the Wings group, you didn't have to work for anything, you were just born good! You'll never know what it's like to be a failure!
The Strong Survive#549.dst: お前は気楽に言えるよな…もう翼班にいて、何の苦労もせず、生まれつき優秀なんだ！落ちこぼれの気持ちなんて一生分からないさ！
The Strong Survive#549.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#550.src: I can't believe we're done with the second day already. Enjoy being a recruit while it lasts, it won't get any easier from here.
The Strong Survive#550.dst: もう二日目が終わったなんて信じられない。新兵の今を楽しんでおけ、ここから楽にはならないぞ。
The Strong Survive#550.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#551.src: You're on thin ice, Priscilla... You didn't improve at all from yesterday! What will people think if I let a weakling follow me around?
The Strong Survive#551.dst: 崖っぷちよ、Priscilla…昨日から全然伸びてないじゃない！弱い子を連れ歩いてたら、みんなにどう思われるか！
The Strong Survive#551.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#552.src: Please Lynn! Just give me a second chance! I promise I will get into the top {~} tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#552.dst: お願い Lynn！もう一度だけ機会をちょうだい！明日は上位 {~} 位に入るって約束する！
The Strong Survive#552.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#553.src: Make it top {~}! And if you fail... I'll never speak to you again!
The Strong Survive#553.dst: 上位 {~} 位にしなさい！できなかったら…二度と口をきかないから！
The Strong Survive#553.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#554.src: Top {~}!? That's... Eh... Fine, I will make it into the top {~} tomorrow, I promise!
The Strong Survive#554.dst: 上位 {~} 位！？それは…ええと…分かった、明日は上位 {~} 位に入る、約束する！
The Strong Survive#554.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#555.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#555.dst: こんにちは新兵さん！何かお困りですか？
The Strong Survive#555.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#556.src: You're done for the day, there are no challenges left.
The Strong Survive#556.dst: 今日の予定は終わりです、もう試練はありませんよ。
The Strong Survive#556.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#557.src: Now go get a well deserved rest. Head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room, and from there, enter the room to the left.
The Strong Survive#557.dst: さあ、ゆっくり休んでください。次の部屋に入ってすぐ正面の部屋へ進み、そこから左の部屋に入ってください。
The Strong Survive#557.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#558.dst: おやすみなさい、ゆっくり休んで！
The Strong Survive#558.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#559.src: You're not worth my time. Do me a favour and buzz off.
The Strong Survive#559.dst: お前に割く時間はない。頼むから消えてくれ。
The Strong Survive#559.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#560.src: I am willing to put the incident at lunch today aside. You just need to tell me how you or Arnol discovered what happened in my duel on the first day.
The Strong Survive#560.dst: 今日の昼食の件は不問にしてもいい。君か Arnol が、初日の私の決闘で何があったかをどう知ったのか、話してくれればな。
The Strong Survive#560.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#561.src: I'm not easily fooled, I don't buy the made up story that you two were looking for advice.
The Strong Survive#561.dst: 私は簡単には騙されない。二人が助言を求めに来たという作り話など信じん。
The Strong Survive#561.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#562.src: You should take this proposition seriously. I am not the type of person you would want as your enemy.
The Strong Survive#562.dst: この提案は真剣に受け止めたほうがいい。私は敵に回したい類の人間ではない。
The Strong Survive#562.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#563.src: It was a fluke, that's the only explanation of how you were able to beat me by one singular point! It means nothing!
The Strong Survive#563.dst: まぐれだ、たった一点差で俺に勝てた理由はそれしかない！何の意味もない！
The Strong Survive#563.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#564.src: Right... Keep telling yourself that, but in the back of your mind you know that I beat you. I'll never make you forget that fact!
The Strong Survive#564.dst: はいはい…そう言い聞かせてれば？でも心の底では私に負けたって分かってるくせに。絶対に忘れさせてあげない！
The Strong Survive#564.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#565.src: They've been at it for a while now. Which one do you think will beat the other tomorrow?
The Strong Survive#565.dst: あの二人、ずっとああだよ。明日はどっちが勝つと思う？
The Strong Survive#565.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#566.src: I'm not sure... What do you think will happen if they tie?
The Strong Survive#566.dst: さあ…引き分けたらどうなると思う？
The Strong Survive#566.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#567.src: I hope that doesn't happen, they would probably be up all night arguing about who's better.
The Strong Survive#567.dst: そうならないといいな、どっちが上か一晩中言い争いそうだ。
The Strong Survive#567.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#568.src: Could this day have gone any worse?
The Strong Survive#568.dst: これ以上悪い日ってある？
The Strong Survive#568.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#569.src: The honourable Commander Ferreo did nothing as Adder beat a fellow recruit to a pulp...
The Strong Survive#569.dst: あの立派な Ferreo 司令官は、Adder が仲間の新兵をめった打ちにしても何もしなかった…
The Strong Survive#569.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#570.src: The instructors of the esteemed {p} recruit program seem to have no interest in actually training us...
The Strong Survive#570.dst: 名高い {p} の新兵課程の教官たちは、本気で僕らを鍛える気なんてないみたいだ…
The Strong Survive#570.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#571.src: And I am starting to doubt the idea of bringing honour to my house...
The Strong Survive#571.dst: 家に名誉をもたらすってことにも、疑問を感じ始めてる…
The Strong Survive#571.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#572.src: At least I'm not alone though...
The Strong Survive#572.dst: でも少なくとも、僕は一人じゃない…
The Strong Survive#572.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#573.src: Sneak around to find more information on Commander Ferreo's plans.
The Strong Survive#573.dst: こっそり動き回り、Ferreo 司令官の計画についてさらに情報を探る。

The Strong Survive#574.src: You found all of my diary entries, well done.
The Strong Survive#574.dst: 私の日記を全部見つけたか、大したものだ。
The Strong Survive#574.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#575.src: It's been so long since I've hid them, I was beginning to forget about them ever existing.
The Strong Survive#575.dst: 隠してからずいぶん経つから、あったこと自体忘れかけていた。
The Strong Survive#575.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#576.src: Don't expect a medal or anything, I can answer some questions that you may have about them though.
The Strong Survive#576.dst: 勲章なんか期待するなよ。ただ、日記について聞きたいことがあれば多少は答えられる。
The Strong Survive#576.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#577.src: It was Commander Ferreo's final insult. That's the reason I am here, as a guard in {p}.
The Strong Survive#577.dst: Ferreo 司令官の最後の侮辱さ。だから私はここ、{p} で衛兵をやっている。
The Strong Survive#577.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#578.src: After I graduated from the recruit program, my average rankings were seen as too low to join a field Captain or Commander's service.
The Strong Survive#578.dst: 新兵課程を修了したとき、平均順位が低すぎて、前線の隊長や司令官の下には就けないとされた。
The Strong Survive#578.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#579.src: So Ferreo himself stepped up and took me in, stationing me here to waste away. I think it's some form of punishment...
The Strong Survive#579.dst: そこで Ferreo 自ら私を引き取り、ここに配置して腐らせた。一種の罰なんだろう…
The Strong Survive#579.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#580.src: I'm not sure to be quite honest. Maybe I was hoping for a sly recruit like yourself to find them, and not make the same mistakes I did.
The Strong Survive#580.dst: 正直よく分からない。君みたいな抜け目ない新兵に見つけてもらって、私と同じ過ちを避けてほしかったのかもな。
The Strong Survive#580.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#581.src: It may have just been out of boredom though. I can't remember what thoughts were going through my head back when I hid them, after I became a soldier.
The Strong Survive#581.dst: ただの退屈しのぎだったのかもしれない。兵士になって、あれを隠したとき何を考えていたか、もう思い出せない。
The Strong Survive#581.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#582.src: Deep down... Maybe I wanted Commander Ferreo to find those notes. I wonder what he would have though after reading them...
The Strong Survive#582.dst: 心の底では…Ferreo 司令官にあの記録を見つけてほしかったのかもな。読んだら何を思っただろうか…
The Strong Survive#582.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#583.src: I had a feeling you'd ask me that. And surprisingly, yes, I did discover the truth about Commander Ferreo's success. There is no secret. He did it all through a fierce determination to become greater.
The Strong Survive#583.dst: そう聞かれると思っていた。そして意外にも、ああ、Ferreo 司令官の成功の真相は突き止めた。秘密なんてない。偉くなるという激しい決意だけで成し遂げたんだ。
The Strong Survive#583.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#584.src: When Commander Ferreo was young, he had nothing, he was a vagabond in {p}. Not living, just, surviving.
The Strong Survive#584.dst: 若い頃の Ferreo 司令官は何も持っていなかった。{p} の浮浪者でね。生きるというより、ただ生き延びていた。
The Strong Survive#584.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#585.src: Sometimes the Fruman Military would come to visit, and everyone in the town gathered together to see them. Ferreo saw how everyone loved and praised them for their valiance.
The Strong Survive#585.dst: 時々 Fruma 軍が訪れると、町中の人が集まって見物した。皆が彼らの勇敢さを愛し讃えるのを Ferreo は見ていた。
The Strong Survive#585.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#586.src: He desperately wanted to be praised and loved like that too. So he made it his goal to reach that position, overcoming the countless obstacles in his way.
The Strong Survive#586.dst: 自分もあんなふうに讃えられ、愛されたいと切望した。だからその地位を目指し、行く手の無数の障害を乗り越えた。
The Strong Survive#586.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#587.src: Through sheer strength and expertise, he quickly became a Wings Commander, breaking military records in the process.
The Strong Survive#587.dst: 純粋な力と技量で、瞬く間に翼部隊の司令官となり、その過程で軍の記録を塗り替えた。
The Strong Survive#587.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#588.src: There were rumours that he would push further and attempt to become a Sovereign, even though all the positions were full at the time...
The Strong Survive#588.dst: さらに上を目指して君主になろうとしている、という噂もあった。当時は全ての座が埋まっていたのにな…
The Strong Survive#588.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#589.src: He had finally reached the level of fame and admiration that he had set out for. But I imagine the potential for even greater heights tormented him.
The Strong Survive#589.dst: ついに望んだ名声と称賛を手にした。だが、さらなる高みの可能性が彼を苦しめたのだろう。
The Strong Survive#589.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#590.src: Not many know this, but just before he was given his current position, Commander Ferreo had a meeting with Sovereign Majin and The Queen.
The Strong Survive#590.dst: 知る者は少ないが、今の地位を与えられる直前、Ferreo 司令官は 君主 Majinと女王と会談している。
The Strong Survive#590.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#591.src: We can only speculate at what the discussed, but quickly after said meeting, Majin appointed Commander Ferreo as head of {p}. My guess is that he was punished for his ambition...
The Strong Survive#591.dst: 何が話されたかは推測するしかないが、その会談の直後、Majin は Ferreo 司令官を {p} の長に任じた。私の推測では、野心の罰だったんだろう…
The Strong Survive#591.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#592.src: Good luck on your training recruit. I recommend you take it more seriously than I did.
The Strong Survive#592.dst: 訓練がんばれよ、新兵。私よりは真剣に取り組むことを勧める。
The Strong Survive#592.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#593.src: Sorry, but I still can't let you enter.
The Strong Survive#593.dst: 悪いが、まだ通すわけにはいかない。
The Strong Survive#593.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#595.src: I grew suspicious of you when I heard you get up in the middle of the night yesterday to sneak around.
The Strong Survive#595.dst: 昨夜、君が夜中に起き出してこそこそ動き回る音を聞いて、怪しいと思った。
The Strong Survive#595.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#596.src: And somehow you were able to discover the results of my first duel... The only conclusion I can come to is that you have been spying on Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#596.dst: しかも、どうやってか私の初戦の結果を突き止めた…導ける結論は一つ、君は Ferreo 司令官を探っていたということだ。
The Strong Survive#596.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#597.src: For this, you deserve to be exiled, executed, or imprisoned.
The Strong Survive#597.dst: それだけで、追放か処刑か投獄に値する。
The Strong Survive#597.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#598.src: But... I have been looking to challenge myself, so far the training has been underwhelming. I would like to see what a resistance spy is capable of.
The Strong Survive#598.dst: だが…私は自分を試す相手を探していた。これまでの訓練は物足りない。レジスタンスの密偵に何ができるのか見てみたい。
The Strong Survive#598.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#599.src: If you can best me in a duel, I won't report you to Commander Ferreo. The first person to land {~} hits on the other shall be declared the victor.
The Strong Survive#599.dst: 決闘で私に勝てたら、Ferreo 司令官には報告しない。先に相手に {~} 回当てた方が勝者だ。
The Strong Survive#599.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#600.src: As a show of good faith, I will let you land the first hit on me.
The Strong Survive#600.dst: 誠意の証として、最初の一撃は当てさせてやる。
The Strong Survive#600.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#601.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry particles, Adder will swipe his estoc at you. Perfect blocking this attack will stun him, allowing you to counterattack.
The Strong Survive#601.dst: うなり声と怒りのパーティクルが予兆。Adder がエストックで薙ぎ払う。この攻撃を完璧に防ぐとひるみ、反撃の隙ができる。
The Strong Survive#601.speaker: Swipe

The Strong Survive#602.src: Telegraphed by a grunt without angry particles, Adder will hop to the side.
The Strong Survive#602.dst: 怒りのパーティクルなしのうなり声が予兆。Adder が横へ跳ぶ。
The Strong Survive#602.speaker: Sidestep

The Strong Survive#603.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry and blue particles, Adder will lunge forward and charge with his estoc. This attack deals damage twice, once at the start and once at the peak of the lunge. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#603.dst: うなり声と怒り・青のパーティクルが予兆。Adder がエストックを構えて前方へ突進する。突進の開始時と頂点で2回ダメージ。最後の一撃を完璧に防ぐとひるむ。
The Strong Survive#603.speaker: Lunge

The Strong Survive#604.src: Telegraphed by angry and green particles, Adder will continuously swipe his estoc in front of him while running towards the {u} for several seconds. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#604.dst: 怒り・緑のパーティクルが予兆。Adder が数秒間 {u} に向かって走りながら、前方でエストックを連続で薙ぎ払う。最後の一撃を完璧に防ぐとひるむ。
The Strong Survive#604.speaker: Swipe Chain

The Strong Survive#605.src: Absurd... Even after everything I have been through, I still am not strong enough...
The Strong Survive#605.dst: 馬鹿な…あれだけの経験を積んでも、まだ力が足りないのか…
The Strong Survive#605.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#607.src: Make your way through the vents.

The Strong Survive#608.src: We've found ourselves in a terribly difficult situation, Strumon...
The Strong Survive#608.dst: 実に厄介な状況になったな、Strumon…
The Strong Survive#608.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#609.src: We have a spy amongst our recruits and know who they are, yet that messenger expects us to not do anything about it until Sovereign Majin gets here!?
The Strong Survive#609.dst: 新兵の中に密偵がいて、正体も分かっている。なのにあの伝令は、君主 Majinが着くまで何もするなと！？
The Strong Survive#609.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#610.src: I think it is important to be cautious here Commander, if this spy is as powerful as the messenger implied... This could spell the end for all of us...
The Strong Survive#610.dst: ここは慎重になるべきかと、司令官。あの密偵が伝令の言うほど強大なら…我々全員の破滅になりかねません…
The Strong Survive#610.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#611.src: Yes, you're probably right. Nevertheless, once Sovereign Majin arrives and sees that I let a spy into the recruit program... I fear that all that I have worked for will be lost...
The Strong Survive#611.dst: ああ、おそらく君の言う通りだ。だが 君主 Majinが到着し、私が密偵を新兵課程に入れたと知れば…これまで築いたもの全てを失いかねん…
The Strong Survive#611.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#612.src: I will not give up so easily, nor will I do nothing while we wait for Sovereign Majin to arrive...
The Strong Survive#612.dst: そう簡単に諦めはせん。君主 Majinの到着を待つ間、何もしないつもりもない…
The Strong Survive#612.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#613.src: I want Effal to be exiled to Wynn immediately for treason. He let the spy in, and must be punished for that. Find a guard to replace his position as Recruiter, anyone would be more competent than him.
The Strong Survive#613.dst: Effal を反逆罪で直ちに Wynn へ追放しろ。密偵を入れたのは奴だ、罰を受けねばならん。代わりの募兵官は衛兵から探せ、誰でも奴よりはましだ。
The Strong Survive#613.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#614.src: Relay this to the other guards and recruiters. Effal should be out of Fruma by tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#614.dst: これを他の衛兵と募兵官に伝えろ。Effal は明日までに Fruma から出ていくことになる！
The Strong Survive#614.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#615.src: Now, Commander, there is another issue I would like to bring up with you, the reason why I came to your office this late into the night in the first place.
The Strong Survive#615.dst: それで司令官、もう一つお話ししたい件がございます。こんな夜更けに執務室へ伺ったのはそのためです。
The Strong Survive#615.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#616.src: Your plan yesterday went along perfectly. I checked in with the doctor and he told me Katze will need to be sent home.
The Strong Survive#616.dst: 昨日の計画は完璧に運びました。医師に確認したところ、Katze は帰郷させる必要があるそうです。
The Strong Survive#616.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#617.src: Excellent, tomorrow Adder will duel against Arnol. His family name can no longer make up for his weakness!
The Strong Survive#617.dst: 素晴らしい。明日は Adder を Arnol と戦わせる。もはや家名では彼の弱さを補えん！
The Strong Survive#617.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#618.src: Commander... Is this really the best option? The spy seems to have grown a liking towards Arnol. I fear doing this could trigger a retaliation from them...
The Strong Survive#618.dst: 司令官…本当にそれが最善でしょうか？密偵は Arnol に好意を抱いているようです。報復を招くおそれが…
The Strong Survive#618.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#619.src: Does upsetting a single cursed one really frighten you that much, Strumon? Besides, I expect Sovereign Majin will have arrived by then, your concerns are unfounded.
The Strong Survive#619.dst: 呪われし者一人を怒らせるのがそんなに怖いのか、Strumon？それに、その頃には 君主 Majinが到着しているはずだ、君の懸念は杞憂だ。
The Strong Survive#619.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#620.src: Commander, Recruiter, there is an urgent matter that requires attending to. Please, follow me!
The Strong Survive#620.dst: 司令官、募兵官、至急対処すべき事態です。どうか、ついてきてください！
The Strong Survive#620.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#621.src: Unscrew the vent, then head back to the barracks to wake Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#621.dst: 通気口のネジを外し、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] の宿舎へ戻って Arnol を起こす。

The Strong Survive#623.src: What is this about, {u}? Why are you waking me up so early in the morning?
The Strong Survive#623.dst: どうしたの、{u}？なんでこんな朝早くに起こすのさ？
The Strong Survive#623.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#624.src: What!? I'd stand no chance against Adder! He might even end up killing me if I face him! I guess I should have expected Commander Ferreo would do something like this though...
The Strong Survive#624.dst: 何だって！？Adder 相手じゃ勝ち目なんてない！戦ったら殺されるかもしれない！でも Ferreo 司令官ならこういうことをすると予想すべきだったか…
The Strong Survive#624.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#625.src: If you're telling me this now, you must have some idea on how to help me with this mess. What is your plan, {u}?
The Strong Survive#625.dst: 今それを話すってことは、この窮地を切り抜ける考えがあるんだね。どういう計画、{u}？
The Strong Survive#625.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#626.src: Hmmm... Ok, I trust you. Let's go before anyone wakes up.
The Strong Survive#626.dst: うーん…分かった、君を信じる。誰かが起きる前に行こう。
The Strong Survive#626.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#627.src: Hmmm... Ok, I'll go with you.
The Strong Survive#627.dst: うーん…分かった、一緒に行くよ。
The Strong Survive#627.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#628.dst: [-{~}, {~}, {~}] から Tericen を脱出する。

The Strong Survive#629.src: Escape through the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Strong Survive#629.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Tericen の入口から脱出する。

The Strong Survive#630.src: We're leaving through the main entrance? What if a guard spots us?
The Strong Survive#630.dst: 正面入口から出るの？衛兵に見つかったらどうするの？
The Strong Survive#630.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#631.src: Alright, I'll try to stay close.
The Strong Survive#631.dst: 分かった、離れないようにするよ。
The Strong Survive#631.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#633.src: Weird... There seems to be no guards on duty...
The Strong Survive#633.dst: 変だな…見張りの衛兵が一人もいないみたいだ…
The Strong Survive#633.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#635.dst: これはどこから来たんだ！？
The Strong Survive#635.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#637.src: Where are you off to? I don't remember dismissing either of you.
The Strong Survive#637.dst: どこへ行く？二人とも下がってよいと言った覚えはないが。
The Strong Survive#637.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#638.src: I would have thought that by now you'd both know insubordination isn't tolerated here. Neither is treason...
The Strong Survive#638.dst: もう分かっていると思っていたがな、ここでは命令違反は許されん。反逆もだ…
The Strong Survive#638.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#639.src: Does Arnol know you're a spy? Imagine what his family would think, if they found out he's conspiring with the resistance.
The Strong Survive#639.dst: Arnol は君が密偵だと知っているのか？彼がレジスタンスと共謀していると知ったら、家族はどう思うだろうな。
The Strong Survive#639.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#641.src: I'll let them deal with him. But you... the responsibility of prosecuting you has been lended to me.
The Strong Survive#641.dst: 彼の処分は家族に任せよう。だが君は…君を裁く責任は私に委ねられている。
The Strong Survive#641.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#643.src: There is no hope for you or your kind in Fruma!
The Strong Survive#643.dst: Fruma に君や君の同類の望みはない！
The Strong Survive#643.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#644.src: I've never lost a duel, don't fool yourself into thinking I'd let you change that!
The Strong Survive#644.dst: 私は決闘で負けたことがない、それを君が覆せるなどと思い上がるな！
The Strong Survive#644.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#645.src: I won't die here! Not to the likes of you!
The Strong Survive#645.dst: ここで死んでたまるか！貴様ごときに！
The Strong Survive#645.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#647.src: That's enough Commander, you're clearly outmatched.
The Strong Survive#647.dst: もう十分です司令官、明らかにあなたの負けだ。
The Strong Survive#647.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#648.src: Thank you... For looking out for me after everything, even though you had no reason to...
The Strong Survive#648.dst: ありがとう…あんなことがあったのに、理由もないのに僕を気にかけてくれて…
The Strong Survive#648.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#649.src: I've spent my whole life drifting, aimless... But now I know what my purpose is, thanks to you...
The Strong Survive#649.dst: ずっと目的もなく流されて生きてきた…でも君のおかげで、自分の目的が分かったよ…
The Strong Survive#649.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#650.src: My purpose is to make sure that tyrants like Commander Ferreo meet their just end. It seems like this may be your goal as well.
The Strong Survive#650.dst: 僕の目的は、Ferreo 司令官のような暴君に相応の末路を迎えさせること。君の目標もそうみたいだね。
The Strong Survive#650.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#651.src: I must go out on my own now, I hope that one day we meet again. I promise you I'll be stronger by then!
The Strong Survive#651.dst: これからは一人で行かなきゃ。いつかまた会えるといいな。その時にはもっと強くなってると約束するよ！
The Strong Survive#651.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#652.src: I was raised to believe that the cursed ones were wicked, yet you've been nothing but helpful. Seems like that was just another lie...
The Strong Survive#652.dst: 呪われし者は邪悪だと教わって育ったけど、君は助けてくれてばかりだった。あれも嘘の一つだったんだね…
The Strong Survive#652.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#653.src: Are you a recruit as well? You certainly look strong. I imagine you must have a lot of experience.
The Strong Survive#653.dst: 君も新兵か？確かに強そうだ。さぞ経験豊富なんだろうな。
The Strong Survive#653.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#654.src: I am a bit newer to this than you, but I may still be able to offer you some insights if you're curious.
The Strong Survive#654.dst: 私は君より少し新米だが、興味があれば何か教えてやれるかもしれん。
The Strong Survive#654.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#655.src: Well... A carriage rode me halfway to {p}, then it broke down and I had to walk the rest of the way. When I finally arrived the King himself was there to greet me and made me a recruit.
The Strong Survive#655.dst: そうだな…馬車で {p} への道の半ばまで来たが、壊れて残りは歩きだった。ようやく着いたら国王陛下自ら出迎えて、私を新兵にしてくださった。
The Strong Survive#655.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#656.src: I can't seem to remember anything before that though... It probably wasn't too important, what's important is my new job as a recruit!
The Strong Survive#656.dst: その前のことはどうも思い出せんが…大して重要じゃないだろう、大事なのは新兵という新しい仕事だ！
The Strong Survive#656.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#657.src: I wonder if the King will give me a promotion soon...
The Strong Survive#657.dst: 国王はそろそろ私を昇進させてくださるだろうか…
The Strong Survive#657.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#658.src: No... I can't say I have ever seen you before... Are you a fan or something?
The Strong Survive#658.dst: いや…君には会った覚えがないな…ファンか何かか？
The Strong Survive#658.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#659.src: I didn't imagine having fans already but that's great! I'm already on the path of becoming the most famous person in Wynn!
The Strong Survive#659.dst: もうファンがいるとは思わなかったが、素晴らしい！私はもう Wynn で一番有名な人物への道を歩んでいるのだ！
The Strong Survive#659.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#660.src: Waiting? I'm not waiting for anything! I'm just resting... That's all!
The Strong Survive#660.dst: 待つ？何も待ってなどいない！ただ休んでいるだけだ…それだけだ！
The Strong Survive#660.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#661.src: It's tiring doing so much work out there. Plus I need to give the other recruits and guards a chance to prove themselves, I shouldn't hog all of the glory!
The Strong Survive#661.dst: 外であれだけ働くと疲れるんだ。それに他の新兵や衛兵にも自分を証明する機会をやらんとな、栄光を独り占めしてはいかん！
The Strong Survive#661.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#662.src: You don't need to worry about me, I'll be fine out there. Just because you look stronger doesn't mean I'm weak!
The Strong Survive#662.dst: 私の心配はいらん、外でも大丈夫だ。君が強そうに見えるからといって、私が弱いわけではない！
The Strong Survive#662.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#663.src: You're the one who should be worried... Worried about me surpassing you of course!
The Strong Survive#663.dst: 心配すべきは君のほうだ…もちろん、私に追い抜かれる心配をな！
The Strong Survive#663.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#664.src: But hey, we're on the same side, so let's both keep fighting out there! For the King!
The Strong Survive#664.dst: だがまあ、我々は同じ側だ、お互い外で戦い続けよう！国王のために！
The Strong Survive#664.speaker: Effal

The Thanos Depository#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で何が起きているか調べる

The Thanos Depository#001.src: This is just a disaster... I pray nothing goes awry with the recovery team.
The Thanos Depository#001.dst: まったくの惨事だ…回収隊に何事もないよう祈るばかりだ。
The Thanos Depository#001.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#002.src: I'd never be able to live it off if I'm responsible for more deaths.
The Thanos Depository#002.dst: これ以上死者を出す責任を負ったら、一生立ち直れん。
The Thanos Depository#002.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#003.src: But I must do what it takes to prevent {p} from any more disaster.
The Thanos Depository#003.dst: だが {p} をこれ以上の災いから守るためなら、何でもせねば。
The Thanos Depository#003.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#005.src: Atila, you're back! Give it to me straight, did they succeed? We can't afford any more losses.
The Thanos Depository#005.dst: Atila、戻ったか！はっきり言ってくれ、成功したのか？もうこれ以上の損失は許されんのだ。
The Thanos Depository#005.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#007.src: The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble.
The Thanos Depository#007.dst: 昇降機は竜の寝床に直結しています。いつ眠っているか分からない以上、賭けです。
The Thanos Depository#007.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#008.src: So we truly do need to go through the vault. But with the defense systems gone haywire...
The Thanos Depository#008.dst: やはり金庫を通るしかないか。だが防衛装置が暴走している今…
The Thanos Depository#008.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#009.dst: 申し訳ありません、閣下…
The Thanos Depository#009.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#010.src: Think nothing of it, let's get back to the drawing board.
The Thanos Depository#010.dst: 気にするな。一から練り直そう。
The Thanos Depository#010.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#011.src: Yes, I'll get to it immediately.
The Thanos Depository#011.dst: はっ、すぐに取りかかります。
The Thanos Depository#011.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#012.src: You there, human! What's your business here? Come speak to me.
The Thanos Depository#012.dst: そこの人間！ここに何の用だ？こっちへ来て話してくれ。
The Thanos Depository#012.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#013.src: What's your business here? This place is off limits, the vault is very dangerous right now.
The Thanos Depository#013.dst: ここに何の用だ？立入禁止だぞ、金庫は今とても危険なのだ。
The Thanos Depository#013.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#014.src: Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high-quality, yeah? What's your name?
The Thanos Depository#014.dst: おや、よく見ればその装備、なかなかの上物じゃないか？名は何という？
The Thanos Depository#014.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#015.src: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're that guy who defeated that Qira woman, yeah?
The Thanos Depository#015.dst: …その名、どこかで聞いたような…そうだ！あの Qira という女を倒した者だな？
The Thanos Depository#015.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#016.src: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're the one who helped resolve the whole Dogun thing, right?
The Thanos Depository#016.dst: …その名、どこかで聞いたような…そうだ！Dogun の一件を片付けてくれた者だな？
The Thanos Depository#016.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#017.src: I see, I haven't seen you around before.
The Thanos Depository#017.dst: そうか、この辺りでは見ない顔だな。
The Thanos Depository#017.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#018.src: Nevertheless, {p} is in danger. To put it simply, a dragon is living uninvited in our depository.
The Thanos Depository#018.dst: ともかく、{p} は危機にある。手短に言うと、竜が勝手に我らの保管庫に住み着いたのだ。
The Thanos Depository#018.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#019.src: Perhaps, you've seen its lair above our city. Normally she leaves us unharmed, but one day she suddenly made her way in to this vault.
The Thanos Depository#019.dst: 街の上にある巣を見たかもしれんな。普段は我らに害をなさんが、ある日突然この金庫に入り込んだのだ。
The Thanos Depository#019.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#020.src: My great friend Atila has been leading a recon squad, he's discerned that she's nesting an egg.
The Thanos Depository#020.dst: 我が友 Atila が偵察隊を率いて調べたところ、奴は卵を温めているらしい。
The Thanos Depository#020.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#021.src: We've tried at our greatest expenses to steal the egg, and bring it back to her nest, so that maybe she would leave... But, as you've heard, it's not going well.
The Thanos Depository#021.dst: 我らは多大な犠牲を払って卵を盗み出し、巣へ戻そうとした。そうすれば出て行くかもと…だが、聞いての通り、うまくいっていない。
The Thanos Depository#021.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#022.src: I don't normally ask this of strangers, but we've run ourselves thin. Do you think you're up to help? I'll make sure it's all worth your trouble.
The Thanos Depository#022.dst: 普段はよそ者に頼まんのだが、もう手が尽きた。手を貸してくれるか？骨折りには必ず報いよう。
The Thanos Depository#022.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#023.src: So you'll help!? Thank you so much! I'll make sure it's worth every moment!
The Thanos Depository#023.dst: 手伝ってくれるのか！？本当にありがとう！決して無駄にはさせん！
The Thanos Depository#023.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#024.src: You'll have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
The Thanos Depository#024.dst: 保管庫へは、私の後ろのこの部屋を抜けねばならん。他の入口はまさに竜のいる場所だけでな…
The Thanos Depository#024.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#025.src: Atila knows some of the inner workings of the vault. I bid you good luck and will be praying for your success. Your courage will inspire {p}.
The Thanos Depository#025.dst: Atila は金庫の内部に多少詳しい。幸運を祈る、成功を願っているぞ。君の勇気は {p} を奮い立たせるだろう。
The Thanos Depository#025.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#026.src: Oh, so it wasn't meant to be I suppose...
The Thanos Depository#026.dst: そうか、縁がなかったようだな…
The Thanos Depository#026.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#027.src: Well, if we cross paths again, I'll always much appreciate your help... Back to the drawing board...
The Thanos Depository#027.dst: まあ、また会うことがあれば、いつでも助けは大歓迎だ…一から練り直しだな…
The Thanos Depository#027.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#030.src: Find a way through the depository.
The Thanos Depository#030.dst: 保管庫を抜ける道を探す。

The Thanos Depository#031.src: Ride the minecarts to get further in to the depository
The Thanos Depository#031.dst: トロッコに乗って保管庫の奥へ進む

The Thanos Depository#032.src: Steal Ozoth's egg and escape the depository.
The Thanos Depository#032.dst: Ozoth の卵を盗み、保管庫から脱出する。

The Thanos Depository#034.src: Oh-oh my gosh!! I took you for dead, and thought the dragon was sending me up a corpse!
The Thanos Depository#034.dst: う、うわあっ！！死んだものと思って、竜が死体を送ってきたのかと！
The Thanos Depository#034.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#035.src: You really got it!? Hurry, then, the nest is up through this cave! Maybe {p} can finally be rid of its woes...
The Thanos Depository#035.dst: 本当に取ってきたんですか！？では急いで、巣はこの洞窟の上です！これで {p} もついに悩みから解放されるかも…
The Thanos Depository#035.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#036.src: Place Ozoth's egg back in her nest at [{~},-{~}].
The Thanos Depository#036.dst: [{~},-{~}] の巣に Ozoth の卵を戻す。

The Thanos Depository#038.src: She's a beauty, isn't she? A monster though, nevertheless.
The Thanos Depository#038.dst: 美しいでしょう？とはいえ、怪物には違いありませんが。
The Thanos Depository#038.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#039.src: {u}! Over here... Atila told me the news, I came as fast as I could!
The Thanos Depository#039.dst: {u}！こっちだ…Atila から聞いて、急いで駆けつけたぞ！
The Thanos Depository#039.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#040.src: You're a hero, lad! With the dragon out of our city, {p} no longer has to live in fear.
The Thanos Depository#040.dst: 君は英雄だ！竜が街から去り、{p} はもう恐れて暮らさずに済む。
The Thanos Depository#040.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#041.src: I've prepared your reward. The people of {p} will remember your contribution for years to come.
The Thanos Depository#041.dst: 報酬を用意しておいた。{p} の民は君の貢献を末永く忘れんだろう。
The Thanos Depository#041.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#000~1.src: Thank you again...soldier. For helping us make peace...
The Thanos Depository#000~1.dst: 改めてありがとう…兵士さん。和平に力を貸してくれて…

The Thanos Depository#002~1.src: Please take a track controller before entering the rail line.
The Thanos Depository#002~1.dst: 線路に入る前に線路コントローラーを持っていってください。

The Thanos Depository#011~1.src: The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble...
The Thanos Depository#011~1.dst: エレベーターは竜が横たわる場所に直結しています。いつ眠っているかわからない以上、賭けですね…
The Thanos Depository#011~1.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#012~1.src: It's a great feat what you've accomplished. The dwarven defense system was thought to be impeccable. We'll need to rethink our security!
The Thanos Depository#012~1.dst: 見事な偉業だ。ドワーフの防衛システムは完璧だと思われていた。警備を考え直さないとな！

The Thanos Depository#020~1.src: Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high quality, yeah? What's your name?
The Thanos Depository#020~1.dst: よく見ると、その装備、かなりの上物じゃないか？名前は？
The Thanos Depository#020~1.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#031~1.src: You have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
The Thanos Depository#031~1.dst: 保管庫へ行くには、私の後ろのこの部屋を抜けるしかない。他の入口は、ちょうどドラゴンのいる場所なんだ…
The Thanos Depository#031~1.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#032~1.src: The people of {p} have everlasting gratitude, soldier.
The Thanos Depository#032~1.dst: {p} の民は永遠に君に感謝するだろう、兵士よ。

The Thanos Depository#033~1.dst: 新しいクエスト開始: {p} 保管庫

The Ultimate Weapon#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Dodegar Bandysnoot と話す。

The Ultimate Weapon#001.src: I'm glad you came along, I could do with a little help if you're not too busy.
The Ultimate Weapon#001.dst: 来てくれてよかった、忙しくなければちょっと手伝ってほしいんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#001.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#002.src: I'm Dodegar Bandysnoot, the world famous Hobbit swordsmith! Perhaps you've heard of me?
The Ultimate Weapon#002.dst: 僕は Dodegar Bandysnoot、世界的に有名なホビットの刀鍛冶さ！聞いたことあるかな？
The Ultimate Weapon#002.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#003.src: No? Oh... Well, I've had an idea about how I could make the best weapon that the world has ever seen!
The Ultimate Weapon#003.dst: ない？そう…まあいいや、世界一の武器を作る方法を思いついたんだ！
The Ultimate Weapon#003.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#004.src: But, I need some help getting the special resources to make it.
The Ultimate Weapon#004.dst: でも、作るための特別な材料集めを手伝ってほしいんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#004.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#005.src: You'll help?! Excellent! We shall gather enough resources to make one for each of us!
The Ultimate Weapon#005.dst: 手伝ってくれる？！やった！二人分作れるだけの材料を集めよう！
The Ultimate Weapon#005.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#006.src: So firstly, I need some living wood for the handle, [{~} Enchanted Stick] should be enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#006.dst: まず、柄にする生きた木が要る。[{~} Enchanted Stick] あれば足りるはず。
The Ultimate Weapon#006.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#007.src: The wood sprites located across the river to the west, in a big tree trunk, have magical properties! The handle can then mold to the user's hand! One shouldn't be too hard to come across!
The Ultimate Weapon#007.dst: 西の川向こう、大きな木の幹にいる木の精には魔力があるんだ！それで柄が使い手の手に馴染むってわけ！一本くらいならすぐ手に入るはずさ！
The Ultimate Weapon#007.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#008.src: I hope you are prepared, this will be your best quest yet!
The Ultimate Weapon#008.dst: 準備はいい？これまでで最高のクエストになるよ！
The Ultimate Weapon#008.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#009.src: Collect [{~} Enchanted Stick] from Wood Sprites at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return them to Dodegar
The Ultimate Weapon#009.dst: [{~} Enchanted Stick] を木の精 ([-{~}, {~}, -{~}]) から集め、Dodegar に届ける

The Ultimate Weapon#010.src: Wow! You got the wood I needed, thanks!
The Ultimate Weapon#010.dst: わあ！欲しかった木だ、ありがとう！
The Ultimate Weapon#010.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#011.src: While I'm making the handle, could you help me with the blade?
The Ultimate Weapon#011.dst: 僕が柄を作ってる間に、刃の方を手伝ってくれる？
The Ultimate Weapon#011.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#012.src: Since we want this weapon to be as good as possible we need to find some sacred Hobbit metal!
The Ultimate Weapon#012.dst: 最高の武器にしたいから、神聖なホビットの金属を見つけなきゃ！
The Ultimate Weapon#012.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#013.src: The hobbit village, The Shiar, is really close! Follow the southern road. My brother Gogedar should be there!
The Ultimate Weapon#013.dst: ホビットの村 The Shiar はすぐ近くだよ！南の道を行って。弟の Gogedar がいるはず！
The Ultimate Weapon#013.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#014.src: Dodegar needs [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] from the Shiar at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Ultimate Weapon#014.dst: Dodegar には [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] が必要。[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の The Shiar で手に入れる

The Ultimate Weapon#015.src: My brother you say... Trying to create a weapon...
The Ultimate Weapon#015.dst: 兄貴がって…武器を作ろうとしてる…？
The Ultimate Weapon#015.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#017.src: Oh he needs Sacred Hobbit Metal!?
The Ultimate Weapon#017.dst: えっ、神聖なホビットの金属が要るって！？
The Ultimate Weapon#017.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#019.src: Sorry can't help you. I don't really know what that is.
The Ultimate Weapon#019.dst: 悪いけど力になれない。それが何なのかよく知らないんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#019.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#020.dst: いとこの Togedar に聞いてみたら？
The Ultimate Weapon#020.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#021.dst: The Shiar で Togedar を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#022.src: Dodegar? Does not really ring a bell I'm afraid.
The Ultimate Weapon#022.dst: Dodegar？悪いけど、ピンと来ないね。
The Ultimate Weapon#022.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#023.src: Oh! Gogedar's brother, why didn't you tell me that.
The Ultimate Weapon#023.dst: ああ！Gogedar の兄さんか、それを先に言ってよ。
The Ultimate Weapon#023.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#024.src: Sacred Hobbit Metal... This is a metal forged by master blacksmith hobbits within our village. It is a bit expensive to get by but holds great potential, if used properly.
The Ultimate Weapon#024.dst: 神聖なホビットの金属…村の名匠ホビットたちが鍛えた金属さ。手に入れるには少々高いが、うまく使えば大きな可能性を秘めている。
The Ultimate Weapon#024.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#025.dst: おや。一つ欲しいのかい？
The Ultimate Weapon#025.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#026.src: I don't have any. Maybe ask my nephew's brother Alegdar?
The Ultimate Weapon#026.dst: 持ってないよ。おいっ子の兄貴の Alegdar に聞いてみたら？
The Ultimate Weapon#026.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#027.dst: The Shiar で Alegdar を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#029.src: I actually don't know much about... anything.
The Ultimate Weapon#029.dst: 実は僕、何も…よく知らないんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#029.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#030.src: I kind of just... stand around here.
The Ultimate Weapon#030.dst: ただ…ここに立ってるだけっていうか。
The Ultimate Weapon#030.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#031.src: Everyone I have ever met just calls me annoying and useless. So I decided to stop trying.
The Ultimate Weapon#031.dst: 会う人みんなに、うざくて役立たずって言われる。だから頑張るのはやめたんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#031.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#032.src: You know, life is hard. We all just have to fight through, and then eventually, we might become happy.
The Ultimate Weapon#032.dst: 人生ってつらいよね。みんな耐えて戦うしかない、そしたらいつか幸せになれるかも。
The Ultimate Weapon#032.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#033.src: Right sorry... Ask Balegar for any information. He is way smarter.
The Ultimate Weapon#033.dst: あ、ごめん…話なら Balegar に聞いて。彼の方がずっと賢いから。
The Ultimate Weapon#033.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#034.dst: The Shiar で Balegar を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#035.src: My cousin's nephew's dad has had a rough year... I feel bad for him.
The Ultimate Weapon#035.dst: いとこのおいっ子の親父が散々な一年でさ…気の毒だよ。
The Ultimate Weapon#035.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#037.src: I have nooooo clue about that metal. I heard it was just a valuable as a normal rock.
The Ultimate Weapon#037.dst: その金属のことはさーっぱり分からん。ただの石と同じくらいの値打ちだって聞いたけど。
The Ultimate Weapon#037.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#038.src: Maybe my cousin Reyoretrsed knows anything about it.
The Ultimate Weapon#038.dst: いとこの Reyoretrsed なら何か知ってるかも。
The Ultimate Weapon#038.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#039.dst: The Shiar で Reyoretrsed を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#041.src: You are wondering how my name is pronounced? What a rude question.
The Ultimate Weapon#041.dst: 私の名前の読み方が知りたい？なんと失礼な質問だ。
The Ultimate Weapon#041.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#042.src: Ray-ore-tree-sed, obviously. What is a human doing here?
The Ultimate Weapon#042.dst: レイ・オア・ツリー・セッド、当然だろう。人間がここで何をしている？
The Ultimate Weapon#042.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#043.src: You are wondering if I have Sacred whatever metal?
The Ultimate Weapon#043.dst: 神聖な何とかの金属を持っているかって？
The Ultimate Weapon#043.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#044.src: I'm {~}. Now if you excuse me, I am busy standing still. Go bother Richard or something.
The Ultimate Weapon#044.dst: 私は {~}。さて失礼、じっと立っているので忙しいのだ。Richard にでも絡んでくれ。
The Ultimate Weapon#044.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#045.dst: The Shiar で Richard を探す。

The Ultimate Weapon#046.src: I've been trying to tell you that I have what you need.
The Ultimate Weapon#046.dst: 必要な物はここにあるって、ずっと言おうとしてたんだけど。
The Ultimate Weapon#046.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#047.src: You humans really need to practice your communication skills, please.
The Ultimate Weapon#047.dst: 人間ってのは、本当に会話の練習をした方がいいよ。
The Ultimate Weapon#047.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#048.src: Anyway, here. Take it! This metal is just a scam anyway, nothing special with it.
The Ultimate Weapon#048.dst: とにかく、ほら。持っていきな！どうせこの金属はただのインチキで、特別なところなんてないさ。
The Ultimate Weapon#048.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#049.src: Return to Dodegar with the metal.
The Ultimate Weapon#049.dst: 金属を持って Dodegar の所へ戻る。

The Ultimate Weapon#050.src: I hope it wasn't too much of an issue to get!
The Ultimate Weapon#050.dst: 手に入れるの、そんなに大変じゃなかったならいいけど！
The Ultimate Weapon#050.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#051.src: ... I forgot a step. I can't attach a blade without a binder material.
The Ultimate Weapon#051.dst: …工程を一つ忘れてた。接着剤がないと刃が付けられない。
The Ultimate Weapon#051.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#052.src: I need the nectar of a native flower of the forest to attach it. [{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] would do the trick.
The Ultimate Weapon#052.dst: 取り付けるには森の固有種の花の蜜が要るんだ。[{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] があればいける。
The Ultimate Weapon#052.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#053.src: Finding the flower can be rather difficult, here's a riddle on how to find it.
The Ultimate Weapon#053.dst: その花を見つけるのはちょっと難しいから、探し方のなぞなぞを出すね。
The Ultimate Weapon#053.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#054.src: On the side of a hut, hidden inside a hole. Resting in a forest of light, without plight. Whatever that would mean.
The Ultimate Weapon#054.dst: 小屋の脇、穴の中に隠れ。光の森に憂いなく眠る。どういう意味か知らないけど。
The Ultimate Weapon#054.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#055.src: Find the Diplacus Aurantiacus by following the riddle to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Ultimate Weapon#055.dst: なぞなぞを頼りに [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Diplacus Aurantiacus を見つける。

The Ultimate Weapon#056.src: Hold up! This feels waaay, toooo easy.
The Ultimate Weapon#056.dst: 待った！簡単すぎーーーる！
The Ultimate Weapon#056.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#057.src: If I'm going to give you this amazingly, incredible, showstopping, crazy item particulary for free, you need to at least work for it!
The Ultimate Weapon#057.dst: この驚異的で信じられないほど最高にぶっ飛んだ品を「タダ」であげるんだから、せめて苦労くらいはしてもらわないと！
The Ultimate Weapon#057.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#060.src: This looks so much better! Anyway, bring me that flower now!
The Ultimate Weapon#060.dst: こっちの方がずっといい！とにかく、あの花を持ってきて！
The Ultimate Weapon#060.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#061.src: Talk to Dodegar with the Diplacus Aurantiacus.
The Ultimate Weapon#061.dst: Diplacus Aurantiacus を持って Dodegar と話す。

The Ultimate Weapon#062.src: Took you a while, did it not?
The Ultimate Weapon#062.dst: ずいぶん時間がかかったね？
The Ultimate Weapon#062.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#063.src: It's starting to look pretty amazing! Just like it's supposed to I'm sure!
The Ultimate Weapon#063.dst: すごくいい感じになってきた！きっとこれで合ってるはず！
The Ultimate Weapon#063.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#064.src: Maybe this will actually work out. Either way, last ingredient we need!
The Ultimate Weapon#064.dst: 本当にうまくいくかも。何にせよ、あと最後の材料だ！
The Ultimate Weapon#064.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#065.src: So to finalize and apply some magical properties to this uniquely amazing item we need something known as Luster Blood.
The Ultimate Weapon#065.dst: この唯一無二の傑作を仕上げて魔力を宿すには、「輝きの血」と呼ばれるものが必要なんだ。
The Ultimate Weapon#065.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#066.src: The only known creature in the west, probably in the whole world, if I'm being frank, is known as the Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld, not sure where the name comes from.
The Ultimate Weapon#066.dst: 西で、正直に言えば世界中でも、それを持つと知られる唯一の生き物は Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld。名前の由来は知らない。
The Ultimate Weapon#066.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#067.src: I happen to know that this beetle lives in a cave in the eastern ravine thingy! If you walk straight east, you should stumble upon it, I promise!
The Ultimate Weapon#067.dst: その甲虫は東の峡谷みたいな所の洞窟に住んでるって知ってるんだ！まっすぐ東へ歩けば出くわすはず、約束するよ！
The Ultimate Weapon#067.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#068.src: Oh! Almost forgot to mention, about {~} Luster Blood is probably enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#068.dst: あ！言い忘れてた、輝きの血は {~} 個くらいあれば足りると思う。
The Ultimate Weapon#068.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#069.src: Find the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Luster Blood] and bring it back to Dodegar.
The Ultimate Weapon#069.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟を見つけ、[{~} Luster Blood] を Dodegar に持ち帰る。

The Ultimate Weapon#070.src: Do not step any closer... Or I will be forced to obliterate you!
The Ultimate Weapon#070.dst: それ以上近づくな…さもなくば消し去るぞ！

The Ultimate Weapon#071.src: The final component! It is finally here!
The Ultimate Weapon#071.dst: 最後の部品！ついに揃った！
The Ultimate Weapon#071.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#073.src: Do you see how it's glowing, sparkling and... and radiating!
The Ultimate Weapon#073.dst: 見て、光って、きらめいて…輝きを放ってる！
The Ultimate Weapon#073.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#074.src: You don't? Uhm... maybe you need glasses humie.
The Ultimate Weapon#074.dst: 見えない？えっと…メガネが要るんじゃない、人間くん。
The Ultimate Weapon#074.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#075.src: As promised! Here you go! Always happy to practice the art of weapon creation.
The Ultimate Weapon#075.dst: 約束通り！はいどうぞ！武器作りの腕を磨けるのはいつでも大歓迎さ。
The Ultimate Weapon#075.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#000~1.src: The metal is rather rare so I don't know if you can even find it...
The Ultimate Weapon#000~1.dst: その金属はかなり珍しいから、見つけられるかどうか…

The Worm Holes#000.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Worm Holes#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で何が起きているか調べる

The Worm Holes#001.src: Arrighty fellers, let's get this wrapped up now! 'ere's plenty more holes where this one came from!
The Worm Holes#001.dst: よーし野郎ども、ここらで片付けちまうぞ！穴ならまだ山ほどあるんだからな！
The Worm Holes#001.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#003.src: The scaffolds are crackin'! Everyone, get offa there, now!!
The Worm Holes#003.dst: 足場が割れてる！全員、今すぐそこから降りろ！！
The Worm Holes#003.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#005.src: Aw, hell... I knew this project was a bust from the start...there goes Willam and Clint cause a' this!
The Worm Holes#005.dst: ちくしょう…この仕事は最初からダメだと思ってたんだ…Willam と Clint がこのせいで…！
The Worm Holes#005.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#006.src: I gotta get someone tough enough to get down there...hm? Hey, a human! Git on over here!
The Worm Holes#006.dst: 下まで行ける頑丈な奴を探さねえと…ん？おい、人間じゃねえか！こっち来い！
The Worm Holes#006.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#007.src: I gotta ask, how much 'a that didja see, Wynn feller? Wasn't pretty, and I'm in charge a' them folks, so I gotta take responsibility fer that.
The Worm Holes#007.dst: 聞くが、今のをどれくらい見た、Wynn の兄ちゃん？ひでえもんだったろ。あいつらは俺の部下だ、責任は俺が取らなきゃならねえ。
The Worm Holes#007.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#008.src: Th' mayor of {p} there saw these holes poppin' up, and hired us out to cover 'em up. Thing is, the ground's too unstable to build.
The Worm Holes#008.dst: あそこの {p} の村長が穴が次々空くのを見て、埋めるために俺らを雇ったんだ。だが地盤がゆるすぎて何も建てられねえ。
The Worm Holes#008.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#009.src: It's gettin' real worrying round here. They only started openin' up recently, and there've been quakes too. Feels like the place is gonna collapse!
The Worm Holes#009.dst: この辺りはどんどん物騒になってる。穴が開き始めたのはつい最近で、地震まで起きてる。この土地ごと崩れそうだ！
The Worm Holes#009.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#010.src: I think we oughta head down there and figure out what 'n heck's goin' on, and you're the best armed outta any of us, being human 'n all.
The Worm Holes#010.dst: 下へ行って何が起きてんのか突き止めるべきだと思う。で、人間のあんたが俺らの中で一番いい装備してるってわけだ。
The Worm Holes#010.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#011.src: Think y'all could head down 'n see if you can rustle up any leads? There's a path down just to the left of the hole.
The Worm Holes#011.dst: 下りて手がかりを探してきてくれねえか？穴のすぐ左に下りる道がある。
The Worm Holes#011.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#012.src: Go down the hole and look for what's causing this and return to Malo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with proof.
The Worm Holes#012.dst: 穴に下りて原因を探り、証拠を持って [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Malo の所へ戻る。

The Worm Holes#013.src: What in tarnation...? The heck did you find down there, soldier?
The Worm Holes#013.dst: なんてこった…？下で何を見つけてきたんだ、兵隊さん？
The Worm Holes#013.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#014.src: Oh, it was just the skin, huh? Dang...was hopin' you'd've seen what it was, cause I got no clue 'bout this.
The Worm Holes#014.dst: ああ、ただの皮か？くそ…何なのか見てきてくれりゃと思ったんだがな、俺にはさっぱりだ。
The Worm Holes#014.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#015.src: Urgh. Only gal I know who might have an idea 'bout this is that durn elf lady...
The Worm Holes#015.dst: うーん。こいつが分かりそうなのは、あのいまいましいエルフの姉ちゃんくらいだ…
The Worm Holes#015.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#016.src: She's got purple hair and's been wanderin' round like she knows everything. Yeah, she's a bright penny but she ain't gotta be so uppity ta all of us 'bout it.
The Worm Holes#016.dst: 紫の髪で、何でも知ってるって顔でうろついてる。まあ頭はいいんだが、俺らにそこまで偉そうにしなくてもいいだろうに。
The Worm Holes#016.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#017.src: She put up a camp just east of here. She'll prob'ly react better to you than me, so I'll go to the authorities and see if they have any leads.
The Worm Holes#017.dst: ここのすぐ東に野営してる。俺よりあんたの方が話を聞いてもらえるだろう。俺はお役所に行って手がかりがないか聞いてくる。
The Worm Holes#017.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#018.src: Look for Lari and ask what is going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Worm Holes#018.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Lari を探し、何が起きているか尋ねる

The Worm Holes#019.src: ...Haven’t we met? I have witnessed your presence in Gavel more than once.
The Worm Holes#019.dst: …以前お会いしましたね？Gavel であなたの姿を何度か見かけました。
The Worm Holes#019.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#020.src: I am Lari. I might have greeted you properly before if I were not so busy, which reminds me. You have a reason to be here, yes?
The Worm Holes#020.dst: 私は Lari。これほど忙しくなければ、以前きちんとご挨拶できたのですが…そういえば。ここに来たのには理由があるのでしょう？
The Worm Holes#020.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#021.src: Hm...I believe I know what you have found, by your description. That dead skin too, is proof enough, I would say.
The Worm Holes#021.dst: ふむ…お話からすると、見つけたものの正体は分かります。その抜け殻も十分な証拠でしょう。
The Worm Holes#021.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#022.src: The creature which shed that skin is known as a Grootslang. Though large, they are rather peaceful. Gentle giants, I believe the saying is?
The Worm Holes#022.dst: その皮を脱いだ生き物は Grootslang といいます。大きいけれど、とても穏やかです。「気は優しくて力持ち」、でしたか？
The Worm Holes#022.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#023.src: This horrid Decay...it affects their habitats underground. They are seeking shelter closer to the surface. I have been trying to scrub the Decay without success...
The Worm Holes#023.dst: この恐ろしい腐朽が…地下の棲みかを侵しているのです。彼らは地表近くへ逃れてきている。私は腐朽を払おうとしてきましたが、うまくいかず…
The Worm Holes#023.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#024.src: Wait... More holes appeared just today? There...there were deaths?! W-where, when?!
The Worm Holes#024.dst: 待って…今日また穴が？そこで…死者が出たの！？ど、どこで、いつ！？
The Worm Holes#024.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#025.src: No, no...! I refuse to be responsible for any more deaths... Human, tell me your name, please.
The Worm Holes#025.dst: だめ、だめ…！これ以上の死の責任は負えない…人間さん、どうか名前を教えて。
The Worm Holes#025.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#026.src: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. {u}. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.
The Worm Holes#026.dst: {u}、ですね…現場へ向かいましょう。{u}。私が何とかしないと…どうか、土地の痛みを癒せるよう、問題の根源を突き止めるのを手伝って。
The Worm Holes#026.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#027.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Lari と合流する

The Worm Holes#028.src: So this is the site... [Gavellian Spell]...
The Worm Holes#028.dst: ここが現場ですね…[Gavellian Spell]…
The Worm Holes#028.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#029.src: Here. Allow me to provide at least one person safe passage into the pit.
The Worm Holes#029.dst: さあ。せめて一人だけでも、安全に穴の底へ送らせて。
The Worm Holes#029.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#030.src: Have faith- Jump in. I will carry you down slowly.
The Worm Holes#030.dst: 信じて―飛び込んで。ゆっくり下ろしてあげます。
The Worm Holes#030.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#031.src: Take the lead. If we can find any further evidence of the Grootslangs around here, it will aid in my understanding.
The Worm Holes#031.dst: 先に進んで。この辺りで Grootslang の痕跡がもっと見つかれば、理解の助けになります。
The Worm Holes#031.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#032.src: Hm? This wall looks like it's been disturbed recently...
The Worm Holes#032.dst: ん？この壁、最近掘り返されたみたい…
The Worm Holes#032.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#033.src: I can hear it...but where is it crawling...?
The Worm Holes#033.dst: 聞こえる…でも、どこへ這っていくの…？
The Worm Holes#033.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#034.src: That's the mother Wyrm! She must be what is making the holes. We need to follow her!
The Worm Holes#034.dst: あれは母 Wyrm！穴を開けていたのは彼女ね。追いかけないと！
The Worm Holes#034.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#035.src: Never mind the spiders, we need to keep following the Wyrm!
The Worm Holes#035.dst: 蜘蛛は放っておいて、Wyrm を追い続けないと！
The Worm Holes#035.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#036.src: Ah...ehm, {u}? I've... Um, this is...a bit difficult to say, but...
The Worm Holes#036.dst: あ…ええと、{u}？私… その、これは…少し言いにくいのですが…
The Worm Holes#036.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#037.src: I...do not believe we need to fight, or to kill, here? The creatures are native to here, we are invading their space.
The Worm Holes#037.dst: 私は…ここで戦ったり殺したりする必要はないと思うの。この生き物たちはここの住人で、侵入者は私たちの方なのよ。
The Worm Holes#037.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#038.src: Why should they be attacked for merely existing in their territory? Even if they are animals, I believe that you can solve these problems without killing.
The Worm Holes#038.dst: 自分の縄張りにいるだけで、なぜ攻撃されなきゃいけないの？動物だとしても、殺さずに解決できるはずよ。
The Worm Holes#038.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#039.src: I...understand you may not have the same powers as myself... And I, ah...am not free of guilt, either. But I think you could stand to take a peaceful stance.
The Worm Holes#039.dst: 私…あなたに私と同じ力がないのは分かってる…それに私も、その…罪がないわけじゃない。でも、平和的な立場を取れると思うの。
The Worm Holes#039.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#040.src: Even if I am alone on that front...though I understand you are taught differently where you come from. I do not envy you, though I still thank you for your aid thusfar.
The Worm Holes#040.dst: そう思うのが私だけでも…あなたの故郷では違う教えを受けたのも分かってる。あなたが羨ましいとは思わないけれど、ここまでの助けには感謝してるわ。
The Worm Holes#040.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#041.src: Your methods are...disagreeable, but you still have a sense of right to you, I feel... Well, the tunnel diverges here. We'll need to split apart.
The Worm Holes#041.dst: あなたのやり方は…賛成できない。でも正しさの感覚は持っている気がする…さて、トンネルがここで分かれてる。二手に分かれましょう。
The Worm Holes#041.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#042.src: I'll go to the right, so you ought to continue to the left here. I will meet up with you again soon, hopefully.
The Worm Holes#042.dst: 私は右へ行くから、あなたはここから左へ進んで。すぐにまた合流できるといいけど。
The Worm Holes#042.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#044.dst: ワームのトンネルを調べる。

The Worm Holes#045.src: Aah! {u}! Don't...don't make any sudden movements.
The Worm Holes#045.dst: ああっ！{u}！動か…急に動かないで。
The Worm Holes#045.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#046.src: This Grootslang is uncharacteristically aggressive... She's scared, being so close to the surface. Stay behind me, please.
The Worm Holes#046.dst: この Grootslang、いつになく攻撃的…地表に近すぎて怯えてるの。私の後ろにいて。
The Worm Holes#046.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#048.src: Do not approach it! The power of the Wyrm is far too much for you!
The Worm Holes#048.dst: 近づかないで！Wyrm の力はあなたには強すぎる！
The Worm Holes#048.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#049.dst: ま、また！？[Gavellian Spell]― ああ、どいて！
The Worm Holes#049.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#050.src: {u}!! You're unharmed, yes? She's scared and in pain!
The Worm Holes#050.dst: {u}！！怪我はない？彼女、怯えて苦しんでるの！
The Worm Holes#050.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#051.src: I have to get it right this time... I'm going to talk her down, stay there!
The Worm Holes#051.dst: 今度こそうまくやらなきゃ…彼女をなだめてみる、そこにいて！
The Worm Holes#051.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#052.src: You must be calm, I beg you. Retreat to the earth- You harm those above!
The Worm Holes#052.dst: どうか落ち着いて。土の中へ戻って―上の人々を傷つけているの！
The Worm Holes#052.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#053.src: The earth rotting... I take full responsibility, but does the grass above not rot also?
The Worm Holes#053.dst: 大地が腐っていく…責任はすべて私にある。でも、地上の草だって腐っているでしょう？
The Worm Holes#053.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#054.src: I wish to soothe your pain, but you must allow me to aid you- You must listen!
The Worm Holes#054.dst: あなたの痛みを癒したいの。でも助けさせてくれなきゃ―聞いて！
The Worm Holes#054.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#055.src: What does this violence solve? Be calm, please!
The Worm Holes#055.dst: 暴力で何が解決するの？お願い、落ち着いて！
The Worm Holes#055.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#056.src: {u}, it won't budge... There's something in its mind rejecting me. Distract it- but don't approach! It will kill you if you get close. Just...be loud!
The Worm Holes#056.dst: {u}、びくともしない…心の中の何かが私を拒んでる。気を引いて―でも近づかないで！近づいたら殺される。とにかく…大声を出して！
The Worm Holes#056.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#057.dst: Lari と共に Grootslang と戦う

The Worm Holes#059.src: Can you hear me?! I'll get her to...to...s-something! Spit you up, I don't know! Just...please, d-don't die!
The Worm Holes#059.dst: 聞こえる！？彼女に…何か…な、何とかさせる！吐き出させるとか、分からないけど！だから…お願い、し、死なないで！
The Worm Holes#059.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#060.src: W-We have... We have not laid a blow against you! It is not right for you to do the same!
The Worm Holes#060.dst: わ、私たちは…あなたに一撃も加えていない！同じことをするのは間違ってる！
The Worm Holes#060.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#061.src: You would wound and consume everything in your rage? Even knowing the consequences?
The Worm Holes#061.dst: 怒りに任せて、すべてを傷つけ飲み込むの？結果を分かっていても？
The Worm Holes#061.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#062.src: Your hunger cannot be sated with this fruitless destruction! I beg of you, let them out!
The Worm Holes#062.dst: こんな無益な破壊で飢えは満たせない！お願い、彼らを出してあげて！
The Worm Holes#062.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#063.src: You know th- W-wait...where did you... AAAH!
The Worm Holes#063.dst: 分かって― ま、待って…どこから… きゃああっ！
The Worm Holes#063.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#064.dst: …あ、あなた… …私…ぶ、無事なの？私…*ひっく* 私…
The Worm Holes#064.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#065.src: I tried...w-why does no one listen to me? Why won't a-anything change for me?
The Worm Holes#065.dst: やったのに…ど、どうして誰も聞いてくれないの？どうして私には何も変えられないの？
The Worm Holes#065.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#066.src: She...she's been eating dark parasites. They're wracking her insides and h-hurting her head...
The Worm Holes#066.dst: 彼女…黒い寄生虫を食べていたの。それが体の中を蝕んで、あ、頭を苦しめてる…
The Worm Holes#066.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#067.src: I...i-it's so d-dark... I c-can't breathe... This...th-this can't be the end...
The Worm Holes#067.dst: 私…す、すごく暗い… い、息ができない… こ…これで終わりなんて…
The Worm Holes#067.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#068.src: I...n-no, I can't die in here... I-I'm needed still... You're n-needed still! I... I...
The Worm Holes#068.dst: 私…い、いや、ここで死ねない… ま、まだ必要とされてる… あなたもまだ必要なの！私… 私…
The Worm Holes#068.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#069.src: I n-need... Or... O-Or... C-Concentrate, Lari... You can do this...
The Worm Holes#069.dst: ひ、必要… それとも… そ、それとも… しゅ、集中よ Lari… できるわ…
The Worm Holes#069.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#071.src: LET US OUT! LET US OUT OF HERE! DON'T LET US DIE LIKE THIS! I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE!!
The Worm Holes#071.dst: 出して！ここから出して！こんな死に方させないで！お願い、頼むから！！
The Worm Holes#071.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#072.src: ...I...oh no... It's...d-d... I... I j-just... I just w-wanted out... Ohhh...n-no...
The Worm Holes#072.dst: …私…そんな… し、死… わ、私はただ… で、出たかっただけ… ああ…い、いや…
The Worm Holes#072.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#073.src: ...w-we're...leaving. I...I c-can't look at this any more...
The Worm Holes#073.dst: …こ、ここを…出ましょう。私…もうこれ以上見ていられない…
The Worm Holes#073.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#075.src: I'm...I'm so sorry, {u}. If I'd...I don't... I don't even know what else I could have d-done...
The Worm Holes#075.dst: 本当に…本当にごめんなさい、{u}。もし私が…分からない… 他に何ができたのかも、わ、分からない…
The Worm Holes#075.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#076.src: There...it didn’t feel like there was...anything left to it... But, if I’d just been quicker, then... Would it...would it even have made a difference?
The Worm Holes#076.dst: あそこには…もう…何も残っていない気がした… でも、もっと早ければ… 何か…何か変わっていたのかな？
The Worm Holes#076.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#077.src: ...some savior I am... I need to be better, but what else even is there that...ugh, I'm going in circles...
The Worm Holes#077.dst: …何が救世主よ… もっとしっかりしなきゃ、でも他に何が…ああ、堂々巡りだわ…
The Worm Holes#077.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#078.dst: もう… もう行きましょう…
The Worm Holes#078.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#079.src: ...I...I can't believe this. This is...does destiny just hate me? What have I done to deserve this?!
The Worm Holes#079.dst: …私…信じられない。これって…運命は私が嫌いなの？何をしたっていうの！？
The Worm Holes#079.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#080.src: The Mother Wyrm laid eggs... Eggs infested with parasites! Every single one is going to be born berserk!!
The Worm Holes#080.dst: 母 Wyrm が卵を産んでいた… 寄生虫に侵された卵を！全部、狂暴な状態で生まれてくる！！
The Worm Holes#080.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#081.src: You saw how strong the mother was...an infestation like this could cause the entire region of Gavel to collapse in a quake...
The Worm Holes#081.dst: 母親の強さは見たでしょう…こんな蔓延が起きたら、Gavel 全土が地震で崩れてしまうかも…
The Worm Holes#081.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#082.src: They...they need to be stopped, but...I can't do it. I c-can't kill... I'm sorry, I just can't!
The Worm Holes#082.dst: 彼らは…止めなきゃいけない、でも…私にはできない。こ、殺せない… ごめんなさい、どうしても無理なの！
The Worm Holes#082.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#083.src: Bring a group... Even Whelps can be a terror if they're enraged. Just...p-please, take care of this quickly.
The Worm Holes#083.dst: 仲間を連れて行って… 幼体でも怒り狂えば脅威よ。だから…お、お願い、早く片付けて。
The Worm Holes#083.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#084.src: You deserve the best... But that's more than I can give...so here. Take these. I'll move along.
The Worm Holes#084.dst: あなたには最高のお礼がふさわしい… でも私にはこれが精一杯…だから、はい。受け取って。私はもう行くわ。
The Worm Holes#084.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#000~1.src: New Questline Started: The Realm of Light
The Worm Holes#000~1.dst: 新しいクエストライン開始: 光の領域

Through the Pipes#000.src: You hear someone in the distance.
Through the Pipes#000.dst: 遠くで誰かの声が聞こえる。

Through the Pipes#001.src: I'm so glad you found it! I don't know what I would do if I lost Soosu's gift and my bag!
Through the Pipes#001.dst: 見つけてくれて本当によかった！Soosu への贈り物もバッグもなくしてたら、どうしていいか分からなかった！

Through the Pipes#002.src: You are? Excellent! Let's see what you've created.
Through the Pipes#002.dst: できたの？すごい！何を作ったか見せて。

Through the Pipes#004.src: Are you sure you want to leave the dock?
Through the Pipes#004.dst: 本当に船着き場を離れる？

Through the Pipes#006.dst: 発電機がうなりを上げて動き出す。

Through the Pipes#007.src: You pull the hook off of the grapple. It might be useful later.
Through the Pipes#007.dst: 鉤爪ロープから鉤を外した。後で役立つかもしれない。

Through the Pipes#009.src: You must be on your raft to use this.
Through the Pipes#009.dst: 使うにはいかだに乗っている必要がある。

Through the Pipes#010.src: Find a way to open that gate. I don't want to be on this raft for any longer!
Through the Pipes#010.dst: あの門を開ける方法を探して。これ以上このいかだに乗っていたくない！

Through the Pipes#012.src: Huh, this isn't- really what I expected.
Through the Pipes#012.dst: あれ、これって…思ってたのと違う。

Through the Pipes#013.src: Are you sure you want to reset your raft?
Through the Pipes#013.dst: いかだをリセットする？

Through the Pipes#014.src: Maybe there's something you could build to get across...
Through the Pipes#014.dst: 渡るために何か作れるかも…

Through the Pipes#015.src: That looks like enough leaf litter. You should return to the generator to fuel it now.
Through the Pipes#015.dst: 落ち葉はこれで足りそうだ。発電機に戻って燃料を入れよう。

Through the Pipes#017.src: Especially considering how rarely Soosu shows up in public, this festival might be my only opportunity this year...
Through the Pipes#017.dst: Soosu が人前に出るのはめったにないし、この祭りが今年唯一のチャンスかも…

Through the Pipes#018.src: You should let Fichu know you're done.
Through the Pipes#018.dst: Fichu に終わったと伝えよう。

Through the Pipes#019.src: The board crumbles under your step. Maybe there's another way to the other side.
Through the Pipes#019.dst: 足を乗せた板が崩れた。向こう側へ行く別の道があるかもしれない。

Through the Pipes#020.src: Talk with the citizen in despair at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Through the Pipes#020.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で途方に暮れた市民と話す。

Through the Pipes#021.src: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
Through the Pipes#021.dst: ね、ねえ、あなた！どこかでアライグマ見なかった？
Through the Pipes#021.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#022.src: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
Through the Pipes#022.dst: 空き時間を全部使って Soosu への贈り物を作ったのに、あの悪魔に奪われたの！渡す機会がなくなったら悲しすぎる…
