True Colours#221.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#222.src: I would recommend you stay away. Take it as a warning from a friend.
True Colours#222.dst: 近づかないほうがいい。友人からの警告だと思って。
True Colours#222.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#225.src: There’s… nothing much to say. Not because I don’t want to, but because I just don’t know that much about her.
True Colours#225.dst: 特に…言えることはない。話したくないんじゃなくて、本当に彼女のことをよく知らないんだ。
True Colours#225.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#226.src: She keeps her secrets to herself. I’ve only even spoken to her a few times, and all of it was about…
True Colours#226.dst: 彼女は秘密を明かさない。話したのも数回だけで、それも全部…
True Colours#226.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#229.src: It’s what I received the blessing for.
True Colours#229.dst: そのために僕は祝福を受けたんだ。
True Colours#229.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#230.src: I… don’t want to talk about it, right now. It won’t matter until all of this resolves, either way.
True Colours#230.dst: 僕…今はその話をしたくない。どのみち、これが全部片付くまでは関係ないし。
True Colours#230.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#233.src: She’s done awful, horrible things. All of Fruma’s problems trace themselves back to her, in some way.
True Colours#233.dst: 彼女はひどい、恐ろしいことをしてきた。Fruma の問題は全部、何らかの形で彼女に行き着く。
True Colours#233.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#234.src: But… there’s more to her than that.
True Colours#234.dst: でも…それだけの人じゃない。
True Colours#234.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#235.src: She’s like us, you know? She was… forced into a role she hated, trapped somewhere she couldn’t escape. She was made into something entirely outside of her control.
True Colours#235.dst: 彼女も僕らと同じなんだ。…嫌な役目を押しつけられて、逃げられない場所に閉じ込められた。自分ではどうにもならない何かにされたんだ。
True Colours#235.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#236.src: And eventually, she... she found a way out. Or, rather, she made her own way out. Clawed and pushed and fought for any possibility of freedom…
True Colours#236.dst: そしてついに、彼女は…出口を見つけた。いや、自分で道を切り開いたんだ。自由の可能性にしがみつき、押しのけ、戦って…
True Colours#236.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#237.dst: 彼女は自分のために Fruma を作った。
True Colours#237.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#238.src: …it’s rare to find someone who understands, you know? Of course, I’ve had you, and… and Aledar, but it’s isolating. Even others from Fruma, they just… don’t get it.
True Colours#238.dst: …わかってくれる人に出会えるのは稀なんだ。もちろん君や…Aledar がいた、でも孤独だった。Fruma 出身の人ですら…わかってくれない。
True Colours#238.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#239.src: So to have found someone who knows what it’s like, who managed to forge her own path forward… that connection feels worth holding onto.
True Colours#239.dst: だから、あの気持ちを知っていて、自分で道を切り開いた人を見つけて…その繋がりは手放したくないと思えた。
True Colours#239.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#241.src: I should be going. And… you should get back to your friends.
True Colours#241.dst: もう行かないと。君も…友達のところに戻るべきだ。
True Colours#241.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#242.src: Before I do… I have a warning for you, too. The Sovereign of the {p} Gikyo… they know where the Canopy is hiding out. They’re preparing an attack of some kind.
True Colours#242.dst: その前に…僕からも警告がある。{p} の君主 Gikyo…樹冠の隠れ家を知ってる。何か攻撃の準備をしてるんだ。
True Colours#242.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#243.src: …you should be able to warn everybody in time this time around. Make sure nobody gets captured. If they do… it- it won’t be pretty.
True Colours#243.dst: …今回はみんなに警告するのに間に合うはずだ。誰も捕まらないようにして。捕まったら…ひ、ひどいことになる。
True Colours#243.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#244.src: Now… go. Save the friends you still have left with you.
True Colours#244.dst: さあ…行って。まだそばにいる友達を救うんだ。
True Colours#244.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#247.src: {u}, you're... you're back. Does... does that mean you...?
True Colours#247.dst: {u}、か…帰ってきた。それって…つまり…？
True Colours#247.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#248.src: You're... you're alone. Where, um... where are they?
True Colours#248.dst: ひ…一人なの。え、えっと…みんなは？
True Colours#248.speaker: Sui

True Colours#251.dst: …そうなるって思うべきだった。
True Colours#251.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#253.src: How do you know? H-how is it compromised?
True Colours#253.dst: どうしてわかるの？ど、どうして場所がばれたの？
True Colours#253.speaker: Sui

True Colours#254.src: That... did he really do the same thing twice?! Ugh, why is he even helping us?
True Colours#254.dst: それって…彼、本当に同じことを二度も？！ああもう、なんで僕らを助けるんだ？
True Colours#254.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#256.src: Hey hey, Sui and Yusanu! The creature has begun to speak! Isn't it a miracle?
True Colours#256.dst: おーい、Sui、Yusanu！あの生き物がしゃべり始めたよ！奇跡じゃないか？
True Colours#256.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#257.src: Oh, you return! That was... a rather quick excursion. Well, how was it then? Simple in-and-out break-in?
True Colours#257.dst: おや、お帰り！ずいぶん…早いお出かけだったね。で、どうだった？さっと入ってさっと出る簡単な侵入かい？
True Colours#257.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#258.src: Though I hadn't spotted any new arrivals, so... perhaps not.
True Colours#258.dst: もっとも、新入りは見かけなかったから…違うようだね。
True Colours#258.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#259.src: I see, I see. Ran into too many guards, I suppose? It may be for the best, in any case - we've ourselves a talking changeling!
True Colours#259.dst: なるほど、なるほど。衛兵が多すぎたのかな？まあ、それでよかったかもしれない―こっちにはしゃべるチェンジリングがいるんだから！
True Colours#259.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#260.src: Now, as I was saying - you all should come and take a listen, it really is very-
True Colours#260.dst: さて、さっきの話の続きだ―みんな来て聞いてごらん、本当にとても―
True Colours#260.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#261.src: Oh dear! Why didn't you lead with that?! Goodness, that's a problem and a half... I'll have to inform Fuhue.
True Colours#261.dst: おやまあ！なぜそれを先に言わない？！なんと、それは大問題だ…Fuhue に知らせないと。
True Colours#261.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#262.src: She just so happens to be questioning the prisoner as we speak, in fact! The little lizard has happened to spill some... rather interesting secrets.
True Colours#262.dst: ちょうど今、彼女が捕虜を尋問しているところなんだ！あの小さなトカゲが…なかなか興味深い秘密を漏らしてね。
True Colours#262.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#263.src: Come along, kiddos! Let's give it a look, shall we?
True Colours#263.dst: ついておいで、子供たち！見に行こうじゃないか？
True Colours#263.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#264.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] であの生き物がしゃべっている。

True Colours#265.dst: …次はあんな馬鹿なことしないで。
True Colours#265.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#267.dst: よし。ちょうどいいところに。
True Colours#267.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#268.src: It's shut up now, but it was speaking just a moment ago. Don't worry, I'll be able to get it talking again.
True Colours#268.dst: 今は黙っていますが、さっきまでしゃべっていました。ご心配なく、またしゃべらせますから。
True Colours#268.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#269.src: You'll want to hear what it says. It's relevant to your current concerns.
True Colours#269.dst: 言うことを聞いておきたいはずです。あなたたちの今の心配事に関係があります。
True Colours#269.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#270.src: Well alright, Fuhue, take it away!
True Colours#270.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#271.src: Hm! Seems to have done the trick.
True Colours#271.dst: ふむ！効いたようですね。
True Colours#271.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#273.src: What? Magic? I don't know what that word means.
True Colours#273.dst: 何？魔法？その言葉の意味はわかりません。
True Colours#273.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#274.src: They refer to curses or blessings, captain.
True Colours#274.dst: 呪いや祝福のことを言ってるんだよ、隊長。
True Colours#274.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#275.src: Oh! No, no, certainly not. It's a simple talisman. They're a traditional art, passed down to us through generations of the Canopy.
True Colours#275.dst: ああ！いえ、いえ、とんでもない。ただの護符です。樹冠で代々受け継がれてきた伝統の技なんです。
True Colours#275.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#276.src: I believe Master Azael explained it to Yusanu the other day? By inscribing specific glyphs in certain patterns, they can be ignited for varying powerful effects.
True Colours#276.dst: Azael 様が先日 Yusanu に説明したはずでは？特定のグリフを決まった模様で刻むと、点火して様々な強力な効果を出せるんです。
True Colours#276.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#277.src: Through experimentation, we've determined which glyphs yield which results, though there's more we still don't know! As a matter of fact-
True Colours#277.dst: 実験を重ねて、どのグリフがどんな結果を生むかを突き止めました。でもまだわからないことも多くて！実は―
True Colours#277.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#278.src: Fuhue, I appreciate the enthusiasm, I do, but shouldn't we return to the matter at hand?
True Colours#278.dst: Fuhue、熱意はありがたい、本当に。でも本題に戻るべきじゃないかい？
True Colours#278.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#279.src: Yes. Of course. That's enough on talismans for now. Everyone, hurry up and take a look.
True Colours#279.dst: ええ。もちろん。護符の話はこのくらいに。皆さん、早く見てください。
True Colours#279.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#280.src: I am an ordinary citizen! This is a crime!
True Colours#280.dst: 私はただの市民だ！これは犯罪だ！
True Colours#280.speaker: Changeling

True Colours#282.src: Ah, I see now. This one hadn't made it very far in its training. That would explain why it was so easy to capture.
True Colours#282.dst: ああ、なるほど。こいつは訓練があまり進んでいなかったんですね。どうりで簡単に捕まったわけです。
True Colours#282.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#287.src: It- it knows! It knows their names, so- so does it know where-
True Colours#287.dst: こ、こいつ知ってる！みんなの名前を知ってる、じゃ、じゃあ居場所も―
True Colours#287.speaker: Sui

True Colours#288.src: No mention of my brothers... or anyone else from the Steel Feather...
True Colours#288.dst: 兄さんたちの話はない…鋼の羽根の誰の話も…
True Colours#288.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#289.src: Oh... I- I didn't even... realize. I didn't even think... I- I'm sorry.
True Colours#289.dst: あ…わ、私…気づきもしなかった。考えもしなかった…ご、ごめん。
True Colours#289.speaker: Sui

True Colours#290.src: It's... fine. I just... wish I could know for sure they're still alive out there.
True Colours#290.dst: いい…んだ。ただ…生きてるって確かめられたらいいのに。
True Colours#290.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#291.src: Hey, little man, lighten up! The way I see it, it's incredibly likely they've split the two groups.
True Colours#291.dst: おい、坊や、元気を出したまえ！私の見立てでは、二つのグループを分けた可能性が非常に高いね。
True Colours#291.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#292.src: Yes. It's a very common psychological torture technique! Splitting up groups of people does a number on one's-
True Colours#292.dst: ええ。とてもよくある心理的拷問の手口です！集団を引き離すと人の心に大きな―
True Colours#292.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#293.src: Fuhue, really, do you think this is the time? Given our audience?
True Colours#293.dst: Fuhue、本当に、今それを言う時かい？聞いてる相手を考えて？
True Colours#293.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#294.dst: はあ。誰も私の見識を評価しない。
True Colours#294.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#295.src: Now, importantly, all changelings receive training here in the {p}! The crown has a special fort up on the eastern mountainside for it.
True Colours#295.dst: さて、大事なのは、チェンジリングはみんなこの {p} で訓練を受けるってことだ！王家は東の山腹にそのための特別な砦を持っている。
True Colours#295.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#296.src: Oh! Oh, we can organize a raid on the fort, gather information and find-
True Colours#296.dst: おお！おお、砦への襲撃を計画しよう、情報を集めて見つけ―
True Colours#296.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#297.src: News? What news? I haven't heard anything from the owls yet this morning, and...
True Colours#297.dst: 知らせ？何の知らせだい？今朝はまだ梟たちから何も聞いていないし…
True Colours#297.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#298.src: Did I forget? Forget what? Goodness, what am I missing...
True Colours#298.dst: 忘れた？何を？なんと、何を見落として…
True Colours#298.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#299.src: Oh! Oh, dear, right! Right right right! I remember now!
True Colours#299.dst: おお！おや、そうだ！そうそうそう！思い出した！
True Colours#299.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#300.src: The crown knows our location, huh?
True Colours#300.dst: 王家に居場所がばれた、と？
True Colours#300.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#301.src: Again?! Gah!!! Barely get a month's rest before we have to move again...
True Colours#301.dst: また？！ああもう！！！一か月も休めないうちにまた引っ越し…
True Colours#301.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#302.src: Ugh! I guess I'll go gather all our paperwork and emergency rations...
True Colours#302.dst: はあ！書類と非常食を全部まとめてきます…
True Colours#302.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#303.src: I'll summon the owls and deploy them to begin evacuations. I'll have to track down Cileon as well...
True Colours#303.dst: 梟たちを呼び集めて避難を始めさせよう。Cileon も探し出さないと…
True Colours#303.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#304.src: You know they're just going to stay behind to take out as many soldiers as possible, right?
True Colours#304.dst: 彼らは残って、できるだけ多くの兵を倒すつもりですよ、わかってますよね？
True Colours#304.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#305.src: Cocky bastard... of course they will.
True Colours#305.dst: 生意気な奴め…当然そうするだろう。
True Colours#305.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#306.src: Anyway! Kiddos, I'll meet you up at the top of this tree! That's where the Owls' headquarters are!
True Colours#306.dst: ともかく！子供たち、この木のてっぺんで会おう！梟たちの本部はそこだ！
True Colours#306.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#307.src: Rurie, I can't deal with all this paperwork on my own! Hand me two of your workers.
True Colours#307.dst: Rurie、この書類を一人じゃ処理できません！部下を二人貸してください。
True Colours#307.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#309.dst: Sui と Yusanu を連れていきたまえ！
True Colours#309.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#310.src: Ah! Of course. That'll do. Well, chop chop outsiders. Pack up here!
True Colours#310.dst: ああ！もちろん。それで結構。さあ急いで、外の方々。ここを片付けて！
True Colours#310.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#312.src: Head to the meet up place at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#313.src: These talismans... the colors, pink green blue white gold... the shapes... there's something. There's something.
True Colours#313.dst: この護符…色、ピンク、緑、青、白、金…形…何かある。絶対に何かある。
True Colours#313.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#314.src: I'm getting close, I can feel it. I just need... a little more time.
True Colours#314.dst: もう少しなんだ、感じる。あと…もう少し時間があれば。
True Colours#314.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#315.src: They keep talking like we aren't here...
True Colours#315.dst: 私たちがいないみたいに話すね…
True Colours#315.speaker: Sui

True Colours#316.src: It's... it's okay. I know they're alive. There's hope! There's hope, there's hope, there's hope.
True Colours#316.dst: だ…大丈夫。みんな生きてるってわかってる。希望はある！希望はある、希望はある、希望はある。
True Colours#316.speaker: Sui

True Colours#317.dst: 任務報告、在庫、拠点計画…
True Colours#317.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#318.src: Ugh! I need to get to my lists. I can't think straight!
True Colours#318.dst: はあ！リストを確認しないと。頭が回らない！
True Colours#318.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#319.src: Well, it's a good thing we have the emergency shelter! A shame it's in a cave. Sigh...
True Colours#319.dst: まあ、非常用の避難所があってよかった！洞窟の中なのが残念だけど。はあ…
True Colours#319.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#322.src: Well well well well! And there they all are!
True Colours#322.dst: おやおやおやおや！みんな揃ったね！
True Colours#322.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#323.src: Greetings are in order to the little doves! Ready to get moving then?
True Colours#323.dst: 小さな鳩たちにご挨拶だ！さて、出発の準備はいいかい？
True Colours#323.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#324.dst: あなたたちって…えっと、梟じゃ？
True Colours#324.speaker: Sui

True Colours#325.src: Owls? Why, yes, of course - but you, dear friends, are doves. The small and defenseless, in dire need of aid...
True Colours#325.dst: 梟？ああ、もちろんそうだとも―だが君たち、親愛なる友よ、君たちは鳩だ。小さく無防備で、助けを切実に必要としている…
True Colours#325.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#326.src: Captain, if we're all in order, shouldn't we get moving? We're to lead them to the next hideout.
True Colours#326.dst: 隊長、全員揃ったなら出発すべきでは？次の隠れ家まで彼らを案内するんです。
True Colours#326.speaker: Canopy Owl

True Colours#327.src: Right you are! Right you are, indeed. Then to the north we shall fly, little doves and silent owls!
True Colours#327.dst: その通り！まったくもってその通り。では北へ飛ぼう、小さな鳩たちと物言わぬ梟たちよ！
True Colours#327.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#328.src: Meet up with Sui, Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#328.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Sui、Yusanu、Rurie 隊長と合流する。

True Colours#329.src: And so we fly forth, birds of the flock! Onwards we go!
True Colours#329.dst: さあ飛び立とう、群れの鳥たちよ！前進だ！
True Colours#329.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#332.src: Oof! My goodness, they don't make these things quite like they used to! Since when have the ziplines been so... exhilerating?
True Colours#332.dst: おっと！なんとまあ、最近のは昔ほど出来が良くないね！ジップラインがいつからこんなに…スリル満点になったんだい？
True Colours#332.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#333.src: Not the most graceful landing, captain.
True Colours#333.dst: 優雅な着地とは言えませんね、隊長。
True Colours#333.speaker: Canopy Owl

True Colours#334.src: Oh, what do you know?! Why don't you try to land gracefully in a- in- in a-... see how you do!!
True Colours#334.dst: おや、君に何がわかる？！なら君も優雅に着地してみたまえ、その―その―その…どうなるか見ものだ！！
True Colours#334.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#335.src: Ahem. Shall we get moving then? Over the hills and down the road, to the meet up spot we go!
True Colours#335.dst: ごほん。では出発しようか？丘を越え道を下り、集合場所へ向かおう！
True Colours#335.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#336.src: ...{u}, Yusanu. When we get to safety, we... we should talk about what to do next.
True Colours#336.dst: …{u}、Yusanu。安全な場所に着いたら…これからどうするか話し合わなきゃ。
True Colours#336.speaker: Sui

True Colours#337.src: Rex, Zeph... Mora... if- if they're here, then... then...
True Colours#337.dst: Rex、Zeph…Mora…も、もしここにいるなら…なら…
True Colours#337.speaker: Sui

True Colours#338.src: Don't worry, Sui, I... I get it. We'll do whatever we can to get your brother out of there. Promise.
True Colours#338.dst: 心配しないで、Sui、僕…わかってる。お兄さんを助け出すためにできることは全部やる。約束する。
True Colours#338.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#339.src: Speaking of the prodigal son and his companions, are we! My my, what a tragic tale... but perhaps I have an inkling of their present whereabouts.
True Colours#339.dst: 放蕩息子とその仲間の話かい！やれやれ、なんと悲劇的な…だが、彼らの今の居場所について心当たりがあるかもしれない。
True Colours#339.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#340.src: You- you do? Why... why didn't you tell us sooner?!
True Colours#340.dst: ほ、本当に？な…なんで早く教えてくれなかったの？！
True Colours#340.speaker: Sui

True Colours#341.src: Ah ah! Sensitive information is for sensitive ears alone. I believed it best to wait for better circumstances... too many unknown faces back at the Canopy.
True Colours#341.dst: おっと！機密情報は選ばれた耳だけのものさ。もっと良い状況を待つのが最善だと思ってね…樹冠には見知らぬ顔が多すぎた。
True Colours#341.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#342.src: Well, silent owls? Fly forth, update the others at the hideout on our whereabouts! I'll keep an eye on our little doves as we discuss matters further.
True Colours#342.dst: さて、物言わぬ梟たち？飛んでいって、隠れ家の皆に我々の居場所を伝えたまえ！話を続ける間、小さな鳩たちは私が見ておく。
True Colours#342.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#343.src: ...you're the boss, Captain. If you say so.
True Colours#343.dst: …ボスはあなたです、隊長。そうおっしゃるなら。
True Colours#343.speaker: Canopy Owl

True Colours#344.src: And I do say so! Well, chop chop, get it moving, wouldn't you?
True Colours#344.dst: そう言っているとも！さあ急いで、動きたまえ？
True Colours#344.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#345.src: Ah... authority is its own sort of treat, isn't it?
True Colours#345.dst: ああ…権力というのはそれだけで楽しいものだね？
True Colours#345.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#346.src: Rurie, you said you had a lead. What is it?
True Colours#346.dst: Rurie、手がかりがあるって言ってたよね。何なの？
True Colours#346.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#347.src: So impatient! So so impatient. Yes, fine, there is a military outpost just to the east, a flap of the wings as the bird flies! I will take you there.
True Colours#347.dst: せっかちだね！本当にせっかちだ。まあいい、すぐ東に軍の前哨基地がある、鳥ならひと羽ばたきの距離さ！案内しよう。
True Colours#347.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#348.src: Uh... isn't that dangerous? You said that's where all the ch-
True Colours#348.dst: え…危なくない？そこって確かチェンジ―
True Colours#348.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#349.src: Yes well not everything can be so easy, can it?! Be brave! Take risks! Et cetera, et cetera.
True Colours#349.dst: まあね、何もかも簡単とはいかないだろう？！勇気を出せ！危険を冒せ！などなど、などなど。
True Colours#349.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#350.src: And with all the guards and soldiers and riffraff mobilized to the Canopy, it certainly will be simpler to sneak in! You do want to save your brother do you not?
True Colours#350.dst: それに衛兵も兵士もごろつきも樹冠に動員されているから、忍び込むのはずっと楽なはずさ！お兄さんを救いたいんだろう？
True Colours#350.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#351.src: ...still. We- we aren't much of fighters! If... if we get caught...
True Colours#351.dst: …それでも。わ、私たちそんなに戦えない！も、もし捕まったら…
True Colours#351.speaker: Sui

True Colours#352.src: I- we can't, keep putting all the work on {u}'s shoulders. We need a better plan!
True Colours#352.dst: わ、私たち、いつまでも {u} に全部押しつけるわけにはいかない。もっといい計画が必要だよ！
True Colours#352.speaker: Sui

True Colours#353.src: Alas, it is now or it is never. Tick tock tick tock, time's running out, little doves! Onwards we shall fly, to save friend and family alike!
True Colours#353.dst: ああ、今やるか、二度とやらないかだ。チクタクチクタク、時間がないよ、小さな鳩たち！友も家族も救いに、さあ飛んでいこう！
True Colours#353.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#354.dst: Rurie 隊長について [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ向かう。

True Colours#357.src: A problem? No... no, no no, there is no problem here! All is just as it should be.
True Colours#357.dst: 問題？いや…いやいや、問題なんてないとも！すべてあるべき姿さ。
True Colours#357.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#358.src: Are... are you- are you sure? You're... you're starting to scare me, Rurie.
True Colours#358.dst: ほ…本当に、本当に大丈夫？なんだか…怖くなってきたよ、Rurie。
True Colours#358.speaker: Sui

True Colours#359.src: H- huh?! Wh- what's going on?!
True Colours#359.dst: え、ええ？！な、何が起きてるの？！
True Colours#359.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#362.src: Th- thank you, Sui, that... I don't... you- you're really, uh, getting the hang of that ice stuff, aren't you?
True Colours#362.dst: あ、ありがとう、Sui、今の…僕…君、本当に、その、氷のやつ使いこなせてきたね？
True Colours#362.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#363.src: I... I didn't even... do that intentionally. It was... reflexive...
True Colours#363.dst: わ、私…わざとやったわけじゃ…ないの。反射的に…
True Colours#363.speaker: Sui

True Colours#364.src: B-but, more... more importantly- what happened? Where's- where's Rurie?
True Colours#364.dst: で、でも、それより…何があったの？Rurie は―Rurie はどこ？
True Colours#364.speaker: Sui

True Colours#368.src: Those... those must have been changelings!
True Colours#368.dst: あいつら…チェンジリングだったに違いない！
True Colours#368.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#369.src: Oho! Impressive stuff. Simple pieces of paper in appearance... but they pack a punch. Rather useful!
True Colours#369.dst: おほっ！見事なものです。見た目はただの紙切れなのに…威力は抜群。とても役に立ちますね！
True Colours#369.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#370.src: Easier than expected. Should use more- eugh, no no no, don't like this one at all.
True Colours#370.dst: 思ったより楽だった。もっと使う―うえっ、だめだだめだ、この姿は全然気に入らない。
True Colours#370.speaker: Cileon

True Colours#371.src: Ah, much improved! Now this - what an enjoyable form it has been, yes yes yes! The drama, the intrigue! Perhaps it would do to use it more, hm hm hm!
True Colours#371.dst: ああ、ずっといい！この姿―実に楽しい姿だった、そうそうそう！芝居がかって、陰謀めいて！もっと使ってもいいかもね、ふふふ！
True Colours#371.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#372.src: Who am I? Why, I am Captain Rurie, leader of the owls! Master of the mists, eyes and ears of the trees - runaway FOOL from higher lands!!!!
True Colours#372.dst: 私が誰かって？もちろん Rurie 隊長、梟たちの長さ！霧の支配者、木々の目と耳―高き地から逃げ出した愚か者！！！！
True Colours#372.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#373.src: Oh but no no no, I should think you have it figured out by now! Is it not obvious?
True Colours#373.dst: おや、でもいやいや、もうわかっているはずだろう！明らかじゃないか？
True Colours#373.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#374.src: What a delight! This before you is the form of the Ranger {p}, Sovereign to these secretive little ants! The name it was given is Gikyo.
True Colours#374.dst: なんと愉快！目の前にあるのは {p} のレンジャーの姿、こそこそした小さな蟻どもの君主！与えられた名は Gikyo。
True Colours#374.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#375.src: To think there has been a struggle to take you in so far yet the task proved simple and easy! How delightful! The Sovereign Forest will be furious!
True Colours#375.dst: 今までさんざん手こずったのに、今回はこんなに簡単！なんと愉快！Sovereign Forest はさぞ怒るだろうねえ！
True Colours#375.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#376.src: But that is enough talk and secrets spilling. It is time, crown's wanted! Time for you to go...
True Colours#376.dst: でもおしゃべりと秘密漏らしはもう十分。時間だよ、王家のお尋ね者！お別れの時間…
True Colours#376.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#377.src: Talk to Sui and Yusanu. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#377.dst: Sui と Yusanu に話しかける。野営地に戻る必要があれば [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ。

True Colours#379.src: Is this really it, then? Ordeal after ordeal and this is where it leads?
True Colours#379.dst: じゃあ本当にこれで終わり？試練に次ぐ試練で、行き着く先がここ？
True Colours#379.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#380.src: Will it ever end? What's the point? The crown's after us now, and- and they're not going to stop!! Why- why even try?!
True Colours#380.dst: いつか終わるの？何の意味が？王家に追われて、しかも―しかも止まる気はない！！なんで―なんで頑張るんだよ？！
True Colours#380.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#381.src: Yusanu! Y-you need to... to get yourself together! Please, d-don't lose your head now... n-not here, of all places.
True Colours#381.dst: Yusanu！し、しっかりして…しっかりしなきゃ！お願い、い、今取り乱さないで…よ、よりによってこんな所で。
True Colours#381.speaker: Sui

True Colours#382.src: I... ha, I- I know it feels hard. Im-impossible, even! A-and maybe I'm, I'm just putting on a brave face... I- I want to lie down and j-just wait for the, the inevitable, as much as you do!!
True Colours#382.dst: 私…はは、わ、わかってる、辛いよね。む、無理だって思う！そ、それに私も、強がってるだけかも…あなたと同じくらい、横になって、た、ただ避けられない終わりを待ちたい！！
True Colours#382.speaker: Sui

True Colours#383.src: But... b-but not now. We're- we're here, a-and they're so close. Mora, Rex, Zeph... we- we have some hope! S-so... don't give up. Not now!
True Colours#383.dst: でも…で、でも今じゃない。私たち―ここにいて、み、みんなすぐ近くにいる。Mora、Rex、Zeph…き、希望はある！だ、だから…諦めないで。今は！
True Colours#383.speaker: Sui

True Colours#385.src: ...okay. Then... where do we start? They... they took all of our belongings... and you can't cast spells without your weapon, can you?
True Colours#385.dst: …わかった。じゃあ…どこから始める？持ち物は…全部取られた…武器がないと魔法は使えないんだよね？
True Colours#385.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#386.src: I... I still have my magic. I can... I can try.
True Colours#386.dst: 私…魔法はまだ使える。や…やってみる。
True Colours#386.speaker: Sui

True Colours#388.src: N-not... that. I... ugh, why is this so hard all of a sudden...?
True Colours#388.dst: そ、それじゃない。私…うう、なんで急にこんなに難しいの…？
True Colours#388.speaker: Sui

True Colours#389.src: Oh, sh- shut up! I- I'm trying, okay!
True Colours#389.dst: も、もう、うるさい！が、頑張ってるの！
True Colours#389.speaker: Sui

True Colours#391.src: ...oh. Oh, oh- I think I know a way out!
True Colours#391.dst: …あ。あっ―出る方法がわかったかも！
True Colours#391.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#392.src: Look, this- this appears to be tempered glass!
True Colours#392.dst: 見て、これ―これ強化ガラスみたいだ！
True Colours#392.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#393.src: Um... I... I have no idea what that means.
True Colours#393.dst: えっと…わ、私…何のことか全然わからない。
True Colours#393.speaker: Sui

True Colours#394.src: No, look- it's one of the inventions I assisted Soosu with. I didn't know what its purpose was at the time, but... I guess this fits.
True Colours#394.dst: いや、見て―Soosu の発明を手伝った中の一つなんだ。当時は用途がわからなかったけど…これで納得だ。
True Colours#394.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#395.src: Tempered glass is incredibly strong and durable. It resists most attempts to break it, except - except for striking the edge of the glass with a sharp object.
True Colours#395.dst: 強化ガラスはものすごく頑丈で壊れにくい。ほとんどの力には耐えるけど―けど、鋭いもので端を叩くと別なんだ。
True Colours#395.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#396.src: And, Sui! If you could make an icicle with your magic... and strike the edge...
True Colours#396.dst: それでね、Sui！魔法でつららを作って…端を叩けたら…
True Colours#396.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#397.src: ...then we could get out? I... m-maybe. But, y-you just saw me- um, nearly flood our cell with... sewage...
True Colours#397.dst: …出られるってこと？わ…たぶん。でも、さ、さっき見たでしょ、私が―えっと、牢屋を…汚水で水浸しにしかけたの…
True Colours#397.speaker: Sui

True Colours#398.src: Sui. You were the one just giving me a pep talk. Come on, you can do it!
True Colours#398.dst: Sui。さっき僕を励ましてくれたのは君だよ。ほら、君ならできる！
True Colours#398.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#399.src: ...okay. Okay, you- you're right! I can... I can do this. I can.
True Colours#399.dst: …うん。うん、あ―あなたの言う通り！私なら…できる。できる。
True Colours#399.speaker: Sui

True Colours#401.src: I- ha, I, I did it!!
True Colours#401.speaker: Sui

True Colours#402.src: That's the first step! We've got the sharp object, now... aim for the corner!
True Colours#402.dst: 第一段階だ！鋭いものは手に入った、次は…角を狙って！
True Colours#402.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#403.src: It- it worked! Ha... hahaha... oh, it worked...
True Colours#403.dst: う―うまくいった！はは…ははは…ああ、うまくいった…
True Colours#403.speaker: Sui

True Colours#404.src: Find Captain Rurie. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#404.dst: Rurie 隊長を探す。野営地に戻る必要があれば [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ。

True Colours#405.src: L-let's go, then! Let's find the others, and- and get out of here!
True Colours#405.dst: い、行こう！他のみんなを見つけて、そ―ここから出よう！
True Colours#405.speaker: Sui

True Colours#406.src: Well! Hoo hoo, my little friends!
True Colours#406.dst: やあ！ほうほう、小さな友たち！
True Colours#406.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#408.src: Uh... duh? That devilish snake got the drop on me when I went up to the owls' nest! Those changelings certainly do not play fair, let me tell you...
True Colours#408.dst: え…当たり前だろう？梟の巣に上がったとき、あの悪魔みたいな蛇に不意を突かれたのさ！チェンジリングは本当に卑怯だよ、まったく…
True Colours#408.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#409.src: How... how can we know for sure it's, um, really him?
True Colours#409.dst: ど…どうやって、えっと、本物だって確かめるの？
True Colours#409.speaker: Sui

True Colours#410.src: What?! Is it not obvious that I am who I say I- oh, whatever, something something it's protocol. Fine.
True Colours#410.dst: 何？！私が名乗った通りの者だなんて明らか―ああ、もういい、規則だか何だかだね。わかったよ。
True Colours#410.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#411.src: Hm... I don't think changelings have access to memories, do they? Rurie, where did we first meet?
True Colours#411.dst: うーん…チェンジリングは記憶までは読めないよね？Rurie、僕らが最初に会ったのはどこ？
True Colours#411.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#412.src: Yes, finally, some sense! It was in that cave! My owls and I captured you as leverage, and if I do recall correctly, you nearly cried like a little baby! Ah, memories...
True Colours#412.dst: そう、やっとまともな話だ！あの洞窟さ！私と梟たちで君たちを人質に捕まえて、私の記憶が正しければ、君は赤ん坊みたいに泣きそうだった！ああ、懐かしい…
True Colours#412.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#413.dst: うわ。うん、間違いなく本人だ。
True Colours#413.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#414.src: Finally! Now then, time for us to get moving!
True Colours#414.dst: やっとか！さて、そろそろ動くとしよう！
True Colours#414.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#415.src: THEY LEFT YOUR KNIVES ON YOU?!
True Colours#415.dst: ナイフを取り上げられなかったの？！
True Colours#415.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#416.src: Oh, no, no no no. They certainly did take them, alright! Seems they missed a few in my boots, though! Lucky me!
True Colours#416.dst: いやいや、とんでもない。しっかり取られたとも！でもブーツの中の数本を見逃したらしい！運がいいね！
True Colours#416.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#417.src: Now, I simply couldn't help but overhear you little loudmouths, so I came up with a plan while you were debating whether I was real or not!
True Colours#417.dst: さて、声の大きい君たちの話がどうしても聞こえてしまってね、私が本物かどうか揉めてる間に計画を立てておいたよ！
True Colours#417.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#418.src: Yusanu. That device of yours is quite important, isn't it? I'll help you fetch it - hopefully add a few more to my kill list along the way, eh?
True Colours#418.dst: Yusanu。君のあの装置はかなり大事だろう？取りに行くのを手伝おう―ついでに撃破リストを何人か増やせるといいね？
True Colours#418.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#419.src: And Sui... go find your family. Important to hold onto those you love, isn't it? You and {u} can handle this, I'm sure, but... be careful.
True Colours#419.dst: そして Sui…家族を探しに行きたまえ。愛する人を離さないのは大事だろう？君と {u} ならやれるはずだ、でも…気をつけて。
True Colours#419.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#421.src: Well then! Let's skedaddle, kiddos! Good luck out there!
True Colours#421.dst: では！さっさとずらかろう、子供たち！幸運を！
True Colours#421.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#422.src: Let's... try and find our stuff. We, ha, can't really handle a whole fort of changelings without your weapon, can we?
True Colours#422.dst: えっと…持ち物を探してみよう。私たち、はは、あなたの武器なしでチェンジリングだらけの砦は無理だよね？
True Colours#422.speaker: Sui

True Colours#423.src: Find your weapon before you proceed further. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#423.dst: 先へ進む前に武器を探す。野営地に戻る必要があれば [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ。

True Colours#424.src: Hey! We can't leave without our belongings.
True Colours#424.dst: ねえ！持ち物を置いては行けないよ。
True Colours#424.speaker: Sui

True Colours#427.src: I... I hope so, but... I'm not sure. The ocean still feels... off. Like, like a step to the left.
True Colours#427.dst: そ…そうだといいけど…わからない。海がまだ…変な感じ。なんていうか、一歩左にずれてるみたいな。
True Colours#427.speaker: Sui

True Colours#428.src: I... don't really, I don't have anything worth grabbing, here...
True Colours#428.dst: 私は…その、ここで取るべきものは何もないの…
True Colours#428.speaker: Sui

True Colours#429.src: Uh, I found this map... come here.
True Colours#429.dst: あ、この地図見つけた…来て。
True Colours#429.speaker: Sui

True Colours#431.src: "{p}, Changeling Facility." So... this whole place is, um, probably crawling with them.
True Colours#431.dst: 「{p}、チェンジリング施設」。じゃあ…ここ全体に、えっと、たぶんうじゃうじゃいるんだ。
True Colours#431.speaker: Sui

True Colours#432.src: This... this m-might be, um, harder than I thought it might be. B-but! I can't give up. They're so close... where are they...?
True Colours#432.dst: これ…お、思ったより、えっと、大変かも。で、でも！諦められない。みんなすぐ近くにいる…どこにいるの…？
True Colours#432.speaker: Sui

True Colours#433.dst: 私たち…ここにいるみたい。
True Colours#433.speaker: Sui

True Colours#434.src: And the Sovereign's office looks like it's at the very back of the building...
True Colours#434.dst: 君主の執務室は建物の一番奥みたい…
True Colours#434.speaker: Sui

True Colours#435.src: There's a, another block of cells right outside. If we're careful enough... maybe we can avoid a confrontation with the Sovereign.
True Colours#435.dst: そのすぐ外に、別の牢屋の区画がある。慎重に行けば…君主と鉢合わせせずに済むかも。
True Colours#435.speaker: Sui

True Colours#436.src: ...th-thanks for being here, {u}. I... I would've given up a long time ago if you weren't.
True Colours#436.dst: …あ、ありがとう、ここにいてくれて、{u}。私…あなたがいなかったら、とっくに諦めてた。
True Colours#436.speaker: Sui

True Colours#437.src: Continue exploring the Changeling Camp and look for your friends. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#437.dst: チェンジリングの野営地の探索を続け、友達を探す。野営地に戻る必要があれば [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ。

True Colours#438.src: Continue to the Officer's Quarters in the southern wing. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#438.dst: 南棟の士官宿舎へ進む。野営地に戻る必要があれば [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ。

True Colours#439.src: Here for a duel?! I love duels?! I love fighting?! I love life?!
True Colours#439.dst: 決闘しに来た？！決闘大好き？！戦い大好き？！人生大好き？！

True Colours#445.src: C-careful! That's... Sovereign Gikyo's office up ahead. Let's, um, try and avoid them.
True Colours#445.dst: き、気をつけて！この先は…Gikyo 君主の執務室。えっと、なるべく避けよう。
True Colours#445.speaker: Sui

True Colours#447.src: No... n-no, no no no, no- no...
True Colours#447.dst: いや…い、いや、いやいやいや、い―いや…
True Colours#447.speaker: Sui

True Colours#448.src: It's... it's a ticket. From the... Steel Feather... the ones... Quill gave us...
True Colours#448.dst: これ…これはチケット。鋼の羽根の…Quill がくれた…あの…
True Colours#448.speaker: Sui

True Colours#450.src: There- ha, there, th-there's no way s-some-someone could, ha, survive... this...
True Colours#450.dst: こ―はは、こ、こんなの、だ、誰も、はは、生きていられるわけ…ない…
True Colours#450.speaker: Sui

True Colours#451.src: How... h-how dare they... how DARE they?! Th-they have to pay for this, {u}, they- they have to!!
True Colours#451.dst: よ…よくも…よくもこんなこと？！つ、償わせなきゃ、{u}、あ―あいつらに償わせなきゃ！！
True Colours#451.speaker: Sui

True Colours#452.src: Come on... come on, come on, we- we need to confront Gikyo, we- come on!!
True Colours#452.dst: 行こう…行こう、行こう、Gikyo を、と、問い詰めなきゃ、ほら―行こう！！
True Colours#452.speaker: Sui

True Colours#453.src: Head to Sovereign Gikyo's office to confront them. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#453.dst: Gikyo 君主の執務室へ向かい、問い詰める。野営地に戻る必要があれば [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ。

True Colours#456.src: Well well, look who has stumbled on in! If it is not the crown's number one wanted and the silly weak sister! Were you not locked up?
True Colours#456.dst: おやおや、誰が転がり込んできたかと思えば！王家のお尋ね者第一号と、おバカで弱っちい妹じゃないか！閉じ込められてたんじゃ？
True Colours#456.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#457.src: No... you... wh- what did you... what did you DO?!
True Colours#457.dst: いや…あんた…な、何を…何をしたの？！
True Colours#457.speaker: Sui

True Colours#458.src: Hehehehahaha! Oh, this? Why it's the prodigal son of course! Go on, say hello to your little sister, big brother!!
True Colours#458.dst: へへへへははは！おや、これかい？もちろん放蕩息子さ！ほら、可愛い妹にご挨拶だよ、お兄ちゃん！！
True Colours#458.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#459.src: You should know I did offer the opportunity to speak, yes yes indeed! If only he would have spat up all those deep deep secrets on your group... could his pain have been avoided?
True Colours#459.dst: 話す機会はちゃんとあげたんだよ、そうそう本当に！君たちの一味の深ーい深ーい秘密を全部吐いてくれれば…痛い思いをしなくて済んだかもねえ？
True Colours#459.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#460.src: But but but but but sad as it is, he refused to say a word! What a shame indeed, indeed. A long deep dark painful agonizing death it was!
True Colours#460.dst: でもでもでもでもでも悲しいことに、一言も話そうとしなかった！本当に残念、残念。長く深く暗く痛く苦しい死だったよ！
True Colours#460.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#461.src: Well since you are here and the rest are taken it would seem it was for naught! I have every little dove just where I want them, yes yes I do.
True Colours#461.dst: まあ、君が来て残りも捕まったなら、全部無駄だったみたいだね！小さな鳩はみんな思い通りの場所さ、そうそうそう。
True Colours#461.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#462.src: Yes! Shooty girl and wind boy! Rex and Zeph I believe it was?
True Colours#462.dst: そう！撃つ娘と風の坊や！Rex と Zeph だったかな？
True Colours#462.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#463.src: Wind boy was always crying and screaming... how pathetic. But shooty girl... yes shooty girl was a delight.
True Colours#463.dst: 風の坊やはずっと泣き叫んでて…なんと情けない。でも撃つ娘は…そう、撃つ娘は最高だった。
True Colours#463.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#464.src: Never let out a word no matter the pain! The ones like her are always the most most most fun to crack, yes they are.
True Colours#464.dst: どんなに痛めつけても一言も漏らさない！ああいう子を壊すのがいっちばん、いっちばん楽しいんだよねえ。
True Colours#464.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#465.src: Alas... all good things must come to an end it would seem! The killjoy Sovereign {p}, swooping in and ruining ALL my fun...
True Colours#465.dst: ああ…どうやら楽しいことにも終わりがあるらしい！興ざめな {p} の君主が飛び込んできて、楽しみを全部台無しに…
True Colours#465.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#466.src: Noooo Gikyo you cannot keep your prisoners no matter how much you wish, no no no, the people {p} demand their girl returned and well who am I to stand against them?
True Colours#466.dst: 「だめだよ Gikyo、どんなに望んでも囚人は手元に置けない、だめだめだめ、{p} の民があの娘の返還を求めている」だってさ、なら逆らえないよねえ？
True Colours#466.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#467.src: And so ended the fun that was being had! But I had the last laugh, ehehehaha. The Athassa girl could take one and not both of the companions! A choice? A choice!
True Colours#467.dst: そうして楽しい時間は終わり！でも最後に笑ったのはこっち、えへへへはは。Athassa の娘が連れていけるのは仲間の片方だけ！選択？選択だ！
True Colours#467.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#468.src: Oh the noble hero that he was, he chose to stay! What a bore. But what a joy! What a joy joy joy joy joy!
True Colours#468.dst: おお、なんと高潔な英雄、彼は残ることを選んだ！つまらない。でも最高！最高最高最高最高！
True Colours#468.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#469.src: And now where is he? Bleeding out, dying, fading, vanishing with each and every passing moment! And it would seem perhaps he is the lucky one!
True Colours#469.dst: で、今どこにいるかって？血を流して、死にかけて、刻一刻と消えていく！そう考えると、彼のほうが幸運かもねえ！
True Colours#469.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#470.src: Well then! Would you care to join him in this dance? To the end of days - yours end HERE and NOW!
True Colours#470.dst: さあ！君もこの踊りに加わるかい？世界の終わりまで―君の終わりは今、ここだ！
True Colours#470.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#471.src: Defeat Sovereign Gikyo. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#471.dst: Gikyo 君主を倒す。野営地に戻る必要があれば [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ。

True Colours#472.src: Check up on Sui. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#472.dst: Sui の様子を見る。野営地に戻る必要があれば [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ。

True Colours#473.src: He's... he's my brother... give... give him... back...
True Colours#473.dst: 彼は…私の兄なの…返して…お兄ちゃんを…返して…
True Colours#473.speaker: Sui

True Colours#476.src: He's dead. He's... dead he's dead he's dead, but so is that BASTARD!!!
True Colours#476.dst: 死んだ。死んだ…死んだ死んだ死んだ、でもあのクズも死んだ！！！
True Colours#476.speaker: Sui

True Colours#477.src: And it... it... it doesn't even matter. I killed them, and... and... and what now? M- Mora, he's- he's still...
True Colours#477.dst: それに…それに…何の意味もない。私が倒した、それで…それで…これからどうするの？M―Mora は、まだ…
True Colours#477.speaker: Sui

True Colours#480.src: No?? Then what do you CALL this?! Rex and Zeph are gone and Mora is- h-he's... he... he's...
True Colours#480.dst: 違う？？じゃあこれを何て呼ぶの？！Rex と Zeph はいなくて、Mora は―か、彼は…彼は…
True Colours#480.speaker: Sui

True Colours#481.src: We... we weren't fast enough... we took too long to get here, a-and now... and now...
True Colours#481.dst: 私たち…間に合わなかった…ここに来るのに時間がかかりすぎて、そ、それで今…今は…
True Colours#481.speaker: Sui

True Colours#482.src: I already GOT revenge, {u}!! I didn't... I didn't know I... it- it happened so fast, and... and... I killed them. I got revenge and... and I still feel hollow.
True Colours#482.dst: 復讐ならもう「した」よ、{u}！！私…知らなかった…あ、あっという間で、それで…それで…私が倒した。復讐したのに…まだ心が空っぽなの。
True Colours#482.speaker: Sui

True Colours#483.src: He's... gone. He's gone, and- a-and I can't... I can't get him back...
True Colours#483.dst: 彼は…いない。いなくなった、そ、それに私…取り戻せない…
True Colours#483.speaker: Sui

True Colours#485.src: We- we need to g-get out of here, I- I- I can't... I can't be here. I can't... I c-can't look at him.
True Colours#485.dst: こ、ここから出なきゃ、わ、私…ここにいられない。無理…か、彼を見ていられない。
True Colours#485.speaker: Sui

True Colours#487.src: ...this is all my fault, isn't it?
True Colours#487.speaker: Sui

True Colours#488.src: I- I- all I've been DOING this whole time has been crying, worrying, and- and- and being USELESS!
True Colours#488.dst: わ、私―私がずっと「してきた」のは、泣いて、心配して、それで―それで―「役立たず」でいることだけ！
True Colours#488.speaker: Sui

True Colours#489.src: I was so afraid of my cur-... why, why, WHY can't I break that habit?! Magic. Magic magic magic magic MAGIC!!
True Colours#489.dst: 私、自分ののろ―…なんで、なんで、「なんで」この癖が抜けないの？！魔法。魔法魔法魔法魔法「魔法」！！
True Colours#489.speaker: Sui

True Colours#490.src: I was so afraid that I never even tried!! If I had, if I- I- if I'd have learned more, been stronger...
True Colours#490.dst: 怖くて試しもしなかった！！もし試してたら、もし―もっと学んで、もっと強くなってたら…
True Colours#490.speaker: Sui

True Colours#491.src: I... I could have... I could have saved him. I could have protected him, I could have healed him, I could have-
True Colours#491.dst: 私…救えたかもしれない。守れたかもしれない、治せたかもしれない、私なら―
True Colours#491.speaker: Sui

True Colours#492.src: But no, of COURSE NOT!! Because I'm worthless and useless and can't help ANYONE!!
True Colours#492.dst: でも違う、「当然」違う！！だって私は価値がなくて役立たずで「誰も」助けられないから！！
True Colours#492.speaker: Sui

True Colours#494.src: Rex and Zeph are- they're still out there. {u}, {u}, we can still save them. We- we know where they are!!
True Colours#494.dst: Rex と Zeph は―まだどこかにいる。{u}、{u}、まだ救える。わ―私たち、居場所を知ってる！！
True Colours#494.speaker: Sui

True Colours#495.src: We just... we just need to find the {p} Sovereign. He has them, he- he has to. He... he has to.
True Colours#495.dst: {p} の君主を見つければいいだけ。あいつが捕まえてる、きっと―きっとそう。きっと…そう。
True Colours#495.speaker: Sui

True Colours#496.src: ...let's go. We can't- we can't let this happen again.
True Colours#496.dst: …行こう。こんなこと―二度と起こさせない。
True Colours#496.speaker: Sui

True Colours#497.src: Meet up with Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#497.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Yusanu と Rurie 隊長に合流する。

True Colours#499.src: Hello, dear friends! I see you have returned to us safe and sound!
True Colours#499.dst: やあ、親愛なる友よ！無事に戻ってきたようだね！
True Colours#499.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#500.src: We found everything we were looking for, and- and more!! Plans, Sui, plans!! Of Deraj prison!!
True Colours#500.dst: 探してたものは全部見つかった、そ―それ以上も！！計画書だよ、Sui、計画書！！Deraj 監獄の！！
True Colours#500.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#501.src: It would seem our dear Changeling Sovereign worked closely with the prison's warden... for what purpose remains unclear, though I imagine something changeling-adjacent?
True Colours#501.dst: どうやら我らが親愛なるチェンジリングの君主は監獄の看守長と密接に協力していたらしい…目的はまだ不明だが、チェンジリング絡みだろうね？
True Colours#501.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#502.src: Sui, with- with these plans, we could... we could stand a chance of breaking everyone out! We could- we could get them all back!
True Colours#502.dst: Sui、こ―この計画書があれば、僕らは…みんなを脱獄させられるかもしれない！取り―みんなを取り戻せるんだ！
True Colours#502.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#508.src: They're gone, Yusanu! Mora's- Mora's dead.
True Colours#508.dst: いないの、Yusanu！Mora は―Mora は死んだ。
True Colours#508.speaker: Sui

True Colours#509.src: The Sovereign, they... they killed him.
True Colours#509.dst: 君主が…あいつらが殺した。
True Colours#509.speaker: Sui

True Colours#510.dst: …え？じゃ、じゃあ他のみんなは…？
True Colours#510.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#511.src: Just... gone. Taken to the {p}. But, Mora is- he's-
True Colours#511.dst: ただ…いなくなった。{p} に連れて行かれた。でも、Mora は―彼は―
True Colours#511.speaker: Sui

True Colours#512.src: So. So, I- I'm glad you have hope! For... for getting your people back! Good for you!!
True Colours#512.dst: だから。だから、わ―私、あなたに希望があってうれしいよ！仲間を…取り戻す希望が！よかったね！！
True Colours#512.speaker: Sui

True Colours#513.src: Emotions are... certainly running high right now, aren't they! Why don't we, ah, regroup with the rest of the Canopy, and... take some time?
True Colours#513.dst: 感情が…ずいぶん高ぶっているようだね！ここはひとつ、ええと、樹冠の皆と合流して…少し時間を置かないかい？
True Colours#513.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#514.src: Take. Some Time? No. No, I'm done taking time. I'm done crying, I'm done worrying! I'm so... so... angry! At the Crown, at myself, at- at Mora!!!!
True Colours#514.dst: 時間を。置く？いや。いや、時間を置くのはもうたくさん。泣くのも、心配するのももうたくさん！私…すごく…怒ってる！王家に、自分に、M―Mora に！！！！
True Colours#514.speaker: Sui

True Colours#515.src: At all of you for treating me like I can't handle anything myself!!!
True Colours#515.dst: 何もできないみたいに私を扱う、あなたたち全員に！！！
True Colours#515.speaker: Sui

True Colours#516.src: S-Sui, please, I- I understand, but-
True Colours#516.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#517.src: DO YOU?! Do you understand?! Because it SOUNDS like everything's all just fine for you! Your brothers are still alive! You even have a plan to get them back!!
True Colours#517.dst: 「わかる」？！本当にわかるの？！だってあなたは全部うまくいってるみたいじゃない！兄弟はまだ生きてる！取り戻す計画まであるし！！
True Colours#517.speaker: Sui

True Colours#518.src: Rex and Zeph, they... they need me. Need us! And... and I'm not letting anyone else get hurt, or- or- or d-die, not if I can stop it!!
True Colours#518.dst: Rex と Zeph は…私を必要としてる。私たちを！それに…私が止められるなら、もう誰も傷つけさせないし、し―し―死なせない！！
True Colours#518.speaker: Sui

True Colours#519.src: The Crown... the Sovereigns... the Queen... they'll pay. They'll pay for everything they've done to me, and my- m-my... my family...
True Colours#519.dst: 王家…君主たち…女王…償わせてやる。私に、私の―か、家族に…したこと全部、償わせてやる…
True Colours#519.speaker: Sui

True Colours#521.src: And how exactly do you expect to be able to take vengeance in your current state, Sui? I beg of you, please rest before doing something so extreme!
True Colours#521.dst: で、今の状態でどうやって復讐するつもりだい、Sui？頼むから、そんな極端なことをする前に休みたまえ！
True Colours#521.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#522.src: Every minute I waste is another chance for something to go wrong!!! "Fading with each and every passing moment..."
True Colours#522.dst: 一分無駄にするごとに、何かがまずくなる可能性が増えるの！！！「刻一刻と消えていく…」
True Colours#522.speaker: Sui

True Colours#523.src: If- if only we were there sooner, then- th-then... so- so, no. No, I can't rest! I will be getting my family back!
True Colours#523.dst: も、もっと早く着いてたら、そ―そしたら…だ、だから、いや。休んでなんかいられない！家族を取り戻す！
True Colours#523.speaker: Sui

True Colours#524.src: Sui, we... we can't just storm off into a new district without a plan! The Canopy, they- they can help us! And Soosu's device, I'm so close to a breakthrough, I just need-
True Colours#524.dst: Sui、僕ら…計画もなしに新しい地区へ突っ込むなんて無理だよ！樹冠なら―樹冠なら力になってくれる！それに Soosu の装置、もうすぐ突破口が見えそうなんだ、あと―
True Colours#524.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#525.src: Then stay behind, Yusanu. I... I don't need you, anyway.
True Colours#525.dst: なら残ればいい、Yusanu。私…どうせあなたなんていらない。
True Colours#525.speaker: Sui

True Colours#527.src: I said, I don't NEED you, Yusanu! What have you even done this whole time we've been in the {p}?! Taken as hostage, tinkering with- with- with that STUPID device!
True Colours#527.dst: 言ったでしょ、あなたなんて「いらない」の、Yusanu！{p} にいる間、あなたが何をしたっていうの？！人質になって、あの―あの―あの「くだらない」装置をいじってただけ！
True Colours#527.speaker: Sui

True Colours#528.src: YOU haven't had to do any of the work! YOU didn't have to- to run random tasks without explanation! YOU didn't have to- to f-fight and k- k- kill a Sovereign! You... you...
True Colours#528.dst: 「あなた」は何の苦労もしてない！「あなた」は説明もなしに―雑用を走り回らなくてよかった！「あなた」は―た、戦って君主をこ、こ、殺さなくてよかった！あなたは…あなたは…
True Colours#528.speaker: Sui

True Colours#531.src: Is... is there nothing I can say to convince you not to go?
True Colours#531.dst: 行かないよう説得できる言葉は…何もないの？
True Colours#531.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#533.src: Fine. I... I can't follow you, Sui, I can't. I'm going to stay with the Canopy... I'm going to save everyone from Deraj... and I'm going to keep working.
True Colours#533.dst: わかった。僕は…ついて行けないよ、Sui、無理だ。樹冠に残る…Deraj からみんなを救い出す…そして研究を続ける。
True Colours#533.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#534.src: ...well, this doesn't have to be goodbye for good, does it? We shall go our separate paths, for a time, then link back together further down the line!
True Colours#534.dst: …まあ、これが永遠の別れってわけじゃないだろう？しばらくはそれぞれの道を行き、いずれまた合流すればいい！
True Colours#534.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#535.dst: うん…そうだね。いいんじゃない。
True Colours#535.speaker: Sui

True Colours#536.src: Hm. If you're set on this path, you'll surely be dealing with the {p} Sovereign. Ah, Majin of House Thalas... what a delightfully horrible man he is.
True Colours#536.dst: ふむ。その道を行く気なら、{p} の君主と対峙することになるだろう。ああ、Thalas 家の Majin…なんとも愉快で恐ろしい男だ。
True Colours#536.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#537.src: Experience? Ha! Hahahaha! Yes, I suppose you could say that! Goodness. Experience.
True Colours#537.dst: 経験？はっ！ははははは！ああ、そう言えなくもないね！やれやれ。経験ときたか。
True Colours#537.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#538.src: A word of warning... he's an easy man to underestimate. All confidence, bluster, so insufferable you could hardly believe there's anything beneath it all!
True Colours#538.dst: 一つ忠告を…彼は侮られやすい男だ。自信たっぷりで大口ばかり、鼻持ちならなさすぎて、中身があるとは到底思えない！
True Colours#538.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#539.src: But his self-proclaimed "number one" position amongst the Sovereigns isn't just for show! His confidence, his demeanour... all of it is earned. As much as one may wish otherwise!
True Colours#539.dst: だが君主の中で「一番」だという自称は伊達じゃない！あの自信も、あの態度も…すべて実力で勝ち取ったものだ。そうでなければいいのにと思うけどね！
True Colours#539.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#540.src: And there's nothing he loves more than to exert his influence over those beneath him. Which would be, ah... everybody?
True Colours#540.dst: そして下の者に影響力を振るうのが何より好きときた。下の者というのは、ええと…全員かな？
True Colours#540.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#541.src: ... If he has my family, then... it doesn't matter. I won't let him get in my way.
True Colours#541.dst: …あいつが家族を捕まえてるなら…関係ない。邪魔はさせない。
True Colours#541.speaker: Sui

True Colours#542.src: Ooh, frightening. Well, I've said my piece. The rest shall be up to you!
True Colours#542.dst: おお、怖い。まあ、言うべきことは言った。あとは君たち次第だ！
True Colours#542.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#543.src: If you ever have need of us again, we'll have set up camp in the cave we first met. You remember the one, yes? Where I-
True Colours#543.dst: また我々が必要になったら、最初に出会った洞窟に野営しているよ。覚えているだろう？私が―
True Colours#543.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#544.src: Sui, I... I'm sorry for Mora. I hope you can... I hope you can save the others. I really do. Please... don't get yourself killed.
True Colours#544.dst: Sui、僕…Mora のことは残念だった。君が…他のみんなを救えるといいな。本当に。お願いだから…死なないで。
True Colours#544.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#545.src: ...I- I'm not planning on it. Bye, Yusanu.
True Colours#545.dst: …そ、そんなつもりはないよ。じゃあね、Yusanu。
True Colours#545.speaker: Sui

True Colours#000~1.dst: - 被験体 #{~}。食堂から食料を盗んだ。

True Colours#001~1.src: - Subjects require sustenance based on the form they are currently using.
True Colours#001~1.dst: - 被験体には現在の姿に応じた栄養が必要。

True Colours#002~1.src: - Leave no gaps in the cell. Subjects may transform into small creatures in order to escape.
True Colours#002~1.dst: - 独房に隙間を残さないこと。被験体は小さな生き物に変身して脱走する恐れがある。

True Colours#005~1.src: The cabinet is locked. A label reads: Project Hallowground.
True Colours#005~1.dst: 棚には鍵がかかっている。ラベルには「Hallowground 計画」とある。

True Colours#009~1.src: Feel free to take the zipline up to the canopy.
True Colours#009~1.dst: ジップラインで樹冠まで上がっていいよ。

True Colours#011~1.dst: 他にも多くの手順がある…

True Colours#012~1.src: Alright, enough games. Now, dance for me! Hehehahehah!
True Colours#012~1.dst: さて、お遊びはここまでだ。さあ、踊ってみせろ！ヘヘハヘハッ！

True Colours#014~1.src: Changelings are a great asset to any army. They are proven excellent spies.
True Colours#014~1.dst: チェンジリングはどの軍にも大きな戦力だ。優秀な密偵であると実証済み。

True Colours#015~1.src: - Provide subjects with daily stimulus. Enquire with instructors on current curriculum.
True Colours#015~1.dst: - 被験体には毎日刺激を与えること。現行の課程は教官に確認すること。

True Colours#016~1.dst: チェンジリング収容手順:

True Colours#017~1.src: - Yusanu. Wanted. Will be held until Sovereign Majin arrives.
True Colours#017~1.dst: - Yusanu。指名手配。君主 Majin の到着まで拘留する。

True Colours#018~1.src: ...and she needed help. Needed someone powerful - someone from Fruma, but who had also seen... well, all of it. The world, and their impact on it.
True Colours#018~1.dst: …そして彼女は助けを必要としていた。強い者が必要だった - Fruma 出身で、しかも…そう、そのすべてを見てきた者が。この世界と、それに彼らが与えた影響を。

True Colours#020~1.src: Their biology makes them easily adaptable to any situation, they can easily become heat resistant or cold resistant.
True Colours#020~1.dst: その体質ゆえにどんな状況にも容易に適応でき、簡単に暑さや寒さへの耐性を得られる。

True Colours#022~1.src: ...there has to be a key around here somewhere.
True Colours#022~1.dst: …この辺りのどこかに鍵があるはずだ。

True Colours#092~1.src: {u}. It's been... a while since we've really had the chance to talk, hasn't it?
True Colours#092~1.dst: {u}。ちゃんと話す機会がなかったのは…久しぶりだね？
True Colours#092~1.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#147~1.src: I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did, too- and more. Once you know what to look for, it's everywhere. Light and Dark... and the War they leave in their wake.
True Colours#147~1.dst: Gavel でその片鱗を見た…君も見たはずだ、それ以上のものを。何を探すべきか分かれば、至る所にある。光と闇…そしてそれらが後に残す戦争が。
True Colours#147~1.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#148~1.src: The list goes on with various... odd statistics.
True Colours#148~1.dst: リストには様々な…奇妙な数値が続いている。

True Colours#151~1.src: It's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse. They're beyond our means to stop, so... the best we can do is keep them at balance.
True Colours#151~1.dst: 両者が拮抗しているからこそ、これ以上悪くならずに済んでいる。我々に止められる相手ではない、だから…せいぜい均衡を保つことしかできない。

Tunnel Trouble#000.src: Talk to Captain Fenor in front of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tunnel Trouble#000.dst: {p} の前 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる Fenor 隊長と話す。

Tunnel Trouble#001.src: Ah! You must be a new recruit! Well, I've got a mission for you.
Tunnel Trouble#001.dst: おお！新兵だな！よし、任務を与えよう。
Tunnel Trouble#001.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#002.src: There's an old cave behind me. It was used in the Corruption Wars...
Tunnel Trouble#002.dst: 後ろに古い洞窟がある。腐敗戦争で使われたものだ…
Tunnel Trouble#002.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#003.src: We used it for quick and easy travel between {p} and {p}. It’s been abandoned for years.
Tunnel Trouble#003.dst: {p} と {p} を素早く行き来するのに使っていたが、何年も放置されている。
Tunnel Trouble#003.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#004.src: This cave could prove to be very useful for future recruits who need to travel between {p} and {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#004.dst: 今後 {p} と {p} を行き来する新兵にとって、この洞窟は大いに役立つはずだ。
Tunnel Trouble#004.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#005.src: Now, here's where you come in - I need you to clear out that cave route so we can use it once more! Good luck, soldier!
Tunnel Trouble#005.dst: そこで君の出番だ。洞窟の道を片付けて、再び使えるようにしてくれ！健闘を祈る、兵士よ！
Tunnel Trouble#005.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#006.src: Enter the cave behind Captain Fenor at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tunnel Trouble#006.dst: Fenor 隊長の後ろ [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟に入る。

Tunnel Trouble#007.src: ...Oh! Shoot, is it time to get to work already?
Tunnel Trouble#007.dst: …おっと！やべ、もう仕事の時間か？
Tunnel Trouble#007.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#008.dst: で、あんたが例の兵士か？
Tunnel Trouble#008.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#009.src: Uh... well, to start, we'll need to clear that debris. Just... give it a shove, or something. That'll probably do it.
Tunnel Trouble#009.dst: えーと…まずはこの瓦礫をどかさないとな。ちょっと押すとか…それでたぶんいける。
Tunnel Trouble#009.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#010.src: Help Miner Linton remove the debris blocking the path.
Tunnel Trouble#010.dst: 坑夫 Linton と一緒に道をふさぐ瓦礫を取り除く。

Tunnel Trouble#011.src: Pretty easy, huh? Hey, maybe you can just go on ahead, and do the rest yourself?
Tunnel Trouble#011.dst: 楽勝だろ？なあ、いっそあんたが先に行って、残りも片付けてくれない？
Tunnel Trouble#011.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#012.src: ...Yeah, no, I should probably do my job. Let me grab my pickaxe, and we can keep going forward.
Tunnel Trouble#012.dst: …いや、ダメだな、仕事はしなきゃ。ツルハシを取ってくるから、先へ進もう。
Tunnel Trouble#012.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#013.src: Clear the cave of possible roadblocks.
Tunnel Trouble#013.dst: 洞窟の障害になりそうなものを片付ける。

Tunnel Trouble#014.src: Oh, come on... Hey, soldier, do your job! Get rid of those monsters, would you?
Tunnel Trouble#014.dst: おいおい…兵士さん、仕事してくれ！あの魔物どもを片付けてくれよ。
Tunnel Trouble#014.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#016.src: A cave-in? Really? More work for me... I'll make us a way through, just keep fighting those corrupteds!
Tunnel Trouble#016.dst: 落盤？マジかよ？また仕事が増えた…道を掘るから、腐敗した奴らと戦っててくれ！
Tunnel Trouble#016.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#017.src: Halfway there... Ugh, I knew I should have brought explosives...
Tunnel Trouble#017.dst: 半分まで来た…はあ、爆薬を持ってくりゃよかった…
Tunnel Trouble#017.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#018.src: I can see the other side! Just a little more...
Tunnel Trouble#018.dst: 向こう側が見えた！あと少し…
Tunnel Trouble#018.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#019.src: There we go, I've made us a hole! Get over here, quickly!
Tunnel Trouble#019.dst: よし、穴が開いた！早くこっちに来い！
Tunnel Trouble#019.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#020.src: ...Oh, come on. You've got to be kidding me. Another cave-in? Really?
Tunnel Trouble#020.dst: …おいおい。冗談だろ。また落盤？マジで？
Tunnel Trouble#020.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#021.src: And of course it's bigger than the last one. What's my pickaxe going to do against this thing?!
Tunnel Trouble#021.dst: しかも当然、前のよりデカい。ツルハシでこれをどうしろってんだ？！
Tunnel Trouble#021.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#022.src: Really should have thought to bring explosives. Well, soldier, we tried our best! Nobody'll blame us if we give up now.
Tunnel Trouble#022.dst: 爆薬を持ってくるべきだった。まあ兵士さん、俺たちは全力を尽くした！今やめても誰も責めないさ。
Tunnel Trouble#022.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#023.src: ...What? Don't look at me like that. Fine, we can- huh? Do you hear that? Over there, to the right.
Tunnel Trouble#023.dst: …何だよ？そんな目で見るなって。わかった、じゃあ―ん？聞こえるか？あっちだ、右の方。
Tunnel Trouble#023.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#024.src: Oh, uh... Hi... Well, this is a little awkward... I'll just... Go.
Tunnel Trouble#024.dst: あ、えっと…どうも…ちょっと気まずいな…僕はその…行きます。

Tunnel Trouble#025.src: ...You know what? I'm not going to ask. As far as I'm concerned, that didn't happen.
Tunnel Trouble#025.dst: …なあ？俺は聞かないことにする。俺の中では、今のは起きなかった。
Tunnel Trouble#025.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#026.src: Right, of course you want to check it out. Fine! Go ahead. I'll just... sit here and twiddle my thumbs 'till you're back.
Tunnel Trouble#026.dst: そりゃ見に行きたいよな。いいさ！行ってこい。俺は…ここで暇つぶしして待ってるよ。
Tunnel Trouble#026.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#027.src: Investigate the small hole to the right of the large pile of debris.
Tunnel Trouble#027.dst: 大きな瓦礫の山の右にある小さな穴を調べる。

Tunnel Trouble#028.src: Oh... Didn't expect you to follow me... Well, um... Hi! This will sound mad but...
Tunnel Trouble#028.dst: あ…ついてくるとは思わなかった…えっと…こんにちは！変に聞こえるだろうけど…
Tunnel Trouble#028.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#029.src: I'm Drale, and I'm on a mission to free these cows from the enslavement of {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#029.dst: 僕は Drale。{p} に奴隷にされた牛たちを解放する使命を帯びているんだ。
Tunnel Trouble#029.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#030.src: Those farmers stole those cows. They are sacred animals. Now they're about to turn them into steak! If you were to help me, maybe I could help you...
Tunnel Trouble#030.dst: 農夫たちが牛を盗んだんだ。牛は神聖な動物なのに、ステーキにされようとしてる！手伝ってくれたら、僕も君を手伝えるかも…
Tunnel Trouble#030.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#031.src: Go free those innocent cows from enslavement! Qu-quickly! Before that farmer gets back...
Tunnel Trouble#031.dst: 罪のない牛たちを解放してきて！は、早く！農夫が戻ってくる前に…
Tunnel Trouble#031.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#032.src: Where are you going? Come here and talk to me first.
Tunnel Trouble#032.dst: どこへ行くの？まずこっちで話を聞いて。
Tunnel Trouble#032.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#033.src: Free the cows without being seen by the farmer.
Tunnel Trouble#033.dst: 農夫に見つからずに牛を逃がす。

Tunnel Trouble#034.src: Go free the cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...
Tunnel Trouble#034.dst: 屠殺場に連れて行かれる前に、農夫たちから牛を解放して！ああ、屠殺場なんて…
Tunnel Trouble#034.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#035.src: Ah, good to see my cows are all in tip-top shape! Welp, time to- gah!
Tunnel Trouble#035.dst: おお、牛たちはみんな元気いっぱいだな！さて、そろそろ―うわっ！
Tunnel Trouble#035.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#036.src: An intruder! What are you doing with my cows!? Guard golem, attack!
Tunnel Trouble#036.dst: 侵入者だ！俺の牛に何してる！？衛兵ゴーレム、かかれ！
Tunnel Trouble#036.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#037.dst: 農夫の衛兵ゴーレムを倒す。

Tunnel Trouble#038.src: Golem! No! That cost me thousands of emeralds!
Tunnel Trouble#038.dst: ゴーレム！そんな！何千エメラルドもしたのに！
Tunnel Trouble#038.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#039.src: Return to Drale about your success.
Tunnel Trouble#039.dst: Drale のもとに戻り、成功を報告する。

Tunnel Trouble#040.src: Thank you so much, but we're not done yet. We need to get these cows out the province.
Tunnel Trouble#040.dst: 本当にありがとう、でもまだ終わりじゃない。この牛たちを地方の外へ連れ出さないと。
Tunnel Trouble#040.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#041.src: There's a small opening behind me. Go through it and help me get these cows on a raft to Gavel!
Tunnel Trouble#041.dst: 僕の後ろに小さな隙間がある。そこを通って、牛たちを Gavel 行きのいかだに乗せるのを手伝って！
Tunnel Trouble#041.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#042.src: Help Drale push the raft with the cows out to sea.
Tunnel Trouble#042.dst: Drale と一緒に、牛を乗せたいかだを海へ押し出す。

Tunnel Trouble#043.src: There's the raft! Help me push it for the cows!
Tunnel Trouble#043.dst: いかだがあった！牛たちのために押すのを手伝って！
Tunnel Trouble#043.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#044.src: And, that should do it! Be free, my friends! A new life awaits!
Tunnel Trouble#044.dst: よし、これでいい！自由になれ、友よ！新しい人生が待ってる！
Tunnel Trouble#044.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#045.src: Again, thank you so much for what you have done this day. These cows deserve a better life than being farm animals.
Tunnel Trouble#045.dst: 改めて、今日は本当にありがとう。この牛たちには家畜より良い暮らしがふさわしい。
Tunnel Trouble#045.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#046.src: ...Oh! Right! You were busy with something before you came to help me, weren't you? Hm... I think I might be able to help you with that as well! Let's go back to the tunnel!
Tunnel Trouble#046.dst: …あっ！そうだ！僕を手伝う前、何か用事の途中だったよね？うーん…それも手伝えるかも！トンネルに戻ろう！
Tunnel Trouble#046.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#047.src: Return to Miner Linton back in the abandoned cave.
Tunnel Trouble#047.dst: 放棄された洞窟にいる坑夫 Linton のもとへ戻る。

Tunnel Trouble#048.src: Oh, good, you're back. It's been, like, an hour! What were you even doing for that long!
Tunnel Trouble#048.dst: おお、戻ったか。もう一時間くらい経ったぞ！そんなに長く何してたんだよ！
Tunnel Trouble#048.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#049.src: ...You helped some crazy cow-obsessed lunatic steal some cows? I don't think you're allowed to do that. There's a law against that, or something.
Tunnel Trouble#049.dst: …牛にとりつかれた変人の牛泥棒を手伝った？それってダメなんじゃないか。たしか法律で禁止されてるとか。
Tunnel Trouble#049.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#050.src: Eh. Not that I really care, either way. I've certainly done worse.
Tunnel Trouble#050.dst: まあ、どっちでもいいけどな。俺ももっとひどいことをしてきた。
Tunnel Trouble#050.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#051.src: Well then! Ready to call it quits? We're definitely not going to make any progress, so we might as we-
Tunnel Trouble#051.dst: さてと！もうやめにするか？どうせこれ以上進めないんだし、いっそ―
Tunnel Trouble#051.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#052.src: Hello again, friend! I'm here with help! Cows, to me!
Tunnel Trouble#052.dst: また会ったね、友よ！助っ人を連れてきた！牛たち、おいで！
Tunnel Trouble#052.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#054.src: Since you helped me with my problem, I thought I should repay that favor by helping you!
Tunnel Trouble#054.dst: 僕の問題を解決してくれたから、今度は僕が恩返しに手伝おうと思って！
Tunnel Trouble#054.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#055.src: Welp, see ya! Oh, and nice to meet you, miner! Now, let's get going my cows!
Tunnel Trouble#055.dst: じゃあね！あと、会えてよかったよ坑夫さん！さあ行こう、牛たち！
Tunnel Trouble#055.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#056.src: ...I- huh. You saw that too, right? I didn't just imagine that?
Tunnel Trouble#056.dst: …お、俺―はあ。あんたも見たよな？俺の幻覚じゃないよな？
Tunnel Trouble#056.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#057.src: You know what? I think I quit. I think this has finally pushed me to my limit! I didn't know that I had one, but apparently I do!
Tunnel Trouble#057.dst: なあ？俺、辞めるわ。今度こそ限界だ！限界なんてないと思ってたけど、あったらしい！
Tunnel Trouble#057.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#058.src: You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while we do that, I'll be searching for a better career.
Tunnel Trouble#058.dst: あんたは…先に行ってくれ。向こう側の誰かに、成功したって伝えてくれ。その間に俺はもっといい仕事を探すよ。
Tunnel Trouble#058.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#060.src: Speak to Sergeant Klafson next to the {p} entrance of the cave.
Tunnel Trouble#060.dst: 洞窟の {p} 側出口のそばにいる Klafson 軍曹と話す。

Tunnel Trouble#061.src: Recruit, Captain Fenor told me to meet you here, said if you came out on this side of that tunnel then you completed your mission!
Tunnel Trouble#061.dst: 新兵、Fenor 隊長からここで待つよう言われた。トンネルのこちら側から出てきたら任務完了だとな！
Tunnel Trouble#061.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Tunnel Trouble#062.src: You did a great deed today, soldier! We can now use this cave to travel easily between {p} and {p}! Great job!
Tunnel Trouble#062.dst: 今日は大手柄だ、兵士！これで {p} と {p} をこの洞窟で楽に行き来できる！よくやった！
Tunnel Trouble#062.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Underice#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} にいる Fredris と話す

Underice#001.src: I'm having trouble with the fish in our lake recently and I am sure the problem lies within the lake itself.
Underice#001.dst: 最近湖の魚のことで困っていて、原因は湖そのものにあると確信しているんだ。
Underice#001.speaker: Fredris

Underice#002.src: I would like to commission you to investigate, but since it's freezing cold in our lake you need something to protect you. I heard the people in {p} on the coast of Wynn have something that can help you.
Underice#002.dst: 調査を頼みたいが、湖は凍えるほど冷たいから身を守る物が必要だ。Wynn の海岸にある {p} の人々が役立つ物を持っていると聞いた。
Underice#002.speaker: Fredris

Underice#003.src: Would you mind coming back with a [Breathing Helmet I]? I think that should be everything you need.
Underice#003.dst: [Breathing Helmet I] を持ってきてくれないか？それさえあれば十分だと思う。
Underice#003.speaker: Fredris

Underice#004.src: Return to {p} and bring Fredris a [Breathing Helmet I]
Underice#004.dst: {p} に戻り、Fredris に [Breathing Helmet I] を届ける

Underice#005.src: What is this thing supposed to be? You know, I would really appreciate your help, but this [Breathing Helmet I] does not look like it's going to keep you protected.
Underice#005.dst: これは何のつもりだ？手伝ってくれるのは本当にありがたいが、この [Breathing Helmet I] じゃ身を守れそうにない。
Underice#005.speaker: Fredris

Underice#006.src: Would you mind heading to our local armour merchant and buying one of our [Breathing Helmet II]? I don't want you to drown. Just come back with the helmet and I will tell you about my problem.
Underice#006.dst: 地元の防具商人から [Breathing Helmet II] を買ってきてくれないか？溺れられちゃ困る。ヘルメットを持ってきたら、問題を話そう。
Underice#006.speaker: Fredris

Underice#007.src: Buy a [Breathing Helmet II] and find the underwater cave
Underice#007.dst: [Breathing Helmet II] を買い、水中洞窟を見つける

Underice#008.src: Explore the cave underneath the frozen lake in {p}
Underice#008.dst: {p} の凍った湖の下にある洞窟を探索する

Underice#009.src: Who are you? You don't look like one of those villagers we stole the fi... Wait, they didn't send you to retrieve "their" fish, did they?
Underice#009.dst: 誰だ？俺たちが魚を盗んだ村人には見えないが…待て、まさか「奴らの」魚を取り返しに来たのか？
Underice#009.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#010.src: For years we let them share the lake with us, the actual inhabitants of it, we were modest and took what we needed, we let them catch the rest. But then they went too far, they caught too much.
Underice#010.dst: 何年も、この湖の本当の住人である俺たちは奴らと湖を分け合ってきた。控えめに必要な分だけ取り、残りは奴らに獲らせた。だが奴らはやり過ぎた、獲りすぎたんだ。
Underice#010.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#011.src: We didn't have enough to eat, we were forced to steal their fish, we would have starved otherwise. And now they want their fish, our fish back? We can't do that, I hope you understand.
Underice#011.dst: 食べる物が足りず、魚を盗むしかなかった。でなきゃ飢え死にだ。なのに奴らの魚、俺たちの魚を返せだと？それはできない、わかってくれ。
Underice#011.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#012.src: However, we don't have to fight over the fish in the lake, we just need a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], that would be enough, nothing else. We never wanted to steal the fish.
Underice#012.dst: だが湖の魚を奪い合う必要はない。[Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish] が一匹あればそれで十分だ。魚を盗みたかったわけじゃない。
Underice#012.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#013.src: If you want to help us and the villagers, just follow the stream that flows into this lake to the south, you will find the best fishing ground there. The pufferfish should be around there too.
Underice#013.dst: 俺たちと村人を助けたいなら、この湖に流れ込む川を南へたどれ。最高の釣り場がある。フグもその辺りにいるはずだ。
Underice#013.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#014.src: Follow the river south to find the fishing dock
Underice#014.dst: 川を南へたどり、釣り場の桟橋を見つける

Underice#015.src: Oh you look a bit lost, let me help you, I've lived here for a long time, I know every corner and every snowflake.
Underice#015.dst: おや、迷ったようじゃな。手伝おう。わしは長くここに住み、隅々から雪のひとひらまで知っとる。
Underice#015.speaker: Gernald

Underice#016.src: You're searching for a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish]? Hmm I heard that name before, my friend, Strato, told me about it years ago. If I remember correctly it is infinite, you can feed every single person in all the provinces from this single fish.
Underice#016.dst: [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish] を探しとるのか？ふむ、聞いたことがある。友の Strato が昔話してくれた。確か尽きることのない魚で、その一匹で全地方の人々を養えるそうじゃ。
Underice#016.speaker: Gernald

Underice#017.src: Sadly Strato is no longer alive. He used to work and live at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}. We always met here, caught fish and told each other stories. I really miss those times...
Underice#017.dst: 残念ながら Strato はもうおらん。{p} の北西にある伐採キャンプで働き、暮らしておった。わしらはいつもここで会い、魚を釣って話をしたものじゃ。あの頃が懐かしい…
Underice#017.speaker: Gernald

Underice#018.src: Maybe you can find some sort of bait there, he had some of the best bait I have ever seen. You should be able to acquire some and throw it in water, maybe that will attract the pufferfish.
Underice#018.dst: そこで何か餌が見つかるかもしれん。あやつの餌は見たこともないほど上等じゃった。手に入れて水に投げれば、フグが寄ってくるかもしれん。
Underice#018.speaker: Gernald

Underice#019.src: Can I ask you something? As you might see I'm not the richest guy, or the youngest. If you manage to catch that fish, could you hand it over? I know we just met but you seem like somebody who would help an old man.
Underice#019.dst: ひとつ頼んでいいかの？見ての通り、わしは金持ちでも若くもない。その魚を釣れたら、譲ってくれんか？会ったばかりじゃが、あんたは年寄りを助けてくれる人に見える。
Underice#019.speaker: Gernald

Underice#020.src: Obtain the bait at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}, use it to catch the fish and then give it to Calamaro or Gernald
Underice#020.dst: {p} の北西の伐採キャンプで餌を手に入れ、魚を釣って Calamaro か Gernald に渡す

Underice#021.src: Just look at those fish, I told you they love this bait.
Underice#021.dst: あの魚を見てみい、この餌が大好きだと言ったじゃろ。
Underice#021.speaker: Gernald

Underice#022.src: There it comes, the [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], I can't believe it!
Underice#022.dst: 来たぞ、[Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish] じゃ、信じられん！
Underice#022.speaker: Gernald

Underice#023.src: You decided to give me the fish? I wish Strato was still around, he would be so amazed. I can't show you how much this means to me, but take this little gift, please, promise me to never change.
Underice#023.dst: 魚をわしにくれるのか？Strato がまだおったら、さぞ驚いたじゃろう。どれほど嬉しいか言い表せんが、このささやかな礼を受け取ってくれ。どうか変わらずにいておくれ。
Underice#023.speaker: Gernald

Underice#024.src: You found a pufferfish! Who would have thought such a small thing could solve our problem. I will start bringing back the fish immediately, but first we will have a nice hot soup. Please take this as payback for your services.
Underice#024.dst: フグを見つけたか！こんな小さい物で問題が解決するとはな。すぐに魚を戻し始めるが、まずは熱いスープだ。手伝いの礼にこれを受け取ってくれ。
Underice#024.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#025.src: You can trade it at the shop right over there, it's hard to miss. I will give you a last advise, you don't want to eat that slimy fish.
Underice#025.dst: そこの店で交換できる、すぐわかるはずだ。最後に忠告だ、あのヌルヌルした魚は食べないほうがいい。
Underice#025.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#026.src: Meet up with Fredris in {p} and claim your reward
Underice#026.dst: {p} の Fredris に会い、報酬を受け取る

Underice#027.src: Oh you are done with whatever you were doing? I heard you ran around the whole place, I don't know if you were the right person to ask for help...
Underice#027.dst: おや、用事は済んだのか？あちこち走り回っていたと聞いたぞ。頼む相手を間違えたかな…
Underice#027.speaker: Fredris

Underice#028.src: I will just ask the next one who comes around, no need to have you run around all day. Take this, I appreciate your effort.
Underice#028.dst: 次に来た人に頼むことにするよ、一日中走らせるのも悪い。これを受け取ってくれ、苦労に感謝する。
Underice#028.speaker: Fredris

Underice#029.src: A real disaster! I can't believe this is happening to me!
Underice#029.dst: 大災難だ！まさか自分にこんなことが！
Underice#029.speaker: Fredris

Underice#030.src: I've been fishing for the last few days and I caught nothing! Zilch! This isn't normal!
Underice#030.dst: ここ数日釣りをしてるのに一匹も釣れない！ゼロだ！こんなのおかしい！
Underice#030.speaker: Fredris

Underice#031.src: I spent my entire life fishing in this area! I wish I could dive under this ice to fix the problem myself...
Underice#031.dst: この辺りで一生釣りをしてきたんだ！氷の下に潜って自分で解決できたらいいのに…
Underice#031.speaker: Fredris

Underice#032.src: Do you think you could help me? You might actually be exactly what I need!
Underice#032.dst: 手伝ってくれないか？君こそ求めていた人かもしれない！
Underice#032.speaker: Fredris

Underice#033.src: Enter my shack, there you will find the entrance... Good luck!
Underice#033.dst: 小屋に入れば入口がある…幸運を！
Underice#033.speaker: Fredris

Underice#034.src: Explore under the ice to find a cause to the fish problem. You'll need the Breathing Helmet for this.
Underice#034.dst: 氷の下を探索し、魚の問題の原因を見つける。Breathing Helmet が必要だ。

Underice#035.src: Talk to Squidward in the Squid Village.
Underice#035.dst: イカの村で Squidward と話す。

Underice#036.src: Have I seen any fish? No, of course not! I don't even know what a fish looks like!
Underice#036.dst: 魚を見たか？まさか！魚がどんな姿かも知らないね！
Underice#036.speaker: Squidward

Underice#037.src: Who could be stealing all those fish? I wonder! Actually...
Underice#037.dst: 誰が魚を盗んでるんだろうな？不思議だ！実は…
Underice#037.speaker: Squidward

Underice#038.src: I'm sure Calamaro did it! He's just that kind of guy. He lives in that house down there.
Underice#038.dst: Calamaro の仕業に決まってる！あいつはそういう奴さ。下の家に住んでるよ。
Underice#038.speaker: Squidward

Underice#039.src: Find Calamaro in the Squid Village.
Underice#039.dst: イカの村で Calamaro を見つける。

Underice#040.src: Me? Stealing fish? You are out of your mind! It's obviously Kroken who is stealing them!
Underice#040.dst: 俺が？魚泥棒？正気か！盗んでるのはどう見ても Kroken だ！
Underice#040.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#041.src: He lives right on top of that waterfall right there, if you want to go talk to him.
Underice#041.dst: あいつはあの滝のすぐ上に住んでる。話したきゃ行ってみな。
Underice#041.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#042.src: Find Kroken in the Squid Village.
Underice#042.dst: イカの村で Kroken を見つける。

Underice#043.src: Do I look like someone who steals fish?
Underice#043.dst: 俺が魚泥棒に見えるか？
Underice#043.speaker: Kroken

Underice#044.src: It's obvious that Squidward did it, he has tons of crates full of fish!
Underice#044.dst: Squidward の仕業に決まってる、魚の詰まった木箱が山ほどある！
Underice#044.speaker: Kroken

Underice#045.dst: Squidward のもとに戻って話す。

Underice#046.src: Okay, okay, fine! It was me all along... I know, what a shock, right?
Underice#046.dst: わかった、わかったよ！全部俺だ…驚いただろ？
Underice#046.speaker: Squidward

Underice#047.src: Okay, I got a proposition for you. Bring me [{~} Raw Fish] and I will stop, deal?
Underice#047.dst: よし、取引だ。[{~} Raw Fish] を持ってきたらやめてやる、どうだ？
Underice#047.speaker: Squidward

Underice#049.src: Bring back {~} Raw Fish to Squidward.
Underice#049.dst: Squidward に Raw Fish を {~} 匹持っていく。

Underice#050.dst: よし、魚を持ってきたな！
Underice#050.speaker: Squidward

Underice#051.src: You can trust me, I won't touch the fish in the frozen lake anymore!
Underice#051.dst: 信じてくれ、凍った湖の魚にはもう手を出さない！
Underice#051.speaker: Squidward

Underice#052.src: Talk to Fredris to collect your reward.
Underice#052.dst: Fredris から報酬を受け取る。

Underice#053.src: Your story really doesn't make sense. Villagers living in a squid village under the lake? Pff!
Underice#053.dst: その話は筋が通らない。湖の下のイカの村に村人が住んでる？ふん！
Underice#053.speaker: Fredris

Underice#054.src: However, if you can garantee me that my problem is gone, I'll trust you.
Underice#054.dst: だが問題が消えたと保証してくれるなら、信じよう。
Underice#054.speaker: Fredris

Underice#055.src: Thank you for your help. Here, take these...
Underice#055.dst: 助けてくれてありがとう。さあ、これを…
Underice#055.speaker: Fredris

Undersupply#000.src: Investigate the river settlement's water troubles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で川沿いの集落の水不足を調べる。

Undersupply#001.src: Oho, now that's some dress I've not seen in many a moon! You're one of those {p} folk, aren't ya? Quite some luxury ya must've lived with.
Undersupply#001.dst: おほう、こんな身なりは久しく見とらんわい！{p} の者じゃろ？さぞ贅沢な暮らしをしとったんじゃろうな。
Undersupply#001.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#002.src: 's a bit more humble down here in the shadow of the dam. Surprised someone like you would take the trip, but it ain't a complaint. Getting about to see the world is a fine endeavor!
Undersupply#002.dst: このダムの陰の暮らしはもっと質素じゃよ。あんたみたいなのが来るとは驚いたが、文句じゃない。世界を見て回るのは立派なことじゃ！
Undersupply#002.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#003.src: Unfortunately, the bar here's dry. Sure, I got alcohol, but you drink that, and you'll be passing more water than ya took in. Dries you right out, and right now we haven't got any water to spare. Dangerous, y'know?
Undersupply#003.dst: あいにく、うちの酒場は干上がっとる。酒はあるが、飲めば飲んだ以上に水が出ていく。体がカラカラになるし、今は水の余裕がこれっぽっちもない。危ないじゃろ？
Undersupply#003.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#004.src: The dam opens up every month or so to let out some water for us, but is passes through a noble manor, past the hill, rationed out to the rest of the forest.
Undersupply#004.dst: ダムはひと月ごとに開いて水を流すんじゃが、丘の向こうの貴族の屋敷を通って、森の各地へ配られるんじゃ。
Undersupply#004.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#005.src: It's so little though, nowadays. The children are going thirsty. The muck in the riverbeds is more mud than water- so even if ya boil it out like I do, what you get is foul trifles.
Undersupply#005.dst: じゃが近頃はほんのわずかでな。子供らが喉を渇かしとる。川底は水より泥じゃ。わしのように煮沸しても、出てくるのは汚い水ばかり。
Undersupply#005.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#006.src: Didn't used to be like this, though. Ain't sure what's changed, but I'm just an old geezer. I've lived my life enough- it's what it's doing to the kids that has me worried. ...say, stranger.
Undersupply#006.dst: 昔はこうじゃなかった。何が変わったのか知らんが、わしはただの老いぼれ。もう十分生きた。心配なのは子供らのことじゃ。…なあ、旅の人。
Undersupply#006.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#007.src: If you're touring about here, you'll probably see the manor soon enough. If ya could get them to spare us some more water a while, I'll give ya a discount! How's about it?
Undersupply#007.dst: この辺を回るなら、じきに屋敷が見えるじゃろう。しばらく水を多めに流すよう頼んでくれたら、値引きしてやるぞ！どうじゃ？
Undersupply#007.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#008.src: Ain't quite sure how you would go about convincing the nobles to let out more water for us, I admit. If I did, I'd take the trek up the hill myself- even in spite of my creaky ol' back.
Undersupply#008.dst: 正直、貴族を説得して水を増やしてもらう方法は、わしにもわからん。わかっとったら、きしむ腰でも自分で丘を登っとるわい。
Undersupply#008.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#009.src: Even if it's just getting them to put a word in to the Sovereign. I imagine that come-lately Zhiraok would do something about it all. I swear that man doesn't know what sleep is...
